tgt: Isimo seKhabhinethi ezindabeni ezisemqoka esimweni samanje.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse batho ba Zimbabwe le mekga ya dipolotiki ka ho tshwara dikgetho tse hlophisitsweng hantle tsa palamente le tsa dibaka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela abantu baseZimbabwe kanye namaqembu ezepolitiki mayelana nokubamba ngempumelelo ukhetho lwephalamende kanye nolwezindawo.

src: Kabinete e rorisitse matsapa a Mopresidente Jacob Zuma e le Monamodi ya emetseng Selekane sa Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tsa Borwa ba Aforika Ditherisanong tsa Zimbabwe, ho netefatseng hore mekga yohle ya dipolotiki e ikitlaelleditse dikgetho tse nang le kgotso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yayishayela ihlombe imizamo yokuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke amaqembu ezepolitiki ayazibophezela ekubambeni ukhetho ngokuthula, eyenziwa uMongameli Jacob Zuma njengoMholi oqokwe Inhlangano Ethuthukisa Amazwe ase-Afrika Eseningizimu ukuthi ahole Izingxoxo Phakathi Kwamaqembu Ezepolitiki eZimbabwe.

src: Kabinete e seollotse tlhaselo ya qhomane moahong o sebediswang ke basebetsi ba Boqosa ba Turkey mane Mogadishu, Somalia, ya ba ya fetisa melaetsa ya matshediso Mebusong ya Somalia le Turkey.
tgt: IKhabinethi yasigxeka isenzo sokuhlasela ngebhomu isakhiwo okuhlala kusona izisebenzi Zendlu Yenxusa lase-Turkey edolobheni laseMogadishu, eSomalia, futhi lathumela amazwi enduduzo kuHulumeni waseSomalia nowase-Turkey kanye nakubantu bakulawo mazwe.

src: Selemong se etellang pele phethelo ya Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho, kabinete e ikamahanya le setjhaba ho ketekeng Kgwedi ya Basadi tlasa mookotaba o reng “Dilemokgolo tsa ho Sebetsa Mmoho Matlafatsong ya Basadi ya Nako e Telele le Tekano ya Bong.”Dilemokgolo di tlotla dintwa tsa tokoloho tse lwannweng ke basadi haesale ho tloha ha moitseki ya qollehang, Charlotte Maxeke, a ile a etella pele sehlopha sa basadi mohwantong wa Bloemfontein o neng o hanana le melao ya dipasa ka 1913.Seabo se entsweng ke basadi twantshong ya melao ya dipasa esita le dikarolong tse ding tsa ntwa ya tokoloho ke ntho ya bohlokwa ya kgothatso Kareteng ya Boitsebiso e sa tswa thakgolwa.
tgt: Njengoba kungasensuku zatshwala ngaphambi kokuthi kugujwe iMinyaka engama-20 Yenkululeko, iKhabhinethi ihlanganyela nesizwe ukugubha iNyanga Yabesifazane ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi “Iminyaka Eyikhulu Yokusebenzisana Ukuze Kufezekiswe Ukunikwa Kwabesifazane Amandla Ngendlela Esimeme kanye Nokulingana Ngokobulili”.Ukugujwa kweminyaka eyikhulu yisenzo sokuhlonipha umzabalazo wabesifazane kusukela ngenkathi isishabasheki esihlonishwayo, u-Charlotte Maxeke, ehola imashi yeqembu labesifazane e-Bloemfontein yokubhikishela imithetho yamapasi ngowe-1913.Igalelo labesifazane empini yokulwisana nemithetho yamapasi kanye nakweminye imikhakha yomzabalazo wenkululeko kuyingxenye ebalulekile enikeze ugqozi lokuthi kwenziwe uMazisi Oyikhadi owethulwe esikhathini esifushane esedlule.

src: Jwaloka ha setjhaba se keteka basadi, Kabinete e boela e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho satalla kgahlanong le tlhekefetso efe kapa efe ya basadi le bana esita le ho hlompha ditokelo tsa basadi jwaloka ha di fuperwe ke Molaotheo.
tgt: Njengoba isizwe sibungaza abesifazane, iKhabhinethi ihlaba futhi ikhwelo eliqondiswe kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika lokuthi kumele babhukule balwisane nokuxhashazwa kwabesifazane nezingane futhi bahloniphe amalungelo abesifazane njengoba evikelwe kuMthethosisekelo wethu.

src: Kabinete e ile ya pheta teboho ya pejana ya Mopresidente Jacob Zuma setjhabeng esita le matjhabeng ka ho etsa Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Nelson Mandela hore e be letsatsi le leholohadi ho fihlela jwale la keteko ya matswalo a Madiba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igcizelela emagameni okubonga ashiwo uMongameli Jacob Zuma phambilini ngenkathi ebonga isizwe kanye nomphakathi wamazwe ngamazwe ngokwenza Usuku lukaNelson Mandela Lwamazwe Ngamazwe lube umgubho omkhulu wosuku lokuzalwa lukaMadiba kunayo yonke eyenziwe esikhathini esedlule.

src: Mohla la 18 Phupu, diketekete tsa batho Aforika Borwa ka bophara le lefatsheng di ile tsa ipha nako ya ho ya thusa batho ba sotlehang.
tgt: Mhla ziyi-18 kuNtulikazi, izinkulungwane zabantu eNingizimu Afrika kanye nasemhlabeni jikelele, zithethe isikhathi sazo zakhwica imikhono zasiza abantu abahluphekayo.

src: Kabinete e ipileditse ho maAforika Borwa ho tshehetsa tlhomamiso ya Letsatsi la Dipapadi le Botjhaba la Nelson Mandela Lebaleng la FNB, Johannesburg, mohla la 17 Phato.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxuse abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi basekele umcimbi ozobanjwa okokuqala ngqa woSuku lukaNelson Mandela Lwezemidlalo Namasiko ozobanjelwa eNkundleni Yezemidlalo i-FNB, eGoli mhla ziyi-17 kuNcwaba.

src: Di-Springbok di tla bapala le Argentina, Bafana Bafana yona e tla thulana le Burkina Faso athe sehlopha sa bolo ya maoto sa Mekaubere sa Aforika Borwa se tla bapala le sa Italy, ho tla latela khonsarete ya mmino e tletseng dikgalala tsa dibini ka phirimana.
tgt: Amabhokobhoko azodlala ne-Argentina, iBafana Bafana izwane amandla ne-Burkina Faso bese Iqembu Lomakadebona Kwezikanobhutshuzwayo laseNingizimu Afrika libhekana ne-Italy, kanti kusihlwa kuzolandela ikhonsathi lomculo lapho kuboshelwe khona izinkakha zabaculi.

src: Tjhelete yohle e bokelletsweng moo e tla iswa projekeng ya kaho ya sepetlele sa Bana sa Nelson Mandela.
tgt: Yonke imali ezotholakala kulo mcimbi izongena kwisikhwama somklamo wokwakhiwa kwesibhedlela sezingane sikaNelson Mandela.

src: Kabinete e ile ya boela ya pheta kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ho “Nka Kgato ho Kgothalletsa Phetoho (le) ho Etsa hore Letsatsi le leng le le leng e be Letsatsi la Mandela”.Kabinete e tswelapele ho ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ohle hore a tswelepele ho bea Mopresidente wa mehleng Nelson Mandela menahanong le merapelong ya wona jwaloka ha a ntse a hlaphohelwa tshebedisong ya meriana ya kalafo.
tgt: IKhabinethi yagcizelela futhi kwikhwela eliqondiswe kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika lokuthi “Babhukule Balethe Ugqozi Loguquko (futhi) Benze Usuku Ngalunye Nsukuzonke Lube Usuku lukaMandela”.

src: Kabinete e mahlonokong ka ho hlokahala ha Moahlodi e Moholo wa mehleng Pius Langa, ya bolokilweng ka la 3 Phato nakong ya Lepato le Kgethehileng la Semmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaqhubeka nokuhlaba ikhwelo elibhekiswe kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi bangamlibali uMongameli wangaphambilini uNelson Mandela futhi bambeke emikhulekweni yabo njengoba eseqala ukwelulama kancane.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso ho lelapa la hae, metswalle le basebetsimmoho.
tgt: IKhabinethi idumele ngokudlula emhlabeni kwalowo owayeyiJaji Eliyinhloko uPius Langa owafihlwa mhla zizi-3 kuNcwaba 2013 ngoMngcwabo Okhethekile Owenzelwa Izikhulu Zikahulumeni.

src: Moahlodi e Moholo wa mehleng Pius Langa o tla hopolwa ka seabo sa hae Ntweng ya tokoloho, tshireletso ya hae ya demokrasi ya rona e tataiswang ke molaotheo, athe morao tjena, le ka mosebetsi wa hae Khomisheneng ya Bolokolohi ba Ditaba.
tgt: IJaji Eliyinhloko langaphambilini uPius Langa uzokhunjulwa ngegalelo lakhe emzabalazweni wenkululeko, nokuvikela kwakhe intando yeningi yethu esekelwe phezu komthethosisekelo, kanye nomsebenzi abewenza esikhathini esifushane esedlule kwiKhomishana Yenkululeko Yezamaphephandaba.6 IKhabhinethi iyazamukela izinyathelo ezinhle ezithathiwe emkhakheni wezemfundo, ikakhulu eziphathelene nokuqiniswa kweSitatimende Senqubomgomo Yohlelo Lwezifundo Nokuhlola kanye nokwesekwa okuqhubekayo okuvela kothisha mayelana nokuqaliswa kwalolu hlelo.

src: Kabinete e hlokomela boteng ba dikgatelopele tse ntle lekaleng la thuto, haholoholo matlafatsong ya Setatemente sa Leano la Kharikhulamo le Tekanyetso esita le tshehetso e ntseng e tswelapele ya matitjhere ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha sona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yakwamukela ukusungulwa kweThimba Elijutshe ukuthi liphathe ukuqaliswa kohlelo lwezifundo Lolimi Lokukhuluma Ngezandla LwaseNingizimu Afrika ngowezi 2014 kusukela kwiBanga-R kuya kwiBanga-12, ngokwekhwelo likaMongameli lokuthi ulimi lokukhuluma ngezandla luthathwe njengolimi olusemthethweni.

src: Kharikhulamo e ntjha e tla fana ka phihlello etomanyana menyetleng ya thuto bakeng sa bohle.
tgt: Uhlelo olusha lwezifundo luzokhulisa izinga lokufinyelela kwabo bonke abantu emathubeni ezemfundo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho ba qetileng materiki ka 2013 ho ingodisa hona jwale ditheong tsa thuto e phahameng bakeng sa 2014 ho ya ka Letsholo la Khetha la Etsa Kopo Hona Jwale!
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo eliqondiswe kubafundi bakamatikuletsheni bonyaka wezi-2013 ukuthi babhalise njengamanje kwizikhungo zemfundo ephakeme abafuna ukufunda kuzona ngowezi-2014 ngokomkhankaso woMnyango Wemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqesha obizwa ngokuthi Faka Isicelo Njengamanje!

src: Baithuti ba kgothalletswa ho ba sedi ha ba kgetha seo ba batlang ho ithutela sona, ba be ba sekaseke ditlhoko tsa bona tsa ditjhelete.
tgt: Abafundi bayakhuthazwa ukuthi bacabangisise kahle ngaphambi kokuthi baqoke umsebenzi abafuna ukuwufundela futhi babheke nezidingo zabo zezimali.

src: Baithuti ba hopotswa ka Sekema sa Setjhaba sa Thuso ya Baithuti ka Ditjhelete, se fanang ka thuso ya ditjhelete ho ba tshwanelehileng ho ya ka mesebetsi ya bona e metle dithutong esita le baithuti ba hlokang ditjhelete.
tgt: Abafundi bayakhunjuzwa ngeSikimu Sikazwelonke SokusizaAbafundi Ngezimali lesi sikimu sisiza abafundi abenza kahle emsebenzini wabo wesikole futhi abadinga ukuxhaswa ngezimali.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa thakgolo ya kanale ya ditaba tsa thelevishene tsa ka nako tsohle ya Lekgotla la Kgaso la Aforika Borwa e rarollang tlhokeho e dulang e eketseha ya kgaso ya ditaba tsa moraorao diketsahalong tsa bohlokwa tsa naha le tsa matjhaba ebile e fa maAforika Borwa ohle lepatlelo la ho hlahisa maikutlo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isishayela ihlombe isenzo sokwethulwa kwesiteshi sikamabonakude seNhlangano Yezokusakaza yaseNingizimu Afrika esisakaza izindaba amahora angama-24 esizobhekana nesidingo esikhulayo sokusakazwa kwezindaba ezisematheni eziphathelene nemicimbi esemqoka kuzwelonke kanye nezizwe ngezizwe futhi sihlinzeka ngezwi kanye nesigcawu kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Cameron van der Burgh, Chad le Clos le Giulio Zorzi disesi tse entseng hore naha e be motlotlo ka ho hapa dikgau Ditlhodisanong tsa Lefatshe tsa 15 tsa Mokgatlo wa Matjhabatjhaba wa ho Sesa Barcelona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela ababhukudi oCameron van der Burgh, Chad le Clos kanye noGiulio Zorzi abenze ukuthi izwe liziqhenye ngokunqoba izindondo eMqhudelwaneni Wamazwe Ngamazwe we-15 Wenhlangano Yezokubhukuda Emhlabeni owawubanjelwe e-Barcelona.10 IKhabhinethi yathumela izilokotho ezinhle kumaSulumani aseNingizimu Afrika ngenkathi enze idili lokuqeda isikhathi sokuzila ukudla i-Eid.

src: Kabinete e lakaleditse Mamoseleme a Aforika Borwa mahlohonolo jwaloka ha a keteka Eid.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ifisela noMphakathi WamaJuda aseNingizimu Afrika okuhle kodwa ngenkathi ugubha inyanga ka-Elul.

src: Dipuisano le diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izingxoxo nezinqumo zeKhabhinethi eziqavile.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho thakgolwa ha mosebetsi wa dipuisano wa Lefapha la Merero ya Metsi bakeng sa Maemo a Maano a Naha a Metsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamukele ngokusemthethweni ukuqaliswa kohlelo lokubonisana mayelana neZimo Zenqubogomo Kazwelonke Yezamanzi oluqaliswe nguMnyango Wezamanzi.

src: Sepheo sa tjhebolobotjha ya leano lena ke ho fumana le ho lokisa ditlamorao dife kapa dife tse sa rerwang esita le dikgeo maanong a jwale a metsi.
tgt: Injongo yalokhu kubuyekezwa kwenqubomgomo ukuthola imbangela yemiphumela ebonakalayo ebingahlosiwe futhi ukuze kulungiswe lokhu kanye namagebe akhona kwizinqubomgomo zezamanzi ezisebenzayo njengamanje.

src: Sena se reretswe ho fihlella sepheo sa Mmuso sa phihlello e lekanang ya metsi ebile e le ya nako e telele.
tgt: Ngalokhu kuhloswe ukuthi kufezekiswe injongo kaHulumeni yokuthi abantu bathole amanzi ngendlela elinganayo futhi esimeme.

src: Maemo a lekotsweng botjha a maano a tla thusa ho ajweng botjha ha metsi ho basebedisi ba metsi ba neng ba kotetswe nakong e fetileng.
tgt: Izimo zenqubomgomo ezibuyekeziwe zizolekelela ekwabiweni kabusha kwamanzi kubasebenzisi bamanzi ababencishwe amathuba ngaphambilini, phakathi kwabanye.

src: A tla boela a netefatsa hore ha ho meralo ya motheo ya metsi e tla kwekwetla setjhaba, haholoholo setjhaba sa mahaeng se hlokang mehlodi metsi.
tgt: Futhi zizoqinisekisa ukuthi ayikho ingqalasizinda ezodlula eceleni noma igweme imiphakathi, ikakhulu ezindaweni zasemakhaya ezingenazo ingcebo zamanzi.

src: Kabinete e ananetse phatlalatso ya Leano la Naha la Boithuelo ba Thepa, bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba ka nako ya matsatsi a 30.Leano le habile ho amanya le ho rarolla kahohlehohle dintlha tse fapafapaneng tse amanang le boithuelo ba thepa, bo phopholetsang hohle dinthong tse fapafapaneng, ho akga: kgwebisano, saense, temo le bophelo bo botle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamukele ngokusemthethweni ukushicilelwa kweNqubomgomo Kazwelonke Yamalungelo Omsebenzi Umuntu Aziqambele Wona, ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngayo esikhathini esiyizinsuku ezingama-30.Le Nqubomgomo ihlose ukuqinisekisa ukuhambelana okuphelele futhi ibhekane nezindaba ezinhlobonhlobo eziphathelene namalungelo omsebenzi umuntu aziqambele wona, futhi lokhu kubandakanya imikhakha eminingi, kufaka phakathi lena elandelayo: ezohwebo, ezesayensi, ezolimo kanye nezempilo.

src: Kahoo ho na le tlhokeho ya mokgwatshebetso o le mong wa leano boemong ba naha le ba matjhaba ho tswa Mmusong.
tgt: Ngakho-ke kunesidingo esivela kuHulumeni sokuthi kube nenqubomgomo eyodwa ezingeni likazwelonke kanye nelamazwe ngamazwe.

src: Kabinete e ananetse moralo wa leano bakeng sa tiso eo motheo wa yona e leng baahi ka sehlooho se reng “Moralo wa ho Matlafatsa dilekane tsa Baahi le Mmuso bakeng sa Tiso Phanong ya Ditshebeletso tsa Mantlha”.Mafapha a mmuso a amehang phanong ya ditshebeletso setjhabeng, a lebelletswe ho fetofetola tiso ya wona le meralo ya tlhahlobo ho kenyelletsa mekgwa ya ho kopanya maikutlo le malebela a baahi phanong ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamukele ngokusemthethweni uhlaka lwenqubomgomo lokuqapha okusekelwe emphakathini olunesihloko esithi “Uhlaka Lokuqinisa ukubambisana Phakathi kweZakhamuzi kanye Nohulumeni mayelana nokuQapha Ukuhlinzekwa Kwezidingongqangi”.Iminyango kahulumeni ebandakanyekayo ekuhlinzekeni umphakathi ngezidingongqangi, kudingeka ukuthi, ilungise izinhlaka zayo zokuqapha nokuhlola ukuze zibandakanye izindlela zokusebenzisa imibono nezinto ezenzeke ezimpilweni zezakhamuzi mayelana nokuhlinzekwa kwezidingongqangi.

src: Sena se rala motheo wa ho kopanya tiso eo motheo wa yona e leng baahi le mokgwa wa tiso wa mmuso.
tgt: Lokhu kubeka isisekelo sokuhlanganisa ukuqapha okusekelwe emphakathini kwindlela kahulumeni yokuqapha.

src: Sena se rala motheo bakeng sa ho kopanya tiso eo motheo wa yona e leng setjhaba mokgweng wa tiso wa mmuso.
tgt: KuloIu hlaka, ukuqapha okusekelwe emphakathini kusho indlela yokuqapha ukusebenza kukahulumeni egxile ezintweni ezenzeke ezimpilweni zezakhamuzi ezijwayelekile ukuze kuqiniswe ukuphendula kukahulumeni futhi kuqhubeke imizamo yokwenza ngcono ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingongqangi.

src: Moralong ona, tiso eo motheo wa yona e leng baahi o hlalosa mokgwa wa tiso tshebetsong ya mmuso e tsepamisang maikutlo malebeleng a baahi ho matlafatsa boikarabelo ba setjhaba le ho sututsa dintlafatso phanong ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamukele ngokusemthethweni iMigomo Yokuphatha Emkhakheni Kahulumeni kanye Nokudluliswa Kwamandla Okuphathwa Kwezimali.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Mekgwatsamaiso ya Tsamaiso ya Setjhaba le Dithomo tsa Bolaodi ba Ditjhelete.
tgt: Le migomo ihlinzeka ngomhlahlandlela wokuthi amandla esiPhathimandla adluliselwa kanjani esiKhulwini Esiphendulayo futhi ehliselwe nasezinhlakeni ezisemazingeni aphansi ngokulayela koMthetho Wemisebenzi kaHulumeni kanye noMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali zikaHulumeni.

src: Mekgwatshebetso e fana ka tataiso ya kamoo matla a Tshusumetso ya Phethahatso a neanwang ka teng ho Mohlanka ya Ikarabellang esita le ho ya boemong bo tlasenyana jwaloka ha ho hlakisitswe Molaong wa Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba le Molao wa Tsamaiso ya Ditjhelete tsa Setjhaba.
tgt: Le migomo yenza ibe lula inqubo yokudlulisa amandla, futhi lokho kugqugquzela ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingongqangi ngendlela efanele.

src: Kabinete e se e ananetse ditumellano tse latelang hore di amohelwa Palamenteng ho ya ka Karolo ya 231 ya Molaotheo wa Aforika Borwa: Ya pele, phihlello ya Aforika Borwa Tumellanong ya ho thewa ha Khomishene ya Tjhuna Lewatleng la India (IOTC), Ya bobedi ke Seboka se Seholo sa Poloko ya Tuna ya Bluefin ka Borwa (CCSBT) le Ya boraro, e leng Mokgatlo wa Dijo le Temo (FAO) wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng Tumellanong ya Mekgwatsamaiso ya Lediboho la Naha ho Thibela, ho se Kgothalletse le ho Fedisa Botshwasi ba Ditlhapi bo seng Molaong, bo sa Tlalehwang bo bile bo sa Laolwe (IUU).Letona la Temothuo, Meru le tsa Ditlhapi le lona le se le ikamahantse le kopano ena e le ho thatoloha ka boleng bo tla tliswa ke sena indastering ya botshwasi ba ditlhapi le seabo sa yona ho hodiseng moruo wa rona.
tgt: Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNgqongqoshe Wemisebenzi kaHulumeni Nokuphathwa Kwayo uzohlinzeka ngemininingwane ethe xaxa mayelana neMigomo nemithelela yayo.5 IKhabhinethi yamukele ngokusemthethweni lezi zivumelwano zoxolo okuzovunyelwana ngazo ePhalamende ngokwesigaba-231 soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika: Esokuqala, Ukusayinda kweNingizimu Afrika iSivumelwano sokusungulwa kweKhomishana ye-Indian Ocean Tuna, esesibili iSivumelwano Sokongiwa Kohlobo Lwenhlanzi Ebizwa nge-Bluefin Tuna (CCSBT) kanye nesesithathu, Isivumelwano Sesimo Sezinyathelo Zamachweba Sokuvimbela kanye Nokuqeda Umkhuba Wokudoba Okungekho Emthethweni, Okungabikiwe futhi Okungalawulwa (IUU) soPhiko Lwezokudla Nezolimo lweNhlangano Yezizwe (FAO).UNgqongqoshe Wezolimo, Amahlathi Nokudoba naye usezibandakanye nalesi sigcawu sokuhlinzeka ngolwazi ukuze achaze ngokuthe xaxa ngosizo oluzolethwa yilokho embonini yezokudoba kanye negalelo layo lokuthuthukisa umnotho wethu.6 IKhabhinethi yakwamukela ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika izosingatha iNgqungquthela ye-11 Yamazwe Abambe Iqhaza (COP) kwiSivumelwano sase-Abidjan ezobanjelwa eKapa mhla zingama 24-28 kuNdasa 2014.Isivumelwano sase-Abidjan singesinye seZivumelwano eziyi-18 Zamalwandle Zezifunda lapho uHlelo lweNhlangano Yezizwe Lwezemvelo lwenza khona izinhlelo zokusebenza njengengxenye yokuqaliswa kwe-Ajenda yase-Stockholm yowe-1972.Lesi Sivumelwano sihlinzeka ngohlaka lwezomthetho lokubambisana ngokwezifunda phakathi kweMibuso ethintekile ukuze kuthathwe izinyathelo ngokubambisana zokuxazulula izinkinga ezixhumene eziphathelene nemvelo yasogwini neyasolwandle ababelana ngayo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse hore Aforika Borwa e tla tshwara Seboka sa 11 sa Mekgatlo (COP) se hlahlamang Seboka se seholo sa Abidjan Cape Town ho tloha mohla la 24-28 Hlakubele 2014.Seboka se seholo sa Abidjan ke se seng sa tse 18 tsa Diboka tse Kgolo tsa Mabatowa a Mawatleng moo merero ya Tshebetso e ileng ya thewa ke Lenaneo la Tikoloho la Matjhaba a Kopaneng e le karolo ya ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lenanetsamaiso la Stockholm la 1972.Seboka se Seholo se fana ka moralo wa molao bakeng sa tshebedisano mmoho ya mabatowa Dinaheng tse amehang ho ikatlaelletsa tshebetso e kopanetsweng mabapi le ho rarolla mathata a nyalanang a tikoloho ya mabopo le mawatle ao di abelanang ka wona.
tgt: Uhlaka oluphezulu kunazo zonke oluthatha izinqumo ngeSivumelwano sase-Abidjan yiNgqungquthela Ye- COP) okuwumhlangano obanjwa njalo emva kweminyaka emibili ohlanganisa ngaphansi kophahla olulodwa oNgqongqoshe Bezemvelo kanye nochwepheshe abavela eMazweni asayinde iSivumelwano, kanye kanye nemibuso eyizingqapheli, kanye nezinhlangano Zezizwe Ezibumbene nezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni.7 IKhabhinethi yanikezwa imininingwane mayelana nombiko wokubamba iqhaza kwethimba elabe limele iNingizimu Afrika kwiSigcawu sama-57 seKhomishana Yesimo Sabesifazane yeNhlangano Yezizwe, esabanjwa kusukela mhla zizi-4 kuya mhla ziyi-15 kuNdasa 2013.Isigcawu sama-57 sasibanjelwe eKomkhulu leNhlangano Yezizwe e-New York, futhi isihloko esasibekwe eqhulwini sasithi “Ukuqedwa Kodlame Olubhekiswe Kwabesifazane Namantombazane”.Kwenziwa izibophezelo eziningana futhi zamukelwa njengezinqumo ngababambiqhaza mayelana nokuqedwa kodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane namantombazane.

src: Setheo se hodimodimo sa Seboka se Seholo sa Abidjan se etsang diqeto, ke COP, e leng kopano ya ka morao a dilemo tse pedi e kgobokanyang Matona a Tikoloho le ditsebi tsa dintho tse sa utlwisiseheng habobebe tse tswang mekgatlong e Dumellanang, esita le dinaha tsa bolemohi, dieijensi tse ding tsa Matjhaba a Kopaneng le mekgatlo eo e seng ya mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yahlaba ikhwelo eliqondiswe eminyangweni kahulumeni yonke ukuthi ibambe iqhaza ekuqalisweni kwalezi zibophezelo.8 Ikhabinethi yamukele ngokusemthethweni ukuthunyelwa Kwisigungu seNhlangano Yezizwe kombiko wenqubekelaphambili Wokubuyekezwa Kwesimo Sesikhathi Esimaphakathi Esiphathelene Nengculazi eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e ile ya kumelwa ka tlaleho ya seabo sa borumuwa ba Aforika Borwa Mmokeng wa 57 wa Khomishene ya Matjhaba a Kopaneng ho tsa Maemo a Basadi, o neng o tshwerwe ho tloha ka la 4 ho isa ho la 15 Hlakubele 2013.Mmoka wa 57 o ne o tshwaretswe Ntlokgolo ya Matjhaba a Kopaneng New York, mme mookotaba o ka sehloohong e ne e le “Phediso ya Dikgoka kgahlanong le Basadi le Banana.”Boitlamo bo tomanyana bo ile ba etswa ba ba ba ananelwa ke ba neng ba nka seabo phedisong ya dikgoka kgahlanong le basadi le banana.
tgt: Umbiko uphendula kwisiMemezelo Sezepolitiki esiphathelene nezinto esiyi-10 okumele zifezekiswe mayelana negciwane lesandulelangculazi kanye nengculazi ezisuselwa kwiqoqwana lezinkomba eziwumongo.

src: Kabinete e entse kgoeletso mafapheng ohle ho kenya letsoho ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha boitlamo bona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yawushayela ihlombe uMnyango Wezempilo ngombiko okhombisa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iqhubeka kahle emizamweni yayo yokuthi ibe seyifezekise eziningi izinkomba ezingumongo uma kufika unyaka wezi-2015 ongumnqamulajuqu.

src: Kabinete e rorisitse Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle ka tlaleho e bontshang hore Aforika Borwa e motjheng wa ho fihlella bongata ba matshwao ka nako e sehilweng ya 20.9 Kabinete e ile ya kumelwa ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Karolo ya 100 (1)
tgt: IKhabhinethi yanikezwa imininingwane ephathelene nokuqaliswa kweSigaba 100 (1)

src: ya ho thusetsa Profenseng ya Limpopo.
tgt: sohlelo lokungenelela eSifundazweni saseLimpopo.

src: Ba ile ba hlokomediswa ka diphumano tse ka sehloohong tse tlalehong ya tlhahlobo, mehato ya thusetso e sisintsweng le kgatelopele e seng e entswe ho fihlela jwale.
tgt: Labikelwa ngemiphumela ebalulekile yombiko wokucwaningwa nokuhlaziywa kwesimo, nezinhlelo zokungenelela kanye nenqubekelaphambili eseyenziwe kuze kube manje.

src: Ba ile ba boela ba hlokomediswa ka dintho tse ntseng di salletse tse ntseng di tshwanela ho phethelwa.
tgt: Babikelwa futhi mayelana nezinye izindaba ezingakaphothulwa okudingeka ukuthi ziphothulwe.

src: Ho fihlela ka la 31 Phupu 2013 palo ya tjhelete ya mokitlane e ne e le R.3 bilione papisong le sekepele sa kadimo sa R.7 bilione ha Limpopo e ne e kena tlasa botsamaisi ka Tshitwe 2011.Kamora ho kgotsofalla mehato ya tokiso e sebedisitsweng mafapheng a mahlano a tlasa botsamaisi, Kabinete e ananetse hore Komiti ya Matona e ka tswelapele ka mosebetsi wa dikgwedi tse tsheletseng wa phetoho o dipakeng wa ho neelana ka botsamaisi ba Limpopo ho Tonakgolo le Phethahatso ya hae e ntjha.
tgt: Mhla zingama-31 kuNtulikazi 2013 ibhalansi yemali ekhona emgodleni kahulumeni wesifundazwe kwabe kuyizigidigidi ezingu-R3,3 uma kuqhathaniswa nemali eyayisetshenziswe ngokweqile eyizigidigidi ezingu-R1,7 ngenkathi isifundazwe sifakwa ngaphansi kohlelo lokulawulwa ngoZibandlela 2011.Ngokubona impumelelo yezinyathelo zokulungisa isimo eminyangweni emihlanu engaphansi kohlelo lokulawulwa, iKhabhinethi ivumile ukuthi iKomidi loNgqongqoshe liqalise amalungiselelo ohlelo lwezinyanga eziyisithupha lokubuyisela ukuphathwa kweLimpopo kuNdunankulu kanye neKhabhinethi yakhe entsha.

src: Kabinete e dumetse hore dipatlisiso tse tomanyana di tshwanela ho tswelapele dinthong tse tobaneng le ho utolla mesebetsi e mebe mme moo batho ba fumanwang ba ile ba sitisa mekgwatsamaiso ya phumantsho, dikgato tse tshwanelehileng tsa kgalemo di tla nkuwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yavuma ukuthi luqhubeke uphenyo oluhlose ukuvundulula izigameko zomkhonyovu owenziwa, futhi kumele kube nohlelo lokuqondiswa kwezigwegwe uma kutholakala ukuthi abantu abalandelanga inqubo efanele yokuthengwa kwempahla nemisebenzi.

src: Komiti ya Matona e tla fana ka ditaba tse phethahetseng ka nako e nepahetseng.
tgt: Kuzoba nesinye isigcawu esizohlinzeka ngolwazi oluthe xaxa esizokwenziwa yiKomidi loNgqongqoshe ngesikhathi esifanele.

src: Dibili.
tgt: IMithethosivivinywa.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya tsa Molao ya Meteroloji Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamukela ukwethulwa koMthethosivivinywa Wezokukalwa Kwesisindo Sezimpahla Okusemthethweni ePhalamende.

src: Bili e reretswe ho tataisa ho metha ho entsweng ke indasteri ha ho hwebisanwa ho sebediswa dikala, dimithara le disebediswa tse ding tsa ho metha ho botsekeng.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa wenzelwe ukunikeza umhlahlandlela wokuqinisekisa ukuthi konke ukukalwa kwezinto okwenziwa abezimboni uma bethengisa izimpahla besebenzisa izikali, amamitha kanye neminye imishini yokukala kukhombisa isisindo soqobo.

src: Sepheo sa Bili ke ho kgothalletsa kgwebisano e hlokang leeme, le ho tshireletsa bophelo bo botle le polokeho le tikoloho setjhabeng.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uhlose ukugqugquzela ukuhweba ngokwethembeka, kanye nokuvikela impilo nokuphepha komphakathi kanye nemvelo.

src: Bili ena e tla boela e rarolla pherekano e Molaong wa jwale wa Meteroloji ya Kgwebisano (1973).Bili ena ke ntho ya bohlokwa tshebedisong e ntlehadi ya meralo ya motheo ya setekgeniki e fupereng Maemo, Tiiso ya Boleng, Kamohelo le Mekgwatshebediso ya meteroloji (SQAM) Aforika Borwa.
tgt: UMthethosivinywa uzolungisa nezinkinga zokungahambelani kahle okukhona kuMthetho Wezikali Zokuhweba we-1973 okhona njengamanje.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Sehlomathiso ya Meriana le Dithethefatsi tse Amanang le yona, 2012 Palamenteng.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa usemqoka kakhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukusebenza kahle kweNgqalasizinda yaseNingizimu Afrika ebandakanya Uhlelo Lwamazinga, Ukuqinisekiswa Kwekhwalithi, Ukugunyazwa kanye Nokukala Isisindo Sezimpahla.. IKhabhinethi yamukela ukwethulwa koMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela Umthetho Wezemithi Nezinto Ezihlobene Nalokho, 2012 ePhalamende.

src: Bili e hlomathisa Molao wa Meriana le Dithethefatsi tse Amanang le yona, 1965 (Molao wa 101 wa 1965) jwaloka ha o hlomathisit swe ke Molao wa 72 wa 2008.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho Wezemithi kanye Nezinto Ezihlobene Nalokho, we-1965 (uMthetho Nombolo.

src: Bili e habile ho thea setheo sa taolo ya meriana se matla, se setle se bile se sebetsa ka bokgabane.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uhlose ukusungula uphiko lokulawula ezemithi oluqinile futhi olusebenza kahle.

src: DithonyoKabinete e ananetse dithonyo tse latelang:.
tgt: AbaqashiweIKhabhinethi yamukele ukuqashwa kwalaba abalandelayo:.

src: Moprofesara Edith Veronica Vries o hirilwe e le Motsamaisi e Moholo Lefapheng la Temo, Meru le tsa Ditlhapi.
tgt: USolwazi Edith Veronica Vries oqashwe njengoMqondisi-Jikelele eMnyangweni Wezolimo, Ezamahlathi Nezokudoba.

src: Mme Duduzile Charity Baby Mbongwa o hirilwe e le Motlatsi wa Motsamaisi e Moholo: Mawa le Tshebetso Bopresidenteng.
tgt: UNksz Duduzile Charity Baby Mbongwa oqashwe njengePhini LikaMqondisi-Jikelele : Ophikweni Lwezamasu kanye Nemisebenzi eHhovisi likaMongameli.

src: Mme Loraine Elzabe Rossouw o hirilwe e le Mohlanka e Moholo wa tsa Ditjhelete Lefapheng la Toka le Ntshetsopele ya Molaotheo.
tgt: UNksz Loraine Elzabe Rossouw oqashwe njengeSikhulu Esiyinhloko Sokuphathwa Kwezimali eMnyangweni Wezobulungiswa kanye Nokuthuthukiswa KoMthethosisekelo.

src: Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa bohlokwa maemong a ha jwale.
tgt: Isimo seKhabhinethi ezindabeni ezisemqoka esimweni samanje.

src: Kabinete e amohetse ho kgakolwa phatlalatsa ha kgatiso ya botshelela ya Matshwao a Ntshetsopele ke Letona la Bopresidenteng la Bodisa le Tlhahlobo ya Tshebetso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yakwemukela ukwethulwa emphakathini koshicilelo lwesithupha lweziNkomba Zentuthuko okwenziwa nguNgqongqoshe oseHhovisi likaMongameli Owengamele Ukuqapha Nokuhlolwa Komsebenzi.

src: Jwaloka ha setjhaba se hlophisetsa ho keteka Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho, maAforika Borwa a tshwanela ho ba motlotlo ka hore bophelo bo fetohile ba ba ba ntlafala haesale ho tloha ka 1994.Matshwao a bontsha ntlafalo dinthong tsa bohlokwa athe a boela a supa mosebetsi o boima o ntseng o tshwanela ho etswa ho sebetsana le tse ding tsa diphephetso tsa rona tse ntseng di iphetapheta.
tgt: Njengoba isizwe silungiselela ukugubha iMinyaka engama-20 Yenkululeko, abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kumele baziqhenye ngokuthi impilo seyishintshile yaba ngcono kusukela ngowe-1994.Izinkomba zibonisa ubungcono emikhakheni ebalulekile futhi kusenjalo zikhombisa nokuzikhandla okusamele kwenzeke ukuze kubhekwane nezinye zezinselelo zethu ezingafuni ukushabalala.

src: Ho feta moo, matshwao a kgothalletsa ngangisano ka diphephetso tseo naha ya rona e tobaneng le tsona mme a boela a sebetsa ho thusa leetong la rona la kgatelopele ya moruo le phedisano.
tgt: Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkomba zikhuthaza inkulumo-mpikiswano ephathelene nezinselelo ezibhekene nelizwe lethu futhi zisebenza njengezinkombandlela ohambweni lwethu lwenqubekelaphambili kwezenhlalo nezomnotho.

src: Kabinete e rorisitse 41% (115) ya bomasepala ba fumanweng ba se na diphoso ditsamaisong tsa ditjhelete ha ho ne ho etswa bahlahlobi ba dibuka tsa ditjhelete ba 2011/2012.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yancoma omasipala abangama-41% (115) abathola izitatimende ezikhombisa ukusetshenziswa kahle kwezimali ngenkathi kwenziwa ucwaningo lokusetshenziswa kwezimali lowezi-2011/12.

src: E boetse ya ananela ntlafalo e entsweng ke bomasepala ba 21 bao nakong e fetileng ba ileng ba fumana ditsheollo tse amanang le selemo se fetileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamukela futhi nobungcono obubonakalayo komasipala abangama-21 phambilini ababethole imibiko emibi yokucwaningwa kwezimali, noma isimo sokusetshenziswa kwezimali ngendlela enhlakanhlaka okwenza ukuthi uMcwaningimabhuku Omkhulu ahluleke ukukhipha umbiko oqondile mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwezimali ngonyaka ofile.

src: Kabinete e ananela mosebetsi o entsweng ke Kantoro ya Mohlakisi Kakaretso ka ho thusa bomasepala ho ntlafatsa ditlhoko tsa bona tsa boikamahanyo pusong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawuthakasela umsebenzi owenziwa nguMcwaningimabhuku Omkhulu wokulekelela omasipala ukuthi basebenze kangcono mayelana nokufezekiswa kwezidingo zokuthotshelwa kwemigomo yokuphatha.

src: E ile ya boela ya ananela boikitlaetso bo entsweng ke boetapele ba bomasepala hore ba tswele pele ho sebeletsa ntlafalo dinthong tse hlakisitsweng ke Kantoro ya Mohlakisi Kakaretso.3 Kabinete e lebohile maAforika Borwa ohle ka ho tshehetsa Letsatsi la Dipapadi le Botjhaba la Nelson Mandela le neng le tshwaretswe ho thusa projeke ya Sepetlele sa Bana sa Nelson Mandela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamukela futhi nokuzibophezela okwenziwe abaholi bomasipala mayelana nokuthi bazoqhubeka nokuzikhandla ngenhloso yokwenza ngcono imikhakha egcizelelwe nguMcwaningimabhuku Omkhulu.3 IKhabhinethi yabonga bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokweseka kwabo uSuku luka-Nelson Mandela Lwezemidlalo Namasiko olwalusingathelwe ukuxhasa ngezimali iphrojekthi yokwakhiwa kweSibhedlela Sezingane sika-Nelson Mandela.

src: MaAforika Borwa a kgothalletswa ho tswelapele ho sebetsa dibakeng tsa bona le ho sebedisana le mmuso ho ntlafatsa maphelo a baahi esita le ho kenya tshebetsong mehopolo eo Madiba a ileng a nyehela bophelo ba hae ka lebaka la yona.4 Kabinete e nketse hloohong leeto le tlang la Mopresidente Jacob Zuma la ho ya Rephaboliking ya Russia.
tgt: Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakhuthazwa ukuthi baqhubeke nokusebenza emiphakathini futhi babambisane nohulumeni ukwenza ngcono izimpilo zezakhamuzi kanye nokufezekisa izifiso zikaMadiba anikela kuzona ngempilo yakhe.4 IKhabhinethi ikuphawulile ukuthi uMongameli uJacob Zuma uzobhekisa amabombo kwiRiphabhulikhi yase-Rashiya.

src: O tla be a ya Sebokeng sa Setlamo sa 20 (G20) St Petersburg mohla la 5 le 6 Loetse 2013 e le karolo ya ho phahamisa ditabatabelo tsa Aforika Borwa tsa sepolotiki le tsa moruo.
tgt: Uzobe eyokwethamela iNgqungquthela Yeqembu Lamazwe angama-20 (i-G20) ezobanjelwa edolobheni lase-St Petersburg mhla ziyisi-5 namhla ziyisi-6 kuMandulo 2013 njengengxenye yokugqugquzela izimfuno zeNingizimu Afrika zezepolitiki nezomnotho.

src: Aforika Borwa e tswelapele ho tshehetsa morero wa G20 wa ntshetsopele o ntshetsang pele botsitso ba moruo lefatsheng esita le kgolo le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi tse tla itjara ka nako e telele.5 Kabinete e rorisitse kopano ya pele ya Lekgotla la Kgwebo la Brazil, Russia, India, China le Aforika Borwa (BRICS), moo baetapele ba kgwebo ho tswa dinaheng tsena ba neng ba kgobokana Aforika Borwa.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika iyaqhubeka nokweseka i-ajenda ye-G20 yezentuthuko eqhuba umzamo wokuqiniseka ukuzinza komnotho emhlabeni kanye nokukhula komnotho okusimeme okuzodonsa isikhathi eside kanye nokuvulwa kwamathuba emisebenzi.5 IKhabhinethi yawuncoma umhlangano wokuqala woMkhandlu Wezamabhizinisi Wombimbi Olubunjwe yi-Brazil, iRashiya, iNdiya, iShayina kanye neNingizimu Afrika (i-BRICS), lapho kwabuthana khona eNingizimu Afrika abaholi bezamabhizinisi abavela kulawa mazwe.

src: Kopanong ena ho ile ha boela ha eba teng baetapele ba bohlokwa ba kgwebo ba tswang dinaheng tse ding tse 19 tsa Aforika.6 Kabinete e amohetse tiisetso e fanweng Foramong ya bo12 ya Molao wa Kgolo le Monyetla wa Aforika (AGOA) ya ho ntjhafatsa AGOA pele e fellwa ke nako ka 2015.
tgt: Lo mhlangano wawuhanjelwe futhi ngabaholi bezamabhizinisi abaqavile abavela kwamanye amazwe ase-Afrika ayi-.6 IKhabhinethi yasamukela ngezandla ezimhlophe isiqinisekiso esanikezwa yiSithangamu se-12 esibanjwa minyaka yonke soMthetho weNtuthuko namaThuba we-Afrika (i-AGOA) sokuvuselela i-AGOA ngaphambi kokuthi iphelelwe isikhathi ngowezi-2015.

src: AGOA e foletse molemo ho tswa nahakgolo ya Amerika le ya Aforika ya ba ya tshehetsa kgwebisano ya naha tse pedi dipakeng tsa Aforika Borwa le Amerika e ntseng e hola ebile e tsitsa.
tgt: I-AGOA seyihlomulise izwe laseMelika kanye nezwekazi lase-Afrika futhi yasekela nobudlelwano bokuhwebelana obukhulayo futhi obuzinzile phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika neMelika.

src: Aforika Borwa e dumela hore AGOA ke moralo o nepahetseng wa ho aha dikamano tse matla, tumellano ya kgwebisano ya dinaha tse pedi le matsete mme e matlafatsa tshebedisanommoho dipakeng tsa Amerika le nahakgolo ya Aforika ka bophara..7 E le karolo ya naha ka bophara ya ho keteka Kgwedi ya Basadi, Motlatsi wa Mopresidente Kgalema Motlanthe o tla etela Motsaneng wa Gombani o Masepaleng wa Mutale, Limpopo, ka Labohlano mohla la 23 Phato 2013 ho ya neelana ka matlo setjhabeng.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika ikholelwa ukuthi i-AGOA ihlinzeka ngohlaka olufanelekile lokwakha ubudlelwano obunohlonze bokuhwebelana kanye nokutshalwa kwezimali futhi iqinisa nokubambisana phakathi kweMelika nezwekazi lase-Afrika lonkana.7 Njengengxenye yemigubho yeNyanga Yabesifazane ethe chithisaka ezweni lonke, iPhini likaMongameli uKgalema Motlanthe uzohambela indawo yase-Gombani, engaphansi kwaMasipala wase-Mutale, e-Limpopo, ngoLwesihlanu mhla zingama-23 Ncwaba 2013, lapho eyonikeza khona umphakathi izindlu.

src: 05 Sep Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa bohlokwa maemong a ha jwale.
tgt: 05 Sep Isimo seKhabhinethi ezindabeni ezisemqoka esimweni samanje.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha Tokomane ya Tshebetso ya Setjhaba ebile e thoholetsa mekgatlo ya basebetsi tshebeletsong ya setjhaba esita le Mmuso e le mohiri boikitlaetsong bo entsweng Tokomaneng ena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukwethulwa koMqulu Wemisebenzi KaHulumeni futhi izishayela ihlombe izinyunyana zabasebenzi bakahulumeni, kanye noMbuso njengomqashi, ngezibophezelo abazenze kulo Mqulu.

src: Tokomane e teka maemo a tshebeletso kahara tshebeletso ya setjhaba moo mekgatlo ya basebetsi tshebeletsong ya setjhaba e itlamang ho tshehetsa maemo a tshebeletso.
tgt: UMqulu wethula amazinga okusebenza emkhakheni wemisebenzi kahulumeni, futhi izinyunyana zabasebenzi bakahulumeni zazibophezela ukuthi zizowasekela la mazinga okusebenza.

src: Kabinete e hlokomela hore hajwale makala a mangata a kene kapa a ile a kena ditherisanong tsa meputso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaphawula ukuthi njengamanje noma esikhathini esedlule imikhakha eminingi beyimatasatasa ezingxoxweni zamaholo.

src: Kabinete e amohela ditumellano tse fihlelletsweng makaleng a mang mme e a tseba ka ditherisano tse ntseng di tswelapele makaleng a mang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izamukela ngezandla ezimhlophe izivumelwano osekufinyelelwe kuzona emikhakheni ethile futhi iyaphawula ukuthi kweminye imikhakha zisaqhubeka izingxoxo.

src: Kabinete e a ananela hore moo demokrasi e leng teng, basebetsi ba na le tokelo ya ho ipelaetsa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazi ukuthi ezweni elinombuso wentando yeningi, abasebenzi banelungelo lokuteleka.

src: Kabinete e thasisetsa hore tokelo e jwalo e tlameha ho etswa ka mokgwa o se nang dikgoka ebile e le o ikamahanyang le molao ka hohlehohle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyagcizelela ukuthi lelo lungelo kumele lifezekiswe ngaphandle kodlame futhi kumele kuthotshelwe umthetho ngokuphelele.

src: Ho na le boikarabelo baetapeleng ba mekgatlo ya basebetsi, bahiri le ditshebeletso tsa naha tsa tshireletso ho netefatsa hore molao ha o tlolwe, ho qojwa diketso tsa ho e lata letailana le hore mehwanto e etswe ka kgotso.
tgt: Abaholi bezinyunyana, nabaqashi kanye nophiko lombuso lwezokuvikeleka banesibopho sokuqinisekisa ukuthi umthetho uyathotshelwa, nokuthi ziyagwemeka izenzo ezikhombisa uchuku futhi isiteleka senzeka ngendlela ephephile.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa mekgatlong yohle ho sebedisa matsapa a yona ho phethela ditherisano kapelepele esita le ho qoba diqhwebeshano tsa nako e telele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxenxa wonke amaqembu ukuthi enze konke okusemandleni awo ukuphothula izingxoxo zamaholo ngokushesha ukuze kugwemeke imibango ezodonsa isikhathi eside.

src: Ditumellano tseo tsa kapelepele di tla thusa ho fokotsa ditjeo moruong di be di kgothaletse katleho ya naha sepheong sa mesebetsi le kgolo.
tgt: Izivumelwano zamaholo ezenziwa ngokushesha zizonciphisa izindleko emnothweni wakuleli futhi lokho kugqugquzela ukufezekiswa kwezinjongo zokuvulwa kwamathuba emisebenzi kanye nokukhula komnotho kuleli lizwe.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Lekgotla la bobedi la Merafo la Selemo le selemo le neng le tshwerwe bekeng e fetileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yakwamukela ukubanjwa kwe-Lekgotla Yaminyaka Yonke Yezezimayini ebibanjwe ngesonto eledlule.

src: Lekgotla le hlahisitse monyetla o mong bakeng sa ba ka sehloohong ba amehang indastering ya merafo ho tswelapele ho fumaneng ditharollo tsa nako e telele diphephetsong tse thefulang lekala lena.
tgt: I-Lekgotla yahlinzeka ababambiqhaza ababalulekile embonini yezimayini ngelinye ithuba lokuhlanganisa amakhanda ngenhloso yokuthola ikhambi elizoziqeda ngokuphelele izinselelo esezikhahlameze lo mkhakha.

src: Tlasa boetapele ba Motlatsi wa Mopresidente Kgalema Motlanthe, mmuso le wona o tswelapele ho tshehetsa tumellano ya moralo esita le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha lekala la merafo le nang le boitjaro ba nako e telele le bile le tsitsitse.
tgt: Ngaphansi kobuholi bePhini likaMongameli uKgalema Motlanthe uhulumeni uyaqhubeka futhi nokweseka uhlaka lwesivumelwano kanye nokuqaliswa kwalo ukuze kube nesimo esisimeme futhi esizinzile emkhakheni wezimayini.

src: Ditokisetsong tsa Tokoloho ya Dilemo tse 20 mohla la 27 Mmesa 2014, Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho hopola nalane ya rona le ho keteka botjhaba ba rona bo kopaneng ka ho se tshwane nakong ya Kgwedi ya Letlotlo la Setjhaba.
tgt: Njengoba kubhekwe emgubhweni weMinyaka engama-20 Yenkululeko ngomhla zingama-27 Mbasa 2014, iKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo eliqondiswe kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi bakhumbule umlando wethu futhi bagubhe amasiko ethu ahlukahlukene ngeNyanga Yamagugu.

src: Mekete ya monongwaha e tla tshwauwa tlasa mookotaba o reng: “Ho tseka botjha, ho Kgutlisa le ho Keteka Letlotlo la rona la Setjhaba le Phelang”.Mekete ya Letsatsi la Letlotlo la Setjhaba e tla tshwarelwa Lebaleng la Dipapadi la Sisa Dukashe le Mdantsane, Masepaleng wa Toropokgolo ya Buffalo, Porofenseng ya Kapa Botjhabela mohla la 24 Loetse 2013.E le karolo ya Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho, selekane sa dikgokahanyo tsa naha se tla etella pele ho kgakolwa ha ‘Labohlano la Tokoloho’ mohla la 20 Loetse 2013, se tla fanang ka lepatlelo ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho baballa tokoloho e lwanetsweng ka thata, ho netefatsa hore meloko e tlang e kgona ho fola molemo demokrasing ya rona e ntseng e hola.
tgt: Imigubho yalo nyaka izokwenziwa ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Ukubuyisa, Ukuvuselela Nokugubha Amagugu Ethu Aphilayo”.Imigubho yoSuku Lwamagugu izobanjelwa eNkundleni Yezemidlalo iSisa Dukashe eMdantsane, ngaphansi kukaMasipala Omkhulu wase-Buffalo City, eMpumalanga Kapa mhla zingama-24 Mandulo 2013.Njengengxenye yomkhankaso weMinyaka engama-20 Yenkululeko, ingqungquthela kazwelonke yobambiswano kwezokuxhumana izokwethula ‘uLwesihlanu Lwenkululeko’ mhla zingama-20 Mandulo 2013, oluzohlinzeka abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngethuba lokuthokozela inkululeko yethu esayilwela kanzima ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izizukulwane ezizayo ziyahlomula kwintando yethu yeningi ethuthukisayo.

src: Nakong ya Loetse, ho tshehetsa matsapa a bahahlaudi ba rona ba kahare, Kabinete e kgothalletsa maAforika Borwa ho etela ditsha tsa Letlotlo la naha ho re hopotsa ka leeto la rona la ho ya tokolohong.
tgt: NgoMandulo, ukuze kwesekwe imizamo yethu yezokuvakasha ngaphakathi kuleli lizwe, iKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi bavakashele izizinda zamagugu, bazikhumbuze ngohambo lwabo olubheke kwinkululeko.

src: Hape, ho tshehetsa letlotlo la rona la tlholeho ka ho etela dipaka tsa naha mahala ho tloha mohla la 9 ho ya ho la 13 Loetse 2013 e le karolo ya borobedi ya selemo le selemo ya Beke ya Dipaka tsa Naha tsa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Futhi, kwesekwe namagugu ethu ezemvelo ngokuthi kuvakashelwe iziqiwu zikazwelonke okuzongenwa kuzona mahhala kusukela mhla ziyisi-9 kuya mhla ziyi-13 Mandulo 2013 njengengxenye yeViki lesiShiyagalombili laminyaka yonke loPhiko Lweziqiwu Zikazwelonke lwaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa batswadi le bahlokomedi bohle ho tshehetsa bana ba bona ditlhophisetsong tse tlang tsa Ditekolo tsa Naha tsa Selemo le Selemo (ANA), mokgahlelong wa ho bala le ho ngola esita le dipalo, tse tla tshwarwa dipakeng tsa mohla la 10 le 13 Loetse 2013.Batswadi le bahlokomedi ba tlameha ho netefatsa hore ba henahenana le diphetho tsa ANA tsa 2013 jwaloka ha di sebetsa e le sesebediswa sa bohlokwa sa tlhahlobo ya baithuti ya moo ba leng matla kapa moo ba fokolang teng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza bonke abazali kanye nabalondolozi bezingane ukuthi basekele izingane zabo ngenkathi zilungiselela Ukuhlolwa koNyaka kweSizwe Sonke (i-ANA) esifundweni sokwazi ukufunda nokubhala kanye nesokubala okuzokwenziwa khona maduze nje phakathi kwamhla ziyi-10 namhla ziyi-13 Mandulo 2013.Abazali kanye nabalondolozi bezingane kumele baqinisekise ukuthi bayayicubungula imiphumela ye-ANA yowezi-2013 njengoba isebenza njengethuluzi elibalulekile lokuhlonza ukukhalipha nobuthakathaka babafundi.

src: Boitlhophisetsong ba ANA e tlang batswadi, bahlokomedi le baithuti ba kotjwa ho sebedisa disebediswa tseo ba di filweng ke Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo.
tgt: Ukuze balungiselele ukuhlolwa kwe-ANA okuzayo, abazali, abalondolozi bezingane kanye nabafundi bayanxenxwa ukuthi basebenzise amathuluzi ahlinzekwe nguMnyango Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo.

src: Tsena di ka fumanwa websaeteng ya Lefapha (WEBTOKEN).
tgt: Lokhu kutholakala kwisizindalwazi soMnyango esithi: WEBTOKEIKhabinethi ithanda ukudlulisa amazwi enkuthazo emasosheni oMbutho Kazwelonke Wezokuvikela waseNingizimu Afrika atshalwe empumalanga nezwe le-Democratic Republic of Congo esikhathini esisukela mhla ziyi-13 Nhlangulana 2013 kuze kube umhla zingama-31 Ndasa 2014.

src: MaAforika Borwa a kopjwa ho tshehetsa le ho ananela masole ana a etsang mosebetsi wa bohlokwa o phethahatsang boikitlaetso ba Aforika Borwa ba kgotso, botsitso le matlafatso ya demokrasi kontinenteng ya Aforika.
tgt: Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayanxuswa ukuthi basekele futhi bahloniphe la masosha abaluleke kakhulu ekufezekiseni ukuzibophezela kweNingizimu Afrika ekuletheni ukuthula, nozinzo kanye nokuqiniswa kwentando yeningi kwizwekazi lase-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa dikgiro tsa Mopresidente tsa Ntate Mxolisi Sandile Oliver Nxasana e le Motsamaisi e Moholo Botjhotjhising ba Setjhaba ba Naha le Vasantri Soni (SC) e le Hlooho ya Yuniti e Ikgethileng ya Dipatlisiso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela labo abaqokwe ngumongameli, okunguMnu.

src: Kabinete e lakaletsa setjhaba sa Majuda a Aforika Borwa Rosh Hashanah e monatenate (5-6 Loetse 2013).
tgt: Mxolisi Sandile Oliver Nxasana oqokelwe esikhundleni sokuba nguMqondisi Kazwelonke Wophiko Lwezokushushisa kanye no-Vasantrai Soni oqokelwe esikhundleni sokuba yiNhloko Yophiko Olukhethekile Oluphenya Izenzo Zobugebengu.

src: Rosh Hashanah e na le tshusumetso ya bohlokwa setjhabeng sa Majuda hobane e bontsha qalo ya mosebetsi wa boitlhahlobo le boitekolo eo sethatho sa yona e leng Yom Kippur, Letsatsi la Tshwarelano.
tgt: IKhabinethi idlulisa izilokotho ezinhle eziqondiswe emphakathi wamaJuda waseNingizimu Afrika ngenkathi egubha i-Rosh Hashanah ngomhla zizi-5-6 Mandulo 2013).

src: Kabinete e fetisa molaetsa wa matshediso ho Letona Mthethwa le ba lelapa labo ka ho hlokahallwa ke mmae, Mme Nurse Gumbi ka la 03 Loetse Dipuisano le diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: I-Rosh Hashanah ibaluleke kakhulu eMphakathini wamaJuda njengoba iwuphawu lokuqala kohlelo lokuzihlola komuntu ngaphakathi kanye nokubheka emuva, oluholela kwi-Yom Kippur, uSuku Lwenhlawulo.

src: Kabinete e amohetse tlaleho ka diphetho tsa Sesebediswa sa Ditekolo tsa Tshebetso ya Bolaodi (MPAT) sa mafapha a naha le a diporofense bakeng sa selemo sa ditjhelete sa 2012/13.
tgt: Nurse Gumbi mhla zi-3 Mandulo Izingxoxo nezinqumo zeKhabhinethi eziqavile.

src: Tlaleho ke sesebediswa se seng se habileng ho ntlafatsa boleng ba ditshebeletso tseo mafapha a fanang ka tsona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yathola umbiko wemiphumela weThuluzi Lokuhlolwa Kokusebenza Kwabaphathi (i-MPAT) beminyango kahulumeni kazwelonke neyezifundazwe ngonyaka wezimali wezi-2012/13.

src: E lekola dibaka tse nne tse batsi tsa bolaodi e leng bolaodi ba phano ya disebediswa bolaodi ba basebetsi merero ya mawa mmoho le ntlafatso ya phano ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: Lo mbiko ungelinye lamathuluzi ahlose ukwenza ngcono izinga lomsebenzi ohlinzekwa yiminyango kahulumeni.

src: Tekolo e etswa mehatong e meraro, boitekolo ka bowena ho latele tlhahlobo ya mosebetsi ya bohlakisi ba kahare ba dibuka tsa ditjhelete ho qetelwe ka ya ho lekolwa ke sehlopha se ikemetseng sa balekodi.
tgt: Uhlola imikhakha yokuphatha emine ebanzi, okusho umkhakha wokuphathwa kohlelo lokuthenga impahla nemisebenzi ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi ukuhlela ngendlela efanelekile kanye nomkhakha wokwenza ngcono ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingongqangi.

src: Tlaleho e tla boela e tsenkollwa ke Lefapha la Bodisa le Tlhahlobo ya Tshebetso nakong ya ho thakgolwa ho seng ho hlophisitswe ha MPAT bekeng e tlang Cape Town.
tgt: Ukuhlolwa kwenziwa emazingeni amathathu, ukuzihlola kweminyango kulandelwe wuhlelo locwaningo-mabhuku lwangaphakathi bese ekugcineni kwenziwe ukuhlolwa okwenziwa yithimba labahloli abazimele.

src: Kabinete e amohetse ya ba ya ananela ditlaleho tsa kotare ya pele ya 2013/14 ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha Ditumellano tsa Phano bakeng sa Diphetho.
tgt: UMnyango Wezokuqapha Nezokuhlolwa Komsebenzi uzochaza kabanzi ngalo mbiko ngenkathi kwethulwa i-MPAT ngesonto elizayo eKapa.

src: Ditlaleho tsena di tla tsenkollwa nakong ya lethathamo le rerilweng la dipuisano le ba mehlodi ya ditaba bakeng sa se seng le se seng sa Diphetho tse Kabinete e bone tlaleho e tswang ho ‘Projeke ya ho Tloswa ha Lesedi le Lebe la Sekoloto’ mme ya ananela ditshisinyo tsa Komiti e Kgethehileng ya Kgwebisano le Dikamano tsa Matjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yathola futhi yamukela imibiko yekota yokuqala yowezi-2013/14 ephathelene nokuqaliswa kweZivumelwano Zokusebenza mayelana neMiphumela Ebekwe Eqhulwini.

src: Sena se habile ho rarolla qaka ya phihlello ya sekoloto ho maAforika Borwa ao a ka kgonang sekoloto.
tgt: Kuzochazwa kabanzi ngale mibiko ochungechungeni lwezithangamu zabezindaba ezihleliwe eziphathelene nomphumela ngamunye kwiMiphumela eyi-12.

src: Bana ke bareki bao e ka nnang yaba ba qetile ho lefa dikoloto tsa bona ka botlalo mme ba boemong boo ba ka kgonang sekoloto empa hajwale, phihlello ya bona e hakureditswe ke lesedi le lebe la sekoloto direkotong tsa bona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yawuphawula umbiko ovela ‘kuMklamo Wokususwa Kolwazi Olubi Oluphathelene Nokuthenga Ngesikweleti’ futhi yamukela nezincomo zeKomidi Elikhethekile lezoHwebo Nobudlelwano Bamazwe Ngamazwe.

src: Sena se habile ho netefatsa hore Molao wa Naha wa Sekoloto (Molao 34 wa 2005) o sebetsa ho ya kamoo o rerilweng ka teng ho netefatsa hore bareki ba ka kgonang sekoloto ba se ke ba kolotelwa.
tgt: Lokhu kuhlose ukulungisa udaba lokuthi labo bantu baseNingizimu Afrika abasesimweni sokukhokha isikweleti abahlinzekwe ngaso, bakwazi ukuthenga ngesikweleti.

src: Sekoloto se sa fihlelleheng kapa se turang se sithabetsa kgolo.
tgt: Ukungatholakali kwesikweleti noma ukunikezwa isikweleti esimba eqolo kuphazamisa ukukhula komnotho.

src: Phihlello mmarakeng wa sekoloto wa nako e telele e a hlokeha sepheong sohle sa ntshetsopele.
tgt: Ukufinyelela emakethe yezikweleti esimeme kusemqoka kakhulu kwizinjongo zentuthuko.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Pampiri e Tshweu ya ho Busetsa Ditlamong esita le ho tekwa ha yona Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabinethi yawamukela uMthetho Odingidwayo Wokugcinwa Esitokisini Kweziboshwa Okuhlehliswe Amacala Azo Enkantolo, kanye nokwethulwa kwalo Mthetho ePhalamende.

src: Moralo wa nakwana wa Pampiri e Tshweu o habile ho ntlafatsa ho laolwa ha mokgwatshebetso wa ho emela ho bua nyewe motho a le ditlamong ditjhankaneng tsa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Uhlaka lwalo Mthetho Odingidwayo luhlose ukwenza ngcono ukuphathwa kohlelo lokugcinwa emajele aseNingizimu Afrika kweziboshwa ezilindele ukuqulwa kwamacala azo.

src: Pampiri e hlakisa mekgwatshebetso e tla susumetsa bolaodi ba ditlamong ba ho busetsa ditlamong.
tgt: Lo Mthetho Odingidwayo uzohlinzeka ngemigomo ezoqhuba ukuphathwa kohlelo lokugcinwa kweziboshwa esitokisini ngenkathi amacala azo ehlehlisiwe enkantolo.

src: Tlaleho e tla ntshuwa ho ya ka metjha ya Palamente.
tgt: Umbiko uzokhishwa ngokwenqubo elandelwa yiPhalamende.

src: Kabinete e dumetse hore Mmoka wa Sehlopha sa Dihlomo o romelwe Palamenteng bakeng sa kananelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yavuma ukuthi iSivumelwano Esiphathelene Neziqhumane Ezikhafula Amabhomu Amaningi Amancane sithunyelwe ePhalamende ukuze samukelwe.

src: Kabinete e tshehetsa ho senngwa ha thepa ya sehlopha sa dihlomo e le ho ikamahanya le Mmoka ona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakweseka ukucekelwa phansi kweziqhumane ezigciniwe ezikhafula amabhomu amaningi amancane, ukuze kuhlonishwe iSivumelwano.

src: Ka Pudungwana ya 2006 seboka sa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) ha se a ka sa fihlella tumellano ya kamoo sefutho sa botho sa ho rarolla bothata ba dihlomo tsena se leng kateng.
tgt: NgoLwezi 2006 ingqungquthela yeNhlangano Yezizwe Ezihlangene yahluleka ukufinyelela esivumelwaneni sokuthi kumele lulungiswe kanjani udaba lomthelela omubi walezi zikhali kubantu.

src: Sena se ile sa lebisa moo sehlopha sa dinaha tse 46, ho akga le Aforika Borwa, se ileng sa eba motjheng o mong o kathoko ho UN, o bitswang Mosebetsi wa Oslo, ho kwala sehlopha sa dihlomo.
tgt: Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni iqembu lamazwe angama-46, kubandakanya neNingizimu Afrika, liqalise uhlelo ngaphandle kweNhlangano Yezizwe Ezihlangene, olubizwa nge-Oslo Process, lokuvimbela nokwenqabela iziqhumane ezikhafula amabhomu amaningi amancane.

src: Aforika Borwa mmoho le dinaha tse ding tse 93 e tekenne Mokgwatshebetso ka Tshitwe ya 2008.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika kanye namanye Amazwe angama-93 yasisayinda iSivumelwano ngoZibandlela 2008.

src: Mohla la 1 Phato 2010 Mokgwatshebetso o ile wa kenngwa tshebetsong.
tgt: Isivumelwano lesi saqala ukusebenza ngomhla lulu-1 Ncwaba 2010.

src: Mokgwatshebetso o kwala tshebediso, tlhahiso, poloko ya thepa le phetiso ya mofuta o itseng wa sehlopha sa dihlomo.
tgt: Isivumelwano sivimbela futhi senqabele ukusetshenziswa, nokukhiqizwa, nokugcinwa, nokudluliswa kohlobo oluthile lweziqhumane ezikhafula amabhomu amaningi amancane.

src: Kananelo ya Mokgwatshebetso e tsamaisana le boikitlaetso ba Aforika Borwa ba ho boloka ditokelo tsa botho le molao wa botho ha e sebetsana le dintwa.
tgt: Ukwamukelwa kwalesi Sivumelwano kuhambelana nokuzibophezela kweNingizimu Afrika ukuhlonipha amalungelo abantu kanye nomthetho ophathelene nokungahlukunyezwa kwabantu ngenkathi kuqhubeka impi.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha tlaleho ya Tlhahlobo ya Dibuka tsa Ngodiso ya Mobu wa Mmuso le tshekatsheko e sa tebang ya Boithuelo ba Poraefete ba Mobu Aforika Borwa, e entsweng ke Mohlahlobikakaretso e Moholo wa tsa Mobu, Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yakwamukela ukwethulwa kombiko wokuCwaningwa Komhlaba Wombuso Obhalisiwe kanye nokuhlaziywa koMhlaba Wabantu Nowabezamabhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika, owethulwa ePhalamende nguMklami Omkhulu Womhlaba.

src: Lesedi le mabapi le mobu le bohlokwa haholo dintshetsopeleng tsohle tse amanang le mobu naheng.
tgt: Ulwazi oluphathelene nomhlaba lusemqoka kakhulu ekuphumeleleni kwakho konke ukuthuthukiswa komhlaba okwenzekayo kuleli lizwe.

src: Sepheo sa tlhahlobo ya dibuka tsa ngodiso ya mobu wa mmuso ke ho fumana hore na mmuso o na le mobu o mokae, o sebedisetswa eng le hore na basebedisi ba wona ke bomang.
tgt: Injongo yokucwaningwa komhlaba wombuso obhalisiwe ukuzama ukuthola ukuthi ungakanani umhlaba ongaphansi kombuso, nokuthi usetshenziselwa ini futhi ngobani abahlala kuwona noma abawusebenzisayo.

src: Sena se tla sebedisetswa ho ntlafatsa botshepehi ba rejistara ya mobu, e tla sebetsa e le motheo bakeng sa thero le tsamaiso tsa mobu tse ntlafaditsweng, ho akga le mesebetsi e meng e amanang le bolaodi ba tshebetso ya thepa esita le phano e ntlafaditsweng ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: Lokhu kuzosetshenziselwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi oluqukethwe kwirejista yomhlaba luyiqiniso, futhi lokho kuzoba yisisekelo sokuhlela okungcono mayelana nezomhlaba kanye nokuphathwa kwawo, kubandakanya neminye imisebenzi ehlobene nokuphathwa kwephotifoliyo yomhlaba kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwezidingongqangi okwenziwe ngcono.

src: Kabinete e ananetse metako ya Khamphane ya Popo ya Tjhelete Aforika Borwa bakeng sa lethathamo la sehopotso sa tjhelete e lewana ya 24 ct ya kgauta ya R2 ya 2013 (1/4 oz) le lethathamo la sehopotso sa tjhelete e lewana ya 24 ct ya kgauta ya R1 (1/10 oz).Motako wa tjhelete e lewana ya kgauta ya R2 ya 2013 o tla ngolwa ka puo ya Sekgothu athe motako wa tjhelete e lewana ya kgauta ya R1 ya 2013 e tla ba tlhoka ya boraro – Mohlampepe wa Ditholwana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yawamukela amadizayini oPhiko Olugaya futhi Lukhiqize Imali yaseNingizimu Afrika onyaka wezi-2013 ohlamvu olungama-R2 (i-1/4 oz) oluyingxenye yochungechunge lwemali yesikhumbuzo ewuhlweza equkethe amakharethi egolide angama-24 kanye nohlamvu lowezi-2013 oluyi-R1 (i-1/10 oz) oluyingxenye yochungechunge lwemali yesikhumbuzo ewuhlweza equkethe amakharethi egolide angama-24.Kwidizayini yohlamvu lwegolide lowezi-2013 olungama-R2 kuzobonakala ulimi lwaBathwa kanti futhi idizayini yohlamvu lwegolide lowezi-2013 oluyi-R1 kuzobonakala umthuthi wempova okleliswe endaweni yesithathu – iLulwane Lezithelo.

src: Metako ya tjhelete e lewana mmoho le Mahlalosi a tsona di tla hatiswa Koranteng ya Melawana ya Mmuso.
tgt: Amadizayini ohlamvu lwemali kanye nokuMenyezelwa kwayo ngokuSemthethweni kuzoshicilelwa kuSomqulu Kahulumeni.

src: Kamorao ho moo, di tla etswa mme di rekiswe ka metjha e tlwaelehileng.
tgt: Emva kwalokho le mali izokhiqizwa bese idayiswa ngendlela ejwayelekile.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha ditlaleho tse tharo tse amanang le kgatelopele e entsweng tshireletsong ya ditokelo le bophelo bo botle ba bana Komiting ya Matjhaba a Kopaneng ya Ditokelo tsa Ngwana le Komiti ya Boqhetseke ya Kopano ya Aforika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yakwamukela ukwethulwa kwemibiko emithathu kwiKomidi leNhlangano Yezizwe Ngezizwe yamaLungelo Engane kanye neKomidi loNgoti loBumbano lwamaZwe ase-Afrika ephathelene nenqubekela phambili eseyenziwe ukuvikela amalungelo nenhlalakahle yezingane.

src: Ditlaleho di fana ka monyetla wa bohlokwa o nang le ponaletso bakeng sa Aforika Borwa ho sekaseka kgatelopele eo e seng e e entse dintlheng tsenaa) Tlaleho ya Naha ka Prothokhole e sa Tlameng ka Thekiso ya Bana, Bootswa ba Bana le ho Nyweka ha Bana.
tgt: Imibiko ihlinzeka ngethuba elisobala futhi elibalulekile lokuthi iNingizimu Afrika ikwazi ukuhlola inqubekela phambili esiyenziwe kule mikhakhaa) Umbiko Wamazwe Wesivumelwano Esingaphoqelekile esiphathelene nokuThengiswa Kwezingane, Ukusetshenziswa Kwezingane Ezenzweni Zokuthengisa Ngomzimba kanye Nezithombe Zocansi Ezikhombisa Izinganeb) Umbiko ohlanganisiwe wesibili nowesithathu kanye nowesine weSivumelwano seNhlangano Yezizwe Ngezizwe ophathelene namaLungelo Enganec) UMqulu wase-Afrika ophathelene namaLungelo kanye Nenhlalakahle Yengane: Umbiko Wamazwe Wokuqala owethulwa kwiKomidi loNgoti loBumbano lwamaZwe ase-Afrika lwamaLungelo Nenhlalakahle Yengane.

src: Kabinete e leboha lethathama la mekgatlo ya setjhaba ka boikitlaetso esita le balekane ba matjhaba ba ikopantseng le mmuso ka ho hlokomela boikitlaetso bo entsweng ke Molaotheo wa rona baneng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonga iyanconcoza ezinhlanganweni eziningi zomphakathi kanye nozakwabo emazweni omhlaba ababambisane nohulumeni ekufezekisweni kwezibophezelo eziqondiswe ezinganeni eziqukethwe kuMthethosisekelo wethu.

src: Dibili.
tgt: IMithethosivivinywa.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Sehlomathiso ya Pusetso ya Ditokelo tsa Mobu Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yakwamukela ukwethulwa ePhalamende kweSichibiyelo Somthethosivivinywa Wokubuyiselwa Kwamalungelo Ezomhlaba.

src: Bili e hlomathisa Molao wa Pusetso ho eketsa letsatsi la ho qetela bakeng sa ho kenngwa ha ditseko tsa pusetso ya mobu ho ya fihla ho la 31 Tshitwe 2018 ho etsetsa hore e be tlolo ya molao ho kenngwa ha tseko ka bolotsana nolofatso ya tsamaiso bakeng sa ho kgethwa ha Baahlodi Lekgotleng la Ditseko tsa Mobu esita le ho hlomathiswa ha dikarolwana tse itseng tse reretsweng ho kgothalletsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Molao ka bokgabane.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho Wokubuyiselwa Komhlaba Kubanikazi Bawo ukuze kwelulwe isikhathi sokufakwa kwezicelo zokubuyiselwa umhlaba sifinyelele kumhla zingama-31 Zibandlela 2018 nokuthathwa njengento engekho emthethweni kokufakwa kwezicelo zokubuyiselwa umhlaba ezihambisana nenkohliso nokwenziwa lula kwenqubo yokuqashwa kwamaJaji eNkantolo Yezicelo Zokubuyiselwa Umhlaba kanye nokuchitshiyelwa kwezimiso ezithile ezihlose ukugqugquzela ukuqaliswa ngempumelelo kokusebenza koMthetho.

src: Ho bulwa botjha ha ho kenngwa ha ditseko ho tataiswa ke tjhebelopele ya Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP) esita le Lenaneo le Phethahetseng la Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Mahaeng le mawa a mang a kgolo a reretsweng ho kgothalletsa poelano ya setjhaba le momahano ya setjhaba.
tgt: Ukuvulwa kabusha kokufakwa kwezicelo zokubuyiselwa umhlaba kuholwa umbono woHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP) kanye noHlelo Olubanzi Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya kanye namanye amasu okukhulisa umnotho okuhloswe ngawo ukuthi kugqugquzelwe ukubuyisana kuzwelonke nobumbano lomphakathi.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Sehlomathiso ya Melao ya Saense le Theknoloji, 2013 Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yakwemukela ukwethulwa ePhalamende kweSichibiyelo Somthethosivivinywa weMithetho Yezesayensi Nezobuchwepheshe, 2013.Isichibiyelo Somthetho siphathelene neMithetho enhlobonhlobo elawula ukusebenza kwezinhlangano (imikhandlu yezesayensi) ezasungulwa ngokwemigomo yoMthetho okukhulunywa ngawo.

src: Bili ya Sehlomathiso e sebetsana le dihlomathiso tsa lethathama la Melao e laolang tshebetso ya ditheo (makgotla a saense) tse neng di thewe ho ya ka Melao eo.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uhlose ukuthi wenze le nqubo ihambelane kahle nokuphakanyiswa kwamagama kanye nokuqokwa kwamalungu kanye nokugcwaliswa kwezikhala ezikhona kumaBhodi noma imiKhandlu yalezo zinhlangano.

src: Bili e habile ho nolofatsa mosebetsi wa ho thonngwa le ho kgethwa ha ditho esita le ho kwalwa ha dikgeo Dibotong kapa Makgotleng a ditheo tseo.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uhlose ukuqinisekisa ukuhamba kahle kwemisebenzi kanye nokuphathwa kwezinhlangano zomphakathi ezingaphansi kukaNgqongqoshe Wezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe.

src: Bili e ntlafatsa tshebetso e ntle le tshwano mosebetsing le taolong ya ditheo tsa setjhaba tse tlalehang ho Letona la Saense le Theknoloji.
tgt: Ukuze kuqiniswe umsebenzi wePhalamende wokuqapha ukusebenza kweminyango kahulumeni, uMthethosivivinywa uhlose ukukhulula iPhalamende kweminye imisebenzi yalo ephathelene nokuqokwa kwamalungu kanye nokugcwaliswa kwezikhala ezikhona kulawo maBhodi noma imiKhandlu.

src: Ho matlafatseng seabo sa tekolo sa Palamente, Bili e habile ho lokolla Palamente boikarabelong bo itseng ba phethahatso bo amanang le ho kgethwa ha ditho esita le ho kwalwa ha dikgeo Dibotong tseo kapa Makgotleng ao.
tgt: Lokhu kuhambelana nomgomo womthethosisekelo wokuhlukaniswa kwamandla okuphatha.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho phatlalatswa ha Bili ya Ditaba tsa Setso Koranteng Melawana ya ya Mmuso bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yakwamukela ukushicilelwa koMthethosivivinywa Wezindaba Zendabuko kuSomqulu Kahulumeni ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngawo.

src: Bili e fana ka dintlha tsa molao bakeng sa kananelo ya Bakgothu ebile e rarolla bothata ba ho kgoneha molaong o seng o le teng o amanang le boetapele ba setso le puso.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa wenza izimiso ezisemthethweni zokwamukelwa komphakathi wama-Khoi-San futhi ulungisa nemikhawulo ekhona emthethweni njengamanje mayelana nobuholi bendabuko kanye nokubusa.

src: Haesale ho tloha ka 1994 mmuso o ile wa nkela hloohong diphephetso tse amanang le Bakgothu, haholoholo kananelo ya setjhaba sa bakgothu le baetapele.
tgt: Kusukela ngowe-1994, uhulumeni ubugxile kakhulu kwizinselele eziphathelene nama-Khoi-San futhi ikakhulu ekwamukelweni ngokusemthethweni kwemiphakathi yama-Khoi-San kanye nabaholi bayo.

src: Bili e tla thusa pehelong ya bohlokwa ya NDP e amanang le ho etswa batsi ha momahano ya setjhaba le kopano, ha ka lehlakoreng le leng e ntse e rarolla bothata ba nako e fetileng ba ho se lekane.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uzoba negalelo ekufezekisweni kwalokho okubekwe eqhulwini yi-NDP mayelana nokukhuliswa kokubambana nokubumbana komphakathi futhi kusenjalo kulungiswe nokungalingani kwesikhathi esedlule.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Moralo wa Tjhebobotjha ya Leano la Molao wa Naha wa Sekoloto le Bili ya Sehlomathiso ya Naha ya Sekoloto bakeng sa ho tekwa Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yavuma ukuthi lwethulwe ePhalamende Uhlaka Lokubuyekezwa Kwenqubomgomo Yomthetho Kazwelonke Wezikweleti kanye Nesichibiyelo Somthethosivivinywa Kazwelonke Wezikweleti.

src: Molao wa Naha wa Sekoloto, 2005 (Molao 34 wa 2005) o kene tshebetsong ka botlalo ka la 1 Phuptjane 2007 mme wa hlahisa boemo bo botjha ba ditaolo tsa sekoloto tshebetsong ya molao ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: UMthetho Kazwelonke Wezikweleti, 2005 (uMthetho 34 wezi-2005) waqala ukusebenza mhla lu-1 Nhlangulana 2007 ngokwethula imitheshwana emisha yokulawula izikweleti ohlelweni lwezomthetho lwaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Sepheo sa Bili ke ho matlafatsa bokgoni ba Molaodi wa Naha wa Sekoloto (NCR) ho rarolla diphephetso tse itseng haholoholo mabapi le mesebetsi ya lekgotla la dinyewe esita le ho matlafatsa ho qobella le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha dikateng tsa Molao wa Naha wa Sekoloto wa 34 wa 2005.Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Indasteri (dti) le lona le qetile ka hore moralo wa leano wa Sekoloto sa Bareki, moo Molao wa Naha wa Sekoloto wa 34 wa 2005 o fumanweng teng, o motle ebile o nepahetse.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uhlose ukuqinisa ikhono lokusebenza loMlawuli Kazwelonke Wezikweleti ukuze kubhekwane nezinselelo ezithile, ikakhulu eziphathelene nezinqubo zasenkantolo kanye nokuqinisa ukuthotshelwa komthetho kanye nokuqaliswa kokusebenza kwezimiso zoMthetho Kazwelonke Wezikweleti 34 wezi-2005.UMnyango Wezohwebo Nezezimboni (i-dti) uthathe isinqumo sokuthi uhlaka lwenqubomgomo ephathelene nokuHlinzekwa Kwabathengi Ngezikweleti, okusekelwe phezu kwayo uMthetho Kazwelonke Wezikweleti 34 wezi-2005, lwamukelekile, lunohlonze futhi lufanelekile.

src: Sena se latela tjhebobotjha e phethahetseng ya 2012, e entsweng ke dti.
tgt: Lokhu kulandela ukubuyekezwa okuphelele okwenziwa yi-dti ngowezi-2012.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Sehlomathiso ya ho Nka Qeto ka Tefo ya Meputso ya Ditho tsa Ditaba tsa Ditheo tsa Molaotheo, 2013.Sepheo sa Bili ke ho thea tshwano mabapi le ho nka qeto ka tefo ya meputso, melemo e fumanwang mosebetsing le melawana e meng le dipehelo tsa kgiro ya ditho tsa ditheo tsa Kgaolo ya 9, moo e matlafatsang tshebetso e ntle le tshwano mesebetsing ya puso ditheong tsena tsa bohlokwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yakwamukela ukwethulwa kweSichibiyelo Somthethosivivinywa Wokuthathwa Kwesinqumo Esiphathelene Nomholo Wamalungu Ezikhungo Ezisungulwe Ngokomthethosisekelo, 2013.UMthethosivivinywa uhlose ukuletha isimo esifanayo mayelana nokuthathwa kwesinqumo esiphathelene namaholo, nezibonelelo kanye neminye imigomo nemibandela yokuqashwa kwamalungu eziKhungo ZikaHulumeni Ezeseka Ukubusa Ngentando Yabantu, futhi ngalokho kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba kahle kwemisebenzi nokuphathwa kwalezi zikhungo ezibalulekile.

src: Dithonyo.
tgt: Abaqashiwe.

src: Kabinete e ananetse kgiro ya Ntate Mokutule Joseph Kgobokoe mosebetsing wa Motlatsi wa Motsamaisi e Moholo: Hlahisong e sa Kgaelleng ya Dijo le Ntlafatso ya Temo Lefapheng la Temo, Meru le Botshwasi ba Ditlhapi.
tgt: Mokutule Joseph Kgobokoe esikhundleni sokuba Iphini likaMqondisi-Jikelele: Ophikweni Lokuqinisekiswa Kokutholakala Kokudla Okwanele kanye Nezinguquko Kwezolimo eMnyangweni Wezolimo, Ezamahlathi Nezokudoba.

src: Kabinete e ananetse kgiro ya Mme Zandile Yvonne Mathe mosebetsing wa Motlatsi wa Motsamaisi e Moholo: Meralo ya Motheo ya Mehlodi ya Metsi ya Naha e Lefapheng la Merero ya Metsi.
tgt: Zandile Yvonne Mathe esikhundleni sokuba Iphini likaMqondisi-Jikelele: Ophikweni Lwezengqalasizinda Kazwelonke Yamanzi eMnyangweni Wezamanzi.

src: Kabinete e ananetse kgiro ya batho ba latelang e le ditho tsa boto tsa Eijensi ya Ntshetsopele ya Dibanka tse Kopaneng:a) Sethe Patricia Makhesha (Modulasetulo)b) Peter Koch (kgiro hape e le Motlatsi wa Modulasetulo)c) Venete Jarlene Kleind) Lufuno Nevondwee) Thabo Vaughan Shenxanef) Samuel Senalor Akrongg) David Ginsburgh) Renganayagee Kisten.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yakwamukela ukuqashwa kwalaba abalandelayo njengamalungu ebhodi yoPhiko Lokuthuthukiswa Kwamabhange Emifelandawonye:a) Sethe Patricia Makhesha (uSihlalo)b) Peter Koch (ophinde waqokwa kabusha njengePhini likaSihlalo)c) Venete Jarlene Kleind) Lufuno Nevondwee) Thabo Vaughan Shenxanef) Samuel Senalor Akrongg) David Ginsburgh) Renganayagee Kisten.

src: Kabinete e ananetse kgetho ya ditho tse latelang Lekgotleng la Diphuphutso tsa Temo ho ya ka karolo 9(1) ya Molao wa Diphuphutso tsa Temo, 1990 Molao wa 86 wa 1990 nakong e sa feteng dilemo tse tharo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yakwamukela ukuqashwa kwala malungu alandelayo oMkhandlu Wocwaningo Lwezolimo ngokwesigaba 9(1) soMthetho Wezocwaningo Lwezolimo, 1990 uMthetho Nombolo.

src: Kabinete e dumellana le ho kgethwa ha batho ba latelang Lekgotleng la Matla a Taolo ya Indasteri ya Tshireletso ya Poraefete, nakong e sa feteng dilemo tse tharo:a) Ntate Daniel Claude Mojalefa Rathebe (Motlatsi wa Modulasetulo)b) Brigadier Cynthia Lindiwe Philison (Molekgotla)c) Ntate Benjamin Somangamane Ntuli (Molekgotla)d) Mme Nontokoza Mthembu (Molekgotla).
tgt: Sibusiso Vil-Nkomo (oqashwe kabusha)d) Dkt.

src: 23 Sep Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa bohlokwa maemong a ha jwale.1 Tlasa boetapele ba Mopresidente Jacob Zuma, mmuso o sebetsa ka lenaneo la naha la meralo ya motheo ya setjhaba la ditrilione tse ngata ngata tsa diranta le reretsweng ho utolla menyetla ya mesebetsi le ho tlisa ditshebeletso ho maAforika Borwa ohle.
tgt: 23 Sep Isimo seKhabhinethi ezindabeni ezisemqoka esimweni samanje.1 Ngaphansi kobuholi bukaMongameli Jacob Zuma, uhulumeni useqalise uhlelo lwaleli lizwe lwengqalasizinda yomphakathi oluzodla imali eyizinkulungwane ngezinkulungwane zezigidigidi zamarandi okuhloswe ngalo ukuvula amathuba emisebenzi kanye nokuletha izidingongqangi kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ka mananeo ana, mmuso o tsitlallela boikitlaetsong ba wona ba ho thea mesebetsi e mengata le ho feta.
tgt: Ngalezi zinhlelo uhulumeni ufekezisa isibophezelo sakhe sokuvula amathuba emisebenzi athe xaxa.

src: Haesale ho tloha kananelong ya Mokgwa o Motjha wa Kgolo mesebetsi e eketsehile ka 750 000, mme katlasenyana ho halofo ya mesebetsi ena e hlahisitswe tshebeletsong ya setjhaba, haholoholo basebetsing ba tsa bophelo bo botle, matitjhere le mapolesa.
tgt: Kusukela ngenkathi kwamukelwa uMgudu Omusha Wokuthuthukiswa Komnotho isibalo samathuba emisebenzi sesikhule ngezi-750 000, futhi isibalo esingaphansana kancane kwesigamu salawa mathuba emisebenzi sivuleke emikhakheni wemisebenzi kahulumeni, ikhakhulu emikhakheni yabasebenzi bezempilo, othisha kanye namaphoyisa.

src: Mananeo ana a bea ntshetsopele ya dikgwebo tse nyenyane ka sehloohong, e leng ntho ya bohlokwa ya ho utolla menyetla ya moruo.
tgt: Lezi zinhlelo zibeka eqhulwini ukuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi amancane, okuyinto eyingxenye ebalulekile ekuvulweni kwamathuba ezomnotho.

src: Kabinete e leboha makala ao a ikamahanyang le mmuso ho kenya tshebetsong lenaneo lena le leholohadi la ntshetsopele ya meralo ya motheo mme e etsa kgoeletso tshebedisanong ya ho potlakisa matsapa a ho thea mesebetsi le ho fetola moruo esita le setjhaba sa habo rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonga iyanconcoza kuleyo mikhakha ebambisene nohulumeni ekuqalisweni kwalo mkhankaso omkhulukazi wokuthuthukiswa kwengqalasizinda futhi ihlaba ikhwelo lokuthi kube nokusebenzisana okuthe xaxa ukuze kusheshiswe imizamo yokuvula amathuba emisebenzi kanye nokuletha uguquko emnothweni kanye nasemphakathini wethu.

src: Mopresidente Jacob Zuma o tla bula Seteishene sa Motlakase sa Grootvlei ka la 20 Loetse 2013 a be a hlahlobe le setsha sa kaho ya seporo sa terene kwana Mpumalanga, e le karolo ya boikitlaetso ba neelano ya meralo ya motheo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Njengengxenye yokuqaliswa kohlelo lwengqalasizinda yomphakathi uMongameli Jacob Zuma uzovula ngokusemthethweni iSiteshi Esiphehla Ugesi sase-Grootvlei mhla zingama-20 Mandulo 2013 futhi ahlole nesizinda okwakhiwa kusona ujantshi wesitimela eMpumalanga.

src: Kabinete e ananetse kaho ya Yunivesithi e ntjha ya Sol Plaatjie Kimberly, Kapa Leboya, e lebeletsweng ho qala pele ho mafelo a Loetse 2013.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yakwamukela ngezandla ezimhlophe ukwakhiwa kweNyuvesi entsha i-Sol Plaatje e-Kimberley, eNyakatho Kapa, okulindeleke ukuthi iqale ukusebenza ingakapheli inyanga kaMandulo 2013.Lokhu yinto eyingqophamlando enkulu ekukhuliseni nokuthuthukisa umkhakha wezemfundo ephakeme waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ena ke katleho e kgolo kgolong le ntshetsopeleng ya lekala la thuto e phahameng Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Umcimbi wokuphendulwa kwesoyi waba wuphawu lokuqaliswa ngokusemthethweni komsebenzi wokwakhiwa kwale nyuvesi.

src: Ketsahalo ya ho phethelwa ha mobu e bile sesupo sa ho thakgolwa ha kaho ya khamphase semmuso.
tgt: Ukwakhiwa kwenyuvesi entsha kuhlonzwe futhi kwabekwa eqhulwini ngaphakathi kweMiklamo Edidiyelwe (i-SIP 14) yiKhomishana KaMongameli Yokuqondisa Ingqalasizinda (i-PICC).2 UMongameli Jacob Zuma, ebambisene neKhabhinethi yakhe, uzohlonipha abantu abadala baseNingizimu Afrika, Ekhayeni Lezivakashi LikaMongameli elibizwa nge-Sefako Makgatho ePitoli mhla zingama-29 Mandulo 2013.

src: Sena se bopa karolo ya ho keteka seabo sa metsofe ya rona ntshetsopeleng ya setjhaba sa habo rona esita le ya naha.
tgt: Lokhu kuyingxenye yokubungaza igalelo labantu abadala ekuthuthukisweni kwemiphakathi yethu kanye nelizwe lethu.

src: Sena e tla be e le sesupo sa qalo ya Beke ya Batho ba Baholo, e tla fela ka la 6 Mphalane, e leng Letsatsi la Bonkgono le Bontatemoholo.3 Mopresidente Jacob Zuma o tla tshetleha puo Ngangisanong e Akaretsang ya Phutheo ya bo68 ya Sebokakakaretso sa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UNGA68) New York ka la 24 Loetse 2013.
tgt: Lo mcimbi uzoba wuphawu lokuqala kweViki Labantu Abadala, elizophela mhla ziyisi-6 Mfumfu, okuwusuku olwaziwa ngoSuku Logogo Nomkhulu.3 UMongameli Jacob Zuma uzokwethula inkulumo kwiSithangami seNkulumo-mpikiswano Ejwayelekile yeSigcawu sama-68 sesiGungu Esijwayelekile seNhlangano Yezizwe (UNGA68) e-New York mhla zingama-24 Mandulo 2013.Isihloko salo nyaka sithi: “I-Ajenda Yentuthuko Kusukela ngowezi-2015: Ukwendlalela!” futhi sigxile kunyaka wezi-2015 okuwumnqamulajuqu wokufezekiswa kweziNjongo Zentuthuko Zekhulunyaka (i-MDGs), kanye ne-Ajenda Yentuthuko ngenkathi kuqhutshekelwa phambili.

src: Mookotaba wa monongwaha ke: “Lenanetsamaiso la Ntshetsopele la Kamora 2015: Ho Bula Sebaya!” mme o habile nakong e beilweng ya 2015 ya Maikemisetso a Ntshetsopele ya Dilemokete (MDGs), esita le Lenanetsamaiso la Ntshetsopele kamorao ho moo, ho ya pele.
tgt: I-UNGA68 ihlinzeka iNingizimu Afrika ngethuba lokuqhubekisela phambili uhlelo lwethu lokufezekiswa kwama-MDGs kanye ne-Ajenda Yentuthuko Kusukela ngowezi-2015.

src: UNAG68 e fa Aforika Borwa lepatlelo la ho ntshetsapele mokgwa wa lewa la rona la ho fihlella di-MDG le Lenanetsamaiso la Ntshetsopele la Kamora 2015.
tgt: Ukubamba kwethu iqhaza kuzosekelwa phezu kwezidingo nezimfuno zikazwelonke zeNingizimu Afrika kanye nezinto ezibekwe eqhulwini, kanye nezibophezelo zethu zesifunda kanye nezezwekazi.4 IKhabhinethi isigxeka kakhulu isenzo sobushokobezi sokuphazamisa ngabomu ukusebenza kwezikhungo zamandla kagesi esenziwa ngabasebenzi ababengenele isiteleka esingekho emthethweni okwaholela ekutheni kunqamuke ukuphakelwa kukagesi ezingxenyeni ezithile zedolobha laseGoli.

src: Seabo sa rona se tla boela se susumetswa ke ditabatabelo le dintho tse ka sehloohong tsa Aforika Borwa, esita le boikitlaetso ba rona ba lebatowa le ba kontinente.4 Kabinete e seolla kahohlehohle ditshitiso tsa marangrang a motlakase, tse entsweng ke batho ba neng ba le seteraekeng se seng molaong, tse ileng tsa baka ho kgaoha ha phepelo ya motlakase dikarolong tsa Johannesburg.
tgt: Ngeke nakancane zishaywe indiva izenzo ezinjalo, ezenzeka ngesikhathi leli lizwe liphokophele ekuqinisekiseni ukuzinza kokuphakelwa kukagesi futhi lo mkhuba kumele kulwiswane nawo ngesandla esiqinile ngokuvunyelwa yingalo yomthetho.5 Ukukhiswa kweZibalo zaseNingizimu Afrika Zezigameko Zobugebengu Kuzwelonke zowezi-2012 / 2013 ezikhishwa njalo ngonyaka kuqinisekisa inkolelo yethu yokuthi uma sisebenzisana singayifinyelela injongo yethu yomphakathi ongenabo ubugebengu, oheha ukutshalwa kwezimali okuyinto eqinisekisa ukuphepha nesimo esizinzile emiphakathini yethu.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho bohle ba amehang ho tshohla ka botebo diphumano tsena ka moya o motle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo eliqondiswe kubo bonke ababambiqhaza ukuthi bazicubungule ngendlela eyakhayo lezi zibalo.

src: Mmuso o ntsha dipalopalo tsena hang ka selemo ka sepheo sa ho fa setjhaba lesedi la moraorao twantshong ya ditlolo tsa molao, esita le ho sheba botjha mawa a jwale a ho lwantsha ditlolo tsa molao.
tgt: Uhulumeni ukhipha lezi zibalo kanye ngonyaka ikakhulu ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka umphakathi ngolwazi lwakamuva mayelana nempi yokulwisana nobugebengu kuleli lizwe, kanye nokubuyekeza amanye amasu asetshenziswayo njengamanje okulwisana nobugebengu.

src: Dipalopalo tsa ditlolo tsa molao di boela di sebediswa kamehla e le sesebediswa sa ho tataisa merero ya ho sebetsa ya Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS).Kabinete e thoholetsa matsapa a matla a SAPS le mekgatlo yohle e ipopileng esita le setjhaba ka ho sebedisana le mmuso twantshong ya ditlolo tsa molao.
tgt: Izibalo zobugebengu ziyasetshenziswa futhi nsukuzonke njengethuluzi labaphathi lokuhola nokulawula izinhlelo zokusebenza zoMbutho Wamaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS).IKhabhinethi ikushayela ihlombe ukuzikhandla kwe-SAPS kanye nazo zonke izinhlangano ezihlelekile nezomphakathi ezibambisene nohulumeni ekulwiseni ubugebengu.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho ikamahanya le twantsho ya ditlolo tsa molao.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxenxa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi babambe iqhaza empini yokulwisana nobugebengu.

src: Ha re sebetsa mmoho re tla netefatsa boteng ba Aforika Borwa moo moAforika Borwa a tla ikutlwa a bolokehile a bile a tshireletsehile.6 Kabinete e bontshitse ho ngongoreha ho hoholo ka dikotsi tsa moraorao tsa mebileng tse mpempe.
tgt: Uma sisebenzisana sizoqinisekisa iNingizimu Afrika lapho bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bezizwa bephephile futhi bevikelekile.6 IKhabhinethi yazwakalisa ukukhathazeka okukhulu mayelana nesibalo esiphezulu sezingozi zomgwaqo ezinyantisa igazi ezenzeke kulezi zinsuku ezedlule.

src: Dikotsi tse jwalo di siile malapa a mang a saretswe ebile di thefula moruo haholo.
tgt: Ezinye zalezi zingozi zishiye imindeni ethile ingondinga sithebeni futhi zinomthelela omubi kakhulu emnothweni.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho beng bohle ba makoloi ho netefatsa hore makoloi a bona a boemong bo amohelehileng ba ho tsamaya mebileng ba be ba kganne ka boikarabelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo eliqondiswe kubo bonke abashayeli ukuthi kumele baqinisekise ukuthi izimoto zabo zisesimweni esifanele ukuhamba emgwaqeni futhi bashayele ngokucophelela okukhulu.

src: Kahoo Kabinete e ipiletsa ho balaola sephethephethe ho tswelapele ka ho se amohele ho hang makoloi a seng boemong bo amohelehileng ba ho tsamaya mebileng esita le ba kgannang ba tahilwe.
tgt: Mayelana nalokho-ke iKhabhinethi inxenxa amaphoyisa omgwaqo ukuthi aqhubeke nomkhankaso wawo wokungazibekezeleli nakancane izimoto ezingekho esimweni esifanele ukuhamba emgwaqeni kanye nabashayeli abashayela bedakiwe.

src: Kabinete e boela e ipiletsa ho ditaaso ho hlompha melao ya tsela.7 Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho keteka Letsatsi la Letlotlo la Botjhaba, 24 Loetse 2013, ka ho etela dibaka tse fupereng letlotlo la botjhaba bo sa tshwaneng naha ka bophara e le ho keteka Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho ya rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba futhi nekhwelo eliqondiswe kubantu abahamba ngezinyawo ukuthi kumele bayihloniphe imithetho yomgwaqo.7 IKhabhinethi inxenxa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi bagubhe uSuku Lwamagugu, mhla zingama-24 Mandulo 2013, ngokuthi bavakashele izikhungo ezinhlobonhlobo zamagugu ethu anothile futhi ahlukahlukene ezitholakala ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zaleli lizwe ngenkathi kugujwa iMinyaka yethu engama-20 Yenkululeko.
