tgt: Ngasemaphethelweni eNgqungquthela bonke ababambiqhaza basayinda iSivumelwano Sentsha Sikazwelonke Sokuhlaliswa Kwabantu, okuyisenzo esithathwa njengesitatimende esikhombisa injongo yokwakha indlela edidiyelwe futhi efaka imikhakha yonke ekuhlinzekweni kwezindlu ngokuthi kugqugquzelwe intsha, ithuthukiswe futhi ibambe iqhaza ngokusebenzisa iMibutho Yentsha Yezokuhlaliswa Kwabantu.

src: Letona Patal o tla tsebisa ditho tse ding kaofela tsa Boto ya IDC matsatsing a mmalwa a tlang.8 Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba/dithonyo tse ding:a) Thonyo ya CEO ya Banka ya Naha, Monghadi TP Nchocho ho tloha ka la 1 Pherekgong 2015 ka konteraka ya dilemo tse hlano ho fihlela ka la 31 Tshitwe 2019.b) Thonyo ya CEO ya Koporasi ya Matsete a Setjhaba, Ngaka Daniel Mmushi Matjila hanghang, bakeng sa dilemo tse hlano ho fihlela ka la 30 Pudungwana 2019.c) Ho thonngwa hape ha Monghadi Murray Michell, Motsamaisi wa Setsi sa Merero ya Mautlwela a tsa Ditjhelete bakeng sa nako ya dilemo tse pedi e ekeditsweng, ho tloha ka la 1 Pherekgong 2015 ho fihlela ka la 31 Tshitwe 2016.d) Katoloso ya konteraka ya Molaodikakaretso wa Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae, Monghadi MkuseliApleni bakeng sa nako e ekeditsweng ya dilemo tse hlano, ho tloha ka la 1 Mmesa 2015 ho fihlela ka la 31 Hlakubele 2020.e) Thonyo ya Mohlanka ya ka Sehloohong waTshebetso waLefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Mahae le Tlhabollo ya Naha, Monghadi Marks Charles Thibela.
tgt: Injongo yalokhu ukugqugquzela abantu abasha ukuthi bafake isandla emklamweni okuhloswe ngawo ukuthi kuhlinzekwe izindlu ezingu-1.5 wezigidi futhi okuhloswe ngakho ukuthi kuqashwe futhi kuqeqeshwe iMibutho Yetsha eyizi-10 000 kule minyaka emihlanu ezayo.

src: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Mananeo a Bohlokwa a Mmuso.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kweziNhlelo Zikahulumeni Ezisemqoka.

src: Kabinete e ananela Puo ya Boemo ba Naha ya Moporesidente Jacob Zuma, e fileng maAforika Borwa monyetla wa ho utlwa ka Lenaneo la Tshebetso la mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamukela Inkulumo Echaza Isimo Sezwe (i-SoNA) kaMongameli uJacob Zuma, enikeze abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ithuba lokuzwa Uhlelo Lokusebenza Lukahulumeni.

src: Mmuso o etsa kgoeletso ho bankakarolo bohle naheng ka bophara ho Sebetsa Mmoho hodima morero o ntlha di robong bakeng sa ho hotetsa kgolo le ho hlahisa mesebetsi.
tgt: Uhulumeni unxusa bonke ababambiqhaza ezweni lonkana ukuba Basebenzisanee ohlelweni olunamaphuzu ayisishiyagalolunye ukuze babhebhezele ukukhula komnotho futhi basungule imisebenzi.

src: Ho netefatsa hore maAforika Borwa a utlwisisa betere Lenaneo la Tshebetso la mmuso, boikitlaetso ba kgokahanyo ya kamora Puo ya Boemo ba Naha bo kentswe tshebetsong bakeng sa ho fana ka dintlha ka botlalo mabapi le ditsebiso tse entsweng ke Moporesidente.
tgt: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika baluqonda kangcono Uhlelo Lokusebenza Lukahulumeni, ngemuva kwe-SoNA kuye kwenziwa izinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze zihlinzeke ngemininingwane maqondana nezimemezelo ezenziwe nguMongameli.

src: Tsena di kenyeletsa Sehlopha sa Matona sa ditsebiso sa Boraditaba se ileng sa bitsa dikopano ho tloha ka la 15 ho ya ka la 24 Hlakola 2015.Ho feta moo, Puo ya Ditekanyetso ya 2015/16 e reretsweng ho tshwarwa ka la 25 Hlakola 2015 e tla hlakisa phano ya mehlodi mananeong a fapafapaneng a mmuso jwaloka ha Moporesidente a tobokeditse.
tgt: Lezi zimemezelo zibandakanya imihlangano Yamaqoqo oNgqonqoshe Nabezindaba ebanjwe kusukela ngomhla ziyi-15 kuya kumhla zingama-24 Nhlolanja 2015.Ngaphezu kwalokho, Inkulumo yeSabiwomali yonyaka wezi-2015/16 ehlelelwe umhla zingama-25 Nhlolanja 2015 izoqhakambisa ukwabiwa kwezinsizakusebenza ezinhlelweni ezahlukahlukene zikahulumeni njengoba zigcizelelwe nguMongameli.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe boitshwaro bo bobe le boo e seng ba bopalamente ba Ditho tsa Palamente tse ding nakong ya Pulo ya Palamente.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakugxeka kakhulu ukuziphatha okunobudlova nokungahambisani nokuba sephalamende kwamanye Amalungu ePhalamende okwenzeke ngenkathi Kuvulwa iPhalamende.

src: Ho a swabisa hore ditho tsena tse kgethilweng ho ba baemedi ba setjhaba di ile tsa kgetha ho hlompholla ho intsha sehlabelo le ntwa e lwannweng bakeng sa ho fumana demokerasi ya rona e thotsweng ka thata.2 Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka kgatelopele e entsweng ka moruo wa mawatleng wa Operation Phakisa.
tgt: Kuyadumaza kakhulu ukuthi laba bantu abaqokwe ngumphakathi ukuthi bawumele ePhalamende bakhethe ukuthela ngehlazo ukuzidela kanye nomzabalazo owenziwa ukuze kuzuzwe intando yeningi labantu yethu esayilwela kanzima.2 IKhabhinethi iye yachazelwa kafushane maqondana nenqubekela phambili esiyenziwe ngoHlelo lwe-Operation Phakisa Lomnotho Wasolwandle.

src: ‘Laboratori’ kapa mokgahlelo wa ho rera o etsahetse ho la Durban ka Phupu le ka Phato 2014 mme wa tswala tlhahiso e tebileng ya ‘merero e bebofaditsweng’ bakeng sa ho hodisa moruo wa mawatleng.
tgt: I-Lab noma isigaba sokuhlela senziwa e-Durban ngoNtulikazi noNcwaba wezi-2014 futhi saholela ekukhiqizweni ‘kwezinhlelo zokuhlukaniswa ’ komsebenzi ube yizindinyana ezingafezekiswa kalula ukuze kukhuliswe umnotho wasolwandle.

src: Operation Phakisa jwale e se e le mokgahlelong wa ho kenngwa tshebetsong, o kenyeletsang bodisa le taolo ya ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha porojeke.
tgt: Lolu Hlelo (i-Operation Phakisa) selungene esigabeni sokuqaliswa kokusebenza, okubandakanya ukuqapha kanye nokuphatha umklamo wokuqaliswa kokusebenza.

src: Diyuniti tsa phano di se di theilwe mme le mekgwa ya bodisa le ntlafatso le ditsamaiso di se di theilwe.
tgt: Amayunithi okudilivela asesunguliwe kanti futhi izindlela zokuqapha kanye nokukhulisa umnotho kanjalo nezinqubo sezibekiwe.

src: Hape ho ile ha fanwa ka tsebiso mabapi le Operation Phakisa ya bobedi e eteletsweng pele ke Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle, ho tsepamisitswe maikutlo hodima Phihlello ya Sebele ya Ditliliniki le Tokiso eo e leng motjheng mme e thakgotswe ke Moporesidente ka la 18 Pudungwana 20.3 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Morero wa Lewa la Naha wa Ditokelo tsa Bophelo bo Botle mabapi le Thuto ya Boikatiso le ya Thobalano ya ho Kena boholong.
tgt: Ukuchazelwa kafushane kweKhabhinethi kuphinde kwahlinzekwa maqondana ne-Operation Phakisa yesibili eholwa nguMnyango Wezempilo, egxile Kwisibalo Semitholampilo Esezingeni Elifanelekile eyakhiwayo futhi eyethulwa nguMongameli mhla ziyi-18 Lwezi 20.3 IKhabhinethi igunyaze Iqhinga Likazwelonke Lohlaka Lokusebenza Lamalungelo kanye Nempilo Yezocansi Lwabantu Abasha kanye Nokuzalana.

src: Lewa lena le tsepamisitse maikutlo bakeng sa ntshetsopele le kgodiso ya diphetho tsa kalafo eo eleng hore Thuto ya Bophelo bo Botle ya Thobalano le Boikatiso batjheng ke taba e bohlokwa.
tgt: Iqhinga ligxile ekuthuthukisweni kanye nokukhuthazwa kwemiphumela yezempilo nokuyilapho impilo yezocansi lwabantu abasha kanye nokuzalana iwumongo khona.

src: Lewa hape le tla netefatsa kgokahano e ntlafetseng, tsamaelano le boimatahanyo le lenaneo la mmuso, setjhaba le balekane ba ntshetsopele ba seng ba ntse ba sebetsa mabakeng a bophelo bo botle ba ho kena boholong ho tsa thobalano le boikatiso.
tgt: Iqhinga lizophinda liqinisekise ukudidiyelwa okwenziwe ngcono, ukuxhunyaniswa kanye nokuhanjelwaniswa nohlelo lukahulumeni, izinhlangano zomphakathi kanye nokubanjiswene nabo kwezentuthuko oseluvele lusebenza endimeni yempilo yezocansi lwabantu abasha kanye nokuzalana.

src: Komiti ya kopanelo ya Matona bakeng sa Leano la Setjhaba e tla okamela ho kenngwa tshebetsong, bodisa le tekolo ya Lewa lena.4 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya moralo wa Leano la Ntlafatso ya Kgodiso ya Bana Koranteng ya Mmuso.
tgt: Ikomidi loNgqongqoshe Abahlukahlukene leNqubomgomo Yezakhamuzi lizokwengamela ukuqaliswa kokusebenza, ukuqapha kanye nokuhlolwa kwaleli Qhinga.4 IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukushicilelwa kohlaka lweNqubomgomo Yokuthuthukiswa Kwezingane Kusenesikhathi eMqulwini Kahulumeni.

src: Sena se etsa karolo ya Lenaneo la Tshebetso la Aforika Borwa le Kopanetsweng bakeng sa Ntlafatso ya Kgodiso ya Bana - Ho ya pele ka 2013-2016, le tjhaelletswe monwana ke Kabinete ka la 18 Loetse 2013.
tgt: Lokhu kuyingxenye yoHlelo Lokusebenza Oludidiyelwe lwaseNingizimu Afrika Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezingane Kusenesikhathi – Oluqhubekela phambili ohlelweni lonyaka wezi-2013 ukuya kowezi-2016, olwagunyazwa yiKhabhinethi mhla ziyi-18 Mandulo 2013.

src: Leano le fana ka moralo bakeng sa boikarabello ba mmuso ba ho fana ka pakana e pharaletseng ya ditshebeletso tsa Ntlafatso ya Kgodiso ya Bana ya boleng e tla ba teng bakeng sa bohle ka palo e lekaneng le sebaka hore bana kaofela ba fumane monyetla o lekalekanang wa ho di fihlella.
tgt: Inqubomgomo ihlinzeka ngohlaka lokusebenza lokuziphendulela kukahulumeni ekuhlinzekeni ngesithungo esibanzi sezinsizakalo eziseqophelweni eliphezulu Zokuthuthukiswa Kwezingane Kusenesikhathi ezizotholakala ezweni lonke ngamanani agculisayo futhi zibe seduzane nemiphakathi ukuze zonke izingane zizothola ithuba elilinganayo lokufinyelela kuzona.

src: Leano hape le hlahisa ditshebeletso tse mmalwa tse ntjha bakeng sa ho kwala dikgeo tse hlwailweng letotong la ditshebeletso tse teng hajwale haholoholo nakong ya matsatsi a pele a 1 000 a bophelo ba ngwana.
tgt: Inqubomgomo iphinde yethule inqwaba yezinsizakalo ezintsha ezizogcwalisa izikhala ezihlonziwe ezinsizakalweni ezinhlobonhlobo ezitholakalayo njengamanje ikakhulukazi ezinsukwini zokuqala eziyi-1 000 zempilo yengane.

src: Kabinete hape e tjhaelletse monwana ho thehwa ha Komiti ya Kopanelo ya Matona (IMC), e tla netefatsa katamelo e momahaneng le ho hokahana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yagunyaza ukusungulwa kweKomidi loNgqongqoshe Abahlukahlukene (i-IMC), elizoqinisekisa indlela yokusebenza ebumbene nedidiyelwe.

src: E tla tsamaiswa ke Letona la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba.5 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho lokollwa ha tlaleho ya Moralo wa Pele wa nako le nako wa Naha mabapi le Seboka sa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) mabapi le Ditokelo tsa Batho ba Phelang ka Boqhwala, bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba nakong ya matsatsi a Tlaleho e akaretsa nako ya Mmesa 2012- Hlakubele 20.6 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Aforika Borwa e nke karolo ho Selemo sa Matjhaba sa Mmapa ka 2015 le 2016 ka ho hlophisa diketsahalo maemong a naha ka maikemisetso a ho eketsa temoso ka dimmapa le tsebo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: USihlalo walo kuzokuba wuNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi.5 IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukukhishwa kombiko Wezwe Owuhlaka Lokuqala Oluyizikhawu maqondana neNgqungquthela yeNhlangano Yezizwe Ezihlangene (i-UN) ephathelene Namalungelo Abantu Abaphila Nokukhubazeka, ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngawo isikhathi esiyizinsuku ezingama-20.

src: Dimmapa di thusa ho utlwisisa diqaka le dikgonahalo, tse jwaloka phano ya matlo, paballo ya mehlodi ya tlhaho, ho laola dikotsi le ho thusa nako e sa le teng dikahong tsa motheo tse pharaletseng tsa dipalangwang.
tgt: Umbiko ukhuluma ngesikhathi esiphakathi kukaMbasa wezi-2012 kuya kuNdasa wezi-20.6 IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ibambe iqhaza Onyakeni Webalazwe Lamazwe Omhlaba ngowezi-2015 nowezi-2016 ngokuhlela imicimbi ezingeni likazwelonke ngenhloso yokukhulisa izinga lokuqwasha ngebalazwe kanye nokukwazi ukufunda nokubhala eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ho utlwisisa tlhahisoleseding ya dibaka tsa boaho ho a thusa bakeng sa ho etsa meralo le ho nka diqeto bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Amabalazwe asiza ukukwazi ukuqonda izinkinga kanye namathuba, njengokuhlinzekwa kwezindlu, ukulondolozwa kwemithombo yezemvelo, ukuphatha ubungozi kanye nokugqugquzela ingqalasizinda yezokuthutha eyenziwa ngesikhathi futhi ephelele.

src: Diqeto tsa Bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.1 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Taelo e mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha tekolo e itshetlehileng hodima boitsebelo bakeng sa ditho tsa Ditshebeletso tse ka Sehloohong tsa Bolaodi (SMS), e ntshitsweng ho ya ka Kgaolo 4 Karolo II
tgt: Ukuqonda ulwazi lokuklanywa komumo womhlaba kugqugquzela ukuhlela kanye nokuthathwa kwezinqumo ezimayelana nokuthuthukiswa kweNingizimu Afrika.

src: le Kgaolo 4, Karolo VI ya Melawana ya Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba, 2001.Taelo e hlomathisitsweng e kgothaletsa ho hlwauwa ho ikemetseng ha dikgeo tsa ntshetsopele tsa Ditho tsa SMS, e tsebisa tshebediso ya dihlakiso tsa setekginiki le ho fana ka tataiso kamoo mafapha a ka sebedisang diphetho tsa tekolo ya boitsebelo mmoho le ditsamaiso tse ding tsohle tsa ho hira le ho kgetha.2 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tshwarwa ha Beke ya Imbizo ya Naha ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo ho tloha ka la 7 ho isa ka la 12 Mmesa 2015 tlasa mookotaba: “Mmoho re ntshetsa Aforika Borwa pele”.Beke ena e tla bonahala ka ho kena ntlo-le-ntlo bakeng sa dintlha ka maemo a malapa ho potapota malapeng kapa ho eta ka lebaka la porojeke ena dipuisano le bankakarolo ho ikopanya le badudi mmoho le tshebediso ya dikgwebo le boraditaba.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi eziqavile.1 IKhabhinethi igunyaze Umyalelo omaqondana nokuqaliswa kokusebenza kokuhlolwa okugxiliswe olwazini lomsebenzi kumalungu Emisebenzi Yabaphathi Abaphezulu (i-SMS), okhishwe ngokweSahluko 4 Ingxenye II

src: Sena se neha ba ka sehloohong lepatlelo la ho buisana ka kotloloho le maAforika Borwa, ho utlwa mathata a setjhaba ho tswa ho bona le ho beha leihlo kgatelopele ya mananeo a mmuso.3 Dibili.1 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya moralo wa Bili ya Tshireletso, Kgothaletso, Ntshetsopele le Bolaodi ba Ditsamaiso tsa Tsebo ya Ditsamaiso tsa Ka hara Naha Koranteng ya Mmuso mmoho le tsamaiso ya dipuisano le setjhaba.
tgt: neSahluko 4, Ingxenye VI Sezimiso Zemisebenzi Kahulumeni, zonyaka wezi-2001.Umyalelo ochitshiyelwe ukhuthaza ukuhlonzwa ngokuzimele kwezikhala zokuthuthukiswa kweLungu le-SMS, wethula ukusetshenziswa kwemisebenzi enobuchule obuthile futhi uhlinzeka ngomhlahlandlela wokuthi iminyango ingayisebenzisa kanjani imiphumela yokuhlolwa kolwazi lomsebenzi ngokuhlanganyela nazo zonke ezinye izinqubo zokuqashwa kanye nokuqokwa kwabasebenzi.2 IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukusingathwa kweSonto Eligxile kwiMbizo Kazwelonke kusukela mhla ziyi-7 kuya mhla ziyi-12 kuMbasa ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi “Sisonke siqhubekisela iNingizimu Afrika phambili”.Leli Sonto lizogqanyiswa ukuhambela umuzi ngomuzi kuthathwa imininingwane ngezimpilo zabantu bakhona ukudlula noma ukuhanjelwa kwemiklamo izinkulumo-mpendulwano zababambiqhaza kanjalo nokuxoxisana nemiphakathi yabemithombo yezindaba.

src: Sepheo se seholo sa Bili ena ke ho thusa ka tshireletso ya Tsebo ya Ka hara Naha le paballo ya tsebo ya Ka hara Naha e amanang le, mme e le ya baahi ba lehae ba ka hara naha ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lokhu kuhlinzeka izikhulu eziphethe ngesithangami sokuxoxisana ngqo nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, zizizwele ngokwazo izinkinga zomphakathi futhi ziqaphe inqubekelaphambili yezinhlelo zikahulumeni.3 IMithethosivivinywa.1 IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukushicilelwa koMthethosivivinywa Wokuvikelwa, Ukukhuthazwa, Ukuthuthukiswa kanye Nokuphathwa Kwezinhlelo Zolwazi Lomdabu owuhlaka lokuqala eMqulwini Kahulumeni kanjalo nenqubo yokuxoxisana nomphakathi.

src: E thusa ka ho hlabolla ditokelo le melemo tseo baahi ba lehae ba ka hara naha ba neng ba di tinngwe.2 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Taolo ya Dithunya, 2015 Koranteng ya Mmuso bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Injongo enkulu yalo Mthethosivivinywa ukugqugquzela ukuvikelwa Kolwazi Lomdabu kanye nokubuyiswa nokwamukelwa kolwazi Lomdabu oluhlobene noluphethwe yimiphakathi yomdabu kanye neyendawo eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Bili e hlomathisa Molao wa Taolo ya Dithunya, 2000 le ho arabela ho Pono ya Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha ka ho batla ho ntlafatsa moralo wa molao le bolaodi bo tla laola dithunya.
tgt: Ugqugquzela ukubuyiswa kwamalungelo kanye nemihlomulo imiphakathi yomdabu kanye neyendawo eyayiphucwe yona.2 IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukushicilelwa koMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela Ukulawulwa Kwezibhamu, wonyaka wezi-2015 eMqulwini Kahulumeni ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngawo.

src: Taolo ya dithunya ke ntlha ya bohlokwa ya katamelo ya mmuso ya ho lwantsha botlokotsebe.4 Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa hajwale.1 Kabinete e kgothaletsa badudi le dibopeho tse itlhophisitseng ho sebetsa le mmuso, tlasa boetapele ba Lefapha la Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Botjhaba, ho netefatsa hore diphephetso tse potapotileng Malamulele ho la Limpopo di a rarollwa.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho Wokulawulwa Kwezibhamu, wonyaka wezi-2000 futhi uphendule kwiNhlosombono Yohlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP) ngokufuna ukwenza ngcono uhlaka lokusebenza olusemthethweni nolulawulayo oluzobusa ukuphathwa kwezibhamu.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe tshitiso ya dikolo ke dihlopha tse itseng e le tsela ya ho hlahisa ditletlebo.
tgt: Ukulawulwa kwezibhamu kuyingxenye ebalulekile yendlela kahulumeni yokulwisana nobugebengu.4 Isimo seKhabhinethi Ezindabeni Ezisematheni.1 IKhabhinethi inxusa imiphakathi kanye nezinhlaka ezihlelekile ukuba zisebenzisane nohulumeni, ngaphansi kobuholi beHhovisi likaNgqongqoshe Wokwengamela Ngokubambisana kanye Nezendabuko, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izingqinamba ezizungeze indawo yase-Malamulele e-Limpopo ziyaxazululwa.

src: Sena se amohile bana tokelo ya bona ya thuto le ho thibela ba bang tokelo ya ho ingodisetsa dihlahlobo tsa bona tsa tlatsetso tsa Kereiti ya Ho thehwa ha masepala wa Malamulele ho tshwanela ho ba diatleng tsa molao jwaloka ha o behilwe ke Boto ya Karohanyo.2 Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe ditlhaselo tsa melata jwaloka tlolo ya molao mme e thathiselletsa ka hore makala a tsa molao a keke a qeaqea ho sebetsana ka matla kgahlanong le mang kapa mang ya tla fumanwa a rotetsa merusu e jwalo.
tgt: Lokhu kuphuca izingane ilungelo lazo lokufunda futhi kuncishe ezinye ilungelo lokubhalisela izivivinyo zazo zokuchibiyela iBanga le-12.

src: Ha ho bothata bo jwang kapa jwang ba moruo le ho se kgotsofale tse amohelehang tse ka amantshwang le ditlhaselo tsena tsa botlokotsebe.
tgt: Ukusungulwa kukamasipala e-Malamulele kumele kwenziwe ngaphakathi kwemingcele yomthetho njengoba kunqunywe yiBhodi Lokuklanywa Kwemingcele.2 IKhabhinethi iyakugxeka kakhulu ukuhlaselwa kwabantu bokufika kuleli njengesenzo sobugebengu futhi iyagcizelela ukuthi izikhungo zokuqiniswa komthetho ngeke zinqikaze ukuthatha izinyathelo ngokushesha kunoma ubani otholwe ebhebhezela lolo dlame olunjengalelo.

src: Aforika Borwa ke moitlami ka ho saena Porothokhole ya Geneva e mabapi le Baphaphathehi mme e itlamme ho tshireletsa melata yohle e ka hara naha.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika ingelinye lamazwe acikica Isivumelwano saseGeneva esiqondene Nabakhoseli bakwamanye amazwe futhi izinikele ukuvikela bonke abantu bokufika abakuleli lizwe.

src: Jwaloka moitlami ho Porothokhole ena, mme jwaloka naha e kgothaletsang ditokelo tsa botho, re tla tshireletsa ditokelo tsa motheo tsa motho ofe kapa ofe ya ka hara naha ya rona, ho kenyeletswa melata.3 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho hlahiswa Palamenteng bakeng sa tiisetso, Tumellano e Thehang Tumellano le Tlhophiso ya Mokgopi wa Resefe wa BRICS mabapi le Banka e Ntjha ya Ntshetsopele.
tgt: Njengelinye lamazwe acikica lesi Sivumelwano, futhi njengezwe eliqhakambisa amalungelo abantu, sizowavikela amalungelo ayisisekelo abantu bonke abangaphakathi kwelizwe lethu, kubandakanya nabantu bokufika kuleli.3 IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukubekwa ezithebeni zePhalamende kweSivumelwano Esisungula Isikhwama Esizobhekelela Izigameko Zokulahlekelwa Ebezingalindelekile zeBRICS ukuze kuthathwe isinqumo sokuthi lesi sivumelwano kumele sicikicwe yini noma cha kanye Nesivumelwano maqondana Nebhange Lezentuthuko Elisha.

src: Tlhophiso ya Mokgopi wa Resefe e thewa bakeng sa ho arabela ho dikgatello tsa tsepamiso ya ditefello tsa nako e kgutshwanyane.
tgt: Ukuhlelenjwa Kwezingodla Zemigwamanqa kuyasungulwa ukuze kusabele ezingcindezini zesikhashana zokuzinzisa izinkokhelo.

src: Ho fetafeta moo, e tla sebetsa e le mokgwa wa temoso bakeng sa ho thusa dinaha tsa BRICS ho thibela dikgatello tsa nako e kgutshwanyane tsa phallo ya tjhelete, ho fana ka tshehetsano mmoho le ho tswella ho matlafatsa polokeho ya ditjhelete ya lefatshe.4 Kabinete e ananela ho fana ka marapo ha Modulasetulo wa moifo wa Aforika Borwa wa Lekgotla la Kgwebo la BRICS ho tswa ho Monghadi Patrice Motsepe ho ya ho Monghadi Brian Molefe.
tgt: Ngaphezu kwalokho, kuzosebenza njengesinyathelo sokuvikela ukusiza amazwe e-BRICS avimbele izingcindezi zesikhathi esifushane zokuphelelwa imali, kuzohlinzeka ngoxhaso oluhlanganyelwe futhi kuqinise ukuphepha kwenzuzo yezezimali yomhlaba wonke.4 IKhabhinethi iyakuqaphela ukudluliswa kukaSihlalo wengxenye yaseNingizimu Afrika woMkhandlu Wezamabhizinisi e-BRICS kusuka kuMnu.

src: Nakong ya tshebetso ya hae, Monghadi Motsepe o atlehile bakeng sa ho theha lekgotla lena la bohlokwa jwaloka karolo ya setheo sa BRICS le ho sebetsa jwaloka modulasetulo ka bokgabane.
tgt: Motsepe waba ngusihlalo wokuqala ngqa wakho kokubili ingxenye yaseNingizimu Afrika kanye noMkhandlu Wezamabhizinisi e-BRICS wonkana.

src: Kabinete e leboha Monghadi Motsepe ka mosebetsi wa hae le ho lakaletsa Monghadi Molefe tse molemo jwaloka ha a tla kallana le mosebetsi ona wa bohlokwa.5 Kabinete e thoholetsa Sehlopha sa Naha sa Kirikete ka tshebetso ya sona Mohopeng wa Lefatshe wa Kirikete mme e ba lakaletsa tse molemo jwaloka naha e ba tshehetsa bakeng sa thonamente e motjheng Australia le New Zealand.6 Kabinete e thoholetsa seletsi sa folutu Wouter Kellerman ya hapileng Kgau ya Grammy bakeng sa alebamo e kgabane ka ho fetisisa ya moloko o motjha.
tgt: Motsepe waphumelela ekusunguleni lo mgwamanqa obalulekile njengengxenye esemqoka yesakhiwo se-BRICS futhi wasebenza njengosihlalo ngamalengiso.

src: Monghadi Kellerman o hatisitse Winds of Samsara le moqapi wa moIndia Ricky Kej, e ba hapetseng kgau bakeng sa kopanelo ya bona.7 Kabinete e hlahisa teboho ya yona ho basebedisi ba eneji ka ho arabela kgoeletso ya ho fokotsa tshebediso ya motlakase.
tgt: Molefe okuhle kodwa njengoba ethatha lo msebenzi obaluleke kangaka.5 IKhabhinethi incoma iqembu Lesizwe Lekhilikithi ngokudlala kahle kwalo emdlalweni Wendebe Yomhlaba Yekhilikithi futhi ibafisela okuhle kodwa njengoba izwe lonke lizobaxhasa nasemqhudelwaneni oqhubekayo e-Australia nase-New Zealand.6 IKhabhinethi ihalalisela umdlali kamakhweyana u-Wouter Kellerman owaklonyeliswa ngeNdondo ye-Grammy nge-album engungqa-phambili yesikhathi samanje.

src: War Room e theilweng ke Kabinete ka Tshitwe 2014 e eteletsweng pele ke Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa e sebetsa ka thata ho akofisa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha morero o ntlha di hlano tsa ho fetola maemo a hajwale.
tgt: Kellerman uqophe i-Winds of Samsara kanye nomqambi wezingoma waseNdiya u-Ricky Kej, okubazuzele indondo ngokusebenzisana kwabo.7 IKhabhinethi izwakalisa ukubonga kwayo kubona bonke abathengi bakagesi ngokusabela ekhweleni lokunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kukagesi.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le Moporesidente Zuma ka ho fetisetsa matshediso a yona ho ba lelapa le metswalle ya senatla sa bongodi ba Seaforikanse Moporofesara André Brink.
tgt: Ithimba Lokuhlela Nokwenza Amasu elasungulwa yiKhabhinethi ngoZibandlela wezi-2014 liholwa yiPhini likaMongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa liyanyakaza ukusheshisa ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kohlelo olunamaphuzu amahlanu ngenhloso yokuguqula isimo samanje sibe ngcono.8 IKhabhinethi ihlanganyela noMongameli Zuma ekudluliseni amazwi enduduzo emndenini kanye nabangani bengcithabuchopho kwezokubhala ngesiBhunu uSolwazi André Brink.

src: O tla hopolwa jwaloka e mong wa bangodi ba ka sehloohong ba Seaforikanse ya sebedisitseng talente ya hae ya bongodi ho bua kgahlanong le mmuso wa kgethollo.5 Diketsahalo tse tlang.1 Kabinete e thathiselletsa kgoeletso ya Moporesidente Jacob Zuma bakeng sa mekga yohle Lesotho ho sebetsa ka tsela e tla bopa maemo a matle bakeng sa ho tshwara dikgetho tse nang le kgotso, ponaletso, tsa nnete, le tse lokolohileng le ho hloka leeme, mme kahoo di bontsha thato ya setjhaba.
tgt: Uzokhunjulwa njengomunye wababhali abasemqoka besiBhunu abasebenzisa ikhono labo lokubhala ukulwisana nombuso wobandlululo.5 Imicimbi ezayo.1 IKhabhinethi igcizelela ikhwela elihlatshwe nguMongameli uJacob Zuma kuzona zona izinhlangano e-Lesotho ukuba ziziphathe ngendlela esungula isimo esigculisayo sokubamba ukhetho olunokuthula, olusobala, oluqotho, kanye nokhululekile futhi olungacwasi muntu, ngaleyo ndlela olubonisa intando yeningi labantu.

src: Kabinete hape e hlahisa boitshepo ba yona mosebetsing wa bonamodi ba Moifo wa Mokgatlo wa Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tse ka Borwa ba Aforika (SADC) wa Tekolo ya Dikgetho ho la Lesotho tlasa boetapele ba Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Ramaphosa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde izwakalise ithemba layo emsebenzini oqhubekayo wokugqugquzela weNxusa le-SADC Elibhekelele Ukuthula e-Lesotho ngaphansi kobuholi bePhini likaMongameli u-Ramaphosa.

src: Jwaloka karolo ya diqeto tsa Dihlooho tsa Puso ya Troika tsa SADC le Mmuso, Aforika Borwa e tla bapala karolo ya yona ka ho eta pele le ho ba karolo ya Moifo wa SADC wa Tekolo ya Dikgetho ho Mmuso wa Lesotho, bakeng sa dikgetho tse rerilweng tsa la 28 Hlakola 20.2 Molaodi ya ka Sehloohong wa Sesole sa Naha sa Aforika Borwa, Moporesidente Jacob Zuma e tla ba mohlanka ya ka sehloohong moketeng wa Letsatsi la Mabotho a Hlometseng tlasa mookotaba “Lebotho la tshireletso la boporofeshenale le nang le bokgoni bakeng sa batho ba Aforika Borwa” ka la 21 Hlakola 2015, ho la Potchefstroom, Leboya Bophirima.
tgt: Njengengxenye yezinqumo Zezinhloko Zombuso we-SADC Troika kanye Nohulumeni, iNingizimu Afrika izodlala indima yayo ngokuhola kanye nokuba yingxenye yeNxusa le-SADC Elibhekelele Ukuthula Okhethweni loMbuso wase-Lesotho, ngokhetho oluhlelelwe umhla zingama-28 Nhlolanja 20.2 Umkhuzi Wamabutho Wombutho Wezempi Kazwelonke waseNingizimu Afrika, uMongameli uJacob Zuma uzokuba yisikhulu esiqavile esingamele Umgubho Wosuku Lwemibutho Yezempi ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi “Umbutho wezempi osemthethweni nonamandla wabantu baseNingizimu Afrika” mhla zingama-21 kuNhlolanja 2015, e-Potchefstroom, eNyakatho Ntshonalanga.

src: Letsatsi la Mabotho a Hlometseng le ketekwa selemo ka seng ho hlompha banna le basadi ba junifomo ba iteletseng ho sebeletsa setjhaba lapeng le mose.3 Kabinete e kgothaletsa bahiri bohle ba imatahantseng le Molao wa Tekatekano ya Kgiro (EE) ho kenela Dikgau tsa Tekatekano ya Kgiro 2015 pele ho letsatsi la ho kwalwa la 13 Hlakubele 2015.Ketsahalo ena e tla tshwarwa ke Khomishene ya Tekatekano ya Kgiro, e ananela bahiri ba kentseng tshebetsong mawa a netefatsang tekatekano le phapang mosebetsing, ha ho tloswa ditshebetso tsohle tse leeme tse kgethollang.4 Letona la Bohahlaudi Derek Hanekom o tla fana ka puo ho Dikopano tsa Aforika e leng se tla etsahala Setsing sa Dikopano sa Sandton ho tloha ka la 23 ho isa ho la 25 Hlakola 2015 tlasa mookotaba: “Mmoho re tswellisa Aforika”.
tgt: Usuku Lwemibutho Yezempi lugujwa njalo ngonyaka ukuhlonipha amadoda nabesifazane abasembuthweni abasebenzela izwe ngokuzikhandla lapha ekhaya nangaphandle.3 IKhabhinethi igqugquzela bonke abaqashi abathobela uMthetho Wokuqasha Ngokulingana (i-EE) ukuba bangenele Izindondo Zokuqasha Ngokulingana zonyaka wezi-2015 ngaphambi kosuku lokuvala lomhla ziyi-13 kuNdasa 2015.Lo mcimbi osingathwa yiKhomishana Yokuqasha Ngokulingana, uhlonipha abaqashi abaqalise ukusebenza kwamaqhinga aqinisekisa ukuqasha ngokulingana kanye nokuhlukahlukana kwabantu, ngenkathi beqeda yonke imikhuba yokucwasana okungenabulungiswa.4 UNgqongqoshe Wezokuvakasha u-Derek Hanekom uzokwethula inkulumo yokuvula ye-Meetings Africa ezobanjelwa eSandton Convention Centre kusukela mhla zingama-23 kuya kuma-25 kuNhlolanja 2015 ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi: “Sithuthukisa i-Afrika Ndawonye.

src: Ho kenngwa Tshebetsong ha Mananeo a Bohlokwa a Mmuso.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza Kwezinhlelo Zikahulumeni Eziqavile.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Tekanyetso ya Naha ya 2015 e tla kganna ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha morero o ntlha di robong tse ileng tsa tekwa ke Moporesidente nakong ya hae ya Puo ya Boemo ba Naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isamukele Isabiwomali Sikazwelonke sowezi-2015 esizoshayela ukuqala kokusebenza kohlelo olunamaphuzu ayisishiyagalolunye njengoba lwethulwa nguMongameli ngenkathi ethula Inkulumo Echaza Isimo Sezwe.

src: Tekanyetso ena e fana ka bonnete, botsitso le taolo e hlwahlwa ya ditjhelete tse hlokahalang bakeng sa ho tsamaisa moruo wa Aforika Borwa hara maemo ana a boima a moruo.
tgt: Lesi sabiwomali sihlinzeka ngesiqiniseko, ukuzinza kanye nokucongobezela lapho kwenganyelwa izimali zezwe okudingekayo ukuze umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ukwazi ukusimama nakulezi zimo zomnotho ezinzima.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa hore mekgwa ya lekgetho e tsebisitsweng Tekanyetsong ya Naha ya 2015 e ya hlokahala bakeng sa ho tshehetsa ditjhelete selemong sena se ka pele ho rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igcizelele ukuthi izinyathelo zezentela ezethulwe Kusabiwomali Sikazwelonke sowezi-2015 ziyadingeka ukuze kwesekwe ezezimali zezwe nakulo nyakamali esikuwo.

src: MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho sebetsa mmoho le mmuso ho lwantshana le maemo a hajwale a moruo bakeng sa ho susumetsa kgolo ya moruo ho ya pele.2 Kabinete e thoholetsa mosebetsi o kgabane o entsweng ke Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa ka ho thusa ka dikgetho tse lokolohileng le ho hloka leeme ka hara Lesotho mosebetsing wa hae jwaloka Motsamaisi wa Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tse ka Borwa ba Aforika (SADC).
tgt: Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakhuthazwa ukuba basebenzisane nohulumeni ukutheleza izimo zezomnotho esibhekene nazo ukuze kuye phambili ukucijiswa kokusimama komnotho.2 IKhabhinethi incoma umsebenzi oncomekayo owenziwe yiPhini likaMongameli uCyril Ramaphosa lapho ebelekelela ukhetho olukhululekile nolunobulungiswa eLesotho ukudlala indima yakhe njengoMdidiyeli Wenhlangano Ethuthukisa Amazwe aseNingizimu ne-Afrika (i-SADC).

src: Kabinete hape e thoholetsa Lekgotla la Boeletsi la Dikgetho (EAC) la SADC, Khomishene ya Dikgetho ya Lesotho (LEC), Mabotho a Tshireletso le batho ba Lesotho bakeng sa ho tshwara dikgetho tsa kgotso, tse lokolohileng le ho hloka leeme.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde income Umkhandlu Wokwelulekwa Kwesigungu Sokhetho (i-EAC), iKhomishani Yezokhetho yaseLesotho (i-LEC), Abezokuphepha kanye nabantu baseLesotho ngokuba babe nokhetho olunokuthula, olukhululekile kanye nolunobulungiswa.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla sebetsa le mmuso o motjha o kgethilweng wa Lesotho ho ntshetsapele moruo wa dinaha tsena tse pedi, Lebatowa la Aforika e Borwa le Kontinente ka bophara.3 Kabinete e ananela le ho amohela bonkakarolo ba Aforika Borwa ho tshwayeng ha Letsatsi la Lefatshe la Diphoofolo tse hlaha ka la 3 Hlakubele 2015.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika izosebenzisana nohulumeni osanda kukhethwa waseLesotho ukuze kusimamiswe umnotho wala mazwe womabili, Isizinda esiseNingizimu ne-Afrika kanye neli zwekazi lonkana.3 IKhabhinethi ikubonile futhi ikwamukele ukuzibandakanya kweNingizimu Afrika ekuphawuleni koSuku Lomhlaba Lwezilwane Zasendle mhla zi-3 Ndasa 2015.

src: Tlasa boetapele ba Letona Molewa Aforika Borwa e tswela pele ho kenya tshebetsong mananeo a tshireletsang tikoloho ya naha le ntwa kgahlanong le botsomi bo seng molaong.
tgt: Ngaphansi kobugosa bukaNgqongqoshe Molewa iNingizimu Afrika iyaqhubeka nokubeka izinhlelo ezivikela imvelo nendawo yezwe iphinde ilwisane nokuzingela ngokungemthetho.

src: Sa bohlokwa hara tsena ke ho behwa ha Sepolesa sa tsa Tlhaho Boemafofaneng ba Matjhaba ba O. Tambo.
tgt: Okuphambili kulezi ukutshalwa Kofezela Abaluhlaza, phecelezi ama-Green Scorpions, esikhumulweni sezindiza i-OR Tambo International.

src: Sena ke ho netefatsa boimatahanyo le Melawana ya Mefuta e Kotsing kapa e Tshireleditsweng ya Diphoofolo, Melawana ya Khonferense ya Mekga bakeng sa Seboka sa Kgwebo ya Matjhaba bakeng sa Dibopuwa tse Kotsing tsa Diphoofolo le Dimela tse Hlaha (CITES), Botsomi naheng, Melawana ya Phumantsho le Karolelano ya Melemo le Melawana ya Mefuta ya Diphoofolo tsa Mekenella.
tgt: Lokhu kungokokuqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa Kwezimiso Zemvelo Esengcupheni noma Evikelwe, Izimiso ze-CITES, Izimiso Zokuhlwaywa Kwemvelo Ephilayo, Ukufinyeleleka Nokwabelana Ngemihlomulo kanjalo Nezimiso Zemvelo Yokufika Nehlaselayo.

src: Aforika Borwa hape e bapetse karolo ya bohlokwa tshebedisanong le Interpol, haholoholo ho Boto ya Boeletsi ya Boimatahanyo le Tikoloho le Komiti ya Bophethahatsi, mme ka hara dihlopha tse tharo tsa Interpol tsa tshebetso tseo e leng Sehlopha sa Tshebetso sa Botlokotsebe ba Diphoofolo tse Hlaha, sa Botlokotsebe ba Botshwasi ba Ditlhapi le sa Botlokotsebe ba Tshilafatso ya Tikoloho.4 Kabinete e elelletswe hore Durban e entse boiketo ba ho tshwara Dipapadi tsa Matjhaba tsa Commonwealth tsa 2022, bo entsweng semmuso London ka la 2 Hlakubele 2015.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika iphinde yadlala indima eqavile ekuxoxisaneni ne-Interpol, ikakhulukazi kuBhodi Yokweluleka Yekomidi Lokuthotshelwa Kwemibandela Yezemvelo, kanjalo nakumaqembu okusebenza ngobugebengu amathathu e-Interpol lapha sibala Iqembu Lokusebenza Lobugebengu Obubhekiswe Kwizilwane Zasendle, Iqembu Lokusebenza Lezobugebengu Kwezokudoba kanye Neqembu Lokusebenza Lobugebengu Bokungcolisa.4 IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukuthi i-Durban ifake isicelo sokusingatha ama-2022 Commonwealth Games, nesethulwe ngokusemthethweni eLondon mhla zi-2 Ndasa 2015.

src: Ho tshwarwa ha dipapadi tsena ho ka tla le bokgoni ba ho hlahisa mesebetsi e ka bang 11 650 le ho Phahamisa moruo wa naha ka tjhelete e akantsweng ho R20 bilione.
tgt: Ukusingatha le midlalo kungadala imisebenzi ebalelwa kweyizi-11 650 kuphinde kusimamise umnotho wezwe ngezigidigidi zamarandi ezibalelwa kwezingama-20.

src: Lefa le leng la Dipapadi e tla ba mokgwa wa dipalangwang tsa setjhaba o hokahantsweng bakeng sa Durban moo merero ya teng e seng e tjhaelletswe monwana.
tgt: Elinye ifa lale Midlalo kuyoba uhlelo oludidiyelwe lwezokuthutha zomphakathi nesikhuluma nje izinhlelo zakhona sezigunyaziwe.2 Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi Eziqavile.1 IKhabhinethi igunyaze Ukuchitshiyelwa Kwenqubomgomo Yokushintsha Ukusakaza Ngendlela Edijithali kubandakanywe uhlelo lokulawula ku-Set Top Box (i-STB), noluzocaciswa kahle kunqubomgomo eshicilelwe.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Leano la Sehlomathiso sa ho Fetolwa ha Mokgwa wa Kgaso ka ho kenyeletswa ha mokgwa wa taolo ho Mabokose a kengwang Hodimo a Thelevishene (STB), o tla hlaloswa ka ho hlaka ha leano le se le phatlaladitswe.
tgt: Uhulumeni uzohlinzeka nge-STB yamahhala kumakhaya ampofu angaphezu kwezigidi ezinhlanu anomabonakude.

src: Mmuso o tla fana ka STB mahala ho beng ba malapa a futsanehileng a fetang dimilione tse hlano.
tgt: Kuzobekwa eqhulwini lawo makhaya asezizindeni ezisemingceleni yezwe.

src: Ho tla shejwa pele malapa a phelang dibakeng tsa mabatowa a meeding ya naha.
tgt: Kungekudala nje Ungqongqoshe Wezokuxhumana uzomemezela usuku okuzovulwa ukusakaza ngendlela edijithali kanjalo nalolo okuzocinywa ngalo ukusakaza ngendlela ebizwa phecelezi, i-analogue.2 IKhabhinethi igunyaze Uhlaka lweminyaka emihlanu Lwezolimo, ezamahlathi Nezokudoba kanye Nenqubomgomo Yohlelo Lokusebenza Kwezolimo.

src: Letona la Dikgokahanyo le tla tsebisa ka letsatsi la ho bulwa ha letshwao la dijithale le la ho kwalwa ha mokgwa wa Analoko haufinyane.2 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana morero wa dilemo tse hlano wa lewa la moralo wa Temo, Meru le Botshwasi ba Ditlhapi le Leano la Moralo wa Tshebetso wa Temo.
tgt: Uhlaka lubeka ngokusobala izinselele eziqavile ezibhekene nezimboni zontathu luphinde lunikeze izindlela zokungenelela ezingasetshenziswa kuzo zozine lezi zindawo, lapha sibala Ukulingana noguquko, ukukhula ngokulinganayo nokuncintisana, ukuzinza endaweni kanye nokubusa.

src: Moralo o teka diphephetso tsa bohlokwa tse tobilweng ke makala a mararo le ho sisinya boitshunyako dibakeng tse nne e leng Tekatekano le diphethoho kgolo e lekalekanang le phehisano, paballo ya tikoloho le taolo.
tgt: Icebo kanye nohlelo lokuqaliswa komsebenzi luzobe lulokhu lubukezwa njalo ngonyaka.

src: Karolelano ya mobu ke le leng la mananeo a mmuso le hodisitseng tekatekano, empa ho fihlela mona ha e so fihlelle ho hongata ka tsela ya diphethoho.
tgt: Ukwabiwa komhlaba kungolunye lwezinhlelo zikahulumeni oluqhakambisa ukulingana kubantu, kodwa kuze kube manje, akukuningi eselukufezile ekuletheni uguquko.

src: Leha lenaneo la kahobotjha le ntshetsopele le tekile hore sepheo se seholo sa karolelano ya naha e ne e le ho fetola sebopeho sa Temo ya Aforika Borwa, hape e batla ho tshehetsa makala hore ho hodiswe moruo le ho hlahisa mesebetsi.3 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana bakeng sa Seboka sa Lefatshe sa Dipetlele sa bo40 sa Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Dipetlele se tla tshwarelwa Durban ho ya mafelong a 2016.
tgt: Kodwa-ke lolu hlelo lokwakha kabusha nokuthuthukisa lwaveza ukuthi inhlosongqangi yokwabiwa komhlaba ingukushintsha ukuma kwesimo sezolimo eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Dipetlele ke mokgatlo wa lefatshe o ikemetseng, o sa etseng phaello, oo e seng wa mmuso bakeng sa dipetlele le mokgatlo wa tlhokomelo ya kalafo.
tgt: Luphinde lufise ukweseka lezi zimboni ukuze kusimame umnotho kwakhiwe nemisebenzi.3 IKhabhinethi igunyaze Umhlangano wama-40 Wezibhedlela Zomhlaba Wenhlangano Yomhlaba Yezibhedlela ozobanjelwa e-Durban ngasekupheleni kowezi-2016.

src: Seboka sa selemo ka seng se neha basebeletsi ba kalafo monyetla wa ho arolelana mekgwa ya tshebetso ya dikatamelo tse hlwahlwa ka ho fetisisa tsa ho ntlafatsa diphetho tsa tlhokomelo ya kalafo.4 Kabinete e etsa boipiletso ho batswadi ho itahlela ka setotswana ho Dikgetho tsa Makgotlataolo a Dikolo (di-SGB) tsa 2015 tse tla tshwarwa dikolong tsohle tsa setjhaba ho tloha ka la 6 ho ya ho la 28 Hlakubele 2015.
tgt: Inhlangano Yomhlaba Yezibhedlela iyinhlangano yomhlaba wonke jikelele ezimele, engenzi nzuzo, engekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni engeyezibhedlela kanye nezihlangano ezihlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo.

src: Di-SGB di nehela ntshetsopeleng ya maikutlo a matla a ho ba beng ba dikolo tsa rona.
tgt: Umhlangano lo waminyaka yonke uhlinzeka abasebenzi bezempilo ngethuba lokucobelelana ngamasu nezindlela zokuthuthukisa imiphumela yezokwelapha.4 IKhabhinethi inxusa abazali ukuba bazibandakanye ngokuphelele okhethweni Lwezigungu Ezilawula Ukusebenza Kweszikole (i-SGB) oluzokwenziwa kuzo zonke izikole zikahulumeni kusukela mhla ziyi-6 kuya kumhla zingama-28 kuNdasa 2015.

src: Tshebetso ya dikolo ka kakaretso ho kenyeletswa le ho sebetsa hantle dithutong ho a ntlafala ha batswadi ba itahletse ka setotswana le ho ba le kgahleho mererong ya sekolo.
tgt: Ama-SGB alekelela ekuthuthukisweni kwalowo muzwa wokubandakanywa kwemiphakathi ezikoleni zethu.

src: Ditho tsa SGB tse fetang 250 000 di kgethwa dilemong tse ding le tse ding tse tharo ho sebetsa dikolong tsa rona tsa setjhaba di kopane ka morero o tshwanang, ho etsa thuto ntlha ya mannete ya setjhaba.
tgt: Ukusebenza kwezikole nje jikelele kubandakanya nemiphumela kuvame ukusimama uma abazali bezibandakanye ngokugcwele ezindabeni zezikole.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha Dibili tse pedi, tseo bobedi di hlomathisang Molao wa Bana, 2005 (Molao wa 38 wa 2005) jwaloka ha o hlomathisitswe ke Molao wa 41 wa 2007, ho Palamente.
tgt: Aabalelwa ngaphezu kwezi-250 000 amalungu e-SGB akhethwayo esikhathini seminyaka emithathu ukuba aasebenze ukubhekelela izikole zikahulumeni ehlanganiswe umgomo owodwa, ukwenza imfundo ibe yindaba yomphakathi wonkana.3 Imithethosivivinywa.1 IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukulethwa Kwemithethisivivinywa emibili, yomibili echibiyela Umthetho Wezingane, wezi-2005 (Umthetho ongunombolo 38 wezi-2005) njengoba uchitshiyelwe nguMthetho wama-41 wezi-2007, ePhalamende.

src: Dihlomathiso di arabela ho dikahlolo tsa makgotla a dinyewe, tse behileng hore dikarolo tse itseng tsa Molao di kgahlanong le Molao wa Motheo.
tgt: Lezi zichibiyelo ziphendula izahlulelo zenkantolo, ezamemezela ukuthi izigaba ezithile zoMthetho zazingahambisani nomthethosisekelo.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Bana, 2015 (karolo 75 ya Bili) – Dihlomathiso di shebana le tlhaloso ya “tlolo ya molao wa motabo” le ho imatahanya le Molao wa Botlokotsebe (ditlolo tsa molao wa motabo le mabaka a tsamaelanang) ya sehlomathiso sa Molao wa 32 wa 2007.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela Wezingane, wezi-2015 (isigaba sama-75 soMthethosivivinywa) – Ukuchitshiyelwa lokhu kuqondene nokulungiswa kwencazelo yokuthi “icala lezocansi” kanye nokuyenza ihambisane Nomthetho Wobugebengu (amacala ezocansi kanye nokunye okuqondene nalokho) uMthetho ongunombolo 32 wezi-2007.

src: Dihlomathiso hape di sebetsana le ho dumella batlodi ba molao ba bana ho etsa ditlhahiso pele mabitso a bona a kenyeletswa ho Rejisetara ya Naha ya Tshireletso.
tgt: Ukuchitshiyelwa lokhu kuphinde kubhekane nokuvumela izingane ezeqa umthetho ukuba zikwazi ukuzikhulumela ngaphambi kokuba amagama azo afakwe Kurejista Kazwelonke Yezokuvikela.

src: Dihlomathiso tse sisintsweng hape di hlakisa tlhoko ya ho beha ngwana tlhokomelong le ho fana ka mekgahlelo ya tlatsetso bakeng sa bana ba ka nkuwang ke batswadi bao e seng ba bona ka madi.
tgt: Loku kuchibiyela okuhlongozwayo kuphinde kucacise isidingo sokufaka ingane ngaphansi kohlelo lokunakekelwa ngosingabazali luphinde luhlinzeke ngezinye izigaba ezengeziwe zezingane ezingafaneleka ukuba zitholwe ngabazali abasha.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya bobedi ya Bana, 2015 (karolo 76 ya Bili) – se rerile ho netefatsa hore bana bohle ba fumana ditshebeletso le melemo e reretsweng ho thusa ka phumantsho ya tlhokomelo ya kahisano le tshireletso le ho bopa mokgwa wa thekolohelo ya kahisano o hlwahlwa.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela Wesibili Wezingane, wezi-2015 (isigaba sama-76 soMthethosivivinywa) – uhlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izingane zithokozela izinsiza nemihlomulo okuhloswe ngayo ukuba zithole ukunakekelwa ngokwasemphakathini kanye nokuthi ziphephe kanjalo nokwakha uhlelo lwezenhlalakahle olusebenza ngempumelelo.

src: Hape e batla ho fana ka tikoloho e bolokehileng le e tshireletsehileng bakeng sa ho falliswa ha bana bao ho fumanehang hore ba hloka tlhokomelo le tshireletso.
tgt: Uuphinde usophe ukuhlinzeka ngendawo ephephile nenokuvikeleka ezinganeni ezizithola zihlwempu futhi zidinga ukunakekelwa nokuvikelwa.4 Isimo seKhabhinethi Ezindabeni Ezisematheni.1 IKhabhinethi iyihlaba iyayihlikiza indaba yokuputshuka kwemiqingo engabeka ukuphepha kwezwe engcupheni.

src: Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa Hajwale.
tgt: Yize noma kuyinqubo yakhona ukuba izwe labelane, phakathi kokunye, ngezindaba ezithinta amathuba ezomnotho kanye nokuphepha kwezwe, kodwa amahemuhemu okuputshuka kwemiqingo yeNhlangano Kahulumeni Yezokuvikela akukho emthethweni.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe ka matla, ho nyenyelepa ha ditokomane tse ka behang tshireletso ya naha tsietsing.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukela uphenyo olugcwele leNhlangano Kahulumeni Yezokuvikela odabeni lolu futhi iqinisekisa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi izoqhubeka nokwenza umsebenzi wayo wokuvikela nokugcina isithunzi sezwe, izakhamuzi kanye nengqalasizinda kuphephile.

src: Leha e le tshebetso ya matjhaba e tlwaelehileng bakeng sa dinaha ho arolelana mautlwela, hara tse ding, dintlha tse paroletsang tse amanang le menyetla ya moruo le mabaka a tshireletso, ho nyenyelepa ho bolelwang ha ditokomane tse hlahisang ditshebetso tsa Lekala la Tshireletso ya Puso ha ho molaong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igcizelela umyalezo waNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikeleka Kwezwe, uDavid Mahlobo, ukuthi ukuziphatha okufana nalokhu kubukela phansi umsebenzi owenziwayo ukuze kuvikelwe izwe nemingcele yalo.2 IKhabhinethi yemukela isimemezelo sakwa-Eskom sokuthi Iyunithi 6 Yesiteshi Sikagesi, i-Medupi, ikhiqize amandla kagesi okuqala kuleli sonto, nokwenza ukuthi ibe iyunithi yokuqala kwayisithupha ukuba asebenzisane.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa molaetsa wa Letona la Tshireletso ya Puso, Letona David Mahlobo, hore boitshwaro bo jwalo bo nyenyefatsa bohlwahlwa ba tshebetso ba mosebetsi wa ho baballa naha le meedi ya yona.
tgt: Ukusebenzisana yinqubo lapho ijenereyitha ixhunywa ebuxhakaxhakeni obuphehla amandla agesi kazwelonke.

src: Kabinete e ananela tsebiso ya Eskom ya hore Yuniti ya bo 6 ya Seteishene sa Motlakase sa Medupi e qadile ho hlahisa motlakase wa yona wa pele bekeng ena, ho e etsa ya pele ya diyuniti tsa yona tse tshelela hore e kenngwe tshebetsong.
tgt: Ngenkathi siqhubeka nokuzama ukwandisa amandla kagesi kuzwelonke, ikhabhinethi inxusa umphakathi ukuba ulandele imithetho ebekiwe yokonga ugesi.

src: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ke tsela eo ka yona sefehlamatla se hokelwang ka motlakase ho marangrang a naha a motlakase.
tgt: Imiphakathi iyakhuthazwa ukuba isebenzise ugesi ngokucongobezela, ngenkathi sisazama ukwethula eminye imithombo yamandla agesi.3 IKhabhinethi incoma isibindi, ukuzinikela, ukuzibophezela nokusebenza ngokuzikhandla kwabesilisa nabesifazane abangaphumuli bevikela impahla ukuba ingalimali, imfuyo kanye nemvelo ebalulekile ngenkathi amalangabi eKapa edla lubi.

src: Ha re ntse re tswela pele ho sebeletsa tabeng ya ho eketswa ha phepelo ya motlakase ho marangrang a naha, Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho setjhaba ho tswela pele ho imatahanya le mekgwa ya ho baballa eneji.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izwakalise ukubonga emiphakathini okuthe ngobuntu bayo, yazibandakanya nohulumeni ukwakha izikhungo zokunakekela ukuze kuhlaliswe labo abangenazindawo.

src: Badudi ba kgothaletswa ho boloka motlakase, ha re tswella ho hlahisa mehlodi e meng ya eneji.3 Kabinete e thoholetsa sebete, boitlamo, boitelo le mosebetsi o matla wa banna le basadi ba sebetsang ka thata ho pholosa bophelo le ho thibela tshenyo ya thepa, mehlape le tikoloho ya tlhaho tse neng di kupeditswe ke mello e hlaha ho la Motse Kapa.
tgt: Umoya wokuvolontiya okhonjiswe abantu abasize izisulu zomlilo ube muhle kakhulu futhi uyakhuthaza.

src: Kabinete e hlahisa teboho ya yona ho badudi ka moya wa Botho, ka kopanelo le mmuso ka ho theha ditsha tsa tlhokomelo ya bongata ho thusa ba lahlehetsweng ke bodulo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isakhathazekile ngokuhlaselwa kwezifikanamthwalo futhi yexwayisa ukuthi izikhungo zomthetho zizoqhubeka nokubonakala ezindaweni ezithintekayo, nokuthi abenzi bokubi bazobhekana nengalo yomthetho.

src: Moya wa boithaopi o bontshitsweng ke batho ba neng ba thusa diphofu tsa mello ke o moholo le o kgothatsang.4 Kabinete e dula e ngongorehile ka ditlhaselo tsa melata mme e hlokomedisa hore makala a kgatello ya molao a tla tswela pele ho iponahatsa ka bongata dibakeng tse amehang, mme batlodi ba molao ba tla kopana le letsoho le matla la molao.
tgt: Udlame olubhekiswe kuzifikanamthwalo kuleli luyabhekisiswa yizinhlaka zikaHulumeni.5 IKhabhinethi ihalalisele iqembu laseNingizimu Afrika likanobhutshuzwayo Labangaphansi kweminyaka eyi-17, Amajimbos, ngokwenza izwe liziqhenye ngalo lapho liphumelela ukungena emdlalweni wamanqamu Emncintiswaneni Wabangaphansi kweminyaka eyi-17 wezi-2015 e-Afrika e-Niamey, e-Niger.

src: Dikgoka kgahlanong le melata di shebuwe ka leihlo le ntjhotjho le ho sebetswa ka dibopeho tse fapaneng tse teng tsa Mmuso.5 Kabinete e thoholetsa Sehlopha sa bolo sa Aforika Borwa sa ba ka Tlasa Dilemo tse 17 (U17), Amajimbos, bakeng sa ho etsa naha motlotlo ka ho atleha ho kenela makgaolakgang a 2015 a Bompodi ba Aforika ba U17 Niamey, ho la Niger.
tgt: Indlela abadlale ngayo encomekayo kulo mncintiswano Wentsha Yase-Afrika ubanikeze ithuba lokudlala emncintiswaneni Wendebe Yomhlaba, i-FIFA U17, e-Chile ngasemaphathelweni awo lo ophezulu.6 IKhabhinethi izwakalisa isililo ngokudlula emhlabeni kwenye yezingqalabutho zabaculi baseNingizimu Afrika u-Zayn Adam, usaziwayo owayecula phambili eqenjini elalithandwa kakhulu ngeminyaka yezi-1970 i-Pacific Express, nomculo wakhe owavelela isikhathi esiyiminyaka engama-50.

src: Mosebetsi wa bona o babatsehang ho Bompodi ba Batjha ba Aforika o ba dumella ho kenela Mohope wa Lefatshe wa FIFA wa U17 ho la Chile hamorao selemong sena.6 Kabinete e utlwisitswe bohloko ke ho hlokahala ha mohale wa mmino wa Aforika Borwa Zayn Adam, sephoko se hlwahlwa sa sehlopha se matla sa di-70 Pacific Express eo mosebetsi wa hae o nkileng ho feta dilemo tse E ne e le ntho e le nngwe le nalane ya mmino ya Motse Kapa.7 Kabinete e thabile hore, jwaloka letshwao la nnete la mmuso o kgathallang, mokgahlelo wa ho qetela wa ho busetsa masalla oohle a maAforika Borwa a ileng a timela ho putlameng ha ntlo ya baeti eo e leng ya Synagogue Church of All Nation (SCOAN) ho la Lagos o phethetswe.
tgt: Wayehamba phambili emlandweni womculo waseKapa.7 IKhabhinethi ithakase kakhulu ngokuthi, njengohulumeni onakekelayo, isiwombe sokugcina sokubuyiswa kwezidumbu zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abadlula emhlabeni ngenkathi kubhidlika indlu yezivakashi yase-Synagogue Church of All Nation (SCOAN) eLagos sesiphothuliwe.

src: Mehopolo ya rona e na le ba malapa ba lahlehetsweng ke baratuwa ba bona le ba lemetseng mahlomoleng ao.5 Diketsahalo tse tlang.1 Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla etsa puo pulong ya Ntlo ya Naha ya Baetapele ba Setso Palamenteng, Motse Kapa ka la 5 Hlakubele 2015 (kajeno).
tgt: Imindeni yalabo abalahlekelwe ngabathandiweyo babo isemicabangweni yethu kanjalo nalabo abalimala kule nhlekelele.5 Imicimbi Ezayo.1 UMongameli Jacob Zuma uzokwethula inkulumo yokuvulwa Kwendlu Yabaholi Bendabuko Kuzwelonke ePhalamende, eKapa ngomhla ziyi-5 Ndasa 2015 (namuhla).

src: Kamano dipakeng tsa mmuso le baetapele ba setso e hlokolosi bakeng sa ho aha metse ya mahae e kganyang, e lekalekanang le ya moshwelella.2 Kabinete e ananela ho kgutla ha bahale ba hlomphehang ba ntwa ya tokoloho J.
tgt: Ubudlelwano phakathi kukahulumeni nabaholi bendabuko bubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kwakhiwa imiphakathi eshabashekayo, enokuphatha ngokulingana kanye nezindawo zasemakhaya ezinesimo esizinzile.2 IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukubuyiselwa kwamathambo ezishoshovu ezaziwayo zomzabalazo u-JB Marks no-Moses Kotane eNingizimu Afrika zisuka e-Russia lapho zazingcwatshwe khona iminyaka engama-42 edlule.

src: Marks le Moses Kotane ho tla Aforika Borwa ho tswa Russia moo ba ileng ba bolokwa dilemo tse 42 tse fetileng.
tgt: Laba baholi abangazicabangelanga bona bodwa, abathathwa njengabazali bomzabalazo wenkululeko futhi abafaka ugqozi kuzigadlaba ezifana no-Nelson Mandela, Oliver Tambo no-Walter Sisulu, bazothola ukungcwatshwa ngokusemthethweni.

src: Baetapele bana ba neng ba itetse, ba nkuwang e le bontate ba ntwa ya tokoloho le ba kgothaditseng diqhoku tse kang Nelson Mandela, Oliver Tambo le Walter Sisulu, ba tla fumana mapato a ikgethileng a semmuso.
tgt: UMongameli Jacob Zuma uyalele ukuthi ifulegi lakuleli lithotshwe kusukela ngomhla ziyi-9 kuNdasa kuze kube ngumhla zingama-22 Ndasa 2015.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o laetse hore Folakga ya Naha e fofele hare ho tloha ka la 9 Hlakubele ho fihlela bosiung ba la 22 Hlakubele 2015.
tgt: U-Moses Kotane uzongcwatshwa kabusha ePella, eNyakatho Ntshonalanga ngomhla ziyi-14 Ndasa 2015 bese u-JB Marks angcwatshelwe e-Ventersdorp, eNyakatho Ntshonalanga mhla zingama-22 Ndasa 2015.

src: Moses Kotane o tla patwa botjha ho la Pella, Leboya Bophirima ka la 14 Hlakubele 2015 mme J.
tgt: Ukubuyiswa kwamathambo kuyingxenye yokuzibophezela kukahulumeni ekubuyiseni amathambo awo onke amaqhawe afela emazweni okuhamba.

src: Selemong se fetileng molwantshi wa kgethollo ya hlomphehang, raditaba Nat Nakasa o ile a busetswa ka katleho ho tswa New York hore a tlo patwa botjha Setsheng sa Bafu sa Bahale Chesterville, Durban.3 Kabinete e ananela letsholo le matla le pharaletseng la ho hlolwa le ho etsa diteko tsa Lefuba (TB) le tla thakgolwa ke Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa ka la 24 Hlakubele 2015 e leng Letsatsi la Lefatshe la TB, Seterekeng sa Ngaka Kenneth Kaunda sa Porofense ya Leboya Bophirima – tlasa mookotaba “Phediso ya lefu la TB Aforika Borwa: Ho akofisa karabelo ya rona Ditjhabeng tse ka Sehloohong”.
tgt: Ngonyaka odlule amathambo entatheli eyaziwayo u-Nat Nakasa abuyiswa ngempumelelo esuka e-New York ukuze angcwatshwe kabusha e-Heroes Acre e-Chesterville, e-Durban.3 IKhabhinethi yamukela umkhankaso ongukhukhulelangoqo Wokuxilongwa nokuhlolwa kweSifo Sofuba (i-TB) ozokwethulwa yiPhini likaMongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa ngomhla zingama-24 Ndasa 2015 nokuzobe kuwuSuku Lomhlaba Lwe-TB, esiFundeni sase-Dr Kenneth Kaunda esiFundazweni saseNyakatho Ntshonalanga – ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi “Ukushabalaliswa kukamashayabhuqe we-TB eNingizimu Afrika: Siphuthumisa Usizo Lwethu Kuzisulu Zegciwane leSandulela-Ngculazi”.

src: Letsholo lena la nako e telele le tla susumetsa maAforika Borwa oohle haholoholo ba dulang metseng ya merafo, batshwaruwa ba leng tjhankaneng le ditsing tsa ntshetsopele ya thuto ya pele ya bana hore ba hlolwe le ho etswa diteko bakeng sa TDilemong tse hlano tse fetileng ho entswe mehato e meholo bakeng sa ho matlafatsa mawa a mmuso a taolo ya TB ka ho hlolwa le diteko tse ekeditsweng haholoholo ka Dikeletso tsa Kgothatso tsa HIV le letsholo la Diteko.
tgt: Lo mkhankaso ongenasiphelo uzohlomisa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ikakhulukazi labo abahlala emiphakathini yasezimayini, iziboshwa ezisezikhungweni zokuhlunyeliswa kwezimilo kanye nasezinkulisa ukuze bakwazi ukuxilongwa bahlolelwe i-TKule minyaka emihlanu edlule sibe nenqubekela phambili enkulu lapho siqinise amasu kahulumeni okulawula i-TB ngokunyusa amanani abantu abaxilongwa nabahlolwa i-TB ikakhulukazi ngokusetshenziswa koMkhankaso WokuHlolelwa Nokwelulekwa Ngegciwane leSandulela-Ngculazi.

src: Ho hlolwa le diteko di ile tsa boela tsa phahamiswa ka ho hlahiswa ha diteko tsa popolo tse potlakileng bakeng sa TB le TB e hanang pheko.4 Kabinete e thoholetsa boitelo le boitlamo ba matitjhere a rona, bao ntle le bona re ne re ke keng ra fihlella bongata ba dipheo tsa rona tsa naha.
tgt: Ukuxilongwa nokuhlolwa kuphinde kwalekelelwa ukwethulwa kohlelo lokuhlolwa i-TB ne-TB engazweli imishanguzo lunikeze imiphumela ngaleso sikhathi.4 IKhabhinethi incoma ukuzinikela nokuzibophezela kothisha bethu, ngaphandle kwabo ebesingeke sikwazi ukufeza imigomo yethu eminingi njengezwe.

src: Dikgetho bakeng sa Dikgau tsa Botitjhere tsa Naha di ananela nehelo e kgethehileng eo matitjhere a e etsang bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya naha ya rona Mokete wa Dikgau o tla tshwarwa ka la 7 Hlakubele 2015 Gallagher Estate, ho la Midrand.
tgt: Amagama aphakanyiselwe Izindondo Zothisha Kuzwelonke azisa igalelo elingelinganiswa elifakwa othisha emizamweni yokuthuthukisa izwe lethu umcimbi walezi Zindondo uzoba ngomhla ziyi-7 Ndasa 2015 e-Gallagher Estate, e-Midrand.

src: Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo le tshwara ketsahalo ena ya selemo ka seng ho isa tlhompho ho matitjhere a itetseng, a itlammeng, a sebetsang ka thata le a seporofeshenale.5 Letona la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere, Letona Nomvula Mokonyane le tla thakgola Beke ya Naha ya Metsi tulong e hlasetsweng ke komello ya KwaDukuza ho la KwaZulu-Natal ka la 16 Hlakubele 2015 tlasa mookotaba: “Ha ho se ka nkelang Metsi Sebaka”.
tgt: UMnyango WezeMfundo Eyisisekelo usingatha lo mcimbi waminyaka yonke ukuze ukhombise ukwazisa ukuzinikela, ukuzibophezela, ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla nokuziphatha ngendlela ehlelekile kothisha.5 UNgqongqoshe Wezamanzi Nokuthuthwa Kwendle uNomvula Mokonyane uzokwethula Isonto Likazwelonke Lezamanzi endaweni ehlaselwe yisomiso KwaDukuza, KwaZulu-Natali mhla ziyi-16 Ndasa 2015 ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Akukho okungafaniswa Namanzi”.

src: Beke ena ya Naha e tla qetella ka Letsatsi la Lefatshe la Metsi ka la 22 Hlakubele 2015.
tgt: Leli sonto eligujwa nguzwelonke lizophethwa ngoSuku Lomhlaba Lwamanzi mhla zingama-22 Ndasa 2015.

src: Letsholo lena le tla ruta maAforika Borwa ka molemo wa metsi le tlhokeho ya ho laola bakeng sa moshwelella wa mohlodi ona o haellang.
tgt: Lo mkhankaso uzofundisa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokubaluleka kwamanzi nesidingo sokuphathwa ngendlela ezinzile kwale nsiza eyimvelakancane.

src: Kabinete e hopotsa maAforika Borwa oohle hore re phela naheng eo ho yona metsi a haellang le ho kgothaletsa bohle ho a boloka, ka ho lokisa ho dutla hwa dipeipi le ho phela ka ho hlalefela metsi.6 Sontaha, 8 Hlakubele, e tshwaya Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Basadi (IWD) e leng letsatsi le sebediswang selemo ka seng lefatshe ka bophara ho shebela morao kgatelongpele e entsweng, kgoeletso bakeng sa diphethoho le ho keteka diketso tsa sebete le maikemisetso ke basadi ba tlwaelehileng ba bapetseng karolo e kgolohadi nalaneng ya metse ya bona le dinaha tsa bona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuza bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi sihlala ezweni elingenawo amanzi amaningi iphinde inxenxe bonke abantu ukuba bonge amanzi ngokulungisa wonke amapayipi avuzayo baphinde benze izinguquko endleleni abaphatha ngayo amanzi.6 NgeSonto, mhla ziyi-8 kuNdasa, Usuku Lwabesifazane Lomhlaba (i-IWD) nokuwusuku olusetshenziswa umhlaba ukubheka emuva inqubekela phambili eseyenziwe, nokuba kukhuthazwe ushintsho kuphinde kuthokozelwe izinto ezikhombisa isibindi nokuzimisela kwabantu besifazane abafana nami nawe kodwa abadlala indima engefaniswe emlandweni wayo yonke imiphakathi namazwe.

src: Lefapha la Basadi le tla etella pele mekete ya IWD Sekolong se Phahameng sa Langa ho la Motse Kapa tlasa mookotaba, “Ditokelo tsa Basadi ke Ditokelo tsa Botho: Mmoho re Ntshetsa Aforika Borwa e hlokang Dikgoka pele”.
tgt: UMnyango Wezabesifazane uzohola imigubho kazwelonke ye-IWD eLanga High School eKapa ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: Amalungelo Abesifazane Ngamalungelo Abantu.

src: Mookotaba ona o imatahantse le mookotaba wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng wa: “Tekatekano bakeng sa Basadi ke tswelopele ya bohle!” le pehelo ya Kopano ya Aforika ya selemo sa 2015 e leng “Selemo sa Matlafatso ya Basadi le Ntshetsopele ho ya ho Lenanetsamaiso la Aforika la 2063”.
tgt: Lesi siqubulo sihambisana naleso seNhlangano Yezizwe esithi: Ukuphathwa ngokulinganayo Kwabesifazane kuyinqubekela phambili yabo bonke abantu!

src: Letsatsi lena le tla sebediswa ho thakgola lenaneo la Naha le la Diporofense la dipuisano le tla qala ho tloha kgweding ena ho fihlela ka Phuptjane.
tgt: Kanye Nesifungo seNhlangano Yobumbano Lwamazwe Ase-Afrika sonyaka wezi-2015 esithi “Unyaka Wokuhlonyiswa Kwabesifazane Nokuthuthukiswa Ukuze Kufezwe Imigomo Ye-Afrika yangowezi-2063”.

src: Le isa tlalehong ka maemo a basadi e tla thakgolwa ke Moporesidente ka la 9 Phato.7 Kabinete e ipiletsa ho Boraditaba ba Aforika Borwa ho fana ka dikenelo tsa bona bakeng sa phehisano ya Dikgau tsa Boraditaba ba SADC 2015.
tgt: Usuku lolu luzosetshenziselwa ukwethula uhlelo lwezingxoxo Zikazwelonke kanye Nezifundazwe nezizoqala kuyo le ephezulu kuze kube nguNhlangulana.

src: Letsatsi la ho kwala ke la 31 Hlakubele 2015 mme tlhahisoleseding e batsi e fumaneha ho websaete ya Lefapha la Dikgokahanyo ya WEBTOKEDikgau di hokela dibopeho tsa semolao tsa mebuso ya SADC, setjhaba ka kakaretso, dirutehi, basebetsi le boraditaba.
tgt: Lokhu kuzoba yingxenye yombiko ngesimo sabesimame ozokwethulwa nguMongameli mhla ziyi-8 kuNcwaba.7 IKhabhinethi imema Imithombo Yezindaba yaseNingizimu Afrika ukuba ilethe izicelo zokungenela umncintiswano we-SADC Media Awards wezi-2015.

src: Di kgothaletsa momahano ya lebatowa le tshebedisanommoho ka ho kgothaletsa basebeletsi ba tsa ditaba hara ditho tsa mebuso ho akaretsa dintlha tse amanang le lebatowa.
tgt: Usuku lokuvala umhla zingama-31 Ndasa 2015 futhi imininingwane iyatholakala kusizindalwazi soMnyango Wezokuxhumana WEBTOKELezi zindondo zixhumanisa izinhlaka ezihlelekile zohulumeni be-SADC, imiphakathi, izifundiswa nabacwaningi, abasebenzi nabemithombo yezindaba.

src: Ho hlokahala ha Letona Ohm Collins Chabane.
tgt: Ukudlula emhlabeni kukaNgqongqoshe u-Ohm Collins Chabane.

src: Kabinete e utlwisitswe bohloko ke ho hlokahala ka tshohanyetso ha Letona Chabane le batshireletsi ba hae, Bosajene Lesiba Samuel Sekele le Mareme Lawrence Lentsoane, ba hlokahetseng kotsing e sisimosang ya koloi ka Sontaha,sa 15 Hlakubele 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izwakalisa ubuhlungu nokudabuka ngokudlula emhlabeni kungaNgqongqoshe uChabane kanye nabaqaphi bakhe, oSayitsheni Lesiba Samuel Sekele kanye noMareme Lawrence Lentsoane, abadlule emhlabeni kabuhlungu engozini yemoto enyantisayo ngeSonto mhla ziyi-15 Ndasa 2015.

src: Mmuso le batho ba Aforika Borwa ba tla hopola ka ho sarelwa nyehelo e entsweng ke mohlanka enwa wa setjhaba eo esale a itetse bakeng sa ho aha Aforika Borwa e betere ho isa lefung.
tgt: UHulumeni kanye nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika bonkana bazosala bezikhotha amanxeba becabanga ngemisebenzi yalesi sibenzi sabantu ebesizibophezele ngaso sonke isikhathi ukwakha iNingizimu Afrika engcono kwaze kuba kufika usuku lwaso lokwedlula emhlabeni.

src: Jwaloka setho saKabinete, mofu Letona la Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba le Tsamaiso o tla nehwa Lepato la Semmuso la Mokgahlelo wa Tshebeletso ya lepato e tla ba ka Moqebelo wa la 21 Hlakubele 2015 motsaneng wa Xikundu Malamulele, ho la Limpopo.
tgt: NjengeLungu Lekhabhinethi, umufi ongasekho uNgqongqoshe Wezemisebenzi Kahulumeni Nokuphathwa Kwayo uzofihlwa Ngokohlelo Lomngcwabo Kahulumeni Osemthethweni Olungumkhakha Inkonzo yomngcwabo iyoba ngoMgqibelo mhla zingama-21 Ndasa 2015 esigodini saseXikundu eMalamulele, esifundazweni saseLimpopo.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a maholo ka ho fetisisa ho ba malapa le metswalle ya bafu Letona le batshireletsi ba hae ba babedi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yedlulisa ukudabuka kwayo kwimindeni nakubangani bakaNgqongqoshe ongasekho kanye nakweyabaqaphi bakhe ababili.

src: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mananeo a bohlokwa a mmuso.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza Kwezinhlelo Zikahulumeni Ezisemqoka.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla etella pele mekete ya sehopotso sabo-50 sa diphuputso tsa Aforika Borwa tsa rieketara yaSAFARI-1 e sebetswang ke Bolaodi ba Naha ba Eneji ba Aforika Borwa (NERSA) Pelindaba haufi le Pretoria.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uzohola imigubho yama-50 yokuthokozela ucwaningo lwesiphehli senuzi okuyi-SAFARI-1 nesingaphansi Komlawuli Wamandla Kazwelonke waseNingizimu Afrika (i-NERSA) ePelindaba eduze kwasePitoli.

src: Esale ho tloha ka ho thehwa ha yona ka la 18 Hlakubele 1965, rieketara ena, e leng mohlahisi e moholo wa diasothoupo tsa kalafo le tsa indaseteri bakeng sa tshebediso ka hara naha le matjhabeng, e fumane ditlatse tse ngata le ho ananelwa le ke matjhaba.
tgt: Kusukela selokhu sanikwa ilungelo lokusebenza ngomhla ziyi-18 Ndasa 1965, lesi siphehli, nesingumkhiqizi omkhulu wama-isotopes asetshenziswa kwezokwelapha kanye nasezimbonini kuleli ngisho nasemazweni aphesheya, sesithole ukunconywa okukhulu kanye nokuchonywa uphaphe lwegwalagwala yizinhlaka zamazwe omhlaba.

src: Rieketara ena hape e bapetse karolo e hlokolosi diphuputsong tsa nutleleya, ntshetsopeleng le thutong le ho beha Aforika Borwa maemong a pele dikgatelopeleng tsa saense.
tgt: Lesi siphehli sesidlale indima ebaluleke kakhulu ocwaningweni lwenuzi, ekuthuthukisweni kanye nasekufundiseni ngayo futhi sesibeke iNingizimu Afrika ekhaleni lokuqhuba umkhankaso wezesayensi.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa oohle hokgetha batho ba tshwanelehang ho sebetsa ho Khomishene ya Naha ya Meralopele ho letsatsi la ho kwalwa la 10 Mmesa 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi baqoke abantu abafanele ukuthi babamele Kwikhomishani Yokuklama yeLizwe Lonkengaphambi kosuku lokuvala okungumhla ziyi-10 Mbasa 2015.

src: Mosebetsi wa Khomishene e ntjha e tla ba wa ho eletsa mmuso ka mokgwa o hlwahlwa ka ho fetisisa wa ho kenya tshebetsong Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha.
tgt: Le khomishani entsha izogxila kakhulu ekwelulekeni uhulumeni ukuthi angakwazi kanjani ukwenza ukuthi Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP) lusebenze.

src: Hodima moo e tla boela e thusa ka ho ntshetsapele meralo e tebileng makaleng a kgethilweng a hlokang tsepamiso e matla ya maikutlo bakeng sa ho susumetsa kgolo ya moruo, phethoho e matla moruong le ntshetsopele ya moshwelella.
tgt: Ngaphezu kwalokho, le khomishani izophinda futhi isize ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo ezinqala emikhakheni ekhethekile edinga ukunakwa ukuze kukhuliswe umnotho, kube noshintsho olubambekayo kwezomnotho kanye nentuthuko eqhubekayo.
