src: Diqeto tsa Bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi Eziqavile.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa Palamenteng ha Dihlomathiso ho Molao wa Roma wa Lekgotla la Dinyewe la Matjhaba bakeng sa kamohelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iye yaphasisa ukulethwa Kwezichibiyelo kuMthetho Wase-Rome Wenkantolo Yobugebengu Yamazwe Omhlaba (i-ICC) ukuze zigunyazwe.

src: Dihlomathiso di kenyeletsa tlhaloso ya ditlolo tsa molao tsa dikgoka le diketsahalo tsa tlatsetso tse amanang le ditlolo tsa molao tsa dintwa ho Molao wa Roma o ileng wa amohelwa ke Kopano ya Mekga ya Dipuso (Kampala, ho la Uganda ka la 11 Phuptjane 2010).Kamohelo ya dihlomathiso tsena ho Molao wa Roma ke Aforika Borwa ho bontsha boitlamo ba mmuso ho lwantsha ditlolo tsa molao tse matla kgahlanong le batho le tlolo ya molao ya dikgoka e entsweng ka hare kapa ka ntle ho naha ya rona.
tgt: Lezi zichibiyelo zifaka phakathi ukuchazwa kwamacala obudlova kanye nezenzo ezingabizwa ngokuthi zingamacala empi kuMthetho Wase-Rome nowemukelwe Yisigungu Samaqembu Ombuso (e-Kampala, ezweni lase-Uganda mhla ziyi-11 Nhlangulana 2010).Ukugunyazwa kwalezi zichibiyelo kuMthetho Wase-Rome kwenziwa yiNingizimu Afrika kubonisa ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni wakuleli ukulwisana namacala abucayi enziwe kubantu kanye namacala obudlova uma enziwe ngaphakathi kwezwe lethu noma ngaphandle kwalo.

src: Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le Dintlha tsa Hajwale.
tgt: Isimo seKhabhinethi ezindabeni ezisematheni.

src: Kabinete e ananela dikarabelo ho mokgahlelo wa moraorao wa ditsheho tsa meedi tse sisintsweng le ho amohela hore dingangisano tse matla ke karolo ya demokerasi ya rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iziqaphele izingxoxo ezikhona mayelana nesigamu sakamuva semingcele ehlongozwaywo futhi iyakwazisa ukuthi izingxoxo eziphusile ziyinto esenhliziyweni yentando yethu yeningi.

src: Kaha ho na le bomasepala ba bang ba sokolang ho fana ka ditshebeletso le ho hloka ho hatela pele ka lebaka la lekeno le haellang le puso e fokolang, meedi ya bomasepala e dula e shejwa botjha.
tgt: Njengoba kukhona omasipala abatabalasayo ukuletha izidingo kubantu futhi uthole ukuthi bayantengantenga ngenxa yezimali ezingenele kanye nokungabuswa ngendlela, imingcele yomasipala iyaye ihlale ihlale ibuye ibuyekezwe.

src: Diphethoho tse sisintsweng di hlahlojwa pele ke Boto ya Tsheho ya Meedi ya Bomasepala (MDB), e laetsweng ho beha meedi ya bomasepala ho ya ka Molao wa Tsheho ya Meedi wa 1998 (Molao 27 wa 1998) wa Bomasepala ba Mebuso ya Lehae le Molaotheowa Riphaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996.Jwaloka mokgatlo o ikemetseng, ditsamaiso tsa MDB di a bonaletsa le ho kenyeletsa.
tgt: Lezi zinguquko ezihlongozwaywo ziyaye ziqale zibukisiswe kahle Yibhodi Eliklama Imingcele Yomasipala (i-MDB), nokuyisikhungo esethweswe umsebenzi wokwenza imingcele yomasipala ngokusho Kukahulumeni Wendawo: uMthetho Wokukalwa Kwemingcele Yomasipala, 1998 (uMthetho 27 we-1998) kanye noMthethosisekelo WaseRiphabhlikhi YaseNingizimu Afrika we-1996.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa badudi ho nka karolo ka matla ditsamaisong tsena.
tgt: Njengesikhungo esizimele, zonke izinhlelo ze-MDB zenziwa obala futhi kuyaboniswana nangazo.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe tshebediso ya mehwanto ya boipelaetso e tletseng dikgoka jwaloka mokgwa wa ho rarolla mathata a tsheho ya meedi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasigxeka isenzo sokusetshenziswa kwezimashi ezinodlame njengendlela yokusombulula ukungaboni ngasolinye ngodaba lwemingcele.

src: Mosebetsi waMDB ke karolo ya mmuso ya katamelo ya Ho Boela ho tsa Motheo ho netefatsa phano ya ditshebeletso e betere ho badudi.
tgt: Umsebenzi we-MDB uyingxenye ebalulekile yomsebenzi kahulumeni wokuthi Azibuyele Emasisweni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi inikwa izidingo ezingcono neziwufanele.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Basotho ka phethisetso e bobebe ya puso mme e ba kgothaleditse ho sebetsa mmoho bakeng sa kgotso ya moshwelella le ntshetsopele ya moruo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela abantu baseLesotho ngokuba nokhetho olunokuthula nolungenazihibe futhi ibakhuthazile ukuthi basebenzisane ukuze kube nokuthula okungapheli kanye nokuthuthuka kwezomnotho.

src: Kabinete hape e thoholeditse Tonakgolo e ntjha ya Mmuso wa Borena ba Lesotho, Mohlomphehi PakalithaMosisili ka ho kgethwa le tlhomamiso e atlehileng e etsahetseng ka Labobedi la 17 Hlakubele 2015, e neng e kenetswe ke Mohlomphehi Moporesidente Jacob Zuma le Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi futhi ihalalisela uNdunankulu omusha wezwe laseLesotho, uMhlonishwa uPakalitha Mosisili ngokuqokwa kwakhe kanye nangokubekwa kwakhe esihlalweni ngempumelelo okwenzeka ngoLwesibili mhla ziyi-17 Ndasa 2015, kanti lowo mcimbi wawuhanjelwe nanguMhlonishwa uMongameli uJacob Zuma kanye nePhini LikaMongameli uCyril Ramaphosa.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse Motlatsiwa Moporesidente ka karolo eo a e bapetseng ho iseng ho dikgetho tse atlehileng tsa Borena ba Lesotho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibuye yahalalisela iPhini LikaMongameli ngendima elayidlala neyaholela ekutheni kube nokhetho oluyimpumelelo eLesotho.

src: O tswetse pele ho ananela karolo e bapetsweng ke Dinaha tse Tswelang pele tsa Aforika e ka Borwa ka ho thusa ka moralo wa tsela bakeng sa kgotso le dikgetho tsa mmuso o motjha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yaphinda futhi yancoma indima eyadlalwa yiNhlangano Ethuthukisa Amazwe aseNingizimu ne-Afrika (i-SADC) ekwenzeni ukuthi kube nokuthula nozinzo kanye nokukhethwa kohulumeni omusha kuleliya lizwe.

src: Kabinete e boeleditse boitlamo ba Aforika Borwa ba ho tswela pele ho sebetsa mmoho le Borena ba Lesotho ho ntlafatsa dikamano tse teng ka ho tsepamisa maikutlo ho matlafatseng ha tshebedisanommoho ho tsa moruo le kahisano e tla lebisa ntlafatsong ya bophelo ba batho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yaphinda yakubeka kwacaca ukuzibophezela kweNingizimu Afrika ukuqhubeka nokusebenzisana nezwe laseLesotho ukuqhubeka nokukhulisa amaxhama okuxhumana ngokugxila kakhulu ekuqiniseni ezomnotho kanye nokubambisana kwezenhlalo nokuyoholela ekwenzeni ngcono izimpilo zabantu.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Imicimbi ezayo.

src: Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Ramaphosa o tla kenela Sehopotso sa bo-25 sa Boipuso ba Riphaboliki ya Namibia, ho kenyeletsa le Tlhomamiso ya Moporesidente Hage Geingob Windhoek ka la 21 Hlakubele 2015.
tgt: IPhini likaMongameli uRamaphosa uzohambela Usuku Lokugujwa Kwenkululeko Yama-25 e-Namibia, kuhlanganisa nokubekwa ngokusemthethweni kukaMongameli u-Hage Geingob e-Windhoek ngomhla zingama-21 Ndasa 2015.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Namibia letsatsing la ho keteka Jubile ya Silivera le Moporesidente Geingob ka ho ba Hlooho ya Puso ya boraro ya naha eo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithanda ukuhalalisela izwe lase-Namibia ngokugubha lolu suku osekuyi-Silver Jubilee futhi iphinde ihalalisele noMongameli Geingob ngokuqokwa kwakhe ukuthi abe nguMongameli wesithathu kuleliya lizwe.

src: MoporesidenteZuma o tla amohela Moporesidente wa Zimbabwe Robert Mugabe ho tloha ka la 8 ho ya ho la 9 Mmesa 2015 Pretoria.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uzovakashelwa nguMongameli waseZimbabwe uMongameli uRobert Mugabe kusukela ngomhla ziyisi-8 kuya kumhla ziyisi-9 Mbasa 2015 ePitoli.

src: Leeto lena le tla qetella e le phihlello ya Foramo ya kgwebo ya Aforika Borwa-Zimbabwe e reretsweng mohla la 9 Mmesa 2015, e rerileng ho eketsa kgwebisano ya bobedi bona le matsete.
tgt: Lokhu kuvakasha kuyoholela ekutheni kube Nesithangami Sabamabhizinisi Phakathi KweNingizimu Afrika NeZimbabwe okuhlelwe ukuthi sibe ngomhla ziyisi-9 Mbasa 2015, nokuhloswe ngaso ukukhulisa amaxhama okuxhumana kwezohwebo kanye nezokutshalwa kwezimali phakathi kwalawa mazwe womabili.

src: Moporesidente Zuma ka la 19 Mmesa 2015 o tla thakgola dihlooho tsa terene tse 95 Pretoria tse ahilweng e le karolo ya Lenaneo la R300 bilione ya matsete a tjhelete ya dikaho tsa bohlokwa laTransnet ho tsoseletsa dikaho tsa motheo tsa tsamaiso ya dithoto.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma kuzothi ngomhla ziyi-19 Ndasa 2015 ethule izitimela ezingama-95 ePitoli nezakhiwe njengengxenye yohlelo lweTransnet lokutshala imali eyizigidigii zamarandi ezingama-300 ukulungisa kabusha ingqalasizinda kwimboni yezokuthwala impahla kuleli.

src: Nakong ya lenaneo lena la matsetemesebetsi e mengata e tla hlahiswa le dikgwebo tsa lehae di tla una molemo ho tswa ho tshebediso ya mehlodi ya lehae, ntshetsopele ya bokgoni le phetisetso ya thekenoloji.
tgt: Kulesi sikhathi sokutshalwa kwemali kuzokwakhiwa inqwaba yamathuba emisebenzi emisha kanti namabhizinisi endawo azozuza ngokuthi kwenziwe imisebenzi endaweni, kube nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kanye nokwedluliselwa kwezobuchwepheshe.

src: Diterene tsena tse ntjha di tobana le tshallomorao ya mokgwa wa diterene wa naha le ho thusa ho ntlafatsa tlhahiso le bohlwahlwa ba marangrang a rona a diporo.
tgt: Lezi zitimela ezintsha zizosiza ukulwa nokusalela emuva embonini yezitimela futhi zizokwenza ukuthi ukukhiqiza kube ngcono kulo mkhakha futhi kwenze nokuthi izitimela zethu zisebenze ngendlela.

src: Ho thakgolwa hona hape ho tshwaya phethoho ya Boenjineri ba Transnet ho ba mohlahisi wa thepa e felletseng ya mantlha kaha tse 85 tsa diterene di hlahisitswe setsheng sa bona se Koedoespoort, haufi le Pretoria.
tgt: Lokhu kwethulwa futhi kuzobonisa ukushintshwa Kwezobunjiniyela KwaTransnet ukuze ibe ngumsunguli ophelele ngokugcwele ngoba izitimela ezingama-85 kulezi zakhiqizwa kwisikhungo esise-Koedoespoort, eduze kwasePitoli.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla bulaIndaba ya Boraindaseteri ba Batho ba Batsho e tla tshwarwa ho tloha ka la 25 ho ya ka la 26 Hlakubele 2015 Setsing sa Dikopano sa Gallagher, Midrand, jwaloka karolo ya boitlamo ba mmuso ba ho ntshetsa pele boraindaseteri ba batho ba batsho ka hara naha.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uzovula Umhlangano Wabaphathi Bokwenza Impahla Abamnyama nozokwenzeka kusukela mhla zingama-25 kuya kumhla zingama-26 Ndasa 2015 e-Gallagher Convention Centre, e-Midrand, njengengxenye yokuzibophezela kukahulumeni ekuthuthukiseni abaphathi bokwenza impahla abamnyama kuleli lizwe.

src: Indaba e tla fohla dipuisano pakeng tsa lekala la setjhaba le la poraefete ho ntshetsa pele boraindaseteri ba batho ba batsho, le ho fetola ka matla le ho bopa botjha moruo ho fihlella kgolo e kenyeletsang.
tgt: Lo mhlangano uzokwenza ukuthi kube nezinkulumo-ngxoxo phakathi komkhakha kahulumeni kanye nomkhakha ozimele ukuthuthukisa abaphathi bokwenza impahla abamnyama, kanye nokuhlela umnotho ngesivinini nangamandla ukuze kungabibikho oshiywa ngaphandle uma kukhuliswa umnotho.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla etsa puo ho Kopano ya Ditho tsa Naha (NMA) ya Mokgatlo wa Aforika Borwa wa Mebuso ya Lehae, e tla tshwarelwa Setsing sa Dikopano sa Gallagher, Midrand ho tloha ka la 24 ho ya ka la 26 Hlakubele 2015.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uzokwethula inkulumo Kumalungu Endlu YesiShayamthetho Kazwelonke (i-NMA) Yenhlangano Yohulumeni Basekhaya YaseNingizimu Afrika, kanti lokhu kuyokwenzeka e-Gallagher Convention Centre, e-Midrand kusukela ngomhla zingama-24 kuya kumhla zingama-26 Ndasa 2015.

src: NMA e tla lekola maemo a mebuso ya lehae kamora dilemo tse 15 le ho tshohla mawa a ho sebetsa ka bokgabane le phano ya ditshebeletso, kaho ya bokgoni, bobodu le dintlha tse mabapi le tsheho ya meedi ya bomasepala.
tgt: I-NMA izoveza isithombe ngohulumeni bezindawo ngemuva kweminyaka eyi-15 bese kukhulunywa nangamacebo okubhekana ngqo nokulethwa kwezidingo kubantu, ukufukula omasipala, ukulwa nenkohlakalo kanye nezindaba ezithinta imingcele yomasipala.

src: Kopano e tla tshwarwa tlasa mookotaba: “Dilemotse15 tsa Mebuso ya Lehae ya Demokerasi – Re matlafatsa le ho Kenyeletsa Demokerasi ya Lehae e shebileng batho ya Ntshetsopele e Kganyang”.
tgt: Lo mbuthano uzobanjwa ngaphansi kwesihloko esithi: Iminyaka eyi-15 Yohulumeni Bezindawo Abanentando Yeningi – Ukuqinisa kanye Nokuzinzisa Intando Yeningi Enomfutho, Ethuthukisayo Nesondelene Nabantu”.

src: MaAforika Borwa a tla keteka ketsahalo ya naha ya Letsatsi la Ditokelo tsa Bothoka la 21 Hlakubele 2015 Uitenhage, ho la Kapa Botjhabela tlasa mookotaba: “Re keteka Tjhata ya Tokoloho, Re ThabelaDitokelo tsa Botho tse Lekanang Bakeng sa Bohle”.
tgt: Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bazogubha Usuku Lukazwelonke Lwamalungelo Oluntu ngomhla zingama-21 Ndasa 2015 e-Uitenhage, eMpumalanga Kapa ngaphansi kwesihloko esithi: “Ukugubha Umqulu Wenkululeko, Ukuthokozela Amalungelo Oluntu Alinganayo Kuwonkewonke”.

src: Diketsahalo tsena di tla fana ka lepatlelo bakeng sa maAforika Borwa oohle ho hopola ho intsha sehlabelo ho neng ho tsamaelana le ntwa bakeng sa demokerasi le boitelo ba rona ba ho ntshetsapele ditokelo tsa botho jwaloka ha di phuthetswe ka hara Molaotheo.
tgt: Le mibhiyozo izohlinzeka ngendawo kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi bakwazi ukukhumbula ukuzinikela okwakuphelezela umzabalazo ukuqhubekisela phambili amalungelo oluntu njengalokhu ebalulwe kuMthethosisekelo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa oohle ho keteka letsatsi lena la bohlokwa ka ho fohla momahano e matla ya kahisano le kaho ya setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi baluthokozele lolu suku olubaluleke kangaka ngokuthi babe nokubambana njengomphakathi futhi kwakhiwe isizwe.

src: Jwaloka karolo ya Kgwedi ya Ditokelo tsa Botho, dipuisano tsa badudi di tla ba teng ho parola le diporofense tsohle ho kgothaletsa kopakopano ka hara badudi ba ditlwaelo tse fapaneng.
tgt: Njengengxenye Yenyanga Yamalungelo Oluntu, kuyoba nezinkulumo-mpikiswano emiphakathini kuzona zonke izifundazwe ukukhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwemiphakathi ephila nekhule ezindaweni ezahlukene.

src: Sena se tla finyella ho Tlaleho ya Naha ya Momahano ya Setjhaba leSeboka sa Bodisa se tla tshwarwa ka la 30 Hlakubele 2015 Port Elizabeth.
tgt: Lokhu kuyobe sekuholela ekutheni kube Nomhlangano Kazwelonke Wokuzobika kanye Nokubheka Ukuxhumana Komphakathi noyobanjwa mhla zingama-30 Ndasa 2015 eBhayi.

src: Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhabale tla tshwara Indaba ya Naha ya Mesebetsi ya Kahisanoho tloha ka la 24 ho ya ho la 26 Hlakubele 2015 Setsing sa Matjhaba sa Dikopano ho la Durban tlasa mookotaba: “Re tsoseletsa tsamaiso ya mesebetsi ya kahisano ka hara Aforika Borwa”.Indaba ena e tla hlahisa ditshisinyo le boitshunyako bakeng sa ho tobana le dintlha tse nang le kgahlamelo hodima tsamaiso ya mesebetsi ya kahisano le ho matahanya thomo ya ntshetsopele ya lekala bakeng sa ho tshehetsa phethoho e matla ya mmuso ya moruo wa kahisano.
tgt: UMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi uzobamba Ingqungquthela Kazwelonke Yosonhlalakahle kusukela mhla zingama-24 kuya kumhla zingama-26 Ndasa 2015 e-International Convention Centre e-Durban ngaphansi kwesihloko esithi: “Ukunika amandla umsebenzi wokuba ngusonhlalakahle eNingizimu Afrika”.Le ngqungquthela iyosungula izincomo kanye nezinhlaka zokungenelela ukubhekana nezindaba ezithikameza umsebenzi wokuba ngusonhlalakahle bese wenza ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwalo msebenzi kuhambisane namandla anikwe lomsebenzi okuwukweseka izinhlelo zikahulumeni zokushintsha izimpio zabantu ngokwenhlalo kanye nangokomnotho.

src: Ho fihlella sena, lefapha le fanne ka lenaneo la ho ithuta bakeng sa ho thusa ka ditjhelete baithuti ba ithutang mesebetsi ya kahisano diyunivesithing.
tgt: Ukuze kuphunyeleliswe lokhu, lo Mnyango usuvele unohlelo lwemifundaze wokuxhasa abafundi abenza izifundo zokuba ngosonhlalakahle emanyunivesi.

src: Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba hape le tla tshwara Khonferense ya bo-2 e Kgahlanong le Boqhekanyetsi le Boboduho tloha ka la 30 ho ya ho la 31 Hlakubele 2015Hoteleng ya St George’s, Centurion tlasa mookotaba: “Re netefatsa ditokelo tsa botho tsa bohle ka tsamaiso e hlokang boqhekanyetsi ditjheleteng tsa dithuso tsa setjhaba”.
tgt: UMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi uzobamba Ingqunguthela Yawo Yesibili Yokulwa Nenkohlakalo kanye Nokukhwabanisa kusukela mhla zingama-30 kuya kumhla zingama-31 Ndasa 2015 e-St George’s Hotel, e-Centurion ngaphansi kwesihloko esithi: “Ukuqinisekisa amalungelo awo wonke umuntu ngohlelo lwesibonelelo sikahulumeni esingenayo inkohlakalo”.

src: Khonferense e tla lekola mekgwa ya hajwale ya ho hlaola bobodu ka hara tsamaiso ya dithuso tsa setjhaba.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela izobheka izindlela ezikhona njengamanje ezisetshenziswayo ukuqeda inkohlakalo ohlelweni lwezimali zesibonelelo sikahulumeni.

src: Kabinete e ananela ho tshwarwa hapulo ya papadi ya baseketebolo ya Tlhodisano ya Dinaha tse Nnee tla etsahala Lebaleng la Dipapadi la Wembley, Johannesburg ho tloha ka la 19 ho ya ka la 22 Hlakubele 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela ukuzobanjwa komqhudelwano wokuqala ngqa we-basketball Wezizwe Ezine ozobanjelwa Enkundleni yase-Wembley, eGoli kusukela ngomhla ziyi-19 kuya kumhla zingama-22 Ndasa 2015.

src: Sena se tlisa mmoho dihlopha tse kgolo tsa banna tsa Aforika Borwa, Nigeria, Mozambique le Kenya ho seo ho hopolwang hore e tla ba ketsahalo ya selemo ka seng.
tgt: Lokhu kuzoletha amaqembu amakhulu abesilisa aseNingizimu Afrika, elase-Nigeria, elase-Mozambique kanye nelase-Kenya ndawonye kulo mqhudelwano esibona sengathi uzoba umcimbi wonyaka.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa sehlopha sa rona sa kirikete, se tswetseng pele ho ya ho seka-makgaolakgang ka tlholo ya diwikete tse robong kgahlanong le Sri Lanka papading ya bona ya Mohope wa Lefatshe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela iqembu lethu lekhilikithi, eseledlulele emzuliswaneni olandelayo ngokuwina ngamawikhethi ayisishiyagalolunye kwi-Sri Lanka Kwindebe Yomhlaba.

src: Re lakaletsa sehlopha le mokwetlisi mahlohonolo ha ba ntse ba tswela pele ka thonamente.
tgt: Sifisela iqembu kanye nomqeqeshi walo okuhle kodwa njengoba bezobe beqhubeka nomqhudelwano.

src: 1.Letoto la ditlhaselo tsa moraorao tjena tsa Melata.1 Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe ka matla diketso tsa merusu ya moraorao tjena kgahlanong le melata.
tgt: Ukubhebhetheka kwezigameko zakamuva zokuhlaselwa kwabantu bokufika.1 IKhabhinethi iyazigxeka kakhulu izenzo zodlame oluqhubekayo oluqondiswe kubantu bokufika kuleli.

src: Ha jwale, Kabinete e rata ho fetisa matshediso a yona a tebileng ho malapa a bohle ba lahlehetsweng ke bophelo le pholo e potlakileng ho ba lemetseng.
tgt: Kuleli qophelo, iKhabhinethi ithanda ukudlulisa amazwi enduduzo kwimindeni yalabo abalahlekelwe yizimpilo zabo kulolu dlame futhi ibafisela ukwelulama okusheshayo labo abalimele.

src: Ha ho boholo ba ho teneha le ho kgena bo ka dumellang ditlhaselo tsena le kgapo ya thepa ka mahahapa mabenkeleng.
tgt: Ukucasuka nokungagculiseki kwabantu ngeke neze kwamukelwe njengesizathu esizwakalayo salokhu kuhlaselwa kwabokufika kanye nokuphangwa kwezitolo.

src: Le ha re ananela mabaka a hlahiswang ke badudi, merusu kgahlanong le batho ba bang di keke tsa rarolla dintlha tsena.
tgt: Nakuba uhulumeni eziphawulile izinkinga eziphakanyiswe yimiphakathi, ngeke neze lezi zinkinga zixazululwe wukuhlasela omunye umuntu onjengawe.

src: Empa, sena se re hlahisa hampe jwaloka batho, re le kgahlanong le mehopolo le metheo ya demokerasi ya rona.
tgt: Esikhundleni salokho, lokhu kukhombisa isithombe esingesihle neze ngathi njengabantu, futhi kuphambene kakhulu nezifiso nezisekelo zelizwe lethu elibuswa ngentando yeningi.

src: Aforika Borwa e lwanne kgahlanong le bokoloniale le Kgethollo mmoho le maAforika a bo rona hore batho bohle ka hara kontinente ya rona ba hlomphuwe le ho tshwarwa ka seriti.2 Kgahlamelo ya ditlhaselo tsena e na le ditlamorao tse matla hodima moruo wa rona, kahisano le ho dikamano tsa rona tsa sepolotiki kontinenteng le lefatsheng.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika yalwisana nenqubo yokuqonelwa ngabezizwe kanye noBandlululo ngokubambisana okukhulu nabantu bakuleli zwekazi lethu lase-Afrika, ukuze kuqinisekiswe bonke abantu kuleli zwekazi bayahlonishwa futhi baphathwa ngesithunzi nesizotha.2 Lokhu kuhlaselwa kwabokufika kunomthelela omubi kakhulu kubudlelwano bethu naleli zwekazi kanye namazwe omhlaba, kwezomnotho kwezenhlalo kanye nakwezepolitiki.

src: Dikhamphani tsa Aforika Borwa tse nang le dikgwebo tse atlehileng ka hara kontinente tse thusang ka ho nyehela lekenong la rona le ho tsitsisa moruo wa rona di ka tloha tsa iphumana di le maemong a tshwanang le ana.
tgt: Kungenzeka futhi kukhahlamezeke ngendlela efanayo izinkampani zaseNingizimu Afrika eziqhuba amabhizinisi ngempumelelo kuleli zwekazi, ezingenisa imali enkulu emgodlagodleni wezimali wakuleli, futhi ezinegalelo elikhulu ekusimamisweni komnotho wethu.

src: Moraorao tjena, dibini tsa Aforika Borwa tse neng di lokela ho ya bontsha makgabane a tsona ka ntle ho meedi ya rona, tse kang BigNuz ho la Zimbabwe, Kelly Khumalo le Casper ho la London, dikonsarete tsa bona di phumutswe ka lebaka la ditlhaselo tsena.
tgt: Kamuva nje, abaculi baseNingizimu Afrika abebezokhombisa amakhono abo emazweni aphesheya, njengeqembu le-BigNuz ebelizohambela kwelaseZimbabwe, nanye no-Kelly Khumalo no-Casper abebezocula e-London, kudingeke ukuthi ahoxiswe amakhonsathi abo ngenxa yalokhu kuhlaselwa kwabokufika.

src: Boholo ba badudi ba rona ba tshepileng mabenkele a melata bakeng sa ditlhoko tsa bona tsa letsatsi ka leng jwale ba tlaletswe ke naha.
tgt: Futhi seyingomtshingo ubethwa ngubani imiphakathi yethu eminingi ebiziphilisa ngezitolo zabokufika kuleli.

src: Kajeno, maAforika Borwa a thabela ho ba naha e lokolohileng, e fihlelletsweng ka lebaka la nyehelo ya dinaha tse ngatanyana tsa Aforika.
tgt: Namuhla, abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bathokozela ukuphila ezweni elikhululekile, futhi lokhu kwazuzwa ngegalelo elikhulu elafakwa ngamazwe amaningi ezwekazi lase-Afrika.

src: Mofu eo e neng e le qhoku ya rona, Moporesidente Oliver Tambo o dutse nako e ka etsang dilemo tse 30 Zambia le maAforika Borwa a mang a mangata a neng a le palehong.
tgt: Isithwalandwe sethu esesadlula emhlabeni, uMongameli Oliver Tambo sakhoseliswa isikhathi esilinganiselwa eminyakeni engama-30 kwelaseZambia kanye nabanye abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaningi ababephila ekudingisweni.

src: Dinaha tsa habo rona tsa Aforika ha di a fella feela ka ho amohela batho ba rona, hape di ile tsa nyehela ka mehlodi mme tse ding di ile tsa phehisa ha bohloko ka ho lahlehelwa ke baahi ba tsona tseleng ya Aforika Borwa ya ho fihlella demokerasi.
tgt: Amazwe ase-Afrika awagcinanga nje kuphela ngokukhoselisa abantu bethu, kodwa futhi asihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo, asixhasa nangezimali futhi amanye alahlekelwa kakhulu ngoba ashonelwa yizakhamuzi zawo emzabalazweni wokulwela intando yeningi eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Aforika Borwa e keke ya kgeloswa ho fihlella pono ya BoAforika bo Tiileng jwaloka ha e kenyeleditswe ho Lenane la Kopano ya Aforika la 2063, eo esale e tsitlallelwa ke baholoholo ba rona ba kang Kwame Nkrumah, Nnamdi Azikiwe, Mwalimu Julius Nyerere le Nelson Mandela.
tgt: Ngeze neze ivume iNingizimu Afrika ukuphazanyiswa emshikashikeni wayo wokufezekisa inhloso-mbono yoBumbano Lwamazwe Ase-Afrika equkethwe kwi-Ajenda yoBumbano Lwe-Afrika (i-AU) yowezi-2063, okuyihloso-mbono eyayiqhutshwa ngokhokho bethu oKwame Nkrumah, Nnamdi Azikiwe, Mwalimu Julius Nyerere kanye no-Nelson Mandela.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o laetse Moifo wa Matona a Toka ya Thibelo ya Botlokotsebe le Tshireletso mmoho le Matona e leng la Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane, la Lefapha la Kgwebo le Indaseteri le la Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba ho kenyeletsa mekga yohle e amehang bakeng sa ho batla tharollo.
tgt: UMongameli Jacob Zuma usejube oNgqongqoshe Beqoqo Lezobulungiswa, Lokuvinjelwa Kobugebengu Nezokuvikeleka ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwamabhizinisi Amancane, Owezohwebo Nezimboni kanye Nowezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi ukuthi bafakane imilomo nabo bonke abathintekayo ukuze kutholakale ikhambi loxazulula le nkinga.

src: Matona a boetse a laetswe ho sebetsana le maemo a moruo wa kahisano a bonahalang eka a motsong wa ditlhaselo tsena, hore taba ena e sebetswe ka matla le ka botlalo.
tgt: Ongqongqoshe banikezwe futhi nomsebenzi wokuthola ikhambi lokulungisa izimo zenhlalo nezomnotho abaphila ngaphansi kwazo abantu, okubonakala sengathi yizona eziwumongo walokhu kuhlaselwa kwabokufika, ukuze lolu daba kubhekwano nalo ngqo ngendlela enohlonze futhi ngokuphelele.

src: Moporesidente o ile a tswela pele ho phatlalatsa ditsela tse nkuweng ke Lebotho la Naha la Tshireletso la Aforika Borwa bakeng sa ho tlisa maemo tlasa taolo meeding ya rona.
tgt: UMongameli uphinde futhi wamemezela izinyathelo ezithathwe nguMbutho Wezokuvikela WaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SANDF) okuhloswe ngazo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imingcele yezwe lethu ilawulwa ngendlela efanelekile.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho badudi bohle, mekgatlo le batho ka bo mong ho ipopa kgahlanong le ditlhaselo tsena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa yonke imiphakathi, izinhlangano kanye nabantu bonke ukuthi babambane ngezandla ukuze kulwisanwe nalokhu kuhlaselwa kwabantu bokufika.

src: Aforika Borwa ha se naha ya merusu mme kahoo methwaela e seng mekae e keke ya dumellwa ho kenya naha yohle ditlamong.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika ayilona neze izwe elinodlame ngakho-ke akufanele neze sivumele idlanzana labantu libambe izwe lonkana ngobhongwane ngenhloso yokufezekisa izinhloso zabo.

src: Meruru ha e ya tloha e le tharollo bakeng sa mathata setjhabeng sefe kapa sefe mme ho keke ha ba jwalo le ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Udlame alukaze nje lube yikhambi lokuxazulula izinkinga kunoma yimuphi umphakathi futhi naseNingizimu Afrika ngeke nje nakancane luze lube yisixazululo.

src: E seng lebitsong la rona!2.
tgt: Masingavumi neze ukuthi kuqhutshwe udlame egameni lethu!2.

src: Diemahale.1 Kabinete e lemohile qeto ya bolaodi ba yunivesithi ya ho tlosa seemahale sa Rhodes khamaphaseng ya Yunivesithi ya Motse Kapa.
tgt: Izichuse.1 IKhabhinethi isiphawulile isinqumo sabaphathi benyuvesi sokususa isichuse sika-Rhodes emagcekeni eNyuvesi yaseKapa.

src: Aforika Borwa dilemong tse mashome a mabedi tse fetileng e entse menyabuketso e meholo bakeng sa ho netefatsa hore matshwao a rona a nalane a bontsha maemo a baahi ba naha ya rona le tsamaiso ya demokerasi.
tgt: Kule shuminyaka mibili edlule iNingizimu Afrika yenze amagxathu amakhulukazi ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi izimpawu zomlando wethu zikhombisa ukwahlukahlukana kwethu njengabantu bakuleli kanye nombuso wethu wentando yeningi labantu.

src: Kabinete le ha ho le jwalo, e ananetse hore leeto la ho tlosa matshwao a nalane a nyenyefatsang le mabitso ka hara naha ya rona ha le ya potlaka ho ya kamoo ho lebeletsweng.
tgt: Kepha-ke iKhabhinethi iyavuma ukuthi umkhankaso wokususa izimpawu zomlando kanye namagama acunulayo ezweni lethu awuqhubeki ngesivinini esigculisayo.

src: Kabinete e lemohile le ho kgothaletsa dingangisano tsa hajwale tse batsi tse qadileng mabapi le diphethoho ka hara setjhaba, le ho lemoha hore diphethoho ha di so ka di potlaka kamoo ho lebeletsweng mme re utlwisisa ho nyahama ha baithuti.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiphawulile inkulumo-mpikiswano ebanzi ephathelene nokulethwa koguquko eqhubekayo njengamanje emiphakathini yethu futhi iyayikhuthaza, kanti futhi njengoba kubonakala ngokucacile ukuthi uguquko aluqhubeki ngesivinini esigculisayo kuyinto esiyiqonda kahle kamhlophe ukungagculiseki kanye nokukhathazeka kwabafundi.

src: Kahoo re ba kgothaletsa ho latela ditsamaiso tse hlaloswang melaong ya rona.2 Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ho itahlela ka setotswana ditsamaisong tse ntseng di tswela pele tse eteletsweng pele ke Lefapha la Bonono le Botjhaba mabapi le botjhaba le kaho ya setjhaba.
tgt: Ngakho-ke siyabakhuthaza ukuthi balandele imigudu efanelekile echazwe ngaphansi kwemithetho yezwe lethu.

src: MaAforika Borwa a hopotswa hore Molao wa Naha wa Mehlodi ya Setso wa 1999 o totobatsa ditsamaiso tsa ditherisano tse lokelang ho latelwa moo ho tshwanelang ho tloswa kapa ho iswa ha diemahale sebakeng se seng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi bazibandakanye kwizinqubo eziqhubekayo njengamanje eziholwa nguMnyango Wezobuciko Namasiko eziphathelene namagugu aleli lizwe kanye nokwakhiwa kwesizwe.

src: Leeto la Puso la Zimbabwe.1 Kabinete e amohela leeto la puso la Zimbabwe le neng le eteletswe pele ke Moporesidente Robert Gabriel Mugabe.
tgt: Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakhunjuzwa ukuthi uMthetho Wamagugu Kazwelonke we-1999 unikeza incazelo efingqiwe yezinqubo zokubonisana okumele zilandelwe uma abantu befuna ukuthi kususwe noma kuthuthwe isichuse siyobekwa kwenye indawo.

src: Aforika Borwa le Zimbabwe, di na le nalane e telele ya bosemphato ba lebatowa le maqhama a botjhaba.
tgt: Uhambo lukaMongameli waseZimbabwe Lokuvakasheli kuleli.1 IKhabhinethi ilwamukele ngezandla ezimhlophe uhambo Lombuso waseZimbabwe lokuvakashela kuleli obeluholwa nguMongameli Robert Gabriel Mugabe olube yimpumelelo enkulu.

src: Batho ba Zimbabwe ba bapetse karolo ya bohlokwa nalaneng ya ho tshehetsa ntwa ya tokoloho ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika neZimbabwe, ngamazwe anomlando omude wokubambisana kulesi sifunda, futhi anobudlelwano obuhle kwezamasiko.

src: Leeto le ntlafaditse dikamano tsa dinaha ka bobedi ka ho theha Khomishene ya Naha tse pedi mmoho le ho saena ditumellano tse tharo le Dimemorandamo tse pedi tsa Kutlwisisano (MoU).Tumellano mabapi le Theho ya Khomishene ya Naha tse pedi e ntlafatsa tshebedisano ya rona ho ya maemong a phahameng ka ho fetisisa ka ho kopana ha Dihlooho tse pedi tsa Puso bakeng sa ho sheba botjha kgatelopele mabapi le ditumellano tsa bobedi bona tsa tshebedisanommoho tse ananetsweng.
tgt: Lolu hambo lukhulise ubudlelwano phakathi kwalawa mazwe ngokuthi kusungulwe iKhomishana Yokusebenzisana Kwalawa Mazwe Amabili futhi kwasayindwa nezivumelwano ezintathu kanye naMamemorandamu Okubambisana amabili.

src: Tumellano mabapi le Tshebedisanommoho ho Bolaodi ba Mehlodi ya Metsi le ho thehwa le ho sebetsa ha Khomishene e Kopanetsweng ya Metsi e tla ntlafatsa tshebedisanommoho meralong ya mehlodi ya metsi, ntshetsopele le bolaodi ka moya wa kutlwano le molemo.
tgt: Isivumelwano Sokusungulwa Kwekhomishana Yokusebenzisana Kwalawa Mazwe Amabili kukhulisa ukuxhumana ngendlela ehlelekile phakathi kwalawa mazwe amabili emazingeni aphakeme, ngokuthi kubanjwe umhlangano woMongameli Balawa Mazwe bobabili ngenhloso yokubuyekeza inqubekelaphambili eyenziwe kwizivumelwano zokusebenzisana okuvunyelwane ngazo.

src: Dinaha tsena tse pedi ka kopanelo di tla etsa diphuputso mabapi le ho utlwisisa bokgoni ba ditsi tsa metsi ho la Zimbabwe bakeng sa ho fana ka metsi ho Rephaboliki ya Aforika Borwa mme ka kopanelo di thehe diporojeke tsa metsi, tse tla bang le molemo mabapi le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi, diphethoho ho tsa moruo le ntshetsopele ya bokgoni le phethisetso.
tgt: Isivumelwano Sokubambisana Ekuphathweni Kwemithombo Yamanzi kanye nokusungula futhi kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kweKhomishana Yokubambisana Ezindabeni Eziphathelene Namanzi kuzophucula ubambiswano kwezokuhlela, ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokuphathwa kwemithombo yamanzi ukuze kube khona ukuvumelana mayelana nendlela okuzosetshenzwa ngayo futhi ukuze ahlomule ngokufanelekile lawa mazwe amabili.

src: Tumellano mabapi le Thusano pakeng tsa Ditsamaiso tsa Madiboho- E ala motheo bakeng sa ho theha lediboho le nang le tsohle.
tgt: Lawa mazwe azokwenza ucwaningo ngokubambisana ngenhloso yokuthola ulwazi mayelana nokuthi imithombo yamanzi kwelaseZimbabwe ingakwazi yini ukuphakela iRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika ngamanzi futhi kuzosungulwa imiklamo yamanzi ngokubambisana, ezohlomulisa lawa mazwe ngokuthi kuvulwe kwamathuba omsebenzi, kulethwe uguquko kwezomnotho futhi kuthuthukiswe futhi kudluliswe kwamakhono.

src: Sepheo ke ho kgontsha ditsamaiso tse pedi tsena ho fapanyetsana ka tlhahisoleseding, ho tshehetsana ka thuso ya setekginiki, le ho sebetsa ka peho-leihlo, maeto le diphuputso mmoho le ho sebedisana mmoho mabapi le ho ntlafatsa bohlwahlwa ba ditshebetso.
tgt: Isivumelwano Sokulekelelana Kwezimpiko Ezilawula Ukungena Nokuphuma Kwempahla Emingceleni - Lesi sivumelwano sibeka isisekelo sokusungula isikhungo lapho umuntu ezothola khona lonke usizo aludingayo endaweni eyodwa ngenkathi ephuma noma engena emngceleni.

src: MoU mabapi le Dipuisano tsa Bodipolomate o tla theha mokgwa bakeng sa dipuisano tsa kamehla tsa bodipolomate mabapi le dintlha tse ka hara Aforika le dintlha tse ding tsa dikgahleho tse tshwanang.
tgt: Lolu wuhlelo lokusebenza ngendlela efanayo emazweni ngamazwe olugqugquzelwa yiNhlangano Yomhlaba Lokulawulwa Kokungena Nokuphuma Kwempahla Emingceleni Yamazwe.

src: Sepheo se seholo sa MoU ke ho theha mokgwa bakeng sa dipuisano tsa bodipolomate kamehla mabapi le dintlha tsa ho matlafatsa dikamano tsa bobedi bona, tshireletso le tshebedisanommoho ka hara Aforika.
tgt: Injongo yalokhu ukulekelela izimpiko ezimbili zalawa mazwe ezethweswe umsebenzi wokulawula imingcele ukuthi zikwazi ukwabelana ngolwazi, zihlinzekane ngosizo oluphathelene nokwenziwa komsebenzi ngendlela efanelekile, futhi zisebenze ngokuhlanganyela emsebenzini wazo wokuqapha, ukuvakashela izikhungo ngenhloso yokuyohlola ukuthi umsebenzi wenziwa ngendlela efanelekile yini kanye nokwenza uphenyo ngokuhlanganyela futhi kubanjiswane ukuphucula indlela okusetshenzwa ngayo.

src: MoU mabapi le Tshebedisanommoho ya Kgwebisano o reretswe ho fana ka lepatlelo bakeng sa dinaha tse pedi ho buisana le ho arolelana diphihlello mabapi le ho hodisa ntshetsopele ya moruo.
tgt: IMemorandamu Yokubambisana (i-MoU) Kwizingxoxo Zokubonisana Emazingeni Osomaqhinga izosungula inkambiso yokubanjwa kwezingxoxo ngokuqhubekayo emazingeni osomaqhinga ukuze kudingidwe izindaba eziphathelene ne-Afrika kanye nezinye ezithinta lawa mazwe womabili.

src: Bobedi bona bo dumellane ka ho sebedisana mmoho ka kgodiso ya kgwebisano, tharollo ya ditshita tsa ho hweba le ho ahuwa ha bokgoni ba setekginiki dibakeng tse hlwauweng mmoho le ntshetsopele ya bokgoni le boitsebelo.
tgt: Inhloso-ngqangi yale-MoU ukusungula inkambiso yokubanjwa kwezingxoxo ngokuqhubekayo emazingeni osomaqhinga ukuze kudingidwe izindaba eziphathelele nokuqiniswa kobudlelwano nokuvikeleka kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwalawa mazwe amabili kwelase-Afrika.

src: Yunivesithi ena, e kenyeletsang khamphase ya mehleng ya MEDUNSA ya Yunivesithi ya Limpopo, e qadile selemo sa yona sa pele sa dithuto ka selemo sa 2015 ka baithuti ba 5 000.Ho thehwa ha SMU ho fana ka monyetla o hlwahlwa bakeng sa ntshetsopele le thupello ya moloko o motjha wa ditsebi ho tsa kalafo o tla fanang ka kgahlamelo e kgabane bophelong le boitekanelong ba maAforika Borwa a mangata a ntseng a kotetswe ke bofuma le kgaello ya ho fihlella ditshebeletso tsa kalafo.
tgt: IMemorandamu Yokubambisana Kwezohwebo ihlose ukuhlinzeka lawa mazwe amabili ngesigcawu sokubonisana kanye nokwabelana ngolwazi mayelana nezimo ahlangabezane nazo kanye nezindlela azisebenzisile kulezo zimo ngenhloso yokulekelelana emizamweni yokukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho.

src: Mmuso o tla tswela pele ho tsetela thutong le ntshetsopeleng ya bokgoni jwaloka mokgwa wa bohlokwa wa ho hotetsa kgolo ya moruo le ntshetsopele.
tgt: Lawa mazwe avumelene ukuthi azobambisana ngokuthi kugqugquzelwe ukuhwebelana, kususwe izithiyo ezivimbela ukuhwebelana futhi kwakhiwe ikhono namandla okusebenza ngendlela efanelekile emikhakheni ehlonziwe ehlukahlukene futhi kugxilwe nasekuthuthukisweni kwamakhono okujwayelekile.

src: Beke ya Naha ya Imbizo ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo.1 Kabinete e hlahisitse teboho ya yona ho maAforika Borwa oohle a tlileng ka bongata bakeng sa ho nka karolo dipuisanong tse otlolohileng le baemedi ba setjhaba nakong ya Beke ya Naha ya Imbizo ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo eo mookotaba wa yona e neng e le “Mmoho re ntshetsa Aforika Borwa pele”.
tgt: I-Sefako Makgatho Health Sciences University.1 IKhabhinethi ikwamukele ngezandla ezimhlophe ukuvulwa ngokusemthethweni kwe-Sefako Makgatho Health Sciences University (i-SMU) nguMongameli Jacob Zuma eGa-Rankuwa, esifundazweni saseGauteng mhla ziyi-14 Mbasa 2015.

src: Sena ke pontsho ya demokerasi e holang moo baahi ba nkang karolo ka matla boikitlaetsong boo sepheo sa bona e leng ho etsa hore mmuso o ikarabelle jwaloka ha ho lebeletswe ho ya ka Morero wa Naha wa Ntshetsopele.
tgt: Le nyuvesi, ebandakanya nophiko lweNyuvesi yaseLimpopo obelubizwa nge-Medunsa, iqale ukusebenza ngowezi-2015, futhi inabafundi abayizi-5 000.Ukusungulwa kweNyuvesi i-Sefako Makgatho kuhlinzeka ngethuba elihle kakhulu lokuthuthukisa nokuqeqesha ongoti abasha bezempilo abazoba negalelo elibonakalayo ezimpilweni zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaningi abancisheke amathuba ngenxa yobubha kanye nokungakwazi ukufinyelela kwizinsizakalo zezempilo.

src: Boradipolotiki ba ka sehloohong ba ile ba buisana le badudi le ho phahlolla ditsebiso tse entsweng ke Moporesidente Jacob Zuma nakong ya Puo ya Pulo ya Palamente ya 20.2 Imbizo hape e fane ka monyetla ho boradipolotiki ba ka sehloohong ho arolelana le badudi merero ya mmuso ya ho ntlafatsa phano ya ditshebeletso le ho mamela dintlha tse tobileng badudi.
tgt: I--Sefako Makgatho Health Sciences University yinyuvesi yokuqala yamasayensi ezempilo ezimele esungulwe kuleli.

src: Diketsahalo di fihlile sehlohlolong ka la 12 Mmesa, ka ntjhafatso ya “Imbizo Lounge”, e neng e tshwerwe ka nako e le nngwe ke boradipolotiki ba bararo ba ka sehloohong diporofenseng tse tharo.
tgt: Iviki Lezimbizo.1 IKhabhinethi ithanda ukudlulisa amazwi okubonga kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaphume ngobuningi babo ukuyobamba iqhaza ohlelweni lokuxhumana ngqo nabantu abamele umphakathi ngeViki Likazwelonke Lezimbizo ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi “Sisonke siqhubekisela iNingizimu Afrika Phambili”.

src: Diqeto tsa Bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.1 Kabinete e amohela diphetho tsa diphuputso tse entsweng mabapi le ditletlebo le dipatlisiso tse 161 091 tse amohetsweng ho Mohala wa Boporesidente ho tloha esale o thehwa mafelong a Hlakubele 2013.
tgt: Lokhu kuyinkomba yokuvuthwa kombuso wethu wentando yeningi labantu lapho izakhamuzi zibamba iqhaza ngenkuthalo ezinhlelweni okuhloswe ngazo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni uyaphendula njengoba uHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP) lulayela ukuthi kube njalo.

src: Diphuputso di hlahlobile mofuta wa dinyewe tse kentsweng ke baahi, tsa hlwaya meokotaba e hlahellang le mekgwa ya tsamaiso ho parola le mafapha oohle a mmuso.
tgt: Abaholi bezepolitiki baxhumane nemiphakathi futhi bayichazela kabanzi ngezimemezelo ezenziwe nguMongameli Jacob Zuma eNkulumweni Echaza Isimo Sezwe yowezi-20.2 Izimbizo zahlinzeka futhi ngethuba lokuthi abaholi bezepolitiki bachazele umphakathi ngezinhlelo zikahulumeni zokuphucula ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingongqangi nokuthi bakwazi ukulalela izinkinga zomphakathi.

src: Diphuputso di hlwaile dintlha tse ngatanyana tse ngongorehisang baahi tse tshwanang ho parola jwalo le mafapha a mmuso.
tgt: Imicimbi yezimbizo yaphothulwa mhla ziyi-12 ngokubanjwa komcimbi oyingqayizivele obizwa nge-“Imbizo Lounge”, owabe usingathwe kanyekanye ngabaholi bezepolitiki abathathu ezifundazweni ezintathu.

src: Diphetho tsa diphuputso di tla thusa mafapha ho utlwisisa betere dintlha tse ngongorehisang badudi, le tlhahisoleseding e hlokahalang e batlwang ke badudi.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi eziqavile.1 IKhabhinethi yayamukela imiphumela yocwaningo olwenziwe oluphathelene nezikhalazo kanye nezicelo zolwazi eziyizi-161 091 ezamukelwe Kwinombolo Yocingo KaMongameli kusukela ekusungulweni kwayo kuze kuyofinyelela ekupheleni kwenyanga kaNdasa 2013.

src: Boitshunyako bona bo tla ntlafatsa mokgwa oo re sebeletsang badudi ka ona.2 Kabinete e fumane tlaleho ya moraorao mabapi le mohlophollo wa tefo ya bafani ba ditshebeletso nakong ya matsatsi a 30 a ho thola setlankana se molaong sa tefo.
tgt: Ucwaningo lwathola ulwazi lokuthi yizikhalazo ezinjani ezifakwe yizakhamuzi, futhi lwahlonza nezingqikithi eziphuma kulezi zikhalazo kanye nezinkinga ezivamisile eziphathelene nokungahanjiswa komsebenzi njengendlela efanelekile kwizinhlaka zikahulumeni ezahlukahlukene.

src: Kabinete e lemohile kgatelopele e entsweng, empa e ile ya hlahisa dingongoreho mabapi le mafapha a mang a ntseng a tobane le diphephetso.
tgt: Imiphumela yocwaningo yahlonza izinto eziningana ezikhathaza izakhamuzi ezivamise ukutholakala kuzo zonke izinhlaka zikahulumeni.

src: Mohlophollo wa papiso mabapi le Mafapha a Naha pakeng tsa 2013 Pherekgong ho ya ho Mphalane le 2014 Pherekgong ho ya ho Mphalane o bontshitse ntlafalo ya 39% mabapi le palohare ya palo ya dintlankana tsa tefo tse lefilweng nakong ya matsatsi a 30 le ntlafalo ya 32% mabapi le palohare ya palo ya ditlankana tsa tefo tse lefilweng kamora matsatsi a 30.Mafapha a Naha a tlalehile ditlankana tsa tefo tse 155 572 tsa boleng ba R3,8 bilione tse lefilweng kamora matsatsi a 30 mme ka nako eo, ditlankana tsa tefo tse 62 887 tsa boleng ba R2,1 bilione tse fetang matsatsi a 30 di ne di so lefuwe.
tgt: Imiphumela yocwaningo izolekelela iminyango kahulumeni ukuthi iqonde kangcono ukuthi yiziphi izinto ezikhathaza imiphakathi, futhi ihlinzeke ngolwazi olufanelekile oludingwa yimiphakathi.

src: Mafapha a diporofense bakeng sa nako e tshwanang a bontsha ntlafalo e seng kae ya 5% ho palohare ya palo ya ditlankana tsa tefo tse lefilweng nakong ya matsatsi a Diporofense di tlalehile ditlankana tsa tefo tse 241 332 tsa boleng ba R13,4 bilione tse lefilweng kamora matsatsi a 30 ditlankana tsa tefo tse 356 079 tsa boleng ba R21,8 bilione tse fetang matsatsi a 30 tse neng di so lefuwe.
tgt: Izinhlelo zokungenelela zizophucula indlela esihlinzeka ngayo umphakathi ngezinsizakalo.2 IKhabhinethi yethulelwa umbiko wakamuva wokuhlaziywa kokukhokhelwa kwezinkampani ezihlinzeka uhulumeni ngezimpahla nezinsizakalo kungakapheli izinsuku ezingama-30 emva kokufakwa kwe-invoyisi efanelekile.

src: Sena ke putlamo ya 52% ho palohare ya palo ya ditlankana tsa tefo tse fetang matsatsi a 30 le tse neng di so lefuwe.
tgt: Uhlaziyo oluqhathanisa iMinyango Kazwelonke kusukela ngenyanga kaMasingana kuye kuNcwaba ngowezi-2013 kanye nowezi-2014 kusukela kuMasingana kuyofinyelela kuNcwaba lukhombisa ubungcono obungama-39% uma kubhekwa inani lama-invoyisi akhokhelwe kungakapheli izinsuku ezingama-30 kanti futhi kubonakala ubungcono obungama-32% uma kubhekwa inani lama-invoyisi akhokhelwe sekudlule izinsuku ezingama-30.Ngesikhathi esifanayo, iminyango kazwelonke yabika ukuthi ayizi-155 572 ama-invoyisi enani eliyizigidigidi zamarandi ezingu-3,8 akhokhelwe sekuphele izinsuku ezingama-30, kanti futhi ayizi-62 887 ama-invoyisi enani eliyizigidigidi zamarandi ezingu-2,1 osekuphele izinsuku ezingama-30 efakiwe, angakakhokhelwa kuze kube manje.

src: Bakeng sa ho thusa mafapha a ntseng a sokola, Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho thehwa ha lekala le ikgethang ka hara Lefapha la Merero, Bodisa le Tlhatlhobo ya Tshebetso ho shebana le mafapha a ntseng a tswella ho sokola.
tgt: Futhi ngaleso sikhathi, iminyango yezifundazwe ikhombise ubungconywana obungama-5% uma kubhekwa inani lama-invoyisi akhokhelwe kungakapheli izinsuku ezingama-30.

src: Lekala lena le tla sebetsa mmoho le Lefapha la Matlotlo a Setjhaba le Lefapha la Tshebeletso ya Mmuso le Taolo (DPSA).Ho phaella hodima moo ho tla phatlalatswa mohala wa naha o tla ba teng bakeng sa bafani ba ditshebeletso ho tlaleha maemo moo ditefello di diehisitsweng.
tgt: Izifundazwe zabika ukuthi ayizi-241 332 ama-invoyisi enani eliyizigidigidi zamarandi ezingu-13,4 akhokhelwe sekuphele izinsuku ezingama-30, kanti futhi ayizi-356 079 ama-invoyisi enani eliyizigidigidi zamarandi ezingu-21,8 osekuphele izinsuku ezingama-30 efakiwe, angakakhokhelwa kuze kube manje.

src: Sena se tla iswa ho lefapha le amehang mme dikarabelo di tla tlalehwa.3 Kabinete e lemohile tlaleho mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lenaneo la Ditsiane la Tlhatlhobo ya Thekiso ya ka Ntle le Thuso ya Matsete (EMIA) le ho boela e amohela karabelo le moralo wa bolaodi wa Lefapha la Kgwebo le Diindaseteri.
tgt: Lokhu kukhombisa ukubuyela emuva noma ukwehla kwezinga ngama-52% uma kubhekwa inani lama-invoyisi osekuphele izinsuku ezingama-30 efakiwe, angakhokhelwanga.

src: Sena se entse karolo ya Morero wa Naha wa Tlhahlobo wa 2013/14 ho lekola bohlwahlwa ba Lenaneo bakeng sa ho tshehetsa bahlahisi ba Aforika Borwa le ba romelang thepa mafatsheng a ka ntle.
tgt: Ukuze kulekelelwe iminyango kahulumeni ehlangabezana nobunzima, iKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukusungulwa kophiko olukhethekile eMnyangweni Wezokuhlela, Ukuqapha Nokuhlola oluzolandelela kuleyo minyango ehlangabezana nobunzima bokukhokhela ama-invoyisi ngesikhathi esibekiwe.

src: EMIA e thusitse dikgwebo tse 6 766 tse romelang thepa mafatsheng a ka ntle ho parola le diporofense le ho ho lefa ditseko tsa palo ya boleng ba R510 milione ho tloha ka 2009/10 ho ya ka 2012/13.
tgt: Lolu phiko luzosebenza ngokubambisana noMnyango Wezezimali Kuzwelonke kanye noMnyango Wezemisebenzi Kahulumeni Nokuphathwa Kwayo (i-DPSA).Ngaphezu kwalokho kuzosatshaIaliswa imininingwane yenombolo yocingo kazwelonke engafonelwa ngabahlinzeki bezimpahla nezinsizakalo uma bengakhokhelwanga ngesikhathi.

src: Tekolo ya bankakarolo ba EMIA e bontsha tshebediso e kgabane ya ditsiane tsa EMIA ke bongata ba batho ba neng ba Tinngwe Menyetla ho ya ka Nalane le difeme tseo beng ba tsona e leng basadi.4 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana moralo wa Tokomane ya Leano la Naha la ho Betjha e tla phatlalatswa ho Koranta ya Mmuso bakeng sa dipuisano tse pharaletseng le setjhaba.
tgt: Izikhalazo zabo zizodluliselwa kwiminyango kahulumeni efanelekile bese kukhishwa umbiko mayelana nezimpendulo ezihlinzekwe yiminyango.3 IKhabhinethi yawuphawula umbiko Wokuhlolwa Kokuqaliswa koHlelo Lwezibonelelo Zokuthengiswa Kwezimpahla Emazweni Angaphandle kanye Nosizo Lwezokutshalwa Kwezimali (EMIA) futhi yazamukela nezinyathelo ezithathwe ngabaphathi, kanye nohlelo lokwenza ngcono isimo loMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni.

src: Sepheo sa yona ke ho ntlafatsa bohlwahlwa ba ho laola ho betjha, ho ntlafatsa kgokahano le tshebedisanommoho le diporofense le ho fetola maemo botjha a Boto ya Naha ya ho Betjha jwaloka molaodi bakeng sa sebetsana ka bokgabane le ho betjha ho seng molaong.5 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya moralo wa Leano la Tahi bakeng sa dipuisano tse pharaletseng le setjhaba.
tgt: Lokhu kube yingxenye yoHlelo Lokuhlola Lukazwelonke lowezi-2013/14 okuhloswe ngalo ukuhlola ukuthi lusebenza kahle yini lolu Hlelo lwe-EMIA ekusekeleni abakhiqizi baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nalabo abathumela izimpahla emazweni angaphandle.

src: Moralo wa Leano la Tahi o tla ntlafatsa bohlwahlwa ba ho laola kgwebo ya tahi le ho thibela kgwebo e seng molaong.
tgt: Uhlelo lwe-EMIA luhlinzeke ngosizo kumabhizinisi athumela impahla emazweni angaphandle ayizi-6 766 ezifundazweni zonkana futhi lukhokhele izicelo zezibonelelo zenani eliyizigidi zamarandi ezingama-510 kusukela ngowezi-2009/10 kuya kowezi-2012/13.

src: Hara dintlha tse ding, ditshisinyo di tobane le kgahlamelo ya tahi ho moruo wa kahisano le ditholwana tsa tshebediso e mpe ya tahi mmoho le diphethoho indasetering ya tahi.6 Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka diphetho tsa tlhatlhobo e tebileng ya Ntlafatso ya Kgodiso ya Bana moo ditlhatlhobo tse tebileng di ileng tsa etswa bakeng sa Kereiti ya R le boitshunyako ba tsa phepo bakeng sa bana ba ka tlasa dilemo tse hlano.
tgt: Ucwaningo olwenziwe kubabambiqhaza be-EMIA lubonisa ukuthi sisetshenziswa kakhulu isibonelelo se-EMIA yizinkampani zaBantu Ababencishwe Amathuba Phambilini kanye namabhizinisi abesifazane.4 IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuthi uhlaka loMbhalo Wenqubomgomo Kazwelonke Yezokugembula lushicilelwe kuSomqulu Kahulumeni ukuze abantu abaningana emphakathini bakwazi ukuzwakalisa izimvo zabo ngalo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ntshetsopele ya Moralo o Kopanetsweng wa Naha wa Phepo bakeng sa Aforika Borwa, oo ka kakaretso o sebetsanang le phepo, ho kenyeletsa nako ya pele ho tswalo, matsatsi a 1 000 a pele a ho phela, ntlafatso ya kgodiso ya bana le Kereiti ya Moralo wa ntlafatso ho tloha ho tekolo mabapi le “Kgahlamelo ya ho Hlahiswa ha Kereiti ya R hodima Diphetho tsa ho Ithuta” o toboketsa ho ntlafatswa ha boleng ba Kereiti ya R bakeng sa ho phahamisa kgahlamelo ya ona ho bana ba futsanehileng le diporofense tse sa sebetseng hantle.
tgt: Ngalolu hlaka kuhloswe ukuphucula indlela okulawulwa ngayo ezokugembula, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi indlela okuqhutshwa ngayo umsebenzi ihambelana kangcono, kuphuculwe ukubambisana nokusebenzisana nezifundazwe futhi kubekwe iBhodi Kazwelonke Yezokugembula, njengomlawuli, esimweni sokubhekana kangcono nenkinga yokugembula okungekho emthethweni.5 IKhabhinethi yakwamukela ukushicilelwa kohlaka lweNqubomgomo Yotshwala ukuze abantu abaningana emphakathini bakwazi ukuzwakalisa izimvo zabo ngalo.

src: Sena se kenyeletsa thupello le ntshetsopele ya matitjhere a Kereiti ya R le ho nkela hloohong thonyo ya batho ba nang le mangolo a phahameng (maemo a NQF a bo5) a amehang bakeng sa morero ona.
tgt: Uhlaka lweNqubomgomo Yotshwala luzokwenza ngcono indlela okulawulwa ngayo ukuthengiswa kotshwala futhi lulwisane nokuthengiswa kotshwala ngaphandle kwemvume.

src: Dibili.1 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho lokollwa ha Bili ya Inshorense, ya 2015 bakeng sa dipuisano le setjhaba.
tgt: Phakathi kokunye, iziphakamiso zale nqubomgomo zizozama ukuxazulula inkinga yomthelela ongemuhle wotshwala kwezenhlalo nezomnotho wabantu kanye nezinye izindleko ezibangelwa ukuxhashazwa kotshwala, kanye nodaba lokulethwa koguquko kwimboni yotshwala.6 IKhabhinethi yahlinzekwa ngolwazi mayelana nemiphumela yokuhlolwa okwenziwe emkhakheni wokuThuthukiswa Kwezingane Zisencane ngenhloso yokuthola ukuthi yiziphi izinkinga ezikhona kulo mkhakha, lapho kwenziwe khona ukuhlola okunzulu kwiBanga R kanye nezinhlelo zokungenelela ekuhlinzekweni kwezingane ezineminyaka engaphansi kwemihlanu ngokudla okunomsoco.

src: Bili ena e matahantswe le Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha, e netefatsa lekala le hlwahlwa le laolwang hantle la inshorense, le ho hodisa botsitso ho tsa ditjhelete bo tla tshehetsa kgolo ya moruo ya moshwelella ka ho fana ka kgahlamelo ho maemo a phahameng a toka a hlahisitsweng ha ho shejwa koduwa ya ditjhelete ya 2008.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuthi kuthuthukiswe uHlelo Lukazwelonke Oludidiyelwe Lokuhlinzekwa Kokudla Okunomsoco olwenzelwe iNingizimu Afrika, okuwuhlelo oluzobhekana ngokuphelele nodaba lokuhlinzekwa kokudla okunomsoco, kubandakanya nokudla okudliwa ngumama ngaphambi kokukhulelwa, nokudla okutholwa ngumntwana ezinsukwini zokuphila kwakhe zokuqala eziyi-1 000, nasesigabeni sokuthuthukiswa kwezingane zisencane kanye nakwiBanga Uhlelo lokuphucula isimo oluwumphumela wokuhlolwa “Komthelela Wokwethulwa Kwemiphumela Yokufunda YeBanga R” lugcizelela ukuphuculwa kwezinga lemfundo yeBanga R ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lokhu kunomthelela omuhle ezinganeni ezihlwempu kanye nasezifundazweni ezingaqhubi kahle kwezemfundo.

src: Bolaodi ba Tekolo ya Bokgoni ba Paballo ya Tjhelete le Taolo bo batla ho hlahisa katamelo e ntjha, e nang le tjhebelopele e itshetlehileng hodima dikotsi tsa ho tjhona ka ho matahanya ditlhoko tsa tjhelete tse teng le dikotsi tsa ya fanang ka inshorense.
tgt: Lokhu kubandakanya ukuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kothisha beBanga R kanye nokuqashwa kwabantu abanesitifiketi semfundo ephakeme esifanelekile (i-NQF level 5) ngenhloso yokufezekisa lokhu.

src: Hape e fana ka ditsiane ho beng ba inshorense ho imatahanya le mekgwa e hlwahlwa ya ho beha leihlo le ho laola.
tgt: Imithethosivivinywa.1 IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuthi kukhishwe uMthethosivivinywa Wezomshwalense, wezi-2015 ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukuzwakalisa izimvo zawo ngawo.

src: Mekgwa ena e batla ho netefatsa tshireletso e betere ya beng ba dipholisi le bakgolamolemo le ho nyehela ho botsitso ho tsa ditjhelete.2 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya moralo wa Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Setsi sa Merero ya Mautlwela a tsa Ditjhelete, sa 2014 bakeng sa dipuisano le setjhaba.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uyahambelana noHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe, futhi uqinisekisa ukuba khona komkhakha wezomshwalense onohlonze futhi olawulwa ngendlela efanele, futhi ugqugquzela uzinzo kwezezimali okuyinto ezosekela ukukhula komnotho okusimeme ngokusebenzisa imigomo yokwenza ibhizinisi ngobuchule nobuhlakani obukhulu, ethuthukiswe ngenhloso yokugwema isimo esifana naleso esenzeka ngesikhathi sokufadalala komnotho ngowezi-2008.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili se sisinya dihlomathiso ho Molao wa Setsi sa Merero ya Mautlwela a tsa Ditjhelete (Molao wa 38 wa 2001).
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uqalisa ukusebenza kohlaka olusha lokwenza ibhizinisi ngobuchule nobuhlakani emkhakheni wezomshwalense.

src: Sena ke ho sebetsana le ditshoso tsa botsitso ba tsamaiso ya rona ya tsa ditjhelete tse hlahiswang ke dikadimo tse bohlaswa tsa ditjhelete le thuso ya boferekanyi ka ditjhelete ka ho netefatsa boimatahanyo le mekgwa ya matjhaba le dipehelo, ka hara moralo wa melao ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: \Uhlelo lokuHlolwa Nokuphathwa Kwesimo Senkampani Sokukwazi Ukukhokha Izikweleti Zayo kuhloswe ngalo ukwethula inkambiso entsha ephokophele phambili futhi esekelwe phezu kobungozi, yokubhekana nenkinga yokucwila kwebhizinisi ngenxa yokushoda kwezimali, ngokuthi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi inkampani inemali eyanele emgodlagodleni wayo ukuze ikwazi ukumelana nobungozi obubhekene nomsebenzi wokuphathwa kwenkampani yomshwalense.

src: Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le Dintlha tsa Hajwale.1 Kabinete e lemohile ka ngongoreho keketseho e bohale ya mafu a mebileng nakong ya mafelo a beke ya Paseka, moo re boneng dikotsi tse 208 tse bakileng mafu a 287, ha ho bapiswa le palo ya mafu ya selemo se fetileng, e neng e eme ho mafu a 193 ho tswa dikotsing tse 148.Boipaballo mebileng ke boikarabelo ba maAforika Borwa oohle mme katleho ya matsholo a rona a boipaballo mebileng a itshetlehile ho basebedisi bohle ba mebila ba bapalang karolo ya bona.
tgt: Lezi zinyathelo kuhloswe ngazo ukuqinisekisa ukuvikelela okungcono kubanikazi bamapholisi omshwalense kanye nalabo ababhaliswe njengabazohlomula kulawo mapholisi futhi kulethwe nozinzo kwezezimali.2 IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuthi kushicilelwe uhlaka loMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela Umthetho Wesikhungo Sezobunhloli Bezezimali, wezi-2014 ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngawo.

src: Bakganni ba lokela ho latela melawana ya tsela, ba seke ba nwa le ho kganna, ba imatahanye le lebelo le lekanyeditsweng le ho netefatsa hore dipalangwang tsa bona di loketse tsela.2 Lebitsong la batho ba Aforika Borwa, Kabinete, e hlahisa matshediso a yona a tebileng ho mmuso le batho ba Rephaboliki ya Kenya, haholoholo malapa a mahlatsipa a hlokahetseng tlhaselong e hlokang kelello Kholetjheng ya Yunivesithi ya Garissa ka la 2 Mmesa 2015.Kabinete e kgema le Moporesidente Jacob Zuma tabeng ya ho tshwela ka mathe ketso ena ya boferekanyi le ho boeletsa hore Aforika Borwa e tshehetsa Kenya le mekutu ya baahi ba matjhaba ya kgotso, botsitso le demokerasi le kaho ya setjhaba ka hara Somalia.3 Kabinete e thoholetsa batho ba Nigeria bakeng sa ho tshwara dikgetho tse nang le kgotso, ponaletso, botshepehi le tse lokolohileng ka la 28 Hlkubele 2015, jwaloka ha di tiiseditswe ke Khomishene ya Naha ya Dikgetho ya Nigeria.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uhlongoza ukuthi kwenziwe izichibiyelo eMthethweni Wesikhungo Sezobunhloli Bezezimali (uMthetho Nombolo 38 wezi-2001).

src: Lebitsong la maAforika Borwa, Kabinete e thoholetsa Mokgenerale Muhammad Buhari ho kgethweng ha hae jwaloka Moporesidente wa Rephaboliki ya Bofederale ya Nigeria.4 Kabinete e thoholetsa Marlene van Niekerk bakeng sa ho ba moAforika Borwa wa pele ho ba letotong le lekgutshwane bakeng sa Moputso wa Matjhaba wa Man Booker.
tgt: Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukubhekana nobungozi obungaphazamisa uzinzo ohlelweni lwethu lwezimali ngenxa yobugebengu bokundandaniswa kwezimali ngendlela engekho emthethweni kanye nokuxhaswa kwabashokobezi ngezimali, ngokuthi kuqinisekiswe ukuthotshelwa kwemigomo nezinkambiso zamazwe ngamazwe, ngaphansi kohlaka lwemithetho yaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: O ananetswe bakeng sa phihlello e ipabotseng ya nako tsohle bongoding ba dipale, tse kenyeletsang mesebetsi e jwaloka Triomf le Agaat.
tgt: Isimo seKhabhinethi Ezindabeni Ezisematheni.1 IKhabhinethi ikuphawule ngokukhathazeka okukhulu ukudlondlobala kwesibalo sabantu abashone ezingozini zomgwaqo nempelasonto yePhasika, njengoba kube nezingozi ezingama-208 ezithathe imiphefumulo yabantu abayizi-287, uma kuqhathaniswa nenani labantu abashone ngonyaka odlule, lapho kwashona khona abantu abayi-193 ezingozini eziyi-148.Ukuphepha emgwaqeni kungumsebenzi wabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika futhi impumelelo yemikhankaso yethu yezokuphepha emgwaqeni incike ekutheni bonke abasebenzisi bomgwaqo badlale indima yabo.

src: Hape o amohetse Kgau ya Ikhamanga ka 2011 bakeng sa “nyehelo ya hae e ipabotseng ho bonono le botjhaba ho tsa dingolwa”.
tgt: Abashayeli kumele bathobele imithetho yomgwaqo, bangashayeli bedakiwe, bangaweqi umgomo wejubane futhi baqinisekise ukuthi izimoto zabo zisesimweni esifanelekile sokuba semgwaqeni.2 Egameni labantu baseNingizimu Afrika, iKhabhinethi idlulisa amazwi enduduzo kuhulumeni kanye nabantu baseKenya, ikakhulu imindeni yalabo abashone esigamekweni esingenangqondo sokuhlaselwa kwabafundi e-Garissa University College mhla zi-2 Mbasa 2015.IKhabhinethi ihlanganyela noMongameli Jacob Zuma ekugxekeni lesi senzo sobushokobezi futhi iyagcizelela ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyayeseka imizamo yelizwe laseKenya kanye neyamazwe omhlaba yokugcinwa kokuthula noxolo, uzinzo, intando yeningi labantu kanye nokwakhiwa kwesizwe saseSomalia.3 IKhabhinethi ihalalisela abantu base-Nigeria ngokubamba ukhetho olukhululekile, olusobala, olwamukelekile futhi olungachemile mhla zingama-28 Ndasa 2015, njengoba lokhu kumenyezelwe ngokusemethethweni yiKhomishana Yokhetho Kazwelonke Ezimele yase-Nigeria.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.1 Kabinete e ananetse hore Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla be a araba dipotso Palamenteng ka Labone, 16 Mmesa 20.2 Kabinete e amohela Leeto la Puso ho ya Jakarta, Indonesia la Moporesidente Jacob Zuma ho tloha ka la 19 ho isa ho la 21 Mmesa 2015, le tla sheba botjha maemo a dikamano tsa bobedi bona ho netefatsa phihlello ya dilemo tse hlano tsa ‘Morero wa Tshebetso’, jwaloka ha o ile wa tshohlwa ke mahlakore ka bobedi Pretoria ka Pudungwana 2014.Moporesidente Jacob Zuma hape o tla kenela Seboka sa Asia-Aforika mahareng a la 22 ho isa ho la 23 Mmesa ho la Jakarta, se tla matlafatsa tshebedisanommoho ya dinaha tse ka borwa ba ekhweita e tla lebisa kgolong ya moruo wa kahisano bakeng sa mabatowa ka bobedi.
tgt: Egameni labantu baseNingizimu Afrika, iKhabhinethi ihalalisela uJenene Muhammad Buhari ngokukhethwa kwakhe njengoMongameli wezwe Elibuswa Ngemibusombuso lase-Nigeria.4 IKhabhinethi ithanda ukuhalalisela u-Marlene van Niekerk ngokuba ngumuntu waseNingizimu Afrika wokuqala osohlwini lwalabo abasethubeni lokuklonyeliswa ngendondo yombhali wezincwadi ovelele, i-Man Booker International Prize.

src: Leeto lena le tla phethelwa ka Sehopotso sa bo60 sa Seboka sa Bandung sa 1955 le Sehopotso sa bo10 sa Bosemphato se Setjha sa Mawala (NAASP) ka la 24 Mmesa 2015, se tla tshwarwa Bandung, ho la West Java.
tgt: Wahlonishwa ngomsebenzi wakhe omuhle kakhulu ekubhalweni kwezincwadi ezingamanoveli, kubandakanya nenoveli yakhe esihloko sithi Triomf kanye nenye enesihloko esithi Agaat.

src: E ne e le Bandung moo baetapele ba mokgatlo wa rona e leng Moses Kotane le Maulvi Cachalia ba ileng ba tlisa dipehelo tsa ho hloka semorabe le boikemelo lenaneong la lefatshe.3 Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa oohle ho kenela Mekete ya Kgwedi ya Tokoloho, e tlisang dilemo tse mashome a mararo tsa tokoloho ka ho kgothaletsa seriti sa botho le ho tsitlallela mohopolo o tshwanang o tla lebisa kahong ya Aforika Borwa e kopaneng le ho atleha.
tgt: Wahlonishwa futhi ngendondo kazwelonke i-Order of Ikhamanga ngowezi-2011 “ngegalelo lakhe elikhulu kwezobuciko bokubhalwa kwezincwadi kanye namasiko”.

src: Mokete wa rona wa naha o tla phethelwa ka Letsatsi la Tokoloho, 27 Mmesa 2015 tlasa mookotaba: “Re Keteka Qalo ya Dilemo tse Mashome a Mararo tsa Tokoloho ya rona ka ho Akofisa Diphethoho tse Matla tsa Moruo”.MaAforika Borwa a boela a hopotswa ka ho intsha sehlabelo ka matla ha batho ba bo rona le basadi ntweng kgahlanong le tsamaiso e soto ya kgethollo hore re tle re thabele tokoloho eo re nang le yona kajeno.
tgt: Imicimbi ezayo.1 IKhabhinethi yakuphawula ukuthi uMongameli Jacob Zuma uzophendula imibuzo ePhalamende ngoLwesine, mhla ziyi-16 Mbasa 20.2 IKhabhinethi iyalwamukela uHambo Olusemthethweni lukaMongameli Jacob Zuma Lokuvakashela e-Jakarta, kwelase-Indonesia kusukela mhla ziyi-19 kuze kube ngumhla zingama-21 Mbasa 2015, oluzobuyekeza isimo sobudlelwano balawa mazwe amabili ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufezekiswa ‘koHlelo Lokusebenza’ lweminyaka emihlanu, njengoba izinhlangothi zamazwe womabili zaxoxisana ngalo ePitoli ngoLwezi 2014.UMongameli Jacob Zuma uzohambela futhi neNgqungquthela yamazwe ase-Afrika nawase-Asia ezobanjwa kusukela mhla zingama-22 kuze kube ngumhla zingama-23 kuMbasa e-Jakarta, okuyingqungquthela ezoqinisa ubambiswano nokusebenzisana phakathi kwamazwe aseNingizimu ne-Ikhweyitha ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukukhula kwenhlalo nomnotho walamazwekazi omabili.

src: Bakeng sa ho hlompha maAforika Borwa a nyehetseng ntshetsopeleng ya demokerasi ya rona, Moporesidente Jacob Zuma ka Letsatsi la Tokoloho o tla fana ka Dikgau tsa Naha moketeng o tla beng o tshwaretswe Meahong ya Kopano.
tgt: Lolu hambo luzophothulwa ngokwethamela uMgubho weminyaka engama-60 kwabanjwa iNgqungquthela yase-Bandung ngowe-1955 kanye noMgubho weminyaka eyi-10 yoBambiswano Olusha Emikhakheni Esemqoka Oluphakathi Kwamazwe ase-Afrika kanye nawase-Asia (i-NAASP) mhla zingama-24 Mbasa 2015, ozobanjelwa e-Bandung, e-West Java.

src: Kabinete e fetisa thoholetso ho baamohedi bohle le ho etsa teboho ya yona bakeng sa nyehelo ya bona.4 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Aforika Borwa e tla tshwara Ho dula ho Setlwaeding ha bo25 ha Kopano ya Aforika ho Lefapha la Dikamano le Tshebedisano ya Matjhaba le Setsing sa Matjhaba sa Dikopano sa Sandton Johannesburg, ho tloha ka la 7-15 Phuptjane 2015.
tgt: Kuse-Bandung lapho abaholi bombutho wethu o-Moses Kotane kanye no-Maulvi Cachalia bethula khona imigomo yokungacwasi ngokobuhlanga kanye nozimele-geqe phambi kwesithangamu samazwe omhlaba.3 IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi babambe iqhaza kwimigubho yeNyanga Yenkululeko, ezongenisa ishuminyaka lesithathu lenkululeko yaleli lizwe ngokuthi kugqugquzelwe ukuhlonishwa kwesithunzi somuntu futhi kuqhutshwe i-ajenda kazwelonke efanayo yokuqinisekisa ukwakhiwa kweNingizimu Afrika ebumbene futhi echumile.

src: Aforika Borwa e ithaopile ho tshwara seboka sena kamora hoba Rephaboliki ya Chad e ikgule.
tgt: Imigubho yethu kazwelonke izophothulwa ngoSuku Lwenkululeko, mhla zingama-27 Mbasa 2015 ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Sigubha Isiqalo Seshuminyaka Lenkululeko yethu Lesithathu ngokuthi Sisheshise Ukulethwa Koguquko Olunohlonze Kwezomnotho”.Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakhunjuzwa futhi ngokuzidela okukhulu okwenziwa ngabanu bezwe lethu kanye nabesifazane emzabalazweni ngenkathi belwisana nenqubo yolunya nesihluku sobandlululo ukuze sikwazi ukuthokozela inkululeko yethu esiphila ngaphansi kwayo namhlanje.

src: Sepheo se seholo sa seboka e tla ba ho sheba botjha kgatelopele e entsweng ho fihlellweng ha dipheo tsa kontinente, ho tsepamisitswe maikutlo haholo hodima mookotaba wa 2015, “Selemo sa Matlafatso ya Basadi le Ntshetsopele e lebisang ho Lenane la Aforika 2063”.
tgt: Njengophawu lokuhlonipha abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abadlale indima enkulu ekuthuthukisweni kombuso wethu wentando yeningi labantu, uMongameli Jacob Zuma uzohlonipha abantu abavelele emikhakheni ehlukahlukene ngokubaklomelisa ngeziNdondo Zikazwelonke ngoSuku Lwenkululeko, emcimbini ozobanjelwa e-Union Buildings.

src: Dintlha tse ding tsa bohlokwa e tla ba maemo a kgotso le tshireletso ka hara Aforika, twantsho ya Lefu la Kokwanahloko ya Ebola le kgahlamelo ya moruo wa kahisano ho kontinente, mehlodi e meng ya matlole a ho tshehetsa AU, ho amohelwa ha Moralo wa ho kenya Tshebetsong Dilemo tse Leshome tsa Pele tsa Lenane la AU 2063 le tlhabollo ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng Sehopotsong sa ona sa bo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabahalalisela bonke abazohlonishwa ngezindondo zikazwelonke futhi ithanda ukudlulisa amazwi okubabonga ngendima abayidlalile.4 IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika isingathe iSigcawu Esijwayelekile sama-25 Sobumbano Lwamazwe Ase-Afrika (i-AU) kumahhovisi oMnyango Wobudlelwano Bamazwe Omhlaba Nokubambisana nase-Sandton International Convention Centre eGoli, mhla ziyisi 7-15 Nhlangulana 2015.

src: Ditlhaselo tsa moraorao tjena tsa melata.
tgt: Izigameko zakamuva zokuhlaselwa kwabokufika.

src: Kabinete e ananela kgotso le kgutso e bonahalang e leng teng metseng e neng e anngwe ke ditlhaselo tsa moraorao tjena tsa melata.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukuthula nozinzo oseluqalile ukubonakala emiphakathini ebikhungethwe yizigameko zokuhlaselwa kwabokufika kuleli emavikini ambalwa edlule.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse mafapha a sebeditseng ka Setsi sa Naha sa Tshebetso sa Kopanelo bakeng sa ho fedisa diketso tsa merusu tse etsahetseng KwaZulu-Natal le Gauteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyincoma kakhulu iminyango kahulumeni ethathe izinyathelo ezinqala ngokusebenzisa iSikhungo Sikazwelonke Sokusebenza Ngokubambisana ukuze kuqedwe izigameko zodlame ezenzeke KwaZulu-Natali kanye naseGauteng.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse baetapele ba diporofense le bomasepala dibakeng tse neng di amehile bakeng sa karolo ya bona ya ho fana ka pebofaletso le ho etella pele morero wa ho kopanya botjha melata le badudi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibancomile futhi nabaholi bezifundazwe kanye nabomasipala ezindaweni ebezikhahlanyezwe wudlame ngegalelo labo lokuhlinzeka ngosizo kanye nokuhola inqubo yokubuyiselwa kwabokufika emiphakathini abebehlala kuyona.

src: Bekeng e fetileng, Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o ile a bitsa dikopano tsa bankakarolo le baemedi ba dikgwebo, dihlopha tsa bodumedi, mekgatlo ya basebetsi, ya setjhaba le ya melata.
tgt: Ngeviki eledlule, uMongameli Jacob Zuma ubize umhlangano wabo bonke abathintekayo, kubandakanya abamele osomabhizinisi, abezenkolo, abasebenzi, izinhlangano zomphakathi ezahlukahlukene kanye nabamele abokufika.

src: Dipuisano e ne e le tse ahang bakeng sa ho thusa tabeng ya ho ntshetsa tsamaiso ena pele.
tgt: Izingxoxo zalo mhlangano bekuyizingxoxo ezakhayo okuhloswe ngazo ukuqhubekisela phambili inqubo yokuqinisekisa ukuthula nozinzo.

src: Bankakarolo bohle ba ile ba dumellana ka lentswe le le leng tabeng ya ho hlahisa ho tshwela ka mathe ditlhaselo tsena le ho itlama ho sebetsa le mmuso ho fumaneng tharollo ya moshwelella.
tgt: Bonke ababambiqhaza bavumelene ngazwilinye, bezwakalisa ukuzigxeka kakhulu lezi zigameko zokuhlaselwa kwabokufika futhi bazibophezela ukuthi bazobambisana nohulumeni ukuze kutholakale ikhambi elizoxazulula le nkinga unomphela, ukuze ingaphinde ibuye futhi.

src: Komiti e Kopanetsweng ya Matona (IMC) e thontsweng moraorao tjena mabapi le Bofalli e sebetsa bakeng sa ho fumana tharollo ya moshwelella mabapi le dintlha tse hlahisitsweng ke badudi le melata.
tgt: Ikomidi Longqongoshe Lezokufuduka Kwabantu (i-IMC) elisungulwe esikhathini esifushane esedlule lisebenza ngokuzikhandla okukhulu ukuze kutholakale ikhambi elizoziqeda nya izinkinga eziphakanyiswe yimiphakathi kanye nabantu bokufika.

src: Diqeto tsa Bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi Eziqavile.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka kgatelopele e entsweng mabapi le Rejisetara ya Thepa e sa Sutheng ya Mmuso wa Naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yahlinzekwa ngolwazi lwakamuva mayelana nenqubekelaphambili eseyenziwe kwiRejista Yomhlaba Nezakhiwo Zikahulumeni Kazwelonke.

src: Lekala la Ditshebeletso tsa Boingodiso ba Matlo le se le thehilwe ho tloha ka la 01 Mmesa 2015.
tgt: Kusukela mhla lu-1 Mbasa 2015 sekusungulwe uPhiko Lokubhaliswa Kwezakhiwo Nomhlaba Kahulumeni.

src: Lekala lena le tla laolwa ka hara Setheo sa Bolaodi ba Kgwebisano ya Thepa ya Bodulo mme le tla okamela thepa ya Puso e sa sutheng.
tgt: Lolu phiko luzolawulwa ngaphansi kweNkampani Yokuphathwa Kwezakhiwo Nomhlaba Kahulumeni futhi umsebenzi wayo kuzoba ukwengamela nokuqapha uMhlaba Nezakhiwo zoMbuso.

src: Le tla sebetsa jwaloka setsi sa poloko se le seng sa thepa e sa sutheng ya Puso, mme le tla fana ka bodisa, bolaodi le peho-leihlo ya Rejisetara ya Thepa e sa Sutheng ya Mmuso.
tgt: Lolu phiko luzosebenza njengomthombo okunguwona kuphela ozogcina futhi uhlinzeke nemininingwane yomhlaba nezakhiwo zoMbuso, futhi luzoba wuhlaka oluzokwengamela, lulawule futhi luqaphe iRejista Yomhlaba Nezakhiwo Zombuso.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho lokollwa ha Moralo wa Leano mabapi le Lebollo la Setso bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele ka ona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuthi kukhishwe uHlaka LweNqubomgomo Yesiko Lokwaluka ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngayo.

src: Morero wa leano lena ke ho batla ho tshireletsa, ho kgothaletsa le ho laola lebollo ka ho sisinya mekgwa le maemo a amohelehang mme hape le ho qala mekgatlo boemong ba naha le ba diporofense.
tgt: Ngale nqubomgomo kuhloswe ukuvikela, ukugqugquzela kanye nokulawula isiko lokwaluka, ngokuthi kuphakanyiswe imigomo namazinga amukelekile okuzosetshenzwa ngaphansi kwawo futhi kuhlinzekelwe izinhlaka ezifanelekile emazingeni kazwelonke kanye nawezifundazwe.

src: Le tla netefatsa hore mabollo a etsahala ka hara tikoloho e laolehang.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo izoqinisekisa ukuthi ukwaluka kwenzelwa ngaphansi kwesimo esifanelekile futhi esilawulekayo.

src: Sena se etsa karolo ya mehato e nkuwang ke mmuso ho hatella mekgwa e nepahetseng, e amohelehang ya mesebetsi ya setso le ho busetsa maemo a amohelehang a boikarabello ao esale a sebediswa bakeng sa dilemo tse telele.
tgt: Lokhu kuyingxenye yezinyathelo zikahulumeni zokuqinisekisa ukugcinwa kwamasiko ngendlela efanelekile futhi eyamukelekile, futhi kwenzelwe ukubuyisa izinga elamukelekile lokuphendula ngendlela efanelekile uma kwenziwa leli siko, njengoba lokhu kuyiyona into eyenze ukuthi leli siko liqhubeke iminyaka ngeminyaka kusukela ekusungulweni kwalo emandulo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Lenaneo le kopanetsweng la mmuso la Bodulo ba Batho bakeng sa Masepala wa Nelson Mandela Bay le tla sebedisa Lekala la Ntshetsopele ya Matlo jwaloka motjha wa ho kenya mesebetsi ya lona tshebetsong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilwamukelile uHlelo Lwezokuhlaliswa Kwabantu oluqhutshwa yiminyango kahulumeni ehlukahlukene oluqondiswe kuMasipala i-Nelson Mandela Bay oluzosebenzisa uPhiko Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezindlu ukulawula kanye nokuqhuba umklamo wokwakhiwa kwezindlu kulo masipala.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tshwarwa ha Seboka sa Matjhaba sa Mekgatlo ya Dilaeborari le Ditheo tsa Seboka sa Selemo le Selemo sa Tlhahisoleseding ya Dilaeborari tsa Lefatshe ho la Motse Kapa ho tloha ka la 15 ho isa ho la 21 Phato 2015 tlasa mookotaba "Dilaeborari tse Hlwahlwa: Phihlello, Ntshetsopele le Diphethoho".
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukusingathwa kweNgqungquthela Yombimbi Lwamazwe Ngamazwe Lwezinhlangano Nezikhungo Zemitapo Yolwazi Ebanjwa Njalo Ngonyaka Yolwazi Oluphathelene Nemitapo Yolwazi Yamazwe Omhlaba edolobheni laseKapa kusukela mhla ziyi-15 kuze kube ngumhla zingama-21 kuNcwaba ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi "Imitapo Yolwazi esebenza ngenkuthalo: Ukufinyeleleka, Intuthuko kanye Noguquko".

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tekwa ha Tumellano ya ho Fedisa Kgwebo e seng Molaong ya Dihlahiswa tsa Kwae.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yakwemukela ukwethulwa kweSivumelwano Senkambiso Efanelekile Okuhloswe Ngayo Ukuqeda Uhwebo Lwemikhiqizo Kagwayi Olungekho Emthethweni.

src: Sena ke ho ya ka Seboka sa Moralo wa Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Bophelo bo Botle mabapi le Taolo ya Kwae oo Aforika Borwa e o tjhaelletseng monwana ka Mmesa 2005.
tgt: Lokhu kuhambisana neSivumelwano Sohlaka Lokulawulwa Kwemikhiqizo Kagwayi SeNhlangano Yezempilo Emhlabeni esasayindwa yiNingizimu Afrika ngoMbasa 2005.

src: Tumellano e tla thusa dinaha ho nka mehato ya lefatshe kgahlanong le kgwebo eo e seng molaong ya dihlahiswa tsa kwae haholoholo dinaheng tse saenetseng Tumellano.
tgt: Lesi sivumelwano sizolekelela amazwe omhlaba ukuthi akwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ngokubambisana ukuze kulwisanwe nohwebo lwemikhiqizo kagwayi olungekho emthethweni, ikakhulu kulawo mazwe asayinde iSivumelwano.

src: Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa hajwale.
tgt: Isimo seKhabhinethi ezindabeni ezisematheni.

src: Kabinete e hlahisitse matshediso a yona ho malapa a bao ba hlokahalletseng dikotsing tsa dipalangwang tsa moraorao tjena tse ileng tsa kenyeletsa ho thulana ha dibese tse pedi Johannesburg bekeng e fetileng le ho thulana ha diterene bekeng ena Seteisheneng sa Denver ka borwa ho Johannesburg.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulise amazwi enduduzo emindenini yabantu abashone ezingozini zezithuthi zomphakathi ezenzeke esikhathini esifushane esedlule, kubandakanya ingozi yokungqubuzana kwamabhasi amabili eyenzeke eGoli ngeviki eledlule kanye neyokunqgubuzana kwezitimela eyenzeke kuleli viki eSiteshini sase-Denver eningizimu yedolobha laseGoli.

src: Kabinete e tshepa hore dipatlisiso ka mafapha a amehang di tla fatolla disosa tsa dikotsi tsena le ho netefatsa hore dikotsi tse kang tsena ha di etsahale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inethemba lokuthi uphenyo oluqhutshwa yiminyango efanelekile luzoyiveza imbangela yalezi zingozi futhi luqinisekise ukuthi izingozi ezinjengalezi azenzeki futhi esikhathini esizayo.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le Moporesidente Zuma ka ho fetisa matshediso a yona ho lelapa, metswalle le ho barati bohle ba bolo ya maoto ka ho hlokahala ha qhoku ya mehleng ya Bafana Bafana John “Shoes” Moshoeu ya bolokuweng ka Mantaha, 27 Mmesa 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithanda ukuhlanganyela noMongameli Zuma ekudluliseni amazwi enduduzo emndenini, abangane kanye nomkhakha wezebhola likanobhutshuzwayo wonkana ngokudlula emhlabeni kwenkakha yomdlali owayedlalela iBafana Bafana esikhathini esedlule, u-John “Shoes” Moshoeu obekwe endlini yakhe yokugcina ngoMsombuluko mhla zingama-27 Mbasa 2015.

src: O tla dula a hopolwa jwaloka sebapadi sa bolo se neng se na le talente e babatsehang haholo se bapetseng karolo ya bohlokwa tlholong ya rona ya Mohope wa Dinaha tsa Aforika wa 1996.
tgt: Siyohlala simkhumbula njalo njengomdlali webhola likanobhutshuzwayo obenekhono elimangalisayo, owadlala indima ebaluleke kakhulu ngenkathi sinqoba iNdebe Yomqhudelwano Wamazwe ase-Afrika yowe-1996.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le Moporesidente Zuma ka ho fetisa matshediso ho Mmuso le batho ba Rephaboliki ya Demokerasi ya Bofederale ya Nepal, ho latela ho reketla ha lefatshe ho matla ka Moqebelo, 25 Mmesa 2015, ho nkileng maphelo a batho ba dikete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithanda ukuhlanganyela noMongameli Zuma ekudluliseni amazwi enduduzo kuHulumeni kanye nabantu bezwe lase-Nepal, kulandela ukuzamazama komhlaba okwesabekayo okwenzeke ngoMgqibelo, mhla zingama-25 Mbasa 2015, okudlule nemiphefumulo yezinkulungwane zabantu.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa mekgatlo eo e seng ya mmuso ya Aforika Borwa eo e seng e rometse dithuso tsa botho Nepal.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazincoma kakhulu lezo zinhlangano zaseNingizimu Afrika ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni esezithumele usizo lwezenhlakahle kwelase-Nepal.

src: Kabinete e hlahisitse matshediso a tebileng ho lelapa la Moborikadiri Mokgenerale Bita ya hlokahetseng a le dilemo tse 75 ho la Tanzania.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izwakalisa ukudabuka kwayo okukhulu emndenini ka-Brigadier General Bita oshone kwelase-Tanzania eneminyaka engama-75.

src: Moborikadiri Mokgenerale Bita o sebeditse jwaloka Mongodi wa Phethahatso wa Komiti ya Tokoloho ho Mokgatlo wa Kopano ya Aforika (OAU) wa mehleng.
tgt: U-Brigadier General Bita ubesebenza njengoNobhala Omkhulu Wekomidi Lokukhululwa Kwamazwe LeNhlangano Yobumbano Lwamazwe ase-Afrika (i-OAU).

src: E ne e le moamohedi wa Kgau ya Metswalle ya O. Tambo ya Gauta, e leng tlhompho e kgolohadi eo Aforika Borwa e fanang ka yona ho melata.
tgt: Esikhathini esedlule uhlonishwe ngeNdondo yeGolide ye-Order of the Companions of OR Tambo, okuyindondo ephakeme kunazo zonke iNingizimu Afrika eyinikeza abantu bakwamanye amazwe abavelele.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Imicimbi ezayo.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla kenela Sehopotso sa bo70 sa Tlholo e Kgolo ya Ntwa ya Lerato la Naha (Ntwa ya Lefatshe ya II) Red Square ho la Moscow ka la 9 Motsheanong 2015.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uzohambela uMgubho wama-70 Wokunqotshwa Kwempi Yesibili Yomhlaba ozobanjelwa e-Red Square e-Moscow mhla ziyisi-9 Nhlaba 2015.

src: O tla boela a tshware dipuisano tsa dinaha ka bobedi le Moporesidente wa Russia Vladimir Putin.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uzobamba futhi nezingxoxo noMongameli wase-Russia u-Vladimir Putin.

src: Leeto lena le tla ahella hodima dikamano tsa hajwale tsa bobedi bona le Mokgatlo wa Russia bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa ho ya pele tshebedisanommoho dintlheng tse ngatanyana.
tgt: Lolu hambo luzokwakhela phezu kobudlelwano obukhona njengamanje phakathi kwezwe lethu nelase-Russia, ngenhloso yokuqhubekisela phambili ukubambisana emikhakheni ehlukahlukene.

src: Bakeng sa ho keteka Letsatsi la Basebetsi (1 Motsheanong 2015), Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho basebetsi bohle ho kopana le ho aha moruo wa Aforika Borwa, le ho nehela ho kontinente le lefatshe.
tgt: Njengoba kuzogujwa uSuku Lwabasebenzi mhlalu-1 Nhlaba 2015, iKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abasebenzi ukuthi babumbane futhi bakhe umnotho weNingizimu Afrika, futhi bafake isandla kuleli zwekazi kanye nasemhlabeni jikelele.

src: Ho tloha ka 1994 mmuso o ntsheditse pele ditokelo tsa basebetsi e leng se bakileng hore basebetsi ba kgole molemo ho tloha tlhahisong ya basebetsi ba tswelang pele le tshireletso ya melemo ya kahisano.
tgt: Kusukela ngowe-1994 uhulumeni usethuthukise futhi waqhubekisa amalungelo abasebenzi osekwenze ukuthi abasebenzi bahlomule ekusungulweni kwemihlomulo eletha inqubekelaphambili kwezabasebenzi kanye nasekuvikelweni kwamalungelo abo emphakathini.

src: Mafapha a Naha a tla teka dipuo tsa ona tsa ditekanyetso Palamenteng mahareng a la 5 le la 21 Motsheanong 2015 ho hlakisa mesebetsi ya ona e ka sehloohong bakeng sa selemo sa hajwale sa ditjhelete.
tgt: Iminyango kazwelonke izokwethula amavoti ezabelomali zayo ePhalamende kusukela mhla ziyisi-5 kuze kube ngumhla zingama-21 Nhlaba 2015 ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka abantu bakuleli ngemininingwane yezinto ezibekwe eqhulwini ngalo nyaka wezimali.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa oohle ho latela dipuo tsa ditekanyetso mapatlelong a fapafapaneng a boraditaba hore a tle a utlwisise betere ha Matona a hlahisa meralo bakeng sa Lenaneo la Tshebetso la Mmuso (PoA).
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabanxusa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi bawalandele amavoti ezabelomali kwimithombo yabezindaba ehlukahlukene ukuze baqonde kangcono ngenkathi oNgqongqoshe bechaza izinto ezizokwenziwa yiminyango yabo ngaphansi koHlelo Lokusebenza LukaHulumeni (i-PoA).

src: Lefapha la Bohahlaodi mmoho le ba Bohahlaodi ba Aforika Borwa ba tla tshwara INDABA 2015 ho tloha ka la 9 ho isa ho la 11 Motsheanong 2015 Setsing sa Matjhaba sa Dikopano sa Inkosi Albert Luthuli ho la Durban.
tgt: UMnyango Wezokuvakasha kanye neNhlangano Yezokuvakasha yaseNingizimu Afrika bazobamba umcimbi wombukiso we-INDABA 2015 kusukela mhla ziyisi-9 kuze kube ngumhla ziyi-11 Nhlaba 2015 esikhungweni semihlangano Inkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre eThekwini.

src: Ketsahalo ena ya seAforika ke lepatlelo le hlokolosi bakeng sa ho hodisa dihlahiswa tsa rona tsa bohahlaodi mmarakeng wa matjhaba.
tgt: Lo mcimbi wamazwe ase-Afrika uyisigcawu esibaluleke kakhulu sokukhangisa imikhiqizo yethu yezokuvakasha, kumazwe ngamazwe.

src: Hape e tshehetsa pono ya mawala a Lekala la Naha la Mawala a Bohahlaodi bakeng sa ho hodisa palo ya baeti ba matjhaba ba kenang ka hara naha ho ya ho 15 milione ka 2020 mme kahoo ho hlahiswe mesebetsi e 225 000 e metjha.
tgt: Umbukiso usekela futhi nenhloso-mbono esemqoka yeSu Lomkhakha Kazwelonke Wezokuvakasha lokukhulisa isibalo sabavakashi abahambela kuleli sifinyelele kwizigidi eziyi-15 ngowezi-2020 futhi lokhu kuzovula amathuba omsebenzi amasha ayizi-225 000.
