tgt: IKhabhinethi izwile futhi nangezigemegeme ezenzeke ezweni lase-Nigeria lapho khona inkampani yakwa-MTN’s iye yahlawuliswa izigidigidi ezi-5.2 zamadola aseMelika Yikhomishani Yezokuxhumana Yase-Nigeria.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona a tebileng ho lelapa la Nqakula le metswalle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yethemba ukuthi izingxoxo ezikhona neziqhubekayo njengamanje phakathi kuka-MTN kanye nabasemagunyeni ezweni lase-Nigeria kuzoholela ekutheni kusonjululwe ngokuphazima kweso lokhu kungaboni ngaso linye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi inkampani yakwa-MTN iyaqhubeka nomsebenzi wayo wokutshala izimali emnothweni wasezweni laseNigerian.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona a tebileng ho lelapa le ba leloko la Letona la Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba le Tsamaiso Ngoako Ramatlhodi, ka ho hlokahala ha mme wa hae ya dilemo tse 95, Mmatlou Elizabeth Ramatlhodi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ishaqeke kakhulu ngokudlula emhlabeni ngokuzuma okukhulu kukaChumani Nqakula, nobeyindodana kaNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela noMakadebona Bezempi uNosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula kanye no-Charles Nqakula, oyiLungu LePhalamende.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di tla lokelwa ke ho netefatswa ha mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithi dudu emndenini wakwaNqakula kanye nakubangani ngokunjalo.

src: Monghadi Mogojare Richard Seleka jwaloka Motsamaisi e Moholo (DG) ho Lefapha la Dikgwebo tsa Setjhaba le.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yedlulisa ukudabuka okukhulu emndenini kanye nasezihlotsheni zikaNgqongqoshe Wezemisebenzi Kahulumeni Nokuphathwa Kwayo u-Adv Ngoako Ramatlhodi, ngokushiywa emhlabeni ngumama wakhe obeseneminyaka yobudala engama-95, umama uMmatlou Elizabeth Ramatlhodi.

src: Monghadi Robert Moeketsa Ramasodi jwaloka motlatsi wa DG: Tlhahiso ya tsa Temo, Bophelo bo Botle le Polokeho ya Dijo ho Lefapha la Temo, Meru le Ditlhapi.
tgt: AbaqashiweBonke laba abaqashiwe ukuqashwa kwabo kuyoqinisekiswa mhla izicucu zokuqashwa kwabo kanye nokuqinisekiswa kokufaneleka kwabo kulezi zikhala kwavunywa.

src: Boto ya Koporasi ya Taolo ya Sephethephethe sa Mebileng:a) Mofumahadi Daphline Harridene Charlotte-Ann Ewertse – Setho seo e seng sa Phethahatso leb) Monghadi Thulani Matiki Norman Kgomo – Setho seo e seng sa Phethahatso.
tgt: UMnu Mogojare Richard Seleka uqashwe Njengomqondisi-Jikelele (i-DG) eMnyangweni Wezamabhizinisi Kahulumeni noe.

src: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mananeo a bohlokwa a mmuso.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa Kokusebenza Kwezinhlelo Zikahulumeni Ezisemqoka.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Lefapha la Bodulo ba Batho bakeng sa ho fana ka matlo porojekeng ya Bodulo ba Batho e Kopanetsweng ya Savanna City ka hara Masepala wa Setereke wa Sedibeng ho dihlopha tse dikojwana di mahetleng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi incoma uMnyango Wezokuhlaliswa Kwabantu ngokunika abantu izindlu ohlelweni olwaziwa ngokuthi yiSavanna City Integrated Human Settlements project olukuMasipala Wesifunda waseSedibeng kubantu abahluphekile.

src: MaAforika Borwa a itlhommeng pele a ile a ikopanya le bankakrolo ba diindaseteri, ho kenyeletswa le bomeyara le bahlanka ba tswang Masepaleng wa Setereke wa Sedibeng, mabapi le ho penta matlo a phethetsweng mmoho le ho thusa ka ditshingwana nakong ya ho thakgolwa.
tgt: Abantu asebezakhele amagama eNingizimu Afrika baye babambisana nalabo ababambe iqhaza odabeni lokwakhiwa kwezindlu, kuhlanganisa izimeya kanye nezikhulu zikaMasipala Wesifunda iSedibeng, ekupendeni lezi zindlu ebeseziphothuliwe ngesikhathi sokwethulwa kwazo kwaphinde futhi kwethulwa nezingadi ezihambisana nalezi zindlu.

src: Ho ahilwe matlo a ka bang 18 000, a tswetseng molemo maqheku, batho ba qhwadileng, le malapa ao dihlooho tsa ona e leng bana le basadi.
tgt: Cishe yizindlu eziyi-18 000 ezakhiwe, nokuzuze kuzo abantu abadala, abantu abaphila nokukhubazeka, imindeni eyondliwa yizingane kanye naleyo eyondliwa ngabantu besifazane.

src: Kabinete e boetse e amohela tsebiso ya hore selemong se tlang lefapha le tla thakgola porojeke, e tla etsa hore ho ahuwe matlo a 60 000.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinda futhi yemukele ukumenyezelwa kokuthi ngonyaka ozayo lo Mnyango uzokwethula uhlelo, noluzokwenza ukuthi kwakhiwe izindlu eziyizi-60 000.

src: Kabinete e amohela kgatelopele e entsweng ke porojeke ya Tshepo 10 000, e thusang ho fedisa tlhokeho ya mesebetsi bakeng sa batjha ka hara Motsemoholo wa Tshwane.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayemukela inqubekelaphambili eseyenziwe uhlelo olwaziwa ngokuthi yi-Tshepo 10 000, nokuwuhlelo olusiza ukulwa nokungaqashwa kanye nokungaqasheki kwabantu abasha ngaphansi Kwedolobha laseTshwane.

src: Porojeke ena ya dimilione-milione tsa diranta ya Motsemoholo, ka tshebedisanommoho le Yunivesithi ya Pretoria, e lebeletse ho rupella batjha ba 10 000 ba sa sebetseng ka ho ba neha maitsebelo le bokgoni tse batlehang bakeng sa ho etsa dikopo tsa ho fumantshwa diporojeke.
tgt: Le projekthi ezodla izigidi zamarandi esungulwe Yidolobha ngokubambisana neNyuvesi yasePitoli, ifisa ukuqeqesha abantu abasha abangasebenzi ababalelwa kwizi-10 000 ngokuthi ibafundise amakhono kanye nobuchule ababudingayo ukuthi bakwazi ukufaka amathenda ekwenziweni kwamaprojekthi.

src: Kamora ho phethela thupello batjha ba theha le ho tsamaisa dikoporasi tse atlehileng.
tgt: Ngemuva kokuphothulwa kokuqeqeshwa, abantu abasha bayaye bese bezisungulela baphinde baphathe imiphilandawonye eyimpumelelo kakhulu.

src: Ho fihlela mothating ona, dikoporasi tse fetang 190 di se di fanne ka menyetla ya mesebetsi ho batho ba batjha ba bangata.
tgt: sikhuluma kumanje nje, yimiphilandawonye engaphezu kwe-190 esihlinzeke abantu abasha abaningi ngamathuba emisebenzi.

src: Hodima moo, mafapha a motsemoholo a hirile ba bang ba batjha ba rupelletsweng.
tgt: Ngaphezu kwalokho, iminyango engaphansi kukamasipala iyaye bese iqasha abanye babantu abasha abasuke sebethole lokhu kuqeqeshwa.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho ntlafatswa ha tsela ya R25 (P6-1), e leng tsela ya dikilomithara tse 42 e kopanyang Gauteng le Limpopo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela ukulungiswa komgwaqo u-R25 (P6-1), nokungumgwaqo oyibanga elingamakhilomitha angama-42 kanti lo mgwaqo uhlanganisa iGauteng kanye neLimpopo.

src: Porojeke ena, e tsamayang pakeng tsa Bapsfontein le Bronkhorstspruit, e hirile batho ba fetang 200.
tgt: Le projekthi ehamba phakathi kwe-Bapsfontein kanye ne-Bronkhorstspruit, iqashe abantu abangaphezu kwama-200.

src: Hape e tla tswela molemo makala a temo le merafo sebakeng seo ka ho hodisa motsamao o batlang o potlakile wa dilori tse tsamaisang thepa le ditshebeletso.
tgt: Le projekthi izophinda futhi ihlomulise imikhakha yezolimo kanye nowezokumbiwa phansi endaweni ngokukhuthaza ukuhamba ngokushesha kwamaloli athwala impahla naphinda futhi ahlinzeke ngezinsizakalo endaweni.

src: Diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izinqumo ZeKhabhinethi eziqavile.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ke Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji, le tla tshwara beke ya saense ya setjhaba e kgolo: Foramo ya Saense ya Aforika Borwa 2015 tlasa mookotaba: “Re hotetsa moqoqo ka saense” ho tloha ka la 8 ho isa ka la 9 Tshitwe 2015, ho la Pretoria.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iye yabekwa esithombeni nguMnyango Wezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe, njengoba izoba nesonto elikhulu lesayensi lomphakathi nelaziwa ngokuthi: yi-Science Forum South Africa 2015 ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: “Ukuvula ingxoxo mayelana nesayensi” kusukela mhla ziyisi-8 kuya kumhla ziyisi-9 kuZibandlela 2015, ePitoli.

src: Ketsahalo ena e neha bankakarolo ba tswang Aforika Borwa, ka hara kontinente le bomphato ba matjhaba lepatlelo bakeng sa dingangisano le ho ithuta ka maano mabapi le ho tsamaelana pakeng tsa saense le setjhaba.
tgt: Lo mcimbi unikeza labo ababambe iqhaza kwisayensi nezinto ezithinta isayensi, abavela eNingizimu Afrika, ezwenikazi lase-Afrika kanye nalabo abangabantu okubanjiswene nabo emazweni omhlaba ithuba lokuthi kube nenkulumongxoxo kanye nokufunda ngenqubomgomo emayelana nokuxhumana phakathi kwesayensi kanye nomphakathi.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Ketsahalo ya Letsatsi le Tsamaelanang le tsa Mawatle ya Lefatshe ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Mawatle (IMO) e tshwarelwe Aforika Borwa ka 2020.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iye yakuphasisa ukuthi umcimbi we-International Maritime Organisation (IMO) okuyi-World Maritime Day Parallel Event ubanjelwe lapha eNingizimu Afrika ngonyaka wezi-2020.

src: Lefapha la Dipalangwang ha ho le jwalo le tla fetisetsa qeto ena ya Kabinete ho kopano ya Lekgotla ya IMO e reretsweng ho etsahala ho tloha ka la 23 Pudungwana ho isa ka la 04 Tshitwe Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: UMnyango Wezokuthutha uzobe usudlulisela lesi sinqumo seKhabhinethi emhlanganweni woMkhandlu we-IMO nokuhlelwe ukuthi ube ngomhla zingama-23 kuLwezi kuya kumhlaka 04 kuZibandlela Imicimbi Ezayo.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla amohela wa mphato wa hae wa China Xi Jinping bakeng sa Leeto la Semmuso la matsatsi a mabedi ho tloha ka la 2 ho isa ka la 3 Tshitwe.
tgt: UMongameli Jacob Zuma uzokwamukela uzakwabo wase-China u-Xi Jinping njengalokhu ezobe esohambeni lwakhe Lokuvakashela Izwe lwezinsuku ezimbili kusukela mhlaka zi-2 kuya mhla zi-3 kuZibandlela.

src: Sepheo sa leeto ke ho phethela Moralo wa Tshebedisanommoho wa Dilemo tse 5-10 wa China-Aforika Borwa o tla thatiselletsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha ditumellano tsa rona esale ho phethelwa Boitlamo ba Beijing ka 2010.
tgt: Ngalolu hambo kuhloswe ukuthi kuphothulwe uhlelo lokubambisana phakathi kwalawa mazwe omabili olwaziwa ngokuthi yi- China-South Africa 5-10 Year Framework on Cooperation noluzophinda lugxilise kabanzi izivumelwano zethu kusukela selokhu kwenziwa Isivumelwano sase-Beijing ngonyaka wezi-2010.

src: Hape le tla tsebisa le ho hodisa Bosemphato bo Pharaletseng ba Mawa bo arolelwanang ke dinaha ka bobedi.
tgt: Lolu hambo luzophinda futhi luqinise luphinde lwelule Ukubambisana Okuningi Kwamaqhinga Okucebisana lawa mazwe omabili abelana ngakho.

src: Dikamano tsa Aforika Borwa le China e dula e le bohare ba ho fihlella lenaneo la yona la ntshetsopele ka leano la yona la matjhabeng kaha le eketsa mekutu ya ho kenya tshebetsong Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP), tshebedisanommoho ho tsa temo, merero ya tsa tikoloho, kgwebisano le diindaseteri le tsa ditjhelete jwaloka ha naha e tswela pele ho kganna lenaneo la ho ntshetsa Aforika Borwa pele.
tgt: Ubudlelwano beNingizimu Afrika nezwe lase-China yibona obudlala indima enkulu kakhulu ekutheni leli likwazi ukufezekisa uhlelo lwayo lwentuthuko ngomgomo walo wangaphandle ngoba bandisa imizamo yokwenza ukuthi iHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP) isebenze, kubanjiswane kwezolimo, kwezemvelo, kwezohwebo nezimboni kanye nakwezezimali njengalokhu izwe lisaqhubeka nokuqhubela iNingizimu Afrika phambili.

src: Hape le fana ka monyetla wa ho sheba botjha kgatelopele mabakeng a hajwale a kgwebisano le tshebedisanommoho pakeng tsa dinaha ka bobedi, le ho potlakisa le ho phethela dibaka tse ntjha tsa tshebedisanommoho.
tgt: Lobu budlelwano futhi bubuye buhlinzeke ngethuba lokubuyekeza inqubekelaphambili kwiminxa yokuhwebelana evele ikhona kanye nokuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kwalawa mazwe omabili, kubuye futhi kusheshiswe bese kufezekiswa izindawo ezintsha zokubambisana.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla etella pele Kemedi e tla kenela ho dula ha bo-21 ha Khonferense ya Mekga ho Seboka sa Meralo ya Phethoho ya Tlelaemete sa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UNFCCC) le ho dula ha bo-11 ha Khonferense ya Mekga e sebetsang jwaloka Kopano ya Mekga ho Porothokhole ya Kyoto (CMP11) e tla tshwarwa ho tloha ka la 30 Pudungwana ho isa ka la 11 Tshitwe 2015 Paris, ho la Fora.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uzohola ithimba elizobe lilibangise Kwingqungquthela Yamazwe Abambe Iqhaza yehlandla lama-21 ezobe ibanjwe ngaphansi kweNgqungquthela YeNhlangano Yezizwe Yohlaka Lwezokuguquguquka Kwesimo Sezulu (i-UNFCCC) kanye Nengqungquthela Yamazwe Abambe Iqhaza yehlandla le-11 kanti izodlala indima yokuba nguMhlangano Wamazwe asayina Isivumelwano saseKyoto (i-CMP11) nozokuba kusukela mhla zingma-30 kuLwezi kuya mhla ziyi-11 kuZibandlela 2015 eParis, eFrance.

src: Ditherisano tsa matjhaba bakeng sa tumellano e ntjha ya semolao e tla hlophisa karabelo ho phethoho ya tlelaemete, e tla qala ho sebetsa ho tloha ka 2020 ho ya pele.
tgt: Izingxoxo zamazwe ngamazwe zokuthi kube nesivumelwano esisha esisemthethweni ziyoba yiyona mpendulo esimweni sokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu, nesiyoqala kusukela ngonyaka wezi-2020 kuya phambili.

src: Ho imatahantswe le ditabatabelo tsa naha tsa Aforika Borwa jwaloka naha ya Aforika e tswelang pele e tla batla tshehetso ya kamora 2020, Aforika Borwa e tla tswela pele ho tshireletsa dipehelo tsa mantlha tsa UNFCCC tsa tekatekano le phapantsho.
tgt: Ngokuhambisana nalokho iNingizimu Afrika ekufunayo njengezwe lase-Afrika futhi nanjengezwe elisathuthuka neliyodinga ukwesekwa ngemuva kweminyaka yezi-2020, iNingizimu Afrika izoqhubeka nokumela kanye nokulwela imigomo enqala ye-UNFCCC, newukulingana kanye nokwehlukana.

src: Ho Sehlopha sa 77 sa kopano ya China, Aforika Borwa e tla tsitlallela ho boloka le ho matlafatsa bonngwe ba dinaha tse ntseng di tswela pele bakeng sa ho fumana Tumellano ya Paris e hlokang leeme, e nang le maikemisetso, e thehilweng hodima tsa saense le e hlahisang sebaka sa ntshetsopele sa dinaha tse ntseng di tswela pele.
tgt: Emhlanganweni Weqembu lamazwe angama-77 kanye ne-China, iNingizimu Afrika iyofuna ukuqhubeka kanye nokuqinisa ubunye bamazwe athuthukayo ukuze ithole Isivumelwano saseParis esingavuni luhlangothi, esiphokophelele phambili, esigxile kwisayensi nesikhiqiza indawo yokuthuthuka kumazwe asathuthuka.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla thakgola Letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 bakeng sa thibelo ya Dikgoka kgahlanong le Basadi le Bana ka la 25 Pudungwana 2015 Naauwpoort, ho la Mahikeng tlasa mookotaba: “Mpalle le nna: Mmoho re Ntshetsapele Aforika Borwa e hlokang Dikgoka.” Letsholo lena le hopolwa jwaloka karolo ya Matsatsi a 365 a Twantsho, leo e leng letsholo le tswellang le lemosang ka dikgoka kgahlanong le basadi le bana, le ho elellwisa batho hore ba balellwe twantshong ya selemo ho pota.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uzokwethula umkhankaso weziNsuku Eziyi-16 Zokulwisana Nodlame Oluqondiswe Kwabesifazane Nezingane ngomhla zingama-25 kuLwezi 2015 e-Naauwpoort, eMahikeng ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: “Ngibale Nami: Sisonke Siqhubekisela iNingizimu Afrika Engenaludlame Phambili.” Lo mkhankaso ugujwa njengengxenye ye-365 Days of Activism, nokungumkhankaso oqhubekayo ovusa ukuqwasha ngodlame olubhekiswe kubantu besifazane kanye nezingane, futhi uvukuza abantu ukuthi babambe iqhaza ekulweni nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane unyaka wonke.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho tshehetsa letsholo lena le ho sebedisa nako ena bakeng sa ho elellwisa badudi le ho imatahanya le mmuso ho fedisa dikgoka kgahlanong le basadi le bana - #Count me In.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi baweseke lo mkhankaso kanye nokuthi basebenzise lesi sikhathi ukuvukuza imiphakathi futhi ibambisane nohulumeni ukuqeda udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane kanye nabantwana - #Count me In.

src: Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa o tla etella pele kemedi ya mmuso dipuisanong tsa yona tse setlwaeding le Foramo ya Bahlophisi ba Boraditaba ba Naha ya Aforika Borwa ka la 21 Pudungwana 2015 jwaloka boitlamo ba mmuso le lenaneo le tswellang la ho tiisa dikamano le boraditaba.
tgt: USekelamongameli uRamaphosa uzohola ithimba likahulumeni ekuxoxisaneni nalo okujwayelekile nenhlangano yabacosheli bezindaba okuyi-South African National Editors’ Forum mhla zingama-21 kuLwezi 2015 njengengxenye yokuzibophezela kukahulumeni kanye nohlelo oluqhubekayo lokuqinisa ubudlelwano nezikhungo ezisakaza izindaba.

src: Mmuso o tla tsebisa bahlophisi ka dintlha tsa bohlokwa le meralo e motjheng ha ho ntse ho fuwa bahlophisi monyetla wa ho hlahisa dibaka tsa kgahleho le mmuso.
tgt: UHulumeni uzobeka esithombeni abahleli bezindaba ngezindaba ezibalulekile kanye nangezinhlelo zikahulumeni ezizayo kanti futhi abahleli bazonikwa ithuba lokuthi baveze ilaka labo kuhulumeni.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla tshwaya Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS tlasa mookotaba - “Ho isa Molokong o Hlokang HIV: PHAHAMSEBETSTSHIRELETSLETHO – e leng kgoeletso ya ho sebetsa ho setjhaba.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika izogubha Usuku Lomhlaba Wonke Lwengculaza ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi - “Siphokophelele Kwisizukulwane Esingenayo i-HIV: SUKUMYENZVIKELLUTHO – kanti lokhu kuyinhlabamkhosi ethi imiphakathi makube khona ekwenzayo ukulwa nalolu bhubhane.

src: Mookotaba wa selemong sena o tsamaelana le mookotaba wa Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng wa Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS bakeng sa 2011 ho isa ho 2015 e leng: “Ho fihlella ho Letho”.
tgt: Le ngqikithi yakulo nyaka isuselwe kwingqikithi Yenhlangano Yeziwe Yosuku Lomhlaba Wonke Lwengculazi yangeminyaka esukela kwizi-2011 kuya kwizi-2015 ethi: “Ukufinyelela Lapho Kungasekho Muntu Othelelekile”.

src: Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS la 2015 le tla boela le matlafatsa puisano ka sekodi le kgethollo, le ho elelliswa ha badudi ka hore ba arabele le ho hodisa phumantsho ya thibelo, kalafo le tshehetso ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: Usuku Lwengculaza Lomhlaba wonke luzophinda luqinise inkulumompendulwano mayelana nokukhishwa inyumbazane kanye nokucwaswa, futhi luzophinda luvukuze imiphakathi ukuthi ukwazi ukubhekana nokuvikela, ukwelapha kanye nezinsizakalo zokweseka lapho abanaleli gciwane.

src: Ketsahalo e kgolo ya ho hopola Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS e tla tshwarelwa KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Umcimbi omkhulu wokugubha Usuku Lomhlaba Lwengculaza uyobanjelwa KwaZulu-Natali.

src: Sena se tla etsa motheo bakeng sa Aforika Borwa ho tshwara Khonferense ya Matjhaba ya AIDS ya bo- 21 Setsing sa Dikopano sa Matjhaba sa Inkosi Albert Luthuli ho la Durban ho tloha ka la 17 ho isa ka la 22 Phupu 2016.
tgt: Kanti yiwona kanye-ke lo mcimbi ozoba yisendlalelo sengqungquthela yengculaza okuyi-21st International AIDS Conference ezobanjelwa kuleli eNkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre e-Durbankusukela mhla ziyi-17 kuya mhla zingama-22 kuNtulikazi 2016.

src: Aforika Borwa e tswella ho etsa kgatelopele ho ntwa kgahlanong le HIV le AIDS, ebile e se e atolositse lenaneo la naha la kalafo ya HIV, moo batho ba dimilione di le tharo ba tholang kalafo ya meriana ya HIV, e le mohato wa ho fokotsa tshwaetso ya ho tloha ho mme ho ya ho lesea le ho rekota matshwao a ntlafetseng a lefuba.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika iyaqhubeka nokubonisa inqubekelaphambili ekulweni ne-HIV kanye ne-AIDS, ngoba isikwaze ukwelula uhlelo lwayo lokuhlinzeka ngemishanguzo, sikhuluma nje kunabantu abangaphezu kwezigidi ezintathu abadla imishanguzo, kanti isikwaze futhi nokunciphisa ukusuleleka komntwana ngegciwane elithola kumama omzalayo kanti futhi nezibalo zibonisa ukuthi leli lizwe lenza kahle kangcono ekulweni nesifo sofuba.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa ho nka karolo diketsahalong tsa di-Imbizo tse rerilweng ho phatlalla le naha nakong ya Beke ya Imbizo ya Naha ya ho Tsepamisa Maikutlo ho tloha ka la 30 Pudungwana ho isa ka la 6 Tshitwe 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi bahambele Izimbizo ezihlelwe ezweni lonkana ngesonto elaziwa ngokuthi yiNational Imbizo Focus Week kusukela mhla zingama-30 kuLwezi kuya kumhlaka ziyi-6 kuZibandlela 2015.

src: Lepatlelo lena le thusa baahi ho buisana le ditho tsa Phethahatso.
tgt: Le nkundla yenza ukuthi izakhamuzi zikwazi ukufakana imilomo noNgqongqoshe abathile.

src: Beke ya Imbizo ya Naha ya ho Tsepamisa Maikutlo e tla tshwarwa tlasa mookotaba: “Mmoho re ntshetsa Aforika Borwa pele” mme e tla beha badudi sehlohlolong ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong ke mmuso bakeng sa ho hotetsa kgolo ya moruo le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi, jwaloka ha o tekilwe ke Moporesidente Zuma Puong ya hae ka Maemo a Setjhaba ya Tlhakola 2015.
tgt: Isonto i-National Imbizo Focus Week lizokwenzeka ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: “Sisonke siqhubekisela iNingizimu Afrika phambili” futhi lapha kuyokwaziswa imiphakathi ngalokho okwenziwa nguhulumeni oHlelweni Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye ekukhuliseni umnotho kanye nasekwakheni amathuba omsebenzi, njengalokhu kwabekwa nguMongameli Zuma eNkulumweni yakhe Echaza Isimo Sezwe ngoNhlolanja 2015.

src: Ditho tsa Phethahatso di tla boela di sebedise monyetla ona ho kgothaletsa bonkakarolo ba badudi bakeng sa ho sebetsana le mathata a fapafapaneng a setjhaba, ho kenyeletswa dintlha tse tsamaelanang le dikgoka kgahlanong le basadi le bana.
tgt: ONgqongqoshe bazophinda basebenzise leli thuba ukukhuthaza umphakathi ukuthi ubambe iqhaza ekulweni nezinto eziningi ezihlukumeza umphakathi, kuhlanganisa nezinto ezihlobene nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane.

src: Tshitwe ke Kgwedi ya Poelano mme Aforika Borwa e tla tshwaya Letsatsi la Poelano la 16 Tshitwe Port Elizabeth, ho la Kapa Botjhabela tlasa mookotaba: “Re ngotla karohano: Re aha bosetjhaba bo tshwanang ba Aforika Borwa ho isa pusong ya naha e tswelang pele”.
tgt: Inyanga kaZibandlela Yinyanga Yokuxolelana kanti iNingizimu Afrika iyogubha Usuku Lokuxolelana ngomhla ziyi-16 kuLwezi eBhayi, eMpumalanga Kapa ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: “Sivala igebe: Sakha ubuzwe baseNingizimu Afrika obufanayo ukuze sibe yizwe elithuthukayo”.

src: Kgwedi ena e na le bohlokwa bo ikgethang bakeng sa setjhaba kaha e kgothaletsa poelano, kgotso le momahano ya setjhaba e leng motheo wa naha e ntjha ya tsamaiso ya demokerasi.
tgt: Le nyanga ibaluleke kakhulu ngoba ikhuthaza ukuxolelana, ukuthola kanye nokubumbana komphakathi kanti lezi yizinto ezaba yisisekelo sokwakhiwa kwentanto yeningi entsha yaleli lizwe.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa kaofela ho sebedisa kgwedi ena bakeng sa ho atamelana ha naha e ntse e tswella ho sebetsa mmoho bakeng sa ho aha setjhaba se le seng se atlehileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi basebenzise le nyanga ukuthi baxhumane njengesizwe njengalokhu siqhubeka nokusebenzisana ndawonye sakha isizwe esihlangene nesinenqubekelaphambili.

src: Kabinete e hopotsa balefi ba lekgetho ba so kang ba kenya ditokomane tsa bona tsa lekgetho bakeng sa selemo sa 2014/15 sa lekgetho hore letsatsi la ho qetela la ho kenya ditokomane ke la 27 Pudungwana 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuza abakhokhi bentela abangakawahambisi amaphepha abo awubufakazi bokukhokha kwabo intela onyaka wentela wezi-2014/15 ukuthi usuku olungumnqamulajuqu umhla zingama-27 kuLwezi 2015.

src: Kabinete e leboha balefi kaofela ba lekgetho bakeng sa ho imatahanya le mmuso mabapi le ho fana ka ditshebeletso tse hlokahalang ka matla tse thusang ho ntlafatsa bophelo ba diketekete tsa badudi ho phatlalla le naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonga bonke abakhokhibentela ngokubambisana nohulumeni ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingeka kakhulu kangaka ezisiza ukwenza ngcono izimpilo zezinkulungwane zemiphakathi ezweni lonkana.

src: Kabinete thoholetsa Setsha sa Mehala sa Bolaodi ba Dikgoka tse Amanang le Bong sa Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba (GBVCC) ka ho hapa Kgau ya Lefatshe ya Setsha sa Mehala se Hlwahlwa ka ho Fetisisa Las Vegas, ho la Amerika, ka Labone, la 5 Pudungwana 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela isikhungo soMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi okuyi-Gender-Based Violence Command Centre (GBVCC) ngokuhlabana kwaso ngomklomelo i-Global Best Contact Centre Award e-Las Vegas, eMelika, ngoLwesine, mhla zi-5 kuLwezi 2015.

src: GBVCC ke setsi sa mehala se sebetsang bosiu le motshehare se reretsweng ho fana ka tshehetso le boeletsi ho diphofu tsa dikgoka tse amanang le bong.
tgt: I-GBVCC isikhungo samahora angama-24 esizinikele ekuhlinzekeni ngokweseka kanye nokweluleka izisulu zodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane.

src: Sena ke e nngwe ya pale ya katleho e bontshang mmuso o kgathallang o ikemiseditseng ntweng ya ho kgina dikgoka tse amanang le Bong.
tgt: Lena enye indaba eyimpumelelo ebonisa uhulumeni onakekelayo omile ekulweni nokuqeda udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Eskom bakeng sa ho sebetsa ka matsatsi a 100 ntle le ho kgaola phepelo ya motlakase.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela u-Eskom ngokusebenza izinsuku eziyi-100 ngaphandle kokunqamula ugesi ngisho nakanye (ukunqamula ugesi ngenhloso yokuwaba ngononina).

src: Eskom e fihletse mokolokotwane ona ka Labobedi, la 17 Pudungwana 2015.
tgt: U-Eskom ufinyelele kuleli qophelo ngoLwesibili, mhla ziyi-17 Lwezi 2015.

src: Matsatsi a 100 a phepelo ya motlakase e sa sitisehang ha ho bolele hore re ka qhanolla.
tgt: Lezi zinsuku eziyi-100 zokuhlinzeka ngogesi okungaphazanyisiwe akusho nokho ukuthi sekufanele ukuthi sihambele phezulu.

src: Empa, Kabinete e ipiletsa ho badudi ho tswella ho lekola boishunyako ba ho baballa eneji.
tgt: Kodwa okunalokho iKhabhinethi imema yonke imiphakathi ukuthi iqhubeke nokusebenzisa izindlela zokonga ugesi.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa bakgethwa ba Dikgau tsa Dipapadi tsa Aforika Borwa tsa 2015 tse tla tshwarwa ka la 22 Pudungwana 2015 Theatereng ya Sand du Plessis Mangaung, ho la Foreisetata.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela labo abaqokelwe Izindondo Zemidlalo Zowezi--2015 nezizobanjwa ngomhla zingama-22 kuLwezi 2015 eSand du Plessis Theatre eMangaung, eFreyistata.

src: Dikgau tsena, tse hlophisitsweng tlasa mookotaba: “Boqhetseke ha se ho ba hlwahlwa ho fetisisa ke ho etsa ho fetisisang”, di keteka dilemo tse 10 tsa ho ananela le ho hlompha batho ba sebeditseng ka bokgabane ka hare le ka ntle ho mabala a dipapadi.
tgt: Le miklomelo, izobanjwa ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: “Ukuhamba phambili akusikhona nje ukuthi yingoba uhambe phambili kodwa kuwukwenza lokho okukwenza ukuba uhambe phambili”, kanti izobe igubha iminyaka eli-10 selokhu yasungulwa ukubona kanye nokuhlonipha labo bantu kanye namathimu abenze kahle ngaphakathi ensimini yokudlala kanye nangaphandle.

src: MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho tshehetsa ketshalo ena ka ho kgetha Naledi ya Selemo ya Dipapadi ya Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa Bohlokwa Maemong a Hajwale.
tgt: Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakhuthazwa ukuthi baweseke lo mcimbi ngokuthi bavotele uMdlali Ovelele Wonyaka wezi-20.

src: Kabinete e imatahantse le Moporesidente Zuma le badudi ba matjhabeng ka ho tshwela ka mathe ka matla ditlhaselo tsa boferekanyi tsa moraorao tjena tse etsahetseng Beirut (Lebanon), Baghdad (Iraq), Yola (Nigeria) le Paris (Fora), tse bakileng tahlehelo ya bophelo ba batho ba se nang molato le tshenyo ya thepa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iye yahlanganyela noMongameli Zuma kanye nomphakathi wamazwe omhlaba ekugxekeni kakhulu ukuhlasela kwabashokobezi okwenzeke e-Beirut (e-Lebanon), e-Baghdad (e-Iraq), eYola (e-Nigeria) kanye nase-Paris (e-France), nokuholele ekutheni kushone abantu abaningi abangenacala kwacekelwa phansi nempahla.

src: Aforika Borwa e ema e tiile ho tshweleng ka mathe ha yona ha ditlhaselo kaofela tse tobileng badudi ba se nang molato mme e boeletsa mmono wa yona wa hore boferekanyi, ka sebopeho sefe kapa sefe le hore bo tswa hokae, bo keke ba amohelwa.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika imile ayiguquki ekugxekeni zonke izinhlobo zokuhlasela okuqondiswe kubantu phaqa abangenacala futhi iyaphinda iyakuveza ukuthi yona imelele nezenzo zobushokobezi, ngisho noma ngabe zingezaluphi uhlobo futhi zivela kunoma iyiphi indawo, angeke nanini zabekezeleleka.

src: Kabinete e tshehetsa diketso tsa Komiti ya Matona a Mmuso e mabapi le Kgaello ya Metsi le Komello bakeng sa ho bebofatsa kgahlamelo ya komello le ho kgothaletsa badudi ho sebedisa metsi ka polokeho bakeng sa ho tiisetsa phepelo ya kamoso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayeseka imisebenzi eseyenziwe Yikomidi LoNgqongqoshe BakaHulumeni(i-IMC) Kwinkinga Yokushoda Kwamanzi kanye Nesomiso ukulwa nokuthi imithelela yesomiso ingezweli kakhulu kanti futhi ifisa ukukhuthaza imiphakathi ukuthi isebenzise amanzi ngokuwonga ukuze kuhlale kunamanzi nangomuso.

src: Mmuso o ekeditse ka R96,6 milione ho R352,6 milione ya sethathong ho tshehetsa mekutu ya naha ya ho imolla mathata a komello.
tgt: UHulumeni usengeze ngesamba semali esiyizigidi ezingama-96,6 kuleyo yokuqala ayeyikhiphile okwakuyizigidi ezingama-352,6 nebekwe eceleni ukuthi kwesekelwe imizamo yezwe yokulwa nesomiso ezindaweni ezithintekile.

src: Sena se kenyeletsa ho rekwa ha ditanka tsa metsi tse 45 bakeng sa ho fuwa dibaka tse amehileng, ho epa dipetse le tlhabollo, papallo ya metsi le ho laola tlhokeho, le ho thusa ka mehlodi.
tgt: Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuthengwa kwezimoto ezithwala amanzi ezingama-45 ukuze zisabalalise amanzi ezindaweni ezithintekayo, kumbiwe nemigodi ezokhipha amanzi kuphindwe kulungiswe lezo zindawo ebese zingasasebenzi kahle, kongiwe amanzi futhi aphathwe nangendlela kubuye futhi kuthathisiselwe amanzi emithonjeni eyizizinda zalapho kuvela khona amanzi.

src: Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Mahae le Tlhabollo ya Mobu le tla dumella hore ho falliswe mehlape ho tloha dibakeng tse thefulehileng ka ho fetisisa ho iswa mobung oo e leng wa mmuso moo ho ntseng ho na le makgulo a betere.
tgt: UMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya Nezinguquko Kwezomhlaba, kuzothi kulezo zindawo ezishayeke kakhulu, ukuvumele ukuthi imfuyo ithuthwe iyokhothiswa kwezinye izindawo ezingumhlaba kahulumeni lapho kuzobe kusekhonyana ukudla kwezinkomo.

src: Hodima moo, Lefapha la Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Botjhaba le hokahane le Bomeyara bakeng sa ho kenya tshebetsong ditsela tse fapafapaneng tsa ho baballa metsi tlasa tataiso ya Lefapha la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere.
tgt: Ngaphezu kwalokho, uMnyango Wokwengamela Ngokubambisana Nezendabuko usubambisane neziMeya ukuzama ukuza nezindlela ezahlukene zokonga amanzi ngaphansi kolawulo loMnyango Wezamanzi Nenhlanzeko.

src: Tsena di kenyeletsa ho hlahisa dithibelo tsa tshebediso ya metsi ho disa boimatahanyo le dithibelo tsa tshebediso ya metsi ho fana ka dikotlo moo ho hlokahalang ho beha ka sehloohong tokiso ya ho dutla ha metsi ho kgothaletsa dithekenoloji tse hlwahlwa tse jwaloka matlwana a sa sebediseng metsi a mangata ha a hulelwa ho bokella metsi a pula le ho sebedisa metsi a sebeditseng bakeng sa ho nosetsa.
tgt: Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwethula imigomo enqala yokusetshenziswa kwamanzi, ukubheka ukuthi ngabe iyalandelwa yini imigomo yokusetshenziswa kwamanzi ukuthi kuhlawuliswe labo abenzi ngendlela efanele lapho kufanele khona ukubeka phambili ukuvala lezo zindawo zamanzi ezivuzayo ukukhuthaza izinto zobuchwepheshe ezihambisana nokongiwa kwamanzi ezifana namathoyilethi ashaywa ngamanzi amancane ukongiwa kwamanzi emvula kanye nokusetshenziswa kwamanzi asesebenze kwenye indawo lapho kwenziwa izinto ezifana nokunisela.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o ile a etella pele kemedi ya Aforika Borwa ho Seboka sa Baetapele ba G20 Antalya, ho la Turkey ho tloha ka la 15 ho isa ka la 16 Pudungwana 2015.
tgt: UMongameli Jacob Zuma uye wahola ithimba eliqhamuka eNingizimu Afrika ebeliya kwiNgqungquthela Yabaholi be-G20 ebibanjelwe e-Antalya, ezweni lase-Turkey kusukela mhla ziyi-15 kuya kumhla ziyi-16 Lwezi 2015.

src: Mookotaba wa seboka e ne e le kenyeletso, matsete le ho kenngwa tshebetsong.
tgt: Ingqikithi yale ngqungquthela yabaholi bamazwe yathi ukufaka wonke umuntu, ukutshala izimali kanye nokwenza.

src: Aforika Borwa e hara dinaha tse 51 tse saenneng Tumello ya Phapanyetsano ya Tlhahisoleseding ya Lekgetho Berlin, ho la Jeremane ka Mphalane 2015.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika iphakathi kwamazwe angama-51 awasayina isivumelwano esaziwa ngokuthi i-Agreement on Automatic Exchange to Tax Information e-Berlin, e-Germany ngoMfumfu 2015.

src: Dinaha di tla qala ho fapanyetsana tlhahisoleseding ka 2017, e tla hlakiswa ke molao oo hajwale o tekilweng ka hara Palamente.
tgt: La wamazwe azoqala abelane ngolwazi kusukela ngonyaka wezi-2017, kanti lokho kuyokwenziwa ngaphansi komthetho okumanje usezithebeni zePhalamende.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o amohetse qeto ya dintlha tsa tshebetso tse15 tsa G20/Mokgatlo bakeng sa porojeke ya Tshebedisanommoho le Kgoholeho ya Motheo wa Ntshetsopele le ho Suthiswa ha Phaello, tseo di neng di le hlokolosi bakeng sa ho netefatsa ho hloka leeme le ho tiisetsa motheo wa lekeno wa dinaha tse ka Borwa ho Sahara.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma ukwamukele ukuphothulwa kwezinto ezizokwenziwa eziyi-15 ngaphansi kohlelo lwe-G20/Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development Base Erosion and Profit Shifting project, nobekuyizinto ebezibaluke kakhulu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke into ihamba ngendlela efanele kanye nokuzinziza indawo yokwenza imali ekwi-sub-Saharan Africa.

src: Ditho tsa Lekgotla la Matona a Kopano ya Makgetho a Madiboho a Aforika e Borwa (SACU) di kopane ka la 11 Pudungwana 2015 Windhoek, ho la Namibia letsatsing le eteletseng pele ho bulwa ha ntlokgolo ya SACU le dipuisano tseo e seng tsa semmuso tsa Dihlooho tsa Dipuso tsa SACU le Mmuso.
tgt: Amalungu e-Southern African Customs Union (SACU) uMkhandlu WoNgqongqoshe aye ahlangana ngomhla ziyi-11 Lwezi 2015 eWindhoek, eNamibia ngaphambi kokwethulwa kwamahhovisi amakhulu e-SACU kanye nangaphambi kokuba nesithangami sokucobelelana ngolwazi noMongameli bamazwe e-SACU kanye noHulumeni.

src: Lekgotla le sebedisitse monyetla ona bakeng sa ho thuisa kgatelopele e entsweng mabapi le Moralo wa Dintlha tse Tsheletseng esale ho tshwere kopano ya ho qetela le ho toboketsa botjha boitlamo ba bona ho SACLekgotla le dumellane hore SACU e tshwanela ho sebetsa ho fihlella ka nqane ho karolelano ya lekeno ho ya boikitlaetsong ba ntshetsopele bo tla tshehetsa kopanelo ka hara lebatowa.
tgt: Lo Mkhandlu wasebenzisa leli thuba ukubheka inqubekelaphambili eseyenziwe Ohlelweni Olunamaphuzu Ayisithupha kusukela emhlanganweni wawo wokugcina, waphinda futhi wagcizelela ukuzibophezela kwawo kwi-SACUMkhandlu wavuma ukuthi i-SACU le kumele yenze okungaphezulu kokwabelana ngemali eyenziwe nje kuphela kodwa kumele iqhamuke ngisho nanezinhlelo ezizokweseka ukuhlangana esifundeni.

src: Ditho hape di amohetse mmapa le moralo wa dtshebetso o tla lebisa ho seboka se tla tshwarwa ka Phuptjane 2016.
tgt: Amalungu aphinda futhi emukela ibalazwe kanye namapulani okusebenzela ingqungquthela yabaphathi bamazwe ezobanjwa ngoNhlangulana 2016.

src: Kabinete e amohela Diphetho tsa Tlhatlhobo tsa 2014-15 tsa mmuso wa naha le wa porofense.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayemukela Imiphumela Yokucwaningwa Kwamabhuku yezi-2014-15 kuhulumeni kazwelonke kanye nakohlumeni bezifundazwe.

src: Tlaleho e bontsha ntlafalo e tsitsitseng mabakeng kaofela a diphetho tsa ditlhatlhobo tsa mmuso wa naha le wa porofense.
tgt: Umbiko ubonisa ukuthi kukhona ukwenza ngcono kuyona yonke imikhakha yokucwaningwa kwamabhuku kuhulumeni kazwelonke nohulumeni wesifundazwe.

src: Di bontsha ho lebisa mokgweng o motle wa bolaodi le taolo e imametseng ya ditjhelete le ho matlafatsa bolaodi bo botle ka ha mafapha a mangatanyana a fumane ditlhatlhobo tse hlwahlwa.
tgt: Imiphumela ibonisa ukuthi khona kukhona okuncane okuzanywayo ngasekuphatheni kahle izinto ngendlela kanye nasekuphatheni izimali ngendlela futhi kwenza ukuthi kunokuphathwa ngendlela manje kweminyango kahulumeni, kanti lokhu kubonakale ngokuthi iminyango eminingi kahlumeni ithole imibiko yokucwaningwa kwamabhuku engenawo amachashaza.

src: Ntlafalo ena e boela e supa hore mmuso o sebetsa ka thata bakeng sa ho netefatsa boikarabelo dibakeng tsa ona tsohle tsa mosebetsi wa ona.
tgt: Lokhu kwenza kangcono kubuye kubonise ukuthi uhulumeni usebenza kanzima ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abasebenzisa izimali zikahulumeni bayaphendula kuyona yonke imisebenzi abayenzayo.

src: Ntle le ntlafalo ena, mmuso o entse qeto ya ho tswella ho tshehetsa mafapha a nang le diphuputso tse sa kgahliseng le ho netefatsa hore mafapha oohle a mmuso a sebetsa ho ya ka tebello.
tgt: Nakuba kukhona lokhu kwenza kangcono ngale ndlela, uhulumeni uthathe isinqumo sokuthi uzoqhubeka weseke leyo minyango ethole imibiko engemihle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhulumeni wonkana usebenza ngendlela engcono kakhulu.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thonngwa ha Moahlodi Mandisa Muriel Maya jwaloka Motlatsi wa Moporesidente wa Lekgotla le Phahameng la Maipiletso ke Moporesidente Zuma ho ya ka karolo 174(4) ya Molaotheo wa Riphaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa the 1996 le Moahlodi Nonkosi Zoliswa Mhlantla jwaloka moahlodi wa Lekgotla la Dinyewe la Molaotheo ho ya ka Karolo 174(3) ya Molaotheo wa Rephaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996 ka tatelano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela ukuqokwa nguMongameli Zuma kukaJaji uMandisa Muriel Maya njengeSekelamongameli leNkantolo Enkulu Yokwedluliswa Kwamacala ngokwemigomo yesigaba se-174(4) soMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika wangonyaka we-1996 kanye nokuqokwa Kwejaji uNonkosi Zoliswa Mhlantla njengojaji eNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo ngokwemibandela yesigaba se-174(3) soMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika we-1996.Lokhu kuqokwa kwalaba kuqinisa ukuzibophezela kweNingizimu Afrika ukuthi kube nobulingana kobulili ezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu futhi kuqhubela phambili ukushintshwa kanye nokuguqulwa kwamajaji.

src: Dithonyo tsena di matlafatsa boitlamo ba Aforika Borwa ba tekatekano ya bong maemong a phahameng ka ho fetisisa le ho akofisa phethoho ya makgotla a dinyewe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabahalalisela bobabili abehluleli futhi ibafisela okuhle kodwa ekusebenzeni kwabo ekwenzeni lomsebenzi obucayi kangaka esigqikini samajaji eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa baahlodi ka bobedi le ho ba lakaletsa tse molemo mabapi le ho phethahatsa boikarabelo bona bo hlokolosi ka hara Makgotla a Dinyewe a Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ifisa ukuhalalisela uDkt S’thembile Ngidi oqophe umlando ngenkathi ethweswa imiyezane eCollege of Medicine South Africa njengodokotela wokuqala ongumuntu wesifazane ukuba ngudokotela ofunde wagogoda ekuhlonzeni kanye nasekudanjisweni komdlavuza KwaZulu-Natali kanti ungowesibili kuphela kuleli lizwe.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Ngaka S’thembile Ngidi ya entseng nalane ka ho fumana mangolo a thuto ho tswa ho Koletjhe ya tsa Kalafo ya Aforika Borwa jwaloka ngaka ya pele e alafang mofetshe ya mosadi ho tswa KwaZulu-Natal ebile e le wa bobedi feela ka hara naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imncoma kakhulu umenzi wamafilimu waseNingizimu Afrika uReina-Marie Loader owenze umbhalo osabhayisikobho onesihloko esithi ‘Horn’ nothole ukunconywa okuningi kakhulu, nowaze waqokelwa ngisho nemiklomelo ama-Rhino Conservation Awards anonyaka wezi-2015 ngoNtulikazi ngaphansi komkhakha othi: Best Awareness, Education and Funding, wase uphumelela kwindondo eyaziwa ngokuthi i-Best Conservation Film kwi-International Film Festival eNew York City, e-USA eyabanjwe khona ngonyaka wezi-2015.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Moetsi wa difilimi wa Aforika Borwa Reina-Marie Loader eo tlhakisetso ya hae ‘Horn’ e fumaneng dithoholetso, ho kenyeletsa ho kgethwa bakeng sa Dikgau tsa Paballo ya Ditshukudu tsa 2015 ka Phupu mokgahlelong wa kgau ya Temoso, Thuto le Merero ya Ditjhelete e Hlwahlwa ka ho Fetisisa, le ho hapa kgau bakeng sa Filimi e Hlwahlwa ka ho Fetisisa ya Paballo ya Tlhaho ho Mokete wa Difilimi tsa Matjhaba wa 2015 New York City, ho la Amerika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithi dudu emndenini kanye nakubangani beSekelangqongqoshe loMnyango Wezamanzi Nenhlanzeko, uNks Pamela Tshwete, ngokushiywa emhlabeni ngumama wakhe, uMama uRuth Nomzi Zondeki.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ho lelapa le metswalle ya Motlatsi wa Letona la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere, Ms Pamela Tshwete, ka ho lahlehelwa ke mme wa hae, Mama Ruth Nomzi Zondeki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yedlulisa amazwi enduduzo kuhulumeni wasezweni lase-New Zealand, emndenini, kubangani kanye nakwinhlangano yebhola lombhoxo iNew Zealand Rugby Union ngokudlula emhlabeni kwesihlabani sebhola lombhoxo, uJonah Tali Lomu, obaziwa kakhulu ngegalelo lakhe emdlaweni wezombhoxo.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ho mmuso wa New Zealand, lelapa, metswalle le Mokgatlo wa Rakbi wa New Zealand ka ho lahlehelwa ke kgalala ya rakbi, Jonah Tali Lomu, ya entseng kgahlamelo e matla papading ena.
tgt: AbaqashiweBonke laba abaqashiwe ukuqashwa kwabo kuyoqinisekiswa mhla izicucu zokuqashwa kwabo kanye nokuqinisekiswa kokufaneleka kwabo kulezi zikhala kwavunywa.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di tla lokelwa ke ho netefatswa ha mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.

tgt: Ukwelulwa Kwesivumelwano Sokusebenza izinyanga eziyishumi nambili sikaNks Nonkululeko Sindane – u-DG: uMnyango Wezobulungiswa kanye Nokuthuthukiswa Komthethosisekelo.

src: Katoloso ya Konteraka bakeng sa dikgwedi tse leshome le metso e mmedi ya Mofumahadi Nonkululeko Sindane – DG: Lefapha la Toka le Ntshetsopele ya Molaotheo.
