src: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mananeo a bohlokwa a mmuso.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni ezisemqoka.

src: Kabinete e amohetswe ho saenwa ha ditumellano tse 26 tsa boleng ba R94 bilione nakong ya Leeto la Puso la haufinyane tjena la Moporesidente wa China Xi Jinping.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukele ngezandla ezimhlophe ukusayindwa kwezivumelwano ezingama-26, ngenkathi uMongameli wase-China u-Xi Jinping ehambele kuleli esikhathini esifushane esedlule, ezibalelwa kwizigidigidi zamarandi ezingama-94.

src: Ditumellano tse saennweng di kenyeleditse R12 bilione bakeng sa ho aha polante ya tlhahiso ya makoloi ka hara Aforika Borwa, thuso ya kadimo ya US$500 milione ho Eskom bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya meralo wa motheo le tiisetso ya thuso ya ditjhelete ya US$2.5 bilione bakeng sa Transnet ho tswa ho Banka ya Ntshetsopele ya China.
tgt: Lezi zivumelwano zibandakanya nesamba semali engamarandi ayizigidigidi eziyi-12 yokusungula isikhungo sokwakha izimoto eNingizimu Afrika, nemali ebolekwe abakwa-Eskom engamaDola aseMelika ayizigidi ezingama-500 yokuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda kanye nesibambiso samaDola aseMelika ayizigidigidi ezimbili nesigamu esinikezwe abakwa-Transnet, esikhishwe yiBhange Lentuthuko lase-China.

src: Jwaloka karolo ya Foramo ya bo-2 e mabapi le Tshebedisano-mmoho ya China-Aforika (FOCAC), Moporesidente Xi Jinping o entse boitlamo ba US$60 bilione bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya Aforika.
tgt: Njengengxenye yeNgqungquthela Yesibili Yobambiswano Phakathi Kwamazwe ase-Afrika ne-China (i-FOCAC), uMongameli Xi Jinping wathembisa ukuthi izwe lakhe lizohlinzeka ngemali engamaDola aseMelika (i-US$) ayizigidigidi ezingama-60 yentuthuko e-Afrika.

src: Kamohelo ya Tumellano le Moralo wa Tshebetso wa (2016-2018) ho FOCAC o matlafatsa bosemphato bo ntseng bo hola ba kutlwano pakeng tsa Aforika le China, bo tla bula menyetla e metjha ya kgwebisano le matsete bakeng sa ho rotetsa kgolo ya moruo.
tgt: Ukwamukelwa kweSimemezelo esisha kanye noHlelo Lokusebenza (lowezi-2016-2018) kwingqungquthela ye-FOCAC kuqinisa ubambiswano oludlondlobalayo phakathi kwe-Afrika ne-China, oluzovula amathuba amasha okuhwebelana nokutshalwa kwezimali ukuze kukhuthazwe ukukhula komnotho.

src: Moruo o boetse o fumane matlafatso ya moruo ka tsebiso ya Mokgatlo wa BMW wa Aforika Borwa ya matsete a R6 bilione polanteng ya ona e Rosslyn, ho la Pretoria, e leng bopaki ba semphato sa bohlokwa se teng pakeng tsa dikgwebo le mmuso, le karolo e bapalwang ke dikgwebo ntshetsopeleng ya moruo.
tgt: Umnotho uthole futhi inkuthazo ngesimemezelo seNkampani yakwa-BMW yaseNingizimu Afrika sokutshalwa kwemali engamarandi ayizigidigidi eziyisithupha ophikweni lwayo oluse-Rosslyn, ePitoli, okuwubufakazi bobambiswano olusemqoka olukhona phakathi kwabamabhizinisi nohulumeni, kanye nendima edlalwa ngabamabhizinisi ekuthuthukisweni komnotho.

src: Ka Labobedi la, 8 Tshitwe, Moporesidente Zuma o abile Ditlotlo tsa Naha ho baahi ba Aforika Borwa le melata e hlahelletseng ka mahetla ba nyehetseng bakeng sa matlafatso ya batho.
tgt: NgoLwesibili mhla ziyisi-8 kuZibandlela, uMongameli Zuma uzohlonipha ngeziNdondo Zezwe abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nabakwamanye amazwe abavelele abafake isandla esikhulukazi ekuthuthukisweni kwabantu.

src: Ditlotlo tsa Naha ke motsotso wa ho sheba morao ho matla, ho keteka le ho ba motlotlo ka batho ba rona.
tgt: Umcimbi wokunikezwa kweziNdondo Zezwe uhlinzeka ngethuba lokubheka emuva kanye nokubungaza umsebenzi omuhle futhi uletha ukuziqhenya okukhulu kubantu bakuleli.

src: Di keteka phihlello ya botho, ho intsha sehlabelo ha botho le maiteko a botho tse etsang hore naha ya rona e be tulo e betere.
tgt: Lezi zindondo zibungaza insebenzo enhle, ukuzinikela kanye nendima enkulu edlalwe ngabantu abathile ngenhloso yokwenza izwe lethu libe yizwe elingcono kakhulu.

src: Re hlompha baamohedi ba Ditlotlo tsa Naha ba 2015.
tgt: Sibathulela isigqoko bonke labo abaklonyeliswe ngeziNdondo Zezwe zowezi-2015.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho sebedisa metsi ka paballo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabanxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi amanzi bawasebenzise ngokuwonga.

src: Sena ke bakeng sa ho tshehetsa mekgwa e nkuweng bakeng sa ho fedisa dikgaello tsa metsi, tse mpefaditsweng ke leqhubu la motjheso le fihlelletsweng ke naha dibekeng tse fetileng.
tgt: Lokhu kuzolekelela emizamweni ehlukahlukene esiqalisiwe yokunciphisa ukuntuleka kwamanzi, okubhebhethekiswe nayisivuvu sokushisa ebesikhona kulama viki edlule.

src: Ha dipula tsa moraorao tjena dikarolong tse ding tsa naha di fane ka kimoloho e itseng, kgaello ya metsi ya naha e dula e le phephetso mme e batla hore bohle re sebedise metsi ka paballo le ka boikarabelo.
tgt: Nakuba izimvula ezitholakele esikhathini esifushane esedlule ezingxenyeni ezithile zaleli lizwe ziyidambisile kancane inkinga yokuntuleka kwamanzi, ukushoda kwamanzi kuseyinselelo enkulu futhi kudinga ukuthi sonke siqinisekise ukuthi amanzi siwasebenzisa ngokuwonga.

src: Kabinete e hlahisitse kananelo ya yona ho maAforika Borwa kaofela bakeng sa ho nka karolo ho letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 la Thibelo ya Merusu Kgahlanong le Basadi le Bana la selemong sena, le neng le fela ka la 10 Tshitwe 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izwakalise amazwi okubonga kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ababambe iqhaza emkhankasweni walo nyaka weziNsuku eziyi-16 Wokulwisana Nodlame Olubhekiswe Kwabesifazane Nezingane, ophothulwe izolo.

src: Diphuphutso tsa moraorao di bontsha dipalo tse phahameng tsa ditshwaetso tse ntjha tsa HIV, haholoholo ka hara basadi ba batjha le banana ka hara Aforika ba mahareng a dilemo tse 15 le tse 24.MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho tswela pele ka tshebetso ya twantsho ena letsatsi ka leng jwaloka karolo ya ho ba le kgahlanong le Merusu ho Basadi le Bana ya #365 Days Campaign le ya #CountMeIn le tla tswela pele ho phatlalla le selemo se tlang.
tgt: Ucwaningo lwakamuva lukhombisa ukuthi siphezulu isibalo sabantu abasuleleka ngegciwane lesandulela ngculazi (i-HIV) kwizwekazi lase-Afrika, ikakhulukazi abesifazane abasebasha kanye namantombazane aneminyaka yobudala ephakathi kweyi-15 kanye nengama-24.Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakhuthazwa ukuthi baqhubeke nokulwisana nsukuzonke nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane, njengengxenye yomkhankaso we-#365 Days Campaign Wokulwisana Nodlame Olubhekiswe Kwabesifazane Nezingane kanye nomkhankaso we-#CountMeIn, okuyimikhankaso ezoqhubeka kuze kuphele unyaka ozayo.

src: Ka ho sebedisa #365 Days Campaign le #CountMeIn, naha e hloka ho tswela pele ho ngoka ditho tsa setjhaba, haholoholo banna, hore ba kopanye matsoho le mmuso bakeng sa ho sebetsana le koduwa WEBTOKEN boikarabelo ba setjhaba, bobedi ka bonngwe le ka kopanelo, ho kgina ho ata ha kokwanahloko ka ho ela hloko bophelo ba rona bo botle le ba ba bang.
tgt: Ngokusebenzisa umkhankaso we#365 Days Campaign kanye nowe-#CountMeIn, leli lizwe kudingeka ukuthi liqhubeke nokugqugquzela amalungu omphakathi, ikakhulukazi amadoda, ukuthi asebenzisane nohulumeni ekulwisaneni nalesi sihlava.

src: Kabinete e ananetse kgatelopele e seng e entswe ke Lekgotla la Diphuputso tsa Saense le Indaseteri bakeng sa ho ntshetsapele tsamaiso ya tlhahiso ya tsa tlhaho ya masole a lwantshang HIV.
tgt: Kungumthwalo osemahlombe esizwe sonke, nomuntu ngamunye, ukunqanda ukusabalala kwe-HIV ngokuthi sinakekele izimpilo zethu kanye nezabanye abantu.

src: Sena se tlisa indaseteri ya kalafo haufi le pheko ya thibelo e sa bitsing tjhelete e ngata.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izwakalise ukuyithokozela inqubekelaphambili eyenziwe wuMkhandlu Wocwaningo Lwezesayensi Nezimboni (i-CSIR) ekuthuthukisweni kwenqubo yokuthola ikhambi lokuvimbela i-HIV.

src: Ha naha e ntse e sokola ho fumana pheko ya HIV le AIDS, maAforika Borwa a ntse a lebeletswe ho etsa thobalano e bolokehileng le ho tsitlallela dipehelo tsa ABC (Abstain, Be faithful and Condomise) bakeng sa ho thibela ditshwaetso tse ntjha.
tgt: Lokhu sekubeke imboni yezempilo esimweni sokuthi khona maduze nje ikwazi ukuqhamuka nekhambi lokuvimbela isandulela ngculazi elingambi eqolo futhi elizoba nomthelela omuhle kwezomnotho.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa kaofela baithuti, barutwana, matitjhere, barupelli, le dikolo le ditheo tsa thuto e phahameng ka ho phethela selemo se atlehileng sa dithuto, ho sa natswe diphephetso tse fihlelletsweng hara selemo.
tgt: Njengoba kusenzima kuleli lizwe ukuthola ikhambi lokwelapha ingculazi, abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kumele bazivikele uma beya ocansini futhi balandele umgomo we-ABC (okusho Ukuzithiba, Ukwethembeka kanye Nokusebenzisa Ikhondomu) ngenhloso yokuvimbela ukusuleleka ngegciwane lesandulela ngculazi.6 IKhabinethi ibashayela ihlombe bonke abafundi, izitshudeni, othisha, izikole kanye nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme ngokuphothula unyaka wemfundo obe yimpumelelo, nakuba kube nezinselelo ezithile ngokuqhubeka konyaka.

src: Kabinete hape e lakaletsa tse molemo ditlhatlhobong tse tlang tsa 2016 ho ba dumetseng hore ditlhatlhobo di tjhetjhiswe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibafisela okuhle kodwa labo bafundi abavumile ukuthi ukuhlolwa kwabo kuhleliselwe onyakeni ozayo, njengoba bezoqala ukubhala ngasekuqaleni kowezi-2016.

src: Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba, ka tshebedisano-mmoho le Lefapha la Tshireletso le Lekala la Naha la Ntshetsopele ya Batjha (NYDA), le tla tshwara Kampo ya Batjha ya bo-6.
tgt: UMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi, ngokubambisana noMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye noPhiko Lukazwelonke Lwezokuthuthukiswa Kwentsha (i-NYDA), uzobamba iNgqungquthela Yentsha Kazwelonke yesithupha.

src: Sena ke lenaneo la ntshetsopele ya boetapele ba batjha le rerileng ho fetola boitshwaro, mmono wa bophelo le ho matlafatsa batjha ka menyetla e teng eo ba ka e tholang.
tgt: Lolu wuhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kobuholi entsheni, okuhloswe ngakho ukuguqula uziphatha nokucabanga kwentsha futhi ihlinzekwe ngolwazi oluphathelene namathuba akhona njengamanje enzelwe intsha.

src: Kampo e thusa hape ka ho lekola le ho ruta bashemane ba batjha ho hola hore e be banna ba ananelang le ho hlompha basadi.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela izolekelela futhi ekucijeni nokufundisa abafana ukuze bakhule babe ngamadoda abazisayo abesifazane futhi abahloniphayo.8 Isivumelwano esisayindwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqesha, uDkt Blade Nzimande namazwe e-BRICS abambisene naleli, i-Brazil, Russia, India kanye ne-China – kuhloswe ngaso ukuthuthukisa uhlaka lokubambisana kwezemfundo esikhathini esizayo.

src: Tumellano e saenetsweng ka kopanelo pakeng tsa Letona la Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello, Ngaka Blade Nzimande, le bomphato ba BRICS – Brazil, Russia, India le China – e reretswe ho ntshetsapele moralo bakeng sa tshebedisano ya bokamoso thutong.
tgt: Lesi sivumelwano sibandakanya imikhakha yemfundo yonkana, isu lenqubomgomo yezemfundo amakolishi eMfundo Yobuchwepheshe Bamakhono Ezandla Nokuqeqesha (ama-TVET) kanye nomkhakha wezemfundo ephakeme.

src: Tumellano e akaretsa thuto ya kakaretso, lewa la leano la thuto, Dikoletjhe tsa Thuto le Thupello ya Tekginiki le Mesebetsi (TVET) le thuto e phahameng.
tgt: Amakolishi angama-TVET anawo amandla nekhono lokuvula amathuba ezomnotho kubantu abasha bakuleli, futhi ngokunjalo alekelele empini yokulwisana nenselelo yokuntuleka kwamathuba omsebenzi, ukungalingani kanye nobubha, okuyizinto ezikhahlameza imiphakathi.

src: Dikoletjhe tsa TVET di na le bokgoni ba ho bula menyetla ya moruo bakeng sa batho ba batjha, ha ho ntse ho sebetsanwa le diphephetso tsa tlhokeho ya mesebetsi, ho se lekalekane, le bofuma bo amang badudi.
tgt: Lesi sivumelwano, okuhloswe ngaso ukwenza ngcono izinga lokufundisa kanye nelokuqeqeshwa kothisha, sibophezela futhi namanyuvesi amazwe e-Brics ekusekeleni imiklamo yocwaningo eyenziwa ngokuhlanganyela, sikhuthaze nezinhlelo zokubambisana emazingeni eziqu ze-postgraduate, doctoral kanye postdoctoral futhi siwabophezele nasekushicileleni imiphumela yocwaningo lwezesayensi ngokubambisana.

src: Tumellano ena, e tla ntlafatsa boleng ba thuto le thuto ya matitjhere, hape e tlama diyunivesithi tsa BRICS ho tshehetsa diporojeke tse kopanetsweng tsa diphuputso, ho kgothaletsa mananeo a tshebedisano-mmoho maemong a dithuto tsa kamora yunivesithi, a bongaka le a dithuto tsa kamora bongaka le ho phatlalatsa mmoho diphetho tsa merero ya tsa saense.
tgt: UMnyango Wezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe usingathe iNgqungquthela Yezesayensi yaseNingizimu Afrika ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Sokhela inhlansi yokuqalisa ukuxoxisana nokufakana imilomo ngezesayensi.” Angaphezu kwama-45 amazwe abambe iqhaza kwizinkulumo-mpikiswano eziphathelene nokuxhumana okukhona phakathi komphakathi nezesayensi, ezobuchwepheshe kanye nokuqanjwa nokusungulwa kwemikhiqizo nezinhlelo ezintsha, ikakhulu ngaphansi kwesimo sentuthuko.

src: Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji le ne le tshwere Foramo ya Saense ya Aforika Borwa tlasa mookotaba “Re hotetsa dipuisano ka saense”.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ilekelelile futhi nasekuqiniseni ukubambisana kweNingizimu Afrika namanye amazwe omhlaba kwezesayensi, ezobuchwepheshe kanye nokuqanjwa nokusungulwa kwemikhiqizo nezinhlelo ezintsha.10 INingizimu Afrika izomelwa eMkhandlwini Wamazwe Ngamazwe Wezolwandle.

src: Foramo hape e sebeditse bakeng sa ho matlafatsa lewa la saense, thekenoloji le semphato sa ntjhafatso la matjhaba la Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Leli yigxathu elikhulukazi eliphokophele ekutholeni kwaleli lizwe kanye nezwekazi lonkana ithuba lokudlondlobala nokukhombisa ikhono lalo emkhakheni wezolwandle.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla emelwa ho Lekgotla la Matjhaba la Mokgatlo wa Mawatle.
tgt: Le nhlangano iyona ethweswe umsebenzi wokwamukela izinqumo eziphathelene nezindaba zasolwandle emhlabeni jikelele, kusukela kwezoMnotho Wasolwandle, izinhlelo zokuhlenga abadinga usizo oluphuthumayo olwandle kanye nezindaba eziphathelene nokuphepha nokuvikeleka olwandle.

src: Sena ke mohato wa bohlokwa ho isa moo re tla bonang bokgoni ba naha le kontinente lekaleng la tsa mawatle.
tgt: Ukubamba iqhaza kulo mkhandlu kuzosekela izinhlelo zikahulumeni ngokuvula amathuba okukhula nokudlondlobala kwaleli lizwe, ngokusebenzisa iSu Lomnotho Wasolwandle kanye nomkhankaso we-Operation Phakisa, okuhloswe ngakho ukuvula amathuba omsebenzi angaphezu kwesigidi ngowezi-2033.‎1.11 Ngeviki eledlule uMbutho Wezokuvikela waseNingizimu Afrika (i-SANDF) uqalise inqubo yokulungisa kabusha nokuvuselela iSiteshi Sasolwandle sesiQhingi i-Salisbury e-Durban njengesizinda semikhumbi yezempi esisebenza ngokuphelele.

src: Mokgatlo ona o ikarabella bakeng sa ho amohela diqeto tse mabapi le merero ya lefatshe ya tsa mawatle, ho tloha ho Moruo wa Mawatle, boikitlaetso ba pholoso le mabaka a polokeho le tshireletso lewatleng.
tgt: Ukulungiswa kwalesi sizinda kuzophucula amandla nekhono lokuzivikela kwaleli lizwe futhi kufake isandla nasemnothweni wasolwandle.12 UMnyango Wezempilo, ngokubambisana ne-Soul City kanye ne-Times Media, wethule isiteshi sikamabonakude esizokwethula izinhlelo zezempilo nenhlalakahle yabantu esibizwa nge-Good Life Network esizokhonjiswa ku-DStv, kwisiteshi nombolo 199.

src: Bonkakarolo setheong sena bo tla tshehetsa lenaneo la mmuso la ho bula bokgoni ba naha ka Lewa la Moruo wa Mawatle le Operation Phakisa, tse rerileng ho hlahisa mesebetsi e fetang milione ka 2033.‎.
tgt: Lesi siteshi sihlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ezihlabahlosile futhi ezithokozisayo ezivutshelwe kuleli eziphathelene nokudla okunomsoco, ezempilo nokuzivocavoca ukuze uhlale ungumqemane, amalungelo esintu, izindaba zocansi eziqondiswe entsheni, isandulela ngculazi kanye nesifo sofuba (i-TB), namalungelo abathengi kanye nawabesifazane.

src: Lebotho la Naha la Aforika Borwa le qadile ka tsamaiso ya ho hlabolla Seteishene sa Sehlekehleke sa Lebotho la Lewatle sa Salisbury se Durban ho ba kampo ya lebotho la lewatle e sebetsang ka botlalo.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi eziqavile.1 IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukushicilelwa kohlaka loMthetho Odingidwayo ophathelene noMshwalense Kazwelonke Wezempilo (i-NHI) weNingizimu Afrika, ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngalo.

src: Thlabollo ya dibaka tsena e tla ntlafatsa bokgoni ba tshireletso le ho nyehela bakeng sa moruo wa mawatle.
tgt: I-NHI iyingxenye yezinguquko ezinohlonze ezizokwenziwa nguhulumeni emkhakheni wezempilo.

src: Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle, ka kopanelo le Soul City le Times Media, le thakgotse kanale e reretsweng tsa bophelo bo botle le mokgwa wa bophelo ya Good Life Network ho DStv kanaleng ya 199.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo ihlongoza ukuthi kukhushulwe amandla nekhono likahulumeni lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo ezisezingeni eliphezulu kubo bonke abantu abavakashela izikhungo zezempilo ezingaphansi kukahulumeni.

src: Kanale ena e fana ka dikateng tse fapafapaneng, tse thabisang le ho ba tse hlahisitsweng lapeng mabapi le phepo, bophelo bo botle le ho kwena, ditokelo tsa botho, tsa motabo ho batjha, HIV le TB, mmoho le ditokelo tsa bareki le tsa bong.
tgt: Lo mshwalense uzoxhaswa ngezimali yisikhwama esizolawulwa nguhulumeni kazwelonke futhi lesi sikhwama sizobaxhasa nodokotela abazimele abafisayo ukubamba iqhaza.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho phatlalatswa ha Pampiri e Tshweu ya Inshorense ya Naha ya Bophelo bo Botle (NHI) ya Aforika Borwa, hore setjhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: Namhlanje uNgqongqoshe Wezempilo, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, uzohlinzeka abezindaba ngolwazi oluphathelene nokuqaliswa kwe-NHI.2 IKhabhinethi iyamukelile iNqubomgomo Kazwelonke Edidiyelwe Yokuthuthukiswa Kwezingane Zisencane (i-ECD).Le nqubomgomo yathuthukiswa ngokubonisana nababambiqhaza abahlukahlukene kulo mkhakha.

src: NHI ke karolo ya mmuso ya ho etsa diphetho tse kgolo ho tsa kalafo.
tgt: NgoNhlolanja wezi-2015 idlule esigabeni sokubonisana nomphakathi ngenhloso yokuthola izimvo zabantu.

src: Leano lena le sisinya bokgoni ba mmuso ba ho fana ka ditshebeletso tsa bongaka ho bohle ba etelang dikaho tsa kalafo.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo yeze-ECD edidiyelwe izoqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izingane ezisencane kanye nabanakekeli bazo bathola izinsizakalo ze-ECD ezibanzi futhi ezisezingeni eliphezulu, kusukela ngenkathi zizalwa kuze kuyofinyelela kwiBanga Le nqubomgomo izokwelula izinsizakalo ze-ECD ukuze zifinyelele nasezinganeni ezineminyaka yobudala eyisishiyagalombili ezinobunzima bokuthuthuka ngendlela efanelekile.

src: Le tla tshehetswa ka ditjhelete ka letlole la bohareng leo hape le tla ba teng ho dingaka tsa poraefete tse batlang ho nka karolo sekemeng sena.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo ihlinzeka futhi nangohlaka lokuqapha nokuhlola ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi iqaliswa ngendlela efanelekile kuzo zonke izingane, kungakhathalekile ukuthi ngezaluphi uhlanga, ubulili noma inkolo.3 IKhabhinethi ilwamukelile uhlaka loMthetho Odingidwayo Wezamalungelo Abantu Abakhubazekile kanye neSimo Oluzoqaliswa Ngaphansi Kwaso.

src: Hang ha ho se ho phethetswe tsohle, leano le tla kenngwa tshebetsong ho ya jwalo le dilemo le ho tsepamisa maikutlo haholo hore le qale dibakeng tse fumanang ditshebeletso tse nyane.
tgt: Lokho kuhambisana neziNjongo Zentuthuko Esimeme ebandakanya abantu abakhubazekile, ezamukelwa yisiGungu Esibandakanya Wonke Amazwe (i-UNGA) angamalungu eNhlangano Yezizwe (i-UN) ngoMandulo wezi-2015.Le nqubomgomo izosheshisa uguquko futhi ilungise isimo esingagculisi neze esikhona njengamanje mayelana nokubandakanywa ngokuphelele nokudidiyelwa kanye nokuphathwa ngokulingana kwabantu abakhubazekile.

src: Letona la Bophelo bo Botle, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, kajeno le tla tsebisa boraditaba ka phano ya NHKabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Leano le Kopanetsweng la Naha la Ntshetsopele ya Thuto ya Qalo ya Bana (ECD).Leano lena le hlahisitswe ka ditherisano le bankakarolo ba fapafapaneng ka hara lekala lena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukushicilelwa kweNqubomgomo Kazwelonke Yezokuthuthwa Kwendle ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngayo.

src: Le ile la sekasekwa ka ditherisano le setjhaba ka Tlhakola 2015.Leano le kopanetsweng la ECD le tla netefatsa hore bana bohle ba banyenyane le bahlokomedi ba bona ba kgona ho fihlella ditshebeletso tse pharalletseng tsa ECD ho tloha tswalong ho fihla ho Kereiti ya Leano lena le atolosetsa tshebeletso ho bana ba dilemo tse robedi ba nang le mathata a kgolo.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo iqhakambisa futhi ibeke eqhulwini inhlalakahle yabantu ngokuthi iqinisekise ukulingana phakathi kwendlela okwabiwa ngayo izimali zokusekela ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo emazingeni aphezulu kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo kulawo makhaya angazitholi ngendlela efanelekile, futhi kusenjalo kulungiswe futhi kuvuselelwe kabusha ingqalasizinda ekhona njengamanje yokuthuthwa kwendle.5 IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukwethulwa ePhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika Kombiko Wesihlanu Okhishwa Ngezikhathi Ezithile Kuphela (wezi-2009-2014) ophathelene Nokuqaliswa Kwesivumelwano Sokuqedwa kwazo zonke Izinhlobo Zokucwaswa Kwabesifazane.

src: Leano ho ya pele le fana ka moralo wa peho leihlo le tekolo ho netefatsa hore le kenngwa tshebetsong ka bokgabane ho banabohle ho sa kgathallwe morabe, bong kapa bodumedi.
tgt: Lo mbiko uhlinzeka ngemininingwane efingqiwe mayelana nemithetho ehlukahlukene nezinqubomgomo kanye nezinhlelo eziqalisiwe ukuze kutholakale ukuthi zinawo yini umthelela obonakalayo, futhi uhlinzeka nangemininingwane yalokho osekufezekiswe yileli lizwe mayelana nokufukulwa nokuthuthukiswa kwabesifazane kanye nokulingana ngokobulili.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Pampiri e Tshweu ya Ditokelo tsa Batho ba phelang ka Boqhwala le Moralo wa ho kenngwa tshebetsong.
tgt: Lo mbiko uyakwamukela futhi ukuthi kusenezinselelo nezithiyo ezingafuni ukushabalala ezivimbela ukuqedwa kokungalingani nokucwaswa kwabantu abathile kuleli.6 IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukushicilelwa koHlaka Lohlelo Lokusebenza Lukazwelonke Lokulwisana Nobuhlanga, Ukucwaswa Kwezinhlanga Ezithile, Ukukhishwa Inyumbazane Kwabantu Bakwamanye Amazwe Abakuleli kanye Nokungabekezelelani Okuhlobene Nalokhu, ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngalo.

src: Sena se matahantswe ho Merero ya Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella e kenyeletsang ya boqhwala, e amohetsweng ke Kopano Kakaretso (UNGA) ya Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) ka Loetse 2015.Leano le tla akofisa diphethoho le ditokiso tse mabapi le kenyeletso e tletseng, kopanelo le tekatekano bakeng sa batho ba phelang ka boqhwala.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luyisu lokusebenza lukazwelonke elididiyelwe futhi elihlelekile okuhloswe ngalo ukulwisana nobuhlanga kanye nokwakha iNingizimu Afrika ebuswa ngentando yeningi eqinisekisayo ukuthi kuqedwa ngokuphelele ukucwasana ngokobuhlanga nangokobulili.

src: Leano lena le beha ho phela hantle ha setjhaba bohareng ba ntshetsopele ka ho tlisa botsitso mahareng a ho aba mehlodi ya ditjhelete bakeng sa ho tshehetsa matsete ho tshebeletso e phahameng, phano ya ditshebeletso ho malapa a sa sebeletsweng hantle, ha ka nqa e nngwe ho baballwa le ho ntlafatsa meralo ya motheo e ntseng e le teng.
tgt: Luhlinzeka futhi ngohlaka lokuqinisekisa ukuthi leli lizwe lonkana lithabatha izinyathelo ezihleleke kahle, ezihambelanayo futhi ezizoqhubeka isikhathi eside ngenhloso yokulwisana nokhondolo lobuhlanga kanye nokucwaswana ngokobuhlanga.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana bakeng sa ho kenngwa Palamenteng ha Tlaleho ya Dinako tse itseng ya bo-5 ya Aforika Borwa (2009-2014) ya ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Khonvenshene e mabapi le Phediso ya Mefuta yohle ya Kgethollo kgahlanong le Basadi.
tgt: Luzolekelela iNingizimu Afrika ukuthi ikwazi ukufezekisa izibopho zayo zikazwelonke, nezesifunda kanye nezamazwe ngamazwe, ikakhulukazi isiMemezelo Sesivumelwano saseThekwini kanye noHlelo Lokusebenza olwamukelwa yiNhlangano Yezizwe kwiNgqungquthela Yamazwe Omhlaba yokulwisana Nobuhlanga eyabanjwa ngowezi-20.7 IKhabhinethi yethulelwe nolwazi mayelana nenqubekelaphambili eseyenziwe ohlelweni lokufudukela kumsakazo wedijithali.

src: Tlaleho ena e fana ka kakaretso ya bohlwahlwa ba letoto la melao, maano le mananeo a kentsweng tshebetsong le ho hlakisa diphihlello tsa naha mabapi le matlafatso ya basadi le tekatekano ya bong.
tgt: Ikwamukelile ukuqala kwesikhathi lapho isiginali yokusakaza ngedijithali izosebenza kanye kanye nesiginali ye-analogi eNingizimu Afrika kusukela mhla lu-1 kuNhlolanja 2016, kuze kufike usuku lomnqamulajuqu wokuqedwa kwe-analogi ngokuphelele.

src: Tlaleho hape e ananela hore ho na le diphephetso le ditshita tse ntseng di le teng bakeng sa ho hlola ho se lekalekane le kgethollo ka hara naha.
tgt: Ukufuduswa kwezinsizakalo zokusakaza nge-analogi ziye kwidijithali kuzokhulula amagagasi okusakaza ngomoya adingeka kakhulu, okuzokwenza ukuthi lawo magagasi asetshenziselwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ze-inthanethi esheshayo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Moralo wa Naha wa Tshebetso bakeng sa ho Lwantsha Bomorabe, Kgethollo ya Merabe, Lehloyo la Melata le ho hloka mamellano, bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: Lokhu kuzobeka umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika esimweni sokuncintisana neminotho yakwamanye amazwe ngokuthi kuvuselelwe imboni yezokusakaza, kuqiniswe imboni yezama-elekthronikhi, kuvulwe amathuba omsebenzi futhi kwandiswe isibalo sezinhlelo zomsakazo ezivutshelwe ngaphakathi kuleli kanye nezinhlelo ezizokwanelisa izidingo zabantu abahlukahlukene.8 IKhabhinethi ithulelwe ulwazi ngalokho okutholwe wuMbiko wezi-2014 Wezinkomba Zesayensi, Ubuchwepheshe kanye Nokusungulwa Nokuqanjwa Kwemikhiqizo Nezinhlelo Ezintsha eNingizimu Afrika nezinqubo zakamuva eziphathelene nokusebenza koHlelo Lukazwelonke Lokusungulwa Nokuqanjwa Kwemikhiqizo Nezinhlelo (i-NSI) ezintsha, okhishwa njalo ngonyaka nguMkhandlu Kazwelonke Wezokweluleka mayelana Nokusungulwa Nokuqanjwa Kwemikhiqizo Nezinhlelo Ezintsha.

src: Moralo ona ke lewa le kopanetsweng le ho hlohlomiswa ka morero wa ho lwantsha bomorabe le ho aha Aforika Borwa ya demokerasi ya nnete e hlokang bomorabe le kgethollo ka bong.
tgt: Lo mbiko usebenzisa izinkomba ezisemqoka kakhulu ngenhloso yokuhlola umsebenzi we-NSI kanye negalelo layo kwizinto ezibalulekile eziseqhulwini kuleli njengoba zibekwe ngokucacile oHlelweni Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP) kanye nezinye izincwajana eziphathelene nezinqubomgomo ezilekelelayo ekuthuthukisweni kwenhlalo-mnotho yabantu bakuleli.

src: E fana ka moralo bakeng sa mekgwa ya moshwelella o hokahantsweng o lokelang ho etswa ke naha ka bophara ho sebetsana le lefa la bomorabe le kgethollo ya merabe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukuhlelwa kabusha kwezifundankantolo (zezimantshi) eLimpopo naseMpumalanga, kanye nokuqokwa kweNkantolo Kamantshi yaseLephalale njengesizinda sesikhashana soPhiko lwaseLimpopo lweNkantolo Ephakeme, kuze kufike isikhathi lapho kuzokwakhiwa khona isizinda esizimele ngasodwana esizosebenza ngokugcwele soPhiko lweNkantolo Ephakeme kule ndawo.

src: Sena se thusa Aforika Borwa ho kgema le ditshwanelo tsa yona tsa matjhaba, tsa lebatowa le tsa naha, haholoholo Boitlamo ba Durban le Lenaneo la Tshebetso le amohetsweng ke UN Khonferenseng ya Lefatshe kgahlanong le Bomorabe ka 2001.
tgt: Ukuhlelwa kabusha kwezifunda-nkantolo zezimantshi kanye negunya lokwengamela leziMpiko zeNkantolo Ephakeme kuyingxenye yezinguquko okuhloswe ngazo ukulungisa ukhondolo lwesikhathi esedlule lokuklanywa kwezifunda-nkantolo ngendlela engenabo ubulungiswa.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka kgatatelopele e seng e entswe mabapi le lenaneo la ho fallela ho mokgwa wa dijithale.
tgt: Futhi kuyingxenye yezinto eziphoqelekile zokuqinisekisa ukulethwa koguquko olubanzi ngenhloso yokwenza ngcono ukutholakala kobulungiswa, okuyinto ehambelana noMthethosisekelo WeRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika we-19.10 IKhabhinethi iwamukelile umbiko ophathelene nenqubekelaphambili eseyenziwe ekuqalisweni kweziqondiso zeKhabhinethi esifundazweni saseLimpopo ngaphansi kweSigaba 100 (1)

src: E tjhaelletse monwna qalo ya nako ya ho kgantshwa habedi ha tumello ya kgaso ya dijithale ka hara Aforika Borwa ka la 1 Tlhakola 2016.Ho falla ho tloha ho ditshebeletso tsa kgaso tsa analoko ho ya ho tsa kgaso ya dijithale ho lokolla mokgwa o batlehang haholo wa maqhubu a radio a loketseng bakeng sa phano ya ditshebeletso tsa kgaso tse phatlaletseng.
tgt: ngaphambi komhla zingama-31 kuNdasa 2016 kule minyango yesifundazwe elandelayo: Owezempilo Owezokuthutha Owezemisebenzi Yomphakathi Owezemigwaqo Nengqalasizinda kanye neHhovisi likaMgcinimafa.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka diphihlello tsa Tlaleho ya Matshwao a Ntlafatso ya Aforika Borwa ya Saense le Thekenoloji ya 2014 tse ntseng di etsahala tshebetsong ya Tshebeletso ya Naha ya Ntlafatso (NSI), e hlahiswang selemo ka seng ke Lekgotla la Naha la Boeletsi ka Ntlafatso.
tgt: eMnyangweni Wezemfundo ngenhloso yokulungiselela ukuthi iHhovisi likaMgcinimafa Esifundazweni likwazi ukuqalisa ngokuphelele iSigaba 18 soMthetho Wezokuphathwa Kwezimali Zikahulumeni, we-1999 (uMthetho Nombolo 1 we-1999) eMnyangweni Wezemfundo eLimpopo, ngokusekelwa nguhulumeni kazwelonke.

src: Tlaleho e sebedisa matshwao a hlokolosi bakeng sa ho lekola tshebetso le nyehelo ya NSI ho dintlha tse ka sehloohong tsa naha jwaloka ha di hlahisitswe ho Morero wa Naha wa Ntshetsopele (NDP) le ditokomaneng tse ding tsa leano tse nyehelang ho ntshetsopele ya moruo wa kahisano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izamukelile lezi ziqondiso ezilandelayo ezibhekiswe kuNdunankulu nakuNgqongqoshe Wesifundazwe Wezezimali kanye Nowezemfundo:a) Ukulekelelwa kweminyango yesifundazwe ukuthi ikwazi ukwenza umsebenzi ogculisayo ngokuthi kuqashwe abasebenzi abanekhono futhi abakhutheleb) Ukuphothulwa kwenqubo yokugcwaliswa kwezikhala zomsebenzi ezikhona ezingeni labaphathi kanyec) Nokubhekana ngqo nenkinga yokuhluleka kwabaphathi ukwenza umsebenzi wabo ngendlela efanelekile kanye nokulwisana nesihlava senkohlakalo.11 IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika isingathe iNgqungquthela esemazingeni aphezulu yeziNgxoxo Zokufakana Imilomo Ngodaba Lokulwisana Nezidakamizwa ezobanjwa kusukela mhla ziyi-11 kuze kube mhla ziyi-12 kuNdasa 2016, ngokusekelwa yiNhlangano Yamazwe ase-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho hlophiswa botjha ha ditereke tsa bomakgiseterata bakeng sa Limpopo le Mpumalanga, le ho theha Lekgotla la Dinyewe la Makgiseterata la Lephalale jwaloka tulo ya Karolo ya Lekgotla le Phahameng la Limpopo, jwaloka mokgwa wa nakwana ho fihlela ho ahuwa Karolo ya tulo ya moshwelella sebakeng seo.
tgt: Lesi isigcawu sokulandelela emva kweZingxoxo Zokufakana Imilomo ezabe ziphakathi kwezwe lase-Russia kanye namazwe ase-Afrika, okuhloswe ngaso ukwethula umbono owodwa futhi ofanayo, okhombisa ubumbano nokuvumelana mayelana nokulwisana nenkinga yezidakamizwa emhlabeni.

src: Ho hlophiswa botjha ha ditereke tsa bomakgiseterata le dibaka tsa tshebetso tsa Dikarolo tsa Lekgotla le Phahameng la Dinyewe ke karolo ya ho fetola maano ka morero wa lokisa botjha lefa la ho hloka toka la mehleng la ho aha dibaka tsa bodulo.
tgt: Lokhu kuzokwethulwa kwiSigcawu Esikhethekile se-UNGA esizobajwa ngoMbasa 2016.Impi yokulwisana nezidakamizwa ezingekho emthethweni iyahambelana nalokho okushiwo yi-NDP futhi lezi ziNgxoxo zizohlinzeka ngethuba lokuphucula uHlelo Lukazwelonke Lokulwisana Nezidakamizwa (lowezi-2013-2017) ukuze lube ngolungcono kakhulu kunakuqala.12 IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuthi uMnyango Wezokuhlaliswa Kwabantu usingathe ingqungquthela, okuzobanjiswana kuyona noHlelo Lwenhlangano Yezizwe Lwezokuhlaliswa Kwabantu, ngaphansi kwesihloko esithi “Ukuhola Ukulethwa Koguquko Edolobheni: Oluzophendula Imijondolo ibe Yizindawo Zokuhlalisa Abantu Ezibandakanya Umuntu Wonke, Eziphephile, Ezinohlonze futhi Ezisimeme” ezoba ngoNdasa 2016.Le ngqungquthela izosekela i-ajenda yamazwe omhlaba yezentuthuko futhi isekele ne-ajenda yakuleli ngokuqinisa ukwesekwa kweNjongo ye-11 Yezinjongo Zentuthuko Esimeme: Yokwenza Amadolobha nezindawo zokuhlaliswa kwabantu zibe ngezibandakanya umuntu wonke, eziphephile, ezinohlonze futhi ezisimeme.

src: Hape ke karolo ya tshwanelo ya diphethoho tse pharaletseng bakeng sa ho matlafatsa phumantsho ya toka, e matahantsweng le Molaotheo wa Aforika Borwa wa 1996.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela iyingxenye yezingxoxo zokuqaliswa kwe-Ajenda Yenhlangano Yezizwe Yokuletha Intuthuko ezolandelwa emva konyaka wezi-2015 kanye “ne-Ajenda Entsha Yezindawo Ezisemadolobheni” ezokwamukelwa futhi ilandelwe yiNhlangano Yezizwe ngowezi-20.13 IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuthi uMkhandlu Wocwaningo Lwezolimo usingathe iNgqungquthela yesithathu Yamazwe Omhlaba Ephathelene Nocwaningo Lwezolimo Okuhloswe Ngalo Ukuletha Intuthuko ezobanjwa ngoMbasa 2016.

src: ya Molaotheo.
tgt: Imithethosivivinywa.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho hulwa ha Karolo 100 (1)
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukushicilelwa koMthethosivivinywa Wezokuhlelwa Kokuhlaliswa Kwabantu Ezindaweni Ezakhelene Nolwandle wezi-2015 ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngawo.

src: ka 31 Tlhakubele 2016 mafapheng a porofense a Limpopo a latelang: Bophelo bo Botle Dipalangwang Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba Ditsela le Meralo ya motheo le la Matlotlo.
tgt: Lo mthethosivivinywa uhlinzeka ngohlaka lomthetho oluzoveza ukuthi ulwandle lungaba negalelo elingakanani kwezomnotho, ngokuthi kugqugquzelwe ukubambisana ekuhlelweni kokuhlaliswa kwabantu kwizindawo ezakhelene nolwandle.

src: Kabinete hape e tjhaelletse monwana ho hulwa ntle le dipehelo ha Karolo 100 (1)
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uzolekelela izinhlaka ezikhona njengamanje ze-Operation Phakisa.

src: ho Lefapha la Thuto bakeng sa ho betla tsela bakeng sa lefapha la Matlotlo la Porofense ho kenya tshebetsong ka bokgabane Karolo 18 ya Molao wa Bolaodi ba Ditjhelete tsa Setjhaba, 1999 (Molao 1 wa 1999) ho Lefapha la Thuto la Limpopo, ka tshehetso e tswang ho mmuso wa naha.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uzohola umgubho woSuku Lokubuyisana ozobanjwa kuleli mhla ziyi-16 kuZibandlela e-Port Elizabeth, esifundazweni saseMpumalanga Kapa ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Sivala igebe: Sakha isizwe saseNingizimu Afrika esiyimbumba, njengoba siphokophele ekwakheni isizwe esithuthukayo”.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ditaelo tse latelang ho Tonakgolo le diMEC tsa Ditjhelete le Thuto:a) Matlafatso ya mafapha a porofense ka ho thaotha basebeletsi ba hlwahlwab) Ho phethela ho thonngwa ha batho bakeng sa mesebetsi ya batsamaisi ba ka sehloohong lec) Ho sebetsana ka matla le ho hloleha ha boetapele le bobodu.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezengqalasizinda Yezokuxhumana Nezinsizakalo Zeposi, uDkt Siyabonga Cwele, uzohola ithimba elizokwethamela iNgqungquthela Yamazwe Omhlaba Yomphakathi Wezolwazi (i-WSIS), ezobanjwa yi-UNGA kusukela mhla ziyi-15 kuya kumhla ziyi-16 kuZibandlela 2015, lapho kuzokwethulwa khona umbono nokucabanga kweNingizimu Afrika, ngenhloso yokufaka isandla ezingxoxweni ze-WSIS+10, okuyizingxoxo ezingeyona ingxenye yezethulo ezisemthethweni.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Aforika Borwa e tshware Khonferense ya Dipuisano tse Kgahlanong le Dithethefatsi ya maemo a hodimo ho tloha ka la 11 ho isa ka la 12 Tlhakubele 2016, e tla ba tlasa bolaodi ba Kopano ya Aforika.
tgt: Isimo seKhabhinethi ezindabeni eziqavile ezisematheni.

src: Sena se sebetsa jwaloka kopano ya ho tswellisa Dipuisano tse Kgahlanong le Dithethefatsi tsa Russia le Aforika, ka morero wa ho fana maemo a kopanetsweng mabapi le ho lwantsha bothata ba lefatshe ba dithethefatsi.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika isingathe ngempumelelo iNgqungquthela Yesikhombisa Yamadolobha ase-Afrika ebihanjelwe yizithunywa ebezimele amadolobha nohulumeni basekhaya base-Afrika, ebibanjelwe eGoli kusukela mhla zingama-29 kuLwezi kuya kumhla zi-3 kuZibandlela 2015.

src: Sena se tla tekwa ho Kopano e Ikgethang ya UNGA ka Mmesa 2016.Ntwa kgahlanong le dithethefatsi tse seng molaong e tsamaellana le NDP mme Dipuisano di tla fana ka lepatlelo la ho tswela pele ho matlafatsa Moralo Wa Naha o ka Sehloohong wa Dithethefatsi wa (2013-2017).
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ebihanjelwe yizimeya eziyi-15 000 kanye namakhansela ayizi-500 000 futhi ebibanjwe ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Ukusungula nokuqalisa izinhlelo zokwenza ingomuso le-Afrika kube ngeliqhakazile, ngokubambisana nabantu: igalelo loMasipala base-Afrika kwi-Ajenda yowezi-2063 yeNhlangano Yamazwe ase-Afrika”, ingenye yezindlela ezinohlonze futhi eziphathekayo zokwakha ubumbano kwelase-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Lefapha la Bodulo ba Batho le tshware mmoho le Lenaneo la UN la Bodulo ba Batho Khonferense ya “Re etella pele Diphethoho ka hara Motsemoholo: Ho tloha Bodulong bo Bohlaswa ho ya ho Bodulo ba Batho bo kenyeletsang, bo bolokehileng, bo Hlwahlwa le ba Moshwelella”, ka Tlhakubele 2016.Khonferense e tshehetsa ka bobedi lenaneo la matjhaba la ntshetsopele le la ntshetsopele ya lehae ka ho matlafatsa tshehetso bakeng sa Morero 11 wa Merero ya Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella: Ho etsa metsemeholo le bodulo ba batho hore e be e kenyeletsang, e bolokehileng, e hlwahlwa le ho ba ya moshwelella.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela yabe igxile ekuqiniseni ohulumeni basekhaya kulo lonke izwekazi lase-Afrika, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokuphathwa kwezimali kanye nokusungulwa kwemithombo ethembekile yokungenisa imali ukuze kufezekiswe i-Ajenda yowezi-2063 – yokuqinisekisa ukuthi izwekazi lase-Afrika liba yilelo esilifunayo.

src: Khonferense e etsa karolo ya dipuisano tse mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lenaneo la Ntshetsopele la UN la kamora 2015 le “Lenaneo le Letjha la Metse ya Ditoropo” le tla amohelwa ke UN ka 2016.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela isekela izinjongo ze-NDP lapho amadolobha kanye nohulumeni basekhaya bedlala indima ebalulekile kwintuthuko yethu yonkana.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Lekgotla la Diphuputso tsa Temo le tshware Khonferense ya bo-3 ya Lefatshe ya Diphuputso tsa Temo bakeng sa Ntshetsopele ka Mmesa 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isenalo ithemba lokuthi ezingxoxweni eziqhubekayo kwiNgqungquthela Yamazwe Abambe Iqhaza (i-COP21) yesigcawu sama-21 soHlaka Lwesivumelwano Senhlangano Yezizwe Esiphathelene Nokuguquguquka Kwesimo Sezulu (i-UNFCCC), kuzofinyelelwa esivumelwaneni esingachemile futhi esizoba yisibopho kuwo wonke amazwe abambe iqhaza.

src: Khonferense e tla hlwaya: dintlha tse ka sehloohong tsa diphuputso tsa matjhaba le tsamaiso ya ntlafatso hore ho tle ho fihlellwe merero ya ntshetsopelo ya bokamoso, haholoholo ho borapolasi ba malapa le metseng e futsanehileng.
tgt: Ukuguquguquka Kwesimo Sezulu yinkinga yomhlaba wonke edinga isixazululo somhlaba wonke, futhi lena yinkinga engaxazululwa kuphela ngokuthi wonke amazwe omhlaba abambisane, ngaphansi kwesivumelwano esibanzi se-UNFCCC okumele sihlonishwe futhi silandelwe yiwona wonke amazwe ayingxenye yaso, futhi kumele wonke amazwe adlale indima ebonakalayo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Bili ya Meralo ya Tlhophiso ya Mawatleng ya 2015 bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: Lezi zinqubomgomo ziholwa ngumgomo obanzi wokuletha intuthuko esimeme, oyinsika yeNhloso-Mbono yowezi-2063 oqukethwe yi-NDP.3 Njengoba lona kungumhlangano weKhabinethi wokugcina wezi-2015, iKhabhinethi ithanda ukudlulisa izilokotho ezinhle kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngalesi sikhathi samaholide kaKhisimusi.

src: Bili e fana ka moralo wa semolao wa ho bula bokgoni ba moruo wa Mawatle ka ho kgothaletsa moralo o kopanetsweng.
tgt: Ngaphansi komoya wesikhathi samaholide kaKhisimusi futhi ngokulandela umoya woBuntu, iKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi balekelele abantu abahlwempu nabantulayo kanye nemindeni edla imbuya ngothi emiphakathini abahlala kuyona.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla etella pele mekete ya Letsatsi la Poelano ka la 16 December Port Elizabeth, ho la Kapa Botjhabela tlasa mookotaba: “Re ngotla karohano: Re aha bosetjhaba ba Aforika Borwa bo tshwanang ho ya ho puso ya naha e tswelang pele”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithanda ukudlulisa amazwi enduduzo kanye nokuzwelana kwayo nomndeni nabangani ba-Mohamed Ismail (“Issy”) Dinat, odlule emhlabeni ngoLwesibili mhla ziyisi-8 kuZibandlela.

src: Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa Bohlokwa Maemong a Hajwale.
tgt: Ukukhathalela kwakhe abanye abantu kanye negalelo lakhe elikhulukazi emzabalazweni wenkululeko kwasilekelela kakhulu ekutheni sithole inkululeko.

src: Tlasa mookotaba: “Re bopa bokamoso ba Aforika le batho: nyehelo ya mebuso ya mahae ya Aforika ho lenaneo la 2063 la Kopano ya Aforika”, seboka sena, se hohetseng bomeyara ba 15 000 le makhanselara a 500 000, ke se seng sa boikitlaetso bo tiileng ba ho aha Kopano ya maAforika.
tgt: Ikhomishana Yocwaningo Lwezamanzi:a) Dkt Nozibele Mjoli (uSihlalo)b) Slz Sibusiso Vil-Nkomo (iPhini likaSihlalo)c) Slz Aldo Stroebeld) Nksz Nompumelelo Msezanee) Dkt Mosidi Makgaef) Nksz Masaccha Khulekelwe Mbonambig) Mnu Mxolisi Adolphius Cassius Ndhlovuh) Dkt Ntombifuthi Patience Nala kanyei) Nalowo omele uMnyango Wezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe.

src: Maano ana a tataiswa ke pehelo e akaretsang ya ntshetsopele ya moshwelella, e leng lejwe la motheo la Pono ya 2030 jwaloka ha e hlahella ho NDKa ha sena ke kopano ya ho qetela ya Kabinete bakeng sa 2015, Kabinete e fetisetsa ditakaletso tse molemo ho maAforika Borwa kaofela bakeng sa sehla sa mekete e tlang.
tgt: Ukwelulwa kwenkontileka yomsebenzi kaMnu Thabane Wiseman Zulu njengoMqondisi-Jikelele (u-DG) woMnyango Wezamandla.

src: Ka moya wa sehla sena mme re ntse re imatahantse le moya wa Ubuntu, Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho thusa batho le malapa a hlokang ka hara metse ya bona.
tgt: Dkt Mmaphaka Ephraim Tau oqashwe njengePhini likaMqondisi-Jikelele (u-DDG): oPhikweni Lwezokuphathwa Kwezamahlathi Nengcebo Yemvelo eMnyangweni Wezolimo, Ezamahlathi Nezokudoba.

src: Re setjhaba se kgathallanang, se hlomphanang le ho tshehetsa ba seng lehlohonolo bophelong.
tgt: Nksz Kelebogile Sybil Sethibelo oqashwe njengo-DDG: oPhikweni Lwezokuphatha Nokulawula eMnyangweni Wezobuciko Namasiko.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso le kutlwelobohloko ho lelapa le metswalle ya Mohamed Ismail (“Issy”) Dinat, ya hlokahetseng ka Labobedi, la 8 Tshitwe.
tgt: Mnu Edward Xolisa Makaya oqashwe njengo-DDG: Ophikweni Olwengamele ezase-Afrika eMnyangweni Wezobudlelwano Namazwe Omhlaba Nokubambisana.

src: Ho itela ha hae le ho nka karolo Ntweng kgahlanong le kgethollo di nyehetse bakeng sa tokoloho ya rona.
tgt: Nksz Thulisile Glory Manzini oqashwe njengo-DDG: oPhikweni Lwezokuphatha e-DTPS.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di tla lokelwa ke ho netefatswa ha mangolo a thuto le tumellano e amehang.
tgt: Uma sesiphothula, iKhabhinethi ithanda ukudlulisa amazwi okubonga kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abawathumelile amafomu abo entela, okuyinto eyenze ukuthi inani lamafomu entela athunyeliwe lifinyelele kwizigidi ezingu-.Leli nani lingaphezulu ngamaphesenti ayi-11.52 uma liqhathaniswa nenani lowezi-2014, futhi isibalo sabantu abathumele amafomu abo entela ngesikhathi esibekiwe libe ngaphezulu kwamaphesenti angama-90, osekwenzeke iminyaka emithathu ilandelana.

src: Ngaka Mmaphaka Ephraim Tau jwaloka Motlatsi wa DG (DDG): Bolaodi ba Meru le Mehlodi ya Tlhaho ho Lefapha la Temo, le Ditlhapi.
tgt: Lokhu kubandakanya uMnyango Wezempilo, Nowezolimo, Nowezamaphoyisa, Nowezasekhaya kanye Nophiko Lwezokuqoqwa Kwentela lwaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Qetellong, Kabinete e fetisetsa teboho ya yona ho maAforika Borwa a imatahantseng le ho kenya ditokomane tsa ona tsa lekgetho tse bakileng ho kgutlisetswa kaofela ha ditokomane.
tgt: Bonke abasebenzisi bomgwaqo bayanxuswa ukuthi bahloniphe imithetho yomgwaqo, kubandakanya nokuthobela umkhawulo wejubane nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izimoto zabo zisesimweni esikulungele ukuba semgwaqeni bangashayeli bedakiwe futhi bafase amabhande uma behamba ngemoto.

src: Sena ke diphesente tse 11.52 ho feta ka 2014, mme boimatahanyo ba balefi ba lekgetho ba ho kenya ditokomane ka nako bo feta diphesente tse 90 bakeng sa selemo sa boraro ka tatelano.
tgt: Abantu abahamba ngezinyawo bayanxuswa ukuthi baqinisekise ukuthi ngenkathi besebenzisa umgwaqo ababeki izimpilo zabo engozini kanye nezalabo abahamba ngezimoto.

src: Boemo bona bo hodima ba boimatahanyo bo thusa mmuso ho fana ka ditshebeletso tse ntlafatsang boleng ba bophelo ba baahi bohle ba ona.
tgt: Amaphoyisa omgwaqo azobe ephume ngezinkani ngenhloso yokubhekana ngqo nezaphulamthetho.

src: Nakong ena ya ho keteka, mmuso o kenya tshebetsong matsholo a fapafapaneng a batlang hore maAforika Borwa kaofela le baeti ba bapale karolo ya bona ya ho netefatsa hore nako ya mekete e thabelwa ka hara tikoloho e bolokehileng le ho tshireletseha.

src: Moruo.
tgt: Umnotho.

src: Kabinete e ile ya kopana ho sekaseka maemo a moruo le dintlha tse amanang le ditekanyetso tsa ditjhelete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibambe umhlangano ngenhloso yokubhunga ngesimo somnotho kanye nezindaba ezihlobene nalokhu eziphathelene nesabelomali.

src: Kabinete lemohile dintlha tse ngatanyana tse nang le kgahlamelo moruong wa naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphawule izinto ezimbadlwana ezinomthelela emnothweni wakuleli.

src: Tjhebahalo ya lefatshe e theohile dikgweding tse sa tswa feta moraorao tjena.
tgt: Kulezi zinyanga ezedlule zehlile izilinganiso zesimo somnotho emhlabeni jikelele.

src: Kgolo e batlang e tsamaya butle ya moruo wa lefatshe e bontsha, ka ho qolleha, tshebetso e batlang e fokola le dikotsi tsa ho thefuleha ha moruo tse batlang di phahame ka hara dinaha tse itseng tse ntseng di tswela pele, ho kenyeletswa le China.
tgt: Ukukhula kancane komnotho womhlaba kukhombisa ikakhulukazi ukungaqhubi kahle kanye nobungozi obuphakeme emazweni asathuthuka amaningi asemqoka, kubandakanya nezwe lase-China.

src: Ho iphumana ho lemohilweng ho lebeletsweng ka hara Amerika ho ka nna ha baka ho phahama ha sekgahla sa tswala sa lefatshe.
tgt: Ukusimama komnotho okubhekwe ngabomvu kwelaseMelika kungenzeka kuholele ekukhuphukeni kwamazinga enzalo emhlabeni jikelele.

src: Methamo ya kgwebisano e tetebetseng le ho tsukutleha ho teng ka hara mebaraka ya lefatshe ya ditjhelete e hlakisa tlhokeho ya ho aha botsitso le ho sebetsa ka hloko bakeng sa nako ena eo re e tobileng ka pele ho rona.
tgt: Ukwehla komthamo wokuhwebelana kanye nezinkinga zokungaqhubi kahle kwezimakethe zamazwe omhlaba kugcizelela isidingo sokuthi amazwe athathe izinyathelo ezinohlonze, futhi enze izinto ngokucophelela okukhulu kulesi sikhathi esizayo.

src: Kabinete e boetse e lemohile hore ho ne ho na le melemo e itseng ho tswa ho theko e tlase ya oli e tala.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphawulile futhi ukuthi kukhona imihlomulo ethile etholakalayo ngenxa yentengo ephansi kawoyela ongahluziwe.

src: Jwaloka moreki e moholo wa thepa e tswang mafatsheng a ka ntle, Aforika Borwa e ngongorehile ka ho fokola ho ntseng ho tswela dithekong tsa thepa.
tgt: Njengelizwe eliyisikhondlakhondla ekuthunyelweni kwemikhiqizo yezimbiwa emazweni angaphandle, iNingizimu Afrika ikhathazekile ngesimo esiqhubekayo samanani aphansi entengo yezimbiwa.

src: Mmuso o tswelapele ho ahella hodima sebopeho sa naha se tswakatswakaneng sa moruo, mme kuno ya dihlahiswa tse romellwang dinaheng tsa ka ntle e tswela pele ho itshetleha haholo hodima ditshepe le thepa e tala e song ho lokiswe ka botlalo.
tgt: Uhulumeni uyaqhubeka nokwakha uhlaka lwezomnotho olugxile emikhiqizweni ehlukahlukene, futhi imali etholakala ngokuthunyelwa kwempahla zohwebo emazweni angaphandle isancike kakhulu kwimikhiqizo esansimbi kanye nemikhiqizo engakalungiswa ngokuphelele.

src: Ho wa ha ditheko tsa thepa ha ho bonahale e le ntho e tla tjhetjhang ka potlako.
tgt: Ukwehla kwamanani entengo yezimbiwa akubonakali kuyinto ezophela khona maduze nje.

src: Sena se tla ba le ditlamorao tsa nako e telele bakeng sa moruo wa Aforika Borwa le ho balekane ba rona kontinenteng ya Aforika.
tgt: Lokhu kusazowukhahlameza isikhathi eside umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika futhi kukhahlameze namazwe amaningi esihwebelana nawo kwizwekazi lase-Afrika.

src: Ho fokola ha Ranta dilemong tse mmalwa tse fetileng ho fana ka menyetla e batlang e ba betere bakeng sa kgolo ya thomello ya ka ntle ya thepa le, ha re kopanya le theko e batlang e ba tlase ya oli ya lefatshe, ho thusitse ho imolla kgatello hodima akhaonte ya rona ya hajwale ya matjhaba.
tgt: Ukwehla kwamandla eRandi kule minyaka embalwa edlule kuhlinzeka ngamathuba angcono kakhulu okukhulisa umthamo wempahla ethunyelwa emazweni angaphandle futhi lokhu kanye nentengo ephansi kawoyela ongahluziwe, kulekelelile ekwehliseni ingcindezi emgodlagodleni wezimali kahulumeni wakuleli.

src: Leha ho le jwalo, kgolo e fokolang ho balekane ba ka sehloohong ba kgwebisano ba Aforika Borwa ho bolela tlhoko e fokotsehileng ya dihlahiswa tsa Aforika Borwa mose.
tgt: Kepha-ke, ukungakhuli kahle kweminotho yamazwe ahwebelana neNingizimu Afrika sekuholele ekutheni sehle isidingo sokuthengwa kwezimpahla zaseNingizimu Afrika emazweni angaphandle.

src: Tikoloho ya matjhabeng e nkuwa e le e nang le phephetso e matla bakeng sa dimmaraka tse ntseng di thuthua, ka ditheko tse tlase tsa thepa le ho tiisa lebanta ha leano la ditjhelete la Amerika ho beha kgatello ho phallo ya ditjhelete le ditebello tsa kgolo.
tgt: Isimo sezomnotho esikhona njengamanje emhlabeni jikelele sithathwa njengesiyinselelo enkulu, ikakhulukazi emazweni asafufusa, ngenxa yenani eliphansi lentengo yezimbiwa kanye nokuqiniswa kwenqubomgomo yezezimali yaseMelika, okuyinto efake ingcindezi kwizilinganiso zokungena nokuphuma kwezimali kanye nokukhula komnotho.

src: Sena se fetohetse ho tlhokahalo ya bohlokwa ya botsitso dimmarakeng tsa ditjhelete.
tgt: Lokhu sekulunciphise kakhulu uzinzo ezimakethe zezimali.

src: Ranta ya Aforika Borwa, eo e leng hara ditjhelete tse sebediswang haholo bakeng sa kgwebisano dimmarakeng tse ntseng di thuthua, e thefulehile haholo dibekeng tsa moraorao tjena.
tgt: Kula maviki edlule, iRandi laseNingizimu Afrika, okungolunye lwezinhlobo zemali yamazwe asathuthuka okuhwebelwana ngazo kakhulu, likhahlamezeke kakhulu.

src: Ka hara maemo ana a thata a lefatshe, moo meruo kaofela e tobaneng le diphephetso tse boima, Kabinete e tiisitse botjha tlhokahalo ya mmuso ya ho tla ka mawa a boitshunyako le ho etsa ka matla hore e busetse morao lebelo la kgolo ya moruo.
tgt: Kulesi simo esinzima esibhekene namazwe omhlaba, iKhabhinethi iphinde yagcizelela ukuthi kunesidingo sokuthi uhulumeni angenelele ngendlela enohlonze ukuze kubuyiswe umgqigqo namandla okukhula komnotho.

src: Lewa la Naha la Ntshetsopele (NDP) le fana ka ditsela tsena tsa boitshunyako.
tgt: UHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP) luyakuhlinzekela lokhu kungenelela kukahulumeni.

src: Mmuso o tla ikopanya le balekane ba kahisano, haholoholo dikgwebo le mekgatlo ya basebetsi, bakeng sa ho aha kutlwano mabapi le diketso tse kopanetsweng tse batlehang bakeng sa ho tlisa botsitso moruong, ho aha tshepo, ho phahamisa maemo matsete le ho kgutlisetsa Aforika Borwa motjheng wa kgolo ya moruo o kenyeletsang.
tgt: Futhi uhulumeni uzokwelula isandla kulabo abambisene nabo, ikakhulukazi abamabhizinisi kanye nezinyunyana zabasebenzi, ukuze kube nokuvumelana ngezinyathelo ezizothathwa ngokuhlanganyela zokuletha uzinzo emnothweni wakuleli, nokuqinisekisa ukwethenjwa komnotho, nokukhuphula izinga lokutshalwa kwezimali futhi kubuyiselwe iNingizimu Afrika emgudwini wokuqinisekisa ukukhula komnotho okubandakanya umuntu wonke.

src: Puo ya Boemo ba Naha (SoNA) ka la 11 Tlhakola e tla nkela mosebetsi ona hloohong.
tgt: Inkulumo Echaza Ngesimo Sezwe (i-SoNA) ezokwethulwa mhla ziyi-11 kuNhlolanja izochaza kabanzi ngalo msebenzi okumele wenziwe.

src: Kabinete e thathiselleditse mekgwa e batlang e le matla bakeng sa ho busetsa morao motjha wa tshebediso ya matlotlo a mmuso wa moshwelella, ho ntse ho hlokometswe tjhebahalo e fokolang ya moruo wa lefatshe le ditlamorao tsa ona ka hara naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukuthathwa kwezinyathelo ezinqala zokubuyisela leli lizwe emgudwini wezezimali osimeme, esikhathini lapho isimo sezilinganiso zokukhula komnotho ziphansi kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele kanti futhi lokhu kuyinto enomthelela emnothweni wakuleli.

src: Letona la Ditjhelete Pravin Gordhan le tla kgakola mekgwa e tla nkuwa ha a tla be a teka ditekanyetso tsa naha ka la 24 Tlhakola Matlole bakeng sa Thuto e PhahamengKabinete e tjhaelletse monwana dihlomathiso ho dikabo tsa ditekanyetso tsa naha tse tla suthisa mehlodi ya ho thusa diyunivesithi ka matlole ntle le ho tlola meedi ya tshebediso ya tjhelete e phatlaladitsweng pejana.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezezimali u-Pravin Gordhan uzohlinzeka ngemininingwane ephathelene nalezi zinyathelo ngenkathi ethula isabelomali sezwe mhla zingama-24 Nhlolanja Ukuxhaswa ngezimali komkhakha wezeMfundo EphakemeIKhabhinethi izamukelile izichibiyelo ezenziwe kwizabelomali zikazwelonke ezizoholela ekutheni kuthathwe imali ebeyabelwe imiklamo ethile inikezwe amanyuvesi, ngaphandle kokuthi kwephulwe imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezimali ebimenyezelwe phambilini.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma le Letona la Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello Blade Nzimande haufinyana tjena ba tshwaile hore dikabo tsena di tla akaretsa ho se nyolohe ha ditefello hoo ho dumellanweng ka hona bakeng sa selemo sa hajwale sa dithuto, ho tlosa mokitlane oo esale o bokellana o kolotwang ke baithuti ba Sekema sa Naha sa Dithuso tsa Ditjhelete tsa Baithuti (NSFAS) le ho thibela ho bokellana ha mokitlane o jwalo bakeng sa nako e bohareng.
tgt: Esikhathini esifushane esedlule uMongameli Jacob Zuma kanye noNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqesha u-Blade Nzimande bamemezele ukuthi le mali izonikezwa izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme ngenhloso yokuzinxephezela njengoba kuvunyelwane ngokuthi ingakhushulwa imali yokukhokhela imfundo ephakeme ngalo nyaka wezemfundo, futhi kukhokhwe ngokuphelele sonke isikweleti semali ekweletwa abafundi abangaphansi koHlelo Lukazwelonke Lokuxhaswa Kwabafundi Ngezimali (i-NSFAS) futhi kuvinjelwe nokukhula kwalesi sikweleti esikhathini esimaphakathi.

src: Mekgwa ena ya boitshunyako ke karabelo ho ditherisano tse ngatanyana tse qadileng ka Phato2015 mme di ntse di tswella.
tgt: Lezi zinyathelo zokungenelela ziyimpendulo kahulumeni kwiziphakamiso ezenziwe ezigcawini zokubonisana eziningana eziqale ngoMfumfu 2015 futhi eziqhubekayo.

src: Letona la Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello mmoho le sehlopha sa hae sa bolaodi ba tshwere dikopano tse ngatanyana le ketapele ya SASCO, Makgotla kaofela a Baemedi ba Baithuti, Foramo ya Diyunivesithi ya Aforika Borwa, Kopano ya Baithuti ya Aforika Borwa, diCEO tsadiSETA, Mokgatlo wa Diphethoho tsa Thuto e Phahameng le komiti ya Palamente e ikarabellang bakeng sa thuto e phahameng.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqesha kanye nethimba lakhe labaphathi babambe imihlangano eminingana nabaholi be-SASCO, nayo yonke iMikhandlu Emele Abafundi (ama-SRC), neNhlangano Yabafundi BeNyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika, neNyunyana Yabafundi baseNingizimu Afrika, nabaPhathi Abakhulu (ama-CEO) bama-SETA, neNhlangano Yoguquko Kwezemfundo Ephakeme kanye nekomidi lasePhalamende elengamele ezemfundo ephakeme.

src: Moporesidente hape o kopane le ketapele ya baithuti le ho phatlalatsa ho thehwa ha Khomishene e tla shebana le dintlha tse hlahisitsweng mabapi le Thuto e phahameng.
tgt: UMongameli uphinde futhi wabamba umhlangano nabaholi babafundi, futhi wamemezela ukuthi kuzosungulwa iKhomishana ezocubungula izindaba eziphathelene neMfundo Ephakeme.

src: Dipuisano tsena di ntse di tswela pela kaha re dumela jwaloka mmuso hore re lokela ho sebeletsa ho fumana tharollo ya moshwelella.
tgt: Lezi zigcawu zokubonisana ziyaqhubeka njengoba sikholelwa ekutheni njengohulumeni kumele sizabalazele ukuthola isixaluzululo esizoziqeda unomphela lezi nkinga.

src: Ditseko tsa baithuti di imatahantse le morero wa lenaneo la mmuso le mabapi le thuto.
tgt: Izimfuno zabafundi ziyahambelana nezinjongo zohlelo lukahulumeni oluphathelene nezemfundo.

src: Jwaloka mokgwa o potlakileng, R.33 bilione e abilwe bakeng sa ho rarolla kgaello e mabapi le matlole a tshebetso a diyunivesithi ka lebaka la tumellano ya keketseho ya ditefello tsa 0% bakeng sa Selemong sa ditjhelete sa 2016/17, mmuso o phetile botjha ho beha ka sehloohongR.543 bilione ya matlole a mmuso a tla abelwa NSFAS bakeng sa ho fana ka dikadimo ho thusa baithuti ba 71 753 ba hlwailweng ho tshwanelwa ke dithuso tsa NSFAS empa ka mohlomong ba ile ba thola thuso e haellang kapa ba sa e tholang ho hang dilemong tse tharo tse fetileng tsa dithuto.
tgt: Njengesinyathelo esiphuthumayo sokubhekana nesimo esikhona njengamanje, kubekwe eceleni isamba semali engamarandi ayizigidigidi ezingu-2.33 okuhloswe ngayo ukuvala isikhala sokushoda kwemali yokuqhuba umsebenzi wansukuzonke emanyuvesi ngenxa yesivumelwano sokungakhushulwa kwemali yokufunda ngowezi-20.

src: Sena se bolela hore baithuti bana ba tshwanelwang ke thuso ba keke ba thibelwa ho tswela pele ka dithuto tsa bona hobane ba kolota diyunivesithi ditjhelete tse saletseng morao.
tgt: Ngonyaka-mali wezi-2016/17, uhulumeni ubeke eceleni imali yoMbuso engamarandi ayizigidigidi ezingu-2.543 ezokwabelwa i-NSFAS ngenhloso yokuboleka abafundi abahlonziwe abayizi-71 753 abakulungele ukuxhaswa ngezimali ngaphansi kohlelo lwe-NSFAS kodwa kule minyaka emithathu edlule abathole uxhaso lwezimali olungaphelele noma abangalutholanga uxhaso lwezimali.

src: Tlatsetso ya R.039 bilione e tla abelwa NSFAS selemong sa dithuto sa 2016/17 ho tshehetsa baithuti ba sa tholang thuso kapa ba thotseng thuso e haellang ba ntseng ba le ka hara tsamaiso ya diyunivesithi ka 2016 bakeng sa ho phethela mangolo a bona a thuto.
tgt: Lokhu kusho ukuthi laba bafundi abakulungele ukuxhaswa ngezimali ngeke basavimbeleka ekutheni bakwazi ukuqhubeka nemfundo yabo ngenxa yemali abayikweletayo.

src: Matlole ana ke tlatsetso ya R10 bilione eo NSFAS e tla e laolang selemong sa dithuto sa 2016.Mmuso o itlamme bakeng sa ho fana ka thuto ya kamora sekolo bakeng sa baithuti kaofela ba tshwanelehang e sa lefellweng moo e fuwang ba futsanehileng le ba sebetsang mesebetsi e tlase, ka hara meedi ya ditjhelete tsa mmuso ya moshwelella.
tgt: Kunesinye isamba semali engamarandi ayizigidigidi ezingu-2.039 ezokwabelwa i-NSFAS ngonyaka-mali wezi-2016/17 ngenhloso yokuxhasa labo bafundi abasesemanyuvesi ngowezi-2016 abangalutholi uxhaso lwezimali noma abathola uxhaso lwezimali olungaphansi kwalolo abaludingayo, ukuze bakwazi ukuphothula izifundo zabo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho baithuti bohle, basebetsi, dirutehi le batsamaisi ba diyunivesithi ho sebetsa mmoho le mmuso bakeng sa ho fihlella sepheo sena.
tgt: Lena yimali ezokwengezwa phezu kwesamba semali engamarandi ayizigidigidi eziyi-10 ezolawulwa futhi yabiwe yi-NSFAS ngonyaka wemfundo wezi-2016.Uhulumeni uzibophezele ekuhlinzekeni imfundo ephakeme mahhala kubo bonke abafundi abaqhamuka emakhaya adla imbuya ngothi futhi abaqhuba kahle ezifundweni zabo kulezo zikhungo zemfundo abafunda kuzona, ngaphansi kwemikhawulo yezimali ezikhona emgodlagodleni wezimali zikahulumeni.

src: Diketso tse sitisang ho ithuta kapa tse bakang ditebello tse hlokang kellello le ho sa fihlellehe ha bonolo ha di na molemo wa letho.
tgt: Izenzo eziphazamisa ukufunda noma eziletha amathemba okungeke kufinyelelwe kuwona ziyibuyisela emuva inqubekela-phambili enhle eseyenziwe.

src: Dikgoka le ditshoso ha di batlehe.
tgt: Azamukelekile nakancane izenzo zodlame nokusabisa.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho MaAforika Borwa oohle ho ananela hore ho na le maemo a phephetso nakong eo re lebaneng le yona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabanxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi bakwamukele ukuthi esikhathini esizayo sizobhekana nezimo ezinzima.

src: Maemo a moruo wa lefatshe a se a fokola.
tgt: Isimo somnotho emhlabeni sintekenteke kakhulu.

src: Kgahlamelo ya ditheko tsa thepa tse theohileng e se e utlwahala ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Umthelela ongemuhle wamanani aphansi entengo yezimbiwa usuyazwakala eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Mathata a ka hara naha a jwaloka motlakase o sa le lekanang a ntse a le teng ka hara rona.
tgt: Ziyaqhubeka izingqinamba esibhekene nazo, ngenkinga yokushoda kwamandla okuphakelwa kukagesi.

src: Komello e matla e baka mathata diporofenseng tse ding.
tgt: Isomiso esesabekayo esiqhubekayo njengamanje sesidale ubunzima obukhulu ezifundazweni eziningi zakuleli.

src: Kabinete e na le tshepo ya hore MaAforika Borwa a dula e le setjhaba se tsitsitseng se tsebang molemo wa ho sebetsa mmoho ka kgotso le kutlwano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inethemba lokuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayaqhubeka nokuba yisizwe esinohlonze, esikwaziyo ukubaluleka kokusebenza ngokubambisana futhi ngokuthula noxolo.

src: Ho pepeswa ha moraorao tjena ha batho ba nang le ditumelo tsa bosemorabe ho matlafaditse boitlamo ba rona bo kopanetsweng ba ho aha setjhaba se hlokang kgethollo ya merabe, kgethollo ya bong le se tswetseng pele.
tgt: Ukudalulwa kwamagama abantu abanezinkolelo zokucwasana ngokobuhlanga okwenzeke esikhathini esifushane esedlule sekuqinise ukuzibophezela kwethu ngokuhlanganyela ekhwakheni umphakathi ongacwasi ngokobuhlanga nangokobulili futhi osimeme nophumelelayo.

src: DithonyoKabinete e tjhaelletse monwana dithonyo tse latelang:.
tgt: AbaqashiweIKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukuqashwa kwalaba abalandelayo:.

src: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mananeo a bohlokwa a mmuso.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni ezisemqoka.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Puo ya Maemo a Setjhaba ya Moporesidente Jacob Zuma eo a e entseng ka Labone, 11 Hlakola.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamukele Inkulumo Echaza Isimo Sezwe kaMongameli Jacob Zuma ethulwe ngoLwesine, ziyi-11 kuNhlolanja.

src: Puo ena e tekile motjha wa lewa la ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha lenaneo la tshebetso la mmuso.
tgt: Le nkulumo ithula umgudu wamaqhinga wokuqalisa ukusebenza kohlelo lokusebenza lukahulumeni.

src: Moporesidente o ipileditse ho mmuso, basebetsi le borakgwebo ho sebetsa mmoho bakeng sa ho fumana ditharollo bakeng sa kgolo ya moruo ya moshwelella.
tgt: UMongameli unxuse uhulumeni, abasebenzi kanye nabamabhizinisi ukuba basebenzisane ukuthola izixazululo zokukhula komnotho okusimeme.

src: Kabinete e tshehetsa mekgwa ya ho fokotsa ditjeho e phatlaladitsweng ke Moporesidente, e tla hlaloswa ho ya pele ke Letona la Ditjhelete ka la 24 Hlakola.
tgt: IKhabinethi isekela izinyathelo zokunciphisa izindleko ezimenyezelwe nguMongameli, ezizochazwa kabanzi nguNgqongqoshe Wezezimali mhla zingama-24 kuNhlolanja.

src: Puo ya Ditekanyetso ya 2016/17 e tla boela e fana ka moralo wa ho abuwa ha mehlodi ho mananeo a fapafapaneng a mmuso jwaloka ha Moporesidente a tobokeditse.
tgt: INkulumo Yesabelomali yonyaka wezi-2016/17 izophinda iveze ukwabiwa kwezinsizakusebenza kuzinhlelo zeminyango ezihlukahlukene njengoba kugcizelelwe nguMongameli.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Indaba ya Merafo e atlehileng, e neng e tshwaretswe Motse Kapa ho tloha ka la 8 ho isa ka la 11 Hlakola.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukele ukubanjwa ngempumelelo kweNgqungquthela Yezimayini, ebibanjelwe eDolobheni LaseKapa kusukela ziyi-8 kwaze kwaba mhla ziyi-11 kuNhlolanja.

src: Baemedi ba ka sehloohong ho tswa ho lekala la merafo le mebuso e seng mekae ho tswa Aforika ba ile ba arolelana mehopolo ya bona ya kamoo lekala lena le ka kgannang matsete le ho sebedisa lesoba la menyetla e teng ka hara Aforika.
tgt: Izikhulu eziqhamuka kumkhakha wezokuvukuza kanye nakohulumeni abaningana base-Afrika zabelane ngemibono yazo ukuthi lo mkhakha ungalunxenxa kanjani utshalomali uphinde usebenzise ngempumelelo amathuba akhona e-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e kgahlisitswe ke boitlamo bo entsweng ke mmuso wa Japane ba ho eketsa matsete ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuthokozele ukuzibophezela okwenziwe nguhulumeni wase-Japan kokwandisa utshalomali lwakhe eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tiiseditse botjha boitlamo ba yona ba lekala la merafo le tsitsitseng le ho atleha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqinisekisile ukuzibophezela kwayo kumkhakha wezokuvukuza ozinzile futhi okhulayo.

src: Moralo wa Tumellano bakeng sa Indaseteri ya Merafo ya Moshwelella e tshehetsa indaseteri ya Merafo tikolohong ena ya hajwale e boima.
tgt: UMhlahlandlela Wesivumelwano Semboni Yezokuvukuza Ezinzile usekela imboni yezokuvukuza esimweni samanje esinzima.

src: Mmuso o tswela pele ho fana ka bonnete ba taolo mme o tla netefatsa ho phethelwa ha Bili ya Ntshetsopele ya Taolo ya Mehlodi ya Diminerale le Peterole, e tekilweng ka pela Palamente.
tgt: Uhulumeni uyaqhubeka nokucacisa imithetho eza kusetyenziswa futhi uzoqinisekisa ukuthi uMthethosivivinywa Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezimbiwaphansi Nopethroli, osezithebeni zePhalamende, uyaphothulwa.

src: Diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi eziqavile.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Leano la ho Kembola la ho qetela, le shebaneng le diphephetso tse sitisang bohlwahlwa ba Molao wa Naha wa ho Kembola, 2004 (Molao 7 wa 2004).
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphasise Inqubomgomo Kazwelonke Yezokugembula yokugcina, exazulula izinselele ezithiya ukusebenza ngempumelelo koMthetho Kazwelonke Wezokugembula, wezi-2004 (uMthetho we-7 wezi-2004).

src: Leano lena le se le ile la tekelwa setjhaba hore se tshwaele.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo isidlulile ohlelweni lokudingidwa kwayo nomphakathi.

src: Leano lena le sisinya dihlomathiso ho meralo ya dibopeho tsa taolo ya diboto tsa ho kembola le ho matlafatsa mekgwa ya taolo bakeng sa ho fokotsa tshebediso e mpe ya ho kembola.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo iphakamisa izichibiyelo kumhlahlandlela wokulawula wezigungu zokugembula futhi iqinisa izindlela zokulawula ngenhloso yokunciphisa ukugembula budedengu.

src: E sebetsa ho dikhasino, bingo, metjhini e lekanyeditsweng tjhelete le ho dipetjho tsa mejaho ya dipere.
tgt: Ufaka amakhasino, amabhingo, imishini ekhona izamba ezithile, kanye nokubhejela amahhashi.

src: Leano le tla kena bakeng sa Boto ya Naha ya ho Kembola le Bolaodi ba Naha ba ho Kembola bo tla tlaleha ka ho otloloha ho Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo izoqeda Isigungu Sikazwelonke Sokugembula kungene Umlawuli Kazwelonke Wezokugembula esikhundleni saso nozokuba ngaphansi koMnyango Wezokuhweba Nezezimboni.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha Tlaleho ya Tjhebo botjha ya Dilemo tsa ho Lokelwa ho Tshwarelwa Botlokotsebe ho Palamente, e batlehang ho ya ka Molao wa Toka wa Bana, 2008 (Molao 75 wa 2008).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukele ukulethwa ePhalamende koMbiko Wokubuyekezwa Kweminyaka Ephansi Yokuphila Kwengqondo Ukuze Utholakale unecala lobelelesi, nokudingekayo ngokoMthetho Wezobulungiswa Bezingane, wezi-2008 (uMthetho wama-75 wezi-2008).

src: Tlaleho e kgothaletsa hore naha e amohele ditshwanelo tsa matjhaba le tsa lebatowa tse mabapi le dilemo tsa ho lokelwa ho tshwarelwa botlokotsebe ha bana ba tlolang molao.
tgt: Lo mbiko uphakamisa ukuthi izwe lisebenzise izibopho zomhlaba nesifunda mayelana neminyaka ephansi yokuphila kwengqondo ukuze utholakale unecala lobelelesi lezingane eziphula umthetho.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa koranteng ya mmuso ha Dibaka tsa Ntshetsopele ya Eneji e ka Hlabollwang Botjha (REDZ).
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukumenyezelwa kweZindawo Zokuphehlwa Kwamandla Asebenziseka Kabusha (i-REDZ).

src: Tsena di tla tsamaisa mekgwa ya taolo ka motjha o le mong, ho hlwaya dibaka tsa tlhaho moo dithekenoloji tsa ho sebedisa matla a moya le a letsatsi bakeng sa motlakase di ka qalwang le moo katoloso ya marangrang a ‘tebileng’ a ka lebiswang teng.
tgt: Lokhu kuzoqondisa izinhlelo zokulawula, kuhlonze izindawo zebalazwe lapho ubuchwepheshe be-Photovoltaic obusebenzisa umonya nelanga kungasetshenziswa khona futhi lapho kungandiswa khona kakhulu ukuphehlwa kukagesi ongena ezintanjeni zikagesi zikazwelonke.

src: DiREDZ di tla netefatsa ho fetohela ho moruo wa khabone e tlase, ho akofisa ntshetsopele ya meralo ya motheo, le ho nyehela ho moralo wa taolo o kopaneng le ho kgonahala o tla fokotsa bolaodi bo tomanyana bo amanang le ditjeho tsa boimatahanyo.
tgt: Lawa ma-REDZ azoqinisekisa ukuguqukela kumnotho ongcolisa kancane, ukusheshiswa kokuthuthukiswa kwengqalasizinda, kanye nokufaka isandla kumhlahlandlela ocacile noqagulekayo onciphisa izithiyo ezihlobene nezindleko zokuthobela umthetho.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka diphihlello tsa Tlaleho ya Ditshupane tsa 2014 tsa Saense, Thekenoloji le Dintjhafatso tsa Lekgotla la Naha la Boeletsi la Ntjhafatso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngemiphumela Yombiko Wezinkomba ZaseNingizimu Afrika Zesayensi, Ezobuchwepheshe Nokusungula zonyaka we-2014 woMkhandlu Kazwelonke Olulekayo Wezokusungula.

src: Tlaleho e fana ka diketsahalo ho tshebetso ya Tsamaiso ya Naha ya Dintlafatso (NSI).
tgt: Umbiko uhlinzeka lokho okuvamise ukwenzeka ekusebenzeni koHlelo Lukazwelonke Lwezokusungula.

src: E hlahloba tshebetso le nyehelo ya NSI ho dintlha tsa bohlokwa tse ka sehloohong tse tekilweng ho Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP).
tgt: Luhlola ukusebenza kanye nomthelela we-NSI emisebenzini kazwelonke eseqhulwini njengoba ivezwe kuHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kweze (i-NDP).

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana tshebediso ya basebeletsi ba mmuso ba behileng meja fatshe le ba ntseng ba sebetsa jwaloka barupelli ho Sekolothupello sa Naha sa Mmuso (NSG).NSG e ile ya thakgolwa ka 2013, e nka sebaka sa Akhademi ya Boetapele ba Tsamaiso ya Setjhaba le Bolaodi (PALAMA), mme e romilwe ho hodisa temoho e tswetseng pele ya boleng le dipehelo tse laolang tsamaiso ya setjhaba le ho matlafatsa boleng, bophara le kgahlamelo ya ntshetsopele ya mehlodi ya bokgoni ba batho dikahong tsa mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukusetshenziswa kwabafundisi bezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme esebethathe umhlalaphansi kanye nabasebenzi bakahulumeni njengabafundisi baseSikoleni Sikahulumeni Sikazwelonke (i-NSG).I-NSG yathulwa ngokusemthethweni ngonyaka we-2013, esikhundleni seSikhungo Sikahulumeni Sokuphatha Nobuholi (i-PALAMA), futhi sinegunya lokukhuthaza ukufezwa kwemigomo ebusa ukulawula kuhulumeni kanye nokwenza ngcono izinga, ubukhulu kanye nomthelela wokuthuthukiswa kwamandla ezokuphathwa kwezabasebenzi ezikhungweni.

src: Boikitlaetso bona bo tla lekwa ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lenaneo le Tlamang la ho Rutwa Mosebetsi bakeng sa basebeletsi ba mmuso.
tgt: Lesi sinyathelo sizohlolwa ngokuqaliswa kokusetshenziswa koHlelo Oluphoqelekile Lokwamukelwa Kwabasebenzi bakahulumeni.

src: Katamelo ena e thusa basebeletsi ba setjhaba ho eketsa boleng ho tshebeletso ya setjhaba.
tgt: Le ndlela yenza ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bakwazi ukwengeza ukubaluleka emsebenzini kahulumeni.

src: Ba tla fana ka boiphihlelo ba bona, botsebi, maitsebelo le tsebo ya ho tataisa le ho kwetlisa basebeletsi ba setjhaba.
tgt: Bazokhipha isipiliyoni, amakhono kanye nolwazi lwabo ukuqeqesha abasebenzi bakahulumeni.

src: Boikitlaetso bona bo tla ntlafatsa ho ya pele ka tsela e hlwahlwa e fokotsang ditjeho tsa boleng ba ditshebeletso tseo re di nehang setjhaba.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luzophinda lwenze ngcono ngendlela eyimpumelelo futhi engabizi izinga lezinsizakalo esizihlinzeka umphakathi.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Tlaleho ya Qetelo ya Mokgahlelo 3 ya Aforika Borwa ya Naha ya ho Kenngwa Tshebetsong ya Mokgatlo wa Tshebedisano-mmoho le Ntshetsopele (OECD) (Khonvenshene e Kgahlanong le Tjotjo).Tlaleho e lokela ho kenngwa ho Sehlopha sa Tshebetso sa OECD sa Tjotjo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume Umbiko Wezwe LaseNingizimu Afrika Wesigaba Sokugcina sesi-3 omayelana nokuqala koKusebenza Kwenhlangano Yezentuthuko Nokubambisana Kwezomnotho (i-OECD) (Isivumelwano Sokulwa Nokufumbathisa).

src: Tlaleho e hlakisa kgatelopele e entsweng ke mmuso boitshunyakong ba ona ba ho thibela tjotjo dinaheng tsa ka ntle ka ho e fokisa, ho e fuputsa le ho e tjhutjhisa.
tgt: Umbiko uzonikezwa Iqembu Elisebenza Ngokufumbathisa le-OECD.

src: Tlaleho hape e hlakisa boikitlaetso bo nkuweng ho hlahisa temoso ka botlokotsebe bona.7 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae (DHA) le kenyeletswe ka tlasa Lepheo la Toka, Thibelo ya Botlokotsebe le Polokeho.
tgt: Lo mbiko uveza inqubekela phambili eyenziwe nguhulumeni ekungeneleleni kwakhe ukuqeda ukufumbathisa okwenziwa ngabantu abavela emazweni angaphandle ngokubona, ukuphenya kanye nokushushisa amacala amayelana nakho.

src: Thomo ya Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae ke ho boloka rejisatara e tshireleditsweng, e nepahetseng ya boitsebiso le maemo a bohle ba ka hara meedi ya naha ya bo rona, e leng sethusi se hlokolosi sa mesebetsi e meng kaofela ya puso.
tgt: Lo mbiko uphinda uveze izinyathelo ezithathiwe ukuqwashisa ngalobu bugebengu.7 IKhabhinethi ivume ukuthi uMnyango Wezasekhaya (i-DHA) ufakwe kabusha Eqoqwaneni Lezobulungiswa, Ukuvinjelwa Kobugebengu Nezokuphepha.

src: Hape le romilwe ho laola tsamaiso ya bofalli, bo nang le kgahlamelo e otlolohileng ho tshireletso ya naha, momahano ya kahisano le phihlello ya dipheo tsa ntshetsopele.
tgt: Igunya loMnyango Wezasekhaya wukugcina irejista ephephile, enolwazi okuyilonalona lomazisi kanye nesimo sawo wonke umuntu ongaphakathi kwemigcele yethu, nekwenza kwenzeke yonke eminye imisebenzi yombuso.

src: Mehleng DHA e ne e nkuwa jwaloka tshehetso e akaretsang ya ditshebeletso tsa tsamaiso tlasa lepheo la Taolo le Tsamaiso.
tgt: Uphinde wanikezwa igunya lokusingatha uhlelo lokufuduka, olunomthelela ngqo ekuphepheni kwezwe, ukubumbana komphakathi kanye nokufezwa kwezinhloso zentuthuko.

src: Dibili.1 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha Bili ya Tshireletso, Kgothaletso, Ntshetsopele le Bolaodi ba Tsebo ya tsa Lapeng ho Palamente.
tgt: Ngaphambili i-DHA ibifakwe ngaphansi kweqoqwana likaHulumeni Nokulawulwa komsebenzi ojwayelekile wokusekela ukulawula.

src: Bili ena, e reretswe ho tshireletsa, ho kgothaletsa ntshetsopele le bolaodi ba ditsamaiso tsa Tsebo ya ka Lapeng.
tgt: Imithethosivivinywa.1 IKhabhinethi ikuphasisile ukwethulwa ePhalamende koMthethosivivinywa Wokuvikela, Ukukhuthaza, Ukuthuthukiswa Nokusingathwa Kolwazi Lwendabuko.

src: E fana ka ho thehwa le mesebetsi ya kantoro ya ditsamaiso tsa Naha tsa Tsebo ya ka Lapeng, bolaodi ba batshwari ba ditokelo tsa tsebo ya tsa lapeng, ho thehwa le mesebetsi ya moifo wa Boeletsi wa ditsamaiso tsa tsebo ya tsa lapeng.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa ukuvikela, ugqugquzele intuthuko nokulawula Kwezinhlelo Zolwazi lwendabuko.

src: Hape e dumella phumantsho le dipehelo tsa phumantsho ya tsebo ya tsa lapeng le ho badudi ba lehae, ho thehwa ha tsamaiso ya naha ya direkoto tsa setjhaba tsa ditsamaiso tsa tsebo ya tsa lapeng, boingodiso, ho dumellwa le phano ya ditifikeiti tsa ditsebi tsa ka lapeng, thuso le kgokahanyo ya tsebo ya tsa lapeng e itshetlehileng hodima ntjhafatso.
tgt: Uhlinzeka ukusungulwa kanye nemisebenzi yehhovisi Likazwelonke Lezinhlelo Zolwazi Lwendabuko, ukuphathwa kwamalungelo abanikazi bolwazi lwendabuko, ukusungulwa kanye nemisebenzi yephaneli yokweLuleka ngezinhlelo zolwazi lwendabuko.

src: Bili e tla tlatseletsa Sehlomathiso sa Molao wa Thuo ya Thepa, 2013 (Molao 28 wa 2013).Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Dingodiso tsa Mangolo a Matlo ya 2015 bakeng sa ho tshwaela ha setjhaba.
tgt: Uphinda uvumele ukufinyelela kanye nemibandela yokufinyelela olwazini lwemiphakathi yendabuko neyendawo, ukusungulwa kohlelo lokuqopha lwezinhlelo zolwazi lwendabuko, ukubhaliswa, ukugunyazwa kanye nokunikezwa izitifiketi kongoti bolwazi lwendabuko, ukulawulwa nokuqondiswa kokusungula okuncike olwazini lwendabuko.

src: Bili e hlomathisa Molao wa Dingodiso tsa Mangolo a Matlo, 1937 (Molao 47 wa 1937).
tgt: Lo mthethosivivinywa uzosekela Umthetho Oyisichibiyelo Wemithetho Yobunikazi Bolwazi, wezi-2013 (uMthetho wa-28 wezi-2013).IKhabhinethi ivume ukushicilelwa koMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela Iregistra Yamatayitela yonyaka wezi-2015 ukuthi umphakathi uphawule ngawo.

src: Bili e rerile ho hlomathisa Molao wa Dingodiso tsa Mangolo a Matlo, 1937 (Molao 47 wa 1937) bakeng sa ho falla ho tloha ho mekgwa ya pampiri ho ya ho ya elektroniki kantorong ya mangolo a matlo.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho Weregistra Yamatayitela, we-1937 (uMthetho wama-47 we-1937).

src: E shebana le dintlha tsa polokeho ka ho fana ka boingodiso ba boramolao ba matlo jwaloka basebedisi ba tsamaiso ya elektroniki ya boingodiso ba mangolo a matlo.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uhlose ukuchibiyela uMthetho Wamaregistra Amatayitela, we-1937 (uMthetho wa-47 we-1937) ukuze kufudukwe kusukwa ekusebenzeni ngephepha kuyiwe kulezo ezisebenza ngobuchwepheshe ehhovisi lamatayitela.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha Bili ya Tshireletso ya Dimela (Bophelo bo botle ba dimela) ya 2015 ho Palamente.
tgt: Uxazulula izindaba zezokuphepha ngokuhlinzeka ukubhalisa kwabadlulisi bezakhiwo njengabasebenzisi abasemthethweni bohlelo lwezobuchwepheshe lokubhaliswa kwamatayitela.2 IKhabhinethi ikuvuphasisile ukulethwa ePhalamende koMthethosivivinywa wezi-2015 Wempilo Yezihlahla.

src: Bili e matahanya molao wa Aforika Borwa le ditshwanelo le maemo a amehang ho thusa ka kgwebisano ya matjhaba e bolokehileng le e hlokang leeme ho tshireletsa kgwebo ya naha ya ka lapeng le ya matjhaba ya dimela le dihlahiswa tsa dimela.
tgt: Lo mthethosivivinywa wenza umthetho waseNingizimu Afrika uhambisane nezibopho kanye namazinga ukwenza lula futhi kube nobulungiswa ukuhweba komhlaba ukuphephisa ukuhweba komhlaba nokwaleli lizwe ngezihlahla kanye nemikhiqizo yezihlahla.

src: Hang ha bili e se e pasitse, Aforika Borwa e tla kgona ho thibela ho kena ha dikokonyana le mafu a ka ntle a thibetsweng a ka hasanyang dikokonyana le mafu a kotsi ka hara naha.
tgt: Uma lo Mthethosivivinywa usuphasile, iNingizimu Afrika izokwazi ukuvimbela ukwethulwa kwezindlela zokuhlukanisa zangaphandle zezinambuzane nezifo ezingasabalalisa izinambuzane eziyingozi kanye nezifo zezitshalo kuleli lizwe.3 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukwethulwa ePhalamende koMthethosivivinywa wezi-2015 Ochibiyela Umthetho Wezinkantolo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Molao wa Makgotla a Dinyewe wa 2015 ho Palamente.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho Wezinkantolo Zezimantshi, we-1944 (uMthetho wa-32 we-1944) noMthetho Wokuchibiyela Izinkantolo Eziphakeme, wezi-2013 (uMthetho we-10 wezi-2013).Izichibiyelo zihlose ukuphungula usizi lwabakweletayo abazithola behlukunyezwa ohlelweni lokuqoqa izikweletu ezinkantolo zezimantshi kanye nokufaka uhlelo loMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni lokususa ulwazi lwezikweletu zabathengi olungeluhle.

src: Bili e hlomathisa Molao wa Makgotla a Bomaseterata, 1944 (Molao 32 wa 1944) le Sehlomathiso sa Molao wa Makgotla a Maholo, 2013 (Molao 10 wa 2013).Dihlomathiso di rerile ho fedisa bothata ba boradikoloto ba iphumanang ba le lehlakoreng la tshebediso e mpe tsamaisong ya ho bokella mekitlane makgotleng a bomaseterata le ho amohela porojeke ya Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri ho tlosa tlhahisoleseding e tlontlollang ya mekitlane ya bareki.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uhlose ukuchibiyela izingxenye zoMthetho Wezinkantolo Zezimantshi, we-1994 (uMthetho wa-32 we-1994) (i-MCA), ukubhekana nokusetshenziswa budedengu koMyalelo Wokuchibiyela Izinkokhelo (i-EAO).Lo Mthethosivivinywa uhlose ukubhekana futhi uqede izahlulelo ezikhishwa ngokungemthetho, kakhulukazi ngonobhala bezinkantolo ngaphandle kokubheka umthetho, izikhathi eziningi ngenxa yokungazi noma ukuhlangana nabakweletwayo, nabameli babo noma nabaqoqi bezikweletu.

src: Bili e rerile ho hlomathisa dikarolo tsa Molao wa Makgotla a Bomaseterata, 1994 (Molao 32 wa 1994) (MCA), ho shebana le tshebediso e mpe ho Taelo ya Kgapo ya Thepa (EAO).
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uzoqinisekisa ukuthi abakweletwayo banikezwa izahlulelo ezihambisana nomyalelo wokukhokha ngamancozuncozu noma Umyalelo Wokuthathwa Kwezinkokhelo ohambisana nemali esemthethweni ebekelwe ukuthi ikhokhwe.

src: Bili e rerile ho shebana le, le ho fedisa dikahlolo tse fanwang ka tsela e seng molaong, haholo ke ditlelereke tsa makgotla a dinyewe ntle le ho laelwa ke lekgotla, boholo ba nako ka lebaka la ho hloka boiphihlelo kapa ho sebetsa mmoho le ba kolotwang, babuelli ba bona kapa babokelli ba mekitlane.
tgt: Imicimbi ezayo.1 Impelaviki yokuqala yokubhalisa abavoti bebhalisela Ukhetho Lukahulumeni Wasekhaya lonyaka we-2016 kuzoqhutshwa mhla zi-5 zize zibe yi-6 Ndasa 2016.

src: Bili e tla netefatsa hore boradikoloto ba fuwa kahlolo e imatahanyang le taelo ya setolomente kapa Taelo ya Kgapo ya Thepa e ka hara sekepele se molaong sa setolomente.
