src: Dikgau tsena di ne di ananela batho ba phelang ka boqhwala le balwanedi ba ditokelo tsa batho ba phelang ka boqhwala ba ipabotseng ka makgabane selemong sa 2015.
tgt: Le miklomelo ihlonipha abantu abaphila nokukhubazeka kanye nezishoshovu zamalungelo okukhubazeka abenze umsebenzi oncomekayo ngonyaka we-2015.

src: Kabinete e tlotla bahlodi bohle ba Dikgau tsa bo-3 tsa Naha tsa Selemo ka seng tsa Boqhetseke tsa Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa ya Aforika Borwa (SAPS), tse lebisang hlompho ho boqhetseke ba ditho tsa SAPS, maresefe le diforamo tsa badudi tsa sepolesa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela bonke abanqobile ku-3rd South African Police Service (SAPS) Excellence Awards, abonga umsebenzi oncomekayo wamalungu e-SAPS, amarizevu kanye namalungu ezinkundla zamaphoyisa omphakathi.

src: Kabinete hape e thoholetsa bangodimmoho Mandla Dube le Leon Otto ba Pambili Media bakeng sa filimi Kalushi: The Story of Solomon Mahlangu.
tgt: IKhabinethi ihalalisela abalobi abahlanganyele uMandla Dube no-Leon Otto we-Pambili Media ngefilimu ethi Kalushi: The Story of Solomon Mahlangu.

src: MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho boha setlabolane sena sa dipolotiki ka ho fetohela ha mohlankana ya motjha ya dilemo di 19 ya hlahang Mamelodi, ka Botjhabela ho Pretoria, ho ba mohale wa Ntwa ya Tokoloho.
tgt: Izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika ziyakhuthazwa ukuba zibuke le filimu yezombusazwe emayelana nokuguquka kwensizwa eneminyaka eyi-19 edabuka eMamelodi, empumalanga nePitori, iba yisishoshovu soMzabalazo.

src: Kabinete e boeleditse hore mmuso, ka Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri le la Bonono le Setso, o tla tswela pele ho tshehetsa kgolo ya indaseteri ya bonono bakeng sa ho keteka le ho pheta pale ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabinethi ikugcizelele ukuthi uhulumeni, ngokusebenzisa iminyango wezoHwebo Nezimboni kanye Nowezobuciko Namasiko, uzoqhubeka nokusekela ukukhula kwemboni yezobuciko ekugubheni nasekuxoxeni umlando waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa molwanedi wa toka ya kahisano Moruti Michael Lapsley bakeng sa ho amohela Moputso wa Kgotso ya Setjhaba wa matjhaba wa 2016 mokgahlelong wa ‘Kgotso ya Lefatshe le Poelano – Mmopi wa Kgotso ya Babatswang ke Matjhaba’.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela isishoshovu sezobulungiswa kwezenhlalakahle uMfundisi Michael Lapsley ngokuthola Umklomelo Womhlaba Wokuthula Emphakathini we-2016 esigabeni “Ukuthula Nokubuyisana Emhlabeni – Umdalixolo Odumile emhlabeni'.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Pieter du Preez bakeng sa ho kgethwa bakeng sa Kgau ya Boqhwala ya Laureus ya Radipapadi wa Lefatshe wa Selemo, ho latela tshebetso ya hae e babatsehang ka 2015.
tgt: IKhabinethi ihalalisela u-Pieter du Preez ngokuqokelwa Umklomelo weLaureus World Sportsperson of the Year with a Disability, ngokudlala kwakhe okuvelele ngonyaka we-2015.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Wayde van Niekerk ya entseng nalane ya ho matha ka lebelo le fetisisang ka ho ba motho wa pele nalaneng wa ho matha mabelo kaofela a mararo: 100m ka tlasa metsotswana e 10‚ 200m ka tlasa metsotswana e 20 le 400m ka tlasa metsotswana e 44‚ jwaloka ha ho tiiseditswe ke Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Difedereishene tsa Mabelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela u-Wayde van Niekerk oqophe umlando kwezokugijima ngesivinini ngokuba umuntu wokuqala emlandweni ngokugijima yonke imijaho emithathu: ama-100m ngaphansi kwemizuzwana eyi-10, ama-200m ngaphansi kwemizuzwana enga-20 kanye nama-400M ngaphansi kwemizuzwana enga-44, njengoba kuqinisekiswe yiNhlangano Yomhlaba Ebunjwe Yizinhlangano Zokusubatha.

src: Dithonyo.
tgt: Abaqashiwe.

src: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mananeo a bohlokwa a mmuso.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni ezisemqoka.

src: Kabinete e amohela diphihlello tse hlakisitsweng ke Moporesidente Jacob Zuma ha a ne a etetse setsheng sa Boemakepe ba Port Elizabeth ho la Kapa Botjhabela,ho lekola kgatelopele e entsweng ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha boikitlaetso ba Operation Phakisa: Moruo wa Mawatle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile osekuzuziwe okuqhakanjiswe nguMongameli u-Jacob Zuma ngenkathi ehambele mathupha Echwebeni laseBhayi eMpumalanga Kapa, ukuhlola inqubekelaphambili esiyenziwe maqondana nokuqaliswa ukusebenza kohlelo lomnotho wasolwandle olwaziwa ngokuthi yi-Operation Phakisa: Umnotho Waselwandle.

src: Mmuso o butse matsete a ka fihlang ho se ka etsang R17 bilione ho Moruo wa Mawatle.
tgt: Uhulumeni usethukulule utshalomali olufinyelela cishe kwizigidigidi eziyi-17 zamarandi Emnothweni Wasolwandle.

src: Ho tloha esale e thehwa, ho se ho hlahisitswe mesebetsi e fetang 4500 makaleng a fapafapaneng.
tgt: Kusukela ekusengulweni kwalo lolu hlelo, sekusungulwe imisebenzi engaphezu kwezi-4 500 emikhakheni enhlobonhlobo.

src: Tse pedi tsa diketswana tse hulang tse ntseng di ahuwa ke Southern African Shipyards bakeng sa Bolaodi ba Maemakepe a Naha ba Transnet (TNPA) Boemakepeng ba Durban di tla lebiswa Boemakepeng ba Port Elizabeth.
tgt: Izingalawana ezimbili kweziyisishiyagalolunye ezakhiwa Izakhamkhumbi zaseNingizimu ne-Afrika zakwa-Transnet National Ports Authority (i-TNPA) Echwebeni lase-Durban zizohanjiswa Echwebeni laseBhayi.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o thakgotse seketswana sa pele se hulang ho la Port Elizabeth, se reheletsweng Mvezo, e leng tulo ya tswalo ya Moporesidente wa mehleng Nelson Mandela.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma wethule ingalawana yokuqala eBhayi, ebizwa ngokuthi uMvezo, eqanjwe ngegama lendawo yokuzalwa kaMongameli waphambilini uNelson Mandela.

src: TNPA e beheletse ka thoko se ka fetang R7 bilione bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa maemakepe a rona.
tgt: I-TNPA seyabe izigidigidi ezingaphezu kweziyi-7 zamarandi ukwenza ngcono amachweba ethu.

src: Moporesidente o ile a sheba metjha ya dikepe e ntlafaditsweng le ho ahuwa botjha e kenang ka hara Boemakepe ba Port Elizabeth tse tla kgona ho amohela dikepe tse kgolo tse 12 ka hodimo papisong le tsa hajwale tse pedi.
tgt: UMongameli uzibhekile izindlela ezishibilikayo ezivuselelwe kabusha nezakhiwe kabusha kanye nemigudu eholela ezakhiweni zokukhuleka imikhumbi Echwebeni laseBhayi ezizokwazi ukuhlala imikhumbi eyi-12 ngaphezulu uma kuqhathaniswa nalena emibili ekhona njengamanje.

src: Kabinete e leboha balefi kaofela ba lekgetho ba ipapisitseng le mmuso selemong sa ditjhelete sa 2015/16 bakeng sa ho fihlisa pokeletso ya rona ya lekeno ho R1trilione lekgetlo la pele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonge bonke abakhokhi bentela ababambisane nohulumeni onyakeni wezimali wezi-2015/16 ekuthatheni izimali zethu eziqoqwayo bazibeke kutriliyoni yamarandi okokuqala ngqa emlandweni.

src: Sena ke sesupo se hlakileng sa matla a moruo wa rona o hlabolohang le ka tlasa maemo a WEBTOKEN ka dinyehelo tsa lekgetho la maAforika Borwa a lokelang le pokeletso e hlwahlwa e etswang ke Ditshebeletso tsa Lekeno tsa Aforika Borwa hore mmuso o kgone betere ho fana ka ditshebeletso tse hlokahalang haholo tse nyehelang bakeng sa ntlafatso ya bophelo ba maAforika Borwa.
tgt: Lesi yisibonakaliso esicacile samandla omnotho wethu ohlumayo ngisho ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima.

src: Kabinete e amohela tsebiso ya Moporesidente Zuma ya la 3 Phato 2016 jwaloka letsatsi la Dikgetho tsa Mebuso ya lehae tsa 2016.
tgt: Kungenxa yezinkokhelo zentela ezivela kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abathobela umthetho kanye nokuqoqwa kwezimali ngempumelelo yiSikhungo Sezinsizakalo Zokuqoqwa Kwezimali saseNingizimu Afrika (i-SARS) nakuba uhulumeni ukwazi kangcono ukuhlinzeka izinsizakalo ezibhekwe ngamehlo abovu ezinegalelo ekwenzeni ngcono izimpilo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Mmuso o itumetse hore mafelo a beke a mabedi a boingodiso a la 5–6 Tlhakubele le la 9–10 Mmesa ho bonahetse ha batho ba ka nnang ba kgetha ba tlile ka bongata diteisheneng tsa ho kgetha,haholo-holo ba tla beng ba vouta lekgetlo la pele le batjha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isamukelile isimemezelo sikaMongameli uZuma somhla zi-3 Ncwaba 2016 njengosuku Lokhetho Lohulumeni Bezindawo Lwezi-2016.

src: Kabinete e leboha bohle ba arabetseng kgoeletso ya hore ba ingodise le ho hlahloba dintlha tsa bona lenaneng la bakgethi.
tgt: Uhulumeni uyakujabulela ukuthi izimpelasonto ezimbili zokubhalisela ukuvota ngomhla zi-5–6 kuNdasa kanye nomhla ziyi-9–10 kuMbasa zibonise inqwaba yabantu abangavota behambela ezikhungweni zokuvota, ikakhulukazi labo abazobe bevota okokuqala kanye nentsha.

src: Ke ka bonkakarolo ba rona ka kopanelo hore demokerasi ya rona e dule e matlafala.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonge bonke labo abasabelile ekhweleni lokubhalisela ukuvota kanye nokuyobheka imininingwane yabo ohlwini labavoti.

src: Kabinete kgothaletsa baahi bohle ba so ka ba ingodisa kapa ho hlahloba dintlha tsa bona ho etela dikantoro tsa Khomishene e Ikemetseng ya Dikgetho ho bomasepala ba bona ho ya lokisa dintlha tsa bona lenaneng la bakgethi (fana ka diaterese) le ho ingodisetsa ho vouta dikgethong tsa la 3 Phato 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa zonke izakhamuzi ezingakabhaliseli ukuvota noma ezingakayibheki imininingwane yazo ukuba zihambele amahhovisi eKhomishana Yokhetho Ezimele komasipala bezindawo bazo bese zivuselela imininingwane yazo ohlwini labavoti (zihlinzeke ngamakheli) bese zibhalisela ukuvota okhethweni lomhla zi-3 kuNcwaba.

src: Bakgethi hape ba ka romela dimoro sa bona tsadi boitsebiso ka SMS ho 3281.0 kapa ba letsetse setsi sa mehala ho 0800 11 8000 ho netefatsa maemo a bona.
tgt: Abavoti bangaphinda futhi bathumele nge-SMS inombolo yabo kamazisi ku-3281.0 noma baxhumane nesikhungo sezingcingo ku-0800 11 8000 ukuqinisekisa isimo sabo.

src: Boingodiso bo netefatsa lebitso la hao lenaneng la bakgethi hore o tle o kgone ho vouta.
tgt: Ukubhalisa kuqinisekisa ukuthi igama lakho likhona ohlwini labavoti ukuze uzokwazi ukuvota.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho baahi ho sebedisa tokelo ya bona ya demokerasi e lwanetsweng ka thata ka ho vouta Dikgethong tsa Mebuso ya Lehae tsa 2016 ka la 3 Phato 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema izakhamizi ukuba zisebenzise ilungelo lethu lomthethosiseko esalithola kanzima lokuvota Okhethweni Lohulumeni Bezindawo Lwezi-2016 ngomhla zi-3 Ncwaba 2016.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa semmuso ha Porojeke ya Teko ya eChannel ya Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae (DHA) ke Moporesidente Zuma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukwethulwa ngokusemthethweni komklamo obizwa ngokuthi yi-eChannel Pilot Project woMnyango Wezasekhaya (i-DHA) nguMongameli uZuma.

src: Tsamaisong ena e ntjha ya ntlafatso e dumella baahi ho etsa dikopo tsa bona tsa dikarete tsa boitsebiso ka inthanete ho phema mela e melelele.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luusha lesimanje manje luvumela izakhamuzi ukuba zikwazi ukufaka izicelo zazo zomazisi abangamakhadi, i-Smart ID, ku-inthanethi futhi zigweme imigqa emide.

src: Ka tshebedisano mmoho le dibanka tse nne tse kgolo – ABSA, FNB, Nedbank le Standard Bank – ho hlahisa lepatlelo la ho etsa dikopo tsa dikarete tsa boitsebiso le diphasepoto ho tla thusa basebedisi ho etela dintlwana tsa Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae ho fana ka dikgatiso tsa bona tsa menwana le dinepe kamora ho ba ba beheletse dibaka le ho lefa ka inthanete.
tgt: Lokhu kusebenzisana namabhange amane amakhulu – okuyi-ABSA, i-FNB, i-Nedbank kanye ne-Standard Bank – ukwethula inkundla yokufaka izicelo kwi-inthanethi zomazisi abangamakhadi kanye namaphasiphothi kuzokwenza izakhamuzi zikwazi ukuhambela amakhosombe e-DHA ukuhambisa izinsalela zawo zeminwe kanye nezithombe emva kokuba esenze isivumelwano sokubonana futhi enza nezinkokhelo kwi-inthanethi.

src: eChannel ke karolo ya lefapha ya kakaretso ya ho ntjhafatsa lewa la ho tlosa ditshebeletso ho tloha tshebedisong ya dipampiri ho ya ho tshebediso ya dijithale, e leng tsamaiso e tla kenyeletsa tlhwekiso ya rejisetara ya setjhaba.
tgt: I-eChannel iyingxenye yeqhinga selilonke lomnyango lesimanjemanje lokususa izinsizakalo ephepheni ziye kubuxhakaxhaka bubochwepheshe, uhlelo oluzobandakanya ukulungiswa kwamaphutha kwirejista enemininingwane yabantu.

src: Kabinete e amohela katleho ya Beke ya Imbizo ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo e neng e etsahala haufinyana tlasa mookotaba ‘Mmoho re ntshetsa Aforika Borwa pele’, moo ho bonweng bahlanka ba mmuso ba ikopanya le badudi ho phatlalla le naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamukelile impumelelo yeViki Lokubamba Izimbizo esanda kubanjwa nje ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi ‘Sisonke siqhubekisela iNingizimu Afrika phambili’, ebonise izikhulu zikahulumeni zixoxisana nemiphakathi ezweni lonkana.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa maAforika Borwa a nkileng karolo ho mananeo a fetang 36 ho phatlalla le naha, e leng se netefaditseng hore mmuso o arabetse ho ditlhoko tse hlwailweng tsa badudi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabancoma labo bantu baseNingizimu Afrika ababambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni ezingaphezu kwama-36 ezweni lonkana, abaqinisekisile ukuthi uhulumeni uyaphendula ezidingweni zomphakathi ezihlonziwe.

src: Beke ya Imbizo ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo e matlafaditse badudi ka tlhahisoleseding e mabapi le mananeo a mmuso.
tgt: IViki Lokubamba Izimbizo isimamise imiphakathi ngolwazi maqondana nezinhlelo zikahulumeni.

src: Lefapha la Bodulo ba Batho le ne le tshwere seboka se atlehileng haholo sa Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) se sebetsanang le mekhukhu, se toboketsa sekgahla se matla sa kgolo ya metse ya ditoropo le kgolo ya mekhukhu.
tgt: UMnyango Wezokuhlaliswa Kwabantu usingathe ingqungquthela eyimpumelelo Yenhlangano Yezizwee (i-UN) ebibhekene nezindawo zokuhlala eziyimikhukhu, igcizelela izinga elimangalisayo lokufudukela kwabantu emadolobheni kanye nokukhula kwemikhukhu.

src: Hona jwale batho ba etsang bilione e le nngwe lefatsheng ba dula mekhukhung.
tgt: Njengamanje abantu abayisigidigidi esisodwa emhlabeni bahlala emikhukhwini.

src: Aforika Borwa e se e ahile dimilione tsa matlo esale ho tloha ka 1994 jwaloka karolo ya ho netefatsa bophelo bo botle bakeng sa bohle.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika kusukela ngowe-1994 seyakhe izigidi ngezigidi zezindlu njengengxenye yokuqinisekisa impilo engcono kubo bonke abantu.

src: DibiliKabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Dibili tsa moralo tse latelang:.
tgt: IMithethosivivinywaIKhabhinethi igunyaze lezinhlaka zeMithethosivivinywa elandelayo:.

src: Bili ya Tshireletso ya Meralo ya Motheo e Hlokolosi ya 2016 e tla phatlalatswa Koranteng ya Mmuso bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa Wokuvikelwa Kwengqalasizinda Esemqoka wezi-2016 uzoshicilelwa kuSomqulu Kahulumeni ukuze kutholakale imibono yomphakathi ngawo.

src: Bili e fetola Molao wa Ditsi tsa Bohlokwa tsa Naha, 1980 (Molao 102 wa 1980), mme e batla ho matahanya tsamaiso ya ho hlwaya le ho hlahisa meralo ya motheo e hlokolosi ka mokgwa wa ponaletso le o nang le maikarabelo.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchitha uMthetho Wezintuba Ezisemqoka Zikazwelonke, we-1980 (uMthetho we-102 we-1980), futhi ufuna ukuhambelanisa inqubo yokuhlonza kanye nokudalulwa kwengqalasizinda esemqoka ngendlela esobala nephendulayo.

src: Hape e tla netefatsa hore meralo ya motheo kaofela e hlokolosi e ya hlwauwa le ho tshireletswa ka tshwanelo bakeng sa polokeho ya naha.
tgt: Uzophinda futhi uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izingqalasizinda zokuvikelela kuzwelonke kwezwe ziyakwazi ukuhlonzwa futhi ziyavikelwa ngokwanele.

src: Bili e fana ka ho tekwa ha moralo wa ditsi bakeng sa ho beha leihlo le ho tsamaisa tshireletso ya meralo ya motheo e hlokolosi.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uhlinzekela ukumiswa kohlaka lokusebenza lwesikhungo ukuqapha nokusebenzisa ukuvikelwa kwezingqalasizinda ezisemqoka.

src: E boela e hlalosa mesebetsi ya lekala le tla eletsa Letona la Sepolesa tlhahisong ya meralo ya motheo e hlokolosi.
tgt: Uphinde uchaze imisebenzi yomgwamanqa ozokweluleka uNgqongqoshe Wezamaphoyisa ekudalulweni kwezingqalasizinda ezisemqoka.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Mekgatlo ya Thepa ya Bodulo bo Kopanetsweng ya 2016 e tla phatlalatswa bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa Wokuchitshiyelwa Kwezinhlangano Zempahla Ehlanganyelwayo wezi-2016 uzoshicilelwa ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngawo.

src: Bili e fetola Molao wa hajwale wa Mekgatlo ya Thepa ya Bodulo bo Kopanetsweng,1996 (Molao 28 wa1996).Bili e tla matlafatsa tsamaiso ya taolo ya demokerasi ya Mekgatlo ya Thepa ya Bodulo bo Kopanetsweng e teng kapa dihlopha tsa Trust tse teng tse behang leihlo mobu wa bodulo bo kopanetsweng.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho wamanje Wezinhlangano Zempahla Ehlanganyelwayo, we-1996 (uMthetho wama-28 we-1996).UMthethosivivinywa uzoqinisa uhlelo lokubusa ngentandoyeningi lweziNhlangano ezikhona njengamanje Zempahla Ehlanganyelwayo noma izikhungo ezikhona njengamanje Zesikhwama Sezimali Ezisisiwe ezengamela umhlaba osetshenziswa ngokuhlanganyela.

src: Bili e fetotsweng e fana ka ho thehwa ha Morejisetara ka hara Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Mahae le Tlhabollo ya Naha, mme e hlalosa mesebetsi ya kantoro ena.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa ochitshiyelwe uhlinzekela ukumiswa kwehhovisi likaNobhala eMnyangweni Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya kanye Nezinguquko Kwezomhlaba, futhi uchaze imisebenzi yaleli hhovisi.

src: Hang ha Bili ena e fetisitswe ho ba molao, e tla matlafatsa taolo ya ditsi tsa puso le ho matlafatsa tshehetso ya Mmuso ho tsona.
tgt: Uma lo Mthethosivivinywa usuphasisiwe waba umthetho, uzoqinisa ukulawulwa kwezikhungo zokubusa futhi uthuthukise ukwesekwa kwawo nguMbuso.

src: E tla thusa badudi ho fumana, ho tshwara le ho laola thepa ya bodulo ka dihlopha tse hlwahlwa tse thehilweng semolao tse tshehetswang ke mmuso.
tgt: Uzovumela imiphakathi ukuba ithole, ibambe futhi iphathe izimpahla ngokusebenzisa izikhungo zokwenziwa komsebenzi ezisungulwe ngokusemthethweni ngempumelelo zisekelwa nguhulumeni.

src: Ho hlahiswa ha Bili ya Bonamodi ba Matjhaba ya 2016 ho Palamente.
tgt: Ukwethulwa koMthethosivivinywa Wokulamula Emhlabeni Wonke wezi-2016 ePhalamende.

src: Tsamaiso ya matjhaba ya bonamodi ke sesebediswa sa bohlokwa bakeng sa ho kena kgwebong ho parola le meedi ya naha.
tgt: Inqubo yokulamula emhlabeni wonke iyithuluzi elisemqoka lokwenza ibhizinisi ngaphesheya kwemingcele yezwe.

src: E tla ntlafatsa phumantsho ho ditshebeletso tsa toka bakeng sa dikhamphani tse nang le kgwebisano le tsa ka ntle ho naha le dikhamphani tsa melata tse ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Uzokwenza ngcono ukufinyeleleka kwezinsizakalo zobulungiswa ezinkampanini ezenza ibhizinisi ngaphandle kwaleli lizwe kanye nezinkampani zasemazweni angaphandle eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Bili e fetola Molao wa Kananelo le Tiisetso ya Phano ya Bonamodi ba Matjhaba, 1977 (Molao 40 wa 1977) mme hape e fetola Molao wa hajwale wa Tshireletso ya Kgwebo, 1978 (Molao 99 wa 1978).
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchitha uMthetho Wokwamukelwa kanye Nokuqiniswa Kwemiklomelo Yokulamula Emazweni Angaphandle, we-1977 (uMthetho wama-40 we-1977) uphinde futhi uchibiyele uMthetho wamanje Wokuvikelwa Kwebhizinisi, we-1978 (uMthetho wama-99 we-1978).

src: Bili e sisintsweng e imatahanya le Molao wa Motlolo wa Bonamodi ba Matjhaba ba Dikgwebo, o amohetsweng ke Khomishene ya UN ya Molao wa Matjhaba wa Kgwebisano.
tgt: Umthethosivivinywa ohlongozwayo uhambelana Nomthetho Owuhlaka maqondana Nokulamula Kwezokuhwebelana Ezweni Lonke, owamukelwa yiKhomishana Yenhlangano Yezizwe maqondana Nomthetho Wezokuhwebelana Emhlabeni Wonke.

src: Phatlalatso ya Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Moralo ya Motheo wa Naha wa Diphuputso ya 2016 ho Koranta ya Mmuso bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Ukushicilelwa kohlaka loMthethosivivinywa Wokuchitshiyelwa Kwesisekelo Socwaningo Lukazwelonke wezi-2016 kuSomqulu Kahulumeni ukuze umphakathi uphawule.

src: Bili e fetola Molao wa Motheo wa Naha wa Diphuputso, 1998 (Molao 23 wa 1998).Bili e tla ntlafatsa bophehisani ba Aforika Borwa ntshetsopeleng le ntjhafatsong ya diphuputso ka tsamaiso e hlwahlwa, e nepahetseng le e hokahaneng ya boikopanyo ba setjhaba le tsa saense, le ho ntlafatsa le phumantsho ya meralo ya motheo ya diphuputso.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho Wesisekelo Socwaningo Lukazwelonke, we-1998 (uMthetho wama-23 we-1998).

src: Hape e tla ntlafatsa karabelo le bohlwahlwa ba ntshetsopele ya diphuputso le phano ya ntjhafatso, ho ntlafatsa boleng ba bophelo ba maAforika Borwa ka boimatahanyo bo betere le dintlha tse ka sehloohong tsa mmuso.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uzokwenza ngcono ubuqhudelwano beNingizimu Afrika ekuthuthukisweni kocwaningo kanye nokuqamba kabusha ngokusebenzisa ukuphathwa ngempumelelo, ngendlela egculisayo futhi edidiyelwe kokuxoxisana komphakathi nabezesayensi, kanye nokuhlinzekwa okwenziwe ngcono kwengqalasizinda yocwaningo kanye nokufinyeleleka.

src: Diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi eziqavile.

src: Cabinet e amohetse Pampiri e Tshweu e Mabapi le Tshebetso ya Sepolesa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamukele Umthetho Odingidwayo Omaqondana Nobuphoyisa.

src: Pampiri e Tshweu ya moralo e qadile ho phatlalatswa bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba ka Tlhakubele 2015.
tgt: Uhlaka Lomthetho Odingidwayo lwashicilelwa okokuqala ukuze kutholakale imibono yomphakathi ngoNdasa 2015.

src: Pampiri e teka ntlha ya sepolesa se sekametseng ka ho baahi ba itahlelang ka setotswana le ho arabela ho tikoloho e teng hajwale ya sepolesa.
tgt: Lo mthetho odingidwayo uhlinzekela imisebenzi yobuphoyisa echeme nezakhamuzi eziphilayo futhi ephendulayo esimweni samanje semisebenzi yobuphoyisa.

src: Hape e teka ntlha ya Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa ya Aforika Borwa le Sepolesa sa Metse Meholo se nang le boikarabelo le ho ba sa seporofeshenale.
tgt: Uphinde uhlinzekele Umbutho Wamaphoyisa waseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) kanye namaphoyisa kamasipala akwaziyo ukuphendula futhi asebenza ngobungoti.

src: Pampiri e Tshweu e etsa boipiletso ba ho thehwa ha Boto ya Naha ya Sepolesa eo, hara mesebetsi e meng, e tla ikarabella bakeng sa ho tla ka mokgwa o se nang leeme wa ho thaotha, ho kgetha le ho thonya makolwane a matjha ka hara ditshebeletso tsa sepolesa.
tgt: Umthetho Odingidwayo unxusa ukuba kusungulwe iBhodi Likazwelonke Lamaphoyisa, elizokuba, phakathi kweminye imisebenzi, nesibophezelo sokumisa imigomo yezinjongo zokuqashwa, ukuhlungwa kanye nokuqokwa kwabantu abasha emisebenzini yobuphoyisa.

src: Kabinete e amohetse Pampiri e Tshweu e mabapi le Polokeho le Tshireletso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamukele Umthetho Odingidwayo Omaqondana Nezokuphepha Nokuvikeleka.

src: Pampiri ena e Tshweu, e seng e tswile bakeng sa tjhebisano le setjhaba ka Hlakola 2015, e tsepamisitse maikutlo hodima katamelo e kopanetsweng le ya ntshetsopele ya polokeho e shebileng ka nqane ho sepolesa.
tgt: Umthetho Odingidwayo, obuvele usukhishiwe ukuze kuxoxiswane nomphakathi ngawo ngoNhlolanja 2015, ugxile endleleni yokusebenza edidiyelwe nethuthukisayo maqondana nokuphepha okungale komsebenzi wobuphoyisa.

src: E batla ho fana ka tataiso bakeng sa mekgwa ya polokeho ya ba badudi.
tgt: Ufuna ukuba ngumkhombandlela mayelana nezinyathelo zokuvikela ezokuphepha zemiphakathi.

src: Pampiri e Tshweu e hlwaya mafapha kaofela a amehang le mekgatlo ya badudi e nyeheleng bakeng sa polokeho ya badudi.
tgt: Umthetho Odingidwayo uhlonza yonke iminyango efanelekile kanye nezinhlangano ezigxile emiphakathini ezinegalelo ekuphepheni kwemiphakathi.

src: Kabinete e tjhaellese monwana moralo wa Leano o mabapi le Ketso ya Moetlo wa lebollo ka hara Aforika Borwa le ho tjhaella monwana hore Lefapha la Merero ya Setso le qale ho rala molao wa naha wa tsa lebollo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze uhlaka lweNqubomgomo emaqondana Nosiko Lokusoka eNingizimu Afrika futhi yagunyaza nokuthi uMnyango Wezendabuko uqale ukwenza uhlaka lomthetho kazwelonke omaqondana nokusoka.

src: Leano lena le se le sebeditswe haholo ka tsamaiso ya dipuisano le setjhaba le bankakarolo ba amehang.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo isivele isidlule ohlelweni olunzulu lokuxoxisana nomphakathi maqondana nayo kanye nababambiqhaza abafanelekile.

src: Leano le fana ka ditataiso tse netefatsang tshireletso ya meetlo ya setso ya lebollo la selemo ka seng la bashemane ntle le ho beha polokeho ya bona tsietsing.
tgt: Inqubomgomo ihlinzeka ngemihlahlandlela eqinisekisa ukuvikelwa kosiko lomdabu lokusokwa minyakayonke kwabafana abasebancane ngaphandle kokubeka ukuphepha kwabo engcupheni.

src: Sena se etsa karolo ya mehato eo mmuso e e nkang ho hatella meetlo e amohelehang e nepahetseng.
tgt: Lokhu kwenza ingxenye yezinyathelo uhulumeni azithathayo ukuqinisa amasiko afanelekile kanye navumelekile.

src: Le ho busetsa boemo bo amohelehang ba maikarabelo ho ba tsamaisang mabollo le batswadi ba romelang bana ba bona mabollong ana.
tgt: Igcina izinga elivumelekile lokukwazi ukuziphendulela kulabo bantu abaphethe izikole zokusoka kanye nabazali abathumela izingane zabo kulezo zikole.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana dikgothaletso tse entsweng ke Komiti ya Dipatlisiso e mabapi le kgwebisano ka manaka a ditshukudu e le e nngwe ya kgetho ya ho baballa mohlape wa naha wa ditshukudu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze izincomo ezenziwe yiKomidi Lophenyo olumaqondana nokufaneleka kokuhweba ngezimpondo zobhejane njengenye yezindlela zokulondoloza obhejane kuleli lizwe.

src: Dikgothaletso di ile tsa tshehetswa ke Komiti ya Boeletsi ba Setekginiki e Kopanetsweng ke Mafapha le Komiti e Kopanetsweng ya Matona e thontsweng ho batlisisa kgonahalo ya ho kenya molaong kgwebisano ya matjhaba ya manaka a ditshukudu.
tgt: Lezi zincomo zamukelwa yiKomidi Lokweluka Kwezobuchwepheshe Leminyango Ehlukene kanye neKomidi loNgqongqoshe Abahlukene aqokelwa ukuba aphenye ngamathuba okwenza kube semthethweni ukuhweba ngokuthengiselana ngezimpondo zobhejane emhlabeni wonke.

src: Dikgothaletso di tshehetsa lewa le kopanetsweng la Aforka Borwa la katamelo ya bolaodi ba ho rarolla ho tsongwa ho seng molaong ha ditshukudu le kgwebisano e seng molaong ya manaka a ditshukudu.
tgt: Izincomo zigunyaza indlela yokusebenza yaseNingizimu Afrika yokuphathwa ngobuqhinga obudidiyelwe kwesixazululo sokuzingelwa kobhejane kanye nokuhweba ngobhejane okungekho emthethweni.

src: Komiti e kgothaletsa hore mokgwa wa hajwale wa ho boloka mohlape o ntseng o le teng wa naha kgahlanong le kgwebisano ka manaka a ditshukudu.
tgt: Ikomidi lincoma ukuthi indlela esetshenziswa manje ukugcina isibalo sobhejane baleli lizwe kumele igcinwe uma iqhathaniswa nokuhwebelana ngezimpondo zobhejane.

src: Lewa la katamelo la naha le kenyeletsa polokeho matlafatso ya badudi taolo ya tswadiso diphano tsa molao o tla kenngwang tshebetsong ka tsela e hlwahlwa le ho hatellwa le taolo ya ho batleha ha manaka a ditshukudu.
tgt: Indlela yokusebenza ngobuqhinga yaleli lizwe iqukethe ukuvikeleka ukunikezwa komphakathi amandla ukuphathwa kwebhayoloji izimiso zemithetho ephendulayo eziqaliswa ukusebenza ngempumelelo futhi eziqiniswayo kanye nokuphathwa kokufunwa ngamandla kobhejane.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana meralo ya dikhoine tsa 2016 tsa sehopotso tse latelang:a) Letoto la Naha la Khoine ya Tlhaho– Boikitlaetso ba BigCats : ‘The Cheetah’.b) Letoto la dikhoine tsa Sterling-silver crown le dikhoine tsa tickey ‘Ditshibollo tsa Aforika Borwa–‘Dolosse’.Meralo ya dikhoine,mmoho le diphatlalatso tsa tsona, di tla hatiswa Koranteng ya Mmuso, mme ebe di tla be se di hlahiswa ka metjha e tlwaelehileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze lawa madizayini alandelayo ezinhlamvu zemali azokuba yisikhumbuzo sowezi-2016:a) Uhlelo Lochungechunge Lwezinhlamvu Zemali ze-National Geographic –Amakati Amakhulu: ‘Ingulule’.b) Uchungechunge lwezinhlamvu zemali zepondo notiki ezinomqhele wesiliva ‘Okukhandwe eNingizimu Afrika–‘i-Dolosse’.Amadizayini ezinhlamvu zemali, kanye nokwaziswa kwawo, azophrintwa kuSomqulu Kahulumeni, bese emva kwalokho azobe esekhiqizwa bese edayiswa kusetshenziswa imigudu ejwayelekile.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Imicimbi ezayo.

src: Moporesidente Zuma dipakeng tsa la18 le 22 Mmesa 2016 o tla nka maeto a tshebetso ho ya mebusong ya ditho tsa Kopano ya Makgetho a Madiboho ya Aforika e Borwa (SACU) e kenyeletsang Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho le Swaziland.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uzokube phakathi komhla ziyi-18 nama-22 Mbasa 2016 enohambo olusemthethweni lokuvakashela amazwe angamalungu eNhlangano yaMazwe Angakhokisani Intela yoHwebo aseNingizimu neAfrika (i-SACU) ahlanganisa i-Namibia, iBotswana, iLesotho kanye ne-Swaziland.

src: Maeto a tla ntlafatsa karolo ya bohlokwae bapalwang ke SACU bakeng sa ho hodisa momahano ya lebatowa le ntshetsopele ya moruo wa ditho tsa yona kaofela.
tgt: Lokhu kuhambela kuzothuthukisa indima ebalulekile i-SACU eyidlalayo ekukhuthazeni ukuhlanganiswa kwezifunda kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho wawo wonke amalungu ayo.

src: Moporesidente o tla nka leeto la Puso ho etela Riphaboliki ya MaIsilamo ya Iran ka la 23 le 24 Mmesa 2016 ho matlafatsa maqhama a sepolotiki le a moruo pakeng tsa dinaha tsena tse pedi.
tgt: UMongameli uzothatha uhambo Lokuhambela Kombuso ezweni lase-Islamic Republic of Iran ngomhla zingama-23 nama-24 kuMbasa 2016 ukuyoqinisa izingxoxo zezombusazwe kanye nezomnotho phakathi kwalamazwe amabili.

src: Moporesidente o tla etella pele mekete ya Naha ya Letsatsi la Tokoloho ka la 27 Mmesa 2016 Limpopo, Lebaleng la dipapadi la Giyani tlasa mookotaba: “Mmoho re aha metse e betere–Mebuso ya le hae ke taba ya mang le mang”.Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela le makala a mang ho bontsha lerato la naha ka ho nka karolo diketsahalong tse fapafapaneng tsa ho hopola Kgwedi ya Tokoloho.
tgt: UMongameli uzohola imigubho yoSuku Lwenkululeko Lukazwelonke ngomhla zingama-27 Mbasa 2016 eLimpopo, eGiyani Stadium ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi: “Sisonke sakha imiphakathi engcono – Uhulumeni Wezindawo uwumsebenzi wawo wonke umuntu”.IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nayo yonke imikhakha ukuba bakhombise ugqozi lwabo ngezwe labo ngokubamba iqhaza emicimbini enhlobonhlobo yokugubha iNyanga Yenkululeko.

src: Dibekeng tse tlang,Palamente e tla be e tshwara Divoutu tsa Ditekanyetso tsa mafapa ka mafapha.
tgt: Kulawa masonto ezayo, iPhalamende lizobe libambe Amavoti Eezabelomali zeminyango.

src: Ba Phethahatso ba mafapha ka ho latelana ba tla be ba hlopholla meralo ya bona ya tshebetso bakeng sa selemo sa ditjhelete sa 2016/17.
tgt: Iziphathimandla zeminyango ehlukahlukene zizothulula izinhlelo zazo zokusebenza zonyaka wezimali wezi-2016/17.

src: Ditho tsa setjhaba di tla tsebiswa ka mananeo a mmuso a phano ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: Amalungu omphakathi azokwaziswa ngezinhlelo zokuhanjiswa kwezidingongqangi zikahulumeni.

src: Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa Bohlokwa Maemong a Hajwale Kabinete e amohetse karabelo le kopo ya tshwarelo e ileng ya latela ka Moporesidente Zuma ho kahlolo ya Lekgotla la Dinyewe la Molaotheo mabapi le boimatahanyo le diketso tsa ditokiso tse tekilweng tlalehong ya Mosireletsi wa Setjhaba.
tgt: Isimo seKhabhinethi ezindabeni ezisematheni.

src: Kabinete e ntse e hlahloba kahlolo bakeng sa ho sheba haeba ho na le mehato e ka nkuwang ho matlafatsa mosebetsi wa Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamukele impendulo kanye nokuxolisa okulandele lapho okwenziwe nguMongameli uZuma maqondana nesinqumo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo mayelana nokuthobela izinyathelo zokulungisa isimo ezavezwa embikweni woMvikeli Womphakathi.

src: Kahlolo ya Lekgotla la Dinyewe la Molaotheo e thathiselletsa le ho mafiella demokerasi ya molaotheo ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isafunda isinqumo ukuze ithole ukuthi ngabe zikhona yini ezinye izinyathelo ezingathathwa ukuqinisa indima kaHulumeni.

src: Kabinete e lemohile ketso ya dibanka tse nne tse fanneng ka tsebiso ya ho kwala diakhaonte tsa banka tsa khamphani e nngwe.
tgt: Isinqumo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo siqinisa siphinde sivumele intando yeningi labantu eyatholakala ngokomthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Leha Kabinete e ananela dipehelo le maemo a dibanka, diketso tsena di ka sitisa boramatsete ba ka nnang ba ba teng ba ka batlang ho tsamaisa dikgwebo ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isiqaphelile isenzo esenziwe ngamabhange amane afake isaziso sokuvala i-akhawunti yasebhange yenkampani ethile.

src: Kabinete e tsheheditse ntlha ya hore Matona a Ditjhelete, Mesebetsi le Mehlodi ya Diminerale a tshwanela ho bula dipuisano tse ahang le dibanka bakeng sa ho fihlella tharollo ya nako e telele tabeng ena.
tgt: Yize iKhabhinethi iyiqonda kahle imigomo nemibandela yamabhange, lesi senzo singaphazamisa abatshalizimali bakusasa abangafisa ukwenza ibhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Letona la Bophelo bo Botle, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, ya fumaneng kgau ya matjhaba ya Lefuba ya USAID-TB jwaloka kananelo ya boetapele ba hae mabapi le ntwa ya lefatshe kgahlanong le lefuba (TB) mmoho le ho etella pele boikitlaetso ba Aforika Borwa le ba lebatowa mabapi le ho hlahloba, kalafo le thibelo ya TB tshwaetso e kopaneng ya TB/HIV le TB e itwanelang ho meriana e mengata.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumelene ngokuthi uNgqongqoshe Wezezimali, Wezabasebenzi kanye Nowezimbiwa Phansi kumele bavulele ingxoxo eyakhayo kanye namabhange ukuze kutholakale isisombululo sesikhathi eside kulolu daba.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho kgethwa ha Aforika Borwa ho ba moamohedi wa 2016 wa Kgau ya Tshebeletso e Ipabotseng ya Sedipolomate ke Lekgotla la Merero ya Lefatshe ho la Washington,DJwaloka naha ya pele ya Aforika ya ho amohela kgau ena, e ananela boitlamo bo babatsehang ba naha mabapi le thuto ya lefatshe, merero ya matjhaba le dikgokahanyo tsa lefatshe bakeng sa ho hodisa ditabatabelo tsa rona tsa naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele uNgqongqoshe Wezempilo, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, othole indondo yomhlaba wonke evela kwi-USAID-TB yokumhlonipha ngobuholi bakhe empini yomhlaba wonke yokulwisana nesifo sofuba (i-TB) kanjalo nokuhola phambili izinhlelo zaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nezezifunda ekuhlolelweni, ukwelapha kanye nokuvimbela i-TB amagciwane okutheleleka nge-TB kanye Negciwane Lesandulelangculazi (i-HIV) ngesikhathi esisodwa kanye ne-TB engazweli amakhambi.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Letona la Dikamano tsa Matjhaba le Tshebedisano, Mofumahadi Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, bakeng sa nyehelo ya hae ho dipuisano tsa matjhaba tsa Aforika Borwa, tse kgannwang ke pono ya “kontinente ya Aforika e kopaneng e nang le kgotso, ya demokerasi, e hlokang semorabe, e hlokang kgethollo ya bong le e tswelang pele, le ho ba e nyehelang ho lefatshe le nang le toka le tekatekano.”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukele ukuqokwa kweNingizimu Afrika njengezwe elizokwamukela Indondo yowezi-2016 Yemisebenzi Enhlobonhlobo Yosomaqhinga nguMkhandlu Wezindaba Zomhlaba e-Washington, DNjengezwe lokuqala lase-Afrika ukuthola le ndondo, ihlonipha ukuzinikela okuvelele kwezwe ekufundiseni umhlaba wonke, izindaba zamazwe omhlaba kanye nokuxhumana emhlabeni wonke ukuze liqhubele phambili izimfuno zezwe.

src: Kabinete e amohela thonyo ke Moporesidente Zuma ya Moatefokate Jan Lekhoa Mothibi, jwaloka Hlooho ya Lekala la Diphuputso tsa Sepolesa le Ikgethang, le ho mo lakaletsa tse molemo boikarabelong ba hae bo botjha ba ho lwantsa bobodu le tsamaiso e mamphemphe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi income uNgqongqoshe Wezobudlelwano Bamazwe Nokubambisana, uNkz Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, ngegalelo lakhe ezingxoxweni zeNingizimu Afrika namazwe omhlaba, ezigqugquzelwa ngumbono “wezwekazi lase-Afrika elibumbene elinoxolo, elibuswa ngentando yeningi labantu, elingacwasi ngokobuhlanga, elingacwasi ngokobulili futhi eliqhakazile, futhi elinegalelo emhlabeni onobulungiswa nonokulingana.”.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a tswang botebong ba pelo ho lelapa la Makwetu le Pan Africanist Congress ka ho hlokahala ha Monghadi Clarence Makwetu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukele ukuqokwa nguMongameli uZuma ko-Advocate u-Jan Lekhoa Mothibi, njengeNhloko yoPhiko Olukhethekile Lezophenyo, futhi imfisela okuhle nokumhlophe emisebenzini yakhe emisha yokuqeda inkohlakalo kanye nokuphatha budlabha.

src: Monghadi Makwetu o tla hopolwa ka nyehelo ya hae e matla le ho intsha sehlabelo bakeng sa mokgatlo wa tokoloho le ho thehwa ha Aforika Borwa e ntjha ya demokerasi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulise amazwi enduduzo nokudabuka okukhulu emndenini wakwaMakwetu nakwi-Pan Africanist Congress ngokwedlula emhlabeni kukaMnu Clarence Makwetu.

src: Moporesidente o phatlaladitse Lepato le Ikgethang la Semmuso la Porofense bakeng sa mohale enwa wa ntwa ya tokoloho.
tgt: UMnu Makwetu uzokhunjulwa ngegalelo lakhe elikhulukazi kanye nasekuzinikeleni kwakhe uqobo embuthweni wokulwela inkululeko kanye nasekusungulweni kweNingizimu Afrika entsha ebuswa ngokwentando yeningi labantu.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona a tswang botebong ba pelo ho lelapa la Naidoo ka ho hlokahala ha Monghadi Kumaran Naidoo.
tgt: UMongameli umemezele ukuthi kube Nongcwabo Okhethekile Wesifundazwe Osemthethweni wale ngqalabutho yomzabalazo wenkululeko.

src: Monghadi Naidoo e ne e le Motsamaisi-Kakaretso ya Tshwereng Mokobobo wa Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Moruo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulise amazwi enduduzo nokudabuka okukhulu emndenini wakwa-Naidoo ngokwedlula emhlabeni kukaMnu Kumaran Naidoo.

src: Pele o ne a sebetsa jwaloka Mohlanka ya ka Sehloohong wa Ditjhelete wa Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri.
tgt: UMnu Naidoo ubeyiBamba likaMqondisi-Jikelele woMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezomnotho.

src: Monghadi Naidoo o entse nyehelo e matla ho taolo ya ditjhelete ka hara Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba.
tgt: UMnu Naidoo ube negalelo elikhulukazi ekuphathweni kwezezimali emkhakheni weMisebenzi Kahulumeni.

src: Kabinete e hlahisa kananelo ya yona ka nyehelo e entsweng ke Monghadi William Smith, ya sebeditseng ho Bongodi ba Kabinete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izwakaliswe ukubonga kwayo maqondana negalelo elifakwe nguMnu William Smith, obesebenza njengeHhovisi likaNobhala weKhabhinethi.

src: Monghadi Smith o behile meja fatshe mafelong a Tlhakubele kamora ho sebeletsa Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba dilemo tse 27.Kabinete e mo lakaletsa tse molemo phomolong ya hae.
tgt: UMnu Smith uthathe umhlalaphansi ekupheleni kukaNdasa emva kokusebenzela umkhakha weMisebenzi Kahulumeni iminyaka engama-27.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka Tlaleho ya Khomishene ya Dipatlisiso e mabapi le Dipelaelo tsa Boqhekanyetsi, Bobodu, Boitshwaro bo Bobe kapa Tsamaiso e Mpe ho Pakana ya Lewa la Ditheko la Tshireletso (Khomishene ya Ditheko tsa Dibetsa) e lokolotsweng ke Moporesidente hoseng hona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imfisela okuhle kodwa kumhlalaphansi wakhe.

src: Tlaleho e fumane hore ha ho bopaki ba ketso e fosahetseng, tjotjo, boqhekanyetsi kapa bobodu tsamaisong ya theko ya dibetsa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilunywe indlebe mayelana noMbiko weKhomishana Yophenyo Maqondana Nezinsolo Zokukhwabanisa, Inkohlakalo, Ukungahloniphi noma Ukungahambisi Ngomthetho Ekuthengweni Kobuqhinga Kwempahla Yokuzivikela (iKhomishana Yokuthengwa Kwezikhali) okhishwe nguMongameli ekuseni namuhla.

src: Re hlakotswe bobe kaha esale re bolela ka dilemo tse ngata hore ha ho letho le lebe le etsahetseng le hore theko ena e ne e se na WEBTOKEN tshepa hore sephetho se tla kwala taba ena e nkileng nako e WEBTOKEN kgema mmoho le Moporesidente Zuma mabapi le ho leboha Moahlodi Willie Seriti le Moahlodi Thekiso Musi, dipaki kaofela, ho kenyeletswa le Moporesidente wa mehleng Thabo Mbeki, baetapele ba bopaki, dihlopha tsa semolao, basebeletsi le ba nyehetseng bakeng sa ho etsa hore mosebetsi wa Khomishene o atlehe.
tgt: Umbiko uthole ukuthi abukho ubufakazi bokwenza okungalungile, ukugwazela, ukukhwabanisa noma inkohlakalo enqubweni yokuthwengwa kwezikhali.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di lokelwa ke ho netefatswa ha mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.
tgt: NjengoHulumeni siyayemukela imiphumela yeKhomishana.

src: Monghadi Siyabonga Gama jwaloka Mohlanka wa Phethahatso wa Sehlopha le Monghadi Garry Pita jwaloka Mohlanka ya ka Sehloohong wa Ditjhelete wa Sehlopha waTransnet.
tgt: Sikhishwe phambili satholakala singenacala njengoba besilokhu sisho eminyakeni eminingi edlule ukuthi kwakungekho ukuphambana nomthetho okwenziwa nanokuthi ukuthengwa kwezikhali kwenziwa ngendlela efanelekile nesemthethweni.

src: Ho kenngwa Tshebetsong ha Mananeo a Bohlokwa a Mmuso.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza Kwezinhlelo Zikahulumeni Ezisemqoka.

src: Kabinete e amohela Leeto la Puso la Moporesidente Jacob Zuma la ho etela Rephaboliki ya maIsilamo ya Iran, le hodisang dikamano tsa moruo le kgwebisano dipakeng tsa dinaha ka bobedi, ka ho saenwa ha ditumellano le maitlamo a mmalwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalwamukela uhambo lukaMongameli u-Jacob Zuma lokuHambela Kombuso ezweni lase-Islamic Republic of Iran, oludlondlobalisa ubudlelwano bezomnotho kanye nezokuhwebelana phakathi kwawo womabili lawa mazwe, ngokucikicwa kwezivumelwano ezihlukahlukene kanye nezibophezelo.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma le Moporesidente Hasan Rouhani ba tiisitse tshebedisano-mmoho mapatlelong a kgwebisano, thuto le ntshetsopele ya maitsebelo saense le thekenoloji eneji, ho kenyeletswa le bokgoni ba ho tsoma kgase le ho e lokisetsa tshebediso temo merafo le bokgolamolemo ba diminerale ntshetsopele ya meralo ya motheo le dipalangwang ditjhelete, merero ya dibanka le inshorense le bohahlaudi.
tgt: UMongameli u-Jacob Zuma kanye noMongameli u-Hasan Rouhani bakuqinisile ukusebenza ngokubambisana emikhakheni yezokuhwebelana, ezemfundo kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono ezesayensi kanye nobuchwepheshe ezamandla, kubandakanya nokuhlolwa kwegesi yamakhemikhali kaphethiloli ongakahluzwa kanye namandla okukwazi ukuhluza ezolimo ezezimayini kanye nokuhlomula kwezezimbiwa phansi ezokuthuthukiswa kwengqalasizinda kanye nezokuthutha ezezimali, ezokubhanga kanye nezemishwalense kanye nezokuvakasha.

src: E leng kaofela tse nyehelang ho Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP).Boemong ba tsa Matjhaba, baetapele ba babedi ba dumellane ka ho matlafatsa kgoeletso bakeng sa tlhabollo ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng ka ho qolleha Lekgotla la Tshireletso la UN, molemong wa lefatshe le ntseng le tswela pele.
tgt: Konke lokhu kunegalelo ekuqalisweni kokusebenza koHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP).Ngasohlangothini lwamazwe omhlaba, abaholi ababili bavumile ukuqinisa ikhwela elihlatshwayo lokuguqulwa kweNhlangano Yezizwe Ezihlangene (i-UN) ikakhulukazi Umkhandlu Wezokuvikeleka weNhlangano Yezizwe Ezihlangene, ngokubhekelela izimfuno zamazwe asathuthuka.

src: Diphetho tsena di matlafaditse Leeto la Tshebetso la Moporesidente ho ya United Arab Emirates (UAE) moo dipuso ka bobedi di ntjhafaditseng boitlamo ba tsona ho lebiseng matlafatsong le kgodisong ya dikamano tsa bobedi, ka ho qolleha kgwebisanong, matseteng le mapatlelong a moruo hore e be bolekane ba lewa le pharalletseng.
tgt: Le miphumela iqinise kabusha Uhambo Lokusebenza lukaMongameli oluya ezweni lase-United Arab Emirates (i-UAE) lapho yomibili le mibuso ivuselele isibophezelo sayo maqondana nokuhlanganiswa kanye nokukhushulwa kobudlelwano obumbaxambili, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni yezokuhwebelana, ezokutshalwa kwezimali kanye neyezomnotho ukuba bube ukubambisana okubanzi okunobuqhinga.

src: Sena se ahella hodima Leeto la Puso la Moporesidente Jacob Zuma ka Pudungwana 2011 moo ho bonahetseng ho thehwa ha Khomishene e Kopanetsweng ya SA-UAE e akofisitseng lebelo la kgwebisano e phethahetseng dipakeng tsa dinaha tse pedi tsena ho tloha ho R13 bilione ka 2011 ho ya ho R27 bilione ka 2015.Aforika Borwa le UAE hape di dumellane ho eketsa tshebedisano-mmoho ho sebetsana le menyetla ho Moruo wa Lewatle, ho hodisa ho romellwa dinaheng tse ka ntle ha dihlahiswa tsa temo tsa Aforika Borwa, dihlahiswa tse entsweng difemeng mme ka ho qolleha theko ya tsa tshireletso le bomphato.
tgt: Lokhu kwakhelwe ohambweni lukaMongameli uJacob Zuma Lokuhambela Kombuso ngoLwezi wezi-2011 olwabonakalisa ukusungulwa kweKhomishana Ehlanganyelwe ye-SA-UAE eyadlondlobalisa umgqigqo ophelele wezokuhwebelana phakathi kwamazwe omabili kusukela ezigidini eziyi-13 zamarandi ngowezi-2011 kuya ezigidini ezingama-27 zamarandi ngowezi-2015.INingizimu Afrika kanye ne-UAE baphinde bavumelana ukuthi bazokwandisa ukusebenza ngokubambisana ukuze basebenzise amathub ngendlela efunwa yibona Kwezomnotho Wasolwandle, ukukhulisa ukuhanjiswa emazweni angaphandle kwemikhiqizo yezolimo yaseNingizimu Afrika, imikhiqizo ekhiqiziwe ikakhulukazi ukuthengwa kwezinto zezokuzivikela kanye namaxhama okubambisana.

src: Leeto hape le hodisitse bokgoni ba Aforika Borwa ba ho aha meralo ya motheo ho shebanwe le menyetla bakeng sa dikhamphani tsa Aforika Borwa ho EXPO 2020 ho la Dubai, hammoho le tshebedisano-mmoho lepatlelong la kgotso le botsitso.
tgt: Lolu hambo luphinde lwakhulisa amandla iNingizimu Afrika enawo ukwakha ingqalasizinda esophe amathuba azotholwa yizinkampani zaseNingizimu Afrika embukisweni i-EXPO 2020 ozobe ubanjelwe eDubai, kanjalo nokusebenza ngokubambisana emkhakheni wezoxolo, ukuvikeleka kanye nozinzo.

src: Kabinete e amohetse mehato e tiileng e kentsweng tshebetsong ke Letona la Dipapadi le Boikgathollo Fikile Mbalula ho aha botjha maemo a qhetsohileng le ho ba le kgethollo e tebileng ho tsa dipapadi le boikgathollo ka tshebediso ya Tjhata ya Diphethoho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izamukelile izinyathelo eziqinile ezibekwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezemidlalo Nokungcebeleka uFikile Mbalula ukubumba kabusha ukubukeka kwesimo sezemidlalo nokungcebeleka esiqhekekile nesibandlululayo ngendlela ejulile esebenzisa uMqulu waso Woguquko.

src: Sena se tla akofisa diphethoho tse tla lebisang tsamaisong e kopaneng ya dipapadi e thehilweng hodima dipehelo tsa demokerasi, tekatekano, ponaletso le boemedi ho ya ka mekgahlelo e fapaneng ya setjhaba, phumantsho le bonkakarolo bo eketsehileng ho ipapisitswe le ditabatabelo tsa NDKabinete e amohela dipuo tsa ditekanyetso tse ntseng di tekwa ke mafapha a fapafapaneng le ditlaleho tse batsi tse supang kgatelopele e entsweng bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa bophelo ba maAforika Borwa.
tgt: Lokhu kuzodlondlobalisa uguquko maqondana nohlelo lwezemidlalo olubumbene olusekelwe ngaphansi kwemigomo yentando yeningi labantu, ukulingana, ukusebenzela obala, ukumeleleka kwabantu ngokwehlukahlukana kwabo, ukufinyeleleka kanye nokubamba iqhaza okukhuphukile ngokuhambelana nezinjongo zoHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ho latela dipuo tsa ditekanyetso mapatlelong a fapafapaneng a boraditaba bakeng sa ho utlwisisa betere ka Lenaneo la Mmuso la Tshebetso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamukela izinkulumo zamavoti esabiwomali ezethulwa yiminyango eyehlukene ezihambisana nemibiko ebanzi eqhakambisa inqubekelaphambili esiyenziwe maqondana nokwenziwa ngcono kwezimpilo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso bakeng sa boitlamo bo tswellang mabapi le diphetho tse bonahalang dibakeng tsa mosebetsi ho itshetlehilwe hodima diphetho ho tswa ho Tlaleho ya Selemo ka seng ya Khomishene ya bo-16 ya Tekatekano Mosebetsing bakeng sa bahiri ba tobilweng e thakgotsweng tlasa mookotaba “Diphethoho di bohlokwa kgwebong”.
tgt: Lokhu kubonisa ukuqaliswa ukusebenza koHlaka Lokusebenza Lwesikhathi Esimaphakathi olusisondeza eduzane nokufezekiswa koMbono wezi-2030 woHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe.

src: Tlaleho ena e thusa mmuso ho utlwisia maemo a tekatekano mosebetsing ka hara naha le kgatelopele ya yona ho diphethoho mosebetsing bakeng sa selemo sa 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba balandelele izinkulumo zokwabiwa kwezimali ezinkundleni zabenzindaba ezinhlobonhlobo ukuze baqonde kangcono ngoHlelo Lokusebenza lukaHulumeni.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse Lefapha la Bodulo ba Batho ka phano ya matlo a 4, 3 milione le menyetla ya matlo ho tloha mathwasong a demokerasi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa ukuba kube khona ukuzibophezela okuqhubekayo ukuze kuvikelwe uguquko olunengqondo lwendawo yokusebenzela ngokubhekelela imiphumela evela Embikweni Wonyaka weKhomishana ye-16 Yokuqashwa Kwabantu Ngokulingana wabo bonke abaqashi abaqokiwe owethulwa ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi “Uguquko lubalulekile”.

src: Menyetla ena e kenyeletsa matlo a tsheheditsweng ka botlalo a 2, 806 235 (matlo a BNG), matlo a hiriswang/kahisano a 121 784, a 6329 a Lenaneo le Hoketsweng ho Ditshehetso tsa Ditjhelete tsa ka Bomong le ditentshe tse nang le ditshebeletso tse 986 608.Mokolokotwane ona o etsang nalane o fane ka bodulo ho batho ba fetang 20 milione mme ho keteka phihlello ena mmuso o thakgotse letsholo la naha la ho bontsha katleho ya naha.
tgt: Umbiko usiza uhulumeni ukuba aqonde isimo sokuqashwa kwabantu ngokulingana ezweni kanye nenqubekelaphambili yaso ekuguqulweni kwendawo yokusebenzela onyakeni wezi-2015.

src: Kabinete e lebohile maAforika Borwa kaofela bakeng sa dinyehelo tsa ona, boitelo le mosebetsi o matla wa ho netefatsa hore seriti sa maAforika Borwa a hlokang se babaletswe ka bodulo ba batho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele uMnyango Wezokuhlaliswa Kwabantu ngokwakhiwa kwezindlu eziyizigidi eziwu-4, 3 kanye namathuba okwakhiwa kwenzindlu kusukela kwafika umbuso wentando yeningi labantu.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Mongodikakaretso wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng ka ho hlophisa Mokete wa Maemo a Hodimo wa ho Saena Tumellano ya Paris, e amohetsweng ke Mekga e 176 ka Tshitwe 2015.
tgt: Lawa mathuba abandakanya izindlu ezixhaswe ngokuphelele eziyizi-2, 806 235 (izindlu ze-BNG), izindlu zomphakathi/eziqashisayo eziyizi-121 784, izi-6329 zoHlelo Lokuxhaswa Komuntu Ngamunye Oluxhunywe Kwezezimali kanye neziza zokwakha ezinezinsizakalo eziyizi-986 608.Leli banga eliyingqophamlando eselihanjiwe selihlinzeke umpheme kubantu abangaphezu kwezigidi ezingama-20 kanti-ke ukubhiyozela le mpumelelo umnyango sewethule umkhankaso kazwelonke wokudweba isithombe sempumelelo yezwe lakithi.

src: Ho saenwa ha Tumellano ya Paris ho tshwaile mohato wa pele ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha yona o tla tataisa mekutu ya matjhaba ya ho fokotsa ho ntshwa ha dikgase tse kotsi le ho mekamekana le diphephetso kaofela tse amanang le ho fetofetoha ha tlelaemete.
tgt: Ukwethulwa kukazwelonke kubanjelwe e-COSMO City, okungomunye wemiklamo yezindlu edidiyelwe eseqhulwini ezweni lonkana nawo ogubha iminyaka eyishumi ukhona.

src: Kabinete e lebeletse ka tshepo sephetho sa ditsamaiso tsa tiisetso tsa lehae, ke bohle, ho thusa hore ho be le ho kenngwa ka nako ka botlalo ha Tumellano ya Paris ka 2020.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonge bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngegalelo labo, ukuzimisela kanye nokusebenza kanzima ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi isithunzi sabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaswele siyabuyiselwa ngezinhlelo zokuhlaliswa kwabantu.

src: Kabinete hape e ananetse hore Lefapha la Merero ya Tikoloho le entse semphato le Lefapha la Bohahlaudi bakeng sa ho fana ka dilaboratori tsa sehlooho se reng “Biodiversity Lab: Re hodisa nyehelo ya moruo ya mehlodi ya Aforika Borwa ya tlhaho” ho tloha ka la 10 Mmesa ho isa la 13 Motsheanong 2016.Sepheo ke ho elellwa bokgoni ba moruo ba diphapang tsa tlhaho tse ruileng tsa Aforika Borwa tse tekilweng ho moralo wa Lewa la Naha la Moruo wa Tlhaho o tjhaelletsweng monwana ke Kabinete ka Phupu 2015 hore setjhaba se nke karolo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi income uNobhala-Jikelele weNhlangano Yezizwe Ezihlangane ngokuhlanganisa Umcimbi Osezingeni Eliphezulu Wokucikicwa Kwesivumelwano sase-Paris, esamukelwa ngamazwe ayi-176 ngoZibandlela wezi-2015.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Moralo wa Tshebetso wa Leano la Diindaseteri (IPAP) 2016/17 – 2018/19, e leng tshiya ya bohlokwa ya Moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong wa Moporesidente o lebisang ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha NDP.
tgt: Ukucikicwa Kwesivumelwano sase-Paris kuwuphawu lwesinyathelo sokuqala ekuqalisweni kokusebenza kwaso okuzohola imizamo yamazwe omhlaba ukunciphisa ukukhiqizwa kwezintuthu ezingcolisa umoya kanye nokuhlangabezana nazo zonke izinselele eziphonswe ukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu.

src: Sena ke ho phetwa ka tatelano ha borobedi ha selemo ka seng ha meralo ya mmuso ya akofiso ya diindaseteri ho ahellang hodima diphihlello, mapatlelo a leano le mananeo a ho phetwa ho fetileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isilangazelele isiphetho sezinqubo zezigunyazo zalapha ezweni ngaphakathi ezihlukahlukene, yibo bonke abantu, ukuvumela ukuqaliswa ngesikhathi kokusebenza ngokuphelele Kwesivumelwano sase-Paris ngowezi-2020.

src: IPAP 2016/17 e rerile ho fihlella leano la diindaseteri le nang le kgahlamelo e batlang e phahame maemong a boima a moruo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yaqaphela ukuthi uMnyango Wezemvelo usubambisene noMnyango Wezokuvakasha ekuhlanganiseni amalebhu okuhanjiswa kwezinsizakalo abizwa ngokuthi yi-“Biodiversity Lab: Ukukhulisa igalelo lezomnotho lemithombo yezemvelo yaseNingizimu Afrika” kusukela mhla ziyi-10 kuMbasa kuya mhla ziyi-13 kuNhlaba 2016.Inhloso ukufezekisa amandla ezomnotho emvelo enothile yaseNingizimu Afrika eyingxubevange aveziwe ohlakeni lokuqala lweQhinga Likazwelonke Lezomnotho Yezemvelo Eyingxubevange olwagunyazwa yiKhabhinethi ngoNtulikazi wezi-2015 ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukubamba iqhaza kulona.

src: Tsena di kenyeletsa dikgahlamelo tse ntseng di tswela pele tsa ho thefuleha ha moruo wa lefatshe ho kenyeletswa le koduwa ya diindaseteri tsa tshepe le ho putlama ha thepa hammoho le komello e matla le mathata a mang a ka lapeng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze Uhlelo Lokusebenza Lwenqubomgomo Yezimboni (i-IPAP) lowezi-2016/17 – 2018/19, oluyinsika eqavile yoHlelo Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye lukaMongameli futhi olunegalelo maqondana nokuqaliswa kokusebenza koHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe.

src: Diphihlello tsa ho tswa selemong se fetileng di kenyeletsa ho baballwa ha mesebetsi e ka bang 67 000 le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi e hlamatsehang e metjha e ballwang ho 7 000 lekaleng la Diaparo le Masela le Dieta.
tgt: Lesi yisibuyekezo sonyaka wesishiyagalombili sezinhlelo eziyimpumelelo zezimboni zikahulumeni esakhela ezinzuzweni, izithangami zezinqubomgomo kanye nezinhlelo zezibuyekezo ezidlulile.

src: Lekala la tlatsetso la dihlahiswa tsa Temo ke le leng la makala a maholo a tlhahiso la phano ya mesebetsi, e ballwang ho mesebetsi e 216 090 ka 2015 ha ho bapiswa le e 208 822 ka 2014.Matsete a boleng ba R600 milione a ile a hohelwa ka 2015/16, mme a etsa motheo bakeng sa ho matlafatsa ntshetsopele ya kgwebo ho tsepamisitswe maikutlo hodima badudi ba mahaeng.
tgt: I-IPAP yowezi-2016/17 ifuna ukuzuza inqubomgomo yezezimboni enomthelela ophezulu ezimweni ezinzima zezomnotho.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Moralo o Kopanetsweng wa Ntshetsopele ya Ditoropo wa ho Phethela le Moralo wa ho Kenya Tshebetsong wa 2016/19.
tgt: Lokhu kubandakanya imithelela eqhubekayo yokuwohloka kwamandla omnotho emhlabeni wonke kubandakanya nesimo esimazonzo embonini yezensimbi nezimbiwaphansi kanjalo nesomiso esibi kakhulu kanye nezinye izingqinamba ezinkulu ezikhona ezweni lakithi ngaphakathi.

src: Sephetho ka kakaretso sa Moralo o Kopanetsweng wa Ntshetsopele ya Ditoropo ke ho fetola qaqolohano ya dibaka tsa bodulo.
tgt: Izimpumelelo zangonyaka odlule zibandakanya ukuphephiswa kwemisebenzi ebalelwa ezi-67 000 kanye nokusungulwa kwemisebenzi eqotho emisha sha eyizi-7 000 emkhakheni Wezendwangu, Izimpahla Zesikhumba kanye Nezicathulo.

src: Sena se tshwaya tsamaiso e ntjha ya metsemeholo le ditoropo tsa Aforika Borwa, sena se tla tataisetsa kgolo ya ditoropo ho lebiseng ho motlolo wa kgolo wa moshwelella o kopaneng, o hokahanyang le ho kopanya metsemeholo le ditoropo, tse bolokehileng, tse nang le mehlodi e hlwahlwa le ho ba dibaka tse ntle tsa ho sebetsa le ho dula ho tsona.
tgt: Izigidi ezingaphezu kwama-600 zamarandi zotshalomali ezihehekile ngowezi-2015/16, ezindlale isisekelo sokuqinisa ukuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi ngokugxila kakhulu emiphakathini yasezindaweni ezisemakhaya.

src: Sena se arabela ho taelo ya NDP la ho hodisa leano la ntshetsopele ya ditoropo le tla netefatsa moralo o nepahetseng, matsete a meralo ya motheo le taolo ya ho tshehetsa bokgoni ba kgolo le ho bula bokgoni ba moruo ba metsemeholo le ditoropo tsa rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze Uhlaka Lokusebenza Lokugcina Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Ezisemadolobheni Ezididiyelwe kanye Nohlelo Lokuqaliswa Ukusebenza lowezi-2016/19.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Moralo wa Leano la Naha la Ntshetsopele ya Ditshebeletso tsa Makala a Thuto – Re aha Tsamaiso e hlwahlwa le e Kopanetsweng ya Ntshetsopele ya Ditshebeletso tsa Makala a Thuto bakeng sa Aforika Borwa, Koranteng ya Mmuso bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Umphumela ophelele woHlaka Lokusebenza Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Ezisemadolobheni Ezididiyelwe ukuguqulwa kokuklaywa kwemingcele yedolobha.

src: Moralo ona wa Leano hang feela ha o kentswe tshebetsong o tla fana ka katamelo e kopanetsweng bakeng sa ditshebeletso tsa ntshetsopele ya makala a thuto a boleng bakeng sa baahi kaofela.
tgt: Lokhu kuwuphawu lesivumelwano esisha samadolobha kanye namadolobhana amancane aseNingizimu Afrika, esizoqhubezela phambili ukukhula kwezindawo ezisemadolobheni siziqhubekisele ohlakeni lokukhula okuqinile kwamadolobha namadolobhana amancane ahlangene, axhumene futhi adidiyelwe, aphephile, anezinsiza ezanele futhi ayizindawo ezinhle zokusebenza kanye nokuhlala kuzo.

src: Sena se tla ba thusa ho etsa diqeto tse kgabane tsa makala a thuto hore ba thole mesebetsi, ba nyehele setjhabeng le ho aha moruo wa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lokhu kuphendula emyalelweni woHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe wokuthi kusungulwe inqubomgomo yokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo ezisemadolobheni ezoqinisekisa ukuhlela okufanelekile, utshalomali lwezingqalasizinda kanye nokuphathwa kwalo ukuze kwesekwe ukukhula kanye nokuthukulula amandla ezomnotho amadolobha kanye namadolobhana amancane ethu.

src: Ditshebeletso tsa Ntshetsopele ya Makala a Thuto di bapala karolo ya bohlokwa mabapi le ho thusa mebaraka ya rona ya mosebetsi hore e sebetse le hore mekgwa ya thuto e fihlelle merero ya yona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukushicilelwa koHlaka lweNqubomgomo Yezinsizakalo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwemikhakha Yemisebenzi Kazwelonke – Ukwakha Uhlelo Lwezinsizakalo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwemikhakha Yemisebenzi Oluyimpumelelo Noludidiyelwe lwaseNingizimu Afrika, eMqulwini Kahulumeni ukuze kutholwe imibono yomphakathi.

src: Sena se nyehela ho lebiseng ha phihlello ya dikgothaletso tsa NDP tsa ho hlasimolla kgolo ya moruo le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi, le ho matahanya basebeletsi le mesebetsi e loketseng eo ba e etsang le ho eketsa ntshetsopele ya maitsebelo le palo ya ba nang le mangolo a diyunivesithi.
tgt: Uhlaka lweNqubomgomo uma seluqalisiwe ukusebenza luzohlinzeka ngendlela yokusebenza ehlanganisiwe yezinsizakalo zokuthuthukiswa kwemikhakha yemisebenzi eziseqophelweni eliphezulu zazo zonke izakhamuzi.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Tsamaiso ya Naha ya Tekolo le ho tjhaella monwana Tlaleho ya Selemo ka seng ya 2014/15 le Moralo wa Naha wa Tekolo bakeng sa 2016/17 ho ya ho 2018/19, jwaloka karolo ya boikitlaetso ba ho ntlafatsa phano ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: Lokhu kuzokwenza izakhamuzi zikwazi ukukhetha imikhakha yemisebenzi ngomqondo ophusile ukuze zikwazi ukuqashwa, zibe negalelo emphakathini futhi zakhe umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Tsamaiso ya Naha ya Tekolo e tswa ho Moralo wa Leano la Naha la Tekolo o netefatsang hore bopaki bo tshepahalang le bo hlokang tshekamelo ho tswa ho ditekolo bo kenyeletswa tsamaisong ya ho etsa meralo, ho etsa ditekanyetso tsa ditjhelete, ntlafatso ya mekgatlo, tjhebo-botjha ya maano, hammoho le lenaneo le tswellang le taolo ya diporojeke ka morero wa ho ntlafatsa tshebetso.
tgt: Izinsizakalo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwemikhakha Yemisebenzi zidlala indima esemqoka ekusizeni umsebenzi wezimakethe zabasebenzi kanye nezinhlelo zezemfundo zikwazi ukuhlangabezana nezinjongo zazo.

src: Ditekolo tse 47 di se di phethetswe kapa di motjheng, tse akaretsang R75 bilione ya ditjeho tsa mmuso.
tgt: Lokhu kunegalelo maqondana nokufezekiswa kwezincomo zoHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe zokugqugquzela ukukhula komnotho kanye nokuqashwa kwabantu, ukuqondaniswa kwabasebenzi abaqashiwe nemisebenzi yabo kanye nokwandisa ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kanye nesibalo sabantu abaneziqu zemfundo yasenyuvesi.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka diphetho tsa tekolo le ho tjhaella monwana dikgothaletso ka morero wa ho eketsa sekgahla ho tswa ho ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lekala la Kahisano la Lenaneo la Katoloso ya Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba (EPWP-SS).Lenaneo lena le bapala karolo ya bohlokwa bakeng sa tshireletso ya kahisano bakeng sa batho ba baholo ba ntseng ba itekanetse ba sa sebetseng, ka ho ba hulela mosebetsing o nang le tlhahiso le ho amohela ditlhapiso tsa kgwedi ka palohare ya tjhelete e etsang R1 517.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nokuqaliswa kokusebenza Kohlelo Lokulinganisa Lukazwelonke futhi lagunyaza umbiko Wonyaka wezi-2014/15 kanye Nohlelo Lokulinganisa Lukazwelonke lesihlanu lowezi-2016/17 kuya kowezi-2018/19, njengengxenye yombhidlango wokwenza ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo-ngqangi.

src: Boholo ba mananeo a lekala la kahisano a fana ka ditshebeletso tse ikgethang ho badudi ba kotsing le ba fumanehileng.
tgt: Uhlelo Lokulinganisa Lukazwelonke lususelwa oHlakeni Lokusebenza leNqubomgomo Yokulinganisa Kazwelonke oluqinisekisa ukuthi ubufakazi obuqotho nobunenjongo obuvela ekulinganisweni buyafakwa ezinhlelweni zokuhlela, ukwabiwa kwezimali, ukwenziwa ngcono kwezinhlangano, ukubuyekezwa kwezinqubomgomo, kanjalo nasezinhlelweni eziqhubekayo kanye nokuphathwa kwemiklamo ukuze kwenziwe ngcono ukusebenza.

src: EPWP-SS e hotse ka potlako pakeng tsa mokgahlelo wa pele le wa bobedi, ho tloha ho mananeo a 5 ho isa ho a 22 a bakileng hore lekala le fihlelle menyetla ya mesebetsi e 175 769 mokgahlelong wa pele le menyetla e 866 246 mokgahlelong wa bobedi, e leng se ka nqane ho sepheo sa 750 000.Dikgothaletso di tsepamisitse maikutlo hodima ntlafatso ya ho kenngwa tshebetsong bakeng sa ho fokotsa dikgaello tabeng ya ho etsa diqeto, ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha (ditefello le ditlhapiso) le phano ya thupello, hammoho le kgokahano.
tgt: Izilinganiso ezingama-47 seziphothuliwe noma zisaqhutshwa, ezikhava izigidigidi ezingama-75 zamarandi ezindleko zikahulumeni.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka diphetho le ho tiisetsa dikgothaletso tsa moralo le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha tekolo ya Thuso ya Ditjhelete ya Ntshetsopele ya Bodulo ba Ditoropong le Moralo wa Ntlafatso ya tsona.
tgt: Imibiko yokulinganisa eyi-15 yagunyazwa kwathi eyi-12 yabekwa ezithebeni zeKhabhinethi kuze kube manje.

src: Diphetho di tshehetsa ho baballwa ha Thuso ya Ditjhelete ya Ntshetsopele ya Ditoropo jwaloka thuso ya tshehetso e thusang ka matlole mohopolo wa bodulo ba batho ba moshwelella le bo lekalekanang molemong wa bafumanehi le malapa a lekeno le mahareng.
tgt: Izinhlelo zokwenza ngcono eziyi-14 ziyaqaliswa ukusebenza kanti futhi inqubekelaphambili maqondana nazo ikhombisa izinguquko ezinkulu kakhulu, ukukhulisa umthelela wazo.

src: Sena ke sa bohlokwa bakeng sa ho fihlella merero ho tswa ho Moralo wa Lewa la Nako e Bohareng phano ya menyetla e 1 495 milione ya bodulo ditikolohong tsa boleng ka 2019.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nemiphumela yokulinganisa kanye nezincomo ezigunyaziwe ngenhloso yokwandisa umthelela osukela ekuqalisweni ukusebenza Kohlelo Lemisebenzi Yomphakathi Eyandisiwe Yomkhakha Wezenhlalo (i-EPWP-SS).Lolu Hlelo ludlala indima esemqoka yokuvikelwa kwesimo senhlalo yabantu abantu abangakhubazeke ndawo abangasebenzi, kokubadonsela emsebenzini onomkhiqizo bese bethola umthobanhlizinyo njalo ngenyanga olinganiselwa esambeni se-R1 517.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana tlaleho ya Ho kenngwa Tshebetsong le Tekolo ya Kgahlamelo ya Thekenoloji le Mehlodi ya Batho bakeng sa Lenaneo la Diindaseteri, karabelo ya botsamaisi ho tlaleho le moralo wa ntlafatso o kentsweng ke Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri.
tgt: Iningi lezinhlelo zomkhakha wezenhlalo lihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezikhethekile emiphakathini entekenteke nehluphekayo.

src: Lenaneo lena le ile la hlahiswa ke Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri ka 1992 ho matlafatsa ntshetsopele ya maitsebelo ho tsa saense, boenjinere le thekenoloji.
tgt: I-EPWP-SS ikhule ngesivinini esikhulu phakathi kwesigaba sokuqala nesigaba sesibili, kusukela ezinhlelweni ezi-5 kuya ezinhlelweni ezingama-22 okuholele kulo mkhakha ukuba ufezekise amathuba emisebenzi ayizi-175 769 esigabeni sokuqala kanye namathuba emisebenzi ayizi-866 246 esigabeni sesibili, nokungaphezulu kakhulu kobekusophiwe okungamathuba emisebenzi ayizi-750 000.Izincomo zigxile ekwenzeni ngcono ukuqaliswa kokusebenza ukuze kuncishiswe ukungasebenzi ngendlela egculisayo ekuthathweni kwezinqumo, ukuqaliswa ukusebenza (izinkokhelo zemithobanhliziyo) kanye nokuhlinzekwa ngokuqeqesha, kanjalo nokuxhumanisa.

src: Le nyehela ho tlhahiso ya mesebetsi ka ho hlahisa phallo ya bafuputsi ba nang le maitsebelo a maholo le batsamaisi ba thekenoloji bakeng sa diindaseteri le ho ntlafatsa bophehisani ba mekgatlo ya kgwebo e nkang karolo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nemiphumela kanye nezincomo ezigunyaziwe zedizayini kanye nokuqaliswa ukusebenza kokulinganiswa Kwesabelo Sokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zokuhlala Ezisemadolobheni kanye Nohlelo Lokwenziwa Ngcono kwaso.

src: Lenaneo lena ke la sebele, la bohlokwa le ho ba ntlha e hlwahlwa ya tshehetso ya ntjhafatso e fanang ka boleng ba tjhelete bo hlamatsehang ka bobedi mabapi le ntshetsopele ya thekenoloji le ho ntshetsapele mehlodi ya batho le maitsebelo a tsamaelanang le diindaseteri.
tgt: Imiphumela yeseka ukugcinwa kweSabelo Sokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zokuhlala Ezisemadolobheni njengesabelo sokunezezela esikhokhela umqondo ovulekile wokuhlaliswa kwabantu okuqhubekayo nokulinganayo ukuze kuhlomule abantu abahluphekayo kanye namakhaya anemali engenayo engenkulu kakhulu.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka diphetho tsa dipatlisiso tsa Tlaleho ya Moifo wa Tshebetso wa Matona mabapi le dipelaelo tsa ‘thekiso ya dikgeo tsa mosebetsi tsa matitjhere’ tse amang batho ka bo mong, mekgatlo ya matitjhere le bahlanka ba Mafapha a itseng a Thuto a Diporofense.
tgt: Lokhu kuwusizo kakhulu ekufezekiseni izinjongo zoHlaka Lokusebenza Lwesikhathi Esimaphakathi ukuhlinzekwa kwamathuba okwakhiwa kwezindlu eziyisigidi esi-1 495 ezindaweni zokuhlala eziseqophelweni eliphezulu ngowezi-2019.

src: Kabinete e ile ya thathiselletsa dikgothaletso tsa ho sebetsa hantle le ho tobana le diphetho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze umbiko maqondana Nokuqaliswa Ukusebenza kanye Nokulinganiswa Komthelela Wezobuchwepheshe kanye Nezindaba Zabasebenzi zoHlelo Lwezezimboni, impendulo yabaphathi embikweni kanye nohlelo lokwenza ngcono oluthunyelwe nguMnyango Wezokuhwebelana kanye Nezezimboni.

src: Tlaleho ya ho Qetela ya Moifo wa Tshebetso wa Matona e fana ka thunthetso ya karolo e bapetsweng ke bankakarolo bohle tsamaisong ya thonyo le ho thaothwa ha matitjhere.
tgt: Lolu Hlelo lwethulwa nguMnyango Wezohwebo kanye Nezezimboni ngowe-1992 ukuze kuqiniswe ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kwezesayensi, ezobunjiniyela kanye nezobuchwepheshe.

src: Hape e ananela mathata a maholo tsamaisong ya hajwale ya dithonyo dikgeong tsa mosebetsi lekaleng la thuto ya motheo le ho fana ka dikgothaletso ho thusa Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo le lekala la thuto ya motheo ka kakaretso ho sebetsana le diphephetso tse hlwailweng.
tgt: Lunegalelo ekusungulweni kwamathuba emisebenzi ngokukhiqiza inqwaba yabacwaningi abanamakhono aphezulu kanye nabaphathi bezobuchwepheshe embonini kanye nokwenza ngcono ubuqhudelwano bezinhlangano zamabhizinisi ezibambe iqhaza.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Naha ya Meru Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nemiphumela yoMbiko Wethimba loNgqongqoshe Lokwenziwa Komsebenzi wokuphenya ngezinsolo ‘zokuthengiswa kwezikhala zemisebenzi yothisha’ ezibandakanya abantu abathile, izinyunyana zothisha kanye nezikhulu zeMinyango ethile Yezemfundo Yezifundazwe.

src: 84 wa 1998).Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha dihlomathiso ho tla ntlafatsa taolo ya moshwelella ya meru le hape ho kgothaletsa bonkakarolo ba dihlopha tse kotsing, tse itshetlehileng hodima tjalo ya meru bakeng sa bophelo ba tsona, ka hara Lekgotla la Naha la Boeletsi la Meru.
tgt: Embikweni walo wokugcina Ithimba loNgqongqoshe Lokwenziwa Komsebenzi lihlinzeke ngohlaziyo lwendima edlalwe yibo bonke ababambiqhaza ohlelweni lokukhethwa kanye nokuqashwa kothisha.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: IMithethosivivinywa.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla kenela mokete wa ho behwa le ho nkiswa kano ha Moporesidente wa Uganda Yoweri Museveni Kampala ka la 12 Motsheanong 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukuhanjiswa koMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela Ezamahlathi Kazwelonke ePhalamende.

src: Leeto la ho tswa ka hara naha le tla boela le matlafatsa dikamano tsa bobedi bona pakeng tsa Aforika Borwa le Uganda.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho Wezamahlathi Kazwelonke, we-1998 (uMthetho onguNombolo 84 we-1998).Ukuqaliswa ukusebenza kwezichibiyelo kuzokwenza ngcono ukuphathwa kwezamahlathi okuqinile futhi kuphinde kugqugquzele ukubamba iqhaza kwamaqempu abantu abantekenteke, abathembele emahlathini ukuze bakwazi ukuphila, eMkhandlwini Wezokululeka Ngezamahlathi Kazwelonke.

src: Moporesident Jacob Zuma o tla di hula pele ho ketsahalo ya Letsatsi la Naha la Thapelo e tla tshwarelwa Lebaleng la Dipapadi la ABSA Durban ka la 29 Mmesa 2016.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uzohambela umcimbi wokugcotshwa kanye nokufungiswa kukaMongameli wase-Uganda u-Yoweri Museveni eKampala ngomhla ziyi-12 Nhlaba 2016.

src: Baetapele ba Ditumelo le ba mekgatlo ya badudi ba tla imatahanya le mmuso bakeng sa ho rapella ho matlafala ho ya pele ha demokerasi, bonngwe ba setjhaba, momahano ya kahisano hammoho le Dikgetho tsa Mebuso ya Lehae tse atlehileng tsa 2016.
tgt: Lolu hambo oluphumayo luzophinde luqinise ubudlelwano obumbaxambili phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ne-Uganda.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka meralo ya Lefapha la Bonono le Botjhaba ya ho tshwara mokete wa Kgwedi ya Aforika ka Motsheanong 2016 tlasa mookotaba: “Re aha Aforika e Betere le Lefatshe le Betere” jwaloka karolo ya kontinente ya ho keteka ho thehwa ha Kopano ya Mokgatlo wa Aforika, oo hajwale e leng Kopano ya Aforika le mosebetsi oo e o entseng.
tgt: UMongameli u-Jacob Zuma uzokwengamela Usuku Lukazwelonke Lomkhuleko ozobanjelwa Ezinkundleni Zemidlalo i-ABSA e-Durban mhla zingama-29 Mbasa 2016.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla thakgola Kgwedi ya Aforika ka Letsatsi la Naha la Thapelo ka la 29 Mmesa 2016.Ka 2016 Kgwedi ya Aforika e tla tsepamisa maikutlo hodima boikitlaetso ba ntshetsopele ya basadi le batjha, ha re ntse re hopola selemo sa bo-60 sa Mohwanto wa Basadi le selemo sa bo-40 sa Merusu ya Batjha ya Soweto.
tgt: Abaholi bezenkolo kanye nabaholi bezinhlangano zomphakathi bazohlanganyela nohulumeni ekukhulekeleni okunye ukuqiniswa kombuso wentando yeningi labantu, ubumbano lukazwelonke, ukubumbana komphakathi kanjalo Nokhetho Lohulumeni Bezindawo lowezi-2016 oluyimpumelelo nolunokuthula.

src: MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho nka karolo lenaneong lena la dintlha tse ngata le kenyeletsang diketsahalo tse pharaletseng tse akgang ka hare bonono ba pono, theatara, mmino, dithuto le dipuisano hammoho le sehopotso sa bo-10 sa Letlole la Lefatshe la Lefa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nezinhlelo zoMnyango Wezobuciko Namasiko zokusingatha Inyanga ye-Afrika ngoNhlaba 2016 ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi: “Ukwakha i-Afrika Engcono kanye Nomhlaba Ongcono” njengengxenye yemigubho yezwekazi yokusungulwa kweNhlangano Yobumbano lwase-Afrika (i-OAU), manje esiyaziwa ngokuthi Ubumbano lwaseAfrika (i-African Union) kanye nomsebenzi esiwenzile.

src: Kgwedi ya Aforika e sebetsa jwaloka lepatlelo la ho kopana botjha le ho itlama botjha ho boAforika le Tsoseletso ya Aforika ka ho etsa hore batho ba kontinente ba atamelane ho feta.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uzokwethula Inyanga yeAfrika ngoSuku Lukazwelonke Lomkhuleko ngomhla zingama-29 kuMbasa 2016.Ngowezi-2016 Inyanga ye-Afrika izogxila ezinhlelweni eziqanjwe kabusha zokuthuthukiswa kwabantu besifazane kanye nentsha, ngenkathi sigubha iminyaka engama-60 yeMashi Yabantu Besifazane kanye neminyaka engama-40 Yemibhikiso Yentsha eSoweto.

src: Ka la 20 Motsheanong 2016 mmuso o tla etella pele mokete wa naha wa dilemo tse lekgolo wa Yunivesithi ya Fort Hare khemapaseng ya Alice ho la Kapa Botjhabela.
tgt: Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayanxuswa ukuba babambe iqhaza ohlelweni oluzobe luhlanganise iminxa ehlukahlukene olubandakanya imisebenzi enhlobonhlobo efaka phakathi imisebenzi yobuciko obubukwayo, imidlalo yeshashalazi, umculo, izifundo kanye nezingqungquthela kanjalo nokubungazwa kweminyaka eyi-10 yeSikhwama Samasiko Omhlaba Wase-Afrika.

src: Bakeng sa boitokisetso ba mokete o moholo, Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o thehile Komiti ya Matona (IMC) ho rera le ho hokahanya mokete ona o etsang nalane wa dilemo tse lekgolo.
tgt: Inyanga yase-Afrika isebenza njengenkundla yokuzixhumana kabusha kanye nokuzibophezela kabusha Obumbanweni lwama-Afrika kanye Nasekuvuselelweni kwe-Afrika ekuhlanganiseni abantu bezwekazi lase-Afrika ndawonye.

src: Setheo sena sa thuto se etsang nalane se sebeditse jwaloka mokolokotwane nakong ya ntwa ya tokoloho mme hape e tsebahala jwaloka “pitsa ya boetapele ba Aforika” hape e le setsi sa thuto sa mehleng sa batho bao e neng e le bahale ba ntwa kgahlanong le mmuso wa kgethollo ba kang ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukwe, Oliver Tambo le Govan Mbeki.
tgt: Ngomhla zingama-20 Nhlaba 2016 uhulumeni uzohola umgubho kazwelonke weminyaka eyikhulu yeNyuvesi i-Fort Hare ophikweni oluse-Alice eMpumalanga Kapa.

src: Ke yona feela yunivesithi ya Aforika e Borwa e hlahisitseng dihlooho tsa puso tse hlano: Nelson Mandela wa Aforika Borwa, Yusuf Lule wa Uganda, Robert Mugabe wa Zimbabwe, Ntsu Mokhehle wa Lesotho le Sir Seretse Khama wa Botswana.
tgt: Ukulungiselela umgubho omkhulu, uMongameli u-Jacob Zuma usesungule iKomidi loNgqongqoshe Abahlukahlukene (i-IMC) ukuba lihlele liphinde lididiyele le ngqophamlando yomgubho weminyaka eyikhulu.

src: Jwaloka karolo ya ho keteka dilemo tse lekgolo tsa Yunivesithi ya Fort Hare Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho Baithuti ba Mehleng le ditho tsa setjhaba ho arolelana mehopolo ya bona ya Fort Hare bakeng sa letsholo la Re arolele Pale ya Hao ka ho sebedisa hashtag #MyFortHare.
tgt: Lesi sikhungo sokufunda esiyingqophamlando sasebenza njengesikhonkwane ngesikhathi sethu sokuzabalazela inkululeko futhi siphinde saziwe njenge “mbiza yobuholi base-Afrika” ngenxa yokuthi iyona nyuvesi eyafunda izingqalabutho zomzabalazo wokulwisana nobandlululo ezinjengo-ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukwe, Oliver Tambo no-Govan Mbeki.

src: Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa o tla etella pele kemedi ya Aforika Borwa ho Foramo ya bo-26 ya Moruo wa Lefatshe (WEF) ya Aforika ho la Rwanda pakeng tsa la 11 le 13 Motsheanong 2016.
tgt: Iyona kuphela inyuvesi eseNingizimu ne-Afrika eyake yakhiqiza izinhloko zombuso ezinhlanu: u-Nelson Mandela waseNingizimu Afrika, u-Yusuf Lule wase-Uganda, u-Robert Mugabe waseZimbabwe, uNtsu Mokhehle waseLesotho kanye no-Sir Seretse Khama waseBotswana.

src: Foramo e tla tshwarwa tlasa mookotaba: “Re hokahanya Mehlodi ya Aforika ka Diphethoho tsa Dijithale”.Mmuso ka Moralo wa ona wa Dintlha tse Robong o ntshetsapele diphethoho tsa ona tsa dijithale.
tgt: Njengengxenye yemigubho yeminyaka eyikhulu yeNyuvesi i-Fort Hare iKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abafundi bangaphambilini bale nyuvesi kanye namalungu omphakathi ukuba abelane ngezinkumbulo anazo nge-Fort Hare emkhankasweni Wokuxoxa Indaba Yakho esebenzisa isibambo esithi #MyFortHare.

src: E fana ka mokgahlelo wa pele wa boikitlaetso ba marangrang a phatlaletseng a tla hokela ditheo tsa mmuso tse 5 000 ka hara bomasepala ba setereke ba robedi nakong ya dilemo tse tharo.
tgt: IPhini likaMongameli uCyril Ramaphosa uzohola ithimba lezinthunywa zaseNingizimu Afrika eliya Esithangamini Sezomnotho Womhlaba Wonke (i-WEF) sama-26 e-Afrika esizobe sibanjelwe eRwanda phakathi komhla ziyi-11 kanye ne-13 Nhlaba 2016.

src: Thuso ya ditjhelete e ka fihlang ho R740 milione e se abilwe bakeng sa ho tshehetsa phano.
tgt: Isithangami sisingathwe ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi: “Ukuxhumanisa Izinsiza zase-Africa ngokusebenzisa Ukuguquka Kwezobuxhakaxhaka Bukagesi”.Uhulumeni esebenzisa Uhlelo lwakhe Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye uqhubezela phambili ukuguquka kwezwe kwezobuxhakaxhaka bukagesi.

src: Lekgotla la Lefatshe la Boeti le Bohahlaudi le akanya hore bohahlaudi bo tla nyehela R560 bilione ho GDP ya rona ka 2025 mme e tla tshehetsa mesebetsi e fetang dimilione tse pedi.
tgt: Uxhaso lwemali ebalelwa ezigidini ezingama-740 zamarandi selwabiwe ukweseka lokhu kukhishwa kwalesi sigaba.

src: Kgodiso ya kgahlamelo ya Bohahlaudi ho Moruo wa Mawatle ke tshiya e hlokolosi ya Moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong, ha ho shejwa hore ho na le bokgoni bo so kang bo sibollwa hantle ba mawatle a rona, bo ka nyehelang kgolong ya moruo.
tgt: INDABA 2016 eNkosi Albert Luthuli Convention Centre e-Durban kusukela mhla ziyi-7 kuya mhla ziyi-9 Nhlaba 2016, iyisithangami Sobumbano lwama-Afrika esizokhuthaza imikhiqizo yethu yezokuvakasha kubathengi basemazweni aphesheya.

src: Moruo wa mawatle le bohahlaudi di fana ka menyetla e matla bakeng sa kgolo ya moruo le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi.
tgt: Ezokuvakasha, njengenye yezinsika eziyisithupha zokukhula komnotho woHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe, zibe negalelo lezigidigidi ezingama-357 zamarandi kwiSamba Somkhiqizo Wezwe (i-GDP) ngowezi-2014 futhi zixhase nge-9% esambeni esiphelele sabantu abaqashiwe eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Bakeng sa ho hopola Letsatsi la Basebetsi ka la 1 Motsheanong 2016, Kabinete e boeletsa boitlamo ba naha ba ho tshireletsa ditokelo tsa basebetsi ka melao ya rona ya mesebetsi e tswetseng pele.
tgt: Umkhandlu Wezokuhamba Nokuvakasha Womhlaba Wonke ulinganisa ngokuthi ezokuvakasha zizoba negalelo lezigidigidi ezingama-560 zamarandi kwi-GDP yethu ngowezi-2025 kanti futhi ziyoxhasa ngemisebenzi engaphezu kwezigidi ezimbili.

src: Ho tloha ka 1994 mmuso ka melao e kang Molao wa Dikamano tsa Basebetsi, Molao wa Maemo a Motheo a Kgiro, Molao wa Tekatekano ya Kgiro le wa Bophelo bo Botle le Polokeho Mosebetsing e hodisitse ditokelo tsa basebetsi.
tgt: Ukukhulisa umthelela Wezokuvakasha Emnothweni Wasolwandle kuyinsika esemqoka yoHlelo Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye, okususelwe emandleni angakathintwa muntu ezilwandle zethu, angaba negalelo ekukhuleni komnotho.

src: Letsholo lena le nkuwang selemo ka seng ke Lefapha la Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello, le tsamaya naha ka bophara ho fihlela ka Loetse 2016 le ho thusa baithuti ho etsa kgetho e hlokolosi ha ba etsa dikopo ho ditsha tsa thuto e phahameng.
tgt: Ekugujweni koSuku Lwabasebenzi mhla lu-1 Nhlaba 2016, iKhabhinethi igcizelela ukuzibophezela kwezwe ukuvikela amalungelo abasebenzi ngokusebenzisa imithetho yethu yabasebenzi enenqubekelaphambili.

src: Baithuti ba kgothaletswa ho ikopanya le Setsha sa Ditshebeletso tsa Ntshetsopele ya Makala a Thuto ka SMS kapa “please call me” ho 072 204 5056 kapa 086 999 0123, imeile EMAILTOKEN,Feisebukung ho WEBTOKEN kapa Twitter ho WEBTOKEN Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa Bohlokwa Maemong a Hajwale.
tgt: Kusukela ngowe-1994 uhulumeni esebenzisa imithetho enjengoMthetho Wezobudlelwano Nabasebenzi, uMthetho Wezimo Zokusebenza Eziyisisekelo, uMthetho Wokuqashwa Kwabantu Ngokulingana kanye noMthetho Wezempilo Emsebenzini kanye Nokuphepha useqhubezele phambili amalungelo abasebenzi.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa bankakarolo ba amehang ho tshwaela ka moralo wa Tjhata e Shebilweng botjha ya Matlafatso e Pharaletseng ya Matlafatso ya Batho ba Batsho Moruong mabapi le indaseteri ya Aforika Borwa ya Merafo le Diminerale ya 2016 e ileng ya phatlalatswa Koranteng ya Mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa abafundi beBanga le-12 ukuba baqale ukuthwebula amafomu okufaka izicelo noma bafake izicelo nge-inthanethi ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme njengengxenye yoMkhankaso othi Apply Now/Khetha Career Guidance.

src: Moralo o shebile botjha Tjhata ya Merafo le ho tswela pele ho kopanya maano a mmuso a diphethoho le melao bakeng sa ho matlafatsa bobebe ba ho kena kgwebong, ho hlahisa tlhakiso ya taolo, bokgoni ba tjhebelopele le bonnete.
tgt: Umkhankaso obanjwa njalo minyaka yonke nguMnyango Wezemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqesha, uzobanjwa kuzwelonke kuze kube nguMandulo 2016 futhi uzosiza abafundi ukuba bakhethe ngomqondo ophusile lapho befaka izicelo ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme.
