tgt: Isibophezelo sikahulumeni sokuqinisa nokuthuthukisa kanye nokukhulisa ukufinyelela kwabafundi emanyuvesi sesibonakale kahle kamhlophe njengoba isibalo sabafundi siphindaphindeke kabili kule minyaka engama-20 edlule.

src: Boitlamo ba mmuso ba ho matlafatsa, ho ntshetsapele, le ho pharalatswa ha ho kena diyunivesithing, bo bonahala ka ho menahana habedi ha palo ya baithuti dilemong tse 20 tse fetileng.
tgt: Lokhu kuqiniswe nayisimemezelo sikaNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqeshwa, uDkt Blade Nzimande, sokuthi kule minyaka emibili ezayo uhulumeni uzosebenzisa imali efinyelela kumarandi angamabhiliyoni ayisikhombisa ukwakha izindlu ezintsha zokuhlalisa abafundi, amalabholethri, ubuchwepheshe bezokuxhumana kanye nezinye izikhungo nezinsizakusebenza ezisemqoka, kusenjalo futhi kwenziwe nomsebenzi osemqoka wokulungisa ingqalasizinda yamanyuvesi futhi kunwetshwe namanyuvesi amasha.

src: Sena se matlafaditswe ke phatlalatso ya Letona la Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello, Ngaka Blade Nzimande ya ditjeho tsa mmuso tse fihlang ho R 7 bilione bakeng sa dilemo tse pedi tse tlang mabapi le bodulo bo botjha ba baithuti, dilaboratori, dikgokahanyo le thekenoloji, le dibaka tse ding tsa bohlokwa, hammoho le tokiso ya diyunivesithi tse teng le katoloso ya diyunivesithi tse ntjha.
tgt: Kunesinye futhi isamba semali engamarandi angamabhiliyoni ayi-2,5 esibekwe eceleni kule minyaka emihlanu ezayo esiqondiswe kulawo manyuvesi ayevinjwe amathuba phambilini futhi abengakutholi ukuxhaswa kahle ngezimali, ukuze nawo akwazi ukulisebenzisa ngokuphelele ikhono lawo lokuqeqesha abafundi.

src: R 2.5-bilione e nngwe bakeng sa dilemo tse hlano tse tlang e tla tobiswa ho diyunivesithi tse neng di tinngwe menyetla pele hore di tle di kgone ho fihlella ka bokgabane bokgoni ba tsona ba phano ya thuto e phethahetseng.
tgt: Ukutshalwa kwezimali kwingqalasizinda, kubandakanya namagumbi okufundisa nokwenza ucwaningo, nemishini nezinsizakusebenza kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi baphila ngaphansi kwesimo esikulungele ukufunda nokuqeqeshwa, okuyizinto ezisemqoka kakhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi amanyuvesi awenza ngempumelelo umsebenzi athweswe wona wokucija nokuhlomisa abafundi ngamakhono.

src: Matsete a Meralo ya Motheo, ho kenyeletsa ho ruta le dibaka tsa diphuputso, thepa, le ditikoloho tse loketseng bodulo ba baithuti ke tsa bohlokwa bakeng sa ho netefatsa hore diyunivesithi di ka kgona ho phethahatsa thomo ya tsona ya matlafatso.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezabasebenzi, u-Mildred Oliphant, uzohola umkhankaso kazwelonke wokuqwashisa nokufundisa ngeNyanga Yabasebenzi yowezi-2017 ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi “Yazi amalungelo akho kanye nezibopho zakho njengendlela yokugqugquzela ukuthotshelwa kwakhudlwana kwemithetho ebekiwe”.Lo mkhankaso uzoqwashisa abasebenzi baseNingizimu Afrika ngamalungelo abo kanye nezibopho zabo.

src: Letona la Mesebetsi, Mildred Oliphant, le tla etella pele letsholo la temoso ya Kgwedi ya Basebetsi la selemo sa 2017 tlasa mookotaba: “Tseba ditokelo tsa hao le boikarabelo jwaloka tsela ya ho hodisa boimatahanyo bo matla”.Letsholo le tla hlakisa maemo a temoso ka hara basebetsi ka hara Aforika Borwa mabapi le ditokelo le boikarabelo ba bona.
tgt: Uzogcizelela futhi nasezinzuzweni ezizuzwe ngabasebenzi eNingizimu Afrika futhi uhlole nokuthotshelwa kwemithetho yezabasebenzi.

src: Hape le tla hlakisa diphihlello tsa basebetsi ka hara Aforika Borwa le ho lekola boimatahanyo le melao ya basebetsi.
tgt: Le nyanga izobandakanya nokugasela kungazelelwe emikhakheni ethathwa njengemikhakha enenjwayelo yokuphula imithetho nemigomo ebekiwe.

src: Kgwedi ena e tla kenyeletsa dihlahlobo tsa tsometso makaleng a nkuwang e le a dulang a tlola molao.
tgt: Uhulumeni usephasise imithetho okuhloswe ngayo ukuqeda ukungalingani okukhulu okusekhona njengamanje kanye nokucwaswa kwabasebenzi, okuyizinto lo hulumeni wentando yeningi labantu azithola zikhona ngenkathi ethatha izintambo zombuso.

src: Mmuso o fetisitse molao bakeng sa ho sebetsana le ho se lekalekane ho matla le kgethollo e tletseng leeme eo re e nyantseng mmusong o fetileng.
tgt: Izinto eziwumongo wemithetho yethu yezabasebenzi yimpokophelo yokuqhubekisela phambili ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, ubulungiswa emphakathini, ukuthula nozinzo kwezabasebenzi kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izizinda okusetshenzelwa kuzona zilawulwa ngokulandela inqubo yentando yeningi labantu.

src: Se motsong wa melao ya rona ya basebetsi ke tlhokeho ya ho hodisa ntshetsopele ya moruo, toka ya tsa kahisano, kgutso mosebetsing le ho etsa hore dibaka tsa mosebetsi e be tsa demokerasi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa yonke imikhakha ukuba idlale indima yayo ekuqedeni ukungalingani okusekhona okuwumphumela wenqubo yesikhathi esedlule, ngokuthi kusheshiswe uguquko emsebenzini njengoba manje lusahamba ngesivinini sonwabu.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho makala kaofela ho bapala karolo ya ona bakeng sa ho sebetsana le ho se lekalekane ha nako e fetileng ka ho tobana le motsamao o monyebe wa diphethoho dibakeng tsa mosebetsi.
tgt: Uhulumeni uqhube imikhankaso yesi-6 Yeviki Likazwelonke Lokugxila Ezimbizweni ngaphansi kwalo hulumeni owathatha izintambo zokubusa ngowezi-2014, kusukela mhla ziyi-17 kuya kumhla zingama-23 kuMbasa 2017.

src: Beke ena e tshwailwe ka nako e matla ya dipuisano pakeng tsa ditho tsa phethahatso le baahi mme e nyehela moralong wa mmuso o pharaletseng wa ho ntlafatsa maphelo a baahi kaofela.
tgt: Okwaphawuleka kakhulu ngalelo viki kwaba yimihlangano eminingi eyabanjwa ngamalungu eziphathimandla zikahulumeni nezakhamuzi futhi linegalelo elikhulu ohlelweni olubanzi lukahulumeni lokwenza ngcono izimpilo zazo zonke izakhamuzi zakuleli.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa badudi ba nkileng karolo ho Izimbizo le bahlanka ba mmuso ho phatlalla le naha, ka morero wa ho tobana le diphephetso tsa tshebeletso ya mmuso le ho fana ka bophelo bo betere bakeng sa bohle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyishayela ihlombe leyo miphakathi eyabamba iZimbizo nezikhulu zikahulumeni ezweni lonkana, ngenhloso yokuxazulula izinselelo ezikhona emkhakheni wezomsebenzi kahulumeni ukuze kuhlinzekwe impilo engcono kubantu bonke.

src: Izimbizo tse ding di ne di kenyeletsa: ho thakgolwa ha Setsi sa Ketapele ya Dikgwebo Koletjheng ya Thuto le Thupello ya Mosebetsi wa Setekginiki (TVET) ya Goldfields Welkom, ho la Freistata ke Letona la Ntshetsopele ya Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane, Mofumahadi Lindiwe Zulu.
tgt: Ezinye zeZimbizo zibandakanya lokhu: ukwethulwa kweSikhungo Sokusungulwa Nokuphathwa Kwamabhizinisi ekholishi yoKufundela Umsebenzi Wezobuchwepheshe Bezandla Nokuqeqeshwa (i-TVET) yase-Goldfields e-Welkom, esifundazweni saseFreyistata nguNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwamabhizinisi Amancane, uNkz Lindiwe Zulu.

src: Setsi sena se nyehela bakeng sa ho tobana le diphephetso tsa tlhokeho ya mosebetsi ho batjha ka ho fana ka tshehetso e nepahetseng ho batjha nako e sa le teng leetong la ketapele ya dikgwebo.
tgt: Lesi Sikhungo siyalekelela ekuxazululweni kwenselelo yokuswelakala kwemisebenzi entsheni, ngokuthi sihlinzeke abantu abasha ngosizo olufanalekile ngenkathi besathatha izinyathelo zokuqala ohambweni lwabo lokusungula amabhizinisi.

src: Dikopano tse 34 di tshwerwe ho phatlalla le naha.
tgt: Kwabanjwa imihlangano engama-34 mayelana nalokhu ezweni lonkana.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o ile a etella pele mekete ya bo-23 ya naha ya Letsatsi la Tokoloho ka la 27 Mmesa 2017 tlasa mookotaba: “Selemo sa OR Tambo: Mmoho re tebisa demokerasi le ho aha metse e bolokehileng e hlokang botlokotsebe”.Dikopano tsa Mopresidente Manguzi, ho la Umhlabuyalingana di bopa karolo ya letsholo la naha le kgahlanong le botlokotsebe, leo hape e leng tatelliso ya Lenaneo la Kantoro ya Moporesidente la Bodisa la Siyahlola ka Hlakubele 2017.
tgt: Izindaba Ezisematheni UMongameli Jacob Zuma wahola imigubho kazwelonke yama-23 yoSuku Lwenkululeko mhla zingama-27 kuMbasa 2017 ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi “Unyaka ka-OR Tambo: Sisonke siqinisa intando yeningi labantu futhi sakha imiphakathi ephephile nengenabo ubugebengu”.Umhlangano phakathi kukaMongameli nomphakathi waseManguzi, KwaMhlabuyalingana, uyingxenye yomkhankaso kazwelonke wokulwisana nobugebengu, futhi lona bekungumhlangano wokulandelela ohlelweni lukaMongameli, i-Presidential Siyahlola Monitoring Programme, olwaqhutshwa ngoNdasa 2017.

src: Le hlakisa tlhokeho ya mohato o potlakileng wa ho tobana le botlokotsebe ba madibohong haholoholo ba ho nkuwa ha makoloi ka mahahapa.
tgt: Lolu hlelo lugcizelela isidingo sokuthathwa kwezinyathelo ezisheshayo ukunqanda ubugebengu obenzeka phakathi kwaleli namazwe angaphandle ikakhulukazi ukudunwa kwezimoto.

src: Mmuso o sebetsa ka matla sebakeng seo ho fedisa botlokotsebe le ho sebetsana le dintlha tsa badudi ba Umhlabuyalingana, ho kenyeletswa le diphephetso tse mabapi le Phaka ya Mokgwabo ya Isimangaliso.
tgt: Uhulumeni usebenza ngokuzikhandla okukhulu kule ndawo ukuqeda ubugebengu kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga ezibhekene nomphakathi wakwaMhlabuyalingana, kubandakanya nezinselelo eziphathelele ne-Isimangaliso Wetland Park.

src: Mekete e shebana le diphihlello tsa naha ho tloha ka selemo sa 1994 ha ho ntse ho hopolwa mosebetsi o lokelang ho etswa mabapi le ho aha Aforika Borwa e kopaneng e le ka nnete, e hlokang leeme, e sa kgetholleng ka bong, ya demokerasi le e tswelang pele.
tgt: Le migubho iqhakambisa izinto ezizuzwe yileli lizwe kusukela ngowe-1994, futhi kusenjalo kukhunjulwe nokuthi kusenomsebenzi okumele wenziwe ukwakha iNingizimu Afrika ebumbene ngokweqiniso, engenakho ukucwaswa kwabantu ngokobuhlanga nangokobulili, ebuswa ngokwentando yeningi labantu futhi echumayo.

src: Ka kgwedi ya tokoloho re keteka nyehelo ho tokoloho ya rona le demokerasi, ya Moporesidente wa mehleng wa ANC le mohale wa naha, Oliver Reginald Tambo, eo a ka beng a na le dilemo tse 100 selemong sena haeba a ne a ntse a phela.
tgt: NgeNyanga Yenkululeko sibungaza iqhawe lezwe lethu uMongameli we-ANC waphambilini, u-Oliver Reginald Tambo, ngegalelo lakhe emzabalazweni wenkululeko yethu nentando yeningi labantu, obezobe ehlanganisa iminyaka eyi-100 ukube ubesaphila.

src: Jwaloka karolo ya lenaneo la Kgwedi ya Tokoloho Letona la Dikgokahanyo, Ayanda Dlodlo, le thakgotse dipuisano tsa batjha jwaloka karolo ya dipuisano tse ntseng di tswella le batjha mabapi le seo ba se utlwisisang ka “OWN YOUR FREEDOM”, e leng theke e sebediswang ho latella dipuisano ho marangrang a kahisano.
tgt: Njengengxenye yohlelo lweNyanga Yenkululeko uNgqongqoshe Wezokuxhumana, u-Ayanda Dlodlo, uqalise inkulumo-mpendulwano yentsha eyingxenye yezingxoxo eziqhubekayo ezibandakanya abantu abasha mayelana nokuthi kusho ukuthini kubona “UKWENZA INKULULEKO YAKHO IBE NGEYAKHO NGOKWEQINISO”, okuyisiqubulo samaganyana asetshenziswayo ukulandela ingxoxo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho batjha bohle ho sebedisa ditokelo le maikarabelo a bona ka nepo le ho hlompha ba lwanetseng tokoloho ya rona, hore e thabelwe ke bohle ka hara naha ya rona ya demokerasi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa abantu abasha ukuba bawasebenzise ngobuhlakani amalungelo abo kanye nezibopho zabo futhi bahloniphe nalabo abalwela inkululeko yethu, ethokozelwa yibo bonke abantu ezweni lethu elibuswa ngokwentando yeningi labantu.

src: Kabinete e ananela kopano ya pele ya boemo bo hodimo ya Aforika Borwa-China ya Mokgwa wa Phapanyetsano wa Batho-ho-Batho (PPEM) e neng e tshwerwe ho tloha ka la 24 ho isa ho la 27 Mmesa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawamukela umhlangano wokuqala woHlelo olusemazingeni aphezulu Lokushintshisana Ngabantu (i-PPEM) phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ne-China owabanjwa kusukela mhla zingama-24 kuya kumhla zingama-27 kuMbasa.

src: Sena e ne e le phethahalo ya tumellano ho tswa Leetong la Puso la selemo sa 2015 Aforika Borwa pakeng tsa Moporesidente Jacob Zuma le Moporesidente Xi Jinping.
tgt: Lokhu bekufezekisa isivumelwano esenziwa nguMongameli Jacob Zuma kanye noMongameli Xi Jinping ngenkathi uMongameli wase-China evakashele kuleli ngowezi-2015.

src: IMC ya Mokgwa wa Phapanyetsano wa Batho-ho-Batho, e eteletsweng pele ke Letona Nathi Mthethwa e ile ya amohela Motlatsi wa Tonakgolo Lui Yandong le baemedi ho tswa ho la Riphabliki ya Batho ba China.
tgt: I-IMC yoHlelo Lokushintshisana Ngabantu, eyabe iholwa nguNgqongqoshe uNathi Mthethwa, yasingatha iPhini LikaMongameli u-Lui Yandong kanye nezithunywa ezivela kwelase-China.

src: Ho saennwe letoto la ditumellano tsa tshebedisano-mmoho tse welang hara meokotaba e mmedi e phatlaletseng –Ntshetsopele ya Matla a Basebeletsi, le Diphuputso le Ntshetsopele.
tgt: Kwacikicwa izivumelwano zokubambisana eziningana ngaphansi kwezingqikithi ezibanzi ezimbili – Ukuthuthukiswa Kwabasebenzi kanye Nocwaningo Nentuthuko.

src: Kgolo ya moruo o kenyeletsang o bonahalang ka phethoho e matla ya moruo wa kahisano e tsamaelana le kaho ya bokgoni ba batho ba rona, haholoholo batjha ba rona maemong a fapafapaneng.
tgt: Ukukhuliswa komnotho obandakanya abantu bonke futhi osekelwe phezu koguquko lwenhlalo-mnotho olunohlonze kuyinto ehambisana ncamashi nokuhlonyiswa nokucijwa ngamakhono kwabantu bakuleli, ikakhulukazi intsha emazingeni ahlukahlukene.

src: Kabinete e ananela nyehelo ya thepa ya bongaka (e entsweng Aforika Borwa) ho tswa mmusong wa China, jwaloka karolo ya tumellano ya tshebedisano-mmoho ho tsa kalafo pakeng tsa Aforika le China, sena se tla nyehela ntlafatsong ya boleng ba phano ya ditshebeletso dipetleleng tsa mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwamukela ngezandla ezimhlophe umnikelo wemishini yokwelapha (eyakhiwe lapha eNingizimu Afrika) ovela kuhulumeni wase-China, njengengxenye yesivumelwano sobambiswano kwezempilo esiphakathi kwezwekazi lase-Afrika ne-China, futhi lokhu kuzolekelela ekwenzeni ngcono izinga losizo lokwelashwa oluhlinzekwa yizibhedlela zikahulumeni.

src: Ka ditumellano tsa tshebedisano-mmoho dinaha ka bobedi di itlamme ho fohla tshebedisano mmoho e tshwarahaneng ya setekginiki, thupello ya matitjhere le phapanyetsano ya ditsebi lekaleng la thuto, haholoholo tabeng ya Dipalo, Saense le Thekenoloji jwaloka thepa e ahang kgolo ya meruo ya tsebo.
tgt: Ngalezi zivumelwano zobambiswano, womabili lawa mazwe azibophezele ekuqinisekiseni ubambiswano oluqinile kwezokucobelelana ngolwazi lomsebenzi, ukuqeqeshwa kothisha kanye nokwabelana ngolwazi lobungoti emkhakheni wezemfundo, ikakhulu kwezeZibalo, eZesayensi kanye Nezobuchwepheshe njengesisekelo okuzokwakhelwa phezu kwaso ukukhulisa iminotho yolwazi.

src: Dibaka tse ding tsa tshebedisano-mmoho e matlafetseng di kenyeletsa: botjhaba dikgokahanyo kalafo saense le thekenoloji dipapadi bohahlaudi merero ya basadi le batjha.
tgt: Eminye imikhakha okuzophuculwa kuyona ubambiswano ibandakanya: ezamasiko ezokuxhumana ezempilo ezesayensi nezobuchwepheshe ezemidlalo ezokuvakasha kanye nomkhakha wezindaba zabesifazane netsha.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona ho malapa le metswalle ya batho ba 235 ba lahlehetsweng ke maphelo a bona ka lebaka la dikotsi tsa mebila nakong ya matsatsi a phomolo ya Paseka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulisa amazwi enduduzo emindenini nabangani babantu abangama-235 abashone ezingozini zomgwaqo ngamaholide ePhasika.

src: Dipalopalo bakeng sa nako eo di bontsha hore 50% ya batho ba hlokahetseng e ne e le ditaaso, tse latetsweng ke bapalami ba etsang 24% le bakganni ba etsang 19%.
tgt: Izibalo zalesi sikhathi samaholide ePhasika zibonisa ukuthi abantu abashonile abangama-50% bekungabantu abahamba ngezinyawo, kulandele abagibeli ngama-24% kanye nabashayeli ngama-19%.

src: Kabinete hape e ipapisa le Moporesidente Jacob Zuma mabapi le ho hlahisa tsharelo e tebileng le letshoho ka ho hlokahala ha baithuti ba 18, le batho ba baholo ba babedi nakong ya kotsi e mpe ya tekesi ya minibese Bronkhorstspruit, kantlenyana ho Pretoria.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlanganyela noMongameli Zuma ekuzwakaliseni ukudabuka kwayo kanye nokwethuka okukhulu ngokudlula emhlabeni kwezingane zesikole eziyi-18 nabantu abadala ababili engozini yetekisi enyantisayo eyenzeke e-Bronkhorstspruit, ngaphandle kwasePitoli.

src: Re boeletsa kgoeletso ya Moporesidente Zuma ya hore makala a qobello ya molao a batlisise kapele sesosa sa kotsi eo.
tgt: Sithanda ukugcizelela kwikhwelo likaMongameli Zuma lokuthi kumele izikhungo zokuqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa komthetho ziphenye imbangela yale ngozi ngokushesha okukhulu.

src: Kabinete e leboha mafapha kaofela a mmuso, Mekgatlo eo e seng ya Mmuso (di-NGO), ditsebi le borakgwebo bakeng sa ho tshehetsa malapa a amehang hammoho le baithuti le basebeletsi ba Sekolo se Phahameng sa Mahlenga le ba Sekolo sa Poraemari sa Refano nakong ena e boima.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulisa amazwi okubonga kuyo yonke iminyango kahulumeni, izinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni (ama-NGO), ochwepheshe kanye nabamabhizinisi abahlinzeke ngosizo emindenini ethintekile kanye nakubafundi nothisha besikole iMahlenga High kanye nabesikole sase-Refano Primary ngalesi sikhathi esinzima.

src: Dikotsi tsa mebila, ka ho qolleha nakong ya matsatsi a phomolo ka hara Aforika Borwa, e dula e le taba e hlokolosi ya naha.
tgt: Ukushona kwabantu abaningi ezingozini zomgwaqo, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi samaholide eNingizimu Afrika, kuyinto ekhathazayo kakhulu kuleli.

src: Mabakeng a mangata mafu ana a ka be a thibetswe ka boitshwaro bo nang le boikarabelo le tshebediso ya mebila ya naha.
tgt: Izingozi eziningi kulezi, yizingozi ebezingagwemeka ngokuthi abasebenzisi bomgwaqo baziphathe kahle ngenkathi besemgwaqeni futhi bacophelele kakhulu.

src: Ho kganna ka bohlaswa le ho se tsotelle ha di amohelehe mme maAforika Borwa kaofela a kgothaletswa ho nka boikarabelo bakeng sa polokeho ya bona mebileng ya bo rona.
tgt: Kuyisenzo esingamukelekile neze ukushayela budedengu, ngaphandle kwenkathalo futhi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayanxuswa ukuba bakwenze kube yinto engumsebenzi wabo osemqoka kakhulu ukuphepha kwabo emigwaqeni yethu.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa lekala la dipalangwang tsa dibese bakeng sa ho kgutlela mosebetsing kamora seteraeke se neng se se na dikgoka, ho bontsha tsela e ntle ya boipelaetso ba diindaseteri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwushayela ihlombe umkhakha wezokuthutha abantu ngamabhasi ngokubuyela emsebenzini emva kwesiteleka ebesingenalo udlame, okuyinto eyisibonelo esihle ekubanjweni kweziteleka zabasebenzi.

src: Karolo e bapetsweng ke Letona la Mesebetsi e tshwanela ho ananelwa bakeng sa ho thusa hore seteraeke se fele bakeng sa lekala lena la bohlokwa la moruo wa bo rona.
tgt: Iphawulekile indima edlalwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezabasebenzi ekuqedeni isiteleka kulo mkhakha obaluleke kangaka emnothweni wethu.

src: Kabinete e kgathatsehile ka keketseho ya moraorao ya dikgoka Vuwani ho latela qeto ya Boto ya Tsheho ya Meedi ya ho e kenyeletsa masepaleng o motjha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhathazekile ngokuqubuka kabusha kodlame endaweni yase-Vuwani kulandela esinqumweni seBhodi Lokuklanywa Kwemingcele Yomasipala sokufaka le ndawo ngaphansi kukamasipala omusha.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe ka matla tshebediso ya bana ba rona jwaloka sesebediswa sa ditherisano, dibeke tsa ho se kene ha dikolo ho rothofatsa bokamoso ba bana bana ba ntseng ba phaellwa ka kgatello ya maikutlo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugxeka kakhulu ukusetshenziswa kwezingane zethu njengethuluzi lokufezekisa izimfuno ezithile futhi ukuvalwa kwezikole amaviki ngamaviki kuphazamisa ingomuso lalezi zingane esezizithola zingaphansi kwengcindezi yomphefumulo eyengeziwe.

src: Dikgoka, ditshoso, tshenyo ya thepa, kapa diketso tse lebisang tabeng ya hore dikolo di senngwe kapa bana ba tingwe ho ya sekolong ha di na sebaka ka hara demokerasi ya rona.
tgt: Udlame, ukwesatshiswa, ukucekelwa phansi kwempahla noma izenzo eziholela ekucekelweni phansi kwezikole noma ezincisha abafundi ithuba lokuya esikoleni azinayo nakancane indawo ezweni lethu elibuswa ngokwentando yeningi labantu.

src: Kabinete e ananela mosebetsi o etswang ke IMC, e eteletsweng pele ke Letona la Lefapha la Kopanelo ya Mmuso le Merero ya Setso (Cogta) Monghadi Des Van Rooyen le leeto la Letona la Maphodisa, Fikile Mbalula, le ho thathiselletsa mmono wa hore diketso tsa botlokotsebe ho kenyeletswa tshenyo ya thepa di keke tsa mamellwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwushayela ihlombe umsebenzi owenziwe yi-IMC, ebiholwa nguNgqongqoshe Wokwengamela Ngokubambisana kanye Nezindaba Zendabuko uMnu Des Van Rooyen, kanye nokuvakashela kuleya ndawo kukaNgqongqoshe Wezamapholisa, uFikile Mbalula, futhi iyaweseka umbono wokuthi izenzo zobugebengu, kubandakanya ukulinyazwa nokucekelwa phansi kwempahla kuyinto engeke ibekezelelwe nakancane.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o reretswe ho kopana le Morena wa VhaVenda Toni Mphephu Ramabulana le baetapele ba botjhaba ba tswang seterekeng sa Vhembe ka maiteko a ho tlisa botsitso.
tgt: Kulindeleke ukuba uMongameli Jacob Zuma abambe umhlangano neNgonyama yamaVenda u-Toni Mphephu Ramabulana kanye nabaholi bendabuko abavela esifundeni sase-Vhembe njengomzamo wokuletha uzinzo kuleya ndawo.

src: Kabinete e toboketsa hore tjhelete le mehlodi e sebediswang bakeng sa ho lokisa dikolo tse sentsweng e reretswe mananeo a mang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyagcizelela ukuthi imali kanye nezinsiza ezisetshenziwe ukwakha kabusha izikole ezicekelwe phansi yimali obekuhloswe ukuba isetshenziswe kwezinye izinhlelo zikahulumeni.

src: Kabinete hape e ipileditse bakeng sa kgutso le botsitso ho latela boipelaetso bo tletseng dikgoka toropong ya Lichtenburg le Lekeisheneng la Blydeville, Masepaleng wa Lehae wa Ditsobotla, ho la Leboya Bophirima.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxuse futhi nokuthi abantu behlise imimoya futhi kubuyiswe nozinzo kulandela imibhikisho ehambisana nodlame edolobheni lase-Lichtenburg kanye naselokishini lase-Blydeville, ngaphansi kukaMasipala Wendawo yase-Ditsobotla, esifundazweni saseNyakatho Ntshonalanga.

src: Ho kena ha dikolo ho sitisehile, mabenkele a ile a utswetswa dikoloi le matlo a mmalwa a ile a tjheswa.
tgt: Ukufunda kuphazamisekile, kwaphangwa nempahla ezitolo futhi kwashiswa izimoto nezindlu eziningana.

src: Tonakgolo ya Leboya Bophirima, Supra Mahumapelo, o thontse sehlopha se kenyeletsang Ditho tsa Lekgotla la Phethahatso (di-MEC) le boramotse ba babedi ho batlisisa le ho tobana le diphephetso tsa phano ya ditshebeletso tulong ena.
tgt: UNdunankulu waseNyakatho Ntshonalanga, u-Supra Mahumapelo, useqoke ithimba elihlanganisa oNgqongqoshe Besifundazwe (abo-MEC) abahlanu kanye nezimeya ezimbili elizophenya futhi lixazulule izinselelo eziphathelene ngohlinzekwa kwezidingo-ngqangi kuleya ndawo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho badudi ba Coligny, ho la Leboya Bophirima ho emisa ka boipelaetso bo tletseng dikgoka le ho dumella ba Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS) Coligny ho phetha dipatlisiso tsa bona ka lefu la ngwana ya bolailweng, ho netefatsa hore toka e a phethahale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawunxusa umphakathi wase-Coligny, esifundazweni saseNyakatho Ntshonalanga ukuba uyeke ukubamba imibhikisho ehambisana nodlame futhi unikeze uMbutho Wamaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) endaweni yase-Coligny ithuba lokuphothula uphenyo lwawo mayelana nengane eshonile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ubulungiswa buqhutshwa ngendlela efanelekile.

src: Baahi ba kgothaletswa ho hlahisa matshwenyeho a bona ka dibopeho tse teng ka hara meedi ya molao.
tgt: Izakhamuzi ziyanxuswa ukuba zisebenzise izinhlaka ezikhona njengamanje uma zifuna ukuzwakalisa izinkinga zazo futhi zithobele umthetho ngenkathi zizwakalisa ukukhathazeka kwazo.

src: Mmuso o thoholetsa makala a qobello ya molao bakeng sa karabelo ya ona mabapi le ho tshwara batlodi ba molao ba diketso tsa dikgoka kgahlanong le basadi le bana.
tgt: Uhulumeni uzishayela ihlombe izikhungo zokuqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa komthetho ngendlela ezisukumela ngayo phezulu ukuze kuboshwe izigilamkhuba ezihlukumeza abesifazane nezingane.

src: Tabeng ena, Kabinete e ananela mehato e potlakileng e nkuweng ke Yuniti ya di-Hawks ya Kgwebisano ka Batho le Sehlopha sa Karabelo ya Dikgoka sa SAPS ba tshwereng moruti wa Durban ka qoso ya ho hweba ka batho ho la Port WEBTOKEN mosebetsi le boikarabelo ba maAforika Borwa kaofela ho sebetsa le ba ka sehloohong ho tshireletsa basadi le bana ba rona le ho netefatsa hore re bapala karolo ya rona ya ho etsa hore metse ya rona e bolokehe.
tgt: Mayelana nalokhu-ke, iKhabhinethi izishayela ihlombe izinyathelo ezisheshayo ezithathwe wuPhiko Loklebe Olulwisana Nokushushumbiswa Kwabantu kanye neThimba Elijutshwe Ukubhekana Namacala Abucayi Kakhulu njengoba bebophe umfundisi ozinze eThekwini obekwe icala lokushushumbiswa kwabantu e-Port Elizabeth.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Zolani Tete ka ho hapa sekola sa boima ba bantam ba Mokgatlo wa Ditebele wa Lefatshe (WBO).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela uZolani Tete ngokunqoba kwakhe isicoco sesisindo samabhantamu ngaphansi kweNhlangano Yezesibhakela Emhlabeni (i-WBO).

src: Sena se mo beha maemong a ho kopanya dikola tsa lefatshe – se bolelang hore jwale o kgona ho phephetsa bakeng sa dikola tsa lefatshe mekgatlong e mene e meholo ya lefatshe e leng: WBO Lekgotla la Lefatshe la Ditebele (WBC), Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Ditebele (WBA) le Federeishene ya Matjhaba ya Ditebele (IBF).
tgt: Lokhu kumbeka ethubeni lokulwa empini yokuhlanganisa izicoco zomhlaba – okusho ukuthi manje usengafaka inselelo yokulwela izicoco zomhlaba ngaphansi kwezinhlangano zesibhakela ezithathwa njengezinkulu emhlabeni jikelele: okuwuMkhandlu Wezesibhakela Emhlabeni (i-WBC), iNhlangano Yomhlaba Yezesibhakela (i-WBA) kanye neNhlangano Yezesibhakela Yamazwe Ngamazwe (i-IBF).

src: Kabinete e ipapisa le Moporesidente Jacob Zuma mabapi le ho romela matshediso ho lelapa le metswalle ya mokwetlisi le setsebi se etsang nalane sa ditebele, Nick Durandt, ya neng a tsejwa ka bokgoni ba hae ba ho hlahisa bomampodi ba ditebele le ho tlosa bashemane diterateng mme a ba etse bomampodi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlanganyela noMongameli Jacob Zuma ekudluliseni amazwi enduduzo aqondiswe emndenini nabangani bomqeqeshi wesibhakela obedume kakhulu, uNick Durandt, obaziwa kakhulu ngekhono lakhe lokukhiqiza abashayisibhakela abayizingqwele futhi obethatha abafana abancane abebewuvanzi emgwaqeni abenze izingqwele.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di lokela ho netefatswa ka mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.
tgt: AbaqashiweUkuqashwa kwabo bonke abalandelayo kuzokwamukelwa ngokusemthethweni kuphela uma sekuqinisekiswe ubufakazi beziqu zabo zemfundo futhi uma sebenikeziwe izimvume ezifanelekile.

src: Dithonyo tsa kantoro ya Moporesidente ho Lekgotla la Dinyewe tsa Naha tsa Bareki, le tla qala ho sebetsa ho tloha ka letsatsi la Taelo ya Boporesidente e amehang:Moporofesara Joseph Mandal Maseko (Modulasetulo wa Phethahatso)Mofumahadi Laura Best (Motlatsi wa Modulasetulo)Monghadi Lulama Andisa Potwana (setho sa nako tsohle)Mofumahadi Penelope Anne Beck (setho sa nakwana)Moatefokate Hope Fiona Neo Sephoti (setho sa nakwana)Mofumahadi Diane Reinette Terblanche (setho sa nakwana)Mofumahadi Nomfundo Maseti (setho sa nakwana)Mofumahadi Maleho Margaret Daisy Nkomo (setho sa nakwana)Moporofesara Bonke Clayton Dumisa (setho sa nakwana)Moporofesara Tanya Ann Woker (setho sa nakwana)Moporofesara Kasturi Moodaliyar (setho sa nakwana)Ngaka Maria Claudina du Toit (setho sa nakwana)Monghadi Xolela Christopher May (setho sa nakwana)Monghadi Fungai Khumbulani Sibanda (setho sa nakwana)Monghadi Lehlohonolo Lucky Rabotapi (setho sa nakwana)Monghadi Trevor Albert Bailey (setho sa nakwana) leMoatefokate Frans Kgolela Manamela (setho sa nakwana).Thonyo ya ditho tseo e seng tsa phethahatso ho Boto ya Khoporeishene ya Dibetsa ya Aforika Borwa (ARMSCOR):Motlatsi wa Moadimirale (ya behileng mejafatshe) RJ Mudimu (Modulasetulo ebile o thontswe hape)Mofumahadi Thuthukile Skweyiya (Motlatsi wa Modulasetulo ebile o thontswe hape)Ngaka Moses Khanyile (o thontswe hape)Monghadi Ndumiso M Tyibilika (o thontswe hape)Monghadi Raymond Mlungwana Vokwana (o thontswe hape)Moatefokate Virginia Lee Anne De La Hunt (o thontswe hape)Mofumahadi CE SimpsonMofumahadi T Mhlan leMoambasadara TJ Ndhlovu.
tgt: Abaqokwe nguMongameli njengamalungu eNkantolo Yezabathengi Kazwelonke, futhi abazongena ezikhundleni zabo ngosuku olushiwo kwiMemorandamu KaMongameli efanelekile:Slz Joseph Mandal Maseko (uSihlalo Omkhulu)Nkz Laura Best (iPhini LikaSihlalo)Mnu Lulama Andisa Potwana (ilungu elizosebenza ngokugcwele)Nkz Penelope Anne Beck (ilungu lesikhashana)Adv Hope Fiona Neo Sephoti (ilungu lesikhashana)Nkz Diane Reinette Terblanche (ilungu lesikhashana)Nkz Nomfundo Maseti (ilungu lesikhashana)Nkz Maleho Margaret Daisy Nkomo (ilungu lesikhashana)Slz Bonke Clayton Dumisa (ilungu lesikhashana)Slz Tanya Ann Woker (ilungu lesikhashana)Slz Kasturi Moodaliyar ilungu lesikhashana)Dkt Maria Claudina du Toit (ilungu lesikhashana)Mnu Xolela Christopher May (ilungu lesikhashana)Mnu Fungai Khumbulani Sibanda (ilungu lesikhashana)Mnu Lehlohonolo Lucky Rabotapi (ilungu lesikhashana)Mnu Trevor Albert Bailey (ilungu lesikhashana) kanye noAdv Frans Kgolela Manamela (ilungu lesikhashana).

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, la 10 Motsheanong 2017, Tuynhuys, Motse Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yabamba umhlangano wayo ngoLwesithathu mhla ziyi-10 kuNhlaba 2017, e-Tuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Foramo ya Moruo wa Lefatshe (WEF) ya AforikaKabinete e amohela ho tshwarwa ka katleho ha WEF ya Aforika ya bo-27 mooMoporesidente Jacob Zuma a neng a eteletse pele Moifo wa Aforika Borwa, Dihlooho tsa Dipuso le Mebuso ho tswa kontinenteng ya Aforika, baetapele ba lefatshe ba diindaseteri le dikgwebo le ketapele ya setjhaba ka kakaretso.
tgt: Isithangamu Sezomnotho Emhlabeni (i-WEF) esiqondene ne-Afrika.

src: Pitso e ne e tshwerwe tlasa mookotaba:“Re fihlella kgolo e kenyeletsang: boetapele bo arabelang le ho ikarabella”.Ho dula habo-27 ha WEF ya Aforika ho tiiseditse lefatshe botjha hore Aforika Borwa e dula e le karolo ya sebaka se nang le bokgoni ba matsete ka hara kontinente ya Aforika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikushayela ihlombe ukusingathwa ngempumelelo kweSithangamu Sezomnotho Emhlabeni sama-27 esiqondene ne-Afrika lapho uMongameli ebehola khona iThimba LaseNingizimu Afrika, iziNhloko Zemibuso kanye Nohulumeni abavela kwiZwekazi lase-Afrika, izinhloko zezimboni emhlabeni nabaholi bezomnotho kanye nezinhlangano zomphakathi wonkana.

src: Bahlophisi ba tiisitse hore baemedi ba fetang 1000 ba ne ba kenetse ketsahalo eo, e leng palo e neng e sa lebellwa ha ho bapiswa leWEF ya Aforika e fetileng.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela yabanjwa ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Ukufezekisa Ukukhula Komnotho Okubandakanya Abantu Bonke: Abaholi Abasabelayo futhi Abaphusile”.

src: Moya o matla wa bolekane pakeng tsa mmuso le boradikgwebo nakong ya WEF ya Aforika o ne o le kgabane haholo.
tgt: Lesi sigcawu sama-27 se-WEF eqondene ne-Afrika sibonise ngokucacile phambi kwamehlo omhlaba ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika isalokhu iyizwe elikwizwekazi lase-Afrika elikulungele ukutshalwa kwezimali.

src: Puisano e matla e nehile Aforika Borwa monyetla wa ho bontsha kgatelopele eo o e etsang e lebisang kgolong ya moruo e kenyeletsang le ho bontsha hore Aforika Borwa e bulehile bakeng sa kgwebo.
tgt: Umoya wobumbano oqinile phakathi kukahulumeni kanye nabamabhizinisi obonakale ngenkathi kubanjwe i-WEF bewumuhle kakhulu.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla dula e itlametse ho dula motjheng wa ho kenya tshebetsong Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP) ho fokotsa maemo a bofuma, ho se lekalekane le tlhokeho ya mesebetsi.
tgt: Izingxoxo ezinohlonze zihlinzeke izwe laseNingizimu Afrika ngethuba lokubonisa inqubekelaphambili eliyenzayo emshikashikeni wokufezekisa ukukhula komnotho okubandakanya abantu bonke kanye nokukhombisa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ikulungele noma nini ukwenza ibhizinisi.

src: Dipalangwang Hothakgolwa ha diterene tse ntjha le tshebeletso ya Lekala la Bapalami ba Diterene la Aforika Borwa(PRASA), ke Moporesidente Jacob Zuma ka la 9 Motsheanong 2017 Seteisheneng sa Pretoria ke karolo ya boitlamo ba mmuso bo tswelang pele ba ho netefatsa dipalangwang tsa setjhaba tse kgonehang le ho tshepahala, le ho matlafatsa meralo ya motheo ya moruo wa naha.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika isalokhu izibophezele ekuqhubekeni emgudwini wayo ophokophele ekuqalisweni nokusetshenziswa koHlelo lwayo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP) ukuze kuncishiswe ububha, ukungalingani kanye nokuntuleka kwamathuba omsebenzi.

src: Diterene tse ntjha tsa Metrorail (tse palangwang ke Batho) ke karolo ya diterene tse ntjha tse tla fanwa ke mmuso nakong ya dilemo tse10 ho isa ho tse15 tse tlang e le karolo ya Lenaneo la Sejwalejwale la PRASBoikitlaetso bona bo tla bopa dikete tsa mesebetsi ya moshwelella le menyetla ya mosebetsi, ka polante e motjheng e tla hlahisa diterene tse ntjha e Nigel, WEBTOKEN qalo ya ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Tumellano ya Fora le Brazil e saennweng pakeng tsa PRASA le Alstom.
tgt: Ukwethulwa kwezitimela ezintsha kanye nezinsizakalo zezitimela zoPhiko Lwezitimela Ezithwala Abagibeli LwaseNingizimu Afrika (i-PRASA), nguMongameli Jacob Zuma mhla ziyisi-9 kuNhlaba 2017 eSiteshini Sezitimela sasePitoli kuyingxenye yokuzibophezela kukahulumeni okuqhubekayo okuhloswe ngakho ukuqinisekisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinto zokuthutha umphakathi ezingambi eqolo futhi ezithembakele, kanye nokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda yezwe yezomnotho.

src: Diterene tse ntjha tsa maemo tsa Metrorail (tse palangwang ke Batho) di fana ka maemo a se nang thaka a boiketlo le tshebeletso, mme di tla fetola boiphihlelo ba maeto a terene a bapalami.
tgt: Izitimela ezintsha ze-Metrorail (ezaziwa futhi ngokuthi yiZitimela Zabantu) ziyingxenye yohlobo lwezitimela uhulumeni azizofaka emzileni kule minyaka eyi-10 kuya kweyi-15 ezayo njengengxenye yoHlelo lwe-PRASA Lokuhlinzeka Ngezitimela Zesimanjemanje.

src: Ke karolo ya mmuso ya ntshetsopele ya moruo ka ntshetsopele e matla ya meralo ya motheo mme diterene tsena di lokile bakeng sa batho ba qhwadileng.
tgt: Lo mklamo uzodala izinkulungwane ngezinkulungwane zamathuba omsebenzi asimeme kanye namathuba etoho, njengoba uqhubeka umsebenzi wokwakha isikhungo okuzokhiqizwa kusona izitimela e-Nigel, Ekurhuleni.

src: Kabinete e ipileditse ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho ba motlotlo le ho tshireletsa diterene tse ntjha kgahlanong le diketso tsa bosenyi.
tgt: Lesi yisiqalo sokuqaliswa kokusebenza kweSivumelwano esenziwe yileli ne-France ne-Brazil esisayindwe yi-PRASA nabakwa-Alstom.

src: Boipelaetso ba VuwaniKabinete e amohela boitshunyako bo atlehileng ba Moporesident Zuma, Vuwani, ho la Limpopo.
tgt: Izitimela ze-Metrorail zikanokusho ezintsha (iZitimela Zabantu) zihlinzeka abagibeli ngamazinga aphezulu kakhulu ezinsizakalo zesitimela kanye nokunethezeka, futhi zizoyiguqula indlela abagibeli abaphatheka ngayo uma behamba ngesitimela.

src: Moporesidente okopane le Motlotlehi Morena Toni Mphephu Ramabulana wa Vha-Venda, le bankakarolo ba bang ba badudi mabapi le ho fihlella ditharollo tsa kutlwano tsa dintlha tse hlahisitsweng.
tgt: Lezi zitimela ziyingxenye yomsebenzi owenziwa nguhulumeni ukuthuthukisa umnotho ngokuqalisa imiklamo emikhulukazi yokuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda futhi zikulungele nokusetshenziswa ngabantu abanokukhubazeka.

src: Kopano e amohetse tshisinyo ya Motlotlehi ya hore Masepala wa Setereke wa Vhembe o tshwanetse ho fana ka ditshebeletso ho batho ba Vuwani ha ho ntse ho batlanwa le tharollo ya moshwelella ya ntlha ya tsheho ya meedi.
tgt: IKhabinethi inxuse bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba baziqhenye ngalezi zitimela ezintsha futhi bazivikele ekucekelweni phansi.

src: Tharollo e sisintsweng e tsamaelana le molao o sebetsang wa hajwale o tsamaisang bomasepala.
tgt: UMongameli ubambe umhlangano neNgonyama yesizwe samaVenda u-Toni Mphephu Ramabulana, kanye nababambiqhaza bomphakathi ngenhloso yokuthola izisombululo zokuxazulula, ngomoya omuhle nangoxolo, izinkinga ezivezwe ngumphakathi.

src: Hape ho ile ha qetwa ka hore mafapha a amehang a naha le a porofense a tshwanela ho tshehetsa masepala wa setereke hore o phethahatse thomo ya ona e ntjha.
tgt: Umhlangano wasamukela isiphakamiso seNgonyama sokuba uMasipala Wesifunda saseVhembe kube yiwona ohlinzeka ngezinsizakalo kubantu baseVuwani ngenkathi kusathungathwa ikhambi lesikhathi eside lokusombulula impicabadala yodaba lokuklanywa kwemingcele yomasipala.

src: Kopano leha ho le jwalo, e tobokeditse hore qeto eo ha e bolele hore masepala e motjha (LIM 345) o a fediswa.
tgt: Lesi sombululo esiphakanyisiwe siyahambisana nemithetho efanelekile elawula omasipala.

src: Qeto ena ke karolo ya boitlamo ba mmuso ba ho fumana tharollo e kenyeletsang.
tgt: Kuphinde futhi kwathathwa nesinqumo sokuthi kumele iminyango kazwelonke neyezifundazwe efanelekile ilekelele umasipala wesifunda ukuze ukwazi ukwenza lo msebenzi omusha othweswe wona.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa bankakarolo bakeng sa ho qobella ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha ditumellano tse hokahantsweng ke Morena.
tgt: Lesi sinqumo siyingxenye yokuzibophezela kukahulumeni ekutholeni isixazululo esibandakanya abantu bonke.

src: Moporesidente o itlamme ho kgutlela ho badudi ba Vuwani bakeng sa ho ikopanya le bona ka letsatsi le sa ntsaneng le tla behwa ke Motlotlehi Morena Toni Mphephu Ramabulana le bankakarolo bohle ka hara sebaka seo.
tgt: Ukufakana imilomo nokubonisana phakathi kukaMongameli nabo bonke ababambiqhaza sekuholele ekutheni kubuyele esimweni esijwayelekile ukusebenza kwezikole namabhizinisi.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho batswadi le badudi ho tshehetsa maitshunyako a mafapha ho netefatsa hore bana ba kgutlela dikolong le ho tsepamisa maikutlo le ho kgahlametsa nako e senyehileng ka maitshunyako a sebediswang dikolong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabancoma impela ababambiqhaza ngokuqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa kwezivumelwano ezenziwe ngaphansi kwezingxoxo ebeziholwa yiNgonyama.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsabadudi ho nyahlatsa merusu, ditshoso le ho utswa thepa ha ba hlahisa dingongoreho tsa bona.
tgt: UMongameli uzibophezele ekutheni uzophindela emphakathini waseVuwani lapho ezohlangana nomphakathi ngosuku olusazonqunywa emva kokubonisana nokuvumelana neNgonyama u-Toni Mphephu Ramabulana kanye nabo bonke ababambiqhaza abafanelekile bakuleya ndawo.

src: Merusu le diketso tsa ho utswa thepa le tshenyo ya thepa ya dikgwebotse etsahetseng haufinyana tjena Coligny,Eldorado Park le Ennerdale di tshwelwa ka mathe ka matla ke Kabinete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabanxusa abazali kanye nomphakathi ukuba basekele izinhlelo zokungenelela zomnyango ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi babuyela emagunjini okufundela futhi bakhathule nomsebenzi osalele emuva ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokungenelela ezihlinzekwayo njengamanje kuzo zonke izikole.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho badudi ho hlahisa matshwenyeho a bona ka mokgwa o batlang ditharollo ntle le ho senya thepa ya setjhaba kapa ho hatikela ditokelo tsa ditho tse ding tsa setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa imiphakathi ukuba iyeke ukuzibandakanya ezenzweni ezinodlame, nokwesabisa kanye nokuphangwa kwempahla ezitolo namabhizinisi ngenkathi izwakalisa ukukhathazeka kwayo.

src: Moporesidente o entse kgoeletso ka selemo sa 2015 Nakong ya Puo ya Maemo a Naha, a ipiletsa ho Moifo wa Toka, Thibelo ya Botlokotsebe le Tshireletso (JCPS) ho sebetsana ka matla le boipelaetso bo tletseng merusu le tshenyo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilugxeka kakhulu udlame kanye nezenzo zokuphangwa nokucekelwa phansi kwamabhizinisi okwenzeke esikhathini esifushane esedlule e-Coligny, Eldorado Park kanye nase-Ennerdale.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa kgoeletso ena ya hore ba tlolang molao ba tla tobana le letsoho le matla la molao.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa imiphakathi ukuba izwakalise ukukhathazeka kwayo ngendlela ehlose ukuthola izisombululo, ngaphandle ngokucekela phansi impahla nezakhiwo zomphakathi noma ukuphazamisa nokucindezela amalungelo amanye amalungu omphakathi.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa bankakarolo bohle ho buisana ka morero wa ho rarolla ka potlako dikgang Ennerdale, Eldorado Park le Coligny.
tgt: UMongameli wahlaba ikhwelo eNkulumweni Echaza Isimo Sezwe (i-SoNA) yowezi-2015, enxusa iQoqwana Lezobulungiswa Nokuvinjelwa Kobugebengu kanye Nokuvikeleka (i-JCPS) ukuba lithathe izinyathelo ezinqala zokubhekana nodlame kanye nemibhikisho edala umonakalo omkhulu.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Setsi sa Mautlwela a Ditjhelete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyagcizelela kuleli khwelo lokuthi labo abaphula umthetho kumele babhekane namandla aphelele engalo yomthetho.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho sennwa ha Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Setsi sa Mautlwela a Ditjhelete (FICA) hore e be molao keMoporesidenteZuma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabanxusa bonke ababambiqhaza ukuba baxoxisane futhi babonisane ngenhloso yokusombulula imibango yase-Ennerdale, Eldorado Park nase-Coligny ngokushesha.

src: Aforika Bowa jwaloka karolo ya badudi ba lefatshe e imatahantseng le ho lwantsha diketso tse seng molaong tsa ditjhelete, e tla imatahanya le boitshunyako ba matjhaba bo batlang ho lwantsha ho pata mohlodi wa tjhelete le ho thusa boferakanyi ka ditjhelete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukucikicwa kweSichibiyelo SoMthethosivivinywa Wesikhungo Sobunhloli Bezimali nguMongameli Zuma ukuze sibe ngumthetho.

src: Bili ena hape e tla nyehela mabapi le ho matlafatsa ponaletso le seriti tsa tsamaiso ya ditjhelete ya Aforika Borwa le ho etsa hore ho be thata bakeng sa ditlokotsebe ho baleha ho lefa lekgetho, ho pata mohlodi wa tjhelete le ho pata phallo e seng molaong ya ditjhelete ba sebedisa mekgwa ya tsamaiso ya ditjhelete ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika, njengoba iyingxenye yamazwe womhlaba alwisana nezenzo ezingekho emthethweni eziphathelene nezezimali, nayo izohambisana nezinhlelo zokungenelela zamazwe ngamazwe okuhloswe ngazo ukulwisana nokushushumbiswa nokushintshisana ngezimali ngendlela efihlakele futhi engekho emthethweni kanye nokuxhaswa kwezenzo zobushokobezi ngezimali.

src: E bopa se seng sa disebediswa tse ngata tseo re nang le tsona jwaloka naha bakeng sa ho lwantsha botlokotsebe ba maemo a hodimo makaleng ka bobedi a poraefete le a mmuso.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uyalekelela futhi nasekuqiniseni ukusebenza ngokusobala kanye nobuqotho bohlelo lwezimali lwaseNingizimu Afrika futhi uzokwenza kube nzima kakhulu ezigebengwini ezibandakanyeka ezenzweni zokugwema ukukhokha intela kanye nokushushumbiswa nokushintshisana ngezimali ngendlela efihlakele futhi engekho emthethweni ukuba zizifihle ngokusebenzisa uhlelo lwezimali lwaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ke Letona la Ditjhelete hore ditherisano di ntse di tswela pele mme di tla phethelwa haufinyana ho netefatsamotjha wa phatlalatso ya melawana e tla kenya tshebetsong Molao wa FICDiqeto tsa KabineteLetona la Ditjhelete le tsebisitse Kabinete ka dikopano tsa haufinyana tjena tsa Selemo tsa Letlole laLefatshe la Ditjhelete (IMF)/ tsa Banka ya Lefatshe, dikopano tsa Leeto la Dipontsho le Batsetedi le tsa WEF ya Aforika.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa ungenye yamathuluzi ahlukahlukene esinawo kuleli okulwisana nobugebengu obuphathelene nezimali obenziwa yizikhulu zikahulumeni kanye nabantu abasezikhundleni eziphakeme abasebenza emkhakheni ozimele.

src: Hape le tsebisitse ka ditshisinyo tsa Aforika ho G20 Compact le matshwenyeho a batsetedi le makala a Balekodi ba mekitlane.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezezimali ukuthi izingxoxo zokubonisana nokufakana imilomo ziyaqhubeka futhi zizophothulwa khona maduze nje ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuqaliswa kwenqubo yokushaywa kwemithethonqubo ezoqalisa ukusebenza koMthetho we-FICIzinqumo Zekhabhinethi.

src: Ho bile le dipuisano tse matla mabapi le tjhebahalo ya moruo wa lefatshe le wa lebatowa le seo re lokelang ho se etsa ho etsolla ho theolwa ha maemo a moruo.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezezimali wethulele iKhabhinethi umbiko mayelana nemihlangano abeyihambele esikhathini esifushane esedlule, ebandakanya imihlangano yaSentwasahlobo Yenhlangano Yamazwe Ngamazwe Yezezimali (i-IMF) NeBhange Lomhlaba, neZigcawu Zokuheha Abatshalimali kanye neNgqungquthela ye-WEF eqondene ne-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e boeleditse hore e dula e itlamme bakeng sa boemo ba leano la ditjhelete tsa mmuso le tekilweng Puong ya Ditekanyetso ya selemo sa 2017, ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha diphethoho bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa taolo ya dikhamphani tsa mmuso ho baballa sekepele se amohelehang sa ditshenyehelo le ho netefatsa botsitso ba mekitlane ya mmuso.
tgt: Ngaphezu kwalokhu uhlinzeke iKhabhinethi ngolwazi mayelana neziphakamiso zeSivumelwano esiphakathi kwe-G20 ne-Afrika kanye nezinto ezikhathaza abatshalimali neziNhlangano Ezenza Izilinganiso Zeminotho Yamazwe Omhlaba.

src: Lenaneo la Mmuso la ho akofisa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha diphethoho tsa dibopeho tse reretsweng ho matlafatsa kgolo ya moruo jwaloka ha di tekilwe ho Moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong le dula le nepahetse bakeng sa ho tobana le dintlha tse ding tse hlahisitsweng ke batsetedi.
tgt: Kubanjwe ingxoxo ebanzi mayelana nesimo somnotho emhlabeni kanye nesomnotho wesifunda futhi kwaxoxiswana ngokuthi yini okumele siyenze ukuze siguqule lesi simo esingaphansi kwaso njengamanje sokwehliswa kwesilinganiso somnotho wezwe, njengoba usufakwe ngaphansi kwezinga leminotho efadalalayo.

src: Kabinete e amohela tlaleho e lokolotsweng haufinyana ke feme ya boeletsi ya EY Consultancy mabapi le Matsete a Otlolohileng ka hara Aforika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igcizelelile ukuthi isalokhu izibophezele ekulandeleni umgudu wenqubomgomo yezezimali obalulwe kwiNkulumo Yesabelomali sowezi-2017, nokuqaliswa kwezinguquko zokwenza ngcono indlela okuphethwe ngayo izinkampani zombuso nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezimali akubi ngaphezu komkhawulo obekiwe wokusetshenziswa kwemali kanye nokuqinisekisa uzinzo ezikweletini zikahulumeni ukuze zingabi ngaphezu kwamandla.

src: Tlaleho e supa Aforika Borwa jwaloka setsi se seholo ka ho fetisisa sa moruo le ho behwa maemong a bobedi ho Lenane la Kgohedi la Aforika la selemo sa 2017.Kabinete hape e tsebisitswe ka leeto le tlang la Makala a Bolekodi ba mekitlane ho buisana le mekgatlo e mengata le bahlomphehi ba phethahatso ba mmuso.
tgt: Uhlelo lukahulumeni lokusheshisa ukuqaliswa kwezinguquko okuhloswe ngazo ukukhuthaza ukukhula komnotho, njengoba lokhu kuqukethwe oHlelweni Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye, lusalokhu lusemqoka kakhulu ekusombululeni ezinye zezinto ezikhathaza abatshalimali.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Moralo wa Lewa le Shebilweng Botjha la Dipalangwang tsa Metse ya Mahae.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawemukela umbiko okhishwe yifemu i-EY Consultancy ophathelene noTshalomali Olungena Ngqo e-Afrika luvela Emazweni Angaphandle.

src: Lewa lena le arabela ho dintlha tse ka sehlohlolong tsa bomasepala ba setereke le diporofense, ka ho tobana le phano e sa lokang ya Meralo ya Motheo ya Dipalangwang tsa Metse ya Mahae le ditshebeletso e fokotsang ntshetsopele ya moruo wa kahisano.
tgt: Lo mbiko ubala iNingizimu Afrika njengelinye lamazwe ayizizinda zomnotho ezinkulukazi futhi ikleliswe endaweni yesibili kwiNkomba yowezi-2017 Yamazwe Akhangayo Kubatshalimali Bangaphandle.

src: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha lewa lena ho tla nyehela bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya moruo wa lehae le wa porofense ka ho ntlafatsa phumantsho ya dipalangwang tsa setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe futhi nangodaba lokuvakashela kuleli kweziNhlangano Ezenza Izilinganiso Zeminotho Yamazwe Omhlaba okuzokwenzeka esikhathini esifushane esizayo lapho lezi zinhlangano zizofakana khona imilomo nezinhlangano ezahlukahlukene kuleli kanye nezikhulu eziphezulu zikahulumeni.

src: Sena se tla eketsa kgokahanyo pakeng tsa dibaka tsa ditoropo le tsa mahae, ka morero wa ho kenyeletsa tikoloho tsa mahaeng ka hara moruo o bataletseng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilugunyazile uHlaka Olubuyekeziwe Lohlelo Lwezokuthutha Lwezindawo Zasemakhaya.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Leano le Pharaletseng la Dipalangwang tsa Mawatleng.
tgt: Lolu hlelo kuhloswe ngalo ukubhekana nezinto ezibekwe eqhulwini komasipala bezifunda kanye nasezifundazweni, ngokuthi kulungiswe inkinga yokugqoza nokungahlinzekwa kahle kweNgqalasizinda Nezinsizakalo Zokuthutha Ezindaweni Zasemakhaya, okuyinto evimbela ukuthuthukiswa kwenhlalo-mnotho kulezi zindawo.

src: Sena se supa boitlamo ba mmuso bakeng sa kgolo, ntshetsopele le diphethoho tsa lekala la dipalangwang tsa mawatleng tsa Aforika Borwa, mabapi le ho tshehetsa ntshetsopele ya moruo wa kahisano ha ka nqa e nngwe le nyehela kgwebisanong ya matjhaba.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kwalolu hlelo kuzolekelela ekuthuthukisweni komnotho wendawo kanye nowesifundazwe ngokwenza ngcono ukutholakala kwezinto zokuthutha umphakathi.

src: Sena se tsamaelana le dintlha tse ka sehlohlolong tsa mmuso tse amanang le Operation Phakisa mabapi leho hodisa Moruo wa Mawatle.
tgt: Lokhu kuzokhulisa ukuxhumana kwezindawo zasemadolobheni kanye nezindawo zasemakhaya, ngenhloso yokuqiniseka ukuthi izindawo zasemakhaya ziyabandakanywa emnothweni wezwe ukuze nazo zihlomule futhi zifake isandla esibonakalayo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Moralo wa Lewa la Dipalangwang tse Hlwekileng bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyigunyazile iNqubomgomo Ebanzi Yezinto Zokuthutha Zasolwandle.

src: Dipalangwang di bapala karolo ya bohlokwa mabapi le ho kgontsha kgwebisano ya matjhaba ka mokgwa o tla bang wa moshwelella ho tsa moruo, kahisano le tikoloho.
tgt: Lokhu kubonisa ngokucacile ukuzibophezela kukaHulumeni ekukhuliseni umkhakha wezinto zokuthutha zasolwandle, nokuwuthuthukisa lo mkhakha futhi kulethwe noguquko, ukuze kusekelwe ukuthuthukiswa kwenhlalo-mnotho yabantu futhi kusenjalo kufakwe isandla kwezokuhwebelana phakathi kwamazwe ngamazwe.

src: Mekgwa ya Dipalangwang e bopa mokokotlo wa mesebetsi ya moruo wa kahisano ka ho thusa ka ho tsamaiswa ha batho le dithoto.
tgt: Lokhu kuyahambisana nezinto ezibekwe eqhulwini nguhulumeni eziphathelene nomkhankaso we-Operation Phakisa okuhloswe ngawo ukukhulisa uMnotho Wasolwandle.

src: Leha ho le jwalo, mesi e tswang lekaleng la dipalangwang e nyehela ho palo kaofela ya ho ntshuwa ha dikgase tse kotsi (GHG), moo makoloi e leng ona a nyehelang haholo.
tgt: Kuyahambelana futhi nezinjongo ezibanzi zokugqugquzela ukukhula komnotho kanye nokukhuthaza ukuvulwa kwamathuba omsebenzi, njengoba lokhu kubekwe ngokucacile kwi-NDP kanye Nohlelo Lwengqalasizinda Lukazwelonke.

src: Lewa lena le rerile ho sisinya maitshunyako a tla fokotsa mesi ya GHG ka hara dipehelo tsa ntshetsopele ya moshwelella.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukushicilelwa koHlaka Lohlelo Lokuqinisekisa Ukubhekelelwa Kwemvelo Kwezokuthutha ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngalo.

src: Sena ke tshebedisano e etelletsweng pele ke Aforika mabapi le ho hlahisa le ho abelana mehlodi ya ho tobana le diphephetso tsa ntshetsopele tse shebaneng le kontinente.
tgt: Ezokuthutha zidlala indima esemqoka ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi ukuhwebelana namazwe omhlaba kwenzeka ngendlela ebhekelela ukusimama komnotho, nenhlalo yabantu kanye nemvelo.

src: E beha Dithekenoloji tsa Tlhahisoleseding le Dikgokahanyo bohareng ba lenaneo la ntshetsopele la selemo sa 2063 la dinaha tsa Aforika.
tgt: Izinhlelo zokuthutha zingumgogodla wemisebenzi yansukuzonke ephathelene nenhlalo-mnotho eNingizimu Afrika ngoba zenza kube lula ukuthuthwa kwabantu nempahla.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla kgola molemo ka bobedi ho tsa moruo le sepolotiki ka bonkakarolo ba yona ho Smart Africa.
tgt: Kodwa-ke, intuthu engcolile ekhiqizwa wumkhakha wezokuthutha inomthelela kumthamo ophelele wentuthu engcolile nesikhutha (ama-GHG) kuleli, futhi umkhakha wezokuthutha ngomgwaqo yiwona ohamba phambili kulokhu.

src: Ka ho beha diindaseteri tsa Aforika Borwa bohareng ba lenaneo la ntshetsopele la Smart Africa, Aforika Borwa e tla nyehela kgolong ya kgwebo ya lehae ka hara lebatowa.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luhlose ukwenza iziphakamiso zokungenelela ezizonciphisa intuthu engcolile nesikhutha ngaphansi kwemigomo yentuthuko esimeme.

src: Leano lena le sisinya tsela ya ho swaela lehakoreng la ho bona HIV jwaloka taba e bohareng ya bolaodi ho sebediswa katamelo ya bophelo bo botle ba setjhaba, hammoho le ho kenyeletswa ha TB jwaloka ntlha e ka sehlohlolong ka hara dikolo, hara tse ding.
tgt: Lolu wubambiswano oluholwa ngamazwe ase-Afrika olugxile ekuthuthukiseni izixazululo ezifanelekile kanye nokwabelana ngezinsiza ukuze kusonjululwe izinselelo ezibhekene naleli zwekazi.

src: Ho phatlalla ha tshebediso ho pharaleditswe ho ya baneng, matitjhereng le ho bahlanka, dikolong tsa mmuso le tsa poraefete.
tgt: Lokhu kwenza uLwazi Lwezobuchwepheshe Kwezokuxhumana lube ngumgogodla we-ajenda yentuthuko yowezi-2063 yamazwe ase-Afrika.

src: DibiliKabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho hlahiswa haSehlomathiso sa Bili ya Khamphani ya Maemafofane, ya selemo sa 2017 le Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Ditshebeletso tsa Sephethephethe sa Moyeng le Tsamaiso ya Difofane Palamenteng.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika izohlomula kukhona kokubili ezomnotho nezepolitiki ngokubamba kwayo iqhaza ku-Smart Africa.

src: Diphetoho dibiling tsena tse pedi di reretswe bakeng sa ho fana ka Sebopeho sa Taolo sa moshwelella.
tgt: Ngokwenza imboni yaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nolwazi nobuchwepheshe bayo obunzulu kube ngumongo we-ajenda yentuthuko ye-Smart Africa, iNingizimu Afrika izofaka isandla ekukhuliseni amabhizinisi akuleli esifundeni.

src: Hape diphethoho di fana ka monyetla wa ho theha dikomiti tsa mekgwa ya maipiletso, tse tla sebetsa mabapi le ho rarolla dikgang dife kapa dife.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukuphasiswa kweNqubomgomo Kazwelonke YoMnyango Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo ephathelene neGciwane Lesandulelangculazi (i-HIV), iZifo Ezithathwelana Ngokocansi (ama-STI) kanye neSifo Sofuba (i-TB).Ngowe-1999 inqubomgomo yayigxile ezinyathelweni ezisetshenziswa emhlabeni wonke jikelele zokuvimbela ukusuleleka ngegciwane, futhi ingazibhekisisi ngokwanele izimo zenhlalo nokuziphatha kwabantu ezibhebhezela i-HILe nqubomgomo iphakamisa ukuthi kube noguquko olunohlonze kwindlela okusetshenzwa ngayo, ngokuthi i-HIV ibhekwe ngasohlangothini lodaba lokuphatha olungumongo ngokusebenzisa indlela egxile empilweni yomphakathi futhi kusenjalo kubandakanywe ne-TB kulokho okuzogxilwa kukhona ezikoleni, phakathi kokunye.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlangMoporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla fana ka puo ya pulo ya Indaba ya Bohahlaudi ya selemo sa2017 e tla tshwarelwa Setsing sa Matjhaba sa Dikopano sa Inkosi Albert Luthuli Durban pakeng tsa la 16 le la 18 Motsheanong 2017.Ena ke indaba ya matjhaba eo hape e tla pepesa dihlahiswa le ditshebeletso tsa Aforika Borwa ka hara lekala la bohahlaudi le bodulo ba baeti.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukwethulwa ePhalamende kweSichibiyelo Somthetho Wenkampani Elawula Izikhumulo Zezindiza, wezi-2017 kanye neSichibiyelo Somthetho Wokundiza Ngamabhanoyi.

src: Indaba ya Bohahlaudi ya 2017 hape e tla hodisa le ho tshehetsa diphethoho tse ntseng di tswela pele le ntshetsopele ya indaseteri ya bohahlaudi ya Aforika Borwa ka ho qolleha karolo e bapalwang ke baetapele ba dikgwebo le beng ba dikgwebo tse nyenyane.
tgt: Izichibiyelo ezikule Mithethosivivinywa emibili zihlinzekela ukusungulwa koHlaka Lokulawula oluzosebenza unomphela.

src: Letona la Eneji Mmamoloko Kubayi kgweding ena o tla etella peleletsholo la Kgwedi ya Eneji tlasa mookotaba,“Re kgothaletsa motswako wa eneji e kgonehang le ya moshwelella mabapi le ho tshehetsa diphethoho tse matla tsa moruo wa kahisano”.
tgt: UMongameli Jacob Zuma uzokwethula inkulumo yokuvula uMbukiso Wezokuvakasha wezi-2017 ozobanjelwa e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre eDurban phakathi komhla ziyi-16 nomhla ziyi-18 kuNhlaba 2017.Lo mbukiso wamazwe ngamazwe uzophinda ubukise futhi ukhangise ngemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo zaseNingizimu Afrika emkhakheni wezokuvakasha kanye nokunakekelwa kwezivakashi.

src: Letsholo le tla ruta, le bope temoso le ho buisana le setjhaba mabapi le bokgabane ba eneji, polokeho ya eneji, dintlha tsa eneji e nngwe e fapaneng le kamoo e leng tsa bohlokwa bakeng sa tshebediso ya malapa, dikgwebo le diindaseteri.
tgt: Umbukiso Wezokuvakasha wezi-2017 uzogqugquzela futhi usekele noguquko oluqhubekayo njengamanje nokuthuthukiswa kwemboni yezokuvakasha yaseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi indima edlalwa ngosomabhizinisi kanye nabanikazi bamabhizinisi abancane.

src: Dingangisano tsa Ditekanyetso tsa Mafapha tsa selemo sa2017ka Motsheanong2017 di hlahisa monyetla wa mafapha a ho hlahisa Palamenteng le setjhabeng ka kakaretso kamoo a tla sebedisang Ditekanyetso tseo a di abetsweng tsa selemo sa 2017.
tgt: Zingaphezu kwezigidi eziyi-10 izivakashi ezivela emazweni angaphandle ezivakashele eNingizimu Afrika ngowezi-2016, okuyisibalo esikhuphuke nge-13% uma siqhathaniswa nesowezi-2015.

src: A tla sebedisa dintlha tsena hape hore a abelane le setjhaba hore ke eng seo mananeo a ona a se fupereng bakeng sa selemo sa hajwale sa ditjhelete.
tgt: Lokhu kungaphezulu kakhulu kwesilinganiso sokukhula kwezivakashi emhlabeni jikelele esiyi--3% kulesi sikhathi okukhulunywa ngaso.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho setjhaba ho itahlela ka setotswana ditlhakisetsong tsena kaha di hlahiswa ka motjha wa Palamente.
tgt: Kulesi sikhathi sokubanjwa koMbukiso Wezokuvakasha, iNingizimu Afrika izohlomula ngokufika kwezithunywa eziningi ezizotheleka ezweni lethu.

src: Lefapha la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere le tla tshwara Beke ya Dikgwerekgwere pakeng tsa la 16 le la 22 Motsheanong 2017 tlasa mookotaba: “Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere bakeng sa Bophelo bo botle le Seriti”.Mmuso o itlamme ho tlisa seriti ho maAforika Borwa ka phano ya ditshebeletso tsa tsamaiso ya dikgwerekgwere.
tgt: Kule nyanga, uNgqongqoshe Wezamandla u-Mmamoloko Kubayi uzohola umkhankaso weNyanga Yezamandla ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Sigqugquzela ukusetshenziswa kwezintlobo ezahlukene zamandla kagesi ezisimeme futhi ezingambi eqolo ngenhloso yokweseka uguquko lwenhlalo-mnotho olunohlonze”.

src: Ntlha e ka sehloohong e tla tsepamisetswa maikutlo bekeng ena e tla ba taba e ka sehlohlolong ya Lenaneo la Phediso ya Mabakete.
tgt: Lo mkhankaso uzofundisa, uqwashise futhi ubonisane nomphakathi mayelana nokusebenzisa ugesi ngendlela efanele, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi kuleli kunogesi owanele ngaso sonke isikhathi kanye nezinye izindaba eziphathelene nogesi, nokuthi lokhu kubaluleke kangakanani ekusetshenzisweni kukagesi emakhaya, emabhizinisini kanye nasezimbonini.

src: Sena se tla bonahala ka phano ya dintlwana tse sebedisang metsi Masepala wa Lehae waNketoana, ho la Freistata le Masepaleng wa Lehae wa Dawid Kruiper, ho la Kapa Leboya jwaloka karolo ya ho akofisa ditshebeletso bakeng sa ho fedisa matlwana a mabakete.
tgt: AmaVoti Ezabelomali Zeminyango Kahulumeni zowezi-2017 azobanjwa ngoNhlaba 2017 ahlinzeka ngethuba lokuba iminyango kahulumeni yethule ephalamende nasemphakathini jikelele imininingwane yokuthi izoyisebenzisa kanjani imali eyabelwe yona ngowezi-2017.

src: Aforika Borwa e keteka Kgwedi ya Aforika tlasa mookotaba: Aforika e Betere le Lefatshe le Betere.
tgt: Iminyango izosebenzisa lezi zethulo ukunekela umphakathi ukuthi yini equkethwe yizinhlelo zayo ngalo nyaka-mali esiwuphethe.

src: Diketsahalo tse ngata di ntse di tswela pele tse eteletsweng pele ke Lefapha la Bonono le Botjhabatse reretsweng ho kgothaletsa bonngwe ba Aforika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa umphakathi ukuba uzifakele izibuko lezi zethulo ngenkathi zethulwa ePhalamende.

src: Kabinete e amohela qeto ya Moporesidente Jacob Zuma ya hoatolosa ho sebediswa ha ditho tsa SANDF ho la Rephabliki ya Demokerasi ya Congo (DRC).Sena ke mohato wa ho nyehela bakeng sa kgotso le botsitso kontinenteng ya Aforika mme ka ho qolleha lebatoweng la rona ho imatahantswe le maitlamo a rona a matjhaba le leano la rona la matjhaba la ho nyehela bakeng sa Aforika e betere le lefatshe le betere.
tgt: UMnyango Wezamanzi Nokuthuthwa Kwendle uzosingatha iViki Lezokuthuthwa Kwendle phakathi komhla ziyi-16 nomhla zingama-22 kuNhlaba 2017 ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Ukuthuthwa Kwendle Okuqinisekisa Impilo Yabantu Nesithunzi Sabo”.

src: Palo e etsang 1371 ya ditho tsa SANDF di sebediswa ka hara DRC ho tshehetsa Morero wa Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) wa Botsitso.
tgt: Uhulumeni uzibophezele ekubuyiseni isithunzi sabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokubahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuthuthwa kwendle.

src: Tshebediso ya rona ya sesole kontinentengbakeng sa tshehetso e tswelang pele ya metjha ya lebatowa le kontinente bakeng sa ho arabela le ho rarolla dikoduwa, ho kgothaletsa kgotso le polokeho, ho matlafatsa momahano ya lebatowa, e eketsa ka bokgabane ba kgwebisano ya ka hara Aforika le ho sebeletsa ntshetsopele ya moshwelella ka hara Aforika.
tgt: Njengengxenye yokusheshisa uhlelo lokuqeda ukuthuthwa kwendle ngamabhakede kuzodluliselwa ezandleni zomphakathi ingqalasizindla yohlelo lokuthuthwa kwendle olusebenzisa amanzi, futhi imiphakathi ezohlomula kulolu hlelo wumphakathi ongaphansi kukamasipala wendawo i-Nketoana Local Municipality, eFreyistata kanye ne-Dawid Kruiper Local Municipality, eNyakatho Kapa.

src: Selemong sena sa OR Tambo ba re bontshitse matla a ho sebeletsa ho lebisang ho Aforika Borwa e betere le setjhaba se betere.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika igubha iNyanga ye-Afrika ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Sakha i-Afrika Engcono kanye Nomhlaba Ongcono”.

src: Re fumana kgothatso ho tswa ho diphihlello tsa bona, boitelo ba bona, lerato le maikemisetso a bona a ho ntshetsapele botho.
tgt: Kunemicimbi ehlukahlukene eqhubekayo eholwa wuMnyango Wezobuciko Namasiko okuhloswe ngayo ukugqugquzela ubumbano kuleli zwekazi lase-Afrika.

src: Tlotlo ya Ikhamanga ya Gauta (1),Tlotlo ya Ikhamanga ya Silifera (7),Tloto ya Ikhamanga ya Boronse (1),Tlotlo ya Baobab ya Gauta(1),Tlotlo ya Baobab ya Silifera (2),Tlotlo ya Baobab ya Boronse(2),Tlotlo ya Luthuli ya Silifera (29),Tlotlo ya Luthuli ya Boronse (1),Tlotlo ya Mapungubwe ya Silifera (2),Tlotlo ya Metswalle ya OR Tambo ya Gauta (1).
tgt: Le micimbi izofinyelela kuvuthondaba mhla zingama-25 kuNhlaba 2017 lapho uMongameli Zuma ezosingatha khona umcimbi wesidlo sasemini endlini yezivakashi zikaMongameli i-Sefako Makgatho Presidential guesthouse.

src: Ho lokollwa ha Tlaleho yabo-17th ya Khomishene ya Tekatekano Mesebetsing ke Letona la Mesebetsi, Mofumahadi Mildred Oliphant e bontsha monyebe o tletseng manganga wa diphethoho dibakeng tsa mosebetsi tse fapafapaneng ka hara mmaraka wa basebetsi wa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Kulesi sidlo sasemini kumenywe abaholi bezinhlangano zabantu abadabuka emazweni angaphandle asebehlala kuleli ngokugcwele futhi ngokusemthethweni uMongameli ahlangana nabo ngowezi-20.

src: Kabinete e amohela phatlalatso ya Letona la Mesebetsi ya hore lefapha le lohotha ho nka mehato e matla bakeng sa ho se imatahanye.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabahalalisela bonke labo abahlonishwe ngezindondo eMcimbini Wezindodo Zezwe wezi-2017.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa ramotse wa mehleng wa Johannesburg, le modulasetulo wa Mokgatlo wa Mebuso ya Lehae wa Aforika Borwa (SALGA), Parks Tau ka ho thonngwa jwaloka modulasetulo-mmoho wa Phanele ya Boemo bo Hodimo e Ikemetseng ya UN ho disa bohlwahlwa ba Habitat III.
tgt: Izindodo ezikhishiwe yilezi ezilandlelayo: i-Order of Ikhamanga yeGolide (munye) iOrder of Ikhamanga yeSiliva (bayisikhombisa) i-Order of Ikhamanga yeThusi (munye) i-Order of the Baobab yeGolide (munye) i-Order of the Baobab yeSiliva (babili), i-Order of the Baobab yeThusi (babili) i-Order of Luthuli yeSiliva (bangama-29) i-Order of Luthuli yeThusi (munye) i-Order of Mapungubwe yeSiliva (babili), kanye ne-Order of the Companions of OR Tambo yeGolide (munye).

src: Lenaneo lena le ile la amohelwa ke UN ho tsoseletsa boitlamo ba lefatshe mabapi le kgodiso ya moshwelella ya dibaka tsa ditoropo.
tgt: Ukukhishwa koMbiko we-17 Wekhomishana Yokuqasha Ngokulingana Emsebenzini nguNgqongqoshe Wezabasebenzi, uNkz Mildred Oliphant kubonisa ukuthi uguquko lusahamba ngesivinini esiphansi kakhulu ezikhungweni ezahlukahlukene emkhakheni wezokuqashwa kwabasebenzi eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri (dti) le hapilekgau ya mopepesi ya hlwahlwa ka ho fetisisa wa molata ho Dipontsho tsa Kgwebisano ya Matjhaba ya Zimbabwe (ZITF) yabo-58.Sena se ananela mekutu e babatsehang ya Sehlopha sa Aforika Borwa mabapi le ho netefatsa boitlamo ba naha ba ho aha bolekane le Zimbabwe mme sena se hlahisitse dikuno tsa moruo tse neng di labalabelwa.
tgt: Lo Mbiko uyakhombisa ukuthi kusekude kakhulu ngaphambi kokuba sifinyelele esimweni sokuqashwa kwabasebenzi esibonisa ukumelwa kwabo bonke abantu bezwe lethu ngendlela efanelekile.

src: Kabinete e fetiseditse matshediso ho mmuso le batho ba Riphabliki ya Tanzania mabapi le kotsi ya bese e nyarosang e bakileng mafu a batho ba 36, moo ba 33 e leng bana.
tgt: Abantu abampisholo, abesifazane kanye nabantu abanokukhubazeka basalokhu bengamelwe neze kahle kuyo yonke imikhakha yokuQasha Ngokulingana Emsebenzini.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di lokela ho netefatswa ka mangolo a thuto le tumellano e amehang.
tgt: Lo mbiko uyabonisa ukuthi abelungu yibona abaqhoqhobele ama-68% ezikhundla zabaphathi abaphezulu kuleli emkhakheni kahulumeni kanye nasemkhakheni ozimele, okuyisibalo esiphindaphindwe kasithupha uma kubhekwa isibalo sabantu abasebenzayo kuleli lizwe.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, la 24 Motsheanong 2017, Tuynhuys, Motse Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yabamba umhlangano wayo ngoLwesithathu mhla zingama-24 kuNhlaba 2017, e-Tuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Dintlha Tsa Hajwale.
tgt: Izindaba ezisematheni.

src: Kabinete e tshwenyehile ka diketsahalo tse ntseng di phahama tsa tlhekefetso le merusu kgahlanong le basadi ka hara setjhaba sa bo rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhathazekile ngokudlondlobala kwezigameko zokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane kanye nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane ezweni lakithi.

src: Diketsahalo tsa haufinyana tjena tsa merusu ya balekane ba ratanang di bonahetse ha basadi ba sebete ba ema ka maoto ho bua kgahlanong le kgatikelo ya ditokelo tsa bona.
tgt: Izigameko zakamuva ezibandakanya udlame olubhebhezelwa ngamasoka abo seziholele ekutheni abesifazane abaningi abanesibindi baphumele obala bazwakalise ukukhathazeka kwabo mayelana nalokhu kwephulwa nokunyathelwa kwamalungelo abo.

src: Kabinete e ananela hore jwaloka naha re ntse re tswela pele ho ba le setjhaba se laolwang ke banna mme ke kahoo ho nang le boipiletso ba hore ho sebetswe ho feta bakeng sa ho lwantsha koduwa ya dipolao tsa basadi le kgwebisano ka batho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuma ukuthi njengezwe sisalokhu siyizwe elilawulwa ngamadoda futhi elibeka amadoda phambili, ngokunjalo-ke inxusa ukuba kwenziwe imizamo ethe xaxa ukulwisana nesihlava sokubulawa nokushushumbiswa kwabesifazane.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho makala kaofela a setjhaba ho ipopa bakeng sa ho lwantsha koduwa ena, ho hanyetsana le mokgwa ofe kapa ofe wa merusu e etswang kgahlanong le basadi le bana, le ho sebetsa le sepolesa le tsamaiso ya toka bakeng sa ho tshwara baetsi ba diketso tsena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa yonke imikhakha yomphakathi ukuba ibambisane ekunqobeni lesi sihlava, ilwisane nanoma yiluphi uhlobo lodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane, futhi isebenzisane namaphoyisa kanye nohlelo lwezobulungiswa ukuze kuboshwe futhi kugwetshwe abenzi bobubi.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o entse boipiletso ba hore ho emiswe ka tlhekefetso ya basadi le bana e ntseng e tswela pele.
tgt: UMongameli Jacob Zuma usenxuse ukuba kuphele ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane okulokhu kuqhubekile njalo.

src: Kabinete e laetse Sehlopha sa Tshireletso ya Kahisano, sa Ntshetsopele ya Badudi le Setjhaba ho tla ka lenaneo la tshebetso le tla kgannela naha ntweng ya ho emisa ka tlhekefetso ya basadi le bana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalele iQoqwana Lezokuvikelwa Komphakathi Nokuthuthukiswa Kwabantu ukuba liqalise uhlelo lokusebenza oluzohola izwe empini yokuqeda udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane.

src: Kabinete e amohela sephetho sa Aforika Borwa sa Tekolo ya Maemo a Setjhaba ka Kakaretso le a Bophelo bo Botle ya 2016 e entsweng ke Lefapha la Dipalopalo la Aforika Borwa (Stats SA), e methang maemo a bophelo bo botle ba maAforika Borwa, le phihlello le boleng ba mananeo a bophelo bo botle.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyayithokozela imiphumela yoCwaningo lowezi-2016 Lwesimo Sempilo Nenhlalo Yabantu Abahlukahlukene BaseNingizimu Afrika olwenziwe wuPhiko Lwezezibalo eNingizimu Afrika (i-Stats SA), olucubungula futhi luhlole isimo sempilo sabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, nezinga lokufinyelela kwezinhlelo zezempilo kubona kanye nekhwalithi yalezo zinhlelo.

src: Tekolo ena hara tse ding e tlaleha hore ho na le phokotseho ya 20% ya ho shwa ha masea le phokotseho ya 11% palong ya basadi le banna ba tsubang.
tgt: Umbiko wocwaningo ubonisa ukuthi, phakathi kokunye, sehle ngama-20% isibalo sokushona kwezingane futhi lehle nge-11% inani labesifazane kanye nabesilisa ababhema ugwayi.

src: Sephetho sena se bontsha hore maitshunyako a maano a behilweng ke tsamaiso ya Moporesidente Zuma a beha ditholwana tse ntle.
tgt: Le miphumela iyakhombisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo zokungenelela eziqaliswe nguhulumeni kaMongameli Zuma seziqalile ukuvuna izithelo ezinhle.

src: Kabinete, le ha ho le jwalo, e tshwenyehile ka palo ya maAforika Borwa e ntseng e tswela pele ho kena thobalanong e sa tshireletsehang le balekane ba bangata.
tgt: Kepha-ke, iKhabhinethi ikhathazekile ngesibalo sabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abasalokhu beqhubeka nokuya ocansini olungaphephile nabalingani abaningi.

src: Se ka etsang 32% le 42% ya basadi le banna ka tatelano se bontshitse hore ha ba e so ka ba kenela diteko tsa HIV leha mmuso o entse mekutu ya ho hlahisa temoso ka ho kenela diteko tsa HIV.
tgt: Abesifazane abangama-32% kanye nabesilisa abangama-42% batshele abenzi bocwaningo ukuthi bona abakaze bahlolelwe igciwane lesandulelangculazi (i-HIV) nakuba uhulumeni enza imizamo yokuqwashisa ngokubaluleka kokuhlolelwa i-HIV.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho nka boikarabelo bakeng sa bophelo ba bona bo botle le boitekanelo, ho kena thobalanong e tshireletsehileng le ho dula ba kenela diteko tsa HIV le mafu kaofela a tshwaetsanang le a sa tshwaetsaneng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabanxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba baqikelele impilo nenhlalakahle yabo, bazivikele uma beya ocansini futhi njalo baye kohlolelwa i-HIV kanye nazo zonke izifo ezithathelwanayo nezingathathelwana.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho batswadi le bahlokomedi ho netefatsa hore bana ba bona ba thola diente kgahlanong le mafu a bana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa abazali kanye nabalondolozi bezingane ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi izingane zabo zigonyelwa izifo ezihlasela izingane.

src: Kabinete e dula e itlamme mabapi le ho etsa bonnete ba hore bana ba sireletsehile bakeng sa ho fedisa mahloko a tshwaetsanang a behang bophelo ba bana kotsing.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isalokhu izibophezele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi izingane ziyagonywa ngenhloso yokuqeda izifo ezithathelwanayo eziyingozi kakhulu empilweni yezingane.

src: Kabinete e tiisetsa batswadi le bahlokomedi hore meriana e fanwang ke Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle e bolokehile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithanda ukuqinisekisa abazali nabalondolozi ukuthi iphephile imithi esetshenziswa nguMnyango Wezempilo ukugoma izingane zabo.

src: Kabinete e amohetse mokgahlelo wa pele o tsoseleditsweng wa Setsi sa Diindaseteri sa Vulindlela Heights Mthatha ho la Kapa Botjhabela.
tgt: IKhabinethi isamukelile isigaba sokuqala sesizinda sezimboni esivuselelwe kabusha i-Vulindlela Heights Industrial esiseMthatha, eMpumalanga Kapa.

src: Sena ke karolo ya Lenaneo la Tsoseletso ya Diphaka tsa Diindaseteri.
tgt: Lokhu kuyingxenye yoHlelo Lokuvuselelwa Kabusha Kwamapaki Ezimboni.

src: Ke ya bobedi ya mofuta wa yona ho la Kapa Botjhabela le ho ba ya botshelela ya diphaka tse ntseng di tsoseletswa ho phatlalla le naha.
tgt: Leli paki lezimboni liyisizinda sesibili salolu hlobo eMpumalanga Kapa futhi lingelinye lamapaki ezimboni ayisithupha avuselelwa kabusha njengamanje ezweni lonkana.

src: Mmuso o tsoseletsa diphaka tsa diindaseteri ho matlafatsa tlhahiso ya mesebetsi le ho netefatsa kgolo e kenyeletsang.
tgt: Uhulumeni uvuselela amapaki ezimboni ngenhloso yokukhuthaza ukuvulwa kwamathuba omsebenzi kanye nokuqinisekisa ukukhula komnotho okubandakanya abantu bonke.

src: Ho suthisa mesebetsi ya moruo ho tloha ditsing tsa metse ya ditoropo hape ke karolo ya mekutu ya mmuso ya ho tlisa diphethoho moruong.
tgt: Ukufuduswa kwemisebenzi yezomnotho isuka ezizindeni ezisemadolobheni nakho kuyingxenye yemizamo kahulumeni yokuletha uguquko lwezomnotho olunohlonze.

src: Tlhahisoleseding e mabapi le kamoo o ka nkang monyetla wa menyetla e teng diphakeng tsa rona tsa diindaseteri, ho fihlella tshehetso ya mmuso le mananeo a ditsiane, le menyetla ya matsete makaleng a fapafapaneng e a fumaneha ho WEBTOKEN kapa ka Setsi sa Mehala sa Lefapha Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri (dti) ho 0861 843 384.
tgt: Ulwazi mayelana nokuthi abantu bangawasebenzisa kanjani amathuba akhona emapaki ezimboni akuleli futhi bafinyelele nasezinhlelweni zosizo nemihlomulo-nkuthazo ehlinzekwa nguhulumeni kanye namathuba okutshalwa kwezimali emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, luyatholakala WEBTOKEN noma eSikhungweni Sokuxhumana Namakhasimende soMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni (i-dti) ngokufonela le nombolo: 0861 843 384.

src: Kabinete e lemohile ka maswabi qeto ya General Motors South Africa (GMSA) (Pty) Ltd ya ho fedisa tlhahiso le thekiso ya makoloi a Chevrolet ka hara naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isiphawule ngokudabuka nokukhathazeka isinqumo senkampani yezimoto i-General Motors South Africa (i-GMSA) (Pty) Ltd sokuvala umsebenzi wayo wokukhiqiza nokuthengisa izimoto zohlobo lwe-Chevrolet kuleli.

src: Sena se fupere ditlamorao tse bohloko bakeng sa ba tla lahlehelwa ke mesebetsi ya bona le bakeng sa moruo wa rona.
tgt: Lokhu kuzoba nomthelela omubi kakhulu kulabo abazophelelwa yimisebenzi yabo kanye nasemnothweni wezwe lakithi.

src: Mmuso o dula o itlamme bakeng sa ho tshehetsa lekala la naha la tlhahiso ya makoloi, e leng le hlokolosi bakeng sa moruo le tlhahiso ya WEBTOKEN dti ba tswela pele ho sebetsa le bankakarolo kaofela ho bebofatsa sekgahla sa sena.
tgt: Uhulumeni usalokhu ezibophezele ekusekeleni umkhakha wezimoto, okuwumkhakha obaluleke kakhulu emnothweni wezwe nasekuvulweni kwamathuba omsebenzi.

src: Bakeng sa ho eketsa tlhahiso, tlhahiso ya mesebetsi le matlafatso ya dihlahiswa tse rekiswang ka ntle, haufinyana tjena re thakgotse mokgahlelo wa borobong wa Moralo wa Leano la Tshebetso la Diindaseteri (IPAP) bakeng sa ho tataisa mesebetsi ya rona.
tgt: Ngenhloso yokukhulisa umsebenzi wokukhiqiza, ukuvulwa kwamathuba omsebenzi kanye nokuqinisa ukuthunyelwa kwempahla emazweni angaphandle, esikhathini esifushane esedlule sethule isigaba sesishiyagalolunye soHlelo Lokusebenza Lwenqubomgomo Yezimboni (i-IPAP) ukuze ihole izinyathelo zethu.

src: Kabinete e ananela hore Isuzu, eo esale e le selekaneng le GMSA ka dilemo tse ngata ka hara Aforika Borwa, e tla nka ditshebetso tsa GMSKabinete e lemohile ho mpefala ha maemo a komello ka hara Kapa Bophirima le Kapa Botjhabela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuphawulile ukuthi inkampani yakwa-Isuzu, ebilokhu ibambisene nabakwa-GMSA eNingizimu Afrika kule minyaka edlule, izothatha izintambo iqhube umsebenzi obewenziwa ngabakwa-GMSIKhabhinethi isiphawulile isimo esibi kakhulu esidalwe yisomiso eNtsonalanga Kapa kanye naseMpumalanga Kapa.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho badudi ho tshehetsa dithibelo tsa tshebediso ya metsi tse tsebahaditsweng ke diporofense.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa imiphakathi ukuba isekele imikhawulo ebekwe yizifundazwe yokusetshenziswa nokongiwa kwamanzi.

src: Moifo o bopilweng ka bahlanka ho tswa ho Lefapha la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere, Komiti ya Naha ya Taolo ya Dikoduwa o sebetsa mmoho le diporofense le mmuso wa lehae, esale o phathahane mabapi le ho netefatsa hore ditharollo tsa nako e kgutshwanyane ho isa ho tsa nako e bohareng di a akofiswa bakeng sa ho tiisetsa polokeho ya metsi ya porofense bakeng sa nako e telele.
tgt: Ithimba elihlanganisa izikhulu ezivela eMnyangweni Wezamanzi Nokuthuthwa Kwendle, neKomidi Likazwelonke Lokuphathwa Nokulawulwa Kwezinhlekelele, ngokusebenzisana nohulumeni bezifundazwe nabezindawo, basebenza ngokuzikhandla okukhulu ukuqinisekisa ukusheshiswa kwezixazululo zesikhathi esifushane kuya esikhathini esimaphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukutholakala kwamanzi anele ezifundazweni esikhathini eside esizayo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho kenyeletswa basebedisi ba malapeng, dikgwebo, lekala la merafo, makala a eneji le a temo ho sebetsa mmoho le ho sebedisa metsi ka polokeho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kubandakanya nabasebenzisi bamanzi basemakhaya, amabhizinisi, umkhakha wezimayini, owezamandla kanye nowezolimo ukuba basebenze ngokubambisana futhi basebenzise amanzi ngokucophelela, futhi bawonge.

src: Kabinete e amohetse tokomane ya dipuisano e lokolotsweng ya Lewa Kgahlanong le Bobodu, e tla matlafatsa Lewa la Naha le Kgahlanong le Bobodu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukukhishwa kombhalo wokuxoxisana weSu Lokulwisana Nenkohlakalo, ozoholela ekusungulweni kweSu Likazwelonke Lokulwisana Nenkohlakalo.

src: Kabinete e mema setjhaba ho etsa diphehiso tse ngotsweng ka websaete ya Lefapha la Meralo, Bodisa le Tlhatlhobo ya Tshebetso: www.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema umphakathi ukuba uthumele iziphakamiso nemibono yawo ebhalwe phansi, ngokusebenzisa i-webhusayithi yoMnyango Wezokuhlela, Ukuqapha Nokuhlola ku: www.

src: Ntwa kgahlanong le bobodu e dula e le e nngwe ya dintlha tse ka sehlohlolong tsa mmuso.
tgt: Impi yokulwisana nenkohlakalo isalokhu ingenye yezinto ezibekwe eqhulwini nguhulumeni.

src: Bobodu le ho nyehla ha seriti ho ka bobedi makala a mmuso le a poraefete di na le kgahlamelo e kotsi hodima ntshetsopele ya naha ya bo rona.
tgt: Inkohlakalo kanye nokungasebenzi ngobuqotho emikhakheni yomibili, okungumkhakha ozimele kanye nomkhakha kahulumeni, kunomthelela omubi kakhulu ekuthuthukisweni kwezwe lethu.

src: Kabinete e hlahisitse ngongoreho ka tlhaselo ya lefatshe ka marangrang a dikgokahano ya haufinyana tjena, e tlalehilweng e le tlhaselo e kgolo ka ho fetisisa ho fihlela hajwale.
tgt: IKhabinethi izwakalise ukukhathazeka ngesigameko sakamuva sokuhlaselwa kohlelo-xhumano lwe-inthanethi emhlabeni jikelele, okubikwe njengesigameko esikhulu kunazo zonke kuze kube manje sokuhlaselwa kohlelo-xhumano lwe-inthanethi.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa kaofela ho nka mehato ya tlhokomelo ha ba sebedisa mekgwa ya dikgokahanyo ya elektroniki le ho etsa ditumellano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba bathathe izinyathelo ezidingekile ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwemininingwane yabo ngenkathi bexhumana noma benza ibhizinisi ngohlelo-xhumano lwe-inthanethi.

src: Ho sebedisa disebediswa tsa antivaerase ya khomphyutha kgafetsa tse tla hlahloba tikoloho e sa lokang inthaneteng le tsona di a kgothaletswa.
tgt: Kunconywa futhi nokuthi abasebenzisi bohlelo-xhumano lwe-inthanethi basebenzise uhlelo-kusebenza lwekhompyutha lwakamuva olulwisana ngokuqhubekayo namavayirasi ahlasela izinhlelo-kusebenza zamakhompyutha.

src: Kabinete e ngongorehile ka tse ntseng di etsahala haufinyana tjena Eskom.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhathazekile ngezigameko zakamuva ezenzeke kwa-Eskom.

src: Kabinete e ananela hore taba ya ho hirwa hape ha Monghadi Brian Molefe jwaloka Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso (CEO) wa Eskom e makgotleng a dinyewe le ka hara Palamente, mme ka hona e tla hlompha ditsamaiso tsena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqonda ngokuphelele ukuthi udaba oluphathelene nokuqashwa kabusha kukaMnu Brian Molefe njengoMphathi Omkhulu (i-CEO) wakwa-Eskom njengamanje luphambi kwezinkantolo kanye nePhalamende, ngakho-ke izozihlonipha lezo zinqubo zize ziphothulwe ngokufanelekile.

src: Moporesidente, le ha ho le jwalo, o thehile Komiti e Kopanetsweng ya Matona (IMC) e bopilweng ka Letona la Dikgwebo tsa Mmuso, la Eneji, la Ditjhelete le la Toka le Ditshebeletso tsa Tlhabollo ya Batshwaruwa.
tgt: Kepha-ke, uMongameli usesungule iKomidi LoNgqongqoshe Beminyango Ehlukahlukene (i-IMC) elihlanganisa uNgqongqoshe Wezamabhizinisi Kahulumeni, Owezamandla, Owezezimali kanye Nowezobulungiswa Nokuhlunyeleliswa Kwezimilo.

src: IMC e kopuwe ho bokeletsa dintlha mabapi le ho tataisa Kabinete kamoo e tla sebetsanang le dintlha tse jwalo nakong e tlang.
