tgt: Leli Komidi lijutshwe ukuba lenze umsebenzi wokuqoqa ulwazi namaqiniso azonikeza iKhabhinethi umhlahlandlela wokuthi kumele ibhekane kanjani nezindaba ezinjengalezi esikhathini esizayo.

src: Moetapele ke Letona la Toka le Ditshebeletso tsa Tlhabollo ya Batshwaruwa, Monghadi Michael Masutha.
tgt: Umhlanganisi waleli komidi nguNgqongqoshe Wezobulungiswa Nokuhlunyeleliswa Kwezimilo, uMnu Michael Masutha.

src: Diqeto tsa kabinete.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Tjhata e Shebilweng Botjha ya Matlafatso e Pharaletseng ya Batho ba Batsho Moruong bakeng sa Indaseteri ya Aforika Borwa ya Merafo le Diminerale ka selemo sa 2017.Letona la Mehlodi ya Diminerale Mosebenzi Zwane o tla fana ka tsebiso hang feela ha tjhata e se e kentswe koranteng ya mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukushicilelwa kukaSomqulu Obuyekeziwe wezi-2017 Wokufukulwa Nokuhlonyiswa Kwabantu Abamnyama Kwezomnotho oqondiswe embonini yeZimayini Nezimbiwa yaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e amohetse Moralo wa Naha wa Maqhubu a Radio wa selemo sa 2017 o tjhaelletsweng monwana ke Lefapha la Meralo ya Motheo ya Dikgokahanyo le Ditshebeletso tsa Poso.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezimbiwa u-Mosebenzi Zwane uzohlinzeka ngolwazi olufanelekile uma lo somqulu usushicilelwe kusomqulu kahulumeni.

src: Ho ajwa ha maqhubu ke Pitso ya Lefatshe ya Dikgokahanyo tsa Radio ho na le kgahlamelo ya bohlokwa kgolong ya moruo wa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilugunyazile uHlelo Lukazwelonke Lwezokusakaza Ngomoya lowezi-2017 oluvunywe yiHhovisi LikaNgqongqoshe Wezengqalasizinda Yezokuxhumana Nezinsizakalo Zeposi.

src: Moralo wa Naha wa Maqhubu a Radio wa selemo sa 2017 ke mohlodi o pharaletseng wa kabo ya ho phatlalla ha maqhubu a radio bakeng sa ditshebeletso tse fapaneng tsa dikgokahanyo tsa radio.
tgt: Umthamo wokusakaza ngomoya owabelwe leli lizwe eNgqungqutheleni Yomhlaba Yezokhuxhumana Ngamagagasi Omoya unomthelela omkhulu ekukhulisweni komnotho waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Moralo o shebilweng botjha wa Naha wa Maqhubu a Radio wa selemo sa 2017 o netefatsa hore Aforika Borwa e matahantswe le Melawana ya Matjhaba ya Radio e tjhaelletsweng monwana e ileng ya amohelwa ka selemo sa 2015 ho Pitso ya Matjhaba ya Meralo ya Motheo ya Dikgokahanyo (ITU).
tgt: UHlelo Lukazwelonke Lwezokusakaza Ngomoya lowezi-2017 luwumthombo obanzi futhi ophelele wokwabelwa kwezinsizakalo zokuxhumana ngamagagasi omoya umthamo wokusakaza ngomoya.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Lewa la Boipaballo ba ka hara Naha ba Metsing.
tgt: UHlelo Lukazwelonke Lwezokusakaza Ngomoya olubuyekeziwe lowezi-2017 luyaqinisekisa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyahambisana neMithethonqubo egunyaziwe Yamazwe Ngamazwe Yezokusakaza Ngomoya eyamukelwa ngokusemthethweni kwiNgqungquthela yowezi-2015 yeNhlangano Yamazwe Ngamazwe Yezokuxhumana Ngezingcingo.

src: Lewa lena, ka Bolaudi ba Boipaballo ba Mawatleng ba Aforika Borwa, le beha maemo le ho ntlafatsa ditsamaiso mabapi le ho dumella le ho etsa ditlhophiso tsa dilaesense bakeng sa diketswana tse sebedisang ditsela tsa rona tsa metsi tsa ka hara naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iligunyazile iSu Lokuphepha Kwemifula Emaphakathi Nezwe.

src: Sena se tla netefatsa boipaballo ba dikepe tse nyenyane ditseleng tsa ka hara naha tsa metsi tsa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lelisu, ngokusebenzisa uPhiko Lwezokuphepha Olwandle LwaseNingizimu Afrika, lubeka amazinga okumele athotshelwe futhi luphucula izinqubo zokuhlinzekwa ngezimvume namalayisense kwezikebhe ezisebenza emifuleni emaphakathi nezwe.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Lewa la Mebila la Tsamaiso ya Dithoto.
tgt: Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuphepha kwezikebhe ezincane emifuleni yaseNingizimu Afrika emaphakathi nezwe.

src: Lewa lena le rerile ho hlahisa moralo o kopanetsweng wa taolo le tshebetso, o tla kgontsha Aforika Borwa ho fihlella maemo a hlwahlwa ka ho fetisisa a matjhaba a ditshebetso tsa mebila ya tsamaiso ya dithoto.
tgt: Lelisu kuhloswe ngalo ukwakha uhlaka lokulawula nokusebenza oludidiyelwe, oluzokwenza ukuba iNingizimu Afrika ikwazi ukufinyelela emazingeni aphuma phambili emhlabeni jikelele aphathelene nomsebenzi wokuthunyelwa kwempahla ngezinto zokuthutha ezihamba emgwaqeni.

src: Dikgothaletso leweng lena di tla matlafatsa bohlwahlwa ba qobello, ho hodisa boipaballo mebileng, ho matlafatsa tshireletso ya meralo ya motheo, ho fokotsa dikgahlamelo tsa tikoloho, le ho bopa moralo o kopanetsweng wa phehisano e laolwang ho ya ka boleng boo ka hara lekala la tsamaiso ya dithoto le ka tswelang pele ho sebeletsa ditlhoko tsa moruo wa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Izincomo zalelisu zizoqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa kangcono kwamazinga abekiwe, zigqugquzele ukuphepha emgwaqeni, zenze ngcono ukuvikelwa kwengqalasizinda, zinciphise umthelela ongemuhle ongakhahlameza imvelo futhi zakhe uhlaka oludidiyelwe lokuncintisana okulawulwa ngokwekhwalithi yomsebenzi oluzovumela ukuba umkhakha wokuthunyelwa kwempahla ngezinto zokuthutha ezihamba emgwaqeni ukwazi ukuqhubeka nomsebenzi wokubhekelela nokuhlinzekela izidingo zomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana meralo ya Khamphani ya Mente ya Aforika Borwa bakeng sa dikhoine tsa sehopotso le tse tla sebediswa tsa dilemo tsa 2017 le 2018.Ka tshebedisano le Kabinete, ho hlahisitswe letoto le letjha le emelang botjhaba, tokoloho le demokerasi tlasa mookotaba: “Re keteka Aforika Borwa”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwagunyazile amadizayini eNkampani Ekhiqiza Izinhlamvu Zemali yaseNingizimu Afrika, owezi-2017 nowezi-2018 ezinhlamvu zemali ezizoba yisikhumbuzo kanye nalezo ezizosetshenziswa emphakathini nsukuzonke.

src: Tswalo ya Molwanedi wa Tokoloho ya dilemo di lekgolo Oliver Reginald Tambo e kgethilwe e le sehlooho sa pele se tla bontshwa.
tgt: Ngokubambisana neKhabhinethi, sekwakhiwe olunye uchungechunge lwezinhlamvu zemali eziwuphawu olumele amasiko, inkululeko kanye nombuso wentando yeningi labantu ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Sibungaza iNingizimu Afrika”.

src: Ho hlahiswa ha R50 (1aonse, silifera ya seteling) e ntjha ya khoene, R500 (1aonse, 24 dikharata tsa gauta) ya khoene le R50 (metale wa motheo) ya khoene ho keteka sehopotso sa dilemo tse 100 tsa letsatsi la tswalo la OR Tambo.
tgt: Umbungazo weminyaka eyikhulu kwazalwa ingqalabutho yomzabalazo u-Oliver Reginald Tambo uqokwe njengomfanekiso wokuqala ozoboniswa kulezi zinhlamvu zemali.

src: Meralo ya letoto la dikhoene tse latelang tsa dilemo tsa 2017 le 2018 tsa sehopotso di hlahisitswe:a. Letoto la dikhoene la selemo sa 2017: Mokete wa Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Oliver Reginald Tambob.
tgt: Ukwethulwa kohlamvu olusha olungama-R50 (oluyisiliva soqobo olusinesisindo esilingana ne-awunsi elilodwa), uhlamvu olungama-R500 (olwakhiwe ngamakharethi egolide angama-24, olusinesisindo esilingana ne-awunsi elilodwa) kanye nohlamvu olungama-R50 (olwakhiwe nge-sterling silver), okuyizinhlamvu okuhloswe ngazo ukugubha iminyaka eyi-100 kwazalwa u-OR Tambo.

src: Dikhoene tse tla sebediswa naheng tsa selemo sa 2017: khoene ya R5 e bontshang Tlotlo ya Metswalle ya OR Tamboc.
tgt: Sekwakhiwe izinhlamvu zesikhumbuzo ezilandelayo zowezi-2017 nowezi-2018:a. Uchungechunge lwezinhlamvu zowezi-2017: Umgubho Yeminyaka Eyikhulu ka-Oliver Reginald Tambob.

src: Letoto la dikhoene la selemo sa 2017 la Protea: Bophelo ba Mohale – Nelson Mandelad.
tgt: Uchungechunge lohlamvu olungu-R5 lowezi-2017 oluzosetshenziswa nsukuzonke emphakathini: uhlamvu olungu-R5 olubonisa i-Order of the Companions of OR Tamboc.

src: Letoto la dikhoene tsa 2017 tsa R1: Dihahabi tsa Aforika Borwa – Marabee.
tgt: Uchungechunge lohlamvu lwe-Protea lowezi-2017: Impilo Yengqalabutho – u-Nelson Mandelad.

src: Letoto la dikhoene tsa selemo sa 2018 la Mokgatlo wa Thuto, Saense le Botjhaba wa Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UNESCO) la Motho le Sebaka sa Bophelo: Resefe ya Sebaka sa Bophelo ya Waterbergf.
tgt: Uchungechunge lohlamvu olungu-R1 lowezi-2017: Izilwane Ezihuquzela Ngesisu zaseNingizimu Afrika – iBululue.

src: Letoto la dikhoene la selemo sa 2018: Mokgatlo wa Naha wa Sebopeho sa Naha ‘Boikitlaetso ba Dikatse tse Kgolo’ – Taug.
tgt: Uchungechunge lohlamvu lowezi-2018 lweNhlangano Yezemfundo, Ezesayensi Nezamasiko engaphansi kweNhlangano Yezizwe (i-UNESCO) Umuntu Nemvelo Aphila Kuyo: Isiqiwu Semvelo sase-Waterbergf.

src: Dikhoene tsa selemo sa 2018: FIFA World Cup RussiaTDiketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Uchungechunge lwezinhlamvu zowezi-2018: Inhlangano Kazwelonke Yezejiyografi ‘Umklamo Wamakati Amakhulu Asendle’ – IBhubesig.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho tshehetsa Beke ya Tshireletso ya Bana ho tloha ka la 28 Motsheanong ho isa ka la 4 Phuptjane tlasa mookotaba: “Bohle ha re tshireletseng bana bakeng sa ho ntshetsa Aforika Borwa pele”.
tgt: Uhlamvu lowezi-2018: Umqhudelwano wezi-2018 Wendebe Yomhlaba ye-FIFA Ozosingathelwa kwelase-Russia, i-2018 FIFA World Cup RussiaTImicimbi ezayo.

src: Tshireletso ya bana ba rona ke mosebetsi le boikarabelo ba maAforika Borwa kaofela batswadi, bahlokomedi, batho ka bo mong le badudi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabanxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba basekele iViki Lokuvikelwa Kwezingane kusukela mhla zingama-28 kuNhlaba kuze kube ngumhla zizi-4 kuNhlangulana, ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Sonke masivikele izingane ukuze siqhubekisele iNingizimu Afrika phambili”.

src: Jwaloka ka setjhaba, ke mosebetsi wa rona ho etsa ho hongata ho netefatsa hore ba tsietsing ka ho fetisisa ka hara setjhaba sa rona ha ba hlekefetswe.
tgt: Ukuvikelwa kwezingane zethu kungumthwalo wabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abazali, abalondolozi, umuntu ngamunye kanye nemiphakathi.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa makala oohle a setjhaba ho sebetsa mmoho bakeng sa ho bopa metse e bolokehileng le ho itekanela hore bana ba rona e tle e be batho setjhabeng.
tgt: Njengezwe, sinomthwalo wokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi mabangahlukunyezwa nakancane labo abangakwazi ukuzivikela ngokwabo emphakathini wethu.

src: Nakong ya mokete wa dilemo tse lekgolo tsa OR Tambo, Aforika Borwa e tla tshwaya Kgwedi ya Batjha ka Phuptjane 2017 tlasa mookotaba: “Selemo sa OR Tambo: Re ntshetsapele Bonkakarolo ba Batjha Moruong.”Kgweding eo kaofela mmuso o tla kenela diketsahalo tse mmalwa ho kenyeletswa dipontsho tsa batjha, dipuisano le dibaka tsa baetapele ba dikgwebo ba batjha ho pepesa menyetla e teng bakeng sa batjha, le ho ba hlohlelletsa ho ikgapela ditlwaelo tsa thuto le boetapele tsa OR Tambo.
tgt: Kusezandleni zethu ukuqeda isihlava sokunganakwa, ukuhlukunyezwa, udlame kanye nokuxhashazwa kwezingane.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa batjha bohle ho fihlella mananeo a fapafapaneng a tshehetso le thuto ao mmuso o a hlahisitseng bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa menyetla le ho ntshetsapele bonkakarolo ba bona moruong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza yonke imikhakha yomphakathi ukuba isebenzisane ukwakha imiphakathi ephephile futhi engumqemane ukuze zikhule kahle izingane zethu.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho bahiri ho nka karolo kgoeletsong ya tloho le ngwana wa ngwanana mosebetsing ka la 25 le la 26 Motsheanong.
tgt: Ngenhloso yokugubha iminyaka eyikhulu kwazalwa u-OR Tambo, iNingizimu Afrika izoqopha iNyanga Yentsha ngoNhlangulana wezi-2017 ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Lona Ngunyaka ka-OR Tambo: Siqhubekisela Phambili Ukubandakanywa Kwentsha Kwezomnotho.”Ngokuqhubeka kwenyanga kaNhlangulana uhulumeni uzosingatha imicimbi ehlukahlukene kubandakanya imibukiso eyenzelwe intsha, izinkulumo-mpikiswano kanye nezizinda zamabhizinisi entsha ngenhloso yokubonisa amathuba akhona enzelwe abantu abasha kanye nokubafaka ugqozi lokuba bamukele futhi bagxile kumagugu-mgomo ka-OR Tambo obuholi nemfundo.

src: Sepheo ke ho hlahisetsa banana ba etsang Kereiti 10 ho ya ho 12 makala a fapaneng a thuto.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabakhuthaza bonke abantu abasha ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi bayafinyelela ezinhlelweni zosizo nezemfundo ezahlukahlukene ezihlinzekwa nguhulumeni ukuze baphucule futhi baqhubekisele phambili amathuba abo okubamba iqhaza emnothweni.

src: Moporesidente Zuma ka Labone, la 25 Motsheanong 2017, o tla tshwara mokete wa naha wa selemo sa 2017 wa Letsatsi la Aforika Ntlong ya Baeti ba Boporesidente ya Sefako Makgatho Pretoria.
tgt: NgoLwesine mhla zingama-25 kuNhlaba 2017 uMongameli Zuma uzosingatha umgubho kazwelonke woSuku lwe-Afrika wezi-2017 endlini yezivakashi zikaMongameli i-Sefako Makgatho Presidential Guesthouse ePitoli.

src: Sena ke phethelo ya diketsahalo le mananeo a tshwayang Kgwedi ya Aforika tlasa mookotaba: “Selemo sa OR Tambo: Re aha Aforika e Betere le Lefatshe le Betere”.
tgt: Lo mgubho wuvuthondaba lwemicimbi nezinhlelo okuqoshwe ngazo iNyanga ye-Afrika ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Lona Ngunyaka ka-OR Tambo: Sakha i-Afrika Engcono Kanye Nomhlaba Ongcono”.

src: Sehopotso sa selemo ka seng sa Letsatsi la Aforika se tshwaya ho thehwa ha Mokgatlo wa Kopano ya Aforika (OAU) ka selemo sa 1963.Ha re phethela Kgwedi ya Aforika, Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela le maAforika a bo rona a dulang ka hara Aforika Borwa le dibakeng tse ding ka hara kontinente ho netefatsa tswelopele ya lebatowa la rona le Aforika ka bophara.
tgt: Umgubho waminyaka yonke woSuku lwe-Afrika uqopha ukusungulwa kweNhlangano Yobumbano Lwamazwe ase-Afrika (i-OAU) ngowe-1963.Njengoba sesiphothula iNyanga ye-Afrika, iKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba babambisane nabantu abavela kwamanye amazwe ase-Afrika abahlala eNingizimu Afrika kanye nalabo abahlala kwezinye izingxenye zaleli zwekazi ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuchuma nokuphumelela kwesifunda sethu kanye ne-Afrika yonkana.

src: Ho mahetleng a bohle ba dulang ka hara meedi ya rona, maAforika Borwa le melata ka ho tshwana ho imatahanya le melao ya naha.
tgt: Futhi kungumthwalo osemahlombe abo bonke abantu abahlala kuleli, okungabantu baseNingizimu Afrika kanjalo nabantu abavela emazweni angaphandle, ukuba bathobele imithetho yezwe.

src: Mmoho re lokela ho lwantsha koduwa ya kgwebisano ka batho, dikwetelo, le tlhekefetso ya basadi le bana.
tgt: Ngokubambisana kumele sonke silwisane nesihlava sokushushumbiswa nokuthunjwa nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane.

src: Melaetsa ya thoholetso.
tgt: Imiyalezo yakuhalalisa.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa moifo wa bongaka wa Yunivesithi ya Stellenbosch le Sepetlele sa Dithuto sa Tygerberg o bopilweng ka Moporofesara Andre van der Merwe, Ngaka Alexander Zuhlke, Moporofesara Rafique Moosa, Ngaka Amir Zarrabi le Ngaka Zamira Keyser.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela ithimba lezokwelapha leNyuvesi yase-Stellenbosch kanye nesibhedlela sase-Tygerberg elihlanganisa uSlz Andre van der Merwe, uDkt Alexander Zuhlke, uSlz Rafique Moosa, uDkt Amir Zarrabi kanye noDkt Zamira Keyser.

src: Haufinyana tjena ba entse oporeishene ya bobedi ya ho kenya setho sa botona, hore e be setsi sa pele sa bongaka sa ho etsa mosebetsi ona habedi.
tgt: Esikhathini esifushane esedlule leli thimba lenze ukuhlinzwa okungokwesibili kuleli kokufakela owesilisa isitho sangasese, futhi ngalokho liqophe umlando ngokuba yisikhungo sezokwelapha sokuqala emhlabeni jikelele esenze ukuhlinzwa kwesibili okunjengalokhu.

src: Katleho ya ketsahalo ena matsohong a moifo wa oporeishene ena ke bopaki ba boitsebelo ba boemo bo hodimo le botsebi bo teng ka hara lekala la kalafo ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Impumelelo yalokhu kuhlinzwa kwesiguli ezandleni zethimba lakuleli lokufakela izitho zomzimba iwubufakazi bekhono nobuchwepheshe obusezingeni eliphezulu obukhona eNingizimu Afrika emkhakheni wezokwelapha kahulumeni.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse Phaka ya Mokgwabo ya iSimangaliso bakeng sa ho amohela Kgau ya Boqhetseke ba Tlhatlhobo ho tswa ho Setheo sa Bahlanka ba Tshebediso ya Ditjhelete sa Aforika Borwa (SAICA) ka Dikgau tsa Boqhetseke ho Lekala la Mmuso pejana kgweding ena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela iSimangaliso Wetland Park ngokuklonyeliswa kwayo ngeNdodo Yombiko Wocwaningo-mabhuku Omuhle Kakhulu emcimbini we-South African Institute of Chartered Accountants (i-SAICA) wokuKlonyeliswa Ngezindondo Kwezikhungo Ezivelele Emkhakheni Kahulumeni obanjwe ngasekuqaleni kwale nyanga.

src: Kgau ena ke kananelo ya Phaka ya ho fumana bohlahlobi ba ditjhelete bo hlokang sekodi bakeng sa dilemo tse hlano ka tatelano.
tgt: Le ndondo iwumklomelo wokuhalalisela lesi siKhungo ngokuthola kwaso imibiko yocwaningo-mabhuku engenasici iminyaka emihlanu ilandelana.

src: iSimangaliso e ile ya tsebahatswa e le Setsha sa pele sa Lefatshe sa Botjhaba ka Tshitwe 1999.
tgt: NgoZibandlela we-1999, iSimangaliso Wetland Park samenyezelwa njengeSizinda Esiyigugu Emhlabeni sokuqala saseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa lenaneo la Working on Fire mabapi le ho amohela polaka ho tswa ho Mmuso wa Alberta Canada e le sehopotso sa thuso e fannweng ke lenaneo lena mabapi le ho laola mello ya hlaha ka hara Porofense ya bona ka selemo sa 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela uhlelo lokulwisana nomlilo i-Working on Fire ngokuzitholela kwalo indondo yokubonga evela kuhulumeni wesifundazwe sase-Alberta e-Canada ewuphawu lokubonga usizo olwahlinzekwa yilolu hlelo ekulawuleni imililo yequbula esiFundazweni sase-Alberta ngowezi-2016.

src: Working on Fire ke Lenaneo la Katoloso ya Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba (EPWP) le reretsweng bakeng sa ho fana ka menyetla ya mosebetsi ho banna le basadi ba batjha.
tgt: I-Working on Fire iwuhlelo olungaphansi koHlelo Olunwetshiwe Lwemisebenzi Yomphakathi (i-EPWP) okuhloswe ngalo ukuhlinzeka ngamathuba etoho kubantu abasha besilisa nabesifazane.

src: Melaetsa ya matshediso.
tgt: Amazwi enduduzo.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, la 7 Phuptjane 2017, Tuynhuys, Motse Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yabamba umhlangano wayo ngoLwesithathu, mhla ziyi-7 kuNhlangulana 2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: DINTLHA TSA HAJWALE Kabinete e boeletsa kgoeletso ya Moporesidente Jacob Zuma bakeng sa hore maAforika Borwa a ipope kgahlanong le dikgoka le tlhekefetso ya basadi le bana, le ho ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho nka mehato e potlakileng ho fedisa koduwa ena ka hara metse ya bo rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igcizelela ikhwela elihlatshwe nguMongameli uJacob Zuma lokuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika babumbane baphikisane nodlame kanye nokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besifazane kanye nezingane, futhi inxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba bathathe izinyathelo eziphuthumayo ukuze kuqedwe lesi sihlava emiphakathini yethu.

src: Sena se latela leeto la Moporesidente Elsies River ho la Motse Kapa mabapi le ho tshehetsa Imbizo ya Ntwa e kgahlanong le Botlokotsebe.
tgt: Lokhu kulandela ukuhambela kukaMongameli e-Elsies River eKapa ngokweseka Imbizo Yokulwisana Nobugebengu.

src: Leeto lena hape le hlakisitse ho ba kotsing ha basadi le bana ka hara setjhaba sa rona.
tgt: Lokhu kuhambela kuphinde futhi kwaqhakambisa ubuthakathaka babantu besifazane kanye nezingane ezweni lakithi.

src: Moporesidente o ikemiseditse ho kgutlela sebakeng seo ho ya fatisisa diphephetso tse ngata tsa botlokotsebe le dipolao, ka ho qolleha tsa bana le kamoo balaodi ba qobello ya molao ba ka ntlafatsang ditshebeletso tsa bona ho badudi.2 Kabinete e amohela ho lokollwa ha Diphuputso tse Akaretsang tsa Malapa tsa selemo sa 2016, tse tswellang ho bontsha kgatelopele mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mananeo a mmuso a ho ntlafatsa maphelo a maAforika Borwa, haholoholo badudi ba neng ba tingwe menyetla pele.
tgt: UMongameli uthembise ukuthi uzophinda abuyele kule ndawo ukuzobheka kabanzi izingqinamba eziningi zobugebengu kanye nokubulawa kwabantu, ikakhulukazi izingane kanye nokuthi iziphathimandla zengalo yomthetho zizoziphucula kanjani izinsizakalo zazo ezizenza emphakathini.

src: Dipalopalo di bontsha hore mmuso e etsa menyabuketso mabapi le ho fana ka bodulo, moo malapa a maAforika Borwa a dulang ka hara matlo a ‘RDP’ kapa matlo a tsheheditsweng ke mmuso a phahameng ho tloha ho 5% ka selemo sa 2002 ho ya ho 13,5% ka selemo sa 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukukhishwa koCwaningo Lwamakhaya Olujwayelekile lowezi-2016, oluqhubekayo nokukhombisa inqubekelaphambili ekuqalisweni ukusebenza kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni ukwenza ngcono izimpilo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi imiphakathi eyayikhishwe inyumbazana phambilini.

src: Diphuphutso tsena hape di bontsha hore mananeo a mmuso a thuso ya kahisano a supa keketseho ho tloha ho 12,7% ka selemo sa 2003 ho ya ho 29,7% ka selemo sa 2016.Hape ho na le keketseho e bonahalang ho phumantsho ya metsi, motlakase le tsamaiso ya dikgwerekgwere, e leng letshwao la bohlokwa bakeng sa maikemisetso a Mmuso wa Aforika Borwa wa ho lokisa dimpe tsa mmuso wa kgethollo le ho fana ka ditshebeletso tsa mantlha ho batho kaofela.
tgt: Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi uhulumeni unamagalelo amahle ekuhlinzekeni ngezindlu, nalapho amakhaya abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abahlala ezindlini ezazakhiwe ngoHlelo Lwentuthuko Nokwakha Kabusha (i-RDP) noma ezindaweni zokuhlala ezixhaswe nguhulumeni ekhuphukile kusuka ku-5% ngowezi-2002 kuya ku-13,5% ngowezi-2016.Ucwaningo luphinde lukhombise ukuthi izinhlelo zikahulumeni zosizo lwezenhlalakahle zikhombisa ukukhuphuka kusuka ku-12,7% ngowezi-2003 kuya ku-29,7% ngowezi-2016.Kunokukhuphuka okuphawulekayo esibalweni samakhaya afakelwe amanzi, axhunyelwa ugesi nathola izinsizakalo zokuthuthwa kwemfucuza, nokuwuphawu olusemqoka logqozi nofuqufuqu lukaHulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika lokulungisa izinto ezimbi zobandlululo bese ehlinzeka ngezidingo-ngqangi kubo bonke abantu.

src: Kabinete, leha ho le jwalo, e lemohile hore ha boingodiso thutong e phahameng bo ntse bo eketseha, leha e le ka monyebe, ebile feela 3,3% ya maAforika Borwa a ba Batsho a dilemong tse 18 ho ya ho tse 29 a neng a ithuta papisong le 18,8% ya baithuti ba maIndia/maAsia le 17,5% ya makgowa sehlopheng sa ba dilemong tsena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi, nakuba kunjalo, ikuqaphelile ukuthi yize isibalo sabantu ababhalisela imfundo ephakeme sikhuphukile, nakuba sikhuphuka ngonyawo lonwabu, abantu abamnyama abangu-3,3% kuphela abaneminyaka ephakathi kweyi-18 kuya kuma-29 ubudala abafundayo uma kuqhathaniswa no-18,8% wabantu abangamaNdiya/abase-Asia kanye no-17,5% wabantu abamhlophe abakuleli qoqo leminyaka.

src: Ke feela 3,5% ya ba Mmala ba neng ba ithuta nakong ya selemo sa 2016.Diphuputso ho ya pele di supile phokotseho ho tloha ho 23,8% ho ya ho 11,8% ya malapa a neng a phela ka tlala, e leng se bontshang kgatelopele mabapi le ho shebana le malapa a phelang bofutsaneng bo feteletseng.3 Kabinete e lemohile Diphuputso tsa Kotara ka Nngwe tsa Lebotho la Basebetsi bakeng sa kotara ya pele ya selemo tse bontshitseng hore moruo o ekeditse mesebetsi ka mesebetsi e 144 000.
tgt: Ngu-3,5% kuphela wabantu abangamakhaladi obufunda ngonyaka wezi-2016.Ucwaningo luphinde lwakhombisa ukwehla kusuka ku-23,8% kuya ku-11,8% wamakhaya abhekene nendlala, okukhombisa inqubekelaphambili ekubhekaneni nemiphakathi ephila nobubha obuseqophelweni eliphezulu.

src: Dipalo tsena di thuntheditswe ke keketseho ya batho ba neng ba batla mosebetsi ba 433 000.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iluqaphelile Ucwaningo Lwamakota Lwezabasebenzi lekota yokuqala yonyaka olukhombise umnotho wengeza imisebenzi eyizi-144 000.

src: Kabinete e thathiselleditse boitlamo ba yona ba ho tswela pele ho theha selekane le lefapha la poraefete le basebetsi maitekong a yona a ho sebetsana le diphephetso tsa naha tsa tlhokeho ya mesebetsi.4 Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha Phaka ya Diindaseteri ya Babelegi e ntjhafaditsweng ho la Hammanskraal jwaloka karolo ya meralo ya mmuso ya ho akofisa ntshetsopele ya moruo le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi sebakeng seo.
tgt: Lezi zibalo zicekelwe phansi ukukhuphuka esibalweni sabantu abafuna umsebenzi ngabantu abayizi-433 000.IKhabhinethi iyasiqinisekisa isibophezelo sayo sokuqhubeka nokusebenzisana nomkhakha ozimele kanye nabasebenzi emizamweni yayo yokubhekana nezinselele zokungabibikho komsebenzi ezweni.

src: Porojeke ena ya R42-milione ke karolo ya mmuso ya Lenaneo la Tsoseletso ya Diphaka Tsa Diindaseteri le e nngwe ya diphaka tse tsheletseng tse ntseng di tsoseletswa ho phatlalla le naha bakeng sa ntshetsopele e pharaletseng ya moruo le diindaseteri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukwethulwa kweBabelegi Industrial Park eHammanskraal njengengxenye yamacebo kahulumeni okudlondlobalisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho kanye nokusungulwa kwemisebenzi kule ndawo.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa diindaseteri le dikgwebo tsa lehae ho sekaseka ho atolosetsa ditshebetso tsa bona ho ya sebakeng sena sa diindaseteri bakeng sa ho fumantshwa mekgwa e fapafapaneng ya tshehetso e teng bakeng sa ho hodisa dikgwebo tsa bona ho ya pele.5 Kabinete e tsebisitswe ke Letona la Ditjhelete, Monghadi Malusi Gigaba, mabapi le dipalo tsa moraorao tsa Palohohle ya Dihlahiswa tsa Aforika Borwa (GDP), e honyetseng ka 0,7% kotareng ya pele ya selemo sa 2017.
tgt: Lo mklamo obize izigidi ezingama-42 zamarandi uyingxenye yoHlelo lukahulumeni Lokuvuselela Izizinda Zezimboni kanti futhi ungenye yezizinda eziyisithupha ezivuseleliwe ezweni lonkana ukuze kuthuthukiswe kabanzi umnotho kanye nezimboni.

src: Sephetho sena sa GDP se mpefetseng ho feta kamoo ho neng ho lebeletswe se tlase haholo ho feta Tjhebobotjha ya Ditekanyetso tsa selemo sa 2017, e neng e lepile kgolo ya GDP ya selemo sa 2017 ho ba 1,3%.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igqugquzela izimboni zalapha ngaphakathi ezweni kanye nabamabhizinisi ukuba bacabangele ukuvula amagatsha amabhizinisi wabo ezizindeni zezimboni ukuze bathole izindlela zokwesekwa ezinhlobonhlobo ezitholakalayo ukuze bathuthukise amabhizinisi abo ngokuthe xaxa.

src: Sena se bakuwe ke, hara tse ding, ho honyela ha tlhahiso, kgwebisano, diindaseteri tsa phano ya dijo le bodulo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilunywe indlebe nguNgqongqoshe Wezezimali, uMnu Malusi Gigaba, maqondana nezibalo zakamuva Zesamba Somkhiqizo Wezwe(i-GDP) waseNingizimu Afrika, ezinciphe ngo-0,7% ekoteni yokuqala yowezi-2017.Lo mphumela we-GDP omubi kunalokho obekulindelwe ungaphansi kakhulu kuneSibuyekezo Sesabelomali sowezi-2017, esaqagula ukukhula kwe-GDP yowezi-2017 sakubeka ku-1,3%.

src: Leha ho le jwalo moruo o ile wa tshehetswa ke kgolo merafong le diindasetering tsa dikwari e eketsehileng ka 12.8%.
tgt: Lokhu kubangelwe, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ukukhwantabala kwezimboni zemikhiqizo, ukuhweba, ukupheka kanye nezindawo zokulala.

src: Diindaseteri tsa temo, meru le ditlhapi di ile tsa hlasimoloha kotareng ya pele ya selemo sa 2017 ka keketseho ya 22,2%.Ho na le matshwao a tshepisang a hore naha e ka itseka bakeng sa ho matlafatsa tjhebahalo ya yona ya kgolo ya moruo.
tgt: Umnotho nakuba kunjalo wesekwe ukukhula embonini yezimayini kanye neyokuqwalwa kwamatshe ekhuphuke ngo-12.8%.

src: Tsena di kenyeletsa kgolo ya ho kenella lefatsheng, ho tsitsisa ditheko tsa phahlo, maemo a matle a tlelaemete, phepelo e tshepahalang ya motlakase le dikamano tse batlang di tsitsitse tsa basebetsi.
tgt: Imboni yezolimo, ezamahlathi kanye nezezinhlanzi isimamile ekoteni lokuqala lowezi-2017 ngokukhuphuka ngo-22,2%.Kunenhlansi yethemba elokozayo izwe elingabambelela kuyona ukuze lisimamise ukububeka kokukhula komnotho walo.

src: Jwaloka taba e potlakileng, Kabinete e ipiletsa ho dikgwebo, basebetsi le setjhaba ka kakaretso ho theha selekane le mmuso bakeng sa ho matlafatsa lenaneo la rona la kgolo le ho ntlafatsa tshepahalo bakeng sa ho kgina ho fokola le ho beha moruo maemong a batlang a phahame, ho fihlella kgolo ya moruo e kenyeletsang.
tgt: Lokhu kubandakanya ukwenza ngcono ukukhula emhlabeni wonke, ukuzinzisa amanani ezimbiwa, izimo zesimo sezulu ezivunayo, ukuphakelwa kukagesi okwethembekile kanye nokwehla kobudlelwano nabasebenzi obuntekenteke.

src: Ntlheng ena Letona la Ditjhelete le tla kopana le baetapele ba dikgwebo ka morero wa ho bopa mawa a ho lwantsha ho putlama ha moruo le ho fihlella kgolo e kenyeletsang.
tgt: Njengesimo esiphuthumayo kakhulu, iKhabhinethi inxusa abamabhizinisi, abasebenzi kanye nomphakathi ngobubanzi ukuba babambisane nohulumeni ukuze kuqiniswe uhlelo lwethu lokukhula komnotho futhi kwenziwe ngcono nokuzethemba ukuze kunqandwe ukwehla komnotho futhi kubekwe umnotho esikhundleni esiphezulu, ukuze kufezekiswe ukukhula komnotho okuhlanganisa zonke izinto.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana kopano ya boraditaba le Letona la Ditjhelete bakeng sa ho arolelana le maAforika Borwa maitshunyako ao mmuso o tla a etsang ka hara meralo ya ditekanyetso tsa hajwale.
tgt: Maqondana nalokhu uNgqongqoshe Wezezimali uzohlangana nabaholi bamabhizinisi embhidlangweni wokusungula amaqhinga azophikisana nokuzika komnotho bese efezekisa ukukhula komnotho okuhlanganisa zonke izinto.

src: Kabinete hape e thathiselletsa moralo o amohetsweng wa ditekanyetso bakeng sa naha.6 Lekala la tekolo la Fitch le la Standard & Poor’s a thathiselleditse ditekolo tsa Aforika Borwa tsa mekitlane ya ditjhelete tsa maatjhabeng tsa nako e telele tsa ‘BB+’.Sena se tla hara nako eo dipuisano tsa Letona Gigaba le lekala la poraefete bakeng sa ho netefatsa hore mosebetsi o kopanetsweng wa mmuso, dikgwebo, basebetsi le setjhaba ka kakaretso di ntseng di tswela pele, le hore maitlamo a entsweng a ya phethahatswa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze isithangami sabezindaba esigcwele esizobanjwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezezimali ukuze abelane nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngezinyathelo zokungenelela uhulumeni azozithatha kulolu hlaka lokusebenza lesabelomali samanje.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa hore maAforika Borwa a lokela ho tswela pele ho sebetsa e le ntho e le nngwe, haholoholo dinakong tse thata le ho sebetsa ka thata ho feta ho netefatsa hore naha e tseke maemo a yona a tekolo ya matsete.7 Kabinete e ananela ditherisano tse thakgolwang kgetlo la pele tsa Komiti e Kopanetsweng ya Tsamaiso bakeng sa Mmaraka o Tshwanang wa Borwa (MERCOSUR) le Mokgatlo wa Lekgetho la Madiboho a Dinaha tsa Aforika e Borwa (SACU (SACU) tse neng di tshwerwe haufinyana tjena ka hara naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yaqinisekisa uhlaka lokusebenza lwesabelomali sezwe olwamukeliwe.

src: Mekga e dumellane hore ka kopanelo e tla sekaseka menyetla ya ho hodisa Tumellano e ka Sehloohong ya Kgwebisano (PTA) ya MERCOSUR-SACU ka ho kenyeletsa makala a yona a kgodiso ya kgwebisano, mekgatlo ya kgwebo, lekala la poraefete, le matlo a bona a bonqosa le dikantoro tsa matjhabeng ka ho latelana.
tgt: Izikhungo zokuklelisa iFitch kanye ne-Standard & Poor’s zikuqinisekisile ukukleliswa kwezikweletu kweNingizimu Afrika ngemali yakwamanye amazwe kwesikhathi eside ngo-‘BB+’.Lokhu kuqhamuka phakathi nezingxoxo uNgqongqoshe uGigaba azibambe nomkhakha ozimele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi owenziwa ngokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, abamabhizinisi, abasebenzi kanye nezinhlangano zomphakathi uyaqhubeka, kanye nokuthi izethembiso ezenziwe ziyafezwa.

src: PTA ya MERCOSUR-SACU e neha ba romellang thepa ya lehae ka ntle monyetla wa ho kenella mmarakeng wa batho ba fetang 280-milione.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakugcizelela ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kufanele baqhubeke nokukhuluma ngezwi elilodwa, ikakhulukazi ngezikhathi ezinzima futhi basebenza kanzima impela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izwe libuyelwa yizinga lalo lesimo sotshalomali.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho ba romellang thepa ka ntle ho nka monyetla ona wa PTA kaha jwale dihlahiswa tsa mona hae di kgona ho kena lepatlelong la MERCOSUR ka dikgahla tse kgothaletswang tsa lekgetho.8 Kabinete e hlahisitse tshwabo ya yona ka qeto ya Amerika (USA) ya ho ikgula Tumellanong ya Paris.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamukela izingxoxo ezenziwe eKomidini lokuqala ngqa Lokuphathwa Ngokubambisana leNhlangano Elawula Izindaba Zentela Nohwebo Yamazwe AseMelika Eseningizimu (i-MERCOSUR) kanye neNhlangano Elawula Izindaba Zentela Yempahla Okuhwebelwana Ngayo Emazweni aseNingizimu ne-Afrika (i-SACU) ebezibanjwe kamuva nje kuleli.

src: Aforika Borwa e ipileditse ho USA ho sekaseka botjha boemo ba yona le ho itlama botjha tsamaisong e kopanetsweng ke dinaha ka bongata.9 Memorandamo wa Kutlwano (MoU) pakeng tsa Novartis, Lekgotla la Aforika Borwa la Diphuputso tsa Bongaka le Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji, o betla tsela ya ho matlafatsa mothamo le boleng ba diteko tsa bongaka le ho aha bokgoni ba diphuputso ka hara kontinente.
tgt: Izinhlangano zivumile ukucabanga ngokubambisana ngamathuba okukhuthaza Isivumelwano Sohwebo Olukhethayo (i-PTA) se-MERCOSUR ne-SACU ngokubandakanya izikhungo zazo zokukhuthaza ezohwebo, izigcawu zohwebo, umkhakha ozimele, kanye nezindlu zazo zamanxusa ngokwehlukana.

src: Tumellano e tla thusa bakeng sa mananeo a kopanetsweng a diphuputso mahlokong a kgethilweng a tshwaetsanang le a sa tshwaetsaneng, ho ntlafatsa phumantsho ya bakudi ba Aforika Borwa ya meriana e ntjhafatsang, le ho aha bokgoni ba naha le ba kontinente ba diphuputso le ntshetsopele.
tgt: Isivumelwano se-MERCOSUR kanye ne-SACU sihlinzeka abahwebi balapha ekhaya abahwebela kwamanye amazwe ngethuba lokuhweba namazwe anabantu abangaphezu kwezigidi ezingama-280.IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abahwebi bakuleli abahwebela kwamanye amazwe ukuba benze i-PTA ibasebenzele njengoba imikhiqizo yalapha ekhaya isikwazi ukudayiswa emazweni angamalunga e-MERCOSUR futhi bakhokhe intela yokuhwebelana enesephulelo.

src: Aforika Borwa e dula e le se seng sa dibaka tse tummeng ka ho fetisisa sa bohahlaudi lefatsheng le ho tswela pele ho nka maemo a hodimo hape ho lenaneo la bophehisane la Foramo ya Moruo wa Lefatshe la ho eta le bohahlaudi lefatsheng jwaloka ha le lokolotswe ka Mmesa 2017.Kabinete e rata ho bona bongata ba ditoropo le metsemeholo e menyenyane ya Aforika Borwa e iketa bakeng sa dikopano tse nyenyane moo di ka kgonang ho imatahanya le ditlhokeho tsa ho tshwara dikopano.
tgt: Isivumelwano saseParis, esizosebenza ngokugcwele ngowezi-2020, sakhelwe phezu kwezinkokhelo ezinqunywe yiwona amazwe uqobo maqondana nezinjongo zamazwe omhlaba okuvunyelwene ngazo ndawonye.

src: Sena se tla thusa ho ntlafatsa qaqolohano ho ya ka sebopeho sa naha bakeng sa bohahlaudi ka nqane ho ditsi tse kgolo le ho ala moruo o fehlilweng ke diketsahalo tsena ka tsela e batlang e lekalekana.11 Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela hore a fadimehele ditaba tsa leshano, ka ho qolleha keketseho ya ho maneha ditaba tse fosahetseng ho marangrang a ditaba a kahisano mabapi le banana le basadi ba lahlehileng, ba kwetetsweng le ba hapilweng ka mahahapa.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika isinxuse i-USA ukuba isicabangisise kabusha isinqumo sayo iphinde izibophezele kabusha kulesi sivumelwano samazwe omhlaba.

src: Ho ropoha ha haufinyana tjena ha merusu KwaMashu, pela Durban ka lebaka la ditlaleho tse fosahetseng tsa hore bana ba nkuwa ka mahahapa sebakeng seo le ho belaellwa ha ho hapuwa ka mahahapa ha ngwanana Naledi, ho la Soweto ke batho ba tsamayang ka Toyota Quantum ho kenyeleditswe le nomoro ya yona ya boingodiso e ileng ya phatlalla ho marangrang a ditaba a kahisano, moo ho tholahetseng hamorao hore ha se nnete.
tgt: Isivumelwano Sokusebenzisana phakathi kwe-Novartis, Umkhandlu Wezocwaningo Lwezokwelapha waseNingizimu Afrika kanye noMnyango Wezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe, sichaba indlela yokusimamisa umthamo kanye nekhwalithi yezivivinyo zokwelapha futhi sakha amandla okwenziwa kocwaningo ezwenikazi.

src: Meritaoke ena, ditaba tsa leshano le ho tsamaisa tlhahisoleseding e fosahetseng ho baka pherekano ka hara metse ya bo rona le ho senya nako le mehlodi ya sepolesa.
tgt: Isivumelwano sizovumela ukwenzeka kwezinhlelo zocwaningo ngokubambisana ezifweni eziqokiwe ezithathelwanayo kanye nezingathathelwana, ukwenza ngcono ukufinyelela kweziguli zaseNingizimu Afrika emithini eqanjwe kabusha, kanye nokwakha amandla ezwe kanye nezwekazi okwenza ucwaningo kanye nokuthuthukisa.

src: Re ipiletsa ho batho hore ba seke ba pheta ho maneha le ho tsamaisa ditaba tsa leshano ho marangrang a ditaba a kahisano, ho fihlela ba tiisitse bonnete ba tsona.12 Kabinete e lemohile ka ngongoreho e kgolo ditlaleho tsa ditaba ka ‘diimeile tse nyenyelepisitsweng tse hlokang nnete’ tseo ho hopolwang hore di beha Matona, bahlanka ba mmuso le batho ba poraefete ka mosing ba belaellwa hore ba entse tse sa lokang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakholwa ukuthi isekhona indawo yokusebenza ngokubambisana okuthe xaxa phakathi kukahulumeni kanye nomkhakha ozimele, futhi iyafunga iyagomela ukuthi lokhu kungachaba indlela ebheke ekubhekaneni nezinselele eziningi eziyinkinga esibhekene nazo.

src: Kabinete e dula e itlamme bakeng sa puso e hlwahlwa le ka nako e le nngwe, hape e ananela hore batho kaofela ba nkuwa ba hloka molato ho fihlela ba bonwe molato ho ya ka dipehelo tsa Molaotheo wa rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawamukela Umbiko wezi-2017 ovela Enhlanganweni Yenkongolo kanye Nemibuthano Yomhlaba, oqhubekayo nokuklelisa iNingizimu Afrika njengendawo eseqhulwini yokubamba imicimbi yamabhizinisi e-Afrika kanye naseMiddle East.

src: Bohle ba anngweng ke diimeile tseo ba kgothaletswa ho sebetsa mmoho le makala a qobello ya molao.
tgt: Lokhu kuzosiza ukwenza ngcono ukusabalaliseka kwezokuvakasha ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene ezingale kwamadolobha amakhulu futhi kusabalalise nomnotho okhandwe yileyo micimbi ngokulinganayo.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o qheletse ka thoko tlaleho e phatlaladitsweng ke koranta ya Sontaha ya ho belaellwa hore o na le ntlo Dubai ho la United Arab Emirates.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba baqaphele izindaba mbumbulu, ikakhulukazi ukukhuphuka kwezindaba ezingelona iqiniso ezibhalwa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana mayelana nokulahleka, ukuthunjwa kanye nokuthwalwa ngenkani kwamantombazane kanye nabantu besifazane.

src: DIQETO TSA KABINETE Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka ditlaleho tsa bo-4 tsa kgatelopele ya tshebetso tsa kotara ka nngwe bakeng sa 2016/17 (Pherekgong-Hlakubele 2017) mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha diphetho tse ka sehlohlolong.
tgt: Ukubheduka kodlame kwakamuva KwaMashu, eduze kwase-Durban mayelana nemibiko yezingane ezithwalwe ngenkani endaweni kanye nezinsolo zokuthwalwa ngenkani kwentombazane eNaledi, eSoweto ngabantu abebehamba ngemoto eyi-Toyota Quantum nezinombolo zayo ezazifakiwe kuthe chithi saka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, nokuthe ekuhambeni kwesikhathi kwatholakala ukuthi bekungelona iqiniso.

src: Bodisa ba Kabinete hodima ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lewa la Meralo ya Nako e Bohareng (MTSF) la 2014 ho isa ho 2019, bo baka phano ya ditshebeletso e ntlafetseng.
tgt: Lobu buqola, izindaba mbumbulu kanye nokusatshalaliswa kolwazi olungelona iqiniso kudala itwetwe emiphakathini yethu futhi kuchitha isikhathi kanye nezinsizakusebenza zamaphoyisa.

src: Sena se re atametsa phihlellong ya Tjhebelopele ya 2030 ya Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP).Mmuso o entse kgatelopele e bonahalang mabapi le ho kenya tshebetsong diphetho tsa ona tse 14 tse ka sehlohlolong le ho kgannela pele merero ya NDDiphephetso tse amang ho kenngwa tshebetsong le mehato e batlehang bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa phano e ile ya hlwauwa.
tgt: Siyacela kubantu ukuba bangadlulisi futhi basabalalise izindaba mbumbulu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kuze kube sebekuqinisekisile ubuqiniso bazo.

src: Lenaneo le hlophisitsweng hantle le tla manehuwa ho WEBTOKEDIKETSAHALO TSE TLANG.1 Moporesidente Zuma o thakgotse Kgwedi ya Batjha tlasa mookotaba “Selemo sa OR Tambo: Re Ntshetsapele Matlafatso ya Batjha Moruong”, ka kopano ya Sehlopha sa Tshebetso sa Batjha sa Kantoro ya Moporesidente.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isiyiqaphelile ngokukhathazeka okukhulu imibiko yabezindaba maqondana ‘nokuputshuka kwama-imeyili’ okubikwa ukuthi achaya oNgqongqoshe, izikhulu kanye nabantu abazimele ezenzweni ezingalungile.

src: Sena se bokantse mmoho mmuso le baetapele ba mekgatlo ya batjha, ba lekotseng kgatelopele ntshetsopeleng ya moruo wa kahisano wa batjha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isazibophezele ngokugcwele ekuphatheni okuhle ngaso sonke isikhathi, iyakuqaphela futhi ukuthi bonke abantu bathathwa njengabamsulwa kuze kube batholwa benecala ngokoMthethosisekelo.

src: Matona le Batlatsi ba Matona ba tla kenella diketsahalong tse fapafapaneng tse reretsweng ho kgothaletsa ntshetsopele le matlafatso ya batjha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abanolwazi mayelana nezenzo ezingalungile ezenziwa yizikhulu zikahulumeni noma oNgqongqoshe ukuba bazise izikhungo zengalo yomthetho ukuze kuzokwenziwa uphenyo.

src: Pitso e tla thakgola Foramo ya Mebuso ya Lehae ya Ntshetsopele ya Batjha.
tgt: Bonke abathintekayo kula ma-imeyili bayanxuswa ukuba basebenzisane nezikhungo zengalo yomthetho.

src: Sena se tla kgontsha batjha ho sheba botjha kgatelopele ya mebuso ya lehae papisong le phihlello ya Leano la Naha la Batjha (NYP) la 2020.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uzichithile izinsolo ebezishicilelwe yiphephandaba langeSonto zokuthi uthenge indlu eDubai e-United Arab Emirates.

src: E tla boela e matlafatsa bolekane pakeng tsa mmuso, dikgwebo le setjhaba ka kakaretso mabapi le ho ntshetsapele baetapele ba batjha lepatlelong la lehae.3 Letona la Tshebeletso ya Mmuso le Tsamaiso, Mofumahadi Faith Muthambi, o tla etella pele kemedi ya Aforika Borwa e tla kenela Letsatsi la Tshebeletso ya Mmuso la Aforika Kigali, ho la Rwanda ho tloha ka la 21 ho isa ka la 23 Phuptjane 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ichazeliwe ngemibiko yenqubekelaphambili yomsebenzi owenziwe ngekota yesine yezi-2016/17 (ukusuka kuMasingana ukuya kuNdasa 2017) maqondana nokuqaliswa ukusebenza kwemiphumela eseqhulwini.

src: Mookotaba wa selemo sena ke: “Re Tebisa Tlwaelo e Tobaneng le Batho ya Phano ya Ditshebeletso: Re theha selekane le batjha bakeng sa Phethoho ya Aforika.” Mookotaba o fana ka menyetla ya ho lekola kamoo Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba e hlalosang le ho arabela ho tlwaelo e tobaneng le batho ya phano ya ditshebeletso e hlaloswang ke tsela eo dintho di etswang ka yona hajwale.
tgt: Ukwengamela kweKhabhinethi maqondana nokuqaliswa ukusebenza koHlaka Lokusebenza Kwesikhathi Esimaphakathi lowezi-2014 kuya kowezi-2019, kuholele ekuhanjisweni kwezidingo-ngqangi okwenziwe ngcono.

src: MELAETSA YA MATSHEDISO.1 Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona ho lelapa le metswalle ya mopalami ya hlokahetseng ha diterene tse pedi tsa Metrorail di ne di thulana pela seteishene sa Elandsfontein Ekurhuleni le ho lakaletsa ba lemetseng kotsing eo ho fola ka potlako.
tgt: Lokhu kusithatha kusisondeze eduzane nokufezekiswa koMbono wezi-2030 woHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP).Uhulumeni usenze inqubekelaphambili ebonakalayo ekuqaliseni ukusebenza kwemiphumela yakhe eyi-14 eseqhulwini kanye nokuthuthukisa izinjongo ze-NDIzinselele ezithikameza ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kanye nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukwenza ngcono ukuhanjiswa kwezidingqo-ngqangi nazo zahlonzwa.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa bakeng sa hore dipatlisiso tsa sesosa sa kotsi di akofiswe ho thibela ho hlaha hape ha dikotsi tse kang ena tse bolayang.2 Kabinete e ile ya ipapisa le badudi ba matjhaba ka ho tshwela ka mathe ka matla tlhaselo ya haufinyana tjena ya boferekanyi ho la United Kingdom (UK).
tgt: Uphiko Lukahulumeni Lwezokuxhumana Nokudluliswa Kolwazi (i-GCIS) ludidiyela izithangami zabezindaba zamaqoqo eminyango, ezihlelelwe ukubanjwa kusukela mhla ziyi-9 kuya mhla ziyi-18 Nhlangulana 2017.

src: Kabinete e fetiseditse matshediso a yona ho mmuso le batho ba UK, ka ho qolleha malapa le baratuwa ba ba hlokahetseng, le ho lakaletsa ba lemetseng ho fola ka potlako.3 Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona ho lelapa le metswalle ya Moporofesara Babatunde Osotimehin, ya hlokahetseng bekeng ena.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma wethule Inyanga Yentsha ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi “Unyaka ka-OR Tambo: Siqhubekisela Phambili Ukubandakanywa Kwentsha Kwezomnotho”, ngomhlangano weQembu likaMongameli Lezindaba Zentsha.

src: Moporofesara Osotimehin e ne e le Motsamaisi wa Phethahatso wa Letlole la Setjhaba la Matjhaba a Kopaneng.
tgt: Lokhu kuhlanganise ndawonye uhulumeni kanye nabaholi bezinhlangano zentsha, abayiqaphelile inqubekelaphambili esiyenziwe ekuthuthukisweni kwenhlalo-mnotho yabantu abasha.

src: O ne a le bohlokwa bakeng sa ho kgannela pele dintlha tsa motabo le boitekanelo ba tswadiso ka hara Aforika dilemong tsa moraorao tjena.
tgt: ONgqongqoshe kanye namaPhini oNgqongqoshe bazozibandakanya emisebenzini enhlobonhlobo ehlose ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwentsha kanye nokunikezwa kwayo amandla.

src: O lwanetse ka mafolofolo ditokelo tsa Basadi ba ratanang le basadi ba bang, Banna ba ratanang le banna ba bang, Ba bong bo habedi, Ba fetotseng bong, Ba ditlwaelo tse makatsang tsa bong le ba kopanelo ya bong.4 DIFEFO TSA KAPA LE MELLO YA KNYSNAKabinete e hlokometse ka difefo tse ammeng boholo ba dibaka tsa Kapa Bophirima le tshenyo e latetseng difefo tseo.
tgt: Lo nyaka uphawula ukugujwa kweminyaka engama-41 Wezibhelu zaseSoweto kanti umgubho wesikhumbuzo usebenza njengesikhumbuzo sokuthi abantu abasha kuleli zwe babesophondweni loMzabalazo wethu.

src: Kabinete e romela matshediso a yona ho malapa a ba lahlehetsweng ke maphelo le thepa nakong ya dikoduwa tsena palo ya moraorao e tlalehilweng ke ya mafu a batho ba robedi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igqugquzela bonke abantu abasha ukuba babambe iqhaza emicimbini yoSuku Lwentsha futhi basebenzise konke ukwesekwa kanye nezinsiza ezibekwe nguhulumeni ukwenza ngcono amathuba abo futhi bathuthukise ukuzibandakanya kwabo kwezomnotho.

src: Setsi sa Taolo ya Dikotsi tsa Dikoduwa sa Motse Kapa se kgothaletswa ho sebetsa ka matla mabapi le ho pholosa maphelo le thepa, ho kenyeletswa sebaka sa Knysna moo ho nang le mello e befileng.
tgt: Ingqungquthela yentsha yohulumeni basekhayaUNgqongqoshe Wokwengamela Ngokubambisana kanye Nezendabuko, uMnu Des van Rooyen, uzohlanganisa Ingqungquthela Yohulumeni Basekhaya kusukela mhla ziyi-19 kuya mhla zingama-22 Nhlangulana 2017, ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi “Abantu abasha bazibambela mathupha entuthukweni”.Ingqungquthela izokwethula Isigcawu Sokuthuthukiswa Kwentsha Sohulumeni Basekhaya.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa dimathi tsa rona le boradipapadi le bommadipapadi bakeng sa ho kgethwa mekgahlelong e robedi ya Dikgau tsa Selemo ka seng tsa Dipapadi tse Lebatowa tsa selemo sa 2017, tse neng di tshwerwe ke Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lokhu kuzovumela abantu abasha ukuba babuyekeze inqubekelaphambili yohulumeni basekhaya beyiqhathanisa nokufezekiswa kweNqubomgomo Kazwelonke Yentsha yezi-2020.

src: Lekgotla la Dipapadi la Kopano ya Aforika la Lebatowa la 5 ke le leng la mabatowa a mahlano a tshepetsweng boikarabelo ba ho ntshetsapele dipapadi tlasa Kopano ya Aforika.
tgt: Izophinda futhi iqinise amaxhama okubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, abamabhizinisi kanye nezinhlangano zomphakathi ekuthuthukiseni abaholi abasebasha kuhulumeni wasekhaya.

src: Ditho tsa lebatowa ke: Angola, Botswana, Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique, Namibia, Aforika Borwa, Swaziland, Zambia le Zimbabwe.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezemisebenzi Kahulumeni Nokuphathwa Kwayo, uNks Faith Muthambi, uzohola ithimba lezithunywa zaseNingizimu Afrika elizohambela umcimbi woSuku Lwemisebenzi Kahulumeni e-Afrika ozobanjelwa eKigali, eRwanda kusukela mhla zingama-21 kuya mhla zingama-23 Nhlangulana 2017.Indikimba yalo nyaka ithi: “Ukugxilisa Kuhlelo Lokuhanjiswa Kwezidingo-ngqangi Olugxile Kwizakhamuzi: Sibambisene Nentsha ukuze Kuguqulwe i-Afrika.” Le ndikimba inikezela ngamathuba okuhlolisisa maqondana nokuthi Uhulumeni uluchaza futhi asabele kanjani ohlelweni lokuhanjiswa kwezidingo-ngqangi olugxile kwizakhamuzi oluchazwa yindlela izinto ezenziwa ngayo njengamanje.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro,la 21 Phuptjane 2017, Tuynhuys, Motse Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yabamba umhlangano wayo ngoLwesithathu, mhla zingama-21 kuNhlangulana 2017, e-Tuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Dintlha tsa hajwale.
tgt: Izindaba ezisematheni.

src: Kabinete e tshohlile ditsebiso tsa haufinyana tjena tsa makala a maholo a tekolo ya maemo a moruo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ifakane imilomo mayelana nezimemezelo zakamuva zezikhungo ezintathu ezinkulu ezenza izilinganiso zeminotho yamazwe omhlaba.

src: Ka boraro ba ona a hlahisitse dintlha tse tshwanang tse kang diphethoho tse monyebe tsa matlafatso ya kgolo, tshebetso ya dikhamphani tsa mmuso(di-SOC) le dikotsi tsa sepolotiki, hara dintlha tse ding.
tgt: Zontathu lezi zikhungo zibalule izinkinga ezifanayo, njengesivinini esiphansi sokulethwa kwezinguquko ezizogqugquzela ukukhula komnotho, ukungasebenzi kahle kwamabhizinisi kahulumeni (ama-SOC) kanye nobungozi bezepolitiki, phakathi kwezinye izinkinga.

src: Kabinete e hlahisitse tshepo maitshunyakong a yona a hlohlomisitsweng hantle bakeng sa ho sebetsana le diphephetso tsa naha tsa moruo hammoho le mosebetsi oo ho kenweng ho ona wa ho matlafatsa tshebetso ya di-SOMmuso o ntse o le motjheng mabapi le ho baballa moralo wa ona wa maemo a ditjhelete tsa puso, ho netefatsa maano a tsitsitseng, le ho sebetsa bakeng sa ho netefatsa kgolo le diphethoho moruong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izwakalise ukuzethemba izinhlelo zayo zokungenelela ezisungulwe ngenhloso yokuxazulula izinselelo zomnotho ezibhekene naleli lizwe kanye nomsebenzi owenziwayo ukuqinisa indlela asebenza ngayo ama-SOC.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa hore motheo wa motjha o phahameng wa kgolo le ntshetsopele ya moruo wa kahisano o se o behilwe.
tgt: Uhulumeni usalokhu eqhubeke njalo ohlakeni lwakhe lokuphathwa kahle kwezimali, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi alukho ungabazane nokudideka mayelana nezinqubomgomo ezisetshenziswayo, nokusebenzela ukuqinisekisa ukukhula komnotho okubandakanya abantu bonke kanye noguquko lwezomnotho.

src: O tsepamisitse maikutlo hodima tshepo ya batsetedi le basebedisi ka ho akofisa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha diphethoho tsa sebopeho bakeng sa kgolo ya moruo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyagcizelela ukuthi kakade sesibekiwe isisekelo somgudu wokukhulisa umnotho ngezinga eliphezulu kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwenhlalo-mnotho.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o bitseditse ba Lekgotla la Boeletsi la Matlafatso ya Batho ba Batsho Moruong(BEE) boitjhorisong ka Labobedi, la 20 Phuptjane 2017, moo ho neng ho tsepamisitswe maikutlo hodima diphethoho tse matla tsa moruo.
tgt: Lokhu kugxile ekuphuculeni ukwethenjwa komnotho wakuleli ngabatshalizimali kanye nabathengi, ngokuthi kusheshiswe ukuqaliswa kwezinguquko kwindlela asebenza ngayo uhulumeni ukuze kukhuliswe umnotho wezwe.

src: Boitjhoriso bona, hara tse ding, bo ile ba shebana le diphephetso tse hlohlomisitsweng le tsa sebopeho tsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Molao o Pharaletseng wa Matlafatso ya Batho ba Batsho Moruong (BBBEE), wa selemo sa 2003 (Molao bo-53 wa selemo sa 2003) le dikgothaletso tse sisintsweng tsa ho fihlella merero ya mmuso mabapi le diphethoho tse matla tsa moru wa kahisano.
tgt: UMongameli Jacob Zuma ubize isigcawu sokucobelelana ngolwazi soMkhandlu Wokweluleka Ezindabeni Eziphathelene Nokufukulwa Nokuhlonyiswa Kwabantu Abamnyama Kwezomnotho (i-BEE) esibanjwe ngoLwesibili mhla zingama-20 kuNhlangulana 2017, ebesigxile oguqukweni lwenhlalo-mnotho olunohlonze.

src: Bolekane pakeng tsa mmuso, dikgwebo, basebetsi le setjhaba ka kakaretso bo hlokolosi bakeng sa ho matlafatsa maemo a tshepo, hore ha re sebetsa mmoho re kgone ho tseka botjha le ho baballa ditekolo tsa maemo a botsetedi.
tgt: Lesi sigcawu, sicubungule, phakathi kokunye, izinselelo ezikhona eziphathelene nesimo nokuhleleka kokuqaliswa kokusebenza koMthetho Wokufukulwa Nokuhlonyiswa Kwabantu Abamnyama Kwezomnotho, wezi-2003 (uMthetho wama-53 wezi-2003) kanye nezincomo ezihlongozwayo zokufezekisa izinjongo zikahulumeni mayelana noguquko lwenhlalo-mnotho olunohlonze.

src: Jwaloka ha Kgwedi ya Batjha e ya mafelong, Kabinete e leboha makala kaofela a nkileng karolo diketsahalong tsa ho phatlalla le naha.
tgt: Ubambiswano phakathi kukahulumeni, abamabhizinisi, abasebenzi kanye nezinhlangano zomphakathi wonkana lusemqoka kakhulu ekuthuthukisweni kwamazinga okwethenjwa komnotho wakuleli, ukuze ngokubambisana sikwazi ukubuyisela umnotho wezwe ezingeni lomnotho okulungele ukutshalwa kwezimali futhi siqhubeke nokuligcina lelo zinga lomnotho.

src: Bonkakarolo ba dikete tsa batjha diketsehalong tse fapafapaneng tsa Kgwedi ya Batjha tsa matlafatso tse neng di tshwerwe ke mafapha, dikaho tsa mmuso le lekala la poraefete ke bo kgothatsang.
tgt: Njengoba kungasensuku zatshwala iphele iNyanga Yentsha, iKhabhinethi idlulisa amazwi okubonga kuyo yonke imikhakha ebambe iqhaza emicimbini yokugubha le nyanga ezweni lonkana.

src: Selemo sena se tshwaya selemosabo-41 sa Meruso ya Baithuti ya Soweto ya selemo sa1976 mme sehopotso se sebetsa jwalo ka kgopotso ya hore batjha ba ka hara naha ba ne ba le ka pele Ntweng ya rona.
tgt: Kuyinto ethokozisayo futhi ekhuthazayo impela ukuzibandakanya kwezinkulungwane ngezinkulungwane zabantu abasha ezinhlelweni ezahlukahlukene zokufukulwa nokuhlonyiswa kwentsha ebezisingathwe yiminyango nezikhungo zikahulumeni kanye nabomkhakha ozimele.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho batjha ho sebedisa tshehetso yohle le mehlodi eo mmuso e di hlahisitseng bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa maemo a bona le ho ntshetsapele bonkakarolo ba bona moruong.
tgt: Lo nyaka uqopha ukuhlangana kweminyaka engama-41 yomBhikisho Wabafundi baseSoweto we-1976 futhi ukugujwa kwalo mbhikisho kuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi abantu abasha bakuleli babehamba phambili eMzabalazweni wethu.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe merusu le ditshoso tsa bapalami tsa haufinyana tjena nakong ya boipelaetso ba beng ba ditekesi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa abantu abasha ukuba balusebenzise ngokugcwele lonke usizo nezinsiza ezihlinzekwa nguhulumeni entsheni ukuze benze ngcono amathuba abo okubamba iqhaza kanye nokudlala indima ebonakalayo emnothweni wezwe.

src: Ditumellano tse latetseng seo pakeng tsa Mokgatlo wa Ditekesi wa Aforika Borwa le Lekala la Dithuso tsa Ditjhelete tsa Ditekesi la Aforika Borwa ke tiisetso e nngwe ya hore dipuisano tsa kgotso di ka rarolla dintlha tse jwalo ntle le ho hahlamela batho ba hlokang molato le ho sitisa moruo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazigxeka izenzo zodlame nokwesatshiswa kwabagibeli ezibonakale ngenkathi kuqhubeka imibhikisho yosomatekisi.

src: Lefapha le tla buisana le dikaho tsa ntshetsopele ya ditjheletebakeng sa ho batlana le ditsela tse ding tsa ho thusa boraditekesi ka ditjhelete.
tgt: Izindlela zokungenelela ngokuthula kunoma iyiphi inkinga ziyohlala njalo ziwusizo ngokuletha imiphumela egculisayo kubo bonke abathintekile.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona a tebileng ho bohle ba lahlehetsweng ke baratuwa ba bona dikoduweng tsa haufinyana tjenaho la Kapa Bophirima le Kapa Botjhabela ka tatelano.
tgt: Isivumelwano esenziwe emva kwalokhu, esiphakathi kweNhlangano Kazwelonke Yamatekisi yaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nenkampani exhasa ngezimali zokuthenga amatekisi, i-SA Taxi Finance Holdings, siyisiqinisekiso esicacile sokuthi ukuxoxisana nokubonisana ngokuthula kungazixazulula izinkinga ezinjalo, ngaphandle kokukhahlameza abantu abangenacala nokuphazamisa umnotho.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa katamelo ya ka potlako e kopanetsweng le karabelo ho tswa mmusong, borakgwebo le maAforika Borwa ka kakaretso mabapi le ho thusa malapa a amehileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isishayela ihlombe impela lesi sinqumo, esihle kakhulu futhi esizohlomulisa abagibeli kanye nemboni yamatekisi.

src: Kabinete e lebisa hlompho ho mohale wa moithaopi wa ditimamollo, Bradley Richards le mokganni wa dilori John Blaaw ba thusitseng batimamollo ka ho tsamaisa metsi le ho lahlehelwa ke bophelo ba e mong wa bona ha ba ne ba thusa batho ba motse wa bo bona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamukela izingxoxo eziqhubekayo njengamanje phakathi koMnyango Wezokuthutha kanye nabaholi bemboni yamatekisi okuhloswe ngazo ukuthola isisombululo sesikhathi eside.

src: Kabinete hape e fetisetsa kananelo e ikgethang ho sehlopha sa Working on Fire se lwantshitseng mello e neng e befile ka sebete.
tgt: Uhulumeni uzobonisana nezikhungo ezixhasa ngezimali ngenhloso yokuqhamuka nezinye izindlela ezihlukile ezingasetshenziswa ukuxhasa osomatekisi.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o etetse badudi ba Wit Lokasie le Knysna Heights ba anngweng ha bohloko ke mello.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulisa amazwi okuzwelana kwayo nabo bonke abashonelwe yizihlobo ezinhlekeleleni zakamuva nje ezenzeke eNtshonalanga Kapa kanye naseMpumalanga Kapa.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o ile a kenela tshebeletso ya bofifi ya Monghadi Richards.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwathulela isigqoko amaqhawe ashone ngenkathi ezama ukuhlenga umphakathi wawo, okungumcimimlilo oyivolontiya, u-Bradley Richards, kanye nomshayeli weloli u-John Blaaw obelekelela abacimimlilo ngokubathuthela amanzi.

src: Ka moya wa nnete wa sehlopha sa batimamollo, Monghadi Barnard o ile a kgona ho ba teng tshebeletsong ya bofifi ya mosebetsi-mmoho le yena Monghadi Richards.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulisa futhi amazwi akhethekile okubonga ithimba lwe-Working on Fire elilwe ngesibindi esikhulu nemililo yequbula ebibhebhetheka ngamandla asabekayo.

src: Kabinete e leboha mekgatlo yohle eo e seng ya mmuso, lekala la poraefete, baithaopi le badudi ba tshehetsang badudi ba amehileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibafisela ukwelulama okusheshayo abacimimlilo ababili, kubandakanya no-Ian Barnard, abalimale ngenkathi bezama ukusindisa impilo ka-Bradley Richards.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa badudi ba Limpopo ba arolelanang moedi le Zimbabwe ho fadimeha le ho ela hloko dikgoho tsa bona.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma wavakashela abantu base-Wit Lokasie kanye nase-Knysna Heights izindawo lezo zikhahlamezwe kakhulu yimililo yequbula.

src: Sena se latela tlaleho ya ho ropoha ha kokwanahloko ya ntaramane ya dinonyana le dikgoho e bitswang H5Kgwebisano ka dihlahiswa tsa bommaditshibana ho tswa Zimbabwe e sa fanyehilwe.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma wethamela futhi nenkozo yesikhumbuzo kaMnu Richards.

src: Kokwanahloko ya H5N8 e kgona ho baka mafu a mang haholo le ho tshwaetsana ka ho fetisisa, le ho lebisa maemong a phahameng a ho shwa.
tgt: Ukubonisa umoya omuhle wokusebenzisana kwethimba labacimimlilo ngokweqiniso, uMnu Barnard wakwazi nokwethamela inkozo yesikhumbuzo kazakwabo uMnu Richards.

src: Borapolasi ba kgwebo le bona ba kgothaletswa ho eketsa mekgwa ya tshireletso ya tsa tlhaho mapolasing a bona.
tgt: UMongameli uthumele usizo lokulekelela abantu ngezidingo zempilo nezenhlalakahle ezahlukahlukene kuzo zonke izindawo ezikhahlamezekile.

src: Kahlolo ena e tla thusa haholo mabapi le ho matlafatsa bokgoni ba tsamaiso ya rona ya toka bakeng sa ho sebetsa kgahlanong le ba tsitlalletseng merusu kgahlanong le basadi le bana.
tgt: Lo msebenzi wokuhlinzeka ngosizo ubulawulwa ngaphansi kohlaka lweSizinda Sikazwelonke Sokuhlanganyela Ekuphathweni Kwezinhlekelele, lubambisene namathimba kaHulumeni Wesifundazwe saseNtshonalanga Kapa kanye nawoPhiko Lesifundazwe Lokuphathwa Kwezinhlekelele.

src: Kabinete e amohela tulo ya haufinyana tjena ya badudi ya Inthanete bakeng sa Bohle e neng e tshwaretsweKliptown, Soweto.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabonga kuzo zonke izinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni, abomkhakha ozimele, amavolontiya kanye nabantu abahlinzeka ngosizo kulabo abakhahlamezekile.

src: Tulo ena– e neng e eteletswe pele ke Letona la Meralo ya Motheo ya Dikgokahanyo le Ditshebeletso tsa PosoSiyabonga Cwele,ka bolekane le Foramo ya Lefatshe ya Moruo, lekala la poraefete le setjhaba ka kakaretso– e entse hore ho be le thupello ya motheo ya maitsebelo a Tlhahisoleseding le Thekenoloji ya Dikgokahanyo (ICT) bakeng sa batjha ba ka bang 500.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa imiphakathi yaseLimpopo eyakhelene neZimbabwe ukuba iqikelele futhi ivikele izinkukhu zayo, kulandela ukubheduka kwegciwane lomkhuhlane wezinyoni nezinkukhu obizwa nge-H5N.

src: Tumellano ya Inthanete bakeng sa Bohle e amohetse sebopeho sa boetapele mme hape le ho hlwaya tse lokelang ho kenngwa tshebetsong nakong ya dikgwedi tse tsheletseng tse tlang.
tgt: Sekumisiwe ukuhwebelana kwaleli nezwe laseZimbabwe ngemikhiqizo yezinyoni nezinkukhu.

src: Kabinete hape e amohetse boitshunyako ba Lefapha la Meralo ya Motheo ya Dikgokahanyo le Ditshebeletso tsa Poso ka Bolaodi bo Ikemetseng ba Dikgokahanyo ba Aforika Borwa le Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Moruo ka Khomishene ya Diphehisano, ho hlahloba ditjeho tse hodimo tsa datha tse tswelang pele ho ba tshita bakeng sa ho eketsa phumantsho yadi-ICKabinete e tshwenyehile ka ditlaleho tsa ho sitiswa ha ditshebeletso dimotjhareng tsa Gauteng ka lebaka tsa dikgang tsa basebetsi tse ntseng di tswela pele.
tgt: Igciwane le-H5N8 yigciwane elithathelwana kakhulu elibanga izifo eziyingozi futhi liyabulala kakhulu.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho bohle ba amehangho fumana tharollo ya kgotso ya dikgang tsa bona ntle le ho ama ba malapa a ba hlokahaletsweng.
tgt: Lesi sinqumo senkantolo sizolekelela kakhulu ekuqiniseni amandla okusebenza komkhakha wezobulungiswa wakuleli ukuze bathathelwe izinyathelo ezifanelekile labo abahlukumeza abesifazane nezingane.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thehwa ha Foramo ya Batjha ya Ntshetsopele ya Mebuso ya Lehae.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isamukelile isigcawu somphakathi se-Inthanethi Kawonkewonke ebesibanjwe esikhathini esifushane esedlule e-Kliptown, eSoweto.

src: Foramo ena e reretswe ho ba lentswe la tswelopele la batjha mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha maikitlaetso a fapafapaneng a ntshetsopele ya batjha ka hara mebuso ya lehae.
tgt: Lesi sigcawu, ebesiholwa nguNgqongqoshe WezeNgqalasizinda Yezokuxhumana Nezinsizakalo Zeposi uSiyabonga Cwele, ngokubambisana nesiThangamu Sezomnotho Emhlabeni (i-WEF), nomkhakha ozimele kanye nezinhlangano zomphakathi wonkana, siholele ekutheni kuqeqeshwe abantu abasha ababalelwa kuma-500 emakhonweni ayisisekelo kwezobuchwepheshe bolwazi nezokuxhumana (i-ICT).IsiVumelwano Se-Inthanethi Kawonkewonke sibamukelile abaholi abaqokiwe futhi sahlonza imikhawulo nemigomo okumele ifezekiswe kulezi zinyanga eziyisithupha ezizayo.

src: Foramo ena e ne e tshwere pitso ya yona ya ho thakgolwa la pele ka la 20-21 Phuptjane Muldersdrift, ka bophirima ho Johannesburg.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde futhi yamukela nokungenelela koMnyango WezeNgqalasizinda Yezokuxhumana Nezinsizakalo Zeposi, ngokusebenzisa uPhiko Oluzimele Lwezokuxhumana LwaseNingizimu Afrika (i-Icasa) kanye noMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komnotho ngokusebenzisa iKhomishana Yezokuncintisana, ukuze kufakelwe izibuko udaba lwezindleko zedatha ye-inthanethi emba eqolo, okuyinto elokhu iqhubekile nokuba yisithiyo esivimbela ukukhuliswa kwesibalo sabantu abathola izinsizakalo ze-ICIKhabhinethi ikhathazekile ngokuphazamiseka komsebenzi emakhazeni okugcina izidumbu eGauteng ngenxa yemibango eqhubekayo phakathi kwabasebenzi nabaqashi.

src: Pampiri ya Mosupatsela e re atametsa ntlheng ya ho netefatsa hore maAforika Borwa kaofela a fumantshwa tlhokomelo ya kalafo, ho sa natswe maemo a bona a ditjhelete.
tgt: Ukufa kuyinto eholela esimweni esinzima kunoma yimuphi umndeni oshonelwe futhi kuletha usizi nomunyu kumalungu omndeni asele.

src: NHI ke tsamaiso e thusang ka ditjhelete ho tsa kalafo e abang matlole bakeng sa phumantsho ya tlohokomelo ya kalafo.
tgt: Kithina njengesizwe awukho neze umbango ongathathwa njengesizathu esizwakalayo sokwenza isenzo esinjengalesi, sokungabonisi ngisho noluncane uzwelo.

src: Sena se kgema le maikemisetso a Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP) a batlang ho netefatsa hore mang le mang o fumantshwa tlhokomelo ya kalafo, ho sa tsotellwe lekeno la hae.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabanxusa bonke abathintekayo ukuba bathole isisombululo esinokuthula kulo mbango, futhi ngaphandle kokuba lokhu kube nomthelela ongemuhle okhahlameza imindeni eshonelwe.

src: Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle le tla tshwara kopano ka la 29 Phuptjane2017 ho hlopholla ka botlalo dikateng tsa Pampiri ya Mosupatsela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukusungulwa kweSithangamu Sokuthuthukiswa Kwentsha Kohulumeni Basekhaya.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Lewa le Shebilweng Botjha la Ntshetsopele ya Mehlodi ya Basebetsi le lebisang selemong sa 2030.
tgt: Kulindeleke ukuba lesi sithangamu sibe yizwi lentsha elinohlonze futhi elithuthukisayo ekuqalisweni kwezinhlelo ezahlukahlukene zokuthuthukiswa kwentsha kohulumeni basekhaya.

src: Lewa lena le shebilweng botjha le sebetsana le bofokodi bo hlwauweng dilemong tse hlano tse fetileng dikarolong tse ding tsa tsamaiso ya thuto le thupello mme hape le hlwaile bohokahanyi pakeng tsa dikarolo tse fapaneng tsa tsamaiso.
tgt: Lesi Sithangamu sibambe ingqungquthela yaso yokuqala mhla zingama-20 kuya kumhla zingama-21 kuNhlangulana e-Muldersdrift, entshonalanga yedolobha laseGoli.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya diphetho tsa bohlokwa tsa diphuputso tsa 2015/16 mabapi le thuso ya mmuso ka ditjhelete bakeng sa Mesebetsi ya Saense le Thekenoloji.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukuba lushicilelwe njengombhalo wenqubomgomo uHlaka LoMthetho Odingidwayo Womshwalense Kazwelonke Wezempilo (i-NHI).

src: Pampiri ya Mosupatsela e mabapi le Saense le Thekenoloji ya selemo sa 1996 e batla hore Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji le behe leihlo thuso ya ditjhelete ya makala a saense le thekenoloji, le nyehelo ya yona kgolong le ntshetsopeleng ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lolu Hlaka LoMthetho Odingidwayo lusondeza izwe esimweni sokuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayaluthola usizo lwezempilo, kungakhathalekile ukuthi baphila ngaphansi kwasiphi isimo senhlalo-mnotho.

src: Sephetho sa diphuputso tsa mafapha a naha a 30 se supa hore se akanngwang ho R23,4 bilione se sebedisitswe ho tswa matlotlong a mmuso selemong sa ditjhelete sa2015/16.Kabinete e lemohile keketseho e bonahalang ya 6.6% ha ho bapiswa le selemo se fetileng ha ho shejwa ditshita tsa hajwale tsa matlotlo.
tgt: I-NHI wuhlelo lokuxhasa ngezimali ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola usizo lwezempilo.

src: Matsete ana kaofela a emela.7% ya palohohle ya ditekanyetso tsa naha tsa selemo.
tgt: Lokhu kuhambelana nenjongo yoHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP) ehlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uyaluthola usizo lwezempilo, kungakhathalekile ukuthi uhola malini.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ntlha ya hore boholo ba matlole ana a sebedisitswe ditshebeletsong tsa saense tse tshehetsang phano ya ditshebeletso dibakeng tsa bohlokwa tsa bokgoni ba mmuso tse kang thuto, kalafo, diminerale, eneji, temo le tikoloho.
tgt: UMnyango Wezempilo uzobamba isithangamu sokuhlinzeka ngolwazi mhla zingama-29 kuNhlangulana 2017 lapho uzohlinzeka khona ngemininingwane ephelele yezinto eziqukethwe kulolu hlaka loMthetho Odingidwayo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Bili ya Lebollo la Setso bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iligunyazile iSu Elibuyekeziwe Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabasebenzi eliphokophele kunyaka wezi-2030.

src: Bili e rerile ho tshireletsa, ho hodisa le ho laola diketsahalo tsa lebollo la setso.
tgt: Leli su elibuyekeziwe lilungisa ubuthakathaka obuhlonzwe kule minyaka emihlanu edlule ezingxenyeni ezithile zohlelo lwezemfundo nokuqeqesha futhi liphinde lahlonza nenkinga yokungabi khona kokuhambelana nokuxhumana kahle kwezingxenye ezahlukene zalolu hlelo.

src: Hang ha e se e tjhaelletswe monwana, Bili e tla fana ka mekgwa le maemo a amohelehang mabapi le ho tsamaisa diketsahalo tsena tsa setso.
tgt: Manje leli su seliyahambelana ne-NDP kanye noHlaka Olukhethekile Lwesikhathi Esimaphakathi lowezi-2014-2019.Leli su liyaqinisekisa futhi nokuthi bonke ababambiqhaza abafanelekile (uhulumeni, abasebenzi, izinhlangano zomphakathi kanye nomkhakha ozimele) bagxila ezidingweni zomnotho kanye nokubaluleka kokusekela isu lezezimboni ukuze kufezekiswe ukukhula komnotho okubandakanya umuntu wonke kanye nentuthuko.

src: E tla sebetsana le tshebediso e mpe ya diketsahalo tsa setso, e leng moo palo e ngata ya bashanyana e shwelletseng mephatong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukushicilelwa kwemiphumela esemqoka etholwe ocwaningweni lowezi-2015/16 oluphathelene nokuxhaswa nguhulumeni kweMisebenzi Yezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe ngezimali.

src: Mmuso le dikaho tsa boetapele ba setso ba nkile mohato wa ho se hlole ho hang ba mamella mafu a makolwane ka lebaka la diketsahalo tsa mephatong.
tgt: Uhlaka loMthetho Odingidwayo Lwezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe lowe-1996 luyalela ukuba uMnyango Wezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe uqaphe ukuxhaswa nguhulumeni kwemikhakha yezesayensi nobuchwepheshe ngezimali kanye negalelo lale mikhakha ekukhulisweni nokuthuthukiswa kweNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwanaSehlomathiso sa Bili ya Motheo wa Naha wa Diphuputso (NRF) ya selemo sa 2017bakeng sa ho tekwa Palamenteng.
tgt: Imiphumela yocwaningo olwenziwe eminyangweni kazwelonke engama-30 ibonisa ukuthi ngonyaka-mali wezi-2015/16 kusetshenziswe imali elinganiselwa kumarandi angamabhiliyoni angama-23,4 evela emgodlagodleni wezimali kazwelonke.

src: Bili e se e ile ya feta ka botlalo mohatong wa dipuisano le setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuphawulile ukukhuphuka kwalesi samba okuncane okungama-6.6% uma siqhathaniswa nesamba sonyaka owandulelayo, ngenxa yezinkinga ezikhona zokuntuleka kwezimali.

src: Dihlomathiso di hlakisa bolaodi ba Letona la Saense le Thekenoloji hodima motheo le ho hlakisa maikarabelo aNRF mabapi le dipuisano ka tsa saense.
tgt: Lesi samba esiphelele sotshalomali silingana nama-1.7% esamba esiphelele sesabelomali sikazwelonke sonyaka.

src: Dihlomathiso tsena di tla matlafatsa bolaodi ba Letona bakeng sa ho tataisaNRF bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa bohlwahlwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakuthokozela ukuba ingxenye enkulu yale mali isetshenziswe ezinsizakalweni zezesayensi ezisekela ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingongqangi emikhakheni esemqoka yomsebenzi kahulumeni njengezemfundo, ezempilo, ezezimbiwa, ezamandla, ezolimo kanye nezemvelo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Bofofisi ba Setjhaba ya selemo sa 2017bakeng sa ho tekwaPalamenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukushicilelwa koMthethosivivinywa Wesiko Lokusoka ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngawo.

src: Bili e matlafatsa polokeho ya bofofisi, tshireletso le moralo wa bolaodi ba tshireletso ya tikoloho ho netefatsa boteng ba moshwelella le botsitso ba indaseteri ya bofofisi ya setjhaba.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uhlose ukuvikela, ukugqugquzela kanye nokulawula inqubo yesiko lokusoka.

src: Dihlomathiso di kenyeletsa, hara tse ding, tumello bakeng saboikemelo ba ditshebetso tsa dikotsi tsa difofane le dipatlisiso tsa dikotsi tumello bakeng sa ho thehwa ha Boto ya Diphuputso tsa Polokeho ya Bofofisi.
tgt: Uma usugunyaziwe, lo Mthethosivivinywa uzohlinzeka ngemigomo namazinga amukelekile okuqhutshwa kwesiko lokusoka.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Dithaetlele tsa Dikarolo tsa Bodulo ya selemo sa 2017bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Uzolwisana nomkhuba wokuxhashazwa kwesiko lokusoka, osekuholele ekushoneni kwabafana abancane abaningana ezikoleni zokusoka.

src: Dihlomathiso di ntlafatsa mosebetsi, tshebediso, ho sebediswa le tsamaiso ya Molao wa Dithaetlele tsa Dikarolo tsa Bodulo, wa selemo sa 1986 (Molao wa bo-95 wa 1986).
tgt: Uhulumeni kanye nabaholi bendabuko sebethathe isinqumo sokuthi ngeke kubekezelelwe nakancane ukushona kwabasokwa ngenxa yokuxhashazwa kwenqubo yokusoka.

src: Molao wa Dithaetlele tsa Dikarolo tsa Bodulo wa selemo sa 1986 o fana ka ditokelo tse itseng ho beng ba bodulosekemeng sa dithaetlele tsa dikarolo tsa thepa ya bodulo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukwethulwa ePhalamende kweSichibiyelo Somthethosivivinywa Wenhlangano Kazwelonke Yezocwaningo (i-NRF) sowezi-2017.Lo Mthethosivivinywa usuziphothulile zonke izigaba zokubonisana nomphakathi.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili se sisintsweng se etsa tshitshinyo ya melawana ya ditokelo tsena ka mokgwa o nang le moelelo.
tgt: Izichibiyelo zicacisa igunya namandla kaNgqongqoshe Wezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe phezu kwale nhlangano futhi zibeka ngokucacile izibopho nemisebenzi ye-NRF kwezesayensi.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Bili ya Thuo ya Mobu ke Badudi ya selemo sa 2017 hore e phatlalatswe bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Lezi zichibiyelo zizoqinisa igunya namandla kaNgqongqoshe lokuhola nokulawula i-NRF ukuze ikwazi ukwenza ngcono indlela esebenza ngayo.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla kenela Seboka sa bohlanosa Kopano ya Aforika e Borwa ya Makgetho a Madiboho (SACU) se tla tshwarelwa Swaziland ka la 23 Phuptjane 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukwethulwa ePhalamende kweSichibiyelo Somthethosivivinywa Wezokundiza Ngamabhanoyi sowezi-2017.

src: Seboka sena sa letsatsi le le leng se tla kenelwa ke Dihlooho tsa Dipuso le Mmuso tsa ditho tsa dipuso tsa SACU, tse kenyeletsang Aforika Borwa, Botswana, Lesotho, Namibia le Swaziland.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uqinisa uhlaka olulawula ukuphepha nokuvikeleka emkhakheni wezokundiza ngamabhanoyi kanye nokuvikelwa kwemvelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusimama nozinzo embonini yezokundiza ngamabhanoyi.

src: Seboka sena se tla tshohla dintlha tse fapafapaneng tse amanang le kgwebisano ya lebatowa le kaho ya diindaseteri le lenaneo la WEBTOKEN tla sheba botjha dintlha tsa tumellano ya SACU le dipehelo tsa tshupiso, ho thusa ka ntshetsopele ya meruo ya WEBTOKEN kaSACU hore mebaraka e eketsehileng bakeng sa thepa le ditshebeletso ho tswa lebatoweng di ka sireletswa ka ditherisano tsa kgwebisano tse tswellangtse reretsweng ho tswellisa pele kopano e matla ya lebatowa le kontinente.
tgt: Lezi zichibiyelo zibandakanya, phakathi kokunye, isimiselo sokuhlinzekela ukusebenza ngokuzimela emkhakheni wezophenyo lwezingozi nezigameko eziphathelene nezindiza nesimiselo sokusungulwa kweBhodi Yophenyo Lwezokuphepha Kwezindiza.

src: Jwaloka ka karolo e tswelang pele ya Imbizo ya twantsho ya ditlolo tsa molao, Moporesidente Zuma o tla nka leeto la Lenaneo la Bodisa la Boporesidente la Siyahlola ho ya Lusikisiki, ho la Kapa Botjhabela ka Moqebelo, 24 Phuptjane 2017.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uchibiyela futhi uphinde ufake izincazelo ezithile kulo Mthetho.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa ho tshehetsa Mokete wa Knysna Oyster le Marathone wa Knysna tse tlang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukushicilelwa kweSichibiyelo Somthethosivivinywa Wobunikazi Bengxenye Ethile Yesakhiwo Esisodwa wezi-2017 ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngawo.

src: Ona ke o mong wa mekete e tummeng haholo o amang haholo barati ba dipapadi le malapa.
tgt: Lo Mthetho Wobunikazi Bengxenye Ethile Yesakhiwo Esisodwa osebenzayo njengamanje unikeza amalungelo athile kubanikazi abangaphansi kohlelo lobunikazi bengxenye ethile yesakhiwo esisodwa.

src: Bankakarolo kaofela ba sebetsa mmoho ho netefatsa hore Knysna e sebetsa ka botlalo le ho bula bakeng sa kgwebo.
tgt: Isichibiyelo Somthethosivivinywa ohlongozwayo siphakamisa ukuba lawa malungelo alawulwe ngendlela ephusile.

src: Letsatsi la Mandela le ipiletsa ho rona bohle, letsatsi ka leng, ho etsa lefatshe tulo e betere.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukushicilelwa koMthethosivivinywa Wokuhlaliswa Kwabantu Emhlabeni Womphakathi wezi-2017 ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngawo.

src: Melaetsa ya matshediso.
tgt: Imicimbi ezayo.

src: Kabinete e ipapisa le Moporesidente Zuma ka ho fetisetsa matshediso:• ho Letona la Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello, Ngaka Blade Nzimande, le lelapa la hae ka ho hlokahala ha mmae,Mofumahadi Nozipho Nzimande.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uzokwethamela iNgqungquthela yesi-5 yeNhlangano Elawula Izindaba Zentela Yokuhwebelwana Emazweni aseNingizimu ne-Afrika (i-SACU) ezobanjelwa kwelaseSwaziland mhla zingama-23 kuNhlangulana 2017.Le Ngqungquthela yosuku olulodwa izokwethanyelwa yiziNhloko Zemibuso Nohulumeni bamazwe angamalungu e-SACU, okungamazwe abandakanya iNingizimu Afrika, Botswana, Lesotho, Namibia kanye ne-Swaziland.

src: O ne a amohela ka mofuthu balwanedi ba tokoloho ba South African Communist Party (SACP) le ba African National Congress (ANC) lapeng la hae nakong ya merusu e neng e aparetse Pietermaritzburg ho la KwaZulu-Natal le dibaka tse mabapi nakong ya dilemo tsa ho qetela tsa bo-1980 le tse qalang ka bo-1990.• ka ho hlokahala haLord Joel Joffe.
tgt: I-SACU iyona engakhuphula isibalo sabantu kanye nezindawo ezintsha okuzothengiswa kuzona izimpahla nezinsizakalo ezivela kulesi sifunda, ngokusebenzisa izingxoxo zokuhwebelana eziqhubekayo njengamanje okuhloswe ngazo ukuthuthukisa nokukhulisa ukudidiyelwa nokusebenzisana kwesifunda kanye nezwekazi lonkana.

src: Lord Joffe, ya hlokahetseng a na le dilemo tse 85, e ne e le leqwetha la tshireletso nyeweng ya Rivonia le ya Little Rivonia.
tgt: Njengengxenye yeziMbizo zokulwisana nobugebengu, uMongameli Zuma uzovakashela endaweni yaseLusikisiki, eMpumalanga Kapa, ngoMgqibelo mhla zingama-24 kuNhlangulana 2017, ngaphansi kohlelo lukaMongameli lokuqapha nokuhlola umsebenzi owenziwayo i-Siyahlola Presidential Monitoring Programme.

src: O tshireleditse ka sebete balwanedi ba ntwa ya mmuso wa kgethollo, le ho etsa nyehelo e matla porojekeng ya demokerasi ka hara Aforika Borwa.• ho batho ba Namibia ka ho hlokahala ha Monghadi Toivo ya Toivo, molwanedi wa diphethoho tsa ntwa ya tokolohoho la Namibia le ho ba molwanedi kgahlanong le mmuso wa kgethollo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba basekele umkhosi ozobanjwa khona maduze nje i-Knysna Oyster Festival kanye nomjaho webanga elide i-Knysna Marathon.

src: Letona la Dikgokahanyo Ayanda Dlodlo o tla emela mmuso wa Aforika Borwa semmuso lepatong le tla etsahala ka Moqebelo, wa la 24 Phuptjane Melaetsa ya thoholetso.
tgt: Lona ngomunye wemikhosi enesasasa kakhulu eheha abathandi bezemidlalo kanye nemindeni.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsasetsebi sa sebopeho sa lefatshe Tshiamo Legoale ya entseng nalane ka ho ba moAforika Borwa wa pele wa ho rweswa kgau ya ho ba Mampodi wa Matjhaba wa FameLab bakeng sa porojeke e fupuditseng ho sebedisa koro bakeng sa ho kotula gauta ho tswa ditutudung tsa merafo.
tgt: Bonke ababambiqhaza basebenza ngokubambisana ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi indawo yase-Knysna isebenza ngokugcwele futhi ikulungele ukwenza ibhizinisi.

src: Legoaleke mokgola-molemo wa mananeo a dibasari a mmuso mme haufinyana tjena o hapile kgau ho Mokete wa Saense wa Cheltenham o neng tshwaretswe United Kingdom.
tgt: Ukwenza usuku ngalunye lube wuSuku lukaMandela wuphawu lokubungaza impilo nokhondolo lukaMadiba ngendlela esimeme ezoletha uguquko olunemithelela emihle eyoqhubeka isikhathi eside.

src: Kabinete e lakaletsa Sehlopha sa Aforika Borwa tsohle tse molemo bakeng sa Dipapadi tsa Batjha tsa Commonwealth tsa selemo sa 2017 tse tlang tse tla tshwarelwa Nassau, ho la Bahamas ho tloha ka la 19 ho isa ka la 23 Phupu 2017.Dipapading tsena ke moo Sehlopha sa Aforika Borwa se thotseng maemo a bobedi tafoleng ya dimedale, ka palohohle ya dimedale tse 35, dipapading tsa selemo sa 2015 Apia, ho la Samoa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo njengoMongameli Zuma idlulisa amazwi enduduzo:kuNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqesha, uDkt Blade Nzimande, kanye nomndeni wakhe ngokudlula emhlabeni kukamama wakhe, uNkk Nozipho Nzimande.

src: Kabinete e ile ya kopanela Tlung ya Baeti ya Moporesidente ya Sefako M Makgatho Pretoria, ka Labobedi, mohla la 1 Phato Diqeto tsa Kabinete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlangane eSefako M Makgatho Presidential Guesthouse ePitoli ngoLwesibili, mhla lu-1 Ncwaba Izinqumo Zekhabhinethi.

src: Aforika Borwa e keteka Kgwedi ya Basadi ka Phato, e le tlotlo ho basadi ba kahodimo ho 20 000 ba ileng ba hwantela Union Buildings ka la 9 Phato 1956, ba ipelaetsa kgahlanong le katollelo ya melao ya dipasa hore e ye basading.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika ibungaza Inyanga Yabesifazane ngoNcwaba, njengendlela yokuhlonipha abesifazane abangaphezu kwezi-20 000 abamashela e-Union Buildings ngomhla ziyi-9 Ncwaba 1956 bemashela ukulwisana nokudluliselwa kwemithetho yamapasi kwabesifazane.

src: Meketjana ya Letsatsi la Naha e tla tshwarelwa Lebaleng la Dipapadi la Galeshwewe, Kimberley Kapa Leboya.
tgt: Imigubho yoSuku Lwabesifazane Lukazwelonke izobanjelwa eGaleshewe Stadium, eKimberley eNyakatho Kapa.

src: Kabinete e ananetse mookotaba wa meketjana ya monongwaha e le “Selemo sa OR Tambo: Basadi ba momahane ho ntshetsa Aforika Borwa pele.” Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ho sebedisa kgwedi ya Phato ho keteka seabo sa basadi setjhabeng sa rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze indikimba yemigubho yalo nyaka njengethi “Unyaka ka-OR Tambo: Abantu besifazane babumbene ukuqhubela iNingizimu Afrika phambili.” IKhabhinethi inxusa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba basebenzise inyanga kaNcwaba ukubungaza indima edlalwa ngabantu besifazane ezweni lakithi.

src: Kabinete e ile ya hlajwa malotsana ka lenaneo la dilemo tse tharo le tla etsuwa ke Mokgatlo wa Tsosoloso ya Boitshwaro (MRM).
