tgt: Izigidi ezingaphezu kwama-74 zamarandi zikhishiwe ukuze zibhekane nezinselele ezihlobene nesomiso, kubandakanya nemililo yamadlelo ebisha ubuhanguhangu muva nje kanye nokwentuleka kokudla kwemfunyo.

src: Kabinete e tswela pele ho ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ho sebedisa metsi ka paballo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaqhubeka nokunxusa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba basebenzise amanzi ngokucophelela.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Kabinete e amohetse keketseho ya tshebediso ya dithekenoloji le dintlafatso tse entsweng lapeng ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukele ukukhuphuka ekwamukelweni kwezobuchwepheshe obuthuthukiswe khona lapha ekhaya kanye nezinto ezintsha eziqanjiwe eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Saense le thekenoloji ke dithusi tse kgolo mokutung wa mekgahlelo e mengata ya naha bakeng sa ho tiisetsa sekgahla se phahamang sa kgolo ya moruo ho Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP).Ho ya ka Tlaleho ya Tshebetso ya Saense, Thekenoloji le Ntlafatso ya 2015 ya Lekgotla la Naha la Boeletsi Ntlafatsong (NACI) ditjeho tsa thekenoloji di batlile di menahana habedi jwaloka phesente ya Palohohle ya Dihlahiswa tsa Naha (GDP) ho tloha ho 0.018% ka selemo sa 2005 ho isa ho 0.033% ka sa 2015.Mafapha a mangata, lekala la poraefete le ditheo tsa diphuputso di tsetetse thekenoloji le ntlafatso tse ngata haholo mananeong a tsona a ntshetsopele ka ho latelana.
tgt: ISayensi Nezobuchwepheshe ngumkhakha losemqoka emzamweni ombaxaningi kazwelonke ukuvikela izilinganiso zokukhula komnotho eziphezulu oHlelweni Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP).

src: Jwaloka tsela ya ho matlafatsa diphihlello tsena ho ya pele, Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana dibaka tse tharo tsa menyetla tse hlwailweng ke Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji ho tshehetsa dithekenoloji tsa kalafo, tshireletso le dithekenoloji tse amanang le polokeho le meralo ya motheo e mabapi le thekenoloji.
tgt: Iminyango eminingi, umkhakha ozimele kanye nezikhungo zocwaningo zifake umfutho omkhulu wezobuchwepheshe kanye nokuqamba izinto ezintsha ezinhlelweni zazo zentuthuko ngokwehlukana kwazo.

src: Kabinete hape e tjhaelletse monwana mosebetsi wa tlatsetso wa ho ba mohlaleng le ho metha ntshetsopeleya thekenoloji le ntlafatso ntshetsopeleng ya kahisano le moruo.
tgt: Njengendlela yokuqinisa kakhulu lezi zinzuzo, iKhabhinethi igunyaze imikhakha enamathuba emithathu ehlonzwe nguMnyango Wezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe ukweseka kwezobuchwepheshe bezempilo, kwezobuchwepheshe bezokuvikela kanye nobuhlobene nezokuvikeleka kanye nengqalasizinda yomphakathi maqondana nobuchwepheshe.

src: Dibili.
tgt: IMithethosivivinywa.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tsebahatswa ha Bili ya Overvaal Resorts Limited ya selemo sa 2017 Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukwethulwa koMthethosivivinywa we-Overvaal Resorts Limited wezi-2017 ePhalamende.

src: Morero wa Bili ke ho hlakola molao wa ho thehwa ha Aventura, Molao wa Overvaal Resorts Limited, 1993 (Molao wa bo-127 wa selemo sa 1993).
tgt: Ukugxila koMthethosivivinywa kungukwesula umthetho wokusungulwa kwe-Aventura, uMthetho we-Overvaal Resorts Limited, we-1993 (uMthetho we-127 we-1993).

src: Sena se tla thusa ho phethelwa ha ho fediswa ha Aventura.
tgt: Lokhu kuzovumela ukuphothulwa kokuchithwa kwe-Aventura.

src: Kabinete e nkile qeto ya ho fedisa Aventura kamora ho ba e nkuwe e le thepa eo e seng ka sehloohong ya mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yathatha isinqumo sokuchitha i-Aventura ngemuva kokuba yayithatha njengebhizinisi likahulumeni elingabalulekile.

src: Bili ena e tswile bakeng sa hore e tshohlwe le setjhaba ka Hlakubele 2017.
tgt: NgoNdasa wezi-2017 uMthethosivivinywa wakhishelwa ngaphandle ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngawo.

src: Bakeng sa ho matahanya molao le dintshetsopele lepatlelong la thuto, Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Melao ya Thuto ya Motheo sa 2017 Koranteng ya Mmuso bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Ngokuhambelanisa isimiso nezintuthuko ezenzeka kumunxa wezemfundo, iKhabhinethi igunyaze ukushicilelwa kweSichibiyelo soMthethosivivinywa Wemithetho Yezemfundo Eyisisekelo wezi-2017 kuMqulu kaHulumeni ukuze kutholakale imibono yomphakathi.

src: Bili ke sephetho sa ho shejwa botjha ha melao kaofela ya thuto ya motheo ka morero wa ho matlafatsa bohlwahlwa ba tsamaisohore ho tle ho ntlafatswe taolo, boetapele le boikarabelo, ho fetola ditshebeletso tsa thuto, le ho sireletsa dihlopha tse kotsing ho netefatsa boitekanelo ba baithuti.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa ungumphumela wokubuyekezwa kwayo yonke imithetho yezemfundo eyisisekelo ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi umnyango usebenza ngendlela egculisayo ukuze kwenziwe ngcono ukuphathwa kwesikole, ubuholi kanye nokukwazi ukuphendula, ukuguqula izinsizakalo zezemfundo, kanye nokuvikela abantu ababuthakathaka ukuze kuqinisekiswe inhlalakahle yabafundi.

src: Dihlomathiso di sisintswe ho Molao wa Dikolo wa Aforika Borwa, 1996 (Molao wa bo-84 wa selemo sa 1996), le Molao wa Kgiro ya Matitjhere, 1998 (Molao wa bo-76 wa 1998).
tgt: Izichibiyelo zahlongozwa eMthethweni Wezikole zaseNingizimu Afrika, we-1996 (uMthetho wama-84 we-1996), kanye noMthetho Wokuqashwa Kothisha, we-1998 (uMthetho wama-76 we-1998).

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Imicimbi Ezayo.

src: Ka Loetse re tla tshwaya Kgwedi ya Botjhaba, Kgwedi ya Bohahlaudi, Beke ya Tjalo ya Difate, Kgwedi ya Tshebeletso ya Mmuso, Kgwedi ya NDP le Beke yaThusong Service Centre.
tgt: NgoMandulo sizobe singena eNyangeni Yamagugu, iNyanga Yezokuvakasha, iSonto Lokutshala Izihlahla, iNyanga Yabasebenzi Bakahulumeni, iNyanga ye-NDP kanye neSonto LamaThusong Service Centre.

src: Dintlha tse batsi ka diketsahalo tsena di tla tsebiswa ke mafapha a amehang.
tgt: Imininingwane ethe xaxa maqondana nale micimbi izokhishwa yiminyango efanelekile.

src: Jwaloka modulasetulo wa SADC, Aforika Borwa e dumetse ho tshwara Kopano ya Matona a Dikgokahanyo tsa Tlhahisoleseding ya Thekenoloji (ICT) a SADC ho tloha ka la 4 ho isa ka la 7 Loetse 2017 ho tshohla kgatelopele e entsweng mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lenaneo la Dikgokahanyo le ICT la SADC.
tgt: Njengosihlalo we-SADC, iNingizimu iye yacela ukusingatha Umhlangano we-SADC woNgqongqoshe be-ICT kusukela mhla zi-4 kuya mhla ziyi-7 kuMandulo 2017 ukudingida inqubekelaphambili esiyenziwe maqondana nokuqalisa ukusebenza koHlelo Lwezokuxhumana nele-ICT lwe-SADC.

src: Letona Ayanda Dlodlo le Letona Siyabonga Cwele ba tla etella pele kemedi ya Aforika Borwa kopanong ena.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe u-Ayanda Dlodlo noNgqongqoshe uSiyabonga Cwele bazohola ithimba lezithunywa zaseNingizimu Afrika kulo mhlangano.

src: Morero wa kopano ke ho fana ka tataiso mabapi le dintlha tsa mawa a dikgokahanyo le ICT le ho ba mohlaleng wa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha diqeto tse entsweng dikopanong tse fetileng.
tgt: Umhlangano uhlose ukuhlinzeka ngomhlahlandlela maqondana nokuxhumana ngobuqhinga kanye nezindaba ze-ICT kanye nokulandelela ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kwezinqumo ezenziwa emihlanganweni edlule.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla sebedisa kopano ena ho hodisa ho fihlellwa ha ditshebeletso tsa meralo ya motheo tsa ICT, ka seo naha e tla ba boemong ba ho ba sebaka sa meralo ya motheo ya lebatowa le ho hodisa dikgwebo tse nyenyane, tse mahareng le tse kgolo (di-SMME) tlasa mananeo a akaretsang a ho thehwa ha diindaseteri le kopano ya lebatowa a SADSeboka sa bo-9 sa Brazil, Russia, India, China le Aforika Borwa (BRICS) se tla tshwarwa Xiamen, China ho tloha ka la 4 ho isa la 5 Loetse 2017.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika izosebenzisa umhlangano ukukhuthaza ukufinyeleleka kwezinsizakalo ezikhokhelekayo zengqalasizinda ye-ICT, ngaleyo ndlela ibeke izwe njengesizinda sengqalasizinda yesifunda kanye nokukhuthaza amabhizinisi asafufusa (ama-SMME) ngaphansi kohlelo lwe-SADC lokuthuthukiswa kwezimboni kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlanganisa isifunda.

src: Mookotaba wa bodulasetulo ba China ho BRICS ke:“BRICS: Dilekane tse Matla bakeng sa Bokamoso bo Kganyang”.Kgwebisano ka botlalo pakeng tsa Aforika Borwa le dinaha tsa BRICS e fihlile ho US$29 bilione ka selemo sa 2016.
tgt: INgqungquthela yeSishiyagalombili yeBrazil, Russia, India, China neNingizimu Afrika (i-BRICS) izobanjelwa eXiamen, eChina kusukela mhla zi-4 kuya mhla zi-5 kuMandulo 2017.

src: Sebaka se seholo ka ho fetisisa sa thekiso ya ka ntle sa Aforika Borwa ka hara BRICS e dutse e le China, e latelwe ke India, Brazil mme e be Russia.
tgt: Indikimba yokuba nguSihlalo we-BRICS kweChina ithi: “I-BRICS: Izinsebenziswano Eziqinile Zekusasa Eliqhakazile”.Isamba sohwebo phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika kanye namanye amazwe e-BRICS sifinyelele ezigidigidini ezingama-US$29 ngowezi-2016.

src: Paterone e tshwanang e ya bonahala mabapi le dihlahiswa tse kenang ka hara naha, moo China e dutseng e le mohlodi o moholo ka ho fetisisa wa dihlahiswa tsa ka ntle.
tgt: Izwe iNingizimu Afrika ethumela kulona izimpahla zohwebo eziningi emazweni angamalunga e-BRICS kusalokhu kuyiChina, ilandelwe yi-India, Brazil bese kugcina iRussia.

src: Seboka sa selemo sa 2017 sa BRICS se tla tobana le dintlha tse hlano tse ka sehlohlolong e leng, ho tebisa tshebedisano-mmoho, ho matlafatsa taolo ya lefatshe, ho etsa diphapanyetsano tsa batho-ho-batho, ho ntshetsapele dintlafatso tsa ditheo le ho aha dilekane tse batsi.
tgt: Kuphinde futhi kube yiChina ethumela izimpahla zohwebo ezininzi kuleli emazweni angamalunga e-BRICS.

src: Lewa la tsepamiso ya maikutlo bakeng sa Aforika Borwa ka hara BRICS ke ho hodisa kgwebisano ya boleng bo eketsehileng, ho hohella matsete ka hara makala a naha a tshepisang a tlhahiso le ho matlafatsa tshebedisano-mmoho ho hodisa merero ya rona ya ntshetsopele.
tgt: Ingqungquthela ye-BRICS yowezi-2017 izofaka phakathi izinto eziseqhulwini ezinhlanu ezisemqoka okuyilezi ezilandelayo, ukugxilisa ukubambisana, ukuqinisa ukuphathwa komhlaba jikelele, ukugqugquzela izivumelwano sokusebenzisana phakathi kwabantu, ukuthuthukisa ukwenziwa ngcono kwezikhungo kanye nokwakha izinsebenziswano ezibanzi.

src: Kabinete e lemohile bonkakarolo ba dikhamphani tsa Aforika Borwa Mokgahlelong wa bo-53 wa Dipontsho tsa Kgwebo tsa Matjhaba tsa Maputo, tse tlwaelehileng jwaloka FACIM, tse tla tshwarwa Mozambique ho tloha ka la 28 Phato ho isa ka la 3 Loetse 2017.
tgt: Inhloso esemqoka yeNingizimu Afrika kwi-BRICS wukukhuthaza ukuhwebelana okwengeza inani, ukuhehela utshalomali emikhakheni yezokukhiqiza yezwe kanye nokuthuthukisa ukubambisana ukuze kuqhutshelwe phambili izinjongo zethu zentuthuko.

src: FACIM ke dipontsho tsa matjhaba tsa kgwebo ya makala a fapaneng tse tshwarwang selemo ka seng ho pepesa Mozambique jwaloka sebaka se hohelang bakeng sa kgwebo le matsete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqaphelile ukubamba iqhaza kwezinkampani zaseNingizimu Afrika emcimbini wama-53 Wombukiso Wohwebo Lwamazwe Ngamazwe waseMaputo, odume kakhulu ngokuthi yi-FACIM, ozobanjelwa eMozambique kusukela mhla zingama-28 kuNcwaba kuya mhla zi-3 kuMandulo 2017.

src: Dikhamphani tse 20 di ile tsa thuswa ka matlole ke Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri (dti) ha tse 10 di ile tsa tshehetswa ke Lekala la Mpumalanga la Kgolo ya Moruo.
tgt: I-FACIM ngumbukiso wohwebo lwemikhakha ehlukahlukene yamazwe ngamazwe obanjwa njalo ngonyaka ukuveza iMozambique njengezwe elihehayo lokuvakashelwa ngenhloso yokuhweba nokutshala imali.

src: Dikhamphani tsena di ne di emetse makala a fapafapaneng ho kenyeletsa makala a dikhemikhale, a tswelliso ya dihlahiswa tsa temo, a diaparo le masela, a boenjineri, a merafo le thepa ya dikaho tse kgolo, lea tekginiki ya motlakase le a tikoloho ya kaho.
tgt: Izinkampani ezingamashumi amabili zixhaswe nguMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni (i-dti) ngenkathi eziyi-10 zisekwe yiSikhungo Sokukhula Komnotho saseMpumalanga.

src: Mozambique ke molekane wa boraro ya moholo ka ho fetisisa wa Aforika Borwa ka hara lebatowa la SADC, kamora Botswana le Namibia.
tgt: IMozambique iyizwe lesithathu ngobukhulu iNingizimu Afrika ehwebelana nalo esifundeni se-SADC, ngemuva kweBotswana kanye neNamibia.

src: Kgwebisano pakeng tsa dinaha tsena tse pedi e eketsehile ho tloha ho R29 bilione ka 2012 ho isa ho R43 bilione ka sa 2016.
tgt: Uhwebo phakathi kwalamazwe amabili lukhuphukile kusukela ezigidigidini ezingama-29 zamarandi ngowezi-2012 kuya ezigidigidini ezingama-43 zamarandi ngowezi-2016.

src: Hajwale ho na le dikhamphani tse 300 tsa Aforika Borwa tse sebetsang ka hara Mozambique.
tgt: Kunezinkampani ezingama-300 njengamanje zaseNingizimu Afrika ezisebenza eMozambique.

src: Bonkakarolo ba dikhamphani tsa Aforika Borwa ho FACIM bo fumane kananelo e itseng bekeng e fetileng ya Khomishene ya Dinaha tse Pedi jwaloka e nngwe ya mapatlelo ao badudi ka hara dinaha ka bobedi ba ka a sebedisang bakeng sa ho buisana mabapi le kgonahalo ya tshebedisano-mmoho le dilekane bakeng sa ho eketsa kgwebisano le matsete pakeng tsa dinaha tsa bo rona.
tgt: Ukubamba iqhaza kwezinkampani zaseNingizimu Afrika kwi-FACIM kutholwe ukubongwa okukhethekile ngenkathi kuneKhomishana Yamazwe Amabili ngesonto eledlule njengenye yezinkundla osomabhizinisi bakulamazwe amabili abangayisebenzisa ukuxoxisana maqondana nokubambisana okungaba khona kanye nezinsebenziswano zokukhuphula uhwebo kanye notshalomali phakathi kwalamazwe akithi.

src: Letona la Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae, Moporofesara Hlengiwe Mkhize, o tla nka karolo ho Dipuisano tsa Matona tsa Bofalli bakeng sa Dinaha tsa Borwa ba Aforika tse tla tshwarelwa naheng ya Borena ba Swaziland ho tloha ka la 2 ho isa ka la 4 Loetse 2017.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezasekhaya, uSolwazi uHlengiwe Mkhize, uzobamba iqhaza Enkulumweni-ngxoxo yoNgqongqoshe Yokufuduka Kwabantu yeAfrika eseNingizimu ezobanjelwa eSwaziland kusukela mhla zi-2 kuya mhla zi-4 kuMandulo 2017.

src: Morero ka kakaretso wa ketsahalo ena ke ho kgothaletsa puisano hara ditho tsa dipuso tsa SADC ho ntlafatsa taolo ya bofalli ka hara lebatowa.
tgt: Injongo ephelele yalo mcimbi ukuqinisa inkulumo-ngxoxo phakathi kwamazwe angamalungu e-SADC ukwenza ngcono ukuphathwa kokufuduka kwabantu esifundeni.

src: Dintlha tse tla sekasekwa di kenyeletsa tlhokahalo ya puso e tsitsitseng, bofalli, bolaodi ba meedi le bofalli ba basebetsi.
tgt: Izindaba okumele zibhekisiswe zibandakanya ukungabi nazwe lilikhaya lakho, ukufuduka kwabantu, ukuphathwa kwemingcele kanye nokufuduka kwabasebenzi.

src: Melaetsa.
tgt: Imiyalezo.

src: Kabinete e hlahisitse matshediso a yona a tebileng le kutlwelo-bohloko ho:Letona la Sepolesa Fikile Mbalula le lelapa la hae ho latela ho hlokahala ha mme wa hae, Mama Emma Mbalula.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izwakalisa amazwi ayo enduduzo kulaba:UNgqongqoshe Wamaphoyisa uFikile Mbalula kanye nomndeni wakhe kulandela ukwedlula emhlabeni kukamama wakhe, uMama Emma Mbalula.

src: E se e ka ba ka thola matla a ho tobana le bothata le lehlaba le tebileng le tliswang ke ho lahlehelwa ke mme lelapeng leha e ka ba lefe.
tgt: Engathi bengathola amandla okubhekana nobuhlungu obujulile obuza nokudlula emhlabeni kukamama wakunoma yiliphi ikhaya.

src: baratuwa ba basebeletsi ba bararo ba morafo bao ho tiisitsweng ba hlokahetse ho latela ho putlama mpeng ya lefatshe ha Morafo wa Kusasalethu haufi le Cartonville Gauteng, ka lebakala ho reketla ha lefatshe ho ngodisitseng Sekaleng sa Richter.
tgt: izihlobo zabasebenzi abathathu basezimayini abesebeqinisekisiwe ukuthi bashonile kulandela ukudilika komgodi waseMayini iKusasalethu eduze kwaseCartonville eGauteng, ngenxa yokundindizela komhlaba okuqophe u-1.8 eSikalini sikaRichter.

src: Kabinete e tshepa hore barafi ba bang ba babedi ba so tholahale ba tla pholoswa ke moifo wa patlo o ntseng o sebetsa hajwale le ho imoloha hore bongata ba barafi ba ile ba tliswa ka hodima lefatshe ka polokeho le hara kotsi ena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inethemba lokuthi abavukuzi ababili abasadukile bazotakulwa ngamathimba abatakuli angaphansi komhlaba sikhuluma nje futhi isikhululekile ngenxa yokuthi inqwaba yabavukuzi ikhishelwe ngaphandle iphephile phakathi nalesi sigameko.

src: Mmuso le batho ba Rephabliki ya Sierra Leone ho latela tse ding tsa dikgohola tse mpe ka ho fetisisa ka hara kontinente ya bo rona.
tgt: uHulumeni kanye nabantu beRepublic of Sierra Leone kulandela esinye isigameko sezikhukhula ezimbi kakhulu esezake zaba khona ezwenikazi lethu.

src: Koduwa ena ya tlholeho e ripitlile dikarolo tsa bohlokwa tsa naha eo, e leng se bakileng tahlehelo e kgolo ya maphelo, tshenyo ya thepa le ho siya koduwa e matla ya botho.
tgt: Le nhlekelele yezemvelo ishaqe izingxenye ezisemqoka zakuleliya lizwe, nokuholele ekulahlekeni kwemiphefumulo eminingi kakhulu, ukucekeleka phansi kwempahla kanye nokushiya ngemuva inkambabeyibuza yenhlekelele yoluntu.

src: Ka DIRCO, Aforika Borwa e nyehetse ka R8 milione bakeng sa thuso koduweng ena.
tgt: Ngokusebenzisa i-DIRCO, iNingizimu Afrika ithembisa ukufaka izigidi eziyi-8 zamarandi ukusiza ukubhekana nale nhlekelele.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, la 13 Loetse 2017, Tuynhuys, Motse Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yabamba umhlangano wayo ngoLwesithathu mhla ziyi-13 kuMandulo 2017 e-Tuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Dintlha tsa hajwale.
tgt: Izindaba Ezisematheni.

src: Moruo.
tgt: Ezomnotho.

src: Kabinete e amohela kgolo e ntle ya Palohohle ya Dihlahiswa tsa Naha (GDP) ya 2.5% kotareng ya bobedi ya selemo sa 2017, e leng e ntshitseng naha ka hara ho putlama ha moruo wa setekginiki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izwakalise ukuthokoza kwayo ngokukhula kweSamba Somkhiqizo Wezwe (i-GDP) ngama-2.5% ekoteni yesibili yowezi-2017, osekwenze ukuba leli lizwe liphume kwinzikamnotho ebeselingene kuyona.

src: Bekeng e fetileng, Lefapha la Dipalopalo la Aforika Borwa (Stats SA) le lokolotse dipalo, tse bontshang kgolo ya selemo-ka-selemo ya 1.1%.
tgt: Izibalo ezibonisa lokhu zikhishwe wuphiko Lwezezibalo eNingizimu Afrika (i-Stats SA) ngeviki eledlule, futhi lokhu kusho ukuthi umnotho ukhule ngama-1.1% uma kuqhathaniswa nesikhathi sifanayo ngonyaka odlule.

src: Leha re shebile ka leihlo le tjhatsi le tshepisang, Kabinete e kgodisehile hore naha e bona matshwao a pele a matle ao e tshepang hore sena ke qalo ya ho iphumana ha moruo wa naha a ahilweng hodima ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong, oo morero wa ona e leng ho hodisa moruo wa Aforika Borwa le ho hlahisa mesebetsi e batlehang haholo.
tgt: Nakuba iKhabhinethi ingathandi ukuphanga umdaka lingakani, iyakholelwa ukuthi izwe seliqalile ukubona izinkomba zokuqala zokusimama komnotho okwakhelwe phezu kwesisekelo esiqinile soHlelo Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye, okuhloswe ngalo ukukhulisa umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika futhi kudalwe namathuba omsebenzi adingeka kakhulu kuleli.

src: Sena se bakile hore ho thakgolwe diphaka tse nne tsa diindaseteri le ho phahama ha dihlahiswa tsa temo tse tala tse rekisetswang dinaha tsa ka ntle kgahlanong le tse kenang ka hara naha ka palohare ya 14.6% ka selemo ho tloha ka selemo sa Lenaneo la Boradiindaseteri ba Batho ba Batsho Ie se le tsheheditse diporojeke tse 62 tse hohetseng R26 bilione matseteng a lekala la poraefete le ho bopa mesebetsi e 19 859 ho fihlela kajeno.
tgt: Lokhu sekuholele ekwethulweni kwezizinda zomnotho ezine kanye nokukhula kwemikhiqizo yezolimo engakalungiswa ethunyelwa emazweni angaphandle, ngama-14.6% ngonyaka kusukela ngowezi-20.

src: Ho tshehetsa tlhahiso ya lehae, dihlahiswa le makala a 21 di rerilwe bakeng sa tlhahiso ya lehae.
tgt: Uhlelo Losozimboni Abamnyama selusekele imiklamo engama-62, ehehe utshalomali oluvela emkhakheni ozimele olungamarandi angamabhiliyoni angama-26 futhi kuze kube manje seludale namathuba omsebenzi ayizi-19 859.

src: Operation Phakisa ho fihlela mona e se e butse matsete a akanngwang ho R.6 bilione moruong wa mawatle, moo mmuso o nyehetseng R15 bilione ya tjhelete ena.
tgt: Ngenhloso yokweseka ukulungiswa kwemikhiqizo kuleli, kuhlonzwe imikhiqizo nemikhakha engama-21 ezokhiqizwa futhi ilungiswe ngaphakathi kuleli.

src: Leha matsete haholo e le a ntshetsopele ya meralo ya motheo ya maemakepe, tlhahiso ya dihlahiswa tsa thepa ya lewatleng ka ho qolleha kaho ya dikepe, diphedi tsa lewatle le diphuputso tsa saense lekaleng la oli le kgase, mafapha a mmalwa a Mmuso a entse dinyehelo tse bonahalang ho netefatsa kgolo ya lekala lena.
tgt: Kuze kube manje, umkhakhanso we-Operation Phakisa usuvule amathuba otshalomali olulinganiselwa kumabhiliyoni angama-24.6 amarandi emkhakheni wezomnotho wasolwandle, futhi kulesi sisamba uhulumeni ufake utshalomali olungamarandi angamabhiliyoni ayi-15.Nakuba utshalomali lugxile ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokuthuthukiswa kwengqalasizinda yezikhumulo zemikhumbi, nowemikhiqizo yasolwandle, ikakhulukazi ukwakhiwa kwezikebhe, nowokufuywa nokulinywa kwezilwane nezitshalo zasolwandle kanye nezingcwaningo zesayensi emkhakheni wemikhiqizo kawoyela negesi yemvelo, iminyango kahulumeni isifake isandla esibonakalayo impela emizamweni yokuqinisekisa ukukhula kwalo mkhakha.

src: Palo ka kakaretso ya mesebetsi e 6 517 e hlahisitswe makaleng a fapafapaneng.
tgt: Sekudaleke amathuba omsebenzi ayizi-6 517 emikhakheni ehlukahlukene.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa kgoeletso ya yona ho mafapha kaofela a setjhaba, ka ho qolleha mmuso, dikgwebo le setjhaba ka kakaretso, ho ahella hodima lebelo le letle le unnweng nakong ya kotara ya bobedi ho tsitlallela sekgahla se phahameng sa kgolo ya moruo le ntshetsopele, le ho thusa ka ho baballa mesebetsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithanda ukugcizelela phezu kwekhwela eliqondiswe kuyo yonke imikhakha yomphakathi, ikakhulukazi uhulumeni, amabhizinisi kanye nezinhlangano zomphakathi wonkana, lokuba kwakhelwe emfuthweni omuhle wokukhula komnotho otholakale ngekota yesibili yonyaka ukuze kuqhutshekelwe phambili namazinga aphakeme entuthuko nokukhula komnotho, futhi ngalokho kuvinjelwe nokulahleka kwamathuba omsebenzi.

src: Letona la Ditjhelete, Monghadi Malusi Gigaba, o tswela pele ho buisana le makala a fapafapaneng mabapi le moralo wa tshebetso wa kgolo ya moruo e kenyeletsang, e rerilweng ho hlohleletsa tshepo ka hara naha.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezezimali, uMnu Malusi Gigaba, uyaqhubeka nokufakana imilomo nemikhakha ehlukahlukene mayelana nohlelo lokusebenza lokuqinisekisa ukukhula komnotho okubandakanya bonke abantu, futhi kulindeleke ukuba lokhu kukhuthaze ukwethenjwa kwaleli lizwe ngabatshalizimali.

src: Letona le tla boela le hlopholla sena ha le fana ka Pehelo ya Leano la Ditekanyetso la Nako e Bohareng Palamenteng, Motse Kapa, ka la 18 Mphalane 2017.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe uzohlinzeka ngemininingwane ethe xaxa ngalokhu ngenkathi ethula iSitatimende Senqubomgomo Yesabelomali Sesikhathi Esimaphakathi ePhalamende mhla ziyi-18 kuMfumfu 2017.

src: Lebenkele le Abelanang ka Ditshebeletso Tsohle la InvestSA – Kapa Bophirima.
tgt: Isikhungo esihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo i-InvestSA One Stop Shop – saseNtshonalanga Kapa.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse ho thakgolwa ha Lebenkele le Abelanang ka Ditshebeletso Tsohle la InvestSA la pele ka hara porofense.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikushayela ihlombe ukwethulwa kwesikhungo esihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene ngaphansi kophahla olulodwa, i-InvestSA One Stop Shop, okungesokuqala ngqa ukwethulwa esifundazweni.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o thakgotse semmuso Lebenkele le Abelanang ka Ditshebeletso Tsohle la InvestSA ho la Kapa Bophirima le ho tiisa boitlamo ba mmuso ba ho ntlafatsa maemo a botsetedi ka hara Aforika Borwa, e leng sebaka se hohelang sa batsetedi ba ka bang teng.
tgt: UMongameli Jacob Zuma wasethula ngokusemthethweni lesi sikhungo esifundazweni saseNtshonalanga Kapa futhi wagcizelela ukuthi uhulumeni usazibophezele ngempela ukwenza ngcono isimo sokutshalwa kwezimali eNingizimu Afrika, njengoba iyizwe elihlinzeka ngamathuba amahle kakhulu kulabo abanesifiso sokutshala izimali zabo kuleli.

src: Lebenkele le Abelanang ka Ditshebeletso Tsohle la InvestSA Ie fokotsa ditjeho tsa ho etsa kgwebo le ho bebofatsa ho etsa kgwebo ka hara naha ka ho fana ka mawa a tataiso, ho fokotsa dikgaello tsa melawana le ho fokotsa mehato e mengata ya semolao bakeng sa batsetedi.
tgt: Lesi sikhungo sizokwenza kube lula ukwenza ibhizinisi kuleli futhi sinciphise nezindleko zalokhu ngokuhlinzeka ngosizo nomhlahlandlela onohlonze kubatshalizimali kanye nokunciphisa izihibe ezibangelwa wukungalawulwa kahle kwenqubo yokwenza ibhizinisi kuleli futhi kususwe nezithiyo ezivimbela noma ezibambezela ukwenziwa kwebhizinisi ngokushesha.

src: Lebenkele la Mmuso le Abelanang ka Ditshebeletso Tsohle la InvestSA le Thakgotswe ka Hlakubele selemong sena mme ka Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri (dti), Lebenkele le Abelanang ka Ditshebeletso Tsohle la InvestSA le tla thehwa diporofenseng kaofela tse robong – pele le tla thakgolwa ho la Kapa Bophirima mme e latelwe ke KwaZulu-Natal le Gauteng ka tatelano.
tgt: I-InvestSA One Stop Shop Kahulumeni yethulwa ngoNdasa kulo nyaka futhi ngokusebenzisa uMnyango Wezohwebo Nezezimboni (i-dti), kuzosungulwa izikhungo ezinjengalesi kuzo zonke izifundazwe zakuleli eziyisishiyagalolunye – njengoba esokuqala sesisunguliwe eNtshonalanga Kapa kuzolandela iKwaZulu-Natali ne-Gauteng.

src: Sehopotso sa bo-5 sa Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP)1.
tgt: Umgubho weminyaka emihlanu kwasungulwa uHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP)1.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le maAforika Borwa mabapi le ho keteka Sehopotso sa bo-5 sa NDP, eo e ileng ya amohelwa ke Palamente ka la 12 Loetse 2012 jwaloka moralo wa naha wa ntshetsopele ya moruo wa kahisano bakeng sa ho tobana le diphephetso tse tharo tsa bofuma, tlhokeho ya mesebetsi le ho se lekalekane ka selemo sa Jwaloka mmapa wa naha o lebisang mononong, NDP ke ya maAforika Borwa kaofela mme e emela ditakatso le ditabatabelo ho tswa Makaleng kaofela a setjhaba, bakeng sa Aforika Borwa e betere.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo njengabantu baseNingizimu Afrika igubha ukuhlangana kweminyaka emihlanu kwasungulwa i-NDP, eyamukelwa ngokusemthethweni yiPhalamende mhla ziyi-12 kuMandulo 2012 njengohlelo olungumhlahlandlela onohlonze wokuthuthukiswa kwenhlalo-mnotho kuleli, okuhloswe ngalo ukubhekana ngqo nezinselelo ezintathu ezinkulu: ububha, ukuntuleka kwamathuba omsebenzi kanye nokungalingani okukhona kuleli, ngaphambi kokuba kufike unyaka wezi-20.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho tshehetsa Tjhebelopele ya 2030 ya NDSeboka sa BRICKabinete e lemohile Seboka sa bo-9 se atlehileng sa Brazil, Russia, India, China le Aforika Borwa (BRICS), se neng se tshwaretswe Xiamen ka hara Riphabliki ya Batho ba China (PRC) ho tloha ka la 3 ho isa ka la 5 Loetse 2017 tlasa mookotaba: “BRICS: Bolekane bo Matla, bolekane bakeng sa Bokamoso bo Kganyang”.
tgt: Njengomhlahlandlela ophokophele ekuchumeni kwezwe, i-NDP ingeyabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika futhi imele amathemba nezifiso zayo yonke imikhakha yemiphakathi yakuleli, zokuphila eNingizimu Afrika engcono kakhulu kunakuqala.

src: Seboka se theha mokolokotwane wa bohlokwa o lebisitseng kahong ya kopano e matla le tshebedisano-mmoho hara mebaraka e ntseng e runya le dinaha tse ntseng di tswela pele ho kenya tshebetsong Lenaneo la 2030 bakeng sa Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabanxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba bayeseke ngokuphelele iNhloso-mbono yowezi-2030 eshiwo ku-NDINgqungquthela ye-BRICIKhabhinethi iyiphawulile iNgqungquthela yesi-9 ye-Brazil, Russia, India, China kanye neNingizimu Afrika (i-BRICS) ebanjwe ngempumelelo enkulu e-Xiamen kwelase-China kusukela mhla zi-3 kuya kumhla zi-5 kuMandulo 2017 ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “I-BRICS: Ubambiswano Oluqinile Oluzoletha Ikusasa Eliqhakazile”.

src: Bolekane ba Aforika Borwa le BRICS bo thehilwe hodima ntshetsopele ya ditabatabelo tsa naha, ho hodisa kopano ya lebatowa le ho kgothaletsa tsamaiso e kenyeletsang ya taolo lefatsheng.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ithathe igxathu elinohlonze eliphokophele ekwakhiweni kobumbano nokusebenzisana okuqinile phakathi kwamazwe asafufusa nasathuthuka ukuze kuqaliswe i-Ajenda yowezi-2030 yokuletha iNtuthuko Esimeme.

src: Kgwebisano ka botlalo ya dinaha tse pedi pakeng tsa Aforika Borwa le dinaha tse ding tsa BRICS e fihlile ho US$29 bilione selemong se fetileng.
tgt: Ubambiswano lweNingizimu Afrika ku-BRICS lusekelwe phezu kokuqhutshekiselwa phambili kwezimfuno nezidingo zaleli lizwe, ukugqugquzela ubumbano lwesifunda kanye nokukhuthaza uhlelo lokuphatha nokulawula emhlabeni jikelele olubandakanya bonke abathintekayo.

src: Sebaka sa thomello ya kantle ya thepa se seholo ka ho fetisisa sa Aforika Borwa ka hara BRICS e dutse e le China, e latelwa ke India, Brazil le Russia.
tgt: Ngonyaka odlule, umthamo ophelele wohwebo phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika namanye amazwe e-BRICS wafinyelela kwisamba esingamadola aseMelika angamabhiliyoni angama-29.

src: Paterone e tshwanang le ena hape e bonahala tabeng ya thepa e kenang ka hara naha, moo China e dutseng e le mohlodi o moholo wa thepa e rekisetswang ka Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Izwe le-BRICS okuthunyelwa kulona kakhulu imikhiqizo yaseNingizimu Afrika kusalokhu kuyi-China, kulandele i-India, Brazil kanye ne-Russia.

src: Leha Aforika Borwa e na le mehlodi ya tlhaho e mengata, ho hlokolosi ho kenya tshebetsong mananeo a bokgolamolemo ho tshehetsa leano la rona la kaho ya diindaseteri.
tgt: Kubonakala isimo esifanayo futhi uma kuza odabeni lwemikhiqizo evela emazweni angaphandle engena kuleli, njengoba i-China isalokhu ingumthombo omkhulukazi wempahla yakwamanye amazwe engena eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ho amohelwa ha Tumellano ya BRICS ya Xiamen le Moralo wa Tshebetso ho hlakisitse motheo o matla oo BRICS e o entseng mabapi le ho thehwa ha mekgwa ya dikaho bakeng sa tshebedisano-mmoho e tiileng.
tgt: Nakuba iNingizimu Afrika iyizwe elicebe kakhulu ngezimbiwa, kusemqoka ukuba kusungulwe izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukulungiswa kwemikhiqizo yezimbiwa ngaphakathi kuleli lizwe ngenhloso yokusekela inqubomgomo yethu yokusungulwa kwezimboni kuleli.

src: Kabinete e hlomphehile ka hore Aforika Borwa ke Modulasetulo ya tla tshwara marapo wa BRICS le ho tiiselletsa sepheo sa yona sa ho ba ka pele bakeng sa ho ahella hodima lenaneo la BRICS la ntshetsopele le monono bakeng sa dinaha tsa selekane, jwaloka ha e itokisetsa ho tshwara Seboka sa bo-10 sa BRICS ka selemo sa 2018. forika Borwa le Russia di saena tumellano.
tgt: Ukwamukelwa kwesiMemezelo se-BRICS Esisemthethweni sase-Xiamen kanye noHlelo Lokusebenza kwagcizelela isisekelo esiqinile esenziwe yi-BRICS ekusungulweni kwezindlela eziphusile zokuletha ubambiswano olunohlonze futhi olubonakalayo.

src: Kabinete e boela e amohela tumellano e saennweng pakeng tsa Aforika Borwa le Russia Sebokeng sa bo-9 sa BRICS, e tla hlahisa tjhelete e lakanang le US$400 milione e tla tsetelwa bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya lekala la oli le kgase la Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakuthokozela ukuhlonishwa kweNingizimu Afrika njengoba izothatha izintambo njengoSihlalo omusha we-BRICS futhi lokhu kuzoqinisa izinhloso zayo zokwakhela phezu kohlelo lwe-BRICS lokuqinisekisa ukuthuthuka nokuchuma kwamazwe abambisene ku-BRICS, njengoba ilungiselela ukusingatha iNgqungquthela ye-10 ye-BRICS ngowezi-2018.

src: Khamphani ya oli ya naha ya Aforika Borwa, PetroSA, le khamphani ya Federeishene ya Russia ya diphuputso tsa sebopeho sa mobu, Rosgeo, di dumellane ho ntshetsapele dibaka tsa ho fuputsa tsa diboloko tsa 9 le 11a Lebopong le ka Borwa la Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isamukela ngezandla ezimhlophe isivumelwano esisayinwe yiNingizimu Afrika ne-Russia ngenkathi kubanjwe iNgqungquthela ye-BRICS yesi-9, esizoletha utshalomali olungamadola aseMelika ayizigidi ezingama-400 oluzofakwa ekuthuthukisweni komkhakha kawoyela negesi yemvelo waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ho batlana le mehlodi ya oli le kgase ka hara Aforika Borwa ke ntlha e kgolo ya lewa la polokeho ya eneji ya naha.
tgt: Inkampani kawoyela yaseNingizimu Afrika, i-PetroSA, kanye nenkampani yezwe lase-Russia ecinga futhi ithungathe izimbiwa emathunjini omhlaba, ebizwa ngokuthi yi-Rosgeo, sezenze isivumelwano sokuthungathwa kwezimbiwa kwisiqeshana somhlaba ongunombolo 9 no-11a oGwini Oluseningizimu lwezwe laseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Rosgeo ya Russia e tla etsa mosebetsi wa diphuputso tsa mobu hammoho le ho tjheka didiba tsa diphuputso.
tgt: Ukuthungathwa nokucingwa kwezimbiwa zikawoyela negesi yemvelo eNingizimu Afrika kuyinto esemqoka kakhulu ekuqinisekisweni kokutholakala kwamandla ezibaseli anele kuleli.

src: Porojeke ena e ka baka hore ho be le ho epollwa ha dikhubiki mithara tse dimilione tse nne tsa kgase ka letsatsi mme qetellong e tla romellwa tlhwekisong ya PetroSA Gas-To-Liquids maane Mossel Bay, Lebopong le ka Borwa.
tgt: Inkampani yase-Russia, i-Rosgeo, izokwenza umsebenzi wokuthungatha izimbiwa emathunjini omhlaba, iphinde futhi yenze nomsebenzi wokubhola nokumba imigodi ejulile okuzocingwa kuyona izimbiwa.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa dti mabapi le ho etella pele moifo wa dikhamphani tse 20 tsa Aforika Borwa dipontshong tsa selemo sa 2017 tsa Moscow tsa Dijo tsa Lefatshe, tse ntseng di tswela pele ho fihlela ka la 15 Loetse Ha re ntse re hodisa indaseteri ya tswelliso ya dihlahiswa tsa temo tsa Aforika Borwa, bonkakarolo ba dikhamphani tsena tsa lehae ho tswa lekaleng la tswelliso ya dihlahiswa tsa temo, bo matlafatsa le ho theha boteng ba Aforika Borwa ka hara mmaraka ona ho la Russia.
tgt: Lo mklamo ungaholela ekutheni kumpontshwe futhi kukhishwe igesi yemvelo engamakhubhikhi-mitha ayizigidi ezine nsuku zonke futhi emva kwalokho ithunyelwe kwisikhungo esihluza imikhiqizo kawoyela negesi yemvelo se-PetroSA esise-Mossel Bay, oGwini Oluseningizimu, lapho kuGuqulwa khona Igesi Yemvelo ibe Yisibaseli Esiwuketshezi.

src: Bonkakarolo ba bona bo kgonne ho ba teng ka lebaka la Sekema sa Mebaraka ya ka ntle le Thuso ya Matsete sa dti, e leng se thusang haholo mabapi le ho ntshetsapele mebaraka ya thomello ya thepa dinaheng tsa ka ntle bakeng sa dihlahiswa tsa Aforika Borwa le ditshebeletso, hammoho le ho thaotha matsete a otlolohileng ho tla ka hara naha.
tgt: Amazwe angaphandle okuthunyelwa kuwona impahla ekhiqizwe eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kgwebisano pakeng tsa Aforika Borwa le Russia e eketsehile ka bokgabane ho tloha ho R5 bilione ka selemo sa 2012 ho ya ho se batlang se etsa R8 bilione ka selemo sa 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela i-dti ngokuhola iqembu lezinkampani zaseNingizimu Afrika ezingama-20 eziyingxenye yombukiso wezi-2017 wase-Moscow Wamazwe Ngamazwe Wokudla, oqhubekayo njengamanje kuze kube ngumhla ziyi-15 kuMandulo Njengoba ukubamba iqhaza kwalezi zinkampani zakuleli ezivela emkhakheni wokulungiswa kwemikhiqizo yezolimo kugqugquzela futhi kukhangise imboni yaseNingizimu Afrika yokulungiswa kwemikhiqizo yezolimo, kuphinda kuqininise futhi kuqinisekise ukuba khona kwezinkampani zaseNingizimu Afrika ezihweba futhi zenza ibhizinisi kwelase-Russia.

src: Thepa e kgolo e romellwang ka ntle ya Aforika Borwa e kenyeletsa ditholwana le matokomane, manya a mankanisi, dino, dispiriti le asene, veine, metjhini ya motlakase le thepa.
tgt: Ukubamba kwazo iqhaza kwenzeke ngosizo oluvela oHlelweni Lokugqugquzela Ukukhangiswa Nokuthunyelwa Kwezimpahla Zakuleli Emazweni Angaphandle kanye Nosizo Oluqondiswe Kubatshalizimali lwe-dti, okuwuhlelo olufaka isandla esikhulu ekufuneni amazwe angaphandle okuzothunyelwa kuwona impahla nezinsizakalo zakuleli futhi kusenjalo kuhehwe notshalomali olusha olungena ngqo kuleli.

src: Kabinete e tshwenyehile ka diketsahalo tsa haufinyana tjena tsa tshebediso ya bana moo ho fumanweng bana ba sebetsa mapolasing ka hara Leboya Bophirima le Foreistata.
tgt: Imikhiqizo yaseNingizimu Afrika ethunyelwa kakhulu emazweni angaphandle ibandakanya izithelo namantongomane, ugologo novinika, iwayini kanye nemishini esebenza ngogesi.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe tshebediso e mpe le tshotlo ena e sa amoheleheng ya bana ba kotsing.
tgt: Ukusetshenziswa kwezingane.1 IKhabhinethi ikhathazekile ngezigameko zakamuva zokusetshenziswa kwezingane, lapho kutholakale izingane zisebenza emapulazini esifundazweni saseNyakatho Ntshonalanga kanye naseFreyistata.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa ditho tsa setjhaba tse lemositseng Lefapha la Mesebetsi leo, hammoho le Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba, ba sebeditseng ka potlako ho sebetsana ka toka le mokgwa ona o sisimosang wa tshebediso e mpe ya bana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakugxeka lokhu kuxhashazwa nokusetshenziswa kwezingane ezintulayo, okuyinto engamukelekile neze.2 IKhabhinethi iyawancoma impela lawo malungu omphakathi abikele uMnyango Wezabasebenzi, futhi ngokuhlanganyela noMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi, lo mnyango uthathe izinyathelo ngokushesha zokubhekana ngqo nalesi senzo esibi kangaka sokuxhashazwa kwezingane.3 IKhabhinethi iyakuthokozela ukuthi lezi zingane ezithintekile sezithathiwe zathunyelwa endaweni ephephile, futhi iyakuthokozela nokuthi uMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi uzoqinisa imikhankaso yawo yokuqapha nokuhlola izizinda okusetshenzelwa kuzona futhi uzosebenzisana nezikhungo zokuqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa komthetho ukuze baboshwe futhi bajeziswe ngendlela efanelekile abenzi bobubi.4 Izingane zethu ziyingomuso lezwe.

src: Kabinete e thabisitswe ke hore bana ba amehang ba falliseditswe dibakeng tsa polokeho le hore Lefapha la mesebetsi le tla matlafatsa ditlhatlhobo le ho sebetsa mmoho le makala a qobello ya molao ho tshwara baetsi ba sena ba molato.4 .
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazigxeka zonke izinhlobo zokusetshenziswa kwezingane futhi iyabanxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba bahlale beqaphile ngaso sonke isikhathi futhi babikele iziphathimandla ngalabo abephula imigomo nezimiso zoMthethosisekelo wezwe lethu.5 UMthetho Wezikole ZaseNingizimu Afrika we-1996 (uMthetho wama-84 we-1996) ngokuhlanganyela noMthetho Wezingane, wezi-2005 (uMthetho wama-38 wezi-2005) ubeka umyalelo ocacile wokuthi zonke izingane ezineminyaka yobudala ephakathi kweyisikhombisa neyi-15 ziphoqelekile ukuba zibe sesikoleni.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe dibopeho kaofela tsa tshebediso ya bana le ho ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho dula ba fadimehile ka dinako tsohle le ho tlaleha ba tlolang dipehelo tsa Molaotheo wa rona.5 .
tgt: Ngokuyalela komthetho, abazali nabalondolozi bezingane kumele baqinisekise ukuthi izingane ezineminyaka eshiwo ngenhla zibhalisiwe futhi ziyaya esikoleni nsuku zonke futhi uma bengakwenzi lokhu kungenzeka babhekane nomthelela ongemuhle wokwephula umthetho.

src: Komello.
tgt: Isomiso.

src: Kabinete e lebohela bohle ka hara Aforoka Borwa ba mametseng kgoeletso ya ho baballa metsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabonga kakhulu kulabo bantu baseNingizimu Afrika abasabelile ekhweleni lokongiwa kwamanzi.

src: Aforika Borwa ke naha e nang le kgaello ya metsi mme maemo a komello a ntseng a tswela pele dikarolong tse ding tsa naha ke kgopotso ho batho bohle ya ho baballa lerothodi ka leng ka ho sebedisa metsi ka bohlale le ka paballo.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika iyizwe elingenawo kahle amanzi futhi izimo zesomiso ezilokhu ziqhubeke njalo ezindaweni ezithile zezwe ziyisikhumbuzo kubo bonke abantu bakuleli sokuba balisebenzise ngobuhlakani iconsi ngalinye lamanzi futhi bawasebenzise ngokuwonga.

src: Leha mekutu ya ho baballa metsi e thusa ho fokotsa kgatello hodima mohlodi wa metsi a pula ya sehla e tlase ho feta tlwaelo ka hara Kapa Bophirima le KwaZulu-Natal ke bopaki ba hore ho lokelwa ho etswa ho hongata bakeng sa ho baballa metsi.
tgt: Nakuba imizamo yokonga amanzi ilekelela ekunciphiseni ingcindezi ekhona phezu kwemithombo yamanzi, isilinganiso esiphansi kunesejwayelekile sezimvula ezibikwe esifundazweni saseNtsholalanga Kapa naKwaZulu-Natali siwubufakazi bokuthi kusekuningi okumele kwenziwe ngenhloso yokonga amanzi.

src: Moifo wa Tshebetso wa Kopanelo wa Matona mabapi le komello, o eteletsweng pele ke Lefapha la Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Setso, o tswela pele ho beha leihlo maemong a komello le ho fana ka tshehetso e hlokahalang ka makala a mafapha ho bebofatsa boemo bona.
tgt: Ithimba LoNgqongqoshe Beminyango Ehlukahlukene Abajutshwe Umsebenzi Wokubhekana Nesomiso, liholwa nguMnyango Wokwengamela Ngokubambisana Nezindaba Zendabuko, liyaqhubeka nokuqapha izimo zesomiso kanye nokuhlinzeka ngosizo oludingekayo ngokusebenzisa iminyango efanelekile ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela omubi obangelwa yilesi simo sesomiso.

src: Mmuso o beheletse ka thoko R74 milione e le letlole la pebofatso bakeng sa ho arabela mabapi le komello e ntseng e tswela pele ka hara Kapa Bophirima.
tgt: Uhulumeni usehlinzeke ngemali engamarandi ayizigidi ezingama-74 okuhloswe ngayo ukulekelela ezimweni ezinzima ezibangelwa yisomiso esilokhu siqhubeke njalo eNtshonalanga Kapa.

src: Lefapha la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere le lona le hatetse pele ka boitokisetso ba ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Sekema sa Thusetso sa ho tloha Berg River ho ya Voelvlei.
tgt: UMnyango Wezamanzi Nokuthuthwa Kwendle nawo sewenze inqubekela phambili emalungiselelweni okuqaliswa koHlelo Lokukhuphula Umthamo Wamanzi Ngokudonsa Amanzi Omfula i-Berg River Ayofakwa Edamini i-Voelvlei.

src: Rekoto ya qeto ya Tekolo ya Kgahlamelo ya Tikoloho e lokelwa ho fumantshwa mafelong a Loetse.
tgt: Irekhodi lesinqumo sokuHlolwa Komthelela Walokhu Kwimvelo kulindeleke ukuba lihlinzekwe ngaphambi kokuphela kwenyanga kaMandulo.

src: Letona la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere, Mofumahadi Nomvula Mokonyane, o se a laetse Bolaodi ba Tonele ya Trans-Caledon ho tla ka ditjhelete le ho kenya tshebetsong porojeke ena.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezamanzi Nokuthuthwa Kwendle, uNkz Nomvula Mokonyane, useyalele uphiko i-Trans-Caledon Tunnel Authority ukuba lwenze imizamo yokuthola izimali bese luqalisa lo mklamo.

src: Ba se ba qadile ho buisana le basebedisi ba baholo mme haufinyana ba tla buisana le Letona bakeng sa tumellano le Letona la Ditjhelete mabapi le ditekanyo tsa dikadimo bakeng sa porojeke ena.
tgt: Lolu phiko seluqalile ukubonisana nabasebenzisi bamanzi abakhulu futhi khona maduze nje luzoxhumana noNgqongqoshe ukuze kuvunyelwane noNgqongqoshe Wezezimali mayelana nemikhawulo yokuboleka izimali ezizosetshenziswa kulo mklamo.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa dikgoeletso ho bohle ba ka hara Aforika Borwa ho netefatsa hore paballo ya metsi e ba teng jwaloka karolo ya bophelo ba bona ba letsatsi ka leng.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyagcizelela ekhweleni eliqondiswe kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika lokuba baqinisekise ukuthi ukongiwa kwamanzi kuba yingxenye yempilo yabo yansuku zonke.

src: Lesotho.
tgt: Eziphathelene nelase-Lesotho.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le Mopresidente Zuma mabapi le ho tshwela ka mathe dipolao tse hlokang kelello tsa Molaodi wa Lebotho la Tshireletso la Lesotho, Mokgenerale Khoantle Motšomotšo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo njengoMongameli Zuma iyakugxeka ukubulawa okungenangqondo koMkhuzi Wombutho Wamasosha ase-Lesotho, uJenene Khoantle Motšomotšo.

src: Ketsahalo ena ya morao-rao ya dikgoka ha e amohelehe.
tgt: Siyinto engamukelekile nakancane lesi sigameko sakamuva sodlame.

src: Jwale ho matsohong a batho le boetapele ba Lesotho ho netefatsa hore kgutso le maemo a tlwaelehileng a kgutlisetswa ka hara Borena e le taba e potlakileng.
tgt: Futhi sekusemahlombe abantu nabaholi base-Lesotho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lubuyiswa ngokushesha okukhulu uzinzo kanye nesimo esijwayelekile kuleliya lizwe.

src: Re dula re na le tshepo ya hore Ketapele ya Matona e Batlisisang Dinnete ya Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tse ka Borwa ba Aforika (SADC) e tla kgona ho thusa Lesotho ho teka maitshunyako a nepahetseng.
tgt: Sisalokhu sinethemba lokuthi iThimba LoNgqongqoshe Abajutshwe Ukuba Bayobheka Isimo futhi Bathole Namaqiniso leNhlangano Yokuthuthukiswa Kwamazwe aseNingizimu ye-Afrika (i-SADC) lizokwazi ukulekelela i-Lesotho ukuba ihlonze izinhlelo nezindlela zokungenelela ezifanelekile.

src: SADC e dula e tiile mererong ya yona ya ho matlafatsa, ho tshireletsa le ho baballa demokerasi, kgotso, polokeho le botsitso ka hara lebatowa mme e sebedisana le boetapele ba Lesotho.
tgt: I-SADC ayikaguquki neze kwinjongo yayo yokuqinisa, ukuvikela kanye nokugcina intando yeningi labantu, ukuthula, ukuvikeleka kanye nozinzo esifundeni ngokusebenzisana nabaholi base-Lesotho.

src: Libya.
tgt: Eziphathelene nelase-Libya.

src: Kabinete e amohela diphetho tsa Komiti ya Boemo bo Phahameng ya Kopano ya Aforika (AU) e mabapi le Libya Boemong ba Dihlooho tsa Dipuso le Mebuso e neng e tshwaretswe Brazzaville, ho la Riphabliki ya Congo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamukela imiphumela yeKomidi Elisezingeni Eliphakeme Eliqondene ne-Libya leNhlangano Yamazwe ase-Afrika (i-AU) eyakhishwa emva koMhlangano Wabaholi Bemibuso Nohulumeni obubanjelwe e-Brazzaville, kwelase-Congo.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o ne a nkile karolo Komiting ya Boemo bo Phahameng, e tshohlileng le ho sheba botjha mekutu e lebisitseng ho tholeng tharollo ya moshwelella mabapi le diqabano tse tswellang ho ba teng ka hara Libya.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma wabamba iqhaza eKomidini Elisezingeni Eliphakeme, elaxoxisana futhi labuyekeza imizamo yokuthola isixazululoesizoqhubeka unomphela kwingxabano nombango oqhubekayo kwelase-Libya.

src: Jwaloka setho sa Komiti ya Boemo bo Phahameng e mabapi le Libya, Aforika Borwa e tshehetsa mekutu kaofela ya AU e reretsweng ho tlisa tharollo ya kgotso bakeng sa koduwa ya Libya.
tgt: Njengelungu leKomidi Elisezingeni Eliphakeme Eliqondene ne-Libya, iNingizimu Afrika iyayeseka yonke imizamo ye-AU okuhloswe ngayo ukuthola isixazululo ngokuthula enkingeni yase-Libya.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa maikutlo a Moporesidente Zuma a hore Aforika Borwa e malala-a-laotswe ho thusa Libya mekutung ya Kamora Kaho Botjha le Ntshetsopele le ho arolelana le yona boiphihlelo ba naha ya bo rona ho tsa poelano, kaho ya molaotheo le phethoho ya demokerasi ya puso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyagcizelela esitatimendeni sikaMongameli Zuma sokuthiiNingizimu Afrika izimisele emizamweni yokuVuselela Kabusha Nokuthuthukisa Izwe lase-Libya Emva Kwenxushunxushu Elibhekene Nayo futhi izimisele nokwabelana ne-Libya ngezifundo ezafundwa yileli lizwe eziphathelene nokubuyisana, ukwakhiwa komthethosisekelo kanye nokuguqulwa koMbuso ngokusebenzisa intando yeningi labantu.

src: Kabinete hape e boeletsa bohlokwa ba dipuisano tsa matjhaba tse hokahaneng tse nang le kutlwano ka hara Libya.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakugcizelela futhi nokubaluleka kokubonisana kwamazwe omhlaba nokulekelela kwawo i-Libya ngendlela ehambelanayo.

src: Pitso ya Mekga (CoP13)1.
tgt: INgqungquthela Yamazwe Abambe Iqhaza (i-CoP13)1.

src: Kabinete e ananela hore Aforika Borwa, jwalo ka mosaenedi ho Khonvenshene ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) ya Twantsho ya Mahwatata, e nka karolo Tulong ya bo-13 ya COP13 e ntseng e tswela pele hajwale Ordos, PRC ho tloha ka la 6 ho isa ka la 16 Loetse Ho lebeletswe hore pitso ena e tla phethela le ho amohela moralo o motjha wa lewa bakeng sa 2018-2030 e hlophisitsweng tlasa mookotaba “Re Lebisa Lefatsheng le Itekanetseng bakeng sa Meloko ya Hajwale le ya Kamoso”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika, njengelizwe elisayine iSivumelwano SeNhlangano Yezizwe (i-UN) Sokulwisana Nokuguquka Kwezindawo Zibe Wugwadule, ibambe iqhaza kwiSigcawu se-13 se-COP13 esiqhubekayo njengamanje e-Ordos, kwelase-China kusukela mhla ziyisi-6 kuze kube ngumhla ziyi-16 kuMandulo Kulindeleke ukuba le ngqungquthela iphothule futhi yamukele uhlaka olukhethekile olusha lowezi 2018-2030 ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi “Sisebenzela Umhlaba Osesimweni Esihle Ukuze Kuhlomule Izizukulwane Ezikhona Njengamanje kanye Nezangomuso”.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla sebetsa ka matla ho netefatsa hore maano a fetolwa ho ba diketso tse phethahalang.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika izosebenzela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo ziyaguqulwa zibe yizinyathelo eziphathekayo futhi ezibonakalayo.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla sebetsa le dinaha kaofela ka hara Aforika mabapi le ho ntshetsapele maemo a naha le a kontinente.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika izosebenzisana nawo wonke amazwe ase-Afrika, iphakamise futhi igcizelele imibono yayo kanye neyelizwekazi.

src: Karolo ya Boemo bo Phahameng ba pitso ena bo tla sekaseka le ho fana ka tataiso ya sepolotiki mabapi le diphephetso tsa dintlha tse ntseng di runya mabapi le mahwatata, ho theoha ha maemo a mobu le komello.
tgt: Ingxenye yale ngqungquthela Esesigabeni Esiphakeme izocubungula futhi ihlinzeke ngomhlahlandlela wokuxazulula izinselelo eziphathelene nezinkinga eziqubukayo zokuguquka komhlaba ube wugwadule, ukucekeleka phansi komhlaba kanye nesomiso.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho tshireletsa le ho hlokomela tikoloho bakeng sa ho e baballa bakeng sa meloko ya kamoso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabanxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba bavikele futhi banakekele imvelo ukuze yongelwe izizukulwane zangomuso.

src: Beng ba dipalangwang tsa setjhaba.
tgt: Abanikazi nabaqhubi bomsebenzi wokuthutha umphakathi.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe diketsahalo tsa dikgoka, ho tjheswa ha makoloi a beng ba thepa le diketso tsa ditshoso pakeng tsa Beng ba Ditekesi tsa Dimithara le Balekane ba E-Hailing tse etsahetseng Sandton, Johannesburg.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazigxeka izenzo zodlame, ukushiswa kwamatekisi kanye nezigameko zokwesabisa phakathi kwaBanikazi Bamatekisi Azimele Asebenzisa Umshini Wemitha Obala Ibanga Elihanjiwe (ama-Meter Taxi Operators) kanye Nabanikazi Bamatekisi Abizwa Ngokusebenzisa Uhlelokusebenza Lukamakhalekhukhwini (i-E- Hailing) ezenzeke e-Sandton, eGoli.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho makala a qobello ya molao ho sebetsana le baetsi ba dikgoka le ditshoso ka hara dipehelo tsa Molaotheo.
tgt: IKhabinethi inxusa izikhungo zokuqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa komthetho ukuba zibhekane ngqo nabaphehli bodlame nokwesabisa, kepha-ke kumele lokhu zikwenze ngaphakathi kwemigomo yokusebenza koMthethosisekelo.

src: Diketsahalo tsena di sutha mekutung ya naha ya ho bopa maemo a kgwebo e lokolohileng le tlhodisano e hlokang leeme.
tgt: Lezi zigameko ziphazamisa imizamo eqinile eseyenziwe yileli lizwe ukwakha isimo lapho abantu behweba ngokukhululeka futhi ngaphansi kokuncintisana okuhle, ngaphandle kokwesatshiswa nokwenzelela.

src: Balekgotla.
tgt: Amakhansela.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe ditlhaselo le dipolao tsa balekgotla ka hara diporofense tse ding le ho fetisetsa matshediso a yona ho malapa le metswalle ya ba bolauweng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakugxeka ukuhlaselwa nokubulawa kwamakhansela kwezinye zezifundazwe zakuleli futhi idlulisa ukudabuka kwayo kanye namazwi enduduzo emindenini nakubangani balawo makhansela abulewe.

src: Sena se kgahlanong le dipehelo tsa boitshwaro tsa Molaotheo, le ho sutha demokerasing ya rona ya tswelopele le tokelo ya batho ya ho kgetha baemedi ba bona ba setjhaba.
tgt: Lokhu kuphambene kakhulu nenkambiso namagugu-mgomo oMthethosisekelo, futhi kudicilela phansi isithunzi sombuso wentando yeningi labantu othuthukisayo, nelungelo labantu lokukhetha abameleli babo njengomphakathi.

src: Esale ho tloha qalong ya selemo, ho bile le mafu a mmalwa ka hara KwaZulu-Natal, mme haufinyana tjena, ho tlalehilwe mafu ka hara Kapa Botjhabela.
tgt: Kusukela ekuqaleni konyaka, sekubulawe amakhansela amaningana esifundazweni saKwaZulu-Natali futhi kamuva nje kubikwe ukuthi naseMpumalanga Kapa kukhona amakhansela asebulewe.

src: Dikgoka tsena di nkile maphelo a balwanedi ba tokoloho ba batjha, ho kenyeletswa le Mongodi Kakaretso wa mehleng wa Liki ya Batjha ya ANC (ANCYL) Sindiso Magaqa, ya neng a sa ntsane a na le se sengata seo a ka se nyehelang mabapi le ho aha Aforika Borwa e tswetseng pele.
tgt: Lolu dlame seluthathe izimpilo zabantu abasha abebeyizishoshovu ezilwela umphakathi, kubandakanya noNobhala-Jikelele waphambilini woPhiko Lwentsha LukaKhongolose (i-ANCYL), uSindiso Magaqa, obengumuntu omusha onesibindi kakhulu, futhi obesazodlala indima enkulu ekwakheni iNingizimu Afrika echumile futhi ephumelelayo.

src: Re ipiletsa ho mekga ya dipolotiki ho kgothaletsa mamellano hara ditho tsa yona le ho ipiletsa ho badudi ho tshehetsa ba Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa ya Aforika Borwa (SAPS) diphuputsong tsa bona.
tgt: Siyawanxusa amaqembu ezepolitiki ukuba agqugquzele ukuthi kube khona ukubekezelelana phakathi kwamalungu awo futhi sinxusa nemiphakathi ukuba iwusekele uMbutho Wamaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) ophenyweni lwawo.

src: Kgwedi ya Botjhaba.
tgt: Inyanga Yamagugu.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa kaofela ho tswela pele ho ananela Kgwedi ya Botjhaba ya selemong sena tlasa mookotaba: “Selemo sa Oliver Reginald Tambo: Re keteka Lefa la Tokoloho ya rona”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabakhuthaza bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba baqhubeke nokugubha iNyanga Yamagugu ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Unyaka ka-Oliver Reginald Tambo: Sigubha Amagugu Enkululeko Yethu”.

src: Kgwedi ena e tsamaelana le dilemo tse lekgolo tsa letsatsi la tswalo la OR Tambo, Morati wa naha ya habo ya Aforika, ya bontshitseng boitelo bo sa thekeseleng ba ho sebeletsa batho ba Aforika Borwa, kontinente le lefatshe.
tgt: Imigubho yale nyanga yenzeka ngesikhathi esifanayo nomgubho wokuhlangana kweminyaka eyikhulu kwazalwa u-OR Tambo, isishoshovu esabe silithanda kakhulu izwekazi lase-Afrika, esabonisa ukuzimisela nokuzinikela okukhulu ekusebenzeleni abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, izwekazi lase-Afrika kanye nomhlaba wonkana.

src: Hape re tshwaile sehopotso sa bo-40 sa lefu la Steve Bantu Biko, ya ileng a bolawa ka sehloho ke mmuso wa kgethollo.
tgt: Siqophe futhi neminyaka engama-40 kwashona u-Steve Bantu Biko, owabulawa ngesihluku esikhulu ngumbuso wobandlululo.

src: Letona la Bonono le Botjhaba, Monghadi Nathi Mthethwa, o lokolotse lenaneo la mekete ya kgweding ena.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezobuciko Namasiko, uMnu Nathi Mthethwa, uselukhiphile uhlelo oluzolandelwa emigubhweni yale nyanga.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka ditlaleho tsa pele tsa tshebetso tsa kgatelopele ya kotara ka nngwe bakeng sa 2017/18 mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha diphetho tsa dintlha tse ka sehlohlolong bakeng sa nako e dipakeng tsa Mmesa le Phuptjane 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlinzekwe ngolwazi oluphathelene nemibiko yenqubekela phambili yokusebenza ngekota yokuqala yowezi-2017/18 mayelana nokufezekiswa kwemiphumela ebekwe eqhulwini esikhathini esiphakathi kukaMbasa noNhlangulana 2017.

src: Mmuso o tswela pele ho etsa kgatelopele e bonahalang mabapi le ho kenya tshebetsong diphetho tsa dintlha tse 14 tse ka sehlohlolong, tse itshetlehileng hodima Moralo wa Lewa wa Nako e Bohareng (MTSF) 2014-2019, o re atametsang tabeng ya ho fihlella Tjhebelopele ya 2030 ya NDKabinete hape e ile ya tsebiswa ka dibaka tse ileng tsa ba le ditiehiso mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong le ho tsebiswa ka mehato e batlehang ho akofisa phano.
tgt: Uhulumeni uyaqhubeka nokwenza inqubekela phambili enhle kakhulu ekufezekisweni kwemiphumela eyi-14 ebekwe eqhulwini, esuselwa oHlakeni Lokusebenza Lwesikhathi Esimaphakathi (i-MTSF) sowezi 2014-2019, okwenza ukuba uhulumeni asondele kakhudlwana ekufezekisweni kweNhloso-mbono yowezi-2030 eshiwo ku-NDIKhabhinethi ithulelwe futhi umbiko ngaleyo mikhakha ehlangabezane nokubambezeleka futhi ihlinzekwe nangolwazi oluphathelene nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukusheshisa ukufezekiswa kwemiphumela.

src: Dikopano tsa boraditaba tsa Matona a Dikarolo ka ho fapana di tla tshwarwa ho tsebisa ka diphetho tsa ditlaleho tsena bekeng ya la 6 ho fihlela ka la 15 Mphalane 2017.
tgt: Ngeviki elisukela mhla ziyisi-6 kuze kube ngumhla ziyi-15 kuMfumfu 2017, kuzobanjwa izithangamu zabezindaba eziqhutshwa ngaMaqoqwana Ongqongqoshe Beminyango Ehlukahlukene.

src: Sekejule se tla lokiswa kgafetsa le ho manehwa ho WEBTOKEKabinete e tjhaelletse monwana tshisinyo ya hore Aforika Borwa e tshware Dipontsho tsa Lefatshe tsa Kopano ya Telecom tsa Matjhaba tsa Meralo ya Motheo ya Dikgokahanyo tsa Mehala ka Loetse 2018.
tgt: Uhlelo lokubanjwa kwale zithangamu luzofakwa imininingwane emisha ngokuqhubekayo bese luboniswa WEBTOKEIKhabhinethi isigunyazile isiphakamiso sokuba iNingizimu Afrika isingathe uMbukiso Wokuxhumana Ngezingcingo Emhlabeni Wenhlangano Yamazwe Ngamazwe Yezokuxhumana Ngezingcingo (i-ITU) ngoMandulo 2018.

src: Tsena ke dipontsho tsa selemo ka seng le foramo bakeng sa mmuso le baetapele ba diindaseteri ho fuputsa diphephetso, dilekane le ditharollo, le ho hlwaya menyetla ya matsete le ditlwaelo tse ntle ka ho fetisisa bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya moruo wa kahisano ka Dithekenoloji tsa Tlhahisoleseding le Dikgokahanyo (di-ICT).Sena e tla be e le lekgetlo la pele ketsahalo ena e tshwarelwa Aforika.
tgt: Lona ngumbukiso obanjwa minyaka yonke futhi uyisithangamu sokuba abaholi bohulumeni nabezimboni bafakane imilomo ngezinselelo, ubambiswano kanye nezixazululo, futhi bahlonze namathuba okutshalwa kwezimali kanye nezindlela eziphuma phambili zokuthuthukiswa kwenhlalo-mnotho ngokusebenzisa ubuChwepheshe Bolwazi Nokuxhumana (ama-ICT).Kuzobe kungokokuqala ngqa ukuba lo mcimbi ubanjelwe kwizwekazi lase-Afrika.

src: Nakong ya ketsahalo ena, indaseteri ya ICT ya Aforika Borwa e tla thola monyetla wa ho pepesa dihlahiswa tsa yona ka ho latelana.
tgt: Ngenkathi kubanjwe lo mcimbi, imboni yeze-ICT yaseNingizimu Afrika izohlinzekwa ngethuba lokubonisa imikhiqizo yayo ehlukahlukene.

src: Lekala la naha la bohahlaudi le lona le tla kgola molemo nakong ena.
tgt: Umkhakha wezokuvakasha waleli lizwe nawo uzohlomula kakhulu ngesikhathi kubanjwe lo mcimbi.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Imicimbi ezayo.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla etella pele kemedi ya Aforika Borwa ho Tulo ya bo-72 e Tlwaelehileng ya Kopano Kakaretso ya UN tlasa mookotaba “Re Tsepamisa Maikutlo Bathong: Re Tsitlallela Kgotso le Bophelo bo Khabane bakeng sa Bohle Polaneteng ya Moshwelella” ho la New York, Amerika.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uzohola izithunywa zeNingizimu Afrika ezizokwethamela iSigcawu Esijwayelekile sama-72 Sesigungu Sikawonkewonke seNhlangano Yezizwe (i-UN) esizobanjwa ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi “Sigxila Kubantu: Silwela Ukuthula Nempilo Ekahle Kubo Bonke Abantu Emhlabeni Osimeme”, edolobheni lase-New York, e-United States of America.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla tswela pele ho sebeletsa ho fihlella diphetho ho UN ha e tla be e nka karolo Tulong ya bo-72.
tgt: Ngenkathi ibambe iqhaza kulesi Sigcawu sama-72, iNingizimu Afrika izoqhubeka nokusebenzela ukulethwa kwezinguquko kwi-UUMongameli Jacob Zuma njengosihlalo we-SADC, uzobiza iNgqungquthela Ekhethekile ye-Double Troika yeziNhloko Zemibuso Nohulumeni ezobanjwa mhla ziyi-15 kuMandulo 2017 ePitoli.

src: Moporesident Jacob Zuma jwaloka Modulasetulo wa SADC, o tla bitsa Seboka sa Double Troika sa Dihlooho tsa Dipuso le Mebuso ka la 15 Loetse 2017 Pretoria.
tgt: Le Ngqungquthela Ekhethekile ye-Double Troika iwumphumela wezigameko zakamuva eziphathelene nesimo sezepolitiki nokuvikeleka ezenzeke kwelase-Lesotho.3 Ithimba laseNingizimu Afrika lezithunywa ezisesigabeni esiphakeme lizokwenza isethulo salo sokuqala sokusingatha uMqhudelwano Wamazwe Ngamazwe Webhola Lombhoxo wezi-2023 edolobheni lase-London mhla zingama-25 kuMandulo 2017.

src: Aforika Borwa e na le rekoto e matla e nang le bopaki ya ho tshwara diketsahalo tse kang eno.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika inomlando omuhle futhi owaziwa emhlabeni jikelele wokusingatha imicimbi enjengalona.

src: Kabinete e lakatsa ho boeletsa tshehetso ya yona e matla ya Boiketo bona le ho ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ho tshehetsa Boiketo bona bo tla nyehela haholo mabapi le momahano ya setjhaba le kaho ya setjhaba le ho sebetsa hape jwaloka sethusi bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya dipapadi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithanda ukugcizelela ukuthi isisekela ngokuphelele lesi Siphakamiso Sokusingatha Indebe Yomhlaba Yebhola Lombhoxo futhi iyabanxusa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba nabo basisekele lesi Siphakamiso ngoba sizodlala indima enkulu ekuqiniseni ubumbano lomphakathi kanye nokwakha isizwe futhi lokhu kuzolekelela kakhulu ekuthuthukisweni kwezemidlalo kuleli.

src: Melaetsa.
tgt: Imiyalezo.

src: Kabinete e lakaletsa baahi ba Jeremane katleho yohle ha ba itokisetsa dikgetho tsa Bofederale ka la 24 Loetse 2017 ho kgetha ditho tsa Bundestag ya bo-19, eo ka nqa e nngwe e tla kgetha Motjhanselara le ho bopa mmuso o motjha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ifisela izakhamuzi zase-Germany impumelelo njengoba zilungiselela ukubamba iqhaza okhethweni lwezwe oluzobanjwa mhla zingama-24 kuMandulo 2017 lapho zizoqoka khona amalungu ephalamende lakhona, i-Bundestag yehlandla le-19, yona-ke ezobe isikhetha uMongameli ozokwakha uhulumeni omusha.

src: Jeremane ke motsetedi e moholo ka hara Aforika Borwa, ya ikemiseditseng dikamano tse tswelang pele, tshebedisano le bolekane.
tgt: Izwe lase-Germany yizwe eliqavile elitshala izimali eNingizimu Afrika, futhi elikuthokozelayo ukuqhubeka nobudlelwano, ukusebenzisana kanye nobambiswano oluhle phakathi kwayo neNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona ho Caribean hammoho le dikarolo tsa Cuba le Amerika ho latela tshenyo e bakuweng ke Sefefo sa Irma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithanda ukuzwakalisa amazwi okuzwelana kwayo nabantu besifunda sase-Caribbean kanjalo nasezingxenyeni ezithile zase-Cuba kanye nase-United States kulandela umonakalo omkhulu odalwe yisiphepho esinamandla i-Hurricane Irma.

src: Re fetisetsa matshediso a tswang botebong ba dipelo ho baratuwa ba ba lahlehetsweng ke maphelo le thepa ya bona koduweng ena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulisa amazwi enduduzo kwizihlobo zalabo abalahlekelwe yizimpilo zabo kanye nempahla yabo kule nhlekelele.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le setjhaba mabapi le ho thoholetsa Kevin Anderson mabapi le ho fihlella makgaolakgang a US Open.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo, njengesizwe, ihalalisela u-Kevin Anderson ngokufinyelela kowamanqamu emqhudelwaneni webhola lomphebezo i-US Open.

src: Ke sebapadi sa pele sa moAforika Borwa ho fihlella makgaolakgang a bompodi bo boholo ba thenese esale ho tloha ka selemo sa 1994.
tgt: Ungumdlali wokuqala ukufinyelela esigabeni sowamanqamu emqhudelwaneni omkhulu webhola lomphebezo kusukela ngowe-1994.

src: Re na le tshepo ya hore o tla tswela pele ho ahella hodima phihlello ya hae e kganyang le ho kgothatsa batjha ba bang ba nang le talente ba MaAforika Borwa.
tgt: Asithandabuzi nakancane ukuthi uzoqhubeka nokwakhela phezu kwale mpumelelo emangalisayo ayizuzile futhi ngalokho afake ugqozi nofuqufuqu kubantu abasha baseNingizimu Afrika abanamakhono kwezemidlalo.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, 27 Loetse 2017, Union Buildings, Pretoria.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yabamba umhlangano wayo ngoLwesithathu mhla zingama-27 kuMandulo 2017 e-Union Buildings, ePitoli.

src: Dintlha tsa Hajwale.
tgt: Izindaba Ezisematheni.

src: Kopano Kakaretso ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UNGA).
tgt: Isigungu-Jikelele seNhlangano Yezizwe (i-UNGA).

src: Kabinete e amohetse puo ya Moporesidente Jacob Zuma ho Tulo e Tlwaelehileng ya bo-72 ya UNGA New York, Amerika ka la 12 Loetse 2017, tlasa mookotaba “Re Tsepamisa Maikutlo Bathong: Re tsitlallela Kgotso le Bophelo bo Kgabane bakeng sa Bohle Polaneteng ya Moshwelella”.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyishayele ihlombe inkulumo kaMongameli Jacob Zuma ayethula eMhlanganweni Ojwayelekile wama-72 we-UNGA e-New York, kwelase-USA mhla ziyi-12 kuMandulo 2017, ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi “Sigxila Kubantu: Silwela Ukuthula Nempilo Enhle Kubantu Bonke Emhlabeni Osimeme”.

src: Dipuisano di ne di tsepamisitse maikutlo hodima, hara tse ding, Merero ya Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella (di-SDG) ho fetofetoha ha tlelaemete le ditaba tsa kgotso le tshireletso le diphethoho tsa UN, ka ho qolleha diphethoho tsa Lekgotla la Tshireletso la UMoporesidente Zuma hape o saenne Tumellano e mabapi le Thibelo ya Dibetsa tsa Nutleleya, e bontshang boitlamo bo tswellang ba Aforika Borwa mabapi le ho fihlella lefatshe le hlokang tshoso e bakwang ke dibetsa tsa nyutleleya le ho netefatsa hore thekenoloji ya nutleleya e sebedisetswa merero ya kgotso feela.
tgt: Izingxoxo zabe zigxile, phakathi kokunye, kwiziNjongo Zentuthuko Esimeme (ama-SDG) ukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu izindaba eziphathelene nokuthula nokuvikeleka kanye nezinguquko kuNhlangano Yezizwe, ikakhulukazi izinguquko eMkhandlwini Wezokuvikela Wenhlangano Yezizwe.

src: Mopresidente Zuma o ne a hlophisitse dijo tsa mantsiboya tsa ho keteka dilemo tse lekgolo ho hlompha mofu Moporesidente wa mehleng wa African National Congress (ANC), Monghadi Oliver Reginald Tambo.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma wasayina futhi neSivumelwano Sokuvinjelwa Kwezikhali Zenuzi, okuyisenzo esibonisa ukuzibophezela okuqhubekayo kweNingizimu Afrika ekuqinisekiseni ukuqedwa ngokuphelele kobungozi bezikhali zenuzi emhlabeni futhi kuqinisekiswe nokuthi ubuchwepheshe benuzi busetshenziselwa ukufeza izinjongo zoxolo kuphela.

src: Kabinete e leboha maAforika Borwa kaofela bakeng sa ho keteka Kgwedi ya Bojalefa ka Loetse le ho boeletsa molaetsa wa Moporesidente Zuma wa Letsatsi la Bojalefa hore bohle ba ka hara naha ba hahamalle kopano e matla le ka hara diphapang.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma wasingatha futhi nomcimbi wesidlo sakusihlwa wokugubha iminyaka eyikhulu kwazalwa uMongameli waphambilini we-African National Congress, uMnu Oliver Reginald Tambo.

src: Jwaloka ha naha e phethela Kgwedi ya Bojalefa tlasa mookotaba “Selemo sa Oliver Reginald Tambo: ho keteka tokoloho ya letlotlo la bojalefa ba rona”, maAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho ahella hodima dipehelo tsa bophelo tse ka hara Molaotheo le ho matlafatsa mekutu ya ho aha setjhaba se hlokang bofuma, tlala, ho hloka bodulo le ho se lekalekane.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonga kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ababamba iqhaza emigubhweni yeNyanga Yamagugu, ngoMandulo, futhi igcizelela emyalezweni kaMongameli Zuma awethula ngoSuku Lwamagugu wokuthi bonke abantu bakuleli kumele bazabalazele ukuletha ubumbano olukhudlwana kuleli lizwe lethu elinabantu abahlukahlukene futhi abaphuma ezinhlakeni ezihlukahlukene.

src: Bakeng sa ho tiisa moya wa bojalefa, Kabinete e amohela tumellano e saennweng pakeng tsa Aforika Borwa le Tanzania, e reretsweng ho baballa nalane ya ntwa ya tokoloho.
tgt: Njengoba leli lizwe seliphothula imigubho yeNyanga Yamagugu ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Unyaka ka-Oliver Reginald Tambo: Sigubha Amagugu Enkululeko Yethu”, abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakhuthazwa ukuba bakhele phezu kwezimompilo ezisekelwa kakhulu wuMthethosisekelo wezwe futhi baqinise nemizamo yokwakha isizwe esingenabo ububha, esingenabo abantu abangenamakhaya futhi esingenayo inkinga yokungalingani kwabantu.

src: UN e fafielletse ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Porojeke ya Ditsela tse Lebisang Boikemelong ka hara Aforika.
tgt: Ekugqugquzeleni umoya wokubungaza amagugu ezwe, iKhabhinethi isishayela ihlombe isivumelwano esisayinwe yiNingizimu Afrika ne-Tanzania, okuhloswe ngaso ukulondoloza umlando womzabalazo wenkululeko.

src: Ka ho ketekwa ha moya wa bonngwe le tshebedisano-mmoho hara mekgatlo ya tokoloho ya Aforika mme e tla baka ho ahuwa ha museamo, laeborari le dibaka tsa polokelo ya nalane.
tgt: INhlangano Yezizwe ikugunyazile ukuqaliswa koMklamo Womgubho Womgwaqo Obheke Kuzimele-geqe kwelase-Afrika.

src: Aforika Borwa, tlasa boetapele ba Letona la Bohahlaudi, Mofumahadi Tokozile Xasa, e nkile karolo ho Letsatsi la Lefatshe la Bohahlaudi (27 Loetse 2017) le ho Kgwedi ya Bohahlaudi, tlasa mookotaba, “Bohahlaudi ba Moshwelella – Sesebediswa sa Ntshetsopele”.
tgt: Lo mklamo wumgubho womoya wobumbano nobambiswano phakathi kwezinhlangano zase-Afrika ezazilwela inkululeko futhi uzoholela ekwakhiweni kwesigcina-magugu, umtapo wolwazi kanye nesigcina-mlando.

src: Sena se fana ka lepatlelo bakeng sa ho tshehetsa diphethoho leanong, ditlwaelong tsa dikgwebo le boitshwaro ba basebedisi ba bohahlaudi, tse lebisitseng ho lekala la bohahlaudi la moshwelella, le ka nyehelang ka matla mabapi le ho fihlellwa ha di-SDNakong ya Letsatsi la Lefatshe la Bohahlaudi, dinaha le ditso tse fapaneng di keteka bongata ba diketsahalo tse itshetlehileng mabatoweng tse kang kgothaletso ya dikepele tse ikgethang le/kapa ho batalatsa ho fihlella dibaka, ho dumellwa ho kena ka bongata mahala diphakeng le dirapeng, le dipuisano tse fapafapaneng le bangkakarolo.
tgt: Tokozile Xasa, yabamba iqhaza emgubhweni woSuku Lwezokuvakasha Emhlabeni, mhla zingama-27 kuMandulo 2017, futhi yabamba iqhaza nasemigubhweni yeNyanga Yezokuvakasha, ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Ezokuvakasha Ezisimeme – Ziyithuluzi Lokuletha Intuthuko”.

src: Aforika Borwa e atlehile bakeng sa ho hodisa bohahlaudi ka dibaka tsa yona tse fapafapaneng tse nang le kgohedi tse kang diphaka tsa rona, mabopo a rona a lewatle a maemo a hodimo, le ditsha tsa bojalefa tse tjhaelletsweng monwana ke lefatshe.
tgt: Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngethuba lokweseka ukulethwa kwezinguquko kwinqubomgomo, nokuguqula izindlela zokwenza ibhizinisi futhi kuguqulwe nendlela amakhasimende ezokuvakasha enza ngayo izinto, ukuze kulethwe ukusimama okukhudlwana impela emkhakheni wezokuvakasha, okuyinto engafaka isandla esikhulu ekufezweni kweziNjongo Zentuthuko Esimeme.

src: Jwaloka sebaka sa bohahlaudi, Aforika Borwa e tobane le kgonahalo ya ho hodisa makala a yona a parolang le makala a mang a moruo ho kgonahatsa bokgoni bo matla ba moruo ka makala a mang a mehleng eo esale a le ka sehloohong a moruo.
tgt: NgoSuku Lwezokuvakasha Emhlabeni amazwe ahlukahlukene, futhi okungamazwe alandela amasikompilo ahlukahlukene, abungaza ezokuvakasha ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene eziqondene nesifunda ngasinye, ezinjengokuhlinzekwa kwezaphulelo emalini yokungena ezikhungweni zamagugu ezithile ukuze kukhuliswe isibalo sabantu abathola ithuba lokuvakashela lezi zikhungo futhi/noma abantu bahlinzekwa ngethuba lokungena mahhala eziqiwini nasemapaki, futhi kwabanjwa nemicimbi ehlukahlukene yokubandakanywa kwababambiqhaza.

src: Ana a kenyeletsa bohahlaudi ba dibaka tsa mahae, tsa bongaka, tsa temo le tsa botjhaba.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika isibonise impumelelo enkulu ekugqugquzeleni ezokuvakasha ngokusebenzisa izikhungo zayo ezihlukahlukene eziheha abavakashi, njengamapaki neziqiwi zakuleli, namabhishi ayo aklonyeliswe ngendondo yamabhishi ahlanzeke kakhulu kanye nezizinda zamagugu ezigunyazwe yizinhlangano zomhlaba.

src: Tumellano ya ho beha ditheko tsa meriana ya HIKabinete e amohela tumellano e etsang pale ya ditefello e fihlelletsweng ke Letona la Bophelo bo Botle, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, ka tshebedisano le mekgatlo e mengata ya matjhaba, ho akofisa boteng ba mokgahlelo wa pele wa pidisi e le nngwe ya kalafo ya HIHo akanngwa hore ho fokotswa ha tefello ho tla baka dipoloko tse ka fihlang ho R.7 bilione dilemong tse tsheletseng tse tlang.
tgt: Njengoba umkhakha wezokuvakasha uqasha abasebenzi abaningi kangaka, lokho kuthathwa njengesikhali esikhulu sokulwisana nenkinga yokuntuleka kwamathuba omsebenzi kuleli.

src: Sena se tla thusa Aforika Borwa ho ngodisa bakudi ba bangata bakeng sa kalafo.
tgt: Njengezwe elithandwa kakhulu ngabavakashi, maningi amathuba okuba iNingizimu Afrika ikhulise imikhakha yayo ehlukahlukene yezokuvakasha, okuyinto ezowusimamisa kakhulu umnotho wakuleli ngokusebenzisa imikhakha yezokuvakasha enjengomkhakha wokuvakashelwa kwezindawo zasemakhaya, umkhakha wokuvakashela kuleli kwabantu bakwamanye amazwe bezothola usizo lokwelashwa, umkhakha wezokuvakasha ophathelene nezolimo kanye nomkhakha wezokuvakasha ophathelene namasiko.

src: Tumellano ya ditefello e etsa hore moriana wa Dolutegravir, o kgothaletswang ke Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Bophelo bo Botle (WHO), o kgonahale bakeng sa mebuso ya dinaha tsa lekeno le tlase le le mahareng.
tgt: Isivumelwano sentengo yemishanguzo yokudambisa ingculazi.

src: Ho ya ka tumellano ya ditefello, Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle le rera ho tsebahatsa motswako wa ho nowa ho tsitsitseng ha meriana e meraro, Tenofovir, Lamivudine le Dolutegravir ka Mmesa 2018.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isishayela ihlombe isivumelwano esiyingqophamlando sentengo yemishanguzo yokudambisa isandulelangculazi esenziwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezempilo, uDkt.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela a a seng a le maemong a ho kena ho tsa thobalano, ka ho qolleha batjha, ho tswela pele ho phela bophelo bo itekanetseng ba ho amohela mekgwa ya thibelo e kang ho dula ba kena thobalanong e bolokehileng ka ho ikgula thobalanong, ho tshepahala le ho sebedisa dikgohlopo, le ho kenela diteko tsa HIV kgafetsa.
tgt: Aaron Motsoaledi, ngokubambisana nezinhlangano zamazwe ngamazwe ezihlukahlukene, okuhloswe ngaso ukusheshisa ukutholakala kohlelo lokudambisa isandulelangculazi ngephilisi elilodwa elishibhile futhi eliphuzwa kanye kuphela ngosuku.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha lehlakore le letjha la Sepetlele sa Cecilia Makiwane Mdantsane, ho la Kapa Botjhabela.
tgt: Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuba iNingizimu Afrika ikwazi ukufaka iziguli ezengeziwe ohlelweni lokwelashwa ngemishanguzo.

src: Ke mokolokotwane o lebisitseng ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha Inshorense ya Naha ya Bophelo bo Botle e tla baka hore ho be le phano ya tlhokomelo ya kalafo ya boleng, ka ho qolleha ho badudi ba futsanehileng.
tgt: Isivumelwano sentengo yemishanguzo sizokwenza ukuba umshanguzo i-Dolutegravir, onconywa kakhulu yiNhlangano Yezempilo Emhlabeni, utholakale ngentengo ephansi kulawo mazwe aneminotho esafufusa kanye neminotho emaphakathi ngobukhulu.

src: Sepetlele sena sa dithuto tse hodimo sa maemo a lefatshe ke matsete a ho fihlella tjhebelopele ya Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP) le di-SDG tsa UN tsa tlhokomelo ya kalafo ya lefatshe.
tgt: Njengoba sekusayinwe lesi sivumelwano, uMnyango Wezempilo uhlose ukwethula iphilisi elilodwa futhi eliphuzwa kanye ngosuku eliyinhlanganisela yemishanguzo emithathu, i-Tenofovir, i-Lamivudine kanye ne-Dolutegravir ngoMbasa wezi-2018.

src: Sepetlele sena sa dibethe tse 526 se tshehetswa ke tsamaiso e kopanetsweng e tla matlafatsa phano ya tlhokomelo ya kalafo ya boleng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa labo bantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaya ocansini, ikakhulukazi intsha, ukuba baqhubeke nokunakekela izimpilo zabo ngokuqikelela ukuthi bayazisebenzisa izindlela zokuzivikela esifweni sengculazi, ngokuthi bazithibe bangayi ocansini, noma babe nomlingani oyedwa kuphela futhi bathembeke kuyena, basebenzise ikhondomu ngaso sonke isikhathi futhi bakwenze kube yinto eyinjwayelo ukuhlolelwa isandulelangculazi.

src: E sebedisa ntjhafatso ya thekenoloji ho fokotsa dinako tsa badudi tsa ho ema, e ntlafatsa ho hlahlojwa le ho thusa ka boitshunyako bo potlakileng ba kalafo bakeng sa bakudi.
tgt: Leli yigxathu eliyingqophamlando eliphokophele ekuqalisweni koMshwalense Kazwelonke Wezempilo ozoholela ekuhlinzekweni kosizo lwezempilo olusezingeni eliphezulu, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ehlwempu.

src: Matsete ana a meralo ya motheo a R1 bilione a tla tshehetsa ntshetsopele ya moruo wa lehae ka hara makeishene.
tgt: Lesi sibhedlela sikanokusho esisezingeni lomhlaba siwumklamo wokutshalwa kwezimali okuhloswe ngawo ukufeza inhloso-mbono yoHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP) kanye neziNjongo Zentuthuko Esimeme zeNhlangano Yezizwe ezibandakanya ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu emhlabeni bathola usizo lwezempilo olusezingeni elifanele.

src: Ha re ntse re tsoseletsa meralo ya motheo ya boitekanelo ba setjhaba, hape re atolosa menyetla bakeng sa badudi ba lehae ya ho ntlafatsa maphelo a bona ka tlhahiso ya mesebetsi le ntshetsopele ya dikgwebo tsa lehae.
tgt: Lesi sibhedlela, esinemibhede angama-526, sisekelwe wuhlelo oludidiyelwe okuhloswe ngalo ukukhulisa izinga lokuhlinzekwa kosizo lwezempilo.

src: Kgwedi ya Ntshetsopele ya Kahisano e tshwarwa selemo ka seng ho hopola menyabuketso e mengata e entsweng ke naha, mabapi le ho fana ka thuso ya kahisano ho ba fumanehileng le ba tsietsing haholo ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lolu hlelo lusebenzisa izindlela zobuchwepheshe zesimanjemanje ukunciphisa isikhathi esichithwa yiziguli ngenkathi zisalindile emgqeni, nokwenza ngcono ukuhlonzwa kwezifo kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli zihlinzekwa ngosizo lwezempilo ngokushesha.

src: Kabinete e lakaletsa ka mofuthu maqheku kaofela le batho ba hodileng Letsatsi le monate la Batho ba hodileng, le tla hopolwa ka Sontaha sa, la 1 Mphalane 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba baqhubeke nokulekelela ekuhlinzekweni kosizo kubantu abahlwempu, njengoba kungasensuku zatshwala kufike iNyanga Yokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi ngoMfumfu.

src: MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho sebedisa kgwedi ya Mphalane ho ananela karolo le sehlabelo sa bohlokwa se entsweng ke batho ba hodileng mabapi le ho fihlella tokoloho ka hara naha ya bo rona.
tgt: Umgubho weNyanga Yokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi ubanjwa minyaka yonke ngenhloso yokukhumbula amagxathu amakhulu asethathwe yileli lizwe ekuhlinzekweni kwezibonelelo zompakathi kubantu abahlwempu futhi abadinga ukubhekelelwa kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ke mosebetsi wa baahi mmoho ba bo rona, e seng feela mmuso, ho fana ka tlhokomelo e eketsehileng ho maqheku a rona le dihlopha tse tsietsing.
tgt: Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakhuthazwa ukuba basebenzise inyanga kaMfumfu ukuhlonipha nokukhumbula indima eyadlalwa ngabantu abadala kanye nokuzinikela kwabo okukhulu emzabalazweni wenkululeko yezwe lethu.

src: Lenaneo la Mmuso wa Aforika Borwa la dithuso tsa setjhaba le thehilwe hodima tumelo e tiileng ya hore dithuso tsa polokeho ya setjhaba ke tokelo ya motheo ya botho mme di bohlokwa bakeng sa ho kgutlisa seriti sa baahi ba yona.
tgt: Kungumsebenzi wabo bonke abantu bakuleli, hhayi uhulumeni nje kuphela, ukunikeza abantu abadala kanye nalabo abahluphekayo ukunakekelwa okuthe xaxa.

src: Dithuso tsa setjhaba di imolla mathata a ditjhelete a dimilione tsa malapa mme ka ho sebetsa mmoho le mmuso di matlafatsa ba tsietsing hore maemo a bona a bophelo a ntlafale a be le seriti.
tgt: Uhlelo lwezibonelelo zikahulumeni ezihlinzekwa nguhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika lwakhelwe phezu kwenkolelo eqinile yokuthi izibonelelo zikahulumeni ziyilungelo lesintu eliyisisekelo futhi zisemqoka kakhulu ekubuyisweni kwesithunzi sezakhamuzi zakuleli.

src: Boitokisetso ba Dihlahlobo.
tgt: Amalungiselelo okuhlolwa kwabafundi.

src: Kabinete e lakaletsa baithuti kaofela tse molemo, ka ho qolleha ba etsang Kereiti 12, jwaloka ha ba itokisetsa dihlahlobo tsa mafelo a selemo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ifisela abafundi okuhle kodwa, ikakhulukazi labo abenza iBanga le-12, njengoba belungiselela ukuhlolwa kwabo kokuphela konyaka.

src: Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo (DBE) le malala-a-laotswe bakeng sa dihlahlobo tsa materiki tse qalang ka la 16 Mphalane 2017 tse tla ngolwa ke baithuti ba fetang 798 000 ba ingodisitseng.
tgt: Ahamba kahle kakhulu amalungiselelo oMnyango Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo (i-DBE) okuhlolwa kukamatikuletsheni okuzoqalwa mhla ziyi-16 kuMfumfu 2017, lapho abafundi ababhalisiwe abangaphezu kwezi-798 000 bezobhala khona izivivinyo zabo zokuphela konyaka.

src: DBE e fana ka tshehetso e eketsehileng ho baithuti ba materiki ka dithuto tsa tlatsetso hona sekolong kamora dihora tsa sekolo, le mafelong a beke le ka matsatsi a phomolo ya dikolo.
tgt: I-DBE ihlinzeka ngokwesekwa okwengeziwe kubafundi bakamatikuletsheni njengoba beqhubeka nokufunda nokuzilungiselela ezikoleni zabo ntambama emva kokuphuma kwesikole, nangezimpelasonto nangamaholidi ezikole.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho batswadi le bahlokomedi ho fana ka tshehetso e batlehang ho baithuti ha ba ntse ba itokisetsa dihlahlobo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabanxusa abazali kanye nabalondolozi bezingane ukuba bahlinzeke abafundi ngakho konke ukwesekwa abakudingayo njengoba belungiselela ukuhlolwa kwabo.

src: Beke ya Selemo ka seng ya Thusong Service Centre.
tgt: IViki lama-Thusong Service Centre Elibanjwa Njalo Ngonyaka.

src: Mmuso o phethetse ka katleho Beke ya Selemo ka seng ya selemong sena ya Thusong Service Centre, e etsahetseng ho tloha ka la 18 ho isa ka la 22 Loetse 2017 tlasa mookotaba: “Selemo sa OR Tambo – Re Ntshetsapele Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane, tse Mahareng le tse Kgolo ho di-Thusong Service Centre”.
tgt: Uhulumeni uliphothule ngempumelelo Iviki lama-Thusong Service Centre elibanjwa njalo ngonyaka, ebelibanjwe kusukela mhla ziyi-18 kuya kumhla zingama-22 kuMandulo 2017 ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Unyaka ka-OR Tambo – Sithuthukisa Amabhizinisi Asafufusa ezikhungweni ezingama-Thusong Service Centre”.

src: Sena se bopile karolo ya Kgwedi ya Tshebeletso ya Mmuso le ho kgothaletsa Lenaneo la Thusong ka ho pepesa lenaneo le kopanetsweng la ho fihlella dibaka ka dibaka le bokgabane ba lona mabapi le ho arabela ditlhoko tsa baahi.
