tgt: Lokhu kuyingxenye yeNyanga Yophiko Lwezemisebenzi Kahulumeni futhi kwagqugquzela uhlelo lwe-Thusong ngokubonisa uhlelo oludidiyelwe lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezingomahambanendlwana futhi kwaboniswa nendlela olusebenza ngayo lolu hlelo ekubhekeleleni izidingo zezakhamuzi zakuleli.

src: Di-Thusong Services Centre di tlisa mokeke wa ditshebeletso tsa mmuso le tlhahisoleseding haufi le batho.
tgt: Ama-Thusong Services Centre aletha izinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene zikahulumeni kanye nolwazi eduze kwamakhaya abantu bakuleli.

src: Lenaneo lena le fihlella bakgolamolemo ba akanngwang ho dimilione tse tsheletseng selemo ka seng ka Lenaneo le Kopanetsweng la Phihlello ya Dibaka ka Dibaka la Phihlello, Beke ya Selemo ka seng ya Thusong Service Centre le mapatlelo a mang a Tsamaiso ya Dikgokahanyo le Tlhahisoleseding ya Mmuso (GCIS).
tgt: Lolu hlelo lufinyelela kubantu abalinganiselwa ezigidini eziyisithupha abahlomulayo njalo ngonyaka ngaphansi koHlelo Oludidiyelwe Oluhlinzeka Ngezinsizakalo Ezingomahambanendlwana, neViki lama-Thusong Service Centre Elibanjwa Njalo Ngonyaka kanye nezinye izinhlelo zoPhiko Lukahulumeni Lwezokuxhumana Nokuhlinzeka Ngolwazi (i-GCIS).

src: Ka lenaneo lena, mmuso o tswela pele ho lokisa ho se lekalekane ha nako e fetileng ka ho tlisa ditshebeletso tsa boleng haufi le badudi bao pele ba neng ba qheletswe ka thoko ntshetsopeleng e tlwaelehileng ya moruo wa kahisano.
tgt: Ngokusebenzisa lolu hlelo, uhulumeni uyaqhubeka nokulungisa isimo sokungahlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi ngendlela elinganayo esiwumphumela wezinqubo zesikhathi esedlule, futhi uhulumeni wenza lokhu ngokuletha izinsizakalo ezisezingeni eliphezulu eduze kwezindawo lapho kuhlala khona abantu ababencishwe amathuba okubamba iqhaza ngokuphelele ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukiswa kwenhlalo-mnotho yabantu.

src: Di-Thusong Service Centre hape di matlafatsa badudi ka maitsebelo le thupello e hlokehang bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa maphelo a bona, ka bolekane bo teng le mmuso, ditheo tse thuswang ke mmuso le lekala la poraefete.
tgt: Futhi ama-Thusong Service Centre ahlomisa imiphakathi ngokuqeqeshwa ngamakhono abawadingayo ukuze bakwazi ukwenza ngcono izimpilo zabo, ngokusebenzisa ubambiswano olukhona njengamanje phakathi kukahulumeni, amabhizinisi kahulumeni kanye nabomkhakha ozimele.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa kgoeletso ya yona ho badudi ho tswela pele ho sebedisa di-Thusong Service Centre ho fihlella ditshebeletso tse kang tsa Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae, la Mesebetsi, la Toka, Lekala la Aforika Borwa la Dithuso tsa Setjhaba (SASA) le Letlole la Dikotsi tsa Mebila (RAF).
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyagcizelela ekhweleni lokunxuswa kwemiphakathi ukuba iqhubeke nokusebenzisa ama-Thusong Service Centre ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezihlinzekwa yizimpiko ezihlukahlukene zikahulumeni, njengoMnyango Wezasekhaya, Owezabasebenzi, Owezobulungiswa, uPhiko Lwezibonelelo Zikahulumeni lwaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nesiKhwama Sezingozi Zomgwaqo.

src: Myanmar.
tgt: Ezase-Myanmar.

src: Kabinete e tshwenyehile ka bothata ba badudi ba Rohingya ba balehileng malapeng a bona Myanmar.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhathazekile ngempicabadala yesimo senhlalo esingesihle neze esibhekene nabantu abawuhlanga lwama-Rohingya asebebalekile bashiya amakhaya abo kwelase-Myanmar.

src: Aforika Borwa e tshehetsa pehelo ya Mongodi-Kakaretso wa UN, Monghadi António Guterres, ya tobokeditseng boikarabelo ba Mmuso wa Myanmar ba ho fana ka tshireletso ho badudi bohle ba amehang, le hape ho kopa makala a thekolohelo ya botho ho fumantshwa phihlello ya badudi ba hlokang thuso le tshireletso.
tgt: António Guterres, ogcizelele isibopho sikahulumeni wase-Myanmar sokuvikela yonke imiphakathi ekhahlamezekile, futhi uphinde wacela ukuba izinhlangano ezisiza abantu zivunyelwe ukuba zifinyelele futhi zihlinzeke ngosizo kuleyo miphakathi edinga usizo nokuvikeleka.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa mahlakore kaofela ho fedisa merusu le ho thibela ho tswela pele ha tshotleho ya batho le ho ipiletsa hore boemo ka hara Puso ya Rakhine bo rarollwe ho itshetlehilwe hodima molao.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa wonke amaqembu ukuba ayeke ukuzibandakanya ezenzweni zodlame ukuze kunqandwe usizi nokuhlupheka kwabantu okuqhubekayo njengamanje futhi iyanxusa ukuba sixazululwe ngokushesha isimo esingesihle neze esiqhubekayo njengamanje esifundazweni sase-Rakhine, ngokulandela izimiso nemigomo ebekwe ngumthetho.

src: Angola.
tgt: Ezase-Angola.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le Moporesidente Zuma mabapi le ho thoholetsa Riphabliki ya Angola ka ho hlophisa Dikgetho tsa Naha tsa Ketsamolao tse atlehileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo, njengoMongameli Zuma, ihalalisela izwe lase-Angola ngokubamba ukhetho olube yimpumelelo.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o ne a kenetse Mokete wa Tlhomamiso ya Moporesidente João Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço Luanda ka Labobedi, la 26 Loetse 2017.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma ubewuthamele umcimbi wokugcotshwa kukaMongameli João Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço obubanjelwe e-Luanda ngoLwesibili mhla zingama-26 kuMandulo 2017.

src: Aforika Borwa le Riphabliki ya Angola di na le nalane e tshwanang ya ntwa kgahlanong le bokoloniale le mmuso wa kgethollo.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika ne-Angola ngamazwe anomlando ofanayo wokulwiswana nengcindezelo yokubuswa ngabezizwe kanye nobandlululo.

src: Esale ho tloha ka selemo sa 1994, dinaha tsena tse pedi di tswetse pele ho hodisa le ho atolosa maqhama a matla a bobedi bona.
tgt: Kusukela ngowe-1994, lawa mazwe amabili alokhu eqhubeke njalo nokukhulisa nokwelula ubambiswano oluqinile olukhona phakathi kwawo.

src: Angola ke e nngwe ya balekane ba baholohadi ba kgwebisano ba Aforika Borwa kontinenteng ya Aforika le ho tswela pele ho hodisa maqhama a yona.
tgt: I-Angola ngelinye lamazwe ahwebelana neNingizimu Afrika kakhulu ezwekazini lase-Afrika futhi iyaqhubeka nokukhulisa nokwelula ubudlelwano bayo neNingizimu Afrika.

src: Tlhaselo ya bahahlaudi ba Netherlands.
tgt: Ukuhlaselwa kwezivakashi zase-Netherlands.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe ho kgothotswa ha haufinyana tjena ha bahahlaudi ba Netherlands ba ileng ba salwa morao ho tloha Boemafofaneng ba Matjhaba ba OR Tambo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasigxeka isigameko sakamuva sokuqolwa kwezivakashi zase-Netherlands ezilandelwe yilezi zigebengu ngenkathi ziphuma esikhumulweni sezindiza i-OR Tambo International Airport.

src: MaAforika Borwa kaofela a lokela ho tshwela ka mathe botlokotsebe bo kang bona bo tshosang lekala la rona le dulang le hola la bohahlaudi.
tgt: Bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kumele bakugxeke kakhulu ubugebengu obunjengalobu ngoba bubeka engcupheni umkhakha wethu wezokuvakasha okhula ngesivinini esikhulu.

src: Kabinete e boetse e ipileditse ho Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa ya Aforika Borwa (SAPS) ho etsa leha e le sefe seo ba ka se kgonang ho tshwara baetsi ba botlokotsebe bona.
tgt: IKhabinethi iphinde yanxusa uMbutho Wamaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika ukuba wenze konke okusemandleni awo ukubopha abenzi balesi senzo sobugebengu esibi kangaka.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho setjhaba ho tla ka tlhahisoleseding leha e le efe e ka thusang balaodi ba qobello ya molao le ho etsa kgoeletso ya tshebediso ya letsoho le matla la molao bakeng sa ba tla fumanwa ba le molato.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawunxusa umphakathi ukuba ubikele amaphoyisa uma uhlangabezana nanoma yiluphi ulwazi olungawalekelela ophenyweni lwawo futhi inxusa ukuba kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bagixabezwa ngezijeziso eziqinile labo abayotholwa benecala lalokhu.

src: Ho thakgolwa ha buka ya melao ya setso ya Bakoena Ba Mopeli.
tgt: Ukwethulwa kwebhukwana lomthetho wendabuko wesizwe sa-Bakoena Ba Mopeli.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa ho thakgolwa ha buka, Bakoena Ba Mopeli Customary Law of Succession and Genealogy, jwaloka phihlello ya mokolokotwane bakeng sa boetapele ba setso ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikushayela ihlombe ukwethulwa kwebhukwana loMthetho Wendabuko isihloko salo esithi: Bakoena Ba Mopeli Customary Law of Succession and Genealogy, njengoba lokhu kuyimpumelelo eyingqophamlando kwezobuholi bendabuko eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Letona la Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Botjhaba, Monghadi Des van Rooyen, le Motlotlehi Morena Letsie III, Hlooho ya Puso ya Borena ba Lesotho, ba ne ba kenetse ketsahalo ena ka Mantaha wa, la 25 Loetse 2017.
tgt: Des van Rooyen, kanye neNgonyama u-Letsie III, iNhloko Yombuso wase-Lesotho, bebewuthamele lo mcimbi obubanjwe mhla zingama-25 kuMandulo 2017.

src: Lefapha la Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Botjhaba le qadile ho hlophisa ditokomane tsa nalane ya dikarolo tse 13 tsa Borena/Bofumahadi ka selemo sa 2011.
tgt: UMnyango Wezokwengamela Ngokubambisana Nezendabuko waqala ukubhala umlando wamaKhosi NeziNdlovukazi eziyi-13 kusukela ngowezi-2011.

src: Buka ena e tla thusa ho utlwisisa nalane ya Bakoena Ba Mopeli le tlhahlamano ya madi bakeng sa ho baballa nalane ya rona.
tgt: Leli bhukwana lizolekelela abantu ukuba bawuqonde kahle umlando wesizwe sa-Bakoena Ba Mopeli kanye nokulandelana kwamakhosi aso ukuze kugcinwe umlando waleli lizwe.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izinqumo ZeKhabinethi.

src: Porothokole ya Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tse ka Borwa ba Aforika (SADC).
tgt: Isivumelwano seNhlangano Yokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi waseNingizimu ne-Afrika (i-SADC).

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho amohelwa ha Porothokhole ya SADC ya Taolo ya Tikoloho bakeng sa Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella, ke Palamente.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukwamukelwa yiPhalamende ngokusemthethweni kweSivumelwano se-SADC sokuPhathwa Kwemvelo Ukuze Kulethwe Intuthuko Esimeme.

src: Sepheo sa porothokhole ke ho kgothaletsa taolo ya tikoloho e parolang le meedi, e leng tabatabelo ya ditho tsa dipuso tsa SADAforika Borwa, jwaloka Modulasetulo wa SADC ho tloha ka Phato 2017 ho isa ka Phato 2018, e itlama ho matlafatsa mekutu ya lebatowa ya ho baballa mehlodi ya tlhaho ya ho parola le meedi le ho kgothaletsa ntshetsopele ya moshwelella ka hara lebatowa la SADSena se matahantswe le NDP, e behileng ka sehlohlolong ho tebisa kopanelo ya lebatowa la SADC hammoho le ho netefatsa paballo ya moshwelella ya tikoloho le diphethoho tse lekalekanang tse lebisang moruong wa khabone e tlase.
tgt: Injongo yalesi sivumelwano wukugqugquzela ukusetshenziswa ngendlela esimeme kanye nokuphathwa kahle kwemvelo egxamalazele imingcele yamazwe e-SADC ahlukahlukene, okuyinto ezoba wusizo kakhulu emazweni e-SADINingizimu Afrika, njengoSihlalo we-SADC kusukela ngoNcwaba 2017 kuze kube nguNcwaba 2018, izibophezele ekuqiniseni imizamo yokonga nokuvikela imithombo yemvelo egxamalazele imingcele yamazwe esifunda se-SADC kanye nokugqugquzela intuthuko esimeme kulesi sifunda.

src: Pitso ya Matona ya Bolekane bakeng sa Tshebetso mabapi le Moruo wa Tlhaho.
tgt: Lokhu kuyahambelana nohlelo lwe-NDP, olubeka eqhulwini ukuqiniswa kokudidiyelwa kwesifunda se-SADC nokuqinisekisa ukusimama kwemvelo nokuletha uguquko ngendlela efanele futhi elingene ukuze kuguqukelwe emnothweni okhiqiza intuthu encane kakhulu engcolisa umoya nemvelo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tshwarwa ha Pitso ya Matona ya Bolekane bakeng sa Tshebetso mabapi le Moruo wa Tlhaho ka Loetse 2018.
tgt: INgqungquthela Yongqongqoshe Yobambiswano Lokuthatha Izinyathelo Zokuqinisekisa Umnotho Obhekelela Imvelo.

src: Lepatlelo lena le tshehetsa dinaha le mabatowa ho beha paballo ya moshwelella motsong wa maano a moruo le ditlwaelo bakeng sa ho ntshetsapele Lenaneo la 2030 la Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukusingathwa kweNgqungquthela Yongqongqoshe Yobambiswano Lokuthatha Izinyathelo Zokuqinisekisa Umnotho Obhekelela Imvelo, ezobanjwa ngoMandulo 2018.

src: Ke lenaneo la UN le kopanyang mmoho botsebi ho tswa Makaleng a mahlano a UN e leng Lenaneo la Tikoloho la UN Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Basebetsi (ILO) Lenaneo la Ntshetsopele la UN Mokgatlo wa Ntshetsopele ya Diindaseteri wa UN le Setheo sa Thupello le Diphuputso.
tgt: Lesi sigcawu sisekela amazwe kanye nezifunda ukuba zenze ukusimama kwemvelo kube wumongo nomgogodla wezinqubomgomo nezinkambiso zomnotho ngenhloso yokuqhubekisela phambili i-Ajenda yowezi-2030 yeNtuthuko Esimeme.

src: Ho tshwara Pitso ya Matona ho tla ntshetsapele lenaneo lena, ka lapeng le kontinenteng ya Aforika, la kgolo e kenyeletsang mabapi le ho amohela motjha wa khabone e tlase le wa moruo o itsekang.
tgt: Lolu wuhlelo lweNhlangano Yezizwe oluzoqoqela ndawonye ubungoti obuvela ezimpikweni ezinhlanu zeNhlangano Yezizwe, okuwuHlelo Lwenhlangano Yezizwe Lwezemvelo iNhlangano Yezabasebenzi Yamazwe Ngamazwe uHlelo Lwentuthuko Lwenhlangano Yezizwe Uphiko Lwenhlangano Yezizwe Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezimboni kanye neSikhungo Senhlangano Yezizwe Socwaningo Nokuqeqeshwa.

src: Boto ya Metsi ya Umngeni.1 Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka maemo a Boto ya Metsi ya Umngeni e leng ya bobedi e kgolohadi ka hara naha e nang le boleng selemo ka seng ba se ka fetang R2,4 bilione le ditekanyetso tsa Ditjeho tsa Tjhelete ya Sehlooho e fetang R7 bilione.
tgt: Ukusingathwa kwale Ngqungquthela Yongqongqoshe kuzoqhubekisela phambili i-ajenda, ngaphakathi kuleli lizwe kanye nasezwenikazi lase-Afrika, yokukhuliswa komnotho okubandakanya abantu bonke ngokuthi kwamukelwe umgudu wezomnotho ogcizelela ukukhiqizwa kwentuthu encane kakhulu futhi ukwazi ukubhekana nesimo sezulu esiguquguqukayo futhi esinobunzima.

src: Kabinete hape e tsebisitswe ka dipuisano tseo lefapha la metsi le tsamaiso ya dikgwerekgwere le neng le di tshwere le batsetedi ba lona.2 Bakeng sa ho tsitsisa dintlha tsa taolo tsa Boto, Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho thonngwa ha Boto ya Nakwana ha Letona le ntse le akofisa motjha wa ho thonya ka ho phethahala Boto ya Metsi ya Umngeni.
tgt: IBhodi Yezamanzi YaseMngeni.1 IKhabhinethi yahlinzekwa ngolwazi mayelana nesimo seBhodi Yezamanzi YaseMngeni, okuyibhodi yezamanzi engeyesibili ngobukhulu kuleli njengoba yenza inzuzo engaphezu kuka-R2,4 wamabhiliyoni futhi iSabelomali sayo Semisebenzi Emikhulu seminyaka emihlanu singaphezu kwamarandi angamabhiliyoni ayisikhombisa.

src: Kabinete e kgotsofaditswe ke mosebetsi o etswang ke Letona mabapi le ho tsitsisa Boto ya Metsi ya Umngeni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yahlinzekwe ngolwazi futhi nangezingxoxo ezibanjwe nguMnyango Wezamanzi Nezokuthuthwa Kwendle nabatshali-zimali.2 Ukuze kulethwe uzinzo ezindabeni zeBhodi eziphathelene nokuphatha nokwengamela, iKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukuqokwa kweBhodi Yesikhashana ngenkathi uNgqongqoshe esazama ukusheshisa inqubo yokuqokwa kweBhodi Yezamanzi YaseMngeni ezosebenza ngokugcwele.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Tekolo ya Mobu bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabinethi igculisekile ngomsebenzi owenziwa nguNgqongqoshe ekuletheni uzinzo kwiBhodi Yezamanzi YaseMngeni.

src: Dihlomathiso di matlafatsa metjha ya boikarabelo le taolo le ho fana ka thonyo ya ditho tse itseng tsa Boto ya Melawana ya Tekolo, e le ho matlafatsa taolo ya tekolo ya mobu ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukushicilelwa kweSichibiyelo Somthetho Wezokuhlolwa Nokuklanywa Komhlaba ukuze umphakathi uzwakalise imibono yawo.

src: Bili hape e batla ho laola tekolo ya mobu ka hara Aforika Borwa ka ho matlafatsa Molekodi-Kakaretso e Moholo wa Mobu hore a shebane le ho beha leihlo boemong ba naha le tsamaiso hodima ditekolo tsa sebopeho sa mobu, sebopeho sa naha le tsa maemo a dimmapa, tlhahlobo ya dibaka tsa mobu le ditshebeletso tsa tlhahisoleseding ka lefatshe.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho Wezokuhlolwa Nokuklanywa Komhlaba we-1997 (uMthetho we-8 we-1997).

src: Bili e sisinya ho tlisa tsamaelano le ho lokisa maemo a dipehelo tse laolang ditshebetso le taolo ya ditheo tsa setjhaba tse ikarabellang ho Letona la Saense le Thekenoloji.
tgt: Lezi zichibiyelo zizocacisa amandla namagunya okuphendula nokwengamela futhi uhlinzekele nokuqokwa kwamalungu omphakathi athile njengamalungu eBhodi Yokulawulwa Komsebenzi Wokuhlola Nokuklama Umhlaba, ukuze kwenziwe ngcono ukulawulwa kokuhlolwa nokuklanywa komhlaba eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Sena se tla netefatsa botsitso ditlhokong tsohle tse lokelang ho fihlellwa le metjha e lokelang ho latelwa ke ditheo jwaloka ha di amana le taolo.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uhlose futhi nokulawula ukuhlolwa nokuklanywa komhlaba eNingizimu Afrika ngokunikeza uMhloli-Jikelele Womhlaba amandla okuqapha nokuphatha indlela okwenziwa ngayo umsebenzi wokuhlola nokuklama umhlaba mayelana nesimo somhlaba nokuguquka kwaso ngokuhamba kwesikhathi (i-geodetic), isimo somhlaba kubandakanya izinto ezakheke ngokwemvelo kanye nezakhiwo ezakhiwe ngabantu (i-topographic) kanye nemingcele ebonisa ukuklanywa nokuhlukaniswa komhlaba (i-cadastral), kubandakanya nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo eziphathelene nedatha yomhlaba (i-geospatial) kanye nolwazi oluphathelene nomhlaba ezweni lonkana.

src: Nakong ya Kgwedi ya Dipalangwang, mmuso – o eteletswe pele ke Lefapha la Dipalangwang le ditheo tsa lona – o tla hlakisa melemo ya moruo ya lekala lena ka ho pepesa ditshebeletso tsa meralo ya motheo ho tsa bofofisi, mawatle, dipalangwang tsa setjhaba, tsa mebileng le diterene.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uphakamisa ukuhanjelaniswa nokufaniswa kwezimiso ezilawula imisebenzi eyenziwayo kanye nokuphathwa kwezikhungo zikahulumeni ezingaphansi kwesandla sikaNgqongqoshe Wezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe.

src: Matsete ana a tla netefatsa ho ahuwa ha marangrang a dipalangwang tsa setjhaba a kopanetsweng ho phatlalla le naha.
tgt: Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuhambelana kwazo zonke izidingo okumele zineliswe kanye nezinqubo zokuphatha okumele zilandelwe yilezi zikhungo.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla tshwara Tulo ya bo-2 ya Khomishene ya Dinaha tse Pedi (BNC) ya Africa Borwa-ZimbabweMoporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla amohela wa mphato wa hae wa Zimbabwe, Mohlomphehi Moporesidente Robert Mugabe, ya tla ba teng Aforika Borwa ka la 03 Mphalane 2017 lebakeng la Tulo ya bo-2 ya BNC ya Aforika Borwa-Zimbabwe.
tgt: Njengoba inyanga kaMfumfu 2017 iwuphawu lweNyanga Yezokuthutha ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Sisonke siqhubekisela iNingizimu Afrika phambili”, iKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abantu bakuleli ukuba basebenzisane ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ingqalasizinda yezokuthutha yezwe iyabahlomulisa bonke abantu bakuleli futhi iKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abasebenzisi bomgwaqo ukuba basebenzise umgwaqo ngokucophelela futhi baqinisekise ukuthi nsuku zonke bakubeka eqhulwini ukuphepha emgwaqeni.

src: Aforika Borwa le Zimbabwe di na le dikamano tse ntle tsa bobedi bona tsa sepolotiki, moruo le kahisano tse fafielletsweng ka maqhama a nalane ya dilemo tse ngata.
tgt: NgeNyanga Yezokuthutha, uhulumeni – eholwa nguMnyango Wezokuthutha kanye nezikhungo ezingaphansi kwawo – uzoqhakambisa imihlomulo yezomnotho etholakala kulo mkhakha ngokubonisa izinsizakalo zengqalasizinda yezokuthutha, emkhakheni wezokuthutha ngomoya, ezokuthutha zasolwandle, ezokuthutha umphakathi, ezokuthutha ngomgwaqo kanye nezokuthutha ngezitimela.

src: Zimbabwe ke e nngwe ya balekane ba Aforika Borwa ba bahlano ba ka hodimo ka ho fetisisa ka hara kontinente ka dipalopalo tse bontshang kgolo selemo ka seng.
tgt: Utshalo-mali olufakwa emkhakheni wezokuthutha lugqugquzela intuthuko nokuvulwa kwamathuba omsebenzi njengengxenye yoHlelo lweNingizimu Afrika Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye, okuhloswe ngalo ukukhulisa umnotho kanye nokudala amathuba omsebenzi adingeka kakhulu kuleli.

src: Letsatsi la Tswalo – Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika izosingatha isigcawu sesibili seKhomishana yeNingizimu Afrika neZimbabwe (i-BNC)UMongameli Jacob Zuma uzosingatha uzakwabo waseZimbabwe, uMongameli Robert Mugabe, ozovakashela eNingizimu Afrika mhla zi-3 kuMfumfu njengengxenye yoMhlangano Wesibili Wekhomishana yezwe laseNingizimu Afrika nelase-Zimbabwe (i-BNC).

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le naha kaofela mabapi le ho lakaletsa Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, ya tsebahalang jwaloka Mme wa Setjhaba, letsatsi la tswalo le monate ha a ne a qeta dilemo tse 81 ka Labobedi, 26 Loetse 2017.
tgt: I-BNC yasayinwa ngoMbasa 2015 futhi yathulwa ngokusemthethweni ngoMfumfu 2016 e-Harare, e-Zimbabwe.

src: Mama Madikizela-Mandela ke e mong wa diqhoku tsa ntwa ya tokoloho tse babatswang ka ho fetisisa.
tgt: INingizimu kanye ne-Zimbabwe ngamazwe anobudlelwano obuhle bezepolitiki, ezomnotho kanye nezenhlalo yomphakathi obusekelwe ngamaxhama omlando aqinile ezokusebenzisana nokubambisana aseqhubeke iminyaka ngeminyaka phakathi kwalawa mazwe amabili.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Banyana Banyana mabapi le ho hapa Bompodi ba Basadi ba 2017 ba COSAFA kamora ho hlola ka 2-1 ho makgaola kgang kgahlanong le Zimbabwe ho la Bulawayo.
tgt: Ngowezi-2016, iNingizimu Afrika yathumela kwelase-Zimbabwe impahla ebalelwa ku-R.3 wamabhiliyoni.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le Moporesidente Zuma mabapi le ho fetisetsa matshediso ho Moporesidente Enrique Peña Nieto wa Dinaha tse Kopaneng tsa Mexico le batho ba Mexico ho latela ho reketla ha lefatshe, tsunami le kganyapa tse bakileng tshenyo, e bakileng mafu a fetang 225 le tshenyo e matla ya meralo ya motheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlanganyela nabo bonke abantu bakuleli ekufiseleni uMama u-Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, odume ngelikaMama Wesizwe, umgubho wosuku lokuzalwa omnandi njengoba ehlanganise iminyaka yobudala engama-81 ngoLwesibili mhla zingama-26 kuMandulo 2017.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di lokelwa ke ho tiisetswa ka mangolo a thuto le tumellano e amehang.
tgt: UMama uMadikizela-Mandela ungomunye wezingqalabutho zaseNingizimu Afrika eziyintandokazi kubantu bakuleli futhi uhlonishwa kakhulu.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho thonngwa ha Boto ya Nakwana ya Boto ya Metsi ya Umgeni:a. Mofumahadi Ziphozethu Mathenjwa (Modulasetulo)b. Mofumahadi Nompumelelo Chamanec.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyambonga ngegalelo lakhe emzabalazweni wenkululeko yakuleli eyatholakala kanzima futhi imfisela unyaka onezibusiso azowuchitha nabantu abathandayo nomndeni wakhe.

src: Ditho tse tla sebetsa ho Phanele ya Bolaodi ba Phethisetso:a. Monghadi Sandile Bubele Siyaka (sehla sa bobedi)b. Monghadi Ntshengedzeni Anthony Michael Tshivhase (sehla sa bobedi)c. Monghadi Christopher Ewing (sehla sa bobedi)d. Monghadi Ebrahim Aboobaker Moolla (sehla sa bobedi)e. Mofumahadi Nonzukiso Zukie Siyotula lef.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo, njengoMongameli Zuma, idlulisa amazwi enduduzo kuMongameli wase-Mexico u-Enrique Peña Nieto kulandela ukuzamazama komhlaba, i-tsunami kanye nesiphepho esinamandla esidale umonakalo omkhulu, osekuholele ekushoneni kwabantu abangaphezu kwama-225 kanye nokucekela phansi kwengqalasizinda.

src: Mofumahadi Nocamagu Nomfundo Mbulawa.
tgt: AbaqashiweUkuqashwa kwabo bonke abalandelayo kuzokwamukelwa ngokusemthethweni kuphela uma sekuqinisekiswe ubufakazi beziqu zabo zemfundo futhi uma sebenikezwe izimvume ezifanelekile.

src: Batsamaisi bao seng ba phethahatso ho Boto ya Inshorense ya Koporasi ya Mekitlane ya Thepa ya Diyantle ya Aforika Borwa - SOC Limited:a. Monghadi Dhevendren Dharmalingam (Modulasetulo)b. Mofumahadi Vuyelwa Matsiliza (o thontswe hape) lec.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukuqokwa kwalaba abalandelayo njengamalungu eBhodi Yesikhashana yo-Umgeni Water Board:a. Nkz.

src: Mofumahadi Siobhain O’Mahony (o thontswe hape).
tgt: Ziphozethu Mathenjwa (uSihlalo)b. Nkz Nompumelelo Chamanec.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, la 18 Mphalane 2017, Tuynhuys, Motse Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi labamba umhlangano walo ngoLwesithathu mhla ziyi-18 kuMfumfu 2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Dintlha tsa Hajwale.
tgt: Izindaba Ezisematheni.

src: Letsatsi la Tokoloho ya Boraditaba.
tgt: Usuku Lwenkululeko Yemithombo Yezindaba.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le maAforika Borwa mabapi le ho hopola Letsatsi la Tokoloho ya Boraditaba ka Labone, 19 Mphalane 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi, nayo njengezakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika, libungaza uSuku Lwenkululeko Yemithombo Yezindaba, ngoLwesine, mhla ziyi-19 kuMfumfu 2017.

src: Boraditaba ba bapetse karolo e hlokolosi ntweng e neng e le kgahlano le mmuso wa kgethollo, ba pepesa sehloho le bokgopo bo entsweng ke mmuso wa kgethollo.
tgt: Imithombo yezindaba yabamba iqhaza elikhulu ekulwisaneni nobandlululo, yavumbulula izigameko ezinyantisayo kanye nesihluku sikahulumeni wobandlululo.

src: Selemo sena se tshwaya dilemo tse 40 esale mmuso wa kgethollo o thibela dikoranta tse neng di pepesa kgethollo tse kang the World, the Weekend World le the Voice.
tgt: Lo nyaka ungunyaka wama-40 selokhu uhulumeni wobandlululo amisa ukusebenza kwamaphephandaba ayenohlonze njenge-The World, i-The Weekend World kanye ne-The Voice.

src: Kajeno, tokoloho ya boraditaba e kenyeleditswe ka matla ka hara Molaotheo wa Aforika Borwa le ho dula e le letshwao la motheo la setjhaba sa bo rona se tswelang pele.
tgt: Namuhla, inkululeko yemithombo yezindaba iqukethwe kuMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika futhi iyisakhi esisemqoka ekuthuthukisweni kwezwe lakithi.

src: Kabinete ho feta moo e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa ho tswela pele ho kgothaletsa phumantsho ya tlhahisoleseding le ho sebedisa tokelo ya tokoloho ya boraditaba ka boikarabelo ho thusa ho aha Aforika Borwa e kopaneng, e hlokang semorabe, e sa kgetholleng ho ya ka bong, ya demokerasi le e tswang pele bakeng sa bohle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liqhubeka nokukhuthaza izakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi ziqhubeke nokugqugquzela ukutholakala kolwazi futhi zisebenzise ilungelo lenkululeko yemithombo yezindaba ebandakanya ukwakha iNingizimu Afrika ebumbene, engacwasi ngokwebala nangokobulili, ebuswa ngentando yeningi yabantu futhi enempumelelo.

src: Moruo wa Mawatle.
tgt: Umnotho Wasolwandle.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Moporesidente Jacob Zuma mabapi le ho fana ka tlaleho ya kgatelopele ho bankakarolo ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Operation Phakisa bakeng sa Moruo wa Mawatle le ho ipiletsa ho bankakarolo bohle ho tswela pele ho aha selekane le mmuso bakeng sa ho bula bokgoni ba moruo ba mawatle a rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lincoma uMongameli uJacob Zuma ngokwethulela ababambiqhaza umbiko mayelana nenqubekela phambili ngokuqaliswa kwe-Operation Phakisa: Umnotho Wasolwandle futhi linxusa bonke ababambiqhaza ukuthi baqhubeke nokubambisana nohulumeni ukuze kubonakale amathuba omnotho otholakala olwandle lwakithi.

src: Moruo wa Mawatle o se o nyehetse se ka etsang 4.4% ho Palohohle ya Dihlahiswa tsa Naha (GDP) tsa Aforika Borwa mme tlaleho ya Moporesidente ho bankakarolo e bontsha ka matla mekutu e kopanetsweng le tshehetso bakeng sa balekane bohle ba mmuso ba itahletseng ka setotswana ka hara bokgoni bona bo batsi.
tgt: Umnotho Wasolwandle sewube negalelo elingu-4.4% kuMkhiqizo WaseNingizimu Afrika Wonyaka Wonke (i-GDP) futhi umbiko kaMongameli oqondiswe kubabambiqhaza ubonakalise ukuzimisela okukhulu kanye nokwesekwa kwabo bonke ababambisene noHulumeni abathathe isinyathelo sokufinyelela emathubeni amakhulu.

src: Diporojeke tsa Moruo wa Mawatle ho fihlela mona di se di butse matsete a kopaneng a R.6 bilione ho tswa mmusong le lekaleng la poraefete, le ho bopa mesebetsi e fetang 6 500.
tgt: Imiklamo Yomnotho Wasolwandle ikwaze ukuvula amathuba otshalomali oludidiyele oluyizigidi ezingama-24.6 zamarandi ezivela kuhulumeni kanye nasezimbonini ezizimele, futhi idale imisebenzi engaphezu kwezi-6 500.

src: Matsete a maholo ka ho fetisisa Moruong wa Mawatle, a hlahisitsweng ka ditsiane tsa mmuso, a lebisitswe ho ntshetsopele ya meralo ya motheo, haholo maemakepe, ho tsa tlhahiso, kaho ya dikepe, kgodiso ya diphedi tsa lewatle le diphuputso tsa saense le lekala la kgase.
tgt: Utshalomali olukhulukazi eMnothweni Wasolwandle, olulawulwa ngokoxhaso oluvela kuhulumeni, labelwa ukuthuthukiswa kwengqalasizinda, ikakhulukazi amatheku, ukukhiqiza, ukwakha izikebhe, imvelo ephila olwandle kanye nocwaningo lwezesayensi emkhakheni wezamafutha kanye negesi.

src: Mmuso o rera ho theha sebaka se le seng se seholohadi sa kaho ya dikepe ka hara Aforika e ka borwa.
tgt: Uhulumeni uhlele ukusungula isikhungo esisodwa esikhulukazi sokwakha izikebhe eNingizimu ne-Afrika.

src: Phaka ya Kaho ya Dikepe ya KwaZulu-Natal ka hara Boemakepe ba Durban e tla kotula bokgoni ho tswa matseteng a matjha, diyantle le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi.
tgt: Ipaki Lokwakhiwa Kwezikebhe KwaZulu-Natali Ethekwini lase-Durban lizovula amathuba otshalomali olusha, izimpahla ezithunyelwa kwamanye amazwe kanye namathuba omsebenzi.

src: Leeto la Puso ho ya Zambia.
tgt: Uhambo Olusemthethweni LwaseZambia.

src: Kabinete e amohela diphetho tsa Leeto la Puso la Mopresidente Zuma la ho etela Riphabliki ya Zambia ho tloha ka la 12 ho isa ka la 13 Mphalane 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela imiphumela evele Ohambweni Olusemthethweni lukaMongameli Zuma eRiphabhulikhi yaseZambia olwaqala mhla ziyi-12 kuya ku-13 kuMfumfu 2017.

src: Dipuisano pakeng tsa Moporesidente Zuma le wa mphato wa hae wa Zambia Edgar Lungu di matlafaditse dikamano tse ntle tse ntseng di le teng tsa sepolotiki, tsa moruo le tsa botjhaba pakeng tsa dinaha ka bobedi, tse hlakiswang ke maqhama a matla a nalane ya dilemo tsa ntwa ya tokoloho.
tgt: Izingxoxo ezabanjwa phakathi kukaMongameli Zuma nozakwabo waseZambia uMongameli Edgar Lungu ziqinise ubudlelwano obuhle bezombusazwe, ezomnotho kanye nezamasiko phakathi kwala mazwe amabili, obusekelwe ubudlelwano obuqinile bakudala obaqala ngeminyaka yomzabalazo wenkululeko.

src: Dihlooho tsa Dipuso tse pedi tsena di butse semmuso setsha sa Naha sa Bojalefa sa OR Tambo Chelstone, ho la Lusaka, mabapi le ho tlotla nyehelo ya OR Tambo ntweng ya tokoloho ya Aforika e ka borwa.
tgt: Labo Mongameli Bamazwe bavule ngokusemthweni indawo yamagugu esizwe i-OR Tambo National Heritage Site eChelstone, eLusaka, behlonipha igalelo lika-OR Tambo emzabalazweni wenkululeko weningizimu ne-Afrika.

src: Zambia e dula e le e nngwe ya balekane ba ka sehloohong ba kgwebisano le Aforika Borwa ka hara lebatowa le ka hara kontinente.
tgt: IZambia isangelinye lamazwe abekwa eqhulwini kwezokuhwebelana neNingizimu Afrika esifundeni kanye nasezwenikazi.

src: Tshebedisano ho tsa moruo pakeng tsa Aforika Borwa le Zambia e tswela pele ho hola, ka diyantle tsa Aforika tse yang Zambia tse akantsweng ho fihla ho R30 bilione ka selemo sa 2016.
tgt: Ukubambisana kwezomnotho phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika kanye neZambia kuyaqhubeka nokukhula, njengoba umkhiqizo iNingizimu Afrika ehwebela iZambia ngawo ulinganiselwa emalini eyizigidigidi ezingama-30 zamarandi ngowezi-2016.

src: Dinaha tsena tse pedi di sebedisana mmoho dibakeng tse fapafapaneng, ho kenyeletswa kgwebisano le matsete, saense le thekenoloji, tshireletso, temo, tikoloho, eneji le bophelo bo botle.
tgt: La mazwe amabili asebenzisana emikhakheni enhlobonhlobo, okubandakanya ezohwebo notshalomali, ezesayensi nobuchwepheshe, ezokuvikela, ezolimo, ezemvelo, ezamandla kanye nezempilo.

src: Leeto la tshebetso ho ya Nigeria.
tgt: Uhambo Olusemthethweni LwaseNigeria.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Moporesidente Zuma mabapi le ho tlotlwa ka seemahale le hore mmila o rehellwe ka yena Nigeria, nakong ya leeto la tshebetso bakeng sa ho matlafatsa dikamano tsa moruo wa kahisano le mabaka a mang a tshebedisano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisela uMongameli Zuma ngokuhlonishwa ngesichuse kanye nokuqanjwa komgwaqo ngegama lakhe eNigeria, ngesikhathi kunohambo olusemthethweni lokuqinisa ubudlelwano bezenhlalomnotho kanye nezinye izindlela zokusebenzisana.

src: Mmusisi wa Puso ya Imo, Rochas Okorocha, o tlotlile Moporesidente Zuma ka Kgau ya Tlhompho ya Imo, e leng kgau e kgolo ka ho fetisisa Pusong eo le ho abelwa ba entseng phapang ntshetsopeleng ya badudi ba habo bona.
tgt: UNdunankulu Wesifundazwe i-Imo, uRochas Okoracha, uhloniphe uMongameli Zuma nge-Imo Merit Award, okuyindondo esezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu kulesi Sifundazwe, enikwa labo ababe negalelo elilethe uguquko ekuthuthukisweni kwemiphakathi yangakubo.

src: Kopano ya bo-17 ya Rim ya Lekgotla la Matona a Dikgaolo tsa Lewatle la India (IORA).
tgt: UMhlangano WoMkhandlu WoNgqongqoshe be-Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) we-1.

src: Aforika Borwa e nkile Bodulasetulo ba IORA nakong ya kopano ya bo-17 o tshwaretsweng Durban ho tloha ka la 14 ho isa ka la 18 Mphalane 2017.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika ithathe isikhundla sokuba uSihlalo we-IORA emhlanganweni we-17 obanjelwe eDurban kusukela mhla ziyi-14 kuya kweziyi-18 kuMfumfu 2017.

src: Mookotaba wa Aforika bakeng sa nako ya yona ya bodulasetulo o re “Re kopanya Batho ba Aforika, Asia, Australasia le Botjhabela bo Hare ka Tshebedisano e Matlafetseng bakeng sa Kgotso, Botsitso le Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella”.
tgt: Isiqubulo seNingizimu Afrika ngehlandla layo sithi "Ukubumba Abantu Base-Afrika, e-Asia, e-Australasia kanye naseMiddle East Ngokuthuthukisa Ukusebenzisana Ngenhloso Yokuletha Ukuthula, Uzinzo kanye Nentuthuko Esimeme".

src: Kabinete e boeleditse boitlamo ba yona ka bodulasetulo bona ho ntshetsa pele tshebedisano ya lebatowa mabakeng a kang a moruo wa mawatle matlafatso ya basadi moruong kgodiso ya dikgwebo tse nyenyane, tse mahareng le tse kgolo matlafatso ya batjha, le tshebedisano ho tsa thuto, saense le thekenoloji.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligcizelele ukuzibophelela kwalo ngokusebenzisa lesi sihlalo ukuze kuqhutshezelwe ukusebenzisana kwezifunda emikhakheni okungabalwa kuyo umnotho wasolwandle ukufukulwa kwabantu besifazane kwezomnotho ukukhuthazwa kwamabhizinisi amancane nasafufusa ukufukulwa kwabantu abasebasha, kanye nokusebenzisana kwezemfundo, ezesayensi kanye nezobuchwepheshe.

src: Dikopano tsa selemo ka seng tsa Letlole la Matjhaba la Ditjhelete (IMF) le Banka ya Lefatshe.
tgt: Imihlangano yaminyaka yonke yeSikhwama Sezimali Somhlaba Wonke (i-IMF) kanye neBhange Lomhlaba.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ke Letona la Ditjhelete, Monghadi Malusi Gigaba, ho latela bonkakarolo ba Aforika Borwa dikopanong tsa selemo ka seng tsa 2017 tsa IMF le Banka ya Lefatshe, tse neng di tshwerwe ho tloha ka la 13 ho isa ka la 15 Mphalane 2017.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezezimali, uMnu Malusi Gigaba, utshele iKhabhinethi emuva kokubamba iqhaza kweNingizimu Afrika emihlanganweni yaminyaka yonke ye-IMF neBhange Lomhlaba, eyabanjwa kusukela ngomhla ziyi-13 kuya kumhla ziyi-15 kuMfumfu 2017.

src: Dikopano di fane ka monyetla wa ho lekola kgatelopele ya matjhaba mabapi le dintlha tsa tswelopele le ho hlakisa maikitlaetso a Aforika Borwa bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya moruo wa kahisano, kgolo e kenyeletsang, tlhahiso ya mesebetsi le phediso ya bofuma.
tgt: Imihlangano ihlinzeke ngethuba lokuhlola okuqhubekayo emhlabeni jikelele kwezentuthuko nokwendlalela izinhlelo zeNingizimu Afrika ngokwayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ezenhlalomnotho, ukukhula komnotho okubandakanya wonke umuntu, ukudalwa kwamathuba omsebenzi kanye nokuqedwa kobubha.

src: Kabinete hape e tsebisitswe mabapi le kopano e neng e tshwerwe ke Letona Gigaba le makala a ikemetseng a tekolo ya mekitlane le batsetedi ho tiisetsa botjha maano a hajwale a Aforika Borwa le katamelo ya boitshwaro bo botle ba tshebediso ya ditjhelete tsa mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde laziswa ngomhlangano obanjwe uNgqongqoshe uGigaba nezinhlangano ezenza izilinganiso zeminotho yamazwe omhlaba kanye nabatshalimali ukugcizelela izinqubomgomo ezikhona eNingizimu Afrika kanye nendlela esetshenziselwa ukulungisa isimo sezezimali.

src: Kabinete e kgotsofetse ka tiisetso botjha e fuweng batsetedi mabapi le meralo ya mmuso ya ho hodisa moruo le boitlamo ba mmuso ba ho sebetsana le dintlha tsa taolo dikgwebong tsa rona tsa mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lanelisekile ngokuqinisekiswa kwabatshalimali ngezinhlelo zikahulumeni zokukhulisa umnotho kanye nokuzibophelela kukahulumeni ekudingideni izindaba zokuphatha ezinkampanini ezingaphansi kukahulumeni.

src: Pehelo ya Leano la Ditekanyetso tsa Nako e Bohareng (MTBPS) e tla tekwa Palamenteng, Motse Kapa, ka la 25 Mphalane mme e tla hlakisa meralo ya mmuso ya tshebediso ya ditjhelete dilemong tse tharo tse tlang.
tgt: Isitatimende seNqubomgomo Yesabelomali Sesikhathi Esimaphakathi (i-MTBPS) sizokwethulwa ePhalamende, eKapa, mhla zingama-25 kuMfumfu futhi sizocacisa izinhlelo zikahulumeni zokusebenzisa imali eminyakeni emithathu ezayo.

src: Ntshetsopele ya Meralo ya Motheo.
tgt: Ukuthuthukiswa kwengqalasizinda.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse matlafatso e kgolo mabapi le ntshetsopele ya mmuso ya meralo ya motheo ka ho nehelana semmuso ka marokgo a mararo Botlokwa ho la Limpopo ke Moporesidente Zuma ka la 17 Mphalane 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lishayele ihlombe uxhaso olukhulu lokuthuthukiswa kwengqalasizinda kahulumeni, ngokuvula kukaMongameli uZuma ngokusemthethweni amabhuloho amathathu eBotlokwa eLimpopo ngomhla ziyi-17 kuMfumfu 2017.

src: Lekala la Mebila ya Naha la Aforika Borwa le ahile marokgo a Botlokwa, e leng borokgo bo le bong ba makoloi le a mabedi a ditaaso hodima mmila wa N1 pakeng tsa Polokwane le Makhado.
tgt: Inhlangano Yemigwaqo kaHulumeni eNingizimu Afrika (i-Sanral) yakhe amabhuloho aseBotlokwa, okubalwa kuwo elinye lamabhuloho asemgwaqweni kanye namabhuloho amabili abantu abahamba ngezinyawo ku-N1 phakathi kwePolokwane neMakhado.

src: Kabinete e dumela hore porojeke ena e tla ntlafatsa haholo maemo a ho tsamaya le polokeho bakeng sa basebedisi kaofela ba mebila sebakeng seo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ayingabazi ukuthi lo mklamo uzozithuthukisa kakhulu izimo zezokuthutha kanye nezokuphepha kubo bonke abantu abasebenzisa umgwaqo kuleya ndawo.

src: Dikgwebo tse nyenyane le tse mahareng.
tgt: Amabhizinisi Amancane Nasafufusa.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane bakeng sa ho tshwara mmoho Dipontsho tsa Matjhaba tsa Tjhaena tsa Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane le tse Mahareng (SME) tsa selemong sena, kaha di nyehela bakeng sa ho bula mmaraka wa Tjhaena bakeng sa dikgwebo tse nyenyane le dikoporasi tsa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lincoma ukuthi uMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwamabhizinisi Amancane ngokuhlanganyela ekusingatheni umbukiso iChina International Small and Medium Enterprises (SME) Fair wakulo nyaka, njengoba uba negalelo ekuvuleleni amabhizinisi asafufusa kanye nemifelandawonye yaseNingizimu Afrika amathuba okuthi athengise imikhiqizo yawo ezweni lase-China.

src: Dipontsho tsa di-SME di tshwaretswe Guangzhou, ho la Tjhaena ho tloha ka la 10 ho isa ka la 27 Mphalane 2017.
tgt: Umbukiso we-SME uzoba seGuangzhou, eChina kusukela ngomhla ziyi-10 kuya kumhla zingama-27 kuMfumfu 2017.

src: Dikgwebo tse nyenyane ke motso wa moruo wa rona le motjhini bakeng sa kgolo ya moruo le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi ka hara Aforika Borwa, mme bonkakarolo ba rona dipontshong tsena tsa kgwebo bo kgothaleditse phihlello ya mmaraka le menyetla ya ho hodisa dikgwebo.
tgt: Amabhizinisi amancane awumongo womnotho wethu futhi awumnyombo wokukhula komnotho kanye nokudalwa kwamathuba omsebenzi eNingizimu Afrika, futhi ukuzibandakanya kwethu embukisweni wohwebo kusinike amathuba okuthengisa imikhiqizo yethu kwamanye amazwe kanye nawokukhulisa amabhizinisi.

src: Kabinete e na le tshepo ya hore sena se bontsha boitlamo ba mmuso morerong wa ho kgothaletsa le ho baballa moshwelella boetapele ba dikgwebo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linesiqiniseko sokuthi lokhu kuveza ukuzibophelela kukahulumeni emgomweni wokukhuthaza nokuqhubekisa ukuqalwa kwamabhizinisi amasha.

src: Ho tsetela dikgwebong tse nyenyane ho tla thusa naha ho arabela diphephetso tsa hajwale tsa moruo wa kahisano.
tgt: Utshalomali emabhizinisini amancane luzosiza izwe lithole isisombululo ezingqinambeni ezikhona kwezenhlalomnotho.

src: Bohahlaudi.
tgt: Ezokuvakasha.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha Lenaneo la Naha la Balebedi ba Bohahlaudi Soweto, ka Labobedi, 17 Mphalane 2017, le reretsweng ho matlafatsa boiphihlelo ba baeti hammoho le ho matlafatsa polokeho ya bahahlaudi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela ukwethulwa koHlelo Lwabaqaphi Ababhekele Ezokuvakasha Kuzwelonke eSoweto, ngoLwesibili mhla zingama-17 kuMfumfu 2017, okuhloswe ngalo ukukhuthaza ukuthi izivakashi ziphathwe ngezandla ezifudumele kanye nokuphucula ukuphepha kwezivakashi.

src: Lefapha la Bohahlaudi, ka bomphato le Bolaodi ba Bohahlaudi ba Gauteng, le thakgotse lenaneo lena Seterateng sa Vilakazi, e leng sona feela seterata lefatsheng se ikgantshang ka bodulo ba Baamohedi ba babedi ba Kgau ya Kgotso ya Nobel – Moporesidente wa mehleng Nelson Mandela le Archbishop Emeritus Desmond Tutu.
tgt: UMnyango Wezokuvakasha, ngokubambisana noPhiko Oluphethe Ezokuvakasha eGauteng, wethule lolu hlelo Emgwaqweni uVilakazi, okuwuwo kuphela umgwaqo emhlabeni ozigqaja ngokuthi kwahlala kuwo izigayigayi ezimbili ezaklonyeliswa ngama-Nobel Peace Prize - owayenguMongameli uNelson Mandela kanye noMbhishophi Omkhulu Osele Esidla Umhlalaphansi uDesmond Tutu.

src: Lenaneo lena le matahantswe le maikemisetso a Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP) mme le rerile ho hlahisa mesebetsi bakeng sa batjha ba 200, ba tla rupellwa ho ba balebedi ba dibaka tsa bohahlaudi bakeng sa nako ya dikgwedi tse Kabinete e kgothaletsa beng ba dikgwebo le badudi ba Gauteng ho sebetsa mmoho le balebedi ho ntlafatsa polokeho ya bahahlaudi le ho qhaneha bokgoni ba moruo ho tswa indasetering ena.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luhambisana nemigomo yoHlelo Lwentuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP) futhi luhlose ukudala amathuba omsebenzi abantu abasha abangama-200, abazoqeqeshelwa ukuba abaqaphi ezindaweni zokuvakasha isikhathi sezinyanga ezingama-36.

src: Kabinete e amohela le ho thoholetsa borasaense ba nkileng karolo ho diphuputso tsa ditheleskhoupu tsa Bolekodi ba Dinaledi ba Aforika Borwa (SAAO) le Thelesekhoupu e Kgolo ya Aforika e Borwa (SALT).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abanikazi bamabhizinisi kanye nemiphakathi eseGauteng ukuthi isebenzisane nabaqaphi ababhekele ezokuvakasha ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuphepha kwezivakashi futhi kusetshenziswe amathuba ezomnotho angatholakala kule mboni.

src: Sena se bakile tshebedisano ya matjhaba e so kang e ba teng esale ho batlisisa motso wa temoho ya pele ya maqhubu a lefatshe a hlahisitsweng ke dinaledi tse pedi tsa dinyotrone ha di thulana.
tgt: IKhabinethi lamukela futhi lihalalisela ososayensi ababambe iqhaza emsebenzini wokusinga obekwenziwa ngesibonisikude (itheleskophu) Esikhungweni saseNingizimu Afrika Esicwaninga Ngomkhathi (i-SAAO) kanye neSibonisikude Esikhulukazi SaseNingizimu Ne-Afrika (i-SALT).

src: Ho thulana hape ho bakile ho phatloha ha kganya ha kilonova.
tgt: Lokhu kuholele ekubambisaneni kwamazwe ahlukene okokuqala ngqa ngenhloso yokwenza ucwaningo ngemvelaphi yamagagasi okunqubuzana adalwa izinkanyezi ezincinyana ezimbili ezinqubuzanayo.

src: Kilonova ke ketsahalo ya dinaledi e etsahalang mokgweng wa maemo a mabedi ha dinaledi tse pedi tsa nyotrone kapa naledi ya nyotrone le lesoba le letsho di kopana.
tgt: Ukunqubuzana kwadala ukuthi kube nokuqhuma kokukhanya okubizwa ngokuthi i-kilanova.

src: Tshibollo ena e tshwaya tswalo ya sehla se setjha ho tsa astrofisiksi, e leng ketsahalo ya pele ya sepakapakeng e kileng ya lekolwa ho ka bobedi maqhubu a lefatshe le kganya.
tgt: I-kilanova iwukuqhuma okwenzeka lapho izinkanyezi ezincinyana ezimbili zijikelezana noma inkanyezi encinyane ilumbana ne-black hole.

src: Ditheleskhoupu tsa SALT le SAAO di fanne ka datha e nngwe ya pele ho seo se bonahalang e le ketsahalo eo ho ithutwang ka yona ka ho fetisisa ya astrofisiksi.
tgt: Le miphumela ivule amasango amasha kwisayensi yezezinkanyezi, ngesigameko sokuqala sezinkanyezi esibonakele emagagasini okunqubuzana kanye nokukhanya.

src: SALT le SAAO di hara dibaka tsa tekolo ya dinaledi tse fumanwang fatshe le sebakeng tse 70 tse kileng tsa lekola ho phatloha ha sebakeng ha dinaledi tse pedi tsa nyotrone, hang feela kamora maqhubu a tsona a ho thothomela ha lefatshe a ne a lemohuwa ke Laser Interferometer Gravitational-Wave Observatory ya Amerika le Virgo detector ya Yuropa.
tgt: I-SALT kanye nezinye izibonisikude ze-SAAO ezihlinzeke ngeminye yemininingo yokuqala yalokho osekuthathwa ngokuthi isigameko sesayensi yezezinkanyezi esesicwaningwe kakhulu kunangaphambilini.

src: Mokete wa Lefatshe wa Batjha le Baithuti.
tgt: Umbukiso Womhlaba Wentsha kanye Nabafundi.

src: Russia e tla tshwara Mokete wa Lefatshe wa Batjha le Baithuti wa 2017 ho tloha ka la 14 ho isa ka la 22 Mphalane 2017, e kenetsweng ke batjha ba fetang 20 000 ba tswang dinaheng tse 150.
tgt: IRussia isingethe uMbukiso Womhlaba Wentsha kanye Nabafundi wezi-2017 oqale ngomhla ziyi-14 kuya kwezingama-22 kuMfumfu 2017, ohanjelwe abantu abasha abangaphezu kwezi-20 000 basemazweni ayi-150.

src: Sepheo sa mokete ke ho bokella mmoho batjha ba lefatshe mabapi le mohopolo wa toka, ho matlafatsa dikamano tsa matjhaba, le ho ntshetsapele dikamano tsa merabe e kopaneng le botjhaba bo kopanetsweng.
tgt: Inhloso yombukiso ukuhlanganisa abantu abasha basemhlabeni ngaphansi kombono wezobulungiswa, ukuqiniswa kobudlelwano bakumazwe ngamazwe, kanye nokuthuthukisa ubudlelwano kubantu bezinhlanga kanye namasiko ahlukene.

src: Tshireletso ya bana.
tgt: Ukuvikelwa kwabantwana.

src: Kabinete e hlahisitse matshwenyeho a yona ho latela ditlaleho tse nyarosang tsa ditlolo tsa molao kgahlanong le bana, tsa moraorao ka ho fetisisa e leng moo ho belaellwang tlhekefetso ka motabo ya baithuti ba fetang 80 ba Sekolo sa Poraemari sa AB Xuma Orlando, ho la Soweto ke molebedi wa sekolo.
tgt: IKhabinethi liveze ukukhathazeka kwalo kulandela imibiko ephazamisayo ngobugebengu obubhekiswe ezinganeni, njengoba kamuva nje kube nezinsolo zokunukubezwa ngokocansi kwabafundi abangaphezu kwama-80 basesikoleni samabanga aphansi i-AB Xuma e-Orlando, eSoweto wunogada wesikole.

src: Lefapha la porofense le thoholetswa bakeng sa karabelo e potlakileng ka ho tlosa hanghang, bolaodi bo ka sehloohong ba sekolo seo, ho tlisa basebeletsi ba setjhaba le ho etsa dipatlisiso ka tshebediso ya lekala le ikemetseng.
tgt: Umnyango wasesifundazweni uncome ukusukuma ngokushesha okubonakele kususwa abaphathi besikole ngokuphazima kweso, ukuletha osonhlalakahle kanye nokuqalisa uphenyo oluqhutshwa uphiko oluzimele.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho badudi bohle ka hara Aforika Borwa ho sebetsa mmoho bakeng sa ho sireletsa bana bohle kgahlanong le sebopeho sefe kapa sefe sa kotsi kapa tlhekefetso, le ho sebetsa le sepolesa bakeng sa ho etsa hore metse ya rona e bolokehe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa yonke imiphakathi yaseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi ibambane ngezandla kuvikelwe izingane kunoma oluphi uhlobo lobugebengu nokuhlukunyezwa, futhi kubanjiswane namaphoyisa endawo ukuze kugcinwe imiphakathi yethu iphephile.

src: Ditlhatlhobo.
tgt: Ukuhlolwa Kwabafundi.

src: Kabinete e na le tshepo ya hore ditlhatlhobo tsa mafelo a selemo tsa dikolo di tla tswela pele ntle le tshitiso ho latela boipilaetso ba bongata bo neng bo eteletswe pele ke Mokgatlo wa Basebetsi wa Matitjhere wa Aforika Borwa (SADTU).
tgt: IKhabinethi likholwa ukuthi ukuhlolwa kokuphela konyaka kwezikole kuzoqhubeka ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka kulandela umbhikisho omkhulu kuleli sonto obowuholwa inyunyana yothisha, i-South African Democratic Teacher's Union (i-SADTU).

src: SADTU e fanne ka memorandamo ho Letona la Thuto ya Motheo, Mofumahadi Angie Motshekga, ya itlammeng ho rarolla dintlha tsa ngongoreho kapele kamoo ho ka kgonehang.
tgt: I-SADTU idlulisele uhlu lwezikhalo kuNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo, uNkk.

src: Ho bohlokwa hore bankakarolo kaofela ba sebetse mmoho bakeng sa ho bopa tikoloho e nepahetseng e tla thusa baithuti ho tsepamisa maikutlo thutong le ditlhatlhobong tsa bona.
tgt: Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke ababambiqhaza basebenzisane ukuze kube nesimo esifanele abafundi ukuze bakwazi ukugxila ekufundeni nasekuhlolweni kokuphela konyaka.

src: Difefo.
tgt: Izimvula ezinamandla.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona a tebileng ho baratuwa ba ba hlokahetseng nakong ya difefo tsa haufinyana tjena dikarolong tse ding tsa naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulisa ukuzwelana kakhulu nalabo abashiywe izihlobo zabo ngesikhathi kunezimvula ezinamandla zakamuva kwezinye izindawo zezwe.

src: Kabinete hape e fetisetsa diteboho tsa yona ho baithaopi bohle, mekgatlo ya setjhaba, badudi, basebeletsi ba dithuso le dihlopha tsa Taolo ya Dikoduwa bakeng sa ho thusa ba amehileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinda libonga bonke abazinikele, izinhlangano zomphakathi, imiphakathi, abasebenzi abasiza ezimweni zomonakalo kanye namathimba Alawula Umonakalo ngokusiza labo abathintekile.

src: Letona la Puso e Kopanetsweng le Merero ya Botjhaba, Monghadi Des van Rooyen, boemong ba hae jwaloka hlooho ya Setsi sa Naha sa Taolo ya Dikoduwa ka hara Aforika Borwa, o etetse dibaka tse anngweng ke difefo le dipula tse matla ka hara Masepala o Moholo wa eThekwini KwaZulu-Natal ka la 13 Mphalane 2017 le Masepala wa Lehae wa Mogale City Gauteng ka la 16 Mphalane 2017.Ka lebaka la dipula tse matla le difefo tse ruthuthileng dikarolo tse ngata tsa naha, ho hlokahetse batho ba19 mme batho ba fetang 20 ba lemetse.
tgt: Des van Rooyen, esikhundleni sakhe njengenhloko yeSikhungo Sokulawulwa Komonakalo Kuzwelonke eNingizimu Afrika, uhambele izindawo ezikhahlamezwe izimvula ezinamandla kuMasipala Omkhulu waseThekwini KwaZulu-Natali ngomhla ziyi-13 kuMfumfu 2017 kanye nakuMasipala Wendawo iMogale City eGauteng mhla zingama-16 kuMfumfu 2017.

src: Letona van Rooyen hape le etetse sebaka sa diketsahalo tsa Philippi ho la Kapa Bophirima moo ditho tse tsheletseng tsa lelapa, ho kenyeletswa bana ba bararo, di ileng tsa hlokahala ka lebaka la mollo o haitseng mekhukhu e meraro le lebenkele.
tgt: Lezi zimvula ezinamandla ezikhahlameze izindawo eziningi zezwe, zidlule nemiphefumulo yabantu abayi-19 futhi kwalimala abangama-20.

src: Kabinete e ananela ho qala ha motjha wa tharollo ya dikgang wa Life Esidimeni jwaloka se ka nnang ya ba qalo ya ho qeta taba ena bakeng sa malapa a bakudi ba hlokahetseng.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe van Rooyen uphinde wahambela izindawo zasePhilippi eNtshonalanga Kapa ezivelelwe umonakalo kamuva lapho amalungu omndeni ayisithupha okubandakanya izingane ezintathu, eshonile ngenxa yomlilo oqothule izindlu eziyimijondolo ezintathu kanye nesitolo esincane.

src: Kabinete e hlahisa tshepo e felletseng ho Motlatsi wa Moahlodi e Moholo wa Lekgotla la Molaotheo ya behileng meja fatshe Dikgang Moseneke, eo e leng modulasetulo wa taba ena le ho lakaletsa ditho tsa malapa matla ho tswa botebong ba dipelo jwaloka ha e lemoha seo e tlamehang e le bopaki ba boima ba masisapelo ana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lazisa ukuqala kwenqubo yokuxazulula izimpikiswano ngokunye okwakungenzeka eLife Esidimeni njengalokho okungase kube ukuqala kokuphenduleka kwemibuzo emindenini eyashonelwa iziguli.

src: Dipatlisiso ha di a lokela feela ho thusa ba malapa a amehang hore ba thobehe maikutlo empa hape di lokela ho hlahisetsa mmuso dintho kaofela tseo o lokelang ho ithuta tsona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulisa ukumethemba ngaphandle kokunqikaza owayeyiPhini Lejaji Eliyinhloko LaseNkantolo YoMthethosisekelo uDikgang Moseneke, ongumehluleli kulolu daba futhi lifisela amalungu omndeni amandla njengoba ebuka kudingidwa lesi sehlo.

src: Mmuso o itlametse ho fana ka ditshebeletso tsa boleng ho maAforika Borwa kaofela.
tgt: Uhulumeni uzimisele ngokuhlinzeka ngezidingo eziseqophelweni eliphezulu eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ntaramane ya Avian.
tgt: Umkhuhlane Wezinkhukhu Nezinyoni, i-Avian Influenze.

src: Kabinete e netefaleditswe hore Lefapha la Temo, Meru le Ditlhapi (DAFF) le ikitlaeditse ho etsa tekolo ya ka dinako tsohle mapolasing ho phatlalla le naha e le mokutu wa ho thibela ho nama ha ho runya ha Ntaramane ya Avian (HPAI) H5Melatsitsi ya ntaramane ya avian e sibollotswe dinonyaneng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liqinisekisiwe ukuthi uMnyango Wezolimo, Amahlathi kanye Nezokudoba (i-DAFF) wenza ucwaningo oluhambisanayo emapulazini asezweni lilonke ngenhloso yokugwema ukusabalala kokuqubuka komkhuhlane wezinkukhu nezinyoni, i-Avian Influenza (HPAI) H5Lo mkhuhlane ubonakele ezinyonini.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa setjhaba ho tlohela ho tshwarana le dinonyana tse kulang kapa tse shweleng mme se se leke ho fepa dinonyana tse hlaha empa ba ka mpa ba tlaleha dinonyane tseo ba belaelang hore di a kula ho balaodi ba lehae.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa umphakathi ukuthi ugweme ukubamba izinkukhu nezinyoni ezigulayo noma ezifile futhi ungazami ukupha izinyoni zasendle ukudla kepha ubikele abaphethe uma kunezinkukhu nezinyoni osola ukuthi ziyagula.

src: Ditlhaselo tsa Mapolesa.
tgt: Ukuhlaselwa kwamaphoyisa.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe tlhaselo ya ditho tse tsheletseng tsa ditho tsa Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS) Vanderbijlpark ho la Gauteng ka la 10 Mphalane 2017 ke ditho tsa badudi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligxeka ukuhlaselwa kwamaphoyisa ayisithupha angamalungu Ombutho Wamaphoyisa eNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) eVanderbijlpark eGauteng ngomhla ziyi-10 kuMfumfu 2017 ebulawa amalungu omphakathi.

src: Makala a qobello ya molao a fuwe thomo ya ho sireletsa setjhaba ketsong efe kapa efe ya botlokotsebe.
tgt: Izinhlangano eziphoqelela umthetho zijutshelwe ukuvikela umphakathi kunoma eziphi izenzo zobugebengu.

src: Kahoo, ha ho kgalefo e ngata hakae e ka dumeletsehang ya hore mang kapa mang o lokela ho hlasela makala a qobello ya molao.
tgt: Ngakho, alukho uhlobo lobungozi olunosetshenziswa njengesizathu sokuhlasela izinhlangano eziphoqelela umthetho.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa ditho tsa badudi ho sebetsa mmoho le sepolesa ho tshwara ditlokotsebe le ho thusa ho etsa Aforika Borwa e bolokehe bakeng sa bohle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa amalungu omphakathi ukuthi asebenzisane namaphoyisa ukubamba izigebengu nokusiza ekwenzeni iNingizimu Afrika ibe ngephephile elungele bonke abantu.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabinethi.

src: Lenaneo la Matlo la Setjhaba.
tgt: Uhlelo Lokubonelela Umphakathi Ngezindlu.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka diphetho le dikgothaletso tsa Tekolo ya Dikgahlamelo le ho Kenngwa Tshebetsong ha Lenaneo la Matlo a Setjhaba le moralo wa ntlafatso, ka morero wa ho lwantsha dipaterone tsa phano ya dibaka tsa mmuso wa kgethollo ka ho ntlafatsa maemo a dibaka le ho kopanya bodulo ba metse ya ditoropo ba diporojeke tsa matlo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lachazelwa ngokutholakele kanye nezincomo eziqondene Nomthelela kanye Nokuhlolwa Kokuqaliswa Kohlelo Lokubonelela Umphakathi Ngezindlu kanye nohlelo lokuthuthukisa, ngenhloso yokuqeda ukuhlaliswa kwabantu ngokuqhelelana okwadalwa uhulumeni wobandlululo ngokuthuthukisa kokugqagqana kwezindawo kanye nokusondezwa ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni emiklamweni yokwakhiwa kwezindlu.

src: Lenaneo lena le fana ka bodulo bo kgonehang ba kgiro bakeng sa malapa a lekeno le tlase le le mahareng dibakeng tseo maemo a mmaraka a neng a tla ba qhelela ka thoko kapa ho ba abela bodulo bo sa lokang.
tgt: Uhlelo luhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala okuqashwa kuyo engambi eqolo yemindeni ehola kancane kanye nehola imali emaphakathi ezindaweni ebeyingase icwaseke kuyo ngenxa yezimo zokumba eqolo kwaleyo ndawo noma yabelwe izindlu ezingalungile.

src: Lena ke lona lenaneo feela le thusang ka ditjhelete tsa mokitlane le nkelang hloohong ho ba teng ha nako e telele bokgoni ba moshwelella ba diporojeke mme le bopa motsamao o motle wa tjhelete moo bahiri ba lefang rente le moo ditheo tsa matlo di lefang sekgahla sa tshebediso, makgetho le ditefello tsa tshebeletso ho bomasepala.
tgt: Yilolu kuphela uhlelo olusebenzisa uxhaso oluyisikweletu lucubungule amaphrojekthi aqhubekisekayo ngokwezimali isikhathi eside futhi ludale ukungena nokuphuma kwemali okunozinzo njengoba iziqashi zizokhokha imali yokuqasha futhi izikhungo zokubonelela umphakathi ngezindlu zikhokhele izinsiza, intela kanye nezidingo-ngqangi zikamasipala.

src: Tlaleho ena e thusa mafapha a amehang ho ya pele ho ntlafatsa meralo ya yona ya tshebetso ka ho latelana.
tgt: Lo mbiko usiza iminyango efanele ukuthi iqhubeke nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zayo zokusebenza ngokwahlukana kwayo.

src: Tlaleho e felletseng e tla manehwa websaeteng ya Lefapha la Merero, Bodisa le Tekolo ya Tshebetso (WEBTOKEN).
tgt: Umbiko ogcwele uzofakwa kuwebhusayithi yoMnyango Wezokuhlela, Ukuqapha kanye Nokuhlola (WEBTOKEN).

src: Tshebeletso ya Naha ya Batjha (NYS).
tgt: Imisebenzi Yentsha Yakuzwelonke (i-NYS).

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Lenaneo la Moralo la NYS le shebuweng botjha le ho ntlafatswa jwaloka karolo ya ho ntshetsa pele batjha jwaloka badudi ba mahlahahlaha ba Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze Uhlaka Lohlelo lwe-NYS olubukeziwe noluthuthukisiwe njengengxenye yokuthuthukisa abantu abasha babe izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika ezishabashekayo.

src: NYS ke sethusi bakeng sa batjha ka hara Aforika Borwa hore e be baahi ba mahlahahlaha ba naha le ho nyehela ka bokgabane ntshetsopeleng ya naha ka ho le leng ba fihlella ntshetsopele ya bo bona le ya seporofeshenale.
tgt: I-NYS ivulela abantu abasha baseNingizimu Afrika ithuba lokuba amalungu asebenzayo ezweni futhi babe negalelo elihle ekuthuthukisweni kwezwe khona manjalo bezithuthukisa bona siqu nangokomsebenzi.

src: Sena se tla kenyeletsa batjha hore ba nke karolo mesebetsing e tswelang badudi ba lehae molemo ha e ntse e ntshetsa pele bokgoni ba bona ka tshebeletso le ho ithuta hore menyetla ya bona ya ho kenella mebarekeng ya mesebetsi le ho ba baetapele ba dikgwebo e matlafale.
tgt: Lokhu kuzobandakanya ukuthi abantu abasha bazibandakanye emisebenzini ezohlomulisa imiphakathi yasendaweni ibe ithuthukisa amakhono abo ngemisebenzi kanye nokufunda ukuze kwande amathuba abo okuthola imisebenzi nokuba abaqali bamabhizinisi ngempumelelo.

src: Foramo ya bo-3 ya Aforika ya Beke ya Katoloso ya Ditshebeletso tsa Boeletsi tsa Temo.
tgt: ISonto lesi-3 Lesithangami Se-Afrika Lokwengezela Imisebenzi Yokwelulelwa Kwezolimo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tshwarwa ha Foramo ya bo-3 ya Aforika ya Katoloso ya Ditshebeletso tsa Boeletsi ba Temo, e tla tshwarelwa KwaZulu-Natal ho tloha ka la 30 Mphalane ho isa ka la 3 Pudungwana 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukusingathwa kweSonto lesi-3 Lesithangami Se-Afrika Lokwengezela Imisebenzi Yokwelulekwa Kwezolimo, esizobanjwa KwaZulu-Natali kusukela ngomhla zingama-30 kuMfumfu kuya kumhlaka 3 kuLwezi 2017.

src: Ketsahalo e matahantswe le NDP le ho hlwaya kanetso ya dijo jwaloka tsela ya ho sebetsana le diphephetso tse tharo tsa tlhokeho ya mesebetsi, bofuma le ho se lekalekane.
tgt: Lo mbuthano uhambisana ne-NDP futhi uhlonza ukukhiqizwa kokudla okwanele njengendlela yokubhekana nenselele ehlukaniseke kathathu: ukusweleka kwamathuba omsebenzi, ububha kanye nokungalingani.

src: Mookotaba o re: “Re ntlafatsa mokgwa wa temo wa tlelaemete wa maemo: ho kopanya batjha, basadi, le diphethoho ho tsa dijithale”, mme ketsahalo eo e tla tshwarwa tlasa boetapele ba DAFF, ka tshebedisano le Mokgatlo wa Aforika Borwa wa Katoloso ya Temo le Foramo ya Aforika ya ditshebeletso tsa Boeletsi ba tsa Temo.
tgt: Isiqubulo sithi: "Ukukhuphula ezolimo ezihambisana nesimo sezulu: ukudidiyela intsha, abantu besifazane, kanye nokushintsa kwezobuchwepheshe", futhi umcimbi uzobanjwa ngaphansi kobuholi be-DAFF, ngokuhlanganyela noNhlangano yaseNingizimu Afrika Yowelulwa Kwezolimo kanye neSigungu Se-Afrika Somisebenzi Yokwelulekwa Kwezolimo.

src: Marangrang ana a kontinente bakeng sa Katoloso ya Temo le Ditshebeletso tsa Boeletsi (AEAS) ka hara Aforika a fana ka lepatlelo bakeng sa ho ithuta ho kopanetsweng le ntlafatso hara bafani ba AEAS ho phatlalla le Aforika le lefatshe.
tgt: Lezi zigungu zezwekazi zoKwandisa Ezolimo kanye Nemisebenzi Yokweluleka (i-AEAS) e-Afrika zivula inkundla yokufundisana kanye nokusungulwa kwamasu amasha phakathi kwabahlinzekeli be-AEAS kulo lonke lase-Afrika nasemhlabeni.

src: NDP hape e kgothaletsa ntlafatso ya ntshetsopele ya maitsebelo le thupello lekaleng la temo, ho kenyeletswa le thupello ya lebotho le letjha la balemisi ba tla arabela ka bokgabane ditlhokong tsa dihwai tse nyenyane.
tgt: I-NDP iphinde ilwele ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kanye nokuqeqesha emkhakheni wezolimo, okubandakanya ukuqeqesha abasebenzi abasha bezokwengezela abazophumelela ekubhekaneni nezidingo zabalimi abasebenzela ukuziphilisa.

src: Sehlopha sa Lefatshe sa Kgwebisano ya Veine.
tgt: Iqoqo Lamazwe Ahweba Ngewayini Emhlabeni.

src: Bakeng sa ho nyehela ho tlosweng ha ditshita tsa kgwebisano, Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka bodulasetulo ba Aforika Borwa ba Sehlopha sa Lefatshe sa Kgwebisano ya Veine ho tloha ka Mmesa 2017 ho isa Motsheanong 2018.
tgt: Njengoba kususwe izithiyo kwezohwebo, iKhabhinethi laziswe ngesimo seNingizimu Afrika ekubeni uSihlalo weQoqo Lamazwe Ahweba Ngewayini Emhlabeni (i-WWTG) kusukela kuMbasa 2017 kuya kuNhlaba 2018.

src: Jwaloka modulasetulo, Aforika Borwa e tla tshwara kopano ya selemo ka seng ya Sehlopha sa Lefatshe sa Kgwebisano ya Veine Motse Kapa ho tloha ka la 1 ho isa ka la 3 Pudungwana 2017.
tgt: Njengosihlalo, iNingizimu Afrika izosingatha umhlangano wonyaka we-WWTG eKapa kusukela ngomhla lu-1 kuya kumhla zi-3 kuLwezi 2017.

src: Sehlopha se rerile ho thusa ka kgwebisano ya matjhaba ka veine ka ho arolelana tlhahisoleseding, ho buisana ka dintlha tsa taolo mebarakeng ya veine le diketso tse kopanetsweng tsa ho tlosa ditshita tsa kgwebisano.
tgt: Iqoqo lihlose ukulawula ukuhwebelana kwamazwe ngamazwe ngewayini ngokusebenzisa ukwabelana ngolwazi, ukudingidwa kwezinkinga ngemithetho elawula emazweni akhiqiza nahweba ngewayini kanye nezindlela ezihlanganisiwe zokususwa kwezithiyo kwezohwebo.

src: Bahlahisi ba ntseng ba runya le diyantle tsa indaseteri ya veine ya Aforika Borwa ba kgola molemo bonkakarolong ba Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Abakhiqizi abasafufusa kanye nezinkampani zaseNingizimu Afrika ezithengisela amazwe angaphandle iwayini bayahlomula ngokuzibandakanya kweNingizimu Afrika Lokhu kunegalelo Ohlelweni Olunaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye kanye ne-NDP, ehlose ukuvuselela ezolimo kanye nohlelo lokulungiswa kwemikhiqizo yezolimo.

src: Sena se nyehela ho Moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong le NDP, tse rerileng ho hlasimolla botjha lethathama la boleng la temo le tswelliso ya dihlahiswa tsa temo.
tgt: Emkhakheni wezewayini, inhloso ukwandisa indawo ngokukhiqizwa kwewayini, ukwesekela abakhiqizi abasafufusa kanye namazwe ekungagxilwa kuwo ukuze kukhuliswe isamba somkhiqizo wewayini othunyelwa ngaphandle.

src: Lekaleng la temo, sepheo ke ho eketsa sebaka se tlasa tlhahiso ya veine, ho tshehetsa bahlahisi ba banyenyane le ho sheba mebaraka e itseng bakeng sa kgolo ya diyantle.
tgt: UMhlangano Waminyaka Yonke wesi-5 Wenhlangano i-ID4AFRICIKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukusingatha kweNingizimu Afrika uMhlangano Waminyaka Yonke Wesi-5 we-ID4Africa ngowezi-2019.

src: Kopano ya bo-5 ya Selemo ka Seng ya Mokgatlo wa ID4Africa.
tgt: I-ID4Africa uyinhlangano ehlanganisa inqwaba yababambiqhaza ekhuthaza ukulandelwa kwendlela yezobuchwepheshe yokuhola ukuthuthukiswa kwenhlalomnotho yase-Afrika ngokusobala nangendlela ebonakalisa ukukhathala.

src: ID4Africa ke mokgatlo wa bankakarolo ba bangata o kgothaletsang kamohelo e bonaletsang le e nang le boikarabelo ya boitsebiso ba dijithale bakeng sa ho kganna ntshetsopele ya moruo wa kahisano ka hara Aforika.
tgt: Inhloso ngezingxoxo ukuthuthukisa indlela okubhaliswa ngayo abantu kanye nendlela imininingo yezibalo eqoqwa, ididiyelwe futhi icutshungulwe ngayo, okwenza ababhali bemithetho bakwazi ukuthola ulwazi olungathenjwa.

src: Dipuisano di reretswe ho ntlafatsa tsela eo boingodiso ba setjhaba le datha ya dipalopalo tsa bohlokwa di bokellwang, di hokahangwang le ho hlophollwa ka yona, ho etsa hore ho be le tlhahisoleseding e tshepahalang bakeng sa baetsi ba maano.
tgt: Ukusingatha lo mhlangano kuzosiza iNingizimu Afrika ukuze ibone ezinye izimpokophelo ze-NDP futhi ziqwashise ngokubaluleka kweqhingasu lezindlela zokuhlonza iNingizimu Afrika njengezindlela zokuqopha zobuchwepheshe ezisetshenziselwa izincwadi zokuvakashela kwamanye amazwe (amaphasiphothi) kanye namakhadi awumazisi akhiwe ngendlela yobuchwepheshe.

src: Ho tshwara pitso ena ho tla thusa Aforika Borwa ho fihlella merero e meng ya NDP le ho bopa temoso ya molemo wa lewa bakeng sa ditsamaiso tsa Aforika Borwa tsa boitsebiso tse kang tsamaiso ya ho sebetsana le diphasepoto le ditokomane tsa dikarete tsa thekenoloji tsa boitsebiso (ID).
tgt: Kuzophinde kube negalelo elihle ekubizeleni amanye amazwe asesifundeni ukuthi abone okuzuzwayo ngamakhadi awumazisi akhiwe ngendlela yobuchwepheshe.

src: Dipalopalo tsa Naha tsa Botlokotsebe.
tgt: Izibalo zobugebengu zikazwelonke.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka dipalopalo tsa naha tsa botlokotsebe bakeng sa nako ya la 1 Mmesa 2016 ho isa ho la 31 Hlakubele 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi laziswe ngezibalo zobugebengu kuzwelonke zesikhathi esisukela kumhla lu-1 kuMbasa kuya kumhla zingama-31 kuNdasa 2017.

src: Dipalopalo tsa selemo ka seng di thusa mmuso ho beha leihlo dibaka tse ka sehloohong tsa botlokotsebe tse lokelang ho lwantshwa, jwaloka ha ho tekilwe ho Moralo wa Lewa la Nako e Bohareng (MTSF) wa 2014-2019.
tgt: Izibalo zobugebengu zaminyaka yonke zisiza uhulumeni akwazi ukuqapha imigomo esemqoka yokulwa nobugebengu, njengoba imiswe kuHlaka Lokusebenza Kwesikhathi Esimaphakathi (i-MTSF) lowezi-2014-2019.

src: Dipalopalo tsa botlokotsebe di sebediswa jwaloka mokgwa wa temoso wa pele ho matlafatsa ditshebetso tsa thibelo ya botlokotsebe le mawa a mafapha a fapafapaneng.
tgt: Izibalo zobugebengu zisetshenziswa njengendlela yokuqwashisa kusanesikhathi ukuze kuqiniswe izinhlelo zokuvikela ubugebengu kanye namaqhingasu eminyango eyahlukene.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho lokollwa ha tlaleho ya Letona la Sepolesa, Monghadi Fikile Mbalula.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukuthi uNgqongqoshe uFikile Mbalula akhiphe umbiko.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Imicimbi Ezayo.

src: Mokete wa Dilemo tse Lekgolo wa OR Tambo.
tgt: Umgubho Weminyaka Eyikhulu kwazalwa u-OR Tambo.

src: Kabinete e thabisitswe ke hore boitokisetso ba mokete wa dilemo tse lekgolo tsa tswalo ya OR Tambo bo se bo le pele le ho ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho tswela pele ho itlwaetsa lefa la qhoku ya rona ya Ntwa ya tokoloho, karolo eo a e bapetseng tokolohong ya rona, le dipehelo tsa hae tse ntseng di re tataisa le kajeno.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyakujabulela ukubona ukuthi izinhlelo zomgubho weminyaka eyikhulu kwazalwa u-OR Tambo seyisesigabeni esiphambili futhi imema zonke izakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi ziqhubeke nokuzifundisa ngomlando oyifa walesi sigagayi Somzabalazo wethu, iqhaza alidlala enkululekweni yethu, kanye nalokho okwakuyigugu kuye okusawumhlahlandlela wethu nanamuhla.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tsebisitse selemo sa 2017 e le Selemo sa OR Tambo tlasa mookotaba: “Bophelo le Lefa la OR Tambo” mme, ka Labone, la 19 Mphalane 2017, o tla bula seemahale sa boholo bo lekanang le bophelo ba nnete ba OR Tambo Boemafofaneng ba Matjhaba ba OR Tambo Ekurhuleni, ho la Gauteng.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma wamemezela unyaka wezi-2017 njengonyaka ka-OR Tambo ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi "Impilo Nomlando Oyifa ka-OR Tambo" futhi ngoLwesine, mhla ziyi-19 kuMfumfu 2017, uzokwembula isichuse esikhulukazi sika-OR Tambo Esikhumulweni Sezindiza i-OR Tambo International Airport, Ekurhuleni, eGauteng.

src: MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho kenela mekete ya dilemo tse lekgolo, e tla fihlella sehlohlolo ka la 27 Mphalane Mbizana, ho la Kapa Botjhabela, e leng tulo ya tswalo ya qhoku ena ya Ntwa dilemong tse 100 tse fetileng.
tgt: Izakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika zikhuthazwa ukuthi zihlanganyele ekubungazeni iminyaka eyikhulu, okuzophela mhla zingama-27 kuMfumfu eMbizana, eMpumalanga Kapa, okuyindawo lesi Sigagayi Somzabalazo esazalelwa kuyo eminyakeni eyi-100 eyadlula.

src: Mmuso o tswela pele ho ahella hodima lefa la OR Tambo ho tloha ka selemo sa 1994, le dikuno tse ngata tsa rona jwaloka maAforika Borwa di lokela ho ketekwa le ho tshireletswa.
tgt: Uhulumeni uyaqhubeka nokwakhela phezu kwemisebenzi ka-OR Tambo kusukela ngowe-1994, futhi okuningi esesikuzuzile njengezakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika kumele kubungazwe futhi kuvikelwe.

src: Komiti e Kopanetsweng ya Matona e fuweng mosebetsi wa ho lokisetsa mekete ya dilemo tse lekgolo, tlasa bodulasetulo ba Letona Jeff Radebe, e tla tsebisa boraditaba ka boemo ba boitokisetso ka Labohlano, 20 Mphalane 2017.Melaetsa.
tgt: IKomidi loNgqongqoshe Abahlukene elinomsebenzi wokulungiselela imibungazo yeminyaka eyikhulu, osihlalo walo kunguNgqongqoshe uJeff Radebe, lizokwazisa imithombo yezindaba ngoLwesihlanu zingama-20 kuMfumfu ngokuthi uhulumeni usewulungele kangakanani lo mbungazo.

src: Tlhaselo Somalia.
tgt: Ukuhlaselwa kwaseSomalia.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe ka matla tlhaselo ya bomo haufinyana tjena ka ntle ho hotele ya Mogadishu, ho la Somalia.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugxeka kakhulu ukuhlaselwa ngebhomu kwakamuva ngaphandle kwehhotela laseMogadishu, eSomalia.

src: Ho tlalehilwe hore bonyane batho ba 300 ba hlokahetse mme ba bang ba balwang ka makgolo ba lemetse.
tgt: Kubikwe ukuthi kushone abantu abangama-300 futhi kwalimala amakhulu.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso ho baratuwa ba batho ba hlokahetseng tlhaselong ena e sehloho ya batho ba se nang molato.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lidlulisa ukuzwelana okukhulu nalabo abalahlekelwe izihlobo zabo kulokhu kuhlaselwa kwabantu abamsulwa okunyantisayo.

src: Matshediso ho lelapa la Lubisi.
tgt: Ukuzwelana nomndeni wakwaLubisi.

src: Kabinete hape e fetisetsa matshediso a yona a tswang boteng ba pelo ho Motsamaisi-Kakaretso Kantorong ya Moporesidente, Ngaka Cassius Lubisi, ho latela ho hlokahala ha mohatsae, Mofumahadi Lumka Lubisi, pejana kgweding ena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithi alwehlanga lungehlanga kuoMqondisi-Jikelele oseHhovisi LikaMongameli, uDkt.

src: Kabinete e kopane Tuynhuys Motse Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lahlangana eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Dintlha tsa hajwale.
tgt: Izindaba Ezisematheni.

src: Pehelo ya Leano la Ditekanyetso tsa Nako e Bohareng (MTBPS) 2017.
tgt: Isitatimende seNqubomgomo Yesabelomali Sesikhathi Esimaphakathi (i-MTBPS) sowezi-2017.

src: Kabinete e amohela MTBPS e tshetlehilweng ke Letona la Ditjhelete, Monghadi Malusi Gigaba, Palamenteng, Motse Kapa, bekeng e fetileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela i-MTBPS eyethulwe uNgqongqoshe Wezezimali, uMnu.

src: Ditekanyetso tsa ditokiso di tswela pele ho kganna kgolo e kenyeletsang le matlafatso ya ditjhelete tsa mmuso ka ho le leng ho tshireletsa le ho kgothaletsa ditshenyehelo tsa setjhaba mabapi le thuto, boitekanelo, meralo ya motheo ya mantlha le tshireletso ya setjhaba, tseo maAforika Borwa a bo rona a itshetlehileng hodima tsona hore ba natefelwe ke bophelo bo betere.
tgt: Malusi Gigaba, ePhalamende, eKapa, ngesonto eledlule.

src: Maemong a tsitsipano a moruo, boitlamo ba mmuso ba ho mekamekana le diphephetso ka hara Aforika Borwa bo bontshwa ka maitshunyako a ho hodisa meruo ya makeishene le ya dibaka tsa metse ya mahae, ho matlafatsa taolo e hlwahlwa dikhamphaning tsa mmuso, hammoho le kabo ya tlatsetso e bonahalang ya ho thusa thuto e phahameng ka matlole.
tgt: Ukuchitshiyelwa kwesabelomali kuyaqhubeka nokuhola ukukhula komnotho okubandakanyayo kanye nokuqiniswa kwesimo sezimali kube kuvikelwa futhi kukhuthazwa ukuthi imali isetshenziselwe izinhlelo zomphakathi kwezemfundo, ezempilo, ingqalasizinda eyisisekelo kanye nezibonelelo zikahulumeni, abantu abaningi baseNingizimu Afrika abethembele kukho ukuze baphile impilo engcono.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho kenela mekutu e eketsehileng ya ho hodisa moruo.
tgt: Esimweni sezimali esinezingqinamba, ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni ukuhlangabezana nezinselele eNingizimu Afrika kubonakala ngezindlela zokungenelela ukuze kukhuliswe iminotho yasemalokishini nasezindaweni zasemakhaya, kuqiniswe ukuphatha okuhle ezinkampanini zikahulumeni, kanjalo nokwandisa isabelomali esanele kwezemfundo yasemazingeni aphakeme.

src: Tekolo ya Lebotho la Basebetsi.
tgt: Ucwaningo Ngesimo Sabantu Abaqashiwe.

src: Kabinete e ananela Tekolo ya Kotara ka Nngwe ya Lebotho la Basebetsi e lokolotsweng haufinyana tjena bakeng sa kotara ya boraro ya selemo sa 2017, e bontshang hore sekgahla sa tlhokeho ya mesebetsi se dutse se sa fetoha ho tloha kotareng e fetileng moo e neng e le 27.7%.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela ukukhishwa koCwaningo Ngokuqashwa Kwabantu Emisebenzini kwekota lesithathu lowezi-2017, elibonakalise ukuthi isimo sokungatholakali kwamathuba omsebenzi asikashintshi kusukela ekoteni eledlule elabonakalisa ama-27.7%.

src: Ho rekotuwe dikuno tsa kgiro lekaleng la mmuso tse etsang 187 000 nakong ya kotara, lekaleng leo e seng la mmuso le lekaleng la temo a rekotile tahlehelo ya mesebetsi ya 71 000 le 25 000 ka tatelano.
tgt: Amathuba omsebenzi avelile emikhakheni okusetshenzwa kuwo ngokugcwele abe yizi-187 000 ngekota.

src: Mmuso o dula o iteletse ho etsa sohle se ka kgonehang ho sebetsana le diphephetso tsa tlhokeho ya mesebetsi le ho ipiletsa lekaleng la poraefete ho bapala karolo ya lona.
tgt: Umkhakha okungasetshenzwa kuwo ngokugcwele ulahlekelwe ngamathuba omsebenzi ayizi-71 000 kanti wona owezolimo ulahlekelwe ngamathuba omsebenzi ayizi-25 000.

src: Mokete wa Dilemo tse Lekgolo wa Oliver Reginald Tambo.
tgt: Ukugujwa Kweminyaka Eyikhulu Kwazalwa u-Oliver Reginald Tambo.

src: Kabinete e leboha maAforika Borwa kaofela bakeng sa ho keteka dilemo tse lekgolo tsa mohale wa Ntwa ya Tokoloho OR Tambo, o fihletseng sehlohlolo ka mokete wa Labohlano, la 27 Mphalane 2017 Motsaneng wa Nkantolo ho la Kapa Botjhabela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi libonga zonke izakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika ngokubungaza iminyaka eyikhulu kwazalwa iqhawe Lomzabalazo u-OR Tambo, okwagcina ngombungazo owaba ngoLwesihlanu, ngomhla zingama-27 kuMfumfu 2017 Esigodini iNkantolo eMpumalanga Kapa.

src: Jwaloka karolo ya mekete ya dilemo tse lekgolo, Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o ne a eteletse pele diporojeke tsa ntlafatso, tse kenyeletsang:Phano ya Letamo la Ludeke Mbizana, le ahilweng e le karolo ya Sekema sa Lebatowa le Leholo la Phepelo ka Bongata ya Metsi la Mbizana ke Lefapha la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya DikgwerekgwereLeeto la ho ya lelapeng la Nyameni Motsaneng wa Ludeke moo Moporesidente a ileng a hotetsa motlakase, e le karolo ya lenaneo la mmuso le pharaletseng la ho hokela motlakase dibakeng tsa mahae Mbizana le dibakeng tse mabapiDibaesekele tse abetsweng baithuti Sekolong sa Tekginiki se Phahameng sa OR Tambo, e le karolo ya lenaneo la Lefapha la Dipalangwang la Shova Kalula, le tshehetsang baithuti ba tsamayang sebaka sa dikilomithara tse fetang tse tharo ho ya sekolongNyehelo ya dikhompyutha Sekolong se Ikgethang sa Vukuzenzele bakeng sa bana ba nang le boqhwala, e neng e eteletswe pele ke Letona la Dikgokahanyo, Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane.
tgt: Njengengxenye yemibungazo yeminyaka eyikhulu, uMongameli Jacob Zuma wavula ngokusemthethweni imiklamo yokuthuthukisa, okubandakanya: Ukuvulwa kwedamu iLudeke eMbizana, elakhiwa ngaphansi koHlelo Lokuhlinzeka Ngamanzi Esifundeni SaseMbizana.

src: Dipalopalo tsa botlokotsebe tse lokolotsweng haufinyana tjena ke Letona la Sepolesa, Monghadi Fikile Mbalula, di bontshitse dibaka tse ding moo re entseng kgatelopele mabapi le ho lwantsha botlokotsebe le dibaka tse ding moo maemo a botlokotsebe a ntseng a dutse a phahame.
tgt: Ukuvakashela umndeni wakwaNyameni Esigodini iLudeke lapho uMongameli akhanyisa khona ugesi, njengengxenye yohlelo lukahulumeni lokufaka ugesi ezindaweni zasemakhaya eMbizana namaphetheloAbafundi banikwa amabhayisikili esikoleni i-OR Tambo Technical High School, ngaphansi kohlelo loMnyango Wezokuthutha i-‘Shova Kalula’, olweseka abafundi abahamba ibanga elingaphezu kwamakhilomitha amathathu uma beya esikoleni Ukunikela ngamakhompyutha kubafundi baseVukuzenzele Special School okuyisikole sabantwana abaphila nokukhubazeka, okwakuholwa uNgqongqoshe Wezokuxhumana, uMmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane.

src: Dipalopalo tsa botlokotsebe di thusa mmuso le Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa ya Aforika Borwa (SAPS) ho beha leihlo dibaka tse ka sehlohlolong le ho sebetsa jwaloka mokgwa wa ho lemosa nako e sa le teng bakeng sa ho matlafatsa ditshebetso tsa thibelo ya botlokotsebe le mawa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa zonke izakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nemiphakathi ukuthi kubanjiswane namaphoyisa ukulwa nobugebengu.

src: Ke karolo ya lewa la thibelo ya botlokotsebe ho netefatsa hore batho bohle ka hara naha ba bolokehile le ho ikutlwa ba le jwalo.
tgt: Fikile Mbalula, ziveze ezinye zezindawo labo esenze kangcono khona ngokulwisana nobugebengu kanye nezinye izindawo ezisanamazinga obugebengu aphezulu.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa ho tshwela ka mathe ha yona ha tlhekefetso ya basadi le bana, ho sa tsotellwe maemo a baetsi ba diketso tse jwalo setjhabeng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likholwa ukuthi uma kungabanjiswana sonke singazuza ngokwakha imiphakathi ephephile nengaba sethubeni lokuthuthukiswa.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa mahlatsipa ho tlaleha diketsahalo tsena tse mpe ho baetapele ba qobello ya molao, ba lokelang ho batlisisa dipelaello tsa GBV le ho sebetsa ka matla ka hara lepatlelo la molao ho netefatsa hore toka e ya phethahatswa.
tgt: Izibalo zobugebengu zisiza uhulumeni kanye noMbutho Wamaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) ukuqapha izindawo okugaselwa kuzo kakhulu futhi ziyisixwayiso sokuqinisa izindlela zokusebenza kanye namasu okunqanda ubugebengu.

src: Letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 a Diketso tsa Thibelo ya Dikgoka Kgahlanong le Basadi le Bana le a atamela mme Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana mookotaba wa selemong sena: “Mpalleng le nna: Mmoho re Ntshetsapele Aforika Borwa e Hlokang Dikgoka”.
tgt: Ziyingxenye yesu lokunqanda ubugebengu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abantu ezweni abazizwa bephephile nje kuphela kepha baphephile impela.

src: Kabinete hape e ipiletsa ho baahi ho rutana ka ditokelo tsa basadi le bana, le ka mekgwa e meng ya thuso e teng bakeng sa ho thusa mahlatsipa a dikgoka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinda ligxeka ukuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besifazane nabantwana ngokocansi, noma ngabe abenzi bala macala bakweziphi izikhundla emphakathini.

src: Letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 a Diketso tsa Thibelo ke letsholo la Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN), le etsahalang selemo ka seng ho tloha ka la 25 Pudungwana (Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Phediso ya Dikgoka Kgahlanong le Basadi) ho isa ka la 10 Tshitwe (Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Ditokelo tsa Botho).
tgt: IKhabhinethi likhuthaza izisulu ukuthi zibubike lobu bugebengu obunyantisa umzimba emaphoyiseni, okumele aphenye izinsolo ze-GBV futhi athathe izinyathelo ezingokomthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuba nobulungiswa.

src: MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho itahlela ka setotswana mananeong a tsebiso le ho hlahisa temoso metseng ya bona le makaleng a fapaneng ka ho latelana.
tgt: Sekusondele umkhankaso Wezinsuku Eziyi-16 Zokulwa Nodlame Olubhekiswe Kwabesifazane Nezingane futhi iKhabhinethi ligunyaze isiqubulo sakulo nyaka esithi: "Ngibale Nami: Sisonke Siqhubezela Phambili iNingizimu Afrika Engenalo Udlame".

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho bankakarolo kaofela ho tshehetsa maikitlaetso a lekala la bohahlaudi a diphethoho kaha sena se hlahisa bokgoni ba ho tswela molemo moruo ka ho matlafatsa badudi ba hlokang menyetla le ho kganna kgolo ya mesebetsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa zonke izakhamizi ukuthi zifundisane ngamalungelo abantu besifazane nezingane, kanye nangezindlela ezinhlobonhlobo ezikhona zokusiza izisulu zobugebengu.

src: Lefapha la Bohahlaudi le ne le tshwere Seboka sa Naha sa Diphethoho tsa Bohahlaudi ka la 30 le la 31 Mphalane 2017 tlasa mookotaba: “Bohahlaudi bakeng sa Bohle: Fetola, Hola le ho Baballa”, moo ho ileng ha lokollwa Tlaleho ya Boemo ba Diphethoho tsa Lekala le ho thakgolwa ha Lepatlelo la Matlafatso e Pharaletseng ya Batho ba Batsho Moruong (B-BBEE) la Bohahlaudi le Letlole la Diphethoho tsa Bohahlaudi.
tgt: UMkhankaso Wezinsuku eziyi-16 Zokulwa nalesi sihlava ungumkhankaso weNhlangano Yezizwe (i-UN), oqala ngomhla zingama-25 kuLwezi (Usuku Lomhlaba Jikelele Lokuqeda Udlame olubhekiswe Kubantu Besifazane) kuya kungomhla ziyi-10 kuZibandlela (Usuku Lwamalungelo Abantu Emhlabeni Jikelele) minyaka yonke.

src: Aforika Borwa le Senegal di fapanyetsane mehopolo mabapi le dintlha tse hlokolosi tsa lebatowa le tsa lefatshe le ho saena ditumellano dintlheng tse mmalwa.
tgt: Izakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika zikhuthazwa ukuthi zizibandakanye ezinhlelweni zokukhuluma nokuqwashisa ezisemiphakathini nasemikhakheni yazo.
