src: Ho saenwa ha Memorandamo wa Kutlwano (MoU) mabapi le ho nyalanya Sehlekehleke sa Robben (se neng se sebediswa ke mmuso wa kgethollo ho kwalla balwanedi ba tokoloho) le Dihlekehleke tsa Gorée (motjha oo ka ona batho ba Aforika ba neng ba tsamaiswa ka dikepe ho iswa bophelong ba bokgoba) se tswela pele ho matlafatsa maqhama a botjhaba le a nalane ha ho hopolwa Dipuisano tsa Dakar tsa selemo sa Leeto la Kemedi ya Indonesia Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa bonke ababambiqhaza ukuthi beseke izinhlelo zokuguqula umkhakha wezokuvakasha njengoba ungaletha inzuzo emnothweni wezwe ngokufukula imiphakathi eyayincishwe amathuba phambilini futhi zihole ukwanda kwamathuba omsebenzi.

src: Kabinete e amohela leeto la Sultan Husain Abubakar Syah wa Tidore ho la Indonesia ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: UMnyango Wezokuvakasha usingathe iNgqungquthela Yokuguqula Ezokuvakasha Kuzwelonke mhla zingama-30 nama-31 kuMfumfu 2017 ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Ezokuvakasha Zabantu Bonke: Guqula, Khulisa bese Uqhubekise", okwakhiswa kuyo uMbiko Ngesimo Sokuguqula Umkhakha kanye nokwethulwa kweNkundla Yezokuvakasha Ethuthukisa Abantu Abamnyama Kwezomnotho Ovulelekile (i-B-BBEE) kanye Nesikhwama Sokuguqulwa Kwezokuvakasha.

src: Kemedi ya Tidore e ne e kenyeleditse Muhammad Amin Farouk, wa leloko la Tuan Guru, molwanedi wa tokoloho ya ileng a hapjwa ke ma-Dutch le ho romelwa Sehlekehlekeng sa Robben ka selemo sa 1780.
tgt: Ukuvakashelwa uMongameli Macky Sall waseSenegal.

src: Tuan Guru (Imam Abdullah bin Qadi Abdussalam) le bomphato ba hae ba bararo ba ile ba kwallwa bakeng sa dilemo tse 12 mme kamora moo ba behwa palehong ho la Kapa, moo a nyehetseng haholo bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya badudi ba lehae le kahong ya moske wa pele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela Ukuvakashelwa uMongameli weRiphabhulikhi yaseSenegal, uMhlonishwa uMacky Sally ngomhla zingama-20 kuMfumfu 2017.

src: Leeto lena le hlakisitse nalane e tshwanang ya puso ya bokoloniale le ntwa ya dilemo tse balwang ka makgolo a dilemo ya tokoloho ya setjhaba ya batho ba Indonesia le Aforika Borwa.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika neSenegal yaxoxisana ngezimo ezisemqoka zezwekazi kanye nezomhlaba jikelele futhi kwasayinwa izivumelwano ezinhlobonhlobo.

src: Kajeno re keteka maqhama a kgwebisano, bohahlaudi le a mang pakeng tsa dinaha tse pedi tsena.
tgt: La mazwe amabili anobudlelwano obuhle kwezombusazwe, ezomnotho kanye nezenhlalakahle, okusekelwe ubudlelwano obuqinile bakudala obaqala ngeminyaka yomzabalazo wenkululeko.

src: Mananeo a Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo a ho kgaoletsa nako e senyehileng le maikitlaetso a mang a thusitse baithuti ba anngweng ke matsholo a boipelaetso hara selemo mme ho lebeletswe sephetho se setle.
tgt: UTuan Guru (Imam Adbullah bin Qadi Abdussalum) kanye nabanye abathathu ayehamba nabo baboshwa cishe iminyaka eyi-12 okwalandelwa ukugcinwa kwabo ekudingisweni eKapa, lapho aba negalelo elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi wasendaweni ngokwakha i-mosque yokuqala.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa makala a qobello ya molao le tshebedisano ya badudi ba thusitseng ka ho tshwarwa ha Willem Oosthuizen le Theo Jackson.
tgt: Leli thimba livakashele iSigungu Sikazwelonke (i-NA) kanye Nomkhandlu Kazwelonke Wezifundazwe (i-NCOP) lapho amukelwe khona izikhulu ezongamele, iPhini Likamongameli uCyril Ramaphosa kanye noNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Komnotho uNgqongqoshe Ebrahim Patel.

src: Bobedi bona bo qobelletse Victor Mlotshwa ho kena ka lekaseng la bafu le ho mo tshosa ka ho mo tshela ka peterole.
tgt: Lolu hambo ligqamise umlando wala mazwe womabili okubuswa ontamolukhuluni kanye namakhulu-minyaka okulwela inkululeko kwabantu base-Indonesia naseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe ho kwalwa ha ditsela tsa setjhaba, ho pepesa matshwao a kgatello ya mehleng le ho senngwa ha matshwao a naha a bontshang demokerasi ya rona e lwanetsweng ka thata.
tgt: Izinhlelo zokusiza abafundi abasele ezifundweni zoMnyango Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo kanye nezinye izinhlelo zisize abafundi abathikanyezwe imibhikisho kulo nyaka futhi kulindeleke imiphumela emihle.

src: Kabinete e itlametse karolo ya yona ya ho aha setjhaba se momahaneng bakeng sa bohle le ho ipiletsa ho baahi kaofela ho bapala karolo ya bona ka boikarabelo le ka moya wa ho sebetsa mmoho ho aha Aforika Borwa e kopaneng, e hlokang semorabe, e sa kgetholleng ho ya ka bong, ya demokerasi le e tswetseng pele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lincoma amaphoyisa kanye nokubambisana kwemiphakathi esize ukuze kulahlwe ngecala uWillem Oosthuizen noTheo Jackson.

src: Kabinete e tsheheditse dihlomathiso tse sisintsweng tsa Dikhoutu tse tharo tsa Lekala la B-BBEDihlomathiso tsena di tobana le diphephetso tsa lekala lena le mathata a diphethoho tseo ka ho le leng di neng di sa tlo sebetswa ka botlalo ka dikhoutu tse tlwaelehileng.
tgt: Nokho, amalungelo amiswe kuMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika we-1996 akahambi wodwa futhi akufanele alimaze amalungelo abanye abantu angokomthethosisekelo.

src: Makala ana a mararo ke a Temo, Ditjhelete le Kaho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligxeka ukuvinjwa kwemigwaqo yomphakathi, ukuvezwa kwezimpawu zokucindezela zangaphambilini kanye nokulinyazwa kwezimpawu zezwe eziyisibonakaliso sentando yeningi labantu eyajulukelwa.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana mohopolo wa Lewa la Naha la tsa Inthanetele ho phatlalatswa ha ona Koranteng ya Mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze uMbiko Wesimo Sohulumeni Basekhaya baseNingizimu Afrika wezi-2015/16.

src: Mohopolo wa Lewa la Naha la tsa Inthaneteo hlakisa tjhebelopele e arolelanwang le ho sutha tlwaelong ya ho ba setjhaba sa tlhahisoleseding ho ya moruong le setjhabeng sa tsebo.
tgt: Lo mbiko wendlala inqubekela phambili ebonakele ekuqalisweni koHlelo Lokubuyela Emasisweni (i-B2B), okuwuhlelo lokuthatha isinyathelo sokuqinisekisa ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo eziyisisekelo, ukuphatha okuhle kanye nokuphathwa kwezimali ngokufanele.

src: O tobana le diphephetso, ho kenyeletswa le kgethollo ho tsa dijithale pakeng tsa barui le bafutsana, pakeng tsa merabe, dibaka tse fapaneng tsa bodulo le mabakeng a bong.
tgt: Lo mbiko ugqamisa izingxenye ezibhekene nezinselele futhi uhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokuqalisa isigaba sesibili soHlelo i-B2B.

src: O fana ka lepatlelo bakeng sa maAforika Borwa ho kenella ho tsa thekenoloji, e leng se hlokahalang le ho amana mabapi le ho ntlafatsa ntshetsopele le nala moruong molemong wa setjhaba ka kakaretso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi leseke izichibiyelo eziphakanyisiwe ezintathu zeMigomo Yohlaka lwe-B-BBEIzichibiyelo zibhekana nezinselele zomkhakha kanye nokwehlukile kwezoguquko ebezingeke zadingideka ngokugcwele emigomweni ewujikelele.

src: Lefapha la Meralo ya Dikgokahanyo le Ditshebeletso tsa Poso le tla fana ka tlhahisoleseding e batsi mabapi le lewa lena.
tgt: Le mikhakha emithathu ngeyezoLimo, Ezezimali kanye Nezokwakha.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Lewa le Mmapa wa Naha wa Ditshebeletso tsa Mmuso ka Inthanete, hore le phatlalatswe Koranteng ya Mmuso.
tgt: Izichibiyelo eziphakanyisiwe zitholakale ngokubambisana nababambiqhaza abafanele.

src: Le tla tlisa diphethoho tsa dijithale ditshebeletsong tsa setjhaba le ho thusa ka phano ya boleng bo ntlafaditsweng ba ditshebeletso ha ka ho le leng le tla be le kenella ka hara dithekenoloji tsa dijithale.
tgt: Yonke imigomo yomkhakha echitshiyelwe izobhalwa kusomqulu kahulumeni.

src: Lewa lena hara tse ding, le tobile, ho arohanngwa ha maikitlaetso a Ditshebeletso tsa Mmuso ka Inthanete le ho iphetapheta ha metjha, didathabeisi, tsamaiso e ngata e sa tsamaelaneng le ho hloka bokgoni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze Iqhingasu Lezobuchwepheshe Kuzwelonke, i-National e-Strategy, kanye nokushicilelwa kwayo kuSomqulu Kahulumeni.

src: Hape le tla eketsa tshebediso ya thekenoloji ya tlhahisoleseding le dikgokahanyo (di-ICT), le tla matlafatsa ntjhafatso dithekenolojing le ditshebedisong tsa Ditshebeletso tsa Mmuso ka Inthanete.
tgt: I-e-stragegy iveza umbono okuvunyelwene ngawo kanye noguquko lwezinhlelo olusuka emphakathini onolwazi luya kumnotho wolwazi nomphakathi.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Lewa la Ntshetsopele la ICT la Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane, tse Mahareng le tse Kgolo (di-SMME).
tgt: Ibhekana nezinselele, ezibandakanya ukwahlukana kwezobuchwepheshe phakathi kwabadla izambane likapondo kanye nabadla imbuya ngothi, phakathi kwezinhlanga ezahlukene, izindawo zokuhlala ezahlukahlukene kanye nezinkinga eziqondene nobulili.

src: Bona ke boitshunyako bo tobileng makala bakeng sa ho sebetsana le diphephetso tse tjamelaneng le di-SMME tse sebetsang ka hara lekala la ICT.
tgt: Ihlinzeka ngenkundla yokuthi izakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika zikwazi ukuzibandakanya kwezobuchwepheshe, obubalulekile nobuhambisana nezentuthuko kanye nempumelelo yezomnotho ukuze kuzuze umphakathi uwonkana.

src: Lewa lena le lohotha maitshunyako a ho akofisa ntshetsopele le kgolo ya dikgwebo tse nyenyane ka hara lekala la ICT, ha ka nqa e nngwe le thusa ka keketseho maemong a kamohelo le tshebediso ya di-ICT ke lekala le akaretsang la dikgwebo tse nyenyane.
tgt: UMnyango Wezengqalasizinda Yezokuxhumana Nezinsizakalo Zeposi uzochaza kabanzi ngaleli qhingasu.

src: Lewa lena le rerile ho tshehetsa dikgwebo tse ntjha tsa ICT, ho matlafatsa dikgwebo tse ntseng di le teng le ho atolosa tshehetso ho di-SMME tse nang le bokgoni ba kgolo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze Iqhingasu Lezobuchwepheshe Kuzwelonke kanye Nomhlahlandlela, i-National e-Strategy and Roadmap, ezoshicilelwa kwayo kuSomqulu Kahulumeni.

src: Tlaleho ena e fana ka dibaka moo ho nang le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ho hlwahlwa le dibaka tse ding moo ho ntseng ho batleha ntlafatso.
tgt: Lizoletha uguquko kwezobuchwepheshe oluzosetshenziswa umphakathi futhi livula ithuba lokuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi eseqophelweni elingcono kube kusetshenziswa ubuchwepheshe bedijithali.

src: Tlaleho e tla manehwa websaeteng ya Lefapha la Merero, Bodisa le Tekolo ya Tshebetso (WEBTOKEN).
tgt: Iqhingasu liqondiswe, phakathi kokunye, ukulondolozwa kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni kanye nezinqubo eziphindaphindwayo, izizindalwazi, ukungahambisani kohlelo olukhulu kanye nokunganelisi.

src: Kabinete e tshehetsa boiketo ba Aforika Borwa ba ho kgethwa hape ho botho ba dilemo tse pedi ba Lekgotla la Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Merero ya Mawatle (IMO).
tgt: Lizophinde landise ukusetshenziswa kolwazi nokuxhumana ngendlela yobuchwepheshe (i-ICT), kugqanyiswe izinhlelo kanye namasu amasha kwezobuchwepheshe azosetshenziswa uhulumeni osebenza ngobuchwepheshe.

src: Dikgetho tsena di tla tshwarwa nakong ya Tulo e Setlwaeding ya Kopano ya bo-30 ho tloha ka la 27 Pudungwana ho isa ka la 6 Tshitwe 2017 London, United Kingdom.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze Iqhingasu Lokuthuthukisa Amabhizinisi Amancane Nasafufusa (ama-SMME) ngokwe-ICLokhu ukungenelela okuqondene nomkhakha othile ukuze ubhekane nezinselele ama-SMME abhekene nazo emkhakheni we-ICT.

src: Aforika Borwa ke naha ya mawatle moo se ka etsang 80% ya kgwebisano ya matjhaba e etswang ka ho sebedisa mawatle.
tgt: Leli qhingasu lihlongoza izindlela zokungenelela ukuze kusheshiswe ukuthuthukisa nokukhula kwamabhizinisi amancane emkhakheni we-ICT, kube kulawulwa ukukhula kwamazinga okudidiyela nokusebenzisa i-ICT emkhakheni wamabhizinisi amancane jikelele.

src: Botho ba Aforika Borwa ho Lekgotla la IMO bo nyehela ho kgolo ya mesebetsi e bakuwang ke Operation Phakisa: ya Moruo wa Mawatle.
tgt: Leli qhingasu lihlose ukweseka amabhizinisi e-ICT asaqala, ukuqinisa amabhizinisi asekhona kanye nokwandisa amathuba okuthola ama-SMME asebenza ngempumelelo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tsebahatswa Palamenteng ha Sehlomathiso ho Porothokhole ya Montreal mabapi le Dinthwana tse Senyang Moalo wa Ozouno ho kenyeletsa dihaedroflorokhabone (di-HFC).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukushicilelwa koMbiko Wokuhlola Uhlelo Lokuhlinzeka Ngokudla Okunempilo Ezikoleni Kuzwelonke.

src: Sehlomathiso sena se rerile ho fokotsa di-HFC (Tumellano ya Kigali), e leng dikgase tse ding tse kotsi tse nyehelang ho phokotseho ya Moalo wa Ozouno.
tgt: Lolu wuhlelo lukahulumeni olunesabelomali esiyizigidigidi ezingu-5.5 zamarandi okuholele ekutheni abantwana abayizigidi eziyisishiyagalolunye zasemiphakathini empofu zithole ukudla okunempilo esikoleni nsukuzonke.

src: Aforika Borwa e se e ntse e le setho se saenetsweng ho Porothokhole ya Montreal.
tgt: IKhabhinethi leseka isimo seNingizimu Afrika sokukhethwa kabusha ebulungeni beminyaka emibili yoMkhandlu Womhlaba Jikelele Wenhlangano Yezasolwandle (IMO).

src: Kabinete hape e tjhaelletse monwana ho tsebahatswa Palamenteng ha kamohelo ya Khonvenshene ya Minamata mabapi le Sekete.
tgt: Lolu khetho luzobanjwa lapho kuzobe kunoMhlangano Owujikelele wama-30 weNhlangano ngomhla zingama-27 kuLwezi kuya kumhla ziyi-6 kuZibandlela 2017 eLondon, e-United Kingdom.

src: E fana ka menyetla bakeng sa tshireletso ya dihlopha tse kotsing, haholoholo ba dulang dibakeng tseo ho tsona ho nang le mesebetsi ya merafo, kgahlanong le ditlamorao tse kotsi tsa sekete tikolohong le boitekanelong ba batho.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika iyizwe elinolwandle futhi chishe ama-80% ohwebo lwamazwe ngamazwe lwenziwa ngolwandle.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka Tlaleho ya Khomishene ya Dipatlisiso tse mabapi le Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello ka hara Riphabliki ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ubulungu beNingizimu Afrika eMkhandlwini i-IMO bunegalelo ekwandeni kwamathuba omsebenzi okususelwa ohlelweni i-Operation Phakisa: yoMnotho Wasolwandle.

src: Komiti ya Kantoro ya Moporesidente ya Ditjhelete e tla kopana ho hlantholla dikateng tsa yona tsa tshusumetso ya ditjhelete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukwethula ePhalamende kokulungiswa kweSichibiyelo seSivumelwano saseMontreal Ngalokho Okunciphisa Ungwengwezi Osemkhathini (i-ozone layer) ukuze kubandakanywe ama-hydrofluorocarbons (ama-HFC).

src: Lefapha la Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello le tla lokela ho sheba botjha maano a amehang le molao, moo ho hlokahalang.
tgt: Ukuchibiyela kubheke ukuqeda ama-HFC (Isivumelwano saseKigali), angezinye zezisi zemvelo ezikhiqizwa ngokwemvelo ezinesandla ekuncishisweni kukangwengwezi osemkhathini.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Bili ya Naha ya Moputso o Tlase e tla etsa hore ho lefuwe moputso o tlase bakeng sa basebeletsi ba lefuwang ka tlase ka ho fetisisa ka hara Mmaraka wa Basebetsi wa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde lagunyaza ukwethulwa ePhalamende kokulungiswa kweSivumelwano saseMinamata se-Mercury.

src: Bili e ipiletsa hore mosebeletsi e mong le e mong a lefuwe mokgolo o seng ka tlase ho moputso o tlase wa Naha.
tgt: Sihlinzeka ngamathuba okuvikela abantu ababuthaka, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni okuqhutshwa kuzo imisebenzi yokuvukuza, kube kunezimo ezingezinhle ezidalwa i-mercury kwezemvelo nasempilweni yabantu.

src: E sebetsana le, hara tse ding, metjha ya ho piketa, diteraeke tsa nako e telele le dibopeho tsa boeletsi ba bonamodi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze UMthethosivivinyo Wamaholo Okungeholelwe Ngaphansi Kwawo Kuzwelonke enomthelela emholweni okungeholelwe ngaphansi kwawo kubasebenzi abahola imali encane kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa Palamenteng ha tse amanang le Mebuso ya Lehae: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Dibopeho tsa Bomasepala ya 2017.
tgt: UMthethosivivinyo unxusa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi baholelwe iholo elingengaphansi kweholo okungeholelwe imali engaphansi kwalo.

src: Sena se fetola se amanang le Mebuso ya Lehae: Molao wa Dibopeho tsa Bomasepala, 1998 (Molao wa bo-117 wa selemo sa 1998).Bili e rerile ho matlafatsa ditlhophiso tsa ka hara mmuso le taolo ya demokerasi.
tgt: Uma lo Mthethosivivinyo sowusebenza abaqashi kuzolindeleka ukuthi bakhokhele abasebenzi babo umholo ongengaphansi kweholo okungeholelwe ngaphansi kwalo, elizochitshiyelwa minyaka yonke.

src: Hape e rerile ho sebetsana le dintlha tse amanang le tsamaiso le bolaodi ba dikgetho tsa bomasepala, le ho kgothaletsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ho hlwahlwa le ho kgabane ha Molao ona, hammoho le ho matlafatsa bodisa le taolo ka hara bomasepala.
tgt: IKhabhibheni liphinde lagunyaza ukwethulwa ePhalamende koMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela Imigomo Eyisisekelo Yokuqashwa wowezi-2017.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa Palamenteng ha Bili ya Mekgwa ya Elektroniki ya Boingodiso ba Ditokomane tsa Matlo ya 2017.
tgt: Lokhu kuchibiyela uMthetho Wemigomo Yokusebenza Eyisisekelo, we-1997 (uMthetho 75 we-1997) ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kufakwa isiqeshana esikhuluma ngoMthethosivivinyo Wamaholo Okungeholelwe Ngaphansi Kwawo.

src: Bili e se e isitswe setjhabeng bakeng sa ditherisano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukwethulwa ePhalamende koMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela Ezobudlelwano Nabasebenzi wowezi-2017.

src: E sebetsa bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya mokgwa wa elektroniki wa boingodiso ba ditokomane tsa matlo (e-DRS), bakeng sa ho tswellisa ditokomane tsa matlo, ho ntlafatsa boingodiso ba methamo e meholo ya ditokomane tsa matlo jwaloka ha e bakwa ke maikitlaetso a Mmuso a tlhabollo ya mobu.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinyo uwumphumela wokubonisana nabo bonke ababambiqhaza abafanele.

src: Jwaloka karolo ya ho kgothaletsa tshebediso ya di-ICT ho aha moruo o kenyeletsang, Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Bili ya Setheo sa Naha sa iKamva ya Maitsebelo ho tsa Inthanete ya 2017 (Bili ya iNeSI) hore e kenngwe koranteng ya mmuso bakeng sa ditherisano le tshwaelo.
tgt: Udingida, phakathi kokunye, izinqubo zokubhikisha, iziteleka ezidonsa isikhathi esingaphezu kwaleso ebesilindelekile kanye nezinhlaka ezelulekayo uma kunemidonsiswano.

src: Bili ya iNeSI e fana ka hore ho thehwe iNeSI e le setheo sa setjhaba ka molao wa sona o se dumellang, bakeng sa ho tobana le kgaello ya Maitsebelo ho tsa Inthanete e sitisang matsete, ntshetsopele ya moruo wa kahisano le bokgoni ba ntshetsopele ka hara naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukwethulwa ePhalamende koMthethosisivinywa Wokuchibiyela Uhulumeni Wendawo: Izinhlaka Zomasipala wowezi-2017.

src: Sena se theha dibaka tsa tlhahiso ya ICT porofenseng ka nngwe, ebe e ba se tla thusa iNeSI ho hlahisa le ho rala mananeo a batlehang le thepa ya thupello, ho kgothaletsa le ho etsa diphuputso tsa ntlafatso, le ho fana ka bokgoni ba diphuputso ho baithuti ba etsang dithuto tsa kamora dikgerata.
tgt: Lokhu kuchibiyela uMthetho Kahulumeni Wendawo: Wezinhlaka Zikahulumeni, we-1998 (uMthetho 117 we-1998).UMthetho uhlose ukuqinisa izinhlelo zohulumeni abahlukene kanye nokubusa ngokwentando yeningi labantu.

src: Sena se nyehela bakeng sa tekatekano le seriti sa botho ka phumantsho ya tlhahisoleseding le ditshebeletso tsa poso tse kgonehang, tse thusang ka ntshetsopele ya kahisano le ntlafatso ya boleng ba bophelo bakeng sa batho ka bo mong le badudi.
tgt: Uhlose nokudingida izinkinga eziqondene nokulawula nokuphatha ukhetho lomasipala, kanye nokukhuthaza ukusebenza ngempumelelo nokuqalisa ngokushesha uMthetho, kanjalo nokuqinisa ukuqapha nobuholi komasipala.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlangKabinete hape e ananetse tse ding tsa diketsahalo tse tlang khalendareng ya mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukwethulwa ePhalamende koMthethosivivinywa Wohlelo Lokubhaliswa Kwamatayitela Nge-Intanethi wowezi-2017.

src: Lenaneo la Boporesidente la Bodisa la Siyahlola.
tgt: UMthethosivivinyo sewudlule kuhlelo lokubonisana nomphakathi.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o rerile ho etela Sepetlele sa Dithuto sa Steve Biko Tshwane ka Labohlano, 3 Pudungwana 2017 ho beha leihlo ditshebeletso tsa phano ya tlhokomelo ya kalafo e le karolo ya Lenaneo la Boporesidente la Siyahlola.
tgt: Uvumela ukuthuthukiswa kohlelo lokubhaliswa kwamatayitela nge-intanethi (i-e-DRS), ukuze kuqhutshwe amatayitela, kubhaliseke amatayitela amaningi njengoba kubizelwe izinhlelo zokubuyisela umhlaba zikaHulumeni.

src: Sepetlele sena ke se seng sa dipetlele tsa setjhaba se sebetsang hantle ka ho fetisisa ka hara naha le ho rehellwa ka Steve Bantu Biko, e leng mofu eo e neng e le mohale wa ntwa ya tokoloho le moithuti wa mehleng wa dithuto tsa bongaka wa Yunivesithi ya Natal (eo hajwale e bitswang Yunivesithi ya KwaZulu-Natal).Leeto la Moporesidente Zuma ke karolo ya lenaneo le tswellang la ho beha leihlo le reretsweng ho sebetsana le diphephetso tse tobaneng le dipetlele tsa mmuso le ho ntlafatsa tsamaiso ya tlhokomelo ya kalafo ka hara naha, e leng e nngwe ya dintlha tse ka sehlohlolong tsa mmuso.
tgt: Njengengxenye yokukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwe-ICT ukwakha umnotho obandakanyayo, iKhabhinethi ligunyaze uMthethosivivinywa Wesikhungo Samakhono Ezobuchwepheshe Kuzwelonke wowezi-2017, i-iKamva National e-Skills Institute, (uMthethosivivinywa i-iNeSI) ezofakwa kusomqulu kahulumeni ukuze kubonisanwe nomphakathi futhi kutholakale izimvo zawo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho tshehetsa Kgwedi ya Naha ya Temoso ya Ditokelo tsa Batho ba nang le Boqhwala pakeng tsa 3 Pudungwana le 3 Tshitwe 2017, eo hape e tsamaelanang le Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Batho ba nang le Boqhwala.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa i-iNeSI uhlinzekela ukusungulwa kwe-iNeSI njengesikhungo sikahulumeni esinothetho waso osilawulayo, ukubhekana nokusilela kwamakhono ezobuchwepheshe avimba utshalomali, ukuthuthukiswa kwezenhlalomnotho kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi ezweni.

src: MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho phahamisa temoso le ho sireletsa ditokelo tsa batho ba phelang ka boqhwala, ha ka ho le leng ho ananelwa dikuno tse entsweng bakeng sa ho sebetsana le diphephetso tse tobaneng le batho ba phelang ka boqhwala.
tgt: Lokhu kuzodala ukusungulwa kwezikhungo zokukhiqizwa kwe-ICT esifundazweni ngasinye, okuzobe sekusiza i-iNeSI ukuze ithuthuke futhi yakhe izinhlelo ezifanele kanye nezinsiza zokuqeqesha, kukhuthazwe futhi kuqhutshwe ucwaningo olusha, futhi kuvulelwe abafundi asebagogoda abaqhuba izifundo zabo ukuze bakwazi ukwenza ucwaningo.

src: Pitso ya Naha ya Ntshetsopele ya Moruo wa Lehae.
tgt: IKhabinethi ligunyaze ukushicilelwa koMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela Izinsizakalo Zeposi kuSomqulu kaHulumeni ukuze kuqoqwe izimvo zomphakathi.

src: Lefapha la Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Botjhaba le Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane a tla epa Pitso ya pele ya Naha ya Ntshetsopele ya Moruo wa Lehae ka la 9 le 10 Pudungwana 2017 Gauteng.
tgt: Lokhu kuchibiyela uMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela Izinsizakalo Zeposi No.

src: Pitso ena ke lepatlelo la lewa bakeng sa dipuisano pakeng tsa lekala la mmuso le la poraefete mabapi le dintlha tse ka sehlohoong le tse hlokolosi tse amanang le ho hlasimolla meruo ya lehae ka ho bopa tikoloho e kgontshang ho fihlella ntshetsopele ya moruo o kenyeletsang.
tgt: 124 we-1998.Lo mthethosivivinywa uhlinzekela ukuhlelwa kabusha komkhakha wezeposi ukuze ube negalelo ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi imisebenzi emisha yobuchwepheshe itholakala kumuntu wonke kube kuqhutshekwa nokuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi emidala yeposi eseqophelweni eliphezulu nephephile.

src: Kabinete e amohela tsebiso ya didolara tsa Amerika tse fetang bilione tse tla tsetelwa bakeng sa dikgwedi tse mmalwa moruong wa Aforika Borwa ho tsa thekenoloji, thuto le kgwebo ya tsa temo.
tgt: Lokhu kunegalelo eqophelweni lesithunzi sabantu ngokutholakala kolwazi kanye nezinsazakalo zeposi ezingambi eqolo, ezilawula ukuthuthukiswa kwezenhlalakahle futhi ezithuthukisa iqophelo lempilo yomuntu ngamunye kanye nemiphakathi.

src: Sena se ile sa tsebiswa ke Lenqosa Harold Doley, Jr, e leng Mmusisi wa Banka ya Ntshetsopele ya Aforika.
tgt: Imicimbi EzayoIKhabhinethi liphinde lazisa ukuthi eminye yemicimbi ezayo ohlwini lwezinto eziza kwenziwa uhulumeni.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Ngaka Nono Simelela ka ho thonngwa e le Mothusi wa Motsamaisi-Kakaretso wa Mokgatlo wa Bophelo bo Botle wa Lefatshe (WHO).
tgt: Uhlelo lokuqapha lukaMongameli, i-Presidential Siyahlola Monitoring Programme.

src: Ngaka Simelela o tla etella pele Lekala la WHO le Sebetsang ka tsa Malapa, Basadi, Bana le Batjha ho tloha ka la 13 Pudungwana 2017.
tgt: Kuhlelwe ukuthi uMongameli Zuma avakashele Isibhedlela iSteve Biko Academic eTshwane ngoLwesihlanu, ngomhla zi-3 kuLwezi 2017 ukuqapha ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo zezempilo njengengxenye yohlelo lokuqapha lukaMongameli, i-Presidential Siyahlola Monitoring Programme.

src: Ke mosadi wa pele wa moAforika wa ho ba Ngaka ya Mopepisi ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lesi sibhedlela singesinye sezibhedlela zikahulumeni eziphuma phambili ezweni futhi saqanjwa ngegama likaSteve Bantu Biko, iqhawe lomzabalazo eseladlula futhi elalingumfundi wezobudokotela eNyuvesi yaseNatali (eseyibizwa ngokuthi iNyuvesi YaKwaZulu-Natali).Uhambo lukaMongameli Zuma luyingxenye yohlelo lokuqapha lukahulumeni oluhlose ukudingida izingqinamba ezikhungethe izibhedlela zikahulumeni kanye nokuthuthukisa uhlelo lokunakekela ngezempilo, okungokunye kwezinhlelo eziseqhulwini kuhulumeni.

src: Kabinete e amohela tsebiso ya Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Rakbi ya ho kgothaletsa hore Aforika Borwa ke naha ya thatohatsi ya ho tshwara tlhodisano ya Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Rakbi wa selemo sa 2023.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa zonke izakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi zeseke Inyanga Kazwelonke Yokuqwashisa Ngamalungelo Abantu Abaphila Nokukhubazeka phakathi kwangomhla zi-3 kuLwezi kuya kungomhla zi-3 kuZibandlela 2017, oluhambisana noSuku Lomhlaba Jikelele Lwabantu Abaphila Nokukhubazeka.

src: Kabinete hape e thoholetsa mosebetsi wa Letona la Dipapadi le Boithapollo, Monghadi Thulas Nxesi, Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Ramaphosa le moifo wa boiketo wa Kopano ya Rakbi ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Izakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika zikhuthazwa ukuthi ziqwashise futhi zivikele amalungelo abantu abaphila nokukhubazeka, kube kwaziswa impumelelo esesibe nayo ekudingideni izinselele abantu abaphila nokukhubazeka ababhekana nazo.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa bankakarolo bohle le bahlodi ba Dikgau tsa bo-15 tsa Selemo ka Seng tsa Ntlafatso ya Lekala la Mmuso.
tgt: UMnyango Wokwengamela Ngokubambisana kanye Nezendabuko kanyenoMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwamabhizinisi Amancane uzohola iNgqungquthela Kazwelonke Yokuthuthukisa Umnotho Wendawo yokuqala ngomhla we-9 nowe-10 kuLwezi 2017 eGauteng.

src: Dikgau tsena di ananela maikitlaetso a phano ya ditshebeletso a atlehileng le ho ba hlwahlwa ka ho sebedisa dikatamelo tse ntjhafatsang, mekgwa le disebediswa.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela iyinkundla ebalulekile yokuxoxisana phakathi kukahulumeni kanye nomkhakha ozimele ngezindaba eziyizinhlolo ezimisiwe kanye nalezo ezisemqoka ukuze kufukulwe iminotho yezindawo ngokwakha indawo evumayo yokufinyelela entuthukweni yezomnotho ebandakanyayo.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa SuperSport United FC bakeng sa ho fihla ho makgaolakgang a Mohope wa CAF Confederation kamora ho hlola sehlopha sa Tunisia sa Club Africa 3-1 le 4-2 ka palohare.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela isimemezelo semali engaphezu kwesigidigidi esisodwa sama-US dollar esizotshalwa eMnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika ezinyangeni ezizayo oqondiswe kwezobuchwepheshe, ezemfundo kanye nezamabhizinisi ezolimo.

src: Sehlopha ka kakaretso se tsejwang ka hore ke Matsatsantsa se tla kopana le TP Mazembe mokgahlelong wa bobedi wa dihlopha tsa kontinente wa makgaolakgang a tlhodisano ena kgweding e tlang.
tgt: Lokhu kumenyezelwe Inxusa uHarold Doley, Jr, uMphathi Webhange Lentuthuko lase-Afrika.

src: E bile moletsaphala wa pele wa moAforika Borwa tlhodisanong ya Mohope wa Lefatshe wa FIFA, ha e ne e le mohlanka ya sebetsang dipapading tsa lefatshe tsa selemo sa 1998 ho la Fora.
tgt: Nono Simelela ngokuqokwa kwakhe njengoMsizi kaMqondisi-Jikelele weNhlangano Yezempilo Yomhlaba (i-WHO).

src: Ditho tsa dinako tsohle tsa Lekgotla la Naha la Dinyewe tsa Basebedisi:a. Mofumahadi Hazel Viloshni Devraj leb.
tgt: Ungowesifazane wokuqala womdabu owudokotela wezifo zabantu besifazane, i-gynaecologist, eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Moatefokate John Rinton Simpson.
tgt: Thulas Nxesi, iPhini likaMongameli uRamaphosa kanye nethimba laseNingizimu Afrika Lomdlalo Webhola Lombhoxo ebelishabashekela ukuthi lo mncintiswano uze kuleli.

src: Moporofesara Shireen Hassimg.
tgt: Lerato Herriette Mothae kanyeb.

src: Kabinete e Kopane ka Laboraro, la 15 Pudungwana 2017 Tuynhuys, Motse Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi labamba umhlangano walo ngoLwesithathu mhla ziyi-15 kuLwezi 2017 e-Tuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Dintlha tsa Hajwale.
tgt: Izindaba Ezisematheni.

src: Matsete.
tgt: Utshalomali.

src: Kabinete e amohela matsete a Khamphani ya Makoloi ya Ford a R3 bilione ka hara Polante ya Silverton, Pretoria, Gauteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyaluthokozela utshalomali olungumabhiliyoni amarandi amathathu olufakwe yiNkampani Yezimoto yakwa-Ford esiKhungweni esakha izimoto sase-Silverton, ePitoli esifundazweni saseGauteng.

src: Matsete ana a tla baka hore ho boptjwe mesebetsi e otlolohileng le e meng ya tlatsetso ka lebaka la keketseho e lebeletsweng ya tlhahiso ya motlolo wa yona wa Ford Ranger.
tgt: Lolu tshalomali luzoholela ekutheni kudaleke amathuba omsebenzi kulesi Sikhungo nakwamanye amabhizisi esisebenzisana nawo njengoba kulindeleke ukuba ukhule umkhiqizo wohlobo lwemoto yale nkampani olubizwa nge-Ford Ranger.

src: Matsete ana a tiisetsa mosebetsi oo re tswelang pele ho o etsa jwaloka mmuso mabapi le ho hodisa moruo le ho sebetsana le diphephetso tsa tlhokeho ya mosebetsi.
tgt: Utshalomali olunjengalolu luwubufakazi bomsebenzi esilokhu siqhubekile nokuwenza njengohulumeni ngenhloso yokukhulisa umnotho kanye nokubhekana ngqo nezinselele zokuntuleka kwamathuba omsebenzi.

src: Ka sekema sa mmuso sa ditsiane tsa R.8 bilione ka hara Tlhahiso ya Makoloi le Lenaneo la Ntshetsopele, ho buletswe matsete a poraefete a R.5 bilione.
tgt: Ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lukahulumeni oludle amabhiliyoni ayi-7.3 wamarandi lwemihlomulo yokukhuthaza utshalomali olubizwa ngoHlelo Lokukhiqizwa Kwezimoto Nokuthuthukiswa Komkhakha Wezimoto sekufake utshalomali olungamabhiliyoni angama-28.5 wamarandi oluvela kubatshalizimali abazimele.

src: Tsena di kenyeletsa tsebiso ya Toyota ya ho etsa dimotlolo tsa yona tse ntjha tsa Toyota Hilux le Fortuner e le karolo ya matsete a etsang R.1 bilione.
tgt: Lokhu kubandakanya nesimemezelo esenziwe yinkampani yakwa-Toyota sokwakhiwa kohlobo olusha lwe-Toyota Hilux ne-Fortuner njengengxenye yotshalomali olungamabhiliyoni ayi-6.1 wamarandi.

src: Hape, BMW e rera ho aha lebenkele la maemo a hodimo a etsang R6 billone a ditopo tsa makoloi.
tgt: Inkampani yakwa-BMW nayo ihlela ukwakha isikhungo sikanokusho sezingxenye zokwakha imizimba yezimoto esizodla imali engamarandi angamabhiliyoni ayisithupha.

src: Koporasi ya Matjhaba ya Makoloi ya Beijing e rera ho tsetela R11 bilione polanteng ya tlhahiso ya makoloi ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Inkampani yezomoto i-Beijing Automobile International Corporation ihlela ukutshala imali engamabhiliyoni ayi-11 wamarandi esikhungweni esakha izimoto eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Sehla sa Lekgetho sa 2017.
tgt: Isikhathi sokuthunyelwa kwamafomu entela sowezi-2017.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa diteboho ho balefi bohle ba lekgetho ba seng ba kentse ditokomane tsa bona tsa lekgetho bakeng sa selemo sa lekgetho sa 2016/17.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyabonga kakhulu kubo bonke abakhokhi bentela asebewathumelile amafomu abo entela onyaka wentela wezi-2016/17.

src: Kuno e fehlilweng ke lekgetho la lekeno e netefatsa hore mmuso o na le bokgoni ba ho fana ka ditshebeletso tse batlehang haholo le tshehetso ya kahisano ho dimilione tse hlokang menyetla tsa maAforika Borwa.
tgt: Imali eyingenisonzuzo etholakele ekukhokhweni kwentela iyaqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni uba namandla okuhlinzeka ngezidingo nezinsizakalo zomphakathi kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abantulayo abayizigidi ngezigidi.

src: Kabinete e hopotsa balefi ba lekgetho hore letsatsi la ho qetela la ho kenya ditokomane tsa lekgetho ke Labohlano la 24 Pudungwana 2017 le ho ba kgothaletsa ho kenya ditokomane tsa bona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyabakhumbuza abakhokhi bentela ukuthi usuku olungumnqamulajuqu wokuthunyelwa kwamafomu entela nguLwesihlanu mhla zingama-24 kuLwezi 2017 futhi liyabakhuthaza ukuba bathumele amafomu abo entela.

src: Pitso ya Naha ya ho Thakgolwa ha Ntshetsopele ya Moruo wa Lehae (LED).
tgt: INgqungquthela Yokuqala Kazwelonke Yezokuthuthukiswa Kweminotho Yohulumeni Bezindawo (i-LED).

src: Kabinete e thabile mabapi le diphetho tsa Pitso ya Naha ya LED e neng e tshwerwe haufinyana tjena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyayithokozela kakhulu imiphumela yeNgqungquthela ye-LED ebanjwe esikhathini esifushane esedlule.

src: E ne e tshwerwe tlasa boetapele ba Letona la Puso e Kopanetsweng le Merero ya Botjhaba, Monghadi Des van Rooyen le Letona la Ntshetsopele ya Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane, Mofumahadi Lindiwe Zulu.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela yabanjwa ngaphansi kobuholi bukaNgqongqoshe Wokwengamela Ngokubambisana Nezindaba Zendabuko, uMnu Des van Rooyen kanye noNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwamabhizinisi Amancane, uNkz Lindiwe Zulu.

src: E hlahisitse monyetla wa ho rala lenaneo le letjha la LED ya Aforika Borwa le tataiswang ke dintlha tse ka sehlohlolong tsa Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP).
tgt: Yahlinzeka ngethuba lokwakhiwa kwe-ajenda entsha yezokuThuthukiswa Kweminotho Yohulumeni Bezindawo eNingizimu Afrika ngokuholwa yizinto ezibekwe eqhulwini oHlelweni Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP).

src: Diphetho tsa yona di kenyeleditse ho thakgolwa ha Lekgotla la Ntshetsopele ya Moruo la Aforika Borwa (EDCSA) la pele, le rerileng ho etsa hore lekala la ntshetsopele ya moruo e be la seporofeshenale.
tgt: Imiphumela yale ngqungquthela ibandakanya nokwethulwa koMkhandlu wokuqala waseNingizimu Afrika Wezokuthuthukiswa Komnotho (i-EDCSA), okuhloswe ngawo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umkhakha wezomnotho usebenza ngobungoti nangobunyoninco.

src: Jwaloka setheo sa seporofeshenale, EDCSA e tla tsamaisa le ho beha leihlo boitshwaro ba seporofeshenale ba bankakarolo ba bangata ba teng maikitlaetsong a fapaneng a ntshetsopele.
tgt: Njengomgwamanda wochwepheshe, i-EDCSA izolawula futhi iqaphe ukuziphatha kwabasebenzi abaningi balo mkhakha ababambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni zentuthuko ezihlukahlukene.

src: Kabinete hape e ananetse ho thakgolwa ho etsang nalane ha Beke ya Lefatshe ya Boetapele ba Dikgwebo (GEW) nomorong ya 22 ho la Sloane, e leng khempase e ntjha ya qalo, ka la 10 Pudungwana 2017, moo Letona Zulu a neng a amohetse kwakwariri ya lefatshe ya baetapele ba dikgwebo, Monghadi Richard Branson.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likuphawulile futhi nokwethulwa okuyingqophamlando kweViki Lomhlaba Jikelele Lezokusungulwa Nokuqhutshwa Komsebenzi Webhizinisi (i-GEW) elethulwe e-22 on Sloane, okuwuphiko lokuphenjwa nokusungulwa kwamabhizinisi, lapho uNgqongqoshe uZulu wabe esingethe khona ingqalabutho yezamabizinisi emhlabeni jikelele u-Sir Richard Branson.

src: Khempase ena ke ya pele ya ho bulwa ke Marangrang a Boetapele ba Dikgwebo ba Lefatshe.
tgt: Lolu phiko lungolokuqala ngqa oluvulwe yiNhlangano Yezokusungulwa Nokuqhutshwa Komsebenzi Webhizinisi Emhlabeni Jikelele (i-Global Entrepreneurship Network).

src: E fana ka ditshebeletso tsa tshehetso ka kotloloho le ka inthanete ho phatlalla le Aforika hammoho le phumantsho ya matjhaba ya marangrang a batataisi, batsetedi le mekgatlo ya tshehetso ya baetapele ba dikgwebo.
tgt: Ihlinzeka ngqo ngezinsizakalo zokweseka osomabhizinisi futhi lubahlinzeke nangezinsizakalo ezitholakala nge-inthanethi kwi-Afrika yonkana futhi kusenjalo ihlinzeka nangethuba lokuxhumana nokusebenzisana nabaqeqeshi bezebhizinisi emhlabeni jikelele, kanye nabatshalizimali nezinhlangano ezeseka umsebenzi wokusungulwa nokuqhutshwa kwamabhizinisi.

src: Nakong ya GEW, batho ba ka etsang 10 milione ba nka karolo diketsahalong tse 35 000, mesebetsing le ditlhodisanong dinaheng tse fetang 165 ho phatlalla le lefatshe.
tgt: Ngenkathi kubanjwe i-GEW, bayizigidi eziyi-10 ababambiqhaza abazibandakanya emicimbini, ezinhlelweni kanye nasemincintiswaneni eyizi-35 000 emazweni angaphezu kwe-165 emhlabeni jikelele.

src: Tlaleho ya Khomishene ya Heher.
tgt: Umbiko Wekhomishana ka-Heher.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho lokollwa ka Mantaha, 13 Pudungwana 2017 ha Tlaleho ya Khomishene ya Dipatlisiso mabapi le Kgonahalo ya ho etsa hore Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello e be mahala ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likuphawulile ukukhishwa, ngoMsumbuluko mhla ziyi-13 kuLwezi 2017, koMbiko Wekhomishana Yophenyo Mayelana Nokuthi Kungalunga Yini Ukuhlinzekwa Mahhala Kwemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqeshwa eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho hlahloba tlaleho ena le ditlamorao tsa yona bakeng sa naha ha dikgothaletso tsa teng di ntse di sekwasekwa ke mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyabanxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba bawufakele izibuko lo mbiko kanye nemithelela yawo ezweni, ngenkathi uhulumeni esacubungula izincomo zawo.

src: Moporesidente o tla etsa tsebiso ka tlaleho ena ha nako e ntse e tsamaya kamora ho sekwasekwa ke Komiti e Kopanetsweng ya Matona ya Matlole a Ditjhelete tsa Thuto e Phahameng le Komiti ya Ditjhelete ya Boporesidente.
tgt: UMongameli uzokwenza isimemezelo mayelana nalo mbiko ngokuhamba kwesikhathi emva kokuba sewucutshungulwe ngokuphelele yiKomidi LoNgqongqoshe Beminyango Ehlukahlukene kanye neKomidi LikaMongameli Lezezimali.

src: Mmuso o dula o ikemiseditse ho rarolla ditshita tsa phumantsho ya thuto e phahameng, mme e shebetse pele ho phethela tharollo ya moshwelella bakeng sa thuso ya ditjhelete tsa thuto e phahameng.
tgt: Uhulumeni usalokhu ezimisele ukususa izithiyo nemigoqo evimbela ukufinyeleleka kwemfundo ephakeme, futhi uphokophele ekutholeni isixazululo esisimeme sokuxhaswa kwemfundo ephakeme ngezimali.

src: Komello.
tgt: Isomiso.

src: Maemo a hajwale a matamo ka hara naha e dula e le matshwenyeho kaha ho na le moyafalo e ngata ho feta pula.
tgt: Umthamo wamanzi akhona njengamanje emadanyini akuleli usalokhu uyinto ekhathazayo impela njengoba umhwamuko owenzekayo emadanyini ungaphezulu kwemvula esiyitholayo ezweni.

src: Taba ya hore Aforika Borwa ha e so fumane pula e lekaneng ho tsosolosa mehlodi ya rona ya metsi ho fihlella maemong a nepahetseng ho bolela hore naha hae e so tswe ka hara boemo ba komello.
tgt: Njengoba iNingizimu Afrika ingakayitholi imvula eyanele ezokhuphula umthamo wamanzi emadanyini ethu ukuze ufinyelele emazingeni agculisayo lokho kusho ukuthi izwe lethu alikaphumi neze esimweni esibi sokukhahlanyezwa yisomiso.

src: Bolepi bo bonela pele hore naha e tla fumana feela pula e ngata ho tloha maqalong a Pherekgong 2018.
tgt: Izangoma zezulu zibikezela ukuthi leli lizwe liyoze liqale ngasekuqaleni kukaMasingana wezi-2018 ukuthola ingxenye enkulu yemvula okumele liyithole.

src: Kabinete e lakatsa ho netefaletsa setjhaba hore mmuso wa naha, mebuso ya diporofense le ya lehae e a thusana le ho sebetsa mmoho ho netefatsa hore Aforika Borwa ha e fellwe ke metsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lithanda ukuqinisekisa umphakathi ukuthi uhulumeni kazwelonke, kanye nohulumeni bezifundazwe nabezindawo basebenza ngokubambisana ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ayiphelelwa ngamanzi.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa mang le mang ho bapala karolo ya hae mabapi le ho baballa le ho sebedisa metsi ka bohlale le ka hloko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa umuntu wonke ukuba adlale indima yakhe ngokuthi awonge amanzi, awasebenzise ngobuhlakani futhi angawasaphazi.

src: Zimbabwe.
tgt: Eziphathelene nelizwe laseZimbabwe.

src: Kabinete e tshehetsa boitshunyako ba Moporesidente Jacob Zuma, boemong ba hae jwaloka Modulasetulo wa Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tse ka Borwa ba Aforika (SADC) ho arabela maemong a Zimbabwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyayeseka imizamo kaMongameli Jacob Zuma, esebenzisa isikhundla sakhe njengoSihlalo WeNhlangano Yokuthuthukiswa Kwamazwe aseNingizimu ne-Afrika (i-SADC) yokuxazulula impicabadala yesimo esimanzonzo esiqhubekayo njengamanje kwelaseZimbabwe.

src: O rometse Baemedi ba Ikgethang, Letona la Tshireletso le Mekaubere ya Ntwa, Mofumahadi Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula le Letona la Tshireletso ya Puso, Moatefokate Bongani Bongo.
tgt: UMongameli usethumele iziThunywa Ezikhethekile kwelaseZimbabwe, okunguNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela Nomakadebona Bezempi, uNkz Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula kanye noNgqongqoshe Wezobunhloli u-Adv Bongani Bongo.

src: Ba tla kopana le Moporesidente Robert Mugabe le Sesole sa Tshireletso sa Zimbabwe.
tgt: Lezi zithunywa kulindeleke ukuba zibambe umhlangano noMongameli Robert Mugabe kanye noMbutho Wezokuvikela waseZimbabwe.

src: Kamora moo, ba tla tsebisa Moporesidente wa Angola João Lourenço boemong ba hae jwaloka Modulasetulo wa Lekala la Dipolotiki, Tshireletso le Polokeho la SADKantoro ya Moporesidente e tla fana ka tse ntseng di etsahala mabapi le taba ena.
tgt: Emva kwalokho zizokwethula umbiko wazo phambi kuMongameli wase-Angola u-João Lourenço onguSihlalo Wophiko lwe-SADC Olwengamele Ezopolitiki, Ezokukuvikela, kanye Nezokuvikeleka.

src: Sekwere Kilomithara sa Array (SKA).
tgt: Isibonakude i-Square Kilometre Array (i-SKA).

src: Kabinete e amohela diphihlello tsa ntshetsopele ya moruo le kahisano lebatoweng la SKA ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyazithokozela izimpumelelo kanye nemihlomulo yezomnotho neyezenhlalo yomphakathi okuzuzwe kutshalomali olugxile ekuthuthukisweni komphakathi esifundeni esakhelene nendawo okwakhiwe kuyona isibonakude se-SKA eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Badudi ba dulang haufi le sebaka sa SKA ba tswela pele ho kgola molemo ka diporojeke tsa thuto le thupello e betere, matsete dikgwebong tse nyenyane le menyetla ya mesebetsi e eketsehileng.
tgt: Imiphakathi eyakhelene nendawo okwakhiwe kuyona i-SKA iyaqhubeka nokuhlomula ngokuthola imfundo engcono nemiklamo yokuqeqeshwa, ukutshalwa kwezimali emabhinisini amancane kanye nokukhula kwezinga lokuvulwa kwamathuba omsebenzi.

src: Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji, tlasa boetapele ba Letona la Saense le Thekenoloji, Mofumahadi Naledi Pandor, o tla tshwara lenaneo la bonkakarolo ba setjhaba ho keteka diphihlello le badudi ba dibaka tse bapileng le Carnarvon, ho la Kapa Leboya ho tloha ka la 16 ho isa ka la 19 Pudungwana 2017.Diqeto tsa Kabinete.
tgt: UMnyango Wezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe, ngaphansi kobuholi bukaNkz Naledi Pandor, uzosingatha uhlelo lokubamba iqhaza nokubandakanywa komphakathi ngenhloso yokugubha nokubungaza izimpumelelo zohlelo lwe-SKA nemiphakathi yase-Carnarvon namaphethelo, esifundazweni saseNyakatho Kapa kusukela mhla ziyi-16 kuze kube ngumhla ziyi-19 kuLwezi 2017.Izinqumo Zekhabhinethi.

src: Ditlaleho tsa Bobedi tsa Kgatelopele ya tshebetso ya kotara ka nngwe bakeng sa 2017/1.
tgt: Imibiko yokusebenza yenqubekelaphambili eyenziwe yiminyango kahulumeni ngekota yesibili yowezi-2017/1.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka Ditlaleho tsa Bobedi tsa Kgatelopele ya kotara ka nngwe bakeng sa 2017/18 (Phupu ho isa ka Loetse 2017) ke dikarolo kaofela tse hlano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlinzekwe ngolwazi mayelana nemibiko yokusebenza yenqubekelaphambili eyenziwe yiminyango kahulumeni ngekota yesibili yowezi-2017/18 (uNtulikazi kuya kuMandulo 2017) eyethulwe ngamaqoqwana eminyango kahulumeni womahlanu.

src: Sena se bopa karolo ya lenaneo le pharaletseng la Kabinete la bodisa le tekolo ya Lenaneo la Tshebetso le itshetlehileng hodima Moralo wa Lewa la Nako e Bohareng (MTSF) la selemo sa 2014 ho isa ho sa 2019.
tgt: Lokhu kuyingxenye yomsebenzi weKhabhinethi obanzi wokuqapha nokuhlola uHlelo Lokusebenza olususelwe oHlakeni Lokusebenza Lwesikhathi Esimaphakathi (i-MTSF) lowezi-2014 kuya kowezi-2019.

src: Lefapha la Merero, Bodisa le Tekolo ya Tshebetso le dikomiti tsa Karolo ya Matona di tla bitsa dikopano tsa boraditaba ho pahlolla kgatelopele ya ditlaleho tsena.
tgt: UMnyango Wezokuhlela, Ukuqapha kanye Nokuhlola kanye namakomidi amaQoqwana Ongqongqoshe bazobamba izithangami zabezindaba lapho bezohlinzeka khona ngolwazi oluphathelene nenqubekelaphambili eseyenziwe okukhulunywa ngayo kule mibiko.

src: GCIS e tla hokahanya dikopano tsa boraditaba le ho phatlalatsa lenaneo la tsona ho WEBTOKEN ha nako e ntse e tsamaya.
tgt: Uphiko Lukahulumeni Lwezokuxhumana Nokuhlinzeka Ngolwazi (i-GCIS) luzolawula futhi luhole lezi zithangami zabezindaba futhi uhlelo lokubanjwa kwalezi zithangami luzoshicilelwa WEBTOKEN ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.

src: Ho behwa sehlohlolong mabapi le maikitlaetso a ho kgwahlapisa diaterese le phano ya diaterese.
tgt: Ulwazi lwakamuva mayelana nenqubekelaphambili eseyenziwe ekuthungathweni nasekuhlonzweni kwamakheli abavoti.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka tlaleho ya kgatelopele mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Kahlolo ya Lekgotla la Molaotheo ya ho fana ka diaterese lenaneong la bakgethi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lethulelwe umbiko mayelana nenqubekelaphambili eseyenziwe ekufezekisweni komyalelo wesiNqumo Senkantolo Yomthethosisekelo wokuhlinzekwa kwamakheli aqondile emqulwini woluhlu lwabavoti.

src: Kabinete e ananetse boimatahanyo ka botlalo le ditlaleho tsa kgatelopele ya dikgwedi kang tse tsheletseng tse iswang Lekgotleng la Molaotheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likuthokozele ukuthotshelwa ngokuphelele kwemibiko ekhishwa njalo emva kwezinyanga eziyisithupha ethunyelwa eNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo.

src: Ho fihlela lena Khomishene e Ikemetseng ya Dikgetho (IEC), ka ho sebedisana le makala a mang a puso, e fihlelletse katleho ya se ka fihlang ho 75% mabapi le ho bokella diaterese tsa batho ba ka nnang ba kenela dikgetho.
tgt: Kuze kube manje iKhomishana Yokhetho Ezimele (i-IEC), ngokusebenzisana nezinye izikhungo zombuso, seyizuze impumelelo ecishe ibe ngama-75% ekuqoqweni kwamakheli abantu abafanele ukuvota.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe hape ka lenaneo le rerilweng ke Kantoro ya Poso ya Aforika Borwa (SAPO) ho thusa ba hlokang diaterese tsa bodulo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lahlinzekwa futhi nangolwazi mayelana nohlelo oluhlongozwayo lokuba i-SAPO ilekelele labo abangenawo amakheli aqondile endawo abahlala kuyona.

src: Kabinete e thabisitswe ke kgatelopele le ketso ya tshebedisano e entsweng ke SAPO, IEC le makala a mang a puso mosebetsing wa porojeke ya diaterese.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyayithokozela impela inqubekelaphambili kanye nomsebenzi omuhle wokubambisana kwe-SAPO, i-IEC kanye nezinye izikhungo zikahulumeni emklamweni wokuhlonzwa nokunikezwa kwamakheli abavoti aqondile.

src: Kabinete e boela e ipiletsa ho ba so kang ba lokisa diaterese tsa bona ho etsa jwalo nakong ya beke ya boingodiso bo tlang ba bakgethi ka Hlakubele 2018.Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Futhi iKhabhinethi liyabanxusa labo abangakahlinzeki ngemininingwane yakamuva yamakheli abo ukuba benze njalo ngeviki elilandelayo lokubhaliswa kwabavoti elizobanjwa ngoNdasa 2018.Imicimbi Ezayo.

src: Tulo ya bone ya Khomishene ya Dinaha tse pedi (BNC) ya Aforika Borwa-Botswana.
tgt: Isigcawu Sesine SeKhomishana Yobambiswano Phakathi KweNingizimu Afrika neBotswana (i-BNC).

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla nka leeto la tshebetso bakeng sa ho nka karolo le ho ba modulasetulo mmoho ho Tulo ya Bone ya BNC ya Aforika Borwa-Botswana e tla tshwarelwa Gaborone, ho la Botswana ka Labohlano, 17 Pudungwana 2017.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uzobamba uhambo olusemthethweni oluya eBotswana lapho ezoba ngomunye woSihlalo ababambisene besiGcawu Sesine SeKhomishana Yobambiswano Phakathi KweNingizimu Afrika neBotswana esizobanjelwa edolobheni laseGaborone, eBotswana ngoLwesihlanu, mhla ziyi-17 kuLwezi 2017.

src: Aforika Borwa le Botswana di kopana selemo ka seng boemong ba Dihlooho tsa Dipuso ka hara moralo wa BNC ho sheba botjha tshebedisano ya bobedi bona le ho tshohla dintlha tse amang dinaha ka bobedi.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika neBotswana babamba umhlangano njalo ngonyaka ezingeni leziNhloko Zemibuso ngaphansi kohlaka lwe-BNC ukuzobuyekeza ubambiswano phakathi kwalawa mazwe amabili futhi baxoxisane nangezindaba ezithinta lawa mazwe womabili.

src: Dinaha ka bobedi di na le dikamano tse kgahlisang tsa kutlwano tse bontshwang ke maqhama a botjhaba le bohaufi ba dinaha tsena.
tgt: Lawa mazwe amabili anobudlelwane obuhle obususelwa kubudlelwane bezamasiko obukhona phakathi kwezakhamizi zalawa mazwe futhi obuqiniswa nawukuthi lawa mazwe angomakhelwane.

src: Di sebedisana mabakeng a mangata a kenyeletsang, dipalangwang, kgwebisano le matsete, bophelo bo botle, mabaka a tikoloho, jwalojwalo.
tgt: Lawa mazwe asebenza ngokubambisana emikhakheni eminingana kubandakanya ezokuthutha, ezohwebo nokutshalwa kwezimali, ezempilo, izindaba zezemvelo, njll.

src: Aforika Borwa ke e nngwe ya balekane ba baholo ba kgwebisano le Botswana, ka dikhamphani tse batlang di ba ngata tsa Aforika Borwa tse sebetsang ka hara naha eo.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika ingelinye lamazwe ahwebelana kakhulu neBotswana futhi lokhu kubonakala ngokucacile njengoba kunezinkampani eziningi zaseNingizimu Afrika ezenza ibhizinisi eBotswana.

src: Leeto la Moporesidente wa Puso ya Angola.
tgt: Uhambo Lokuvakashela kukaMongameli wase-Angolan kuleli.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla amohela Motlotlehi, Moporesidente wa Riphabliki ya Angola, João Lourenço, bakeng sa Leeto la Puso le etsang nalane ka hara Aforika Borwa ho tloha ka la 23 Pudungwana 2017.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uzosingatha uMongameli wase-Angola, uMhlonishwa u-João Lourenço, ohambweni lwakhe lokuvakashela kuleli oluyingqophamlando kusukela mhla zingama-23 kuLwezi 2017.

src: Sena e tla be e le Leeto la hae la Puso la pele ka hara naha ya rona kamora hoba a hlomamiswe.
tgt: Lolu hambo wuhambo lwakhe lokuqala ngqa lokuvakashela eNingizimu Afrika emva kokubekwa kwakhe esihlalweni sokuba nguMongameli wase-Angola.

src: Dinaha ka bobedi di na le maqhama a nalane le a bomphato a ballwang dilemong tse fetileng tsa ntwa ya tokoloho ha Angola e ne e bolokile le ho tshehetsa balwanedi ba tokoloho ba Aforika Borwa dikampong tse fapafapaneng ka hara naha eo.
tgt: Lawa mazwe amabili anobudlelwane obuhle obasungulwa kudala ngezinsuku zomzabalazo wenkululeko lapho izwe lase-Angola lakhoselisa futhi lasekela izishoshovu zomzabalazo zaseNingizimu Afrika ezinkanjini ezihlukahlukene ezweni lase-Angola.

src: Kgwebisano le tshebedisano ho tsa moruo pakeng tsa dinaha ka bobedi e ho hotse haholo, ho fihlella moo Aforika Borwa e leng molekane wa mantlha wa Angola ka hara kontinente.
tgt: Selukhule kakhulu uhwebo nobambiswano phakathi kwalawa mazwe amabili, kangangokuthi iNingizimu Afrika isiyizwe elikleliswe endaweni yokuqala kumazwe ahwebelana ne-Angola kuleli zwekazi.

src: Dikhamphani tse ngata tsa Aforika Borwa di tsamaisa kgwebo ka hara Angola makaleng a fapafapaneng a kenyeletsang, a kaho, merafo, matlo, mabenkele, dijo le dino, dihotele le boikgathollo, dibanka le ditshebeletso tsa bongaka.
tgt: Ziningi izinkampani zakuleli ezenza ibhizinisi e-Angola, emikhakheni ehlukahlukene kubandakanya umkhakha wezokwakha, ezolimo, ezezindlu, ezokuthengiswa kwempahla, ezokudla neziphuzo, ezamahhotela nokuvakasha, ezamabhange kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha.

src: Nakong ya leeto la hae, Moporesidente Lourenço hape o tla tshwara Kopano ya Thuto ka Labohlano, la 24 Pudungwana 2017 moahong wa OR Tambo ho la Pretoria.
tgt: Ohambeni lwakhe kuleli, uMongameli Lourenço uzokwethula nesiFundo ngoLwesihlanu mhla ziyi-24 kuLwezi e-OR Tambo Building ePitoli.

src: Matsatsi a16 a Thibelo ya Diketso tsa Dikgoka.
tgt: Umkhankaso Wezinsuku Eziyi-16 Wokulwisana Nodlame Olubhekiswe Kwabesifazane Nezingane.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le maAforika Borwa kaofela a emang kgahlanong le Diketso tsa dikgoka ho basadi le tlhekefetso ya bana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlanganyela nabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu asebethathe isinqumo sokubhukula balwisane noxhashazwa kwabesifazane nezingane.

src: Matsatsi a 16 a letsholo la Thibelo ya Diketso tsa Dikgoka kgahlanong le Basadi le Bana le tla etsahala pakeng tsa la 25 Pudungwana le la 10 Tshitwe 2017.
tgt: Umkhankaso Wezinsuku Eziyi-16 Wokulwisana Nodlame Olubhekiswe Kwabesifazane Nezingane uzobanjwa kusukela mhla zingama-25 kuLwezi kuze kube ngumhla ziyi-10 kuZibandlela 2017.

src: Sena ke selemo sa bo-19 sa letsholo lena ka hara Aforika Borwa mme le tla tswela pele tlasa mookotaba: “Mpalleng le Nna: Mmoho re Ntshetsapele Aforika Borwa e Hlokang Dikgoka”.
tgt: Lona ngunyaka we-19 kuqhutshwa lo mkhankaso eNingizimu Afrika futhi uzoqhubeka ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Ngibale Nami: Sisonke Siqhubezela Phambili iNingizimu Afrika Engenalo Udlame”.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla thakgola letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 a Thibelo ya Dikgoka ho la Kapa Botjhabela ka Moqebelo, wa la 25 Pudungwana 2017.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uzokwethula umkhankaso Wezinsuku eziyi-16 Wokulwisana Nodlame Olubhekiswe Kwabesifazane Nezingane eMpumalanga Kapa ngoMgqibelo mhla ziyi-25 kuLwezi 2017.

src: Le tla tsepamisa maikutlo hodima phano e tswellang ya Dipuisano tsa Naha, tse kgothaletsang batho ho bua ka kgoba ya dikgoka tse itshetlehileng hodima bong.
tgt: Umkhankaso uzogxila ekuqalisweni ngokuqhubekayo kweziNkulumo-mpendulwano Zikazwelonke, ezikhuthaza abantu ukuba baxoxisane ngesihlava sodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane.

src: Sena se tla etellwa pele ke Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Banna ka Sontaha, sa la 19 Pudungwana 2017, le ipiletsang ho banna ho bapala karolo ya bona mabapi le ho aha setjhaba se bolokehileng le sa kahisano e momahaneng.
tgt: Lokhu kuzokwandulelwa wuSuku Lwabesilisa oluzogujwa ngeSonto, mhla ziyi-19 kuLwezi 2017, lapho kunxuswa khona amadoda ukuba adlale indima yawo ekwakheni umphakathi ophephile futhi obumbene.

src: Lefapha la Toka le Ntshetsopele ya Molaotheo le tla hlophisa letsholo la bobedi la diradio tsa badudi tlasa letoto la tsona la Let’s Talk Justice, le tlisang ditshebeletso tsa mmuso bathong ka ho neha bamamedi monyetla wa ho buisana le bahlanka ba mmuso ka ditaba tse ka sehloohong.
tgt: UMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Komthethosisekelo uzoqhuba umkhankaso wesibili wochungechunge lomsakazo olubizwa ngokuthi: Let’s Talk Justice, okuwumkhankaso oletha izinsizakalo zikahulumeni kubantu ngokuhlinzeka abalaleli ngethuba lokuxhumana nokufakana imilomo nezikhulu zikahulumeni ngezindaba ezisematheni.

src: Ho thakgolwa ha Lekgotla la Dinyewe la Ditlolo tsa Molao tsa Motabo nakong ya letsholo hape ho tla netefatsa phumantsho e betere ya tsamaiso ya toka.
tgt: Ukwethulwa kweNkantolo Yamacala Ezocansi ngenkathi kuqhutshwa lo mkhankaso nakho kuzoqinisekisa ukufinyeleleka kangcono kohlelo lwezobulungiswa.

src: Kabinete e na le tshepo ya hore ka ho sebetsa mmoho re ka qeta motsamao wa tlhekefetso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyakholelwa ukuthi ngokusebenza ngokubambisana singasiqeda nya isihlava sokuxhashazwa kwabesifazane nezingane.

src: Ka mekutu ya rona e kopanetsweng re ka sebetsa ho thibela tlhekefetso ha ka nqa e nngwe re netefatsa setjhaba se bolokehileng bakeng sa basadi le bana.
tgt: Ngokubambisana sonke singabhukula sithathe izinyathelo ezifanele ukuvimbela ukuxhashazwa nokuhlukunyezwa futhi ngalokho siqinisekise ukuthi abesifazane nezingane baphila emphakathini ophephile.

src: Batho bohle ba Aforika Borwa ba kgothaletswa ho apara ribone tse tshweu e le letshwao la boitlamo bakeng sa ho fedisa kgoba ena ka hara setjhaba.
tgt: Bayanxuswa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba bagqoke amaribhoni amhlophe njengophawu lokuzibophezela nokuthembisa ukuthi bazokwenza imizamo yokuqeda lesi sihlava emphakathini wethu.

src: Boitokisetso ba Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDKabinete e ipiletsa setjhabeng kaofela ho nka karolo ho qaleng ha mesebetsi ya Labohlano la Ribone e Kgubedu pele ho Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS ka la 1 Tshitwe le ho fihla mafelong a kgwedi eo.
tgt: Amalungiselelo Aphokophele oSukwini Lwengculazi Lomhlaba Jikelele.

src: Ho apara diribone tse kgubedu ke letshwao la bonngwe le boitlamo mabapi le ntwa kgahlanong le HIV le AIDLetsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS ke monyetla bakeng sa motse ka mong ho ikopanya ntweng e kgahlanong le HIV, ho bontsha tshehetso bakeng sa batho ba phelang ka HIV le ho hopola ba hlokahetseng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa bonke abantu emphakathini ukuba babambe iqhaza emkhankasweni wokugqoka amaRibhoni Abomvu njalo ngoLwesihlanu, ngenjoba siphokophele emgubhweni woSuku Lwengculazi (i-Aids) Lomhlaba Jikelele mhla lu-1 kuZibandlela, ozoqhubeka kuze kuphele inyanga kaZibandlela.

src: Ketsahalo ya selemong sena e tla tshwarwa tlasa mookotaba: “Tokelo ya ka ya ho Tseba Maemo a Ka, Thibelo ke Boikarabelo ba ka”, e hokahanang le mookotaba wa lefatshe: “Tokelo ya Bophelo bo Botle”.
tgt: Ukugqoka iribhoni ebomvu wuphawu lokuzwelana nokuzibophezela ekulwisaneni neGciwane Lesandulelangculazi (i-HIV) ne-Aidsi.

src: Sena se matlafatsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lewa la Morero wa Naha la AIDS la Aforika Borwa, Lefuba le mahloko a Tshwaetsanang ka Motabo 2017 - 2022 (NSP), e leng tshiya ya bohlokwa kgatelopeleng ya Aforika Borwa e lebisitseng phihlellong ya tlhokomelo ya kalafo ya lefatshe jwaloka ha e hlahella ho NDP, e kgothaletsang setjhaba se itekanetseng, se matla le se nang le tekatekano.
tgt: USuku Lwengculazi Lomhlaba Jikelele luhlinzeka ngethuba lokuba yonke imiphakathi ibumbane empini yokulwisana ne-HIV, futhi ikhombise ukweseka abantu abaphila ne-HIV futhi ikhumbule nalabo asebedlulile emhlabeni.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho badudi ho kenela ho nka karolo bekeng e tlang ya Beke ya Naha ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo ya bo-7, e lebeletsweng ho tshwarwa ho tloha ka la 27 Pudungwana ho isa ka la 3 Tshitwe 2017.
tgt: Lokhu kuqinisa ukuqaliswa koHlelo Lokusebenza lweNingizimu Afrika Lokulwisana ne-HIV, Isifo Sofuba (i-TB) kanye Nezifo Ezithathelwana Ngokocansi lowezi-2017 - 2022 (i-NSP), oluyinsika esemqoka kakhulu kwinqubekelaphambili yeNingizimu Afrika ephokophele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi bonke abantu bahlinzekwa ngosizo lwezempilo olusezingeni elifanele njengoba lokhu kubekwe ngokucacile ku-NDP, okuwuhlelo lukazwelonke olugqugquzela isizwe esingumqemane, esinamandla futhi esihlinzekwa ngezinsizakalo ngendlela elinganayo.

src: Tlasa boetapele ba GCIS, lepatlelo lena le kgothaletsa dipuisano tse kopanetsweng pakeng tsa ditho tsa Phethahatso le badudi.
tgt: Ngaphansi kobuholi be-GCIS, lesi sigcawu sigqugquzela ukuxhumana ngenkuthalo phakathi kwamalungu esiGungu Seziphathimandla kanye nemiphakathi.

src: E etsahala ka hara mohopolo wa dilemo tse lekgolo tsa Oliver Reginald Tambo, ya neng a kgothaletsa tekatekano ya bong.
tgt: Iviki lalo nyaka lizokwenzeka onyakeni womgubho weminyaka eyikhulu yokuzalwa kuka-Oliver Reginald Tambo, isishoshovu esabe silwela ukulingana phakathi kwabesilisa nabesifazane.

src: Diketsahalo tsena di reretswe ho tshehetsa letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 a Ntwa kgahlanong le Dikgoka le Tlhekefetso ya Basadi le Bana.
tgt: Imicimbi nezinhlelo ezizokwenziwa ngaleli viki kuhloswe ngakho ukusekela umkhankaso wesiNsuku eziyi-16 Zokulwisana Nodlame Olubhekiswe Kwabesifazane Nezingane.

src: Diketsahalo di tla manehwa khalendareng ya naha le ho arolelanwa websaeteng ya mmuso (WEBTOKEN).Dibili.
tgt: Imininingwane yemicimbi ezobanjwa ngaleli viki izofakwa ohlwini lwezinto ezizokwenziwa yizwe bese ishicilelwa kwiwebhusayithi kahulumeni (WEBTOKEN).Imithethosivivinywa.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya tsebiso ho ya ka karolo 74(5) ya Molaotheo wa Riphabliki ya Aforika Borwa wa selemo sa 1996.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukushicilelwa kwesaziso esikhishwe ngokwesigaba 74(5) soMthethosisekelo WeRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika we-1996.

src: Morero ka sena ke ho qala tsamaiso ya ditherisano tsa naha le diporofense ka merero ya ho tlisa diphethoho meeding ya diporofense mabapi le Masepala wa Lehae wa Matatiele ho la Kapa Botjhabela le dibakeng tse itseng tsa Ba Ga Mothibi ho la Leboya Bophirima.
tgt: Inhloso yalokhu wukuqalisa inqubo yokubonisana kazwelonke kanye neyezifundazwe mayelana nokuqaliswa kokusebenza kwezinguquko ezenziwe emingceleni yezifundazwe eziphathelene noMasipala Wendawo WaseMatatiele eMpumalanga Kapa kanye nezindawo ezithile e-Ba Ga Mothibi esifundazweni saseNyakatho Ntshonalanga.

src: Maikemisetso ka ho ralwa botjha ha meedi ya diporofense ho hlahisitswe ke badudi ba dibaka tse boletsweng ba batlang ho kgutlisetswa diporofenseng tse mabapi.
tgt: Ukuklanywa kabusha kwemingcele yezifundazwe kususelwa ezimfunweni zemiphakathi yalezi zindawo okukhulunywa ngazo lapha, eyanxusa ukuba isuswe ifakwe ezifundazweni ezingomakhelwane.

src: Melaetsa.
tgt: Imiyalezo.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa naha ya Fora jwalo ka thatohatsi e tla tshwara Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Rakbi wa selemo sa 2023 le ho leboha kemedi ya mmuso, e neng e eteletswe pele ke Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa, Letona la Dipapadi le Boithapollo Thulas Nxesi le Kopano ya Rakbi ya Aforika Borwa, bakeng sa mosebetsi wa ho kgothaletsa boiketo ba Aforika Borwa ba ho tshwara ketsahalo ena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithanda ukuhalalisela izwe lase-France njengezwe eliqokelwe ukusingatha uMqhudelwano Wendebe Yomhlaba Yebhola Lombhoxo wezi-2023 futhi iyabonga kakhulu kwithimba likahulumeni elabe liholwa yiPhini LikaMongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa, uNgqongqoshe Wezemidlalo u-Thulas Nxesi kanye Nenhlangano Yebhola Lombhoxo yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SARU), ngomsebenzi omuhle abawenzile ukugqugquzela nokusekela isiphakamiso seNingizimu Afrika sokusingatha lo mqhudelwano.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Letona Pandor, ya abetsweng Kgau ya Titjhere e ka Sehlohlolong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithanda ukuhalalisela uNgqongqoshe Pandor, oklonyeliswe ngeNdondo Kathisha Ovelele.

src: Kgau ena e ile ya nehwa Letona Pandor ke Motjhanselara wa Yunivesithi ya Aforika Borwa, Moporesidente wa mehleng Thabo Mbeki.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe wanikezwa le ndondo nguShansela WeNyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-Unisa), uMongameli Waphambilini waseNingizimu Afrika uThabo Mbeki.

src: Kgau ya Titjhere e ka Sehlohlolong, e leng e nngwe ya mekgahlelo e mene, e ananela nyehelo ya titjhere leha e le efe e ipabotseng kapa e ntsheditseng pele ho ruta, ho ithuta, ntshetsopele ya maitsebelo le/kapa diphutso lekaleng la yona la botsebi.
tgt: INdondo Kathisha Ovelele, engomunye wemikhakha emine, ihlonipha igalelo likathisha ovelele osebenze ngobunyoninco obukhulu ekuqhubekiseleni phambili umsebenzi wokufundisa, ukufunda, ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono noma nocwaningo emkhakheni wakhe.

src: Kabinete e babatsa mosebetsi o entsweng ke Seteishene sa Aforika Borwa sa Tsebo ya Dinaledi, e leng karolo ya moifo wa ditsomi tsa dipolanete wa Wide Angle Search for Planets o sibollotseng dipolanete tse tharo tse ntjha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liwushayela ihlombe umsebenzi omuhle owenziwe yi-South African Astronomical Observatory, eyingxenye yombimbi lwabathungathi bonozungezilanga (amapulanethi) be-Wide Angle Search for Planets consortium asebekwazile ukuhlonza amapulanethi amasha amathathu.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa bankakarolo le bahlodi ba Dikgau tsa selemo sa 2017 tsa Govan Mbeki, tse tlotlang batho ba lekala la kaho ba ipabotseng ka phano ya matlo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyabahalalisela labo abebebambe iqhaza kanye nalabo abadle umhlanganiso emcimbini wezi-2017 we-Govan Mbeki Awards, ohlonipha labo abavelele emkhakheni wezokwakha nokuhlinzekwa kwezindlu.

src: Dikgau tsena di tla nakong eo naha e tswelang pele ho keteka phano le dithuso tsa matlo a fetang milione ho tloha ka selemo sa Kabinete e fetisetsa diteboho bakeng sa diketso tse bontshang sebete tsa ba ditshebeletso tsa tshohanyetso, ditima-mollo le baithaopi bohle ba thusitseng ka ho sebetsana le mello ya haufinyana tjena ho la Kapa Bophirima.
tgt: Lo mcimbi wezindondo ufike ngesikhathi lapho izwe liqhubeka nokubungaza ukuhlinzekwa kwezindlu nemixhaso engaphezu kuka-4.6 wezigidi kusukela ngowe-19.

src: Kabinete e bokane bakeng sa kopano ya ho qetela ya selemo sa 2017 Union Buildings ho la Pretoria.
tgt: IKhabhinethi labamba umhlangano walo wokugcina wezi-2017, e-Union Buildings ePitoli.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabinethi.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Lewa la Naha la Lekala la Bohahlaudi (NTSS) 2016-2026 bakeng sa ho kenngwa tshebetsong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kweQhingasu Likazwelonke Lomkhakha Wezokuvakasha (i-NTSS) lowezi-2016-2026.

src: NTSS e thehilwe hodima ditshiya tse hlano tsa lewa, e leng ho le bapatsa, ho thusa ka phihlello e bobebe bakeng sa bahahlaudi, ho matlafatsa boiphihlelo ba baeti, bolaodi ba dibaka tsa ketelo le melemo e pharalletseng.
tgt: I-NTSS isekelwe ezinsikeni ezinhlanu ezikhethekile okusetshenzelwa phezu kwazo, okusho, ezokukhangisa, ukulawulwa kahle kwenqubo yokufinyelela kwabavakashi ezinhlelweni zokuvakasha, ukuphathwa kahle kwabavakashi nokwenziwa ngcono kwendlela abathokozela ngayo ukuvakasha kwabo, ukuphathwa nokulawulwa kahle kwezindawo ezivakashelwa ngabavakashi kanye nemihlomulo ebanzi yezokuvakasha.

src: Tokomane ka botlalo e fumaneha websaeteng ya Lefapha la Bohahlaudi: WEBTOKEKabinete e tjhaelletse monwana moralo bakeng sa ho thehwa ha Khamphani ya Naha ya Marangrang a Pharalletseng.
tgt: Umbhalo ophelele waleli qhingasu uyatholakala kuwebhusayithi yoMnyango Wezokuvakasha ku: WEBTOKEIKhabhinethi lilugunyazile uhlaka lokusungulwa kweNkampani Kazwelonke Yohlelo Lwe-inthanethi Esheshayo.

src: E tla boptjwa ka ho kopanngwa ha Sentech le Broadband Infraco.
tgt: Le nkampani izosungulwa ngokuthi kuhlanganiswe i-Sentech ne-Broadband Infraco.

src: Sena se tla thusa ka phano ya dintlha tse ikemetseng ka kopanelo ka mokgwa o hokahaneng le ho bopa mampodi wa marangrang a pharalletseng.
tgt: Lokhu kuzokwenza lula ukuqaliswa nokuqhutshwa ngendlela ehambelanayo kwaleyo misebenzi okudingeka ukuba yenziwe yilezi zikhungo ezimbili ngokubambisana, futhi lokhu kuzokwakha isikhungo sikazwelonke esingushampeni weze-inthanethi esheshayo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Tlaleho ya Kgatelopele ya Pele ya Selemo ka seng mabapi le ho Kenngwa Tshebetsong ha Tokomane ya Moralo ya Ditokelo tsa Batho ba Nang le Boqhwala (WPRPD).
tgt: IKhabhinethi liwugunyazile uMbiko Wokuqala Wenqubekela Eseyenziwe Okhishwa Minyaka Yonke Wohlaka Lomthetho Odingidwayo Wamalungelo Abantu Abanokukhubazeka (i-WPRPD).

src: Tlaleho e akaretsa nako ya ho tloha ka la 1 Pherekgong ho isa ka la 31 Tshitwe 2016.Tlaleho e fana ka tekolo ya boemo bo phahameng ya tsela eo mafapha a mmuso a qadileng ho theha ditshupiso tsa leano la WPRPD ka hara ditsamaiso tsa ona tsa meralo, ditekanyetso, le phano ya ditshebeletso le ho tlaleha ka tatelano.
tgt: Lo mbiko uqondene nesikhathi esisukela mhla lu-1 kuMasingana kuya kumhla zingama-31 kuZibandlela 2016.Uhlinzeka ngomphumela wokuhlola nokuhlaziya okusezingeni eliphezulu okubonisa ukuthi iminyango kahulumeni isihambe ibanga elingakanani ekuqiniseni imiyalelo yezinqubomgomo ze-WPRPD, ukuze ifakwe futhi isetshenziswe ngendlela ejulile ezinhlelweni zokuhlela zeminyango ehlukahlukene, ukwabiwa kwemali, ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingongqangi kanye nezinhlelo zokubika.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Lewa la Moralo wa Leano la Boqhwala bakeng sa Tsamaiso ya Thuto le Thupello ya kamora Materiki bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukushicilelwa koHlaka Olukhethekile Lwenqubomgomo Yokukhubazeka oluqondiswe Ohlelweni Lwemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqesha ukuze umphakathi uzwakalise imibono yawo.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka sephetho sa ho Shejwa botjha ha Lenaneo la ho Thusa Boraditekesi ka Ditjhelete le hlophisitsweng ho tloha ka Pudungwana 2015 ho fihla ka Loetse 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lethulelwe umbiko mayelana nemiphumela yokuBuyekezwa Kohlelo Lokuhlelwa Kabusha Kwemboni Yamatekisi okwenziwa kusukela ngoLwezi 2015 kuya kuMandulo 2016.

src: Lenaneo lena ke karolo ya Lewa la Dipalangwang tsa Setjhaba le Bataletseng, le reretsweng ho fana ka tsamaiso e kopanetsweng le ho ba hlwahlwa ha dipalangwang ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luyingxenye yeQhingasu Elibanzi Lezithuthi Zomphakathi, okuhloswe ngalo ukuhlinzeka eNingizimu Afrika ngohlelo lwezokuthutha oludidiyelwe, oluphephile futhi olusebenza kahle.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ntlha ya hore ho be le dipuisano le mosebetsi o mongata le mafapha a amehang pele Lefapha la Naha la Dipalangwang le ka kenya tshebetsong katamelo e hlabollotsweng botjha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi livumile ukuba kubanjwe ezinye izigcawu zokubonisana nababambiqhaza, futhi kusenomsebenzi okumele wenziwe ngokubambisana neminyango kahulumeni efanelekile ngaphambi kokuba uMnyango Kazwelonke Wezokuthutha uqalise ukusebenza kohlelo olusha olubuyekeziwe.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho lokollelwa setjhaba ha kgatiso ya bo-8 ya Ditshupane tsa Ntshetsopele (2016).
tgt: IKhabhinethi livumile ukuba zikhishelwe umphakathi iziNkomba Zentuthuko zehlandla lesi-8 (zowe-2016).

src: Tlaleho ya Tshupane ya Ntshetsopele e tsepamisa maikutlo hodima ntshetsopele ya Aforika Borwa esale ho tloha qalong ya demokerasi mme e beha leihlo ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP): Tjhebelopele ya Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana mekgwa ya ho matlafatsa bolaodi ba boitshwaro ba basebeletsi ba setjhaba mabapi le bahlanka ba etsang dikgwebo le makala a puso.
tgt: Umbiko Wezinkomba Zentuthuko ugxile kwintuthuko yeNingizimu Afrika kusukela esikhathini sokufika kwentando yeningi labantu, futhi izinkomba zentuthuko zihlola futhi ziqaphe ukuqaliswa kweNhlosombono yowezi-2030 yoHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP).

src: E fana ka sefutho ho Melawana ya Tshebeletso ya Mmuso ya selemo sa 2016, e thibelang basebeletsi ba mmuso hore ba se ke ba kena kgwebong le Puso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lizigunyazile izinyathelo zokuqinisa ukulawulwa kokuziphatha ngendlela efanele kwezisebenzi zikahulumeni, odabeni oluphathelene nezikhulu zikahulumeni ezenza ibhizinisi nezikhungo zikahulumeni.

src: Ho tloha ka la 1 Hlakubele, Lefapha la Matlotlo a Naha, le tsheheditswe ke Lefapha la Tshebeletso ya Mmuso le Tsamaiso (DPSA), le tla beha leihlo hodima boingodiso kaofela bo botjha ho marangrang a inthanete a Dathabeisi e Bohareng ya Bafani ba Ditshebeletso (CSD) kgahlanong le Tsamaiso ya Persale.
tgt: Lokhu kuqalisa ukusebenza kweMithethonqubo Yomkhakha Wezemisebenzi Kahulumeni yowezi-2016, enqabela abasebenzi bakahulumeni ukwenza ibhizinisi noMbuso.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Bolaodi bo Botjha ba Tshebetso le Tsamaiso ya Ntshetsopele ya Dihlooho tsa Mafapha, bo bontshang ka nepo kgokahano pakeng tsa motho ka bo mong le tshebetso ya setheo ka kakaretso.
tgt: Kusukela mhla lu-1 kuNdasa, Umnyango Wezezimali Kuzwelonke, ngokwesekwa wuMnyango Wezemisebenzi Kahulumeni Nokuphathwa Kwayo (i-DPSA), lizoqapha futhi liqhathanise imininingwane yabo bonke abahlinzeki bempahla nezinsizakalo abasha ababhalisa nge-inthanethi kwiSizindalwazi Sikazwelonke Sabahlinzeki Bempahla Nezinsizakalo (i-CSD) nemininingwane equkethwe oHlelweni lwe-Persal, okuwuhlelo lwemiholo yabasebenzi bakahulumeni.

src: E tla qala ho sebetsa ka la1 Mmesa Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tsebahatswa le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Moralo wa Sekema sa ho Thaothwa ha Dirutehi tsa Tshebeletso ya Mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lilugunyazile uHlelo Olusha Lokuthuthukiswa Nokulawulwa Kwendlela Ezisebenza Ngayo iziNhloko Zeminyango Kahulumeni, okuwuhlelo olubonisa ngendlela enembayo ukuxhumana phakathi kwendlela asebenza ngayo umuntu ngamunye kanye nendlela osebenza ngayo umnyango kahulumeni wonkana.

src: Sena se bopa karolo ya lenaneo la ntshetsopele ka hara Tshebeletso ya Mmuso ho hohella dirutehi tse nang le talente ka hara Tshebeletso ya Mmuso.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luzoqala ukusebenza kusukela mhla lu-1 kuMbasa IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukwethulwa nokuqaliswa koHlaka Lohlelo Lokuqashwa Kwabafundi Abasanda Kuphothula Iziqu Zemfundo Ephakeme Emkhakheni Wezemisebenzi Kahulumeni.

src: Moralo o kenyeletsa ho supa diphesente tsa dikgeo tsa mesebetsi tsa lefapha ka leng bakeng sa ho thaothwa ha dirutehi mesebetsing e haellang.
tgt: Lokhu kuyingxenye yohlelo lokuthuthukisa oluqhutshwa ngaphakathi eMkhakheni Wezemisebenzi Kahulumeni okuhloswe ngalo ukuheha abafundi abanamakhono abasanda kuphothula iziqu zabo zemfundo ephakeme, ukuze beze bazosebenzela uMkhakha Wezemisebenzi Kahulumeni.

src: Letona la DPSA hape le tla matahanya moralo ona le Lenaneo la Tshebeletso ya Kgiro ya Batjha.
tgt: Lolu hlaka luhlanganisa nokwabiwa kwephesenti elithile lezikhala zomsebenzi emnyangweni kahulumeni ngamunye okuzoqashwa kuzona abafundi abasanda kuphothula iziqu zabo zemfundo kuleyo mikhakha edinga amakhono ayivela kancane.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana bakeng sa phatlalatso ya Ditsebiso tse latelang Koranteng ya Mmuso tse amanang le Tokiso ya Dikahlolo tsa Makgotla a Dinyewe, e reretsweng ho eketsa phihlello ya toka bakeng sa batho ba neng ba qheletswe ka thoko pele le metsana ya mahae e sa tholeng ditshebeletso tse lokelang.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezemisebenzi Kahulumeni Nokuphathwa Kwayo uzoqinisekisa futhi ukuthi lolu hlaka luhambisana kahle noHlelo Lokuqashwa Kwentsha.

src: Tokiso ena e diterekeng tsa bomaseterata Freistata le Kapa Leboya, le ho tloswa ha Ditereke tsa Bomaseterata tse itseng ho Karolo ya Lekgotla le Phahameng la Dinyewe la Gauteng le ho di beha tlasa bodisa ba Karolo ya Lekgotla le Phahameng la Dinyewe la Leboya Bophirima.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukushicilelwa kweZaziso ezilandelayo kuSomqulu Kahulumeni mayelana nokuHlelwa Kabusha Kobubanzi Begunya Lokusebenza Nokwengamela Kwezinkantolo, okuhloswe ngakho ukukhulisa izinga lokutholakala kobulungiswa kubantu ababencishwe amathuba phambilini kanye nasezindaweni ezisemakhaya ezingazitholi izinsizakalo zobulungiswa ngendlela efanele.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Melawana ya Melao ya Bonamodi ho ya ka dipehelo tsa Molao wa Tshireletso ya Matsete, 2015 (Molao wa bo-22 wa selemo sa 2015).
tgt: Ukuhlelwa kabusha kwegunya lezinkantolo lokusebenza nokwengamela kuzokwenziwa kwizifunda-nkantolo ezithile eFreyistata naseNyakatho Kapa, futhi kuzokhishwa iziFunda-nkantolo ezithile ngaphansi koPhiko Lwenkantolo Ephakeme lwaseGauteng, zifakwe ngaphansi kwegunya lokusebenza nokwengamela loPhiko Lwenkantolo Ephakeme yaseNyakatho Ntshonalanga.

src: Melawana ena e fana ka hore motsetedi ya nang le kgang mabapi le mohato o nkuweng ke mmuso o amang matsete, ho kopa Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri (dti) ho kenella ka mokgwa wa bonamodi o ka bang teng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyigunyazile iMithethonqubo ephathelene Nemithetho Yokuxazululwa Kwemibango ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuvikelwa Kotshalomali wezi-2015 (uMthetho wama-22 wezi-2015).

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho bitswa le ho tshwarwa ha dipitso tse latelang:Pitso ya Ditherisano ya Naha ya Lenaneo la Ntshetsopele ya Basebeletsi ba Badudi ya selemo sa 2018 ke DPSA.
tgt: Le mithethonqubo ihlinzekela ukuba umtshalimali ongagculisekile ngesinyathelo esithile esithathwe nguhulumeni, esinomthelela kutshalomali lwakhe, acele ukuba uMnyango Wezohwebo Nezezimboni (i-dti) ungenelele ngenhloso yokuthi kuxoxiswane bese kutholakala isixazululo.

src: Pitso ya bo-23 ya Selemo ka seng ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Batjhutjhisi, e tla tshwarwa ke Bolaodi ba Naha ba Botjhutjhisi ho la Durban ka Loetse 2018.Foramo ya Lefatshe ya Saense ya selemo sa 2021 ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukubanjwa kwezingqungquthela ezilandelayo: INgqungquthela Kazwelonke Yokubonisana Nokuxoxisana Yabasebenzi Bezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi yowezi-2018 ezosingathwa yi-DPSINgqungquthela yama-23 Yamazwe Ngamazwe Yabashushisi Ebanjwa Minyaka Yonke, ezosingathwa wuPhiko Lwezokushushisa Lukazwelonke (i-NPA) eDurban ngoMandulo 2018.

src: Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji le tla buisana le Komiti ya Tsamaiso ya Foramo ya Lefatshe ya Saense ka kgonahalo ya ho tshwara pitso ena.
tgt: Isithangami Somhlaba Wonke Sezesayensi sowezi-2021 okuhlelwa ukuba sibanjelwe eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Dipuisano tsa Boemo bo Phahameng tsa 2017 tsa Kopano ya Aforika (AU), e tla tshwarwa ke DPSA ho tloha ka la 6 ho isa ka la 8 Tshitwe Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana bakeng sa meralo ya letoto la dikhoine tsa sehopotso tsa babokelli le potoloho hore di ntshuwe ka selemo sa 2018.Meralo ya dikhoine, le diphatlalatso tsa tsona, di tla hatiswa Koranteng ya Mmuso: 2018 2oz, 22-dikharate tsa gauta tsa Krugerrand 2018 24-dikharate tsa gauta tsa letoto la dikhoine tsa Natura (Kgolo ya Sube – Archosauria) 2018 24-dikharate tsa letoto la dikhoine tsa gauta tsa R1 (Dihahabi tsa Aforika Borwa – kgudu)2018 khoine ya ditshepe tse pedi ya R5 e potolohang (Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Nelson Mandela)2018 24-dikharate tsa letoto la dikhoine tsa Protea tsa gauta le steling sa silifera (Bophelo ba Mohale – Nelson Mandela)2018 letoto la steling sa silifera sa Korone ya R2 le letoto la Teke ya 2 ½ (Ditshibollo tsa Aforika Borwa – Ditshwantsho tsa mahlasedi a X-ray tse entsweng ka khompyutha le 2018 letoto la dikhoine tse kentsweng mebala tsa steling sa silifera (Dinonyana le Dipalesa tsa Resefe ya Tlhaho ya Waterberg).Dintlha tsa Hajwale.
tgt: UMnyango Wezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe uzoxoxisana neKomidi Elilawulayo Lesithangami Somhlaba Wonke Sezesayensi ngenhloso yokunxenxa ukuba sivume ukuba le ngqungquthela ibanjelwe kuleli.

src: Sephetho sa Palohohle ya Dihlahiswa tsa Naha (GDP)Kabinete e thabisitswe ke kgolo ya moruo wa Afrika Borwa o hotseng ka sekgahla sa 2% tsa selemo ka seng kotareng ya boraro ya selemo sa 2017, ho tloha ho phahameng ho shebuweng botjha ha 2.8% kotareng ya bobedi.
tgt: Inkulumo-mpendulwano Esemazingeni Aphakeme Yenhlangano Yamazwe ase-Afrika (i-AU) yowezi-2017, ezosingathwa yi-DPSA kusukela mhla ziyisi-6 kuya kumhla ziyisi-8 kuZibandlela 20.IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukukhishwa kwamadizayini owezi-2018 ochungechunge lwezinhlamvu zemali eyisikhumbuzo sabaqoqi bezinhlamvu zemali kanye nezinhlamvu zemali ezizosetshenziswa nsukuzonke emphakathini.

src: Tshebetso ena e matla kamoo ho neng ho sa lebellwa ke ka lebaka la kgolo e matla e ntseng e tswela pele lekaleng la temo, le nyehetseng ka dintlha tsa diphesente tse moruong ka kakaretso ha ho shejwa kgolo ya 44.2% kotara-le-kotara.
tgt: Amadizayini ezinhlamvu zemali kanye nokumenyezelwa kwawo ngokusemthethweni, kuzoshicilelwa kuSomqulu Kahulumeni: Uhlamvu lwe-Krugerrand lowezi-2018 olunesisindo esingama-awunsi amabili, olwakhiwe ngamakharethi egolide angama-22 Uhlamvu luka-R5 oluzosetshenziswa nsukuzonke emphakathini, lowezi-2018, olwakhiwe ngezinhlobo ezimbili zezakhi-mali ezisansimbi (Isikhumbuzo Sokuhlangana Kweminyaka Eyikhulu Kwazalwa u-Nelson Mandela) Uchungechunge lohlamvu luka-R1 lowezi-2018 olungamakharethi egolide angama-24 (Izilwane ezihuquzela ngesisu zaseNingizimu Afrika – ufudu olubizwa nge-parrot beaked padloper) Uchungechunge lohlamvu lwe-Natura lowezi-2018 olungamakharethi egolide angama-24 (Olubizwa nge-Rise of the dinosaurs – Archosauria) Uchungechunge lohlamvu lwe-Protea lowezi-2018 olungamakharethi egolide angama-24 futhi olutholakala nangesiliva soqobo (Impilo Yengqalabutho – u-Nelson Mandela) Uchungechunge lowezi-2018 lohlamvu lwe-Crown olungu-R2 olwakhiwe ngesiliva soqobo kanye noTiki 2 ½ (Izinto Eziqanjwe futhi Zasungulwa eNingizimu Afrika – Uhlelo Olukhethekile Lwama-eksireyi Abonisa Isimo Somzimba Wonkana (i-Computed Tomography)) kanyeNochungechunge lohlamvu lowezi-2018 olwakhiwe ngesiliva soqobo (Izinyoni Nezimbali zesiQiwu Semvelo sase-Waterberg).Izindaba Ezisematheni.

src: Tshebetso e matla ho tsa temo, e bileng le kgolo e matla ka dikotara tse tharo tse latelanang, ke ka lebaka la dimela tsa masimong (tse kang poone) dibakeng tsa pula ya lehlabula le dihlahiswa tsa ditshingwaneng.
tgt: Imiphumela yeSamba soMkhiqizo Wezwe (i-GDP)IKhabhinethi liyakuthakasela impela ukukhula komnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ngama-2% ngekota yesithathu yonyaka wezi-2017, kusuka ekukhuleni okubuyekeziwe okukhushulelwe phezulu okungama-2.8% ngekota yesibili yonyaka.

src: Merafo le difeme tsa tlhahiso di nyehetse kgolong e rekotuweng, moo merafo le dikwari di phahameng ka 6.6% le ho nyehela dintlha tse tsa diphesente kgolong ya moruo.
tgt: Lokhu kukhula komnotho okungaphezulu kwalokho obekulindelekile ikakhulukazi kungenxa yokukhula okunohlonze komkhakha wezolimo, ofake amaphuzu angu-0.9% ekukhuleni komnotho sekukonke, okubonisa ukukhula ngama-44.2% uma kuqhathaniswa nekota efanayo yonyaka odlule.

src: Lekala la motlakase ke lona le hulanyang maoto ka ho fetisisa, le theohile ka 5.5%.
tgt: Ukusebenza kahle komkhakha wezolimo, osekubonise ukukhula okunohlonze emakoteni onyaka amathathu elandelana, kungenxa yesivuno esiphakeme sezitshalo ezitshalwa emasimini angodeda ngendlale (njengommbila) esitholakale kulezo zindawo zakuleli ezithola imvula ehlobo futhi kubangelwe nayisivuno esihle semikhiqizo yezolimo etshalwa ezingadini (horticultural products).
