src: Kgolo bakeng sa dintho tse sebediswang malapeng ya 2.6% ke ka lebaka haholo la ho reka thepa ya nako e telele, e bakileng keketseho ya dintlha tsa diphesente tse tsa keketseho ya 2.6%.
tgt: Umkhakha wezezimayini nowezokukhiqiza nayo isifakile isandla ekukhuleni komnotho, njengoba umkhakha wezezimayini nokumbiwa kwezinkwali ukhule ngama-6.6% futhi ufake amaphuzu angu-0.5 % ekukhuleni komnotho.

src: Kgolo ena e neng e sa lebellwa le ho shejwa botjha ho phahameng ha sephetho sa kgolo ya kotara ya bobedi e bolela hore kgolo e ka fihla ho 0.9% ka selemo sa 2017.Sena se ka hodimo ho feta 0.7% e neng e lebeletswe nakong ya Pehelo ya Leano la Ditekanyetso tsa Nako e Bohareng (MTBP).
tgt: Umkhakha kagesi yiwona mkhakha ongenzanga neze kahle, njengoba ufadalale ngama-5.5%.

src: Mmuso o lokela ho netefatsa hore lebelo lena la kgolo le dula le le jwalo ka ho tswela pele ho kenya tshebetsong mekgwa e 14 ya ho matlafatsa tshepo e hahellang hodima ho ntlafatsa tshepo ya basebedisi le ho kgutlisetsa tshepo ya borakgwebo.
tgt: Ukukhula kwezinga lokuthengwa kwempahla emakhaya ngama-2.6% kubangelwe ikakhulukazi wukuthengwa kwempahla ehlala isikhathi eside, okuyinto efake amaphuzu angama-1.6% kulokhu kukhula okungama-2.6%.

src: Lebenkele le Abelanang Tsohle la InvestSAKabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha Lebenkele le Abelanang Tsohle la InvestSA KwaZulu-Natal ke Moporesidente Jacob Zuma e le karolo ya mekutu ya ho ntlafatsa bobebe ba ho etsa dikgwebo ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ukukhula komnotho ngezinga eliphezudlwana kwalelo ebelilindelekile kanye nokubuyekezwa kwezilinganiso zokukhula komnotho zekota yesibili yonyaka kubonisa ukuthi ukukhula komnotho wakuleli kungafinyelela ku-0.9% ngowezi-2017.Lesi silinganiso sithanda ukuba phezudlwana kancane kunesilinganiso sika-0.7% esabikezelwa eSitatimendeni Senqubomgomo Yesabelomali Sesikhathi Esimaphakathi (i-MTBPS).

src: Lena ke Lebenkele la boraro le Abelanang Tsohle le thakgotsweng ka hara naha.
tgt: Kudingeka ukuba uhulumeni aqinisekise ukuthi uyaqhubeka lo mfutho wokukhula komnotho ngokuthi aqhubeke nokusebenzisa izinyathelo eziyi-14 okuhloswe ngazo ukuthuthukisa ukwethenjwa komnotho wakuleli ngokwakhela phezu kokwethenjwa komnotho okuboniswa ngabathengi bakuleli, futhi ukuze kanjalo kubuyiswe nokwethenjwa komnotho wumkhakha wezamabhizinisi.

src: Le reretswe ho bopa tikoloho e nepahetseng ka ho fana ka sebaka sa boikopanyo bakeng sa batsetedi hore ba fumane ditshebeletso tsohle bakeng sa ho akofisa diporojeke le ho fokotsa metjha e mengatangata ya mmuso ha motho a qala kgwebo.
tgt: Isikhungo se-InvestSA Esihlinzeka Ngezinsizakalo Ezihlukahlukene Ngaphansi Kophahla OlulodwaIKhabhinethi likushayela ihlombe ukwethulwa kwesiKhungo se-InvestSA Esihlinzeka Ngezinsizakalo Ezihlukahlukene Ngaphansi Kophahla Olulodwa KwaZulu-Natali nguMongameli Jacob Zuma, njengengxenye yemizamo yokwenza ngcono inqubo yokwenza ibhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ho saennwe ditumellano tse latelang: Memorandamo wa Kutlwano (MoU) mabapi le ho boptjwa ha Khomishene ya Boporesidente ya Dinaha tse Pedi, MoU wa Tshebedisano Lepatlelong la Tikoloho, Ditataiso tsa ho Kenngwa Tshebetsong ha pebofatso ya phumantsho ya divisa, Porothokhole ya Tshebedisano ya Sepolesa le Tumellano ya Thusano Mabakeng a Tsamaiso ya Makgetho a Madiboho.
tgt: Kuhloswe ngaso ukwakha isimo esikahle, ngokuhlinzeka ngesizinda esiyinhloko esisendaweni eyodwa lapho kuzoxhunywana khona nabatshalimali, futhi lapho bezothola khona zonke izinsizakalo abazidingayo, ngalokho-ke kusheshiswe ukuqaliswa kwemiklamo futhi kuncishiswe nokubambezeleka okubangelwa yimicikilisho nemidanti eminingi kahulumeni okudingeka ukube umuntu achushe kuyona uma efuna ukusungula ibhizinisi.

src: Seboka sa Bohlano sa AU le Kopano ya Yuropa (EU)Kabinete e amohela sephetho sa Seboka sa Bohlano sa AU le ESeboka sena se fanne ka monyetla bakeng sa Aforika Borwa ho matlafatsa mawa a dikamano tsa moruo le bodiplomate ka dipuisano tse fapafapaneng sebokeng sena le diketsahalong tse ka thoko tse kang Foramo ya Kgwebo le Seboka sa Batjha, ka ho tsepamisa maikutlo hodima kgolo ya moruo e kenyeletsang kgiro ya batjha le boetapele ba dikgwebo.
tgt: Ubudlelwane phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ne-AngolaIKhabhinethi liyazamukela izivumelwano ezisayinwe ngenkathi uMongameli wase-Angola u-João Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço evakashele eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kgwebisano ya Bokgoba ya Bafalli ba batho batsho ba maAforikaKabinete e imatahanya le badudi ba matjhaba mabapi le ho tshwela ka mathe ditlaleho tsa ho fantiswa ha bafalli ba batho batsho ba maAforika ho la Libya jwaloka makgoba.
tgt: Kusayinwe lezi zivumelwano ezilandelayo: Isivumelwano Sokusebenzisana (i-MoU) ekusungulweni kweKhomishana YoMongameli Balawa Mazwe Amabili, i-MoU Yokubambisana Emkhakheni Wezemvelo, Imihlahlandlela yokuqalisa inqubo yokuqeda isidingo sokuba abavakashi balawa mazwe amabili bathole i-visa ngaphambi kokuvakashela e-Angola noma eNingizimu Afrika, Isivumelwano Sobambiswano Lwamaphoyisa Akulawa Mazwe Amabili kanye Nesivumelwano Sokulekelelana Ezindabeni Eziphathelene Nokungena Nokuphuma Kwempahla Nabantu Emingceleni Yalawa Mazwe Amabili.

src: Diketso tse jwalo tse hlokang botho di kgahlanong le mehopolo ya AU, le disebediswa tse amehang tsa Aforika le tsa matjhabeng, ho kenyeletswa Tjhata ya Aforika le Ditokelo tsa Botho le tsa Batho.
tgt: INgqungquthela Yesihlanu phakathi kwe-AU neNhlangano Yamazwe ase-Yurophu (i-EU)IKhabhinethi liyayamukela imiphumela yeNgqungquthela Yesihlanu ye-AU ne-ELe ngqungquthela ihlinzeke ngethuba lokuba iNingizimu Afrika yenze ngcono ubudlelwane bayo obukhethekile emkhakheni wezomnotho kanye nasemazingeni osomaqhinga, ngokubamba izingxoxo namazwe ahlukahlukene kule ngqungquthela kanye nasemicimbini ebibanjwe eceleni ngenkathi kuqhubeka le ngqungquthela, njengesiThangami Sezebhizinisi kanye neNgqungquthela Yentsha, okuyimicimbi ebigxile ekukhuleni komnotho okubandakanya abantu bonke, ukuqashwa kwentsha kanye nokusungulwa kwamabhizinisi.

src: Kabinete e amohela tsebiso ka ba ka sehloohong ya hore ba tla hlophisa mokgwa wa dipalangwang le phalliso ho la Tripoli bakeng sa baphaphathehi le bafalli ba hlokang tshireletso ya matjhaba.
tgt: Ukuhweba ngezigqila ezingabafuduki bamazwe ase-AfrikaNjengamazwe omhlaba, iKhabhinethi nalo liyigxeka kakhulu imibiko yokuthengiswa kwabafuduki base-Afrika kwelase-Libya ngenhloso yokubenza izigqila.

src: Lefu lena le bakwa ke baktheria e fumanwang mobung, metsing, dimeleng le dihlahisweng tsa lebese tse sa hlwekisiswang, mme le ka baka matshwao ao e kang ke a ntaramane e kopaneng le letshollo.
tgt: Izenzo eziwubulwane obunjengalobu ziyaphikisana nemigomo ye-AU, kanye nezivumelwano nemithetho ephathelene nalokhu yamazwe ase-Afrika kanye namazwe omhlaba jikelele, kubandakanya neSivumelwano Samazwe ase-Afrika Samalungelo Esintu kanye Namalungelo Abantu.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho tswela pele ho sebedisa metsi ka paballo kaha naha e ntse e tswela pele ho ba ka hara komello.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyasamukela isimemezelo esenziwe yiziphathimandla sokuthi zizosungula isikhungo e-Tripoli esizokwamukela futhi sifudukise abakhoseli nabafuduki abadinga ukuvikelwa ngamazwe omhlaba.

src: Ho sa tsotellwe dipula tse ntseng di na, maemo a matamo a ntse a tswela pele ho theoha ka hara naha.
tgt: Ukubheduka kwesifo i-ListeriosisIKhabhinethi liyabanxusa bonke abantu ukuba baqaphele futhi bathathe izinyathelo zokuzivikela – njengokugeza izandla ngaphambi kokulungisa ukudla kanye nokugwema ukudla okungaphekiwe – ngenhloso yokunqanda ukusabalala kwe-Listeriosis, njengoba lusaqhubeka uphenyo mayelana nomthombo wegciwane elibangela lesi sifo.

src: Sena ke ka lebaka la dithempheretjha tse hodimo hammoho le hore ha re so fumane dipula tse tsitsitseng.
tgt: Lesi sifo sibangelwa yigciwane elitholakala emhlabathini, emanzini, ezitshalweni kanye nasemikhiqizweni yobisi engadlulanga enqubweni yokubulala amagciwane, futhi singaholela ekutheni umuntu abe nezimpawu zomkhuhlane ezihambisana nesifo sohudo.

src: Kabinete e kgothatswa ke ditherisano tse hatetseng pele le bomasepala ba kolotang haholo tse lebisitseng tharollong ya sekoloto sa bomasepala.
tgt: Uma sitholakale kusenesikhathi, siyelapheka, ngokusebenzisa ozifozonke besilungu (ama-antibiotic).IKhabhinethi liyabanxusa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba baqhubeke nokusebenzisa amanzi ngokuwonga njengoba leli lizwe lisakhungethwe yisomiso esilokhu siqhubeke njalo.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Dithuso tsa Kahisano ya selemo sa 2017Bili ena e fana ka melemo e ntlafaditsweng mabapi le dithuso tsa mmuso tsa ditshehetso tsa ditjhelete bakeng sa bana ba dikgutsana le ba tsietsing, ho kenyeletswa le ba dulang malapeng a eteletsweng pele ke bana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyazithokozela izingxoxo ezibonisa impumelelo nenqubekelaphambili, ezibandakanya omasipala abanezikweletu ezinkulu zamanzi, okuyizingxoxo okuhloswe ngazo ukuthola isixazululo mayelana nokukhokhwa lwezikweletu zomasipala.

src: Bili ya Ditsebi tsa Thepa ya Matlo ya selemo sa 2017Bili e fedisa Molao wa hajwale wa Merero ya Makala a Matlo, 1976 (Molao wa bo-112 wa selemo sa 1976).
tgt: Isichibiyelo Somthethosivivinywa Wezibonelelo Zikahulumeni sowezi-2017.Lo Mthethosivivinywa uhlinzeka ngemihlomulo engeziwe maqondana nesibonelelo sesondlo sezingane eziyizintandane kanye nezingane ezidinga ukubhekelelwa kangcono, kubandakanya nalezo ezihlala emakhaya aphethwe yizingane.

src: E bopa tikoloho e kgontshang bolaodi bakeng sa ho matlafatsa mosebetsi wa moruo ka hara indaseteri ya matlo ha hape e sebetsana le tlhokeho ya ho netefatsa diphethoho ka hara lekala lena.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa Wabasebenzi Bomkhakha Wokuthengiswa Komhlaba Nezindlu wezi-2017Lo Mthethosivivinywa uphelisa ukusebenza komthetho okhona njengamanje, uMthetho Wezinkampani Ezithengisa futhi Ziqashise Ngomhlaba Nezindlu, we-1976 (uMthetho we-112 we-1976).

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Moralo wa Naha wa Mangolo a Thuto ya selemo sa 2016Bili ena e matlafatsa Molao wa hajwale wa Moralo wa Naha wa Mangolo a Thuto, 2008 (Molao wa bo-67 wa selemo sa 2008).
tgt: Futhi lo mthethosivivinywa uzokwakha isimo sokulawula esikahle, ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa umsebenzi wezomnotho oqhubekayo embonini yokuthengisa nokuqashisa ngomhlaba nezindlu, futhi kusenjalo uvumele ukuba kubhekwane ngqo nesidingo sokuqinisekisa ukulethwa koguquko kulo mkhakha.

src: E tsebahatsa mekgwa ya ho sebetsana le dintlha tsa mafosi le ho beha ditlamorao ho batho ba fanang ka mangolo a thuto a fosahetseng kapa mekgatlo e fanang ka mangolo a thuto a sa nepahalang.
tgt: Isichibiyelo Somthethosivivinywa Wohlaka Lukazwelonke Lweziqu Zemfundo sowezi-2016Lo Mthethosivivinywa uqinisa umthetho okhona njengamanje, uMthetho Wohlaka Lukazwelonke Lweziqu Zemfundo, wezi-2008 (uMthetho wama-67 wezi-2008).

src: Bili ya Botlokotsebe ba Matjhaba ya selemo sa 2017Bili e fana ka moralo wa ketsamolao o ntlafaditsweng ho sebetsana le botlokotsebe ba matjhaba bo entsweng ka hara Aforika Borwa le mose ho meedi ya rona.
tgt: Futhi lo mthethosivivinywa wethula izinyathelo zokubhekana ngqo nenkinga yabantu abaqamba amanga ngeziqu zabo zemfundo futhi ubeka nezinyathelo abangathathelwa zona abantu abaqamba amanga ngeziqu zabo zemfundo noma izinhlangano ezikhipha iziqu-mbumbulu zemfundo.

src: Hape e fana ka tshireletso le toka bakeng sa mahlatsipa a botlokotsobe ba matjhaba.
tgt: Futhi uhlinzeka izisulu zamacala amazwe ngamazwe ngokuvikeleka nobulungiswa obenziwe ngcono.

src: Melaetsa.
tgt: D.Imiyalezo.

src: Moporesidente Uhuru Kenyatta ka ho hlomamiswa ha hae e le Moporesidente wa Rephabliki ya Kenya le hore ke sehla sa hae sa bobedi mmusong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisele:.UMongameli Uhuru Kenyatta ngokugcotshwa kwakhe njengoMongameli wezwe laseKenya, osekuyihlandla lakhe lesibili lokuphatha uhulumeni wakhona.

src: Kabinete e ikemiseditse ho ahella hodima dikamano tse tiileng tse teng pakeng tsa dinaha tsena tsa bo rona ka bobedi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyethemba ukuthi kuzoqhutshekwa nokwakhela phezu kobudlelwane obuqinile obukhona phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika nezwe laseKenya.

src: Moporesidente Emmerson Dambudzo Mnangagwa ka ho hlomamiswa ha hae e le Moporesidente wa Rephabliki ya Zimbabwe.
tgt: UMongameli Emmerson Dambudzo Mnangagwa ngokugcotshwa kwakhe njengoMongameli waseZimbabwe.

src: Kabinete e ikemiseditse ka ho tswela pele ka dikamano tse matla tsa tshebetso le Mmuso wa Zimbabwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyethemba ukuthi buzoqhubeka ubudlelwane bokusebenzana okuhle noHulumeni waseZimbabwe.

src: Majoro Seitebatso Pearl Block ka ho hapa Kgau ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) ya Moemedi wa Selemo wa Bong ka hara Sesole.
tgt: U-Major Seitebatso Pearl Block ngokuklonyeliswa kwakhe ngendondo yeNhlangano Yezizwe (i-UN) Yeshoshozela Lonyaka Elilwela Izindaba Eziphathelene Nobulili.

src: Kgau ena e ananela boitelo le mekutu ya mmaballi wa kgotso mabapi le ho kgothaletsa dipehelo ka hara Lekgotla la Tshireletso la UN ho ya ka Tumellano ya 1325, e ipiletsang ho mekga yohle e lwanang ho tshireletsa basadi le banana kgahlanong le tlhekefetso ka motabo le dikgoka tse itshetlehileng hodima bong.
tgt: Lo mklomelo uhlonipha ukuzimisela nokusebenza ngokuzikhandla komgcini-woxolo othile ekugqugquzeleni imigomo yeSinqumo Somkhandlu Wezokuvikeleka we-UN se-1325, esinxusa wonke amaqembu azibandakanye empini ukuba avikele abesifazane namantombazane ekuxhashazweni ngokocansi nasezenzweni zodlame oluqondiswe kwabesifazane.

src: Ladysmith Black Mambazo, ba fumaneng dithonyo tse pedi bakeng sa Dikgau tsa Grammy tsa selemo sa 2018.
tgt: I-Ladysmith Black Mambazo, ethole ukuphakanyiswa (nominations) okubili kulabo abagaqele iziNdondo Ze-Grammy zowezi-2018.

src: Ya pele ke ya mokgahlelo wa Alebamo e Ipabotseng ka ho Fetisisa ya Mmino wa Lefatshe bakeng sa Alebamo ya bona ya Shaka Zulu Revisited: Mokete wa Sehopotso wa bo-30, mme ya bobedi ke ya mokgahlelo ho Alebamo e Ipabotseng ka ho Fetisisa ya Bana bakeng sa Songs of Peace & Love for Kids & Parents Lefatsheng ka Bophara.
tgt: Ukuphakanyiswa kokuqala kusemkhakheni we-Alibhamu Evelele Emculweni Womhlaba Jikelele (i-Best World Music Album), nge-alibhamu yabo esihloko sithi-Shaka Zulu Revisited: 30th Anniversary Celebration, kanti ukuphakanyiswa kwesibili bakuthole emkhakheni we-Alibhamu Yezingane Evelele, nge-alibhamu yabo esihloko sithi-Songs of Peace & Love for Kids & Parents around the World.

src: Dikgau tsa Grammy di reretswe ho etsahala ka la 28 Pherekgong 2018.
tgt: Umcimbi weziNdondo Ze-Grammy kulindeleke ukuba ubanjwe mhla zingama-28 kuMasingana 2018.U-Chad Le Clos, ngokuba wumbhukudi wokuqala ngqa emhlabeni onqobe izicoco ezine zochungechunge lweNdebe Yomhlaba Yokubhukuda ye-FINSiyaziqhenya ngale mpumelelo yakhe enkulu kangaka futhi siyethemba ukuthi uzoqhubeka nokumela iNingizimu Afrika ngobunyoninco obukhulu.

src: Chad Le Clos, ka ho ba sesesi sa pele sa monna naheng ya rona sa ho hapa letoto la dikola tsa Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Disesi wa FINRe motlotlo ka diphihlello tsa hae hape re na le tshepo ya hore o tla tswela pele ho emela Aforika Borwa ka boqhetseke.
tgt: I-SuperSport United, ngokufinyelela kowamanqamu emqhudelwaneni we-Confederations Cup weNhlangano Yebhola Lezinyawo yase-Afrika (i-CAF).Uzime waseNingizimu Afrika, u-Demi-Leigh Nel-Peters, ngokunqoba isicoco sika-Miss Universe emqhudelwaneni wama-66 obubanjelwe e-United States of America esikhathini esifushane esedlule.

src: SuperSport United, ka ho fihlella makgaolakgang a Mohope wa Bolaodi ba Bolo wa Aforika.
tgt: UDkt Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma, oklonyeliswe ngendondo ye-Lifetime Achievement Award yi-Women Political Leaders Global Forum.

src: Mofumahatsana wa Aforika Borwa, Demi-Leigh Nel-Peters, ka ho rweswa sekola sa Mofumahatsana wa Mmabotle Lefatsheng ka bophara tlhodisanong ya bo-66 ya bommabotle haufinyana tjena ho la Amerika (USA).
tgt: IKhabhinethi lidlulisa amazwi enduduzo kulaba abalandelayo:.Uhulumeni nabantu base-Egypt kulandela isigameko sokuhlasela kwabashokobezi esenzeke endlini yesonto lamaSulumani e-Sinai Peninsula lapho kushone khona abantu abangaphezu kwama-300 futhi kwalimala nabanye abaningi.

src: Ngaka Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma, ya abetsweng Kgau ya Lifetime Achievement ke Foramo ya Lefatshe ya Baetapele ba Basadi ba Dipolotiki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyakugxeka lokhu kuhlaselwa okungenangqondo kwabantu abangenacala emphakathini.

src: Mmuso le batho ba Egepeta ho latela tlhaselo ya boferekanyi moskeng o Penensuleng ya Sinai moo ho bolauweng batho ba fetang 300 le ho ntsha kotsi ba bang ba mmalwa.
tgt: Uhulumeni nabantu base-Nigeria kulandela isigameko sokuzibulala komshokobezi ngebhomu esenzeke mhla zingama-21 kuLwezi 2017 lapho kushone khona abantu abangaphezu kwama-50 futhi kwalimala nabanye abaningi.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe tlhaselo ena e hlokang kelello ho baahi ba se nang molato.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyagcizelela emgomweni walo ocacile futhi ongaguquki wokugxeka izenzo zobushokobezi kanye nazo zonke izenzo zokuvukelwa kombuso ezihambisana nodlame.

src: Mmuso le batho ba Nigeria ho latela ho qhoma ha bomo ya moipolai ka la 21 Pudungwana 2017 e bolaileng batho ba fetang ba 50 le ho ntsha kotsi ba bang ba bangata.
tgt: Umndeni nabangane bakaDkt Mochubela ‘Wesi’ Seekoe, umakadebona owayesishoshovu somzabalazo futhi phambilini owayeyiNxusa laseNingizimu Afrika ezweni lase-Russia.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa ho tshwela ka mathe ho itlhomphileng le ho hlokang ho qeaqea ha yona ha boferekanyi le dikgoka tse nyedisehang.
tgt: Ulisebenzele kahle kakhulu leli lizwe njengeNxusa lakuleli e-Russia futhi walisebenzela njengoSihlalo Wesikhungo Samandla Enuzi saseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Lelapa le metswalle ya Ngaka Mochubela ‘Wesi’ Seekoe, mokaubere wa ntwa ya tokoloho le Lenqosa la mehleng la Aforika Borwa ho la Federeishene ya Russia.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma wamemezela ukuthi uzofihlwa ngoMngcwabo Okhethekile Kahulumeni Wesifundazwe.

src: Lelapa le metswalle ya qhoku ya Ntwa ya Tokoloho le motshwaruwa wa mehleng wa Sehlekehleke sa Robben, Monghadi Eddie Daniels, ya hlokahetseng haufinyana tjena.
tgt: Umndeni nabangane bengqalabutho yoMzabalazo futhi owayeyisiboshwa e-Robben Island, uMnu Eddie Daniels, oshone esikhathini esifushane esedlule.

src: O tla hopolwa bakeng sa boitelo ba hae bo neng bo hloka boinahanelo le tshebeletso ho batho ba Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Uzokhunjulwa kakhulu ngokuzinikela kwakhe okukhulu kanye nokusebenzela abantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Lelapa le metswalle ya Letona la Tshireletso le Mekaubere ya Sesole, Mofumahadi Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, ka ho hlokahala ha ntate wa hae, Monghadi Douglas Mapisa.
tgt: Umndeni nabangane bakaNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela Nomakadebona Bezempi, uNkz Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, oshonelwe wubaba wakhe uMnu Douglas Mapisa.

src: O hlokahaletse Sepetlele sa Cecilia Makiwane East London, ho la Kapa Botjhabela a na le dilemo tse 96.Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Ushonele esibhedlela i-Cecilia Makiwane Hospital e-East London, eMpumalanga Kapa, eseneminyaka engama-96.E.

src: Sehopotso sa Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Nelson MandelaKabinete e imatahanya le maAforika Borwa mabapi le ho kenela sehopotso sa bone sa ho hlokahala ha Nelson Mandela ka la 5 Tshitwe 2013.
tgt: Isikhumbuzo Seminyaka Eyikhulu Kwazalwa u-Nelson MandelaIKhabhinethi lihlanganyela nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika esikhumbuzweni seminyaka emine kwashona u-Nelson Mandela, mhla ziyisi-5 kuZibandlela 2013.

src: Ka selemo sa 2018 naha e tla tshwaya sehopotso sa dilemo tse lekgolo tsa bophelo ba Mandela mme maAforika Borwa kaofela a kgothaletswa ho imatahanya le mekete ya selemo kaofela ha re tla be re isa tlhompho ho e mong wa bara ba bohlokwa ka ho fetisisa ba Aforika.
tgt: Ngowezi-2018 leli lizwe lizogubha iminyaka eyikhulu yempilo kaMandela futhi bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakhuthazwa ukuba babe yingxenye yemigubho ezoqhubeka unyaka wonke, njengoba sizobe sihlonipha enye yamadodana e-Afrika ayibeka induku ebandla.

src: Kabinete e leboha maAforika Borwa kaofela bakeng sa bonkakarolo ba bona diketsahalong tse fapafapaneng tsa sehopotso sa OR Tambo ho phatlalla le naha mme e shebile hore ho tla ba le bonkakarolo bo tshwanang ha re hopola qhoku ya rona le Moporesidente wa pele ya kgethilweng ka tsela ya demokerasi wa Aforika Borwa, Madiba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyababonga bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokubamba kwabo iqhaza emicimbini yesikhumbuzo sika-OR Tambo eyabanjwa ezweni lonkana futhi liyethemba ukuthi abantu bazobamba iqhaza ngendlela efanayo ngenkathi sikhumbula ingqalabutho yethu, uMongameli wokuqala owakhethwa ngaphansi kwenqubo yentando yeningi labantu, uMadiba.

src: Sehla sa MonyakaKabinete e lakaletsa maAforika Borwa kaofela sehla sa monyaka se tletseng thabo le se bolokehileng.
tgt: Isikhathi Samaholide KakhisimusiIKhabhinethi lifisela bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika amaholide kaKhisimusi anentokozo futhi aphephile.

src: Re ipiletsa ho bohle ba tla kena mebileng ho netefatsa hore dipalangwang tsa bona di maemong a loketseng tsela.
tgt: Siyabanxusa bonke labo abazohamba amabanga amade ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi izimoto zabo zisesimweni esikulungele ukuba semgwaqeni.

src: Basebedisi bohle ba mebila, bakganni le ditaaso ba lokela ho ikobela melao ya tsela.
tgt: Bonke abasebenzisi bomgwaqo, abashayeli kanye nabantu abahamba ngezinyawo, kumele bathobele imithetho yomgwaqo.

src: Letona la Dipalangwang, Monghadi Joe Maswanganyi, o thakgotse letsholo la Arrive Alive Bela-Bela, ho la Limpopo ka la 5 Tshitwe.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezokuthutha, uMnu Joe Maswanganyi, wethula umkhankaso we-Arrive Alive (Fika Uphephile) eBela-Bela, eLimpopo mhla ziyisi-5 kuZibandlela.

src: Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS) e tla kenya tshebetsong letsholo la yona la naha ka bophara bakeng sa sehla sa monyaka se bolokehileng mme bohle re na le boikarabelo ba ho tshehetsa SAPS ka ho ikobela molao le ho itshwara ka tsela e nang le boikarabelo.
tgt: Umbutho Wamaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) uzoqalisa umkhankaso ozoqhutshwa ezweni lonkana wokugqugquzela isikhathi samaholide kaKhisimusi esiphephile, futhi bonke abantu bakuleli banesibopho sokusekela i-SAPS ngokugcina umthetho nokuziphatha ngendlela esemthethweni.

src: Lefapha la merero ya Lehae le tla tsebisa meralo ya sehla sa monyaka sa 2017/18 bakeng sa tikoloho ya meedi ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: UMnyango Wezasekhaya uzomemezela izinhlelo zawo mayelana nesimo sokusebenza kwemingcele yaseNingizimu Afrika eziqondiswe esikhathini samaholide kaKhisimusi sowezi-2017/18.

src: Sena ke mabapi le ho thusa hore ho be bobebe le bolaodi bo matlafetseng ba ho tsamaya ha batho le thepa ho kena le ho tswa ka hara Aforika Borwa nakong ena e hlokolosi.
tgt: Lokhu kwenzelwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi luhamba kahle, ngaphandle kwezihibe, uhlelo lokuphuma nokungena kwabantu nempahla emingceleni yaseNingizimu Afrika ngalesi sikhathi esimatasa kakhulu.

src: Hape re ipiletsa ho batswadi le bahlokomedi hore ba se tlohele bana ba le bang kaha e le mosebetsi wa rona ho hlokomela bana ba rona.
tgt: Sithanda futhi nokunxusa abazali kanye nabalondolozi bezingane ukuba bangazishiyi zodwa izingane, ngoba phela kuwumsebenzi wethu ukunakekela izingane zethu.

src: Kabinete e thabile ha e le mona dihlahlobo tsa Materiki di tsamaile hantle ntle le diketsahalo tse tshwenyang mme e lakaletsa sehlopha sa selemo sa 2017 tse molemo ha ba ntse ba emetse sephetho sa bona sa makgaolakgang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyakuthokozela impela ukuthi uhlelo lokuhlolwa kukaMatikuletsheni lwaqhubeka ngaphandle kwezinkinga ezinkulu futhi libafisela okuhle kodwa abafundi bakamatikuletsheni bowezi-2017 njengoba belinde imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwabo kokugcina.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di lokela ho tiisetswa ka mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.
tgt: F.AbaqashiweUkuqashwa kwabo bonke abalandelayo kuzokwamukelwa ngokusemthethweni kuphela uma sekuqinisekiswe ubufakazi beziqu zabo zemfundo futhi uma sebenikeziwe izimvume ezifanelekile.

src: Mofumahadi Ilise Karg jwaloka moemedi wa dti ho Lekgotla la Naha la Boeletsi ba Ntlafatso.
tgt: Nkz Ilise Karg oqokwe njengommeleli we-dti eMkhandlwini Kazwelonke Wokweluleka Ezindabeni Eziphathelene Nokuqanjwa Nokusungulwa Kwezinhlelo Nezinto Ezintsha.

src: Mofumahadi Nonkqubela Helen Maliza.
tgt: Amalungu eBhodi Labaphathiswa (Trustees) lesiKhwama Sikazwelonke Sokufukulwa Nokuhlonyiswa Kwabantu, (i-National Empowerment Fund):.Nkz Nonkqubela Helen Maliza.Nkz Lerato Cynthia Molefe.Nkz Nthabiseng Mateboho Moleko.Mnu Ernest Kwinda kanye.

src: Mofumahadi Lerato Cynthia Molefe.
tgt: noMnu Sipho Zikode (ongummeleli we-dti).Mnu Sandile Mkhize, oqokwe njengoMphathi Omkhulu (i-CEO) we-Magalies Water.

src: Monghadi Sipho Zikode (moemedi wa dti).
tgt: Mnu Wiseman Mkhize, oqokwe njengelungu leBhodi likaMlawuli Kazwelonke Wezamandla Kagesi waseNingizimu Afrika, (i-National Energy Regulator of South Africa).Mnu Phakamani Buthelezi, oqokwe njengo-CEO we-Overberg Water.

src: Monghadi Sandile Mkhize, jwaloka Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso (CEO) wa Magalies Water.
tgt: Advocate Samuel Vukela, oqokwe njengoMqondisi-Jikelele (u-DG) woMnyango Wezemisebenzi Yomphakathi.

src: Monghadi Wiseman Mkhize, jwaloka setho sa Boto ya Bolaodi ba Naha ba Eneji ba Aforika Borwa (NERSA).
tgt: Nkz Brenda Sibeko, oqokwe njengePhini LikaMqondisi-Jikelele (u-DDG) wophiko lweziBonelelo Zomphakathi Ezibanzi (Comprehensive Social Security) eMnyangweni Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi.

src: Monghadi Phakamani Buthelezi, jwaloka CEO ya Overberg Water.
tgt: Mnu Zephania Nhleko, oqokwe njengo-DDG woPhiko Lokuhlelwa Kwezomnotho Nokuhlanganisa (Economic Planning and Coordination) eMnyangweni Wezokuthuthukiswa Komnotho.

src: Moatefokate Samuel Vukela, jwaloka Motsamaisikakaretso (DG) wa Lefapha la Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba.
tgt: Mnu Mandla Victor Ngcobo, oqokwe njengo-DDG: Oyisikhulu Esiyinhloko Esihlinzeka Ngolwazi e-DPSA.

src: Kabinete e ile ya kopana ka Laboraro, mohla la 28 Hlakola 2018, Tuynhuys, Motse Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi labamba umhlangano walo ngoLwesithathu mhla zingama-28 kuNhlolanja 2018 e-Tuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Tse jang motse.
tgt: Izindaba Ezisematheni.

src: Puo ya Ditekanyetso tsa Ditjhelete tsa Naha.
tgt: Inkulumo Yesabelomali Sikazwelonke.

src: Kabinete e ananela boitshepo bo tlokomang bo bonahaditsweng ke Ditekanyetso tsa Ditjhelete tsa Naha tsa 2018 tse ileng tsa tekwa Palamenteng, Motse Kapa, bekeng e fetileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyakuthokozela impela ukwamukelwa ngezandla ezifudumele kweSabelomali Sikazwelonke sowezi-2018 esethulwe ngeviki eledlule ePhalamende, eKapa.

src: Maemong a moraorao a ntjhafatso a hlwibitseng setjhaba sa habo rona se kgabane, Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho ikamahanya le mmuso ho hodisa moruo wa rona esita le ho thea mesebetsi ena e hlokehang ka ho fetisisa.
tgt: Njengoba kuvunguza umoya wokuvuselela kabusha ezweni lethu, iKhabhinethi liyabanxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba babambisane nohulumeni ekukhuliseni umnotho wezwe futhi kuvulwe namathuba omsebenzi adingeka kakhulu kuleli.

src: Phokotso ya tshebediso ya tjhelete e kaalo ka R85 bilione nakong ya dilemo tse tharo tse tlang, e bontsha boikitlaetso ba mmuso ho bokellweng ha ditjhelete esita le kabong e hlokolotsi ya mehlodi ya ho hodisa moruo.
tgt: Ukuncishiswa kochithomali lukahulumeni ngesamba esingamabhiliyoni angama-85 amarandi kule minyaka emithathu ezayo kubonisa ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni ekunciphiseni igebe elikhona phakathi kochithomali kanye nemali engenayo emgodlagodleni kahulumeni, futhi kubonisa ukwabiwa kwezimali nezinsiza zikahulumeni ngobuhlakani obukhulu njengomzamo wokukhulisa umnotho.

src: Dikgato tse tsebisitsweng tsa ho sisithehisa sekgahla sa keketseho ya mekitlane esita le ho kgina kgaello ya ditekanyetso tsa ditjhelete, di ntlafatsa moralo wa rona wa tsa ditjhelete ka bokgabane ebile di fa maAforika Borwa boitshepo matsapeng a bokamoso ba moruo wa rona.
tgt: Izinyathelo ezimenyezeliwe zokunciphisa isivinini sokudlondlobala kwesikweletu sezwe futhi kuncishiswe nokushoda kwesabelomali zizolwenza ngcono kakhulu uhlaka lwemigomo nezinqubo zokuphathwa kwezimali kuleli, futhi okuzokwenza ukuba abantu baseNingizimu Afrika babe nethemba ngekusasa lomnotho wezwe.

src: Kabinete e kgodisehile hore bokenadipakeng bo tla bonahala kgolong ya moruo wa rona, bo tiise boemo ba moruo bo be bo tshireletse maemo a ho theoha ha botsetedi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyakholelwa kakhulu ekutheni noma kanjani lezi zinyathelo ezimenyezeliwe zizowusimamisa umnotho wezwe, futhi lokhu kuzokwenza ukuba likwazi ukuqinisekisa indawo yalo eminothweni yamazwe ngamazwe futhi livikele nesimo sokubekwa kwalo ezingeni leminotho efanelekile ukuba kutshalwe izimali kuyona.

src: Ditekanyetso tsa Ditjhelete tsa Naha tsa 2018 di tshehetsa bafutsana setjhabeng sa rona ka lenaneo le phethahetseng la thusetso ya setjhaba, le thuto ya boemo bo phahameng ya mahala bakeng sa baithuti ba tswang malapeng a futsanehileng.
tgt: ISabelomali Sikazwelonke sowezi-2018 siyabasekela impela abantu abahlwempu ezweni lethu ngokusebenzisa uhlelo olubanzi lwezibonelelo zomphakathi kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwemfundo ephakeme yamahhala kubafundi abavela emakhaya adla imbuya ngothi.

src: Ho arabela dingongorehong tse hlahisitsweng mabapi le dikeketseho tse sisintsweng tsa Lekgetho la Boleng bo Ekeditsweng (VAT), Kabinete e lohotha ho atolla lenane la disebedisuwa tsa mantlha tse sa angweng ke VADilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Nelson Mandela.
tgt: Njengomzamo wokusabela esikhalazweni sabantu mayelana nokukhushulwa kweNtela Yentengo (i-VAT) okuhlongozwayo, iKhabhinethi lisabhekisisa ukuthi mhlawumbe ngeke yini kube wusizo ukwandisa nokukhulisa isibalo sokudla okuyisisekelo ohlwini lwezinhlobo zokudla okungakhokhelwa iNtela Yentengo.

src: Kabinete e kgema mmoho le Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa kgoeletsong ya hae ho maAforika Borwa, ya ho tiisa botjha boikitlaetso bo abelanwang ba ho sebeletsa setjhaba, jwalokaha re tswelapele ho keteka dilemo tse lekgolo tsa tswalo ya Moporesidente wa mehleng Nelson Mandela.
tgt: NjengoMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa, iKhabhinethi nalo liyabanxusa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba bazibophezele ngokubambisana ekusebenzeleni izwe nabantu bakuleli, njengoba siqhubeka nokugubha iminyaka eyikhulu kwazalwa uMongameli waphambilini wakuleli u-Nelson Mandela.

src: Madiba ke Moporesidente wa pele wa Aforika Borwa ya Demokrasi mme o ne a tla qeta le dilemo tse 100 ka la 18 Phupu 2018.
tgt: UMadiba nguMongameli wokuqala weNingizimu Afrika ebuswa ngentando yeningi labantu futhi ukube ubesawadla anhlavana, ubezohlanganisa iminyaka yobudala eyi-100 mhla ziyi-18 kuNtulikazi 2018.

src: Madiba ke thatohatsi ya lefatshe lohle e tlotlehang lefatshe ka bophara e le Mampodi wa Ditokelo tsa Botho, ho se kgetholle ka morabe le ka bong.
tgt: UMadiba yingqalabutho ehlonishwa emhlabeni wonke jikelele njengesiShabasheki Samalungelo Esintu, esalwisana nokucwaswa kwabantu ngokobuhlanga nangokobulili.

src: O bile le seabo sa bohlokwa ho kopanyeng maAforika Borwa, esita le ho kgothaletsa kopano ya demokrasi Aforika ka bophara le lefatshe ka bophara.
tgt: Wadlala indima esemqoka kakhulu ekuletheni ubumbano kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika nasekugqugquzeleni ubumbano lwentando yeningi labantu ezwekazini lase-Afrika lonkana nasemhlabeni jikelele.

src: Moketjana wa pele wa dilemo tse lekgolo tsa Nelson Mandela o bile nakong ya Seboka sa Kopano ya Aforika Addis Ababa, Ethiopia ka Pherekgong ya 2018.
tgt: Umgubho wokuqala weminyaka eyikhulu kwazalwa u-Nelson Mandela wabanjwa ngenkathi kuqhubeka iNgqungquthela Yenhlangano Yamazwe ase-Afrika (i-AU) e-Addis Ababa, kwelase-Ethiopia ngoMasingana 2018.

src: Diketsahalo tse ngatanyana di tla tshwarwa naha ka bophara monongwaha, ho hetla morao bophelong ba Tata Madiba.
tgt: Kulo nyaka, kunemicimbi ehlukahlukene ezobanjwa ezweni lonkana ngenhloso yokukhumbula nokuxoxisana ngempilo kaTata uMadiba.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ohle hore a ikamahanye le meketjana ya dilemo tse lekgolo a le mesebetsing, dikolong, dikerekeng le mekgatlong ya setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyabanxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba babe yingxenye yemicimbi yokugubha iminyaka eyikhulu kwazalwa uMadiba ezikhungweni abasebenza kuzona, ezikoleni, ezinkonzweni kanye nasezinhlanganweni zomphakathi.

src: E etsa kgoeletso ho e mong le e mong wa rona hore re hate menyabuketsong ya Nelson Mandela ka ho sebetsa ka mekgwa ya rona e fapaneng ho aha naha e kopaneng, e se nang kgethollo ya morabe, le ya bong e bile e le e atlehileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyasinxusa thina sonke ukuba sihambe ezinyathelweni zika-Nelson Mandela ngokuthi sisebenze ngezindlela zethu ezihlukahlukene ukwakha izwe elibumbene, elingenakho ukucwasana ngokobuhlanga nangokobulili, futhi eliphumelelayo.

src: Naha ena e boela e keteka dilemo tse lekgolo tsa e mong wa baradi ba kgabane ba Aforika, Mama Albertina Sisulu, ya ileng a nyehela bophelo ba hae a lwanela tokoloho ya basadi le ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Kulo nyaka, izwe lethu ligubha futhi iminyaka eyikhulu kwazalwa enye yamadodakazi engabadi yase-Afrika ayibekile impela induku ebandla, uMama u-Albertina Sisulu, owanikela impilo yakhe ekulweleni ukukhululwa kwabezifazane ngaphansi kwengcindezelo futhi owalwela nenkululeko yeNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kopanong ya yona e latelang, Kabinete e tla rala lenaneo la ho keteka Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Mama Albertina Sisulu.
tgt: Emhlanganweni walo olandelayo, iKhabhinethi lizohlinzeka ngeminingwane yohlelo oluzolandelwa ukugubha iminyaka eyikhulu kwazalwa uMama u-Albertina Sisulu.

src: Komello.
tgt: Isomiso.

src: Kabinete e ananela matsapa a matla a entsweng ke Komiti ya Matona a Kopaneng ka komello, hammoho le ba amehang makaleng ohle a mmuso le kahisanong ho sebetsaneng le maemo a ntseng a ja setsi a komello a thefutseng dikarolo tse ngatanyana tsa naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyayithokozela imizamo elokhu iqhubeke njalo eyenziwa yiKomidi LoNgqongqoshe Beminyango Ehlukahlukene Elijutshwe Umsebenzi Wokubhekana Nesomiso ngokubambisana nabo bonke abathintekayo kuzo zonke izinhlaka zikahulumeni nezomphakathi wonkana ekutholeni amasu okulwisana nesomiso esilokhu siqhubeke njalo, esesikhahlameze izingxenye zezwe eziningana impela.

src: Ntle le taba ya hore Aforika Borwa ke naha e nang le leqeme la metsi, ditlamorao tsa phuthumalo ya lefatshe lohle di tswelapele ho ama mokgwa oo pula e nang ka wona, mme seo se etsa hore mothamo wa matamo a rona o dule o le tlase.
tgt: Ngaphandle nje kweqiniso elingephikiswe lokuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyizwe elinamanzi ayingcosana, isivuvu somhlaba naso siyaqhubeka nokuphazamisa ukutholakala kwezimvula ngendlela ejwayelekile kuleli, okwenza ukuba umthamo wamanzi emadanyini ezwe lethu uqhubeke nokuba phansi kakhulu.

src: Sehlopha sa Tshebetso sa Matona a Kopaneng se sebetsanang le Komello se tswelapele ho hlophisa mosebetsi dipakeng tsa mmuso wa naha, wa diprofense le wa bomasepala dibakeng tsohle tse thefutsweng ke komello.
tgt: IThimba LoNgqongqoshe Beminyango Ehlukahlukene Elijutshwe Umsebenzi Wokubhekana Nesomiso liyaqhubeka ukuhola nokulawula umsebenzi owenziwayo phakathi kukahulumeni kazwelonke, izifundazwe kanye nomasipala kuzona zonke izindawo ezikhahlanyezwe yisomiso.

src: Sena se akga ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha dikgato tsa nako e kgutshwane, e mahareng esita le e telele ho rarolla le ho nolofatsa ditlamorao tse ka etsahalang tsa komello ena.
tgt: Lokhu kubandakanya ukuqaliswa kwezinyathelo zesikhathi esifushane, zesikhathi esimaphakathi kanye nezesikhathi eside, okuhloswe ngazo ukuvimbela nokunciphisa umthelela wesomiso.

src: Mmuso o bokelletse tjhelete ya ho fana ka thuso ya nako e kgutshwane diprofenseng tse amehileng.
tgt: Uhulumeni usebeke eceleni izimali ezizosetshenziselwa ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwesikhathi esifushane ezifundazweni ezikhahlamezekile.

src: O fane ka dithuso tsa ditjhelete tsa kinolo maqakabetsing tse kaalo ka R473 milione esita le R6 bilione e tla eketswa selemong sa ditjhelete sa 2018/19 ho tlatseletsa meralong ya motheo ya metsi Kapa Bophirimela, Kapa Botjhabela le Kapa Leboya.
tgt: Uhulumeni usehlinzeke ngesibonelelo-mali sesomiso esiyizigidi ezingama-473 zamarandi futhi ngonyaka-mali wezi-2018/19 uzohlinzeka ngesinye isabelomali esengeziwe esingamarandi angamabhiliyoni ayisithupha okuhloswe ngaso ukukhulisa nokwandisa ingqalasizinda yamanzi esifundazweni saseNtshonalanga Kapa, eMpumalanga Kapa kanye naseNyakatho Kapa.

src: Mmuso o etsa kgoeletso ho bohle ho tswelapele ho sebetsa le mmuso ho bolokeng metsi, ka ho a sebedisa ka boikarabelo le ka paballo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyabanxusa bonke abantu bakuleli ukuba baqhubeke nokubambisana nohulumeni ekongeni amanzi, ngokuthi bawasebenzise ngokucophelela futhi bangawamoshi.

src: Kabinete e dula e ntse e ikitlaelleditse ho etsa Aforika Borwa hore e be naha e tla kgethwa ke baeti le ke botsetedi ka ho tshwanang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lisalokhu lizibophezele ekwenzeni iNingizimu Afrika izwe elithandwa ngabavakashi, ngokunjalo nabatshali-zimali.

src: Dipolao tsa Mapolesa.
tgt: Ukubulawa kwamaphoyisa.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ho ba malapa le metswalle ya bahlanka ba bahlano ba sepolesa mmoho le lesole la mehleng, ba sa tswa fenethwa ka sehloho tlhaselong ya Motebo wa Sepolesa wa Ngcobo Kapa Botjhabela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lidlulisa amazwi enduduzo nokuzwelana kwalo nemindeni nabangani bamaphoyisa amahlanu kanye nesosha eselathatha umhlalaphansi, ababulawe ngesihluku esikhulu esigamekweni esenzeke esikhathini esifushane esedlule sokuhlaselwa kweSiteshi samaPhoyisa saseNgcobo eMpumalanga Kapa.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe polao efe kapa efe ya banna le basadi ba habo rona ba mapolesa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugxeka kakhulu ukubulawa okungenangqondo kwamalungu emibutho yezokuphepha nokuvikeleka yakuleli.

src: Ho shwa ha mohlanka a le mong wa sepolesa, lesole kapa motho e mong ofe kapa ofe ya sebetsang mosebetsi wa ho tshireletsa kahisano le batho ba habo rona, ha e a amoheleha.
tgt: Kuyinto engamukelekile neze ukubulawa ngisho kwelilodwa nje vo iphoyisa noma isosha noma omunye umuntu othweswe umsebenzi wokuvikela isizwe kanye nabantu bakuleli.

src: Kabinete e ikitlaeditse, ka Letona la Sepolesa, ho etsa kahohlehohle kamoo e ka kgonang kateng ho matlafatsa metebo ya habo rona ya sepolesa, e le ho thibela ditlhaselo tse jwalo kamoso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi selijube uNgqongqoshe Wezamaphoyisa ukuba enze konke okusemandleni akhe ukuhlinzeka nokuhlomisa iziteshi zamaphoyisa zakuleli ngazo zonke izinsiza ezifanelekile ukuze kuvinjelwe ukuhlaselwa kwamaphoyisa okunjengalokhu esikhathini esizayo.

src: Kabinete e boela e ipiletsa ho batswadi le setjhaba ka kakaretso ho netefatsa hore bana ba bolokehile ka nako tsohle, esita le ho sebedisana le makala a kenyang molao tshebetsong, ho tshireletsa ditokelo tsa bana ba rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyabanxusa futhi nabazali kanye nabo bonke abantu bakuleli ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi izingane zabo ziphephile ngaso isikhathi futhi babambisane nezikhungo zokuqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa komthetho ukuze kuvikelwe amalungelo ezingane zethu.

src: Mokgwa ofe kapa ofe wa tlhekefetso kgahlanong le ngwana, o tlameha ho pepeswa o be o tlalehwe hanghang.
tgt: Kumele zivezwe obala futhi zibikwe ngokushesha noma yiziphi izinhlobo zokuxhashazwa kwezingane.

src: Ha re sebetsa mmoho, re ka boloka dibaka tsa rona di bolokehile ra ba ra netefatsa hore baetsi ba ditlolo tsa molao ha ba fumane sekoti sa ho ipata.
tgt: Ngokusebenzisana, sizokwazi ukugcina imiphakathi yethu iphephile futhi siqinisekise ukuthi izigebengu azitholi nencane indawo yokucasha.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izinqumo ZeKhabhinethi.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Moralo wa Leano le Lekotsweng Botjha la Pampiri e Tshweu ho tsa Dipalangwang tsa Naha le tla phatlalatswa bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukushicilelwa koHlaka Lomthetho Olubuyekeziwe Lwenqubomgomo Kazwelonke Yezokuthutha ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngalo.

src: Leano le habile ho fana ka mokgwatsamaiso wa dipalangwang o tlamahanngwang le merero e meng e amanang le lekala ho etsetsa hore ho fokotswe ditjeo tsa ho eta le tsa ho etsa kgwebo.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo ihlose ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo lwezokuthutha oludidiyelwe ezinhlelweni zeminye imikhakha ehlobene nezokuthutha, ngenhloso yokunciphisa izindleko zokugibela izithuthi kanye nezindleko zokuqhuba ibhizinisi lezokuthutha.

src: Le boela le nyalanya merero ya dipalangwang ya naha ena le ditlwaelo tsa dipalangwang tsa lefatshe lohle.
tgt: Inqubomgomo izoqinisekisa futhi nokuhambelana phakathi kwezinhlelo zokuthutha zakuleli kanye nezinhlelo zokuthutha zesimanjemanje ezisetshenziswa emhlabeni jikelele.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Pampiri e Tala Leanong la tsa Mebila la Aforika Borwa, e tla phatlalatswa bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukushicilelwa koMbiko Wokubonisana Wohlaka Lwenqubomgomo YaseNingizimu Afrika Yezemigwaqo ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngawo.

src: Leano le fana ka moralo o ka sehloohong o netefatsang hore mebila ya Aforika Borwa e laoleha betetshana, e batla e bolokehile mme e kenyeletsa mefuta yohle ya dipalangwang hore e fane ka mokgwa o tsitsitseng wa bolaodi ba mebila.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo ihlinzeka ngohlaka lomthetho olubanzi oluzoqinisekisa ukuthi imigwaqo yaseNingizimu Afrika ilawulwa kahle futhi iphephile, futhi ibandakanya zonke izinhlobo zezithuthi ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka indlela esimeme yokulawulwa nokuphathwa kwemigwaqo.

src: Le tataisa melawana ya tsela, meralo ya motheo, polokeho, ditjhelete tsa mebila le dipalangwang tseo e seng makoloi.
tgt: Inqubomgomo izolawula imithethonqubo yezemigwaqo, ingqalasizinda, ukuphepha, ukuxhaswa ngezimali kwemigwaqo kanye nalezo zithuthi ezingasebenzisi injini.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka diphumano tsa Tshekatsheko ya Naha ya Tswelopele ya Diphuputso le Boithutwane (R&D Survey).R&D ke karolo ya bohlokwa ya tswelopele ya moruo wa kahisano naheng ena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lithulelwe umbiko ngemiphumela yeNhlolovo kaZwelonke yoCwaningo Nolwazi Lwentuthuko Olusha lowezi-2015/2016 (uCwaningo lwe-R&D).

src: Ana e bile matsapa a kopanetsweng a mmuso, diindasteri le ditheo tsa diphuputso.
tgt: Lokhu kuwumphumela wokusebenza ngokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, abemboni yalo mkhakha kanye nezikhungo zocwaningo.

src: Tlaleho e a fumaneha websaeteng ya Lefapha la Saense le Theknolji (DST) ya: WEBTOKEKabinete e ananetse metako e fapaneng ya lethathama la 2018 la tjhelete ya sehopotso e lewana, le tla hlahiswa ke khamphane ya Minte ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lo mbiko uyatholakala kwiwebhusayithi yoMnyango Wezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe (i-DST): WEBTOKEIKhabhinethi liwagunyazile amadizayini ochungechunge lwabaqoqi bemali lwezinhlamvu zemali yesikhumbuzo lowezi-2018, oluzokhiqizwa yinkampani ekhiqiza izinhlamvu zemali yaseNingizimu Afrika, i-South African Mint Company.

src: Pokello ya 2018 ya metako e fapaneng e tla keteka Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Nelson Mandela.
tgt: Izinhlamvu zemali yesikhumbuzo zowezi-2018 zizobungaza iMinyaka Eyikhulu Kwazalwa u-Nelson Mandela.

src: Dipokello tsena di ne di leleketswe ke tjhelete e lewana ya sehopotso ya 2017 e neng e keteka Aforika Borwa tlasa mokotaba wa Tokoloho, Demokrasi le Botjhaba.
tgt: Lezi zinhlamvu zemali zandulelwe yizinhlamvu zemali yesikhumbuzo yowezi-2017 ebeyibungaza iNingizimu Afrika ngaphansi kwengqikithi yeNkululeko, Intando Yeningi Labantu kanye Namasiko-mpilo.

src: Dibili.
tgt: Imithethosivivinywa.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Lebollo la Setho ya 2018 Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukuba uMthethosivivinywa Wezokusokwa Ngokwesiko Lendabuko wezi-2018 wethulwe ePhalamende.

src: Bili e habile ho tshireletsa, ho kgothaletsa le ho laola karolo ya tsamaiso ya lebollo la setho.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uhlose ukuvikela, ukugqugquzela kanye nokulawula ingxenye emayelana nokuphathwa kwenqubo yokusokwa ngokwesiko lendabuko.

src: E fana ka ditlwaelo le maemo a naha, tse reretsweng tshireletso ya bophelo le thibelo ya ditemalo esita le mefuta yohle ya ditlhekefetso tseo babolotsuwa ba di etswang.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uhlinzeka ngemigomo namazinga kazwelonke okuhloswe ngawo ukuvikela nokuphephisa izimpilo zabasokwa futhi kuvinjelwe nokulimala kwabo, ngokunjalo kunqandwe nazo zonke izinhlobo zokuxhashazwa abahlangabezana nazo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya 2016 ya Sehlomathiso sa Moralo wa Naha wa Mangolo a Thuto Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukuba iSichibiyelo Somthethosivivinywa wezi-2016 Wohlaka Lukazwelonke Lweziqu Zemfundo (i-NQF) lwethulwe ePhalamende.

src: Bili ena, e hlomathisang Molao wa Moralo wa Naha wa Mangolo a Thuto, 2008 (Molao wa 67 wa 2008), e matlafatsa Molao ka ho ntlafatsa dikgato tsa ho sebetsana le maemo a ho se bue nnete, e qobella hore ho be teng ditlamorao bathong ba sa bueng nnete ka mangolo a bona a thuto kapa mekgatlo e ntshang mangolo a thuto a seng molaong.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa, ochibiyela uMthetho Wohlaka Lukazwelonke Lweziqu Zemfundo, wezi-2008 (uMthetho wama-67 wezi-2008), uqinisa lo Mthetho ngokwenza ngcono izinyathelo zokubhekana nabantu abaqamba amanga ngeziqu zabo zemfundo, futhi ubeka nezinyathelo ezizothathelwa labo abaqamba amanga ngeziqu zabo zemfundo noma izinhlangano ezikhipha iziqu-mbumbulu.

src: E boela e sisinya hore ho be teng melawana ya ho netefatsa hore mangolo a thuto a boqhekanyetsi a fetisetswa mekgatlong ya seporofeshenale e tshwanelehileng (pokello ya lenane la batho ba sa bueng nnete ka mangolo a bona a thuto).
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uphakamisa futhi nemithethonqubo yokuqinisekisa ukuthi iziqu zomgunyathi zidluliselwa ezinhlanganweni zemisebenzi yobungoti ezifanelekile (isizindalwazi okuzodalulwa kusona amagama abantu abaqamba amanga ngeziqu zabo zemfundo).

src: E boela e rarolla taba ya kananelo ya mangolo a thuto a tswang dinaheng tse ding.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa ubeka futhi nenqubo okumele ilandelwe mayelana nokugunyazwa kanye nokwamukelwa kweziqu zemfundo ezitholwe emazweni angaphandle.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Bili ya 2017 ya Polokeho Ditereneng, e tla phatlalatswa bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukuba uMthethosivivinywa Wezokuphepha Emkhakheni Wezokuthutha Ngezitimela wezi-2017 ushicilelwe ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngawo.

src: Bili e habile ho ntlafatsa polokeho ya ditereneng esita le ho thea lekgotla la tsamaiso le lekolang mosebetsi wa Bolaodi ba Polokeho Ditereneng ba Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uhlose ukwenza ngcono ezokuphepha emkhakheni wezokuthutha ngezitimela kanye nokwakha uhlaka lokuphatha nokulawula oluzoqapha umsebenzi woMlawuli Wezokuphepha Emkhakheni Wezokuthutha Ngezitimela.

src: E boetse e amahanngwa le Leano la Naha la Diterene mabapi le ho matlafatsa bodisa ba polokeho, esita le ho kgothaletsa le ho qobella boteng ba polokeho ditereneng tsa rona.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uhambelana futhi neNqubomgomo Kazwelonke Yezokuthutha Ngezitimela mayelana nokuqiniswa komsebenzi wokuqapha ukuphepha, kanye nokugqugquzela nokuqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa kwemithetho yokuphepha emkhakheni wakuleli wezokuthutha ngezitimela.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Moralo wa Bili ya 2017 ya Taolo ya Ditshenyehelo Ditereneng, e tla phatlalatswa bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba le dipuisano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukuba uHlaka Lomthethonqubo Wezomnotho woMthethosivivinywa Wezokuthutha wezi-2017 lushicilelwe ukuze kuboniswane nabo bonke abathintekayo futhi nomphakathi uphawule ngalo.

src: Bili e rarolla taba ya dikgaello tsa taolo le bokgoni mabapi le phano ya mekgwatsamaiso ya dipalangwang e sa senyeng tjhelete ebile e le e sebetsang ka bokgabane.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa ubeka izinqubo okumele zilandelwe mayelana nokulawulwa kanye nokuvalwa kwamagebe abangelwa wukungabi khona kwamandla okusebenza adingekayo ekuhlinzekweni kohlelo lwezokuthutha olungambi eqolo futhi olusebenza kahle.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Imicimbi ezayo.

src: Aforika Borwa, e le Modulasetulo, e tla tshwara Seboka sa Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tse ka Borwa ba Aforika (SADC) sa Matona a tsa Bosebetsi, Kgiro le Tshireletso ya Setjhaba, ho tloha ka la 1 ho isa ho la 2 Hlakubele 2018 Setsing sa Diboka tsa Matjhaba sa Motse Kapa (CTICC).
tgt: INingizimu Afrika izosingatha umhlangano woNgqongqoshe beNhlangano Yokuthuthukiswa Kwamazwe aseNingizimu ye-Afrika (i-SADC) bomkhakha wezaBasebenzi, Ukuvulwa Kwamathuba Omsebenzi kanye Nezibonelelo Zomphakathi, futhi izoba nguSihlalo walo mhlangano ozobanjwa kusukela mhla lu-1 kuze kube ngumhla zi-2 kuNdasa 2018 e-Cape Town International Convention Centre.

src: Mookotaba wa seboka o re: “Kgonahalo ya mosebetsi o motle: Ho ntshetsapele bohokahanyi, momahano le ho kenyeletsa ba bangata”.
tgt: Isiqubulo salo mhlangano sithi: “Siphokophele kumkhathizwe wemisebenzi esezingeni elikahle: Sithuthukisa ukuxhumana, ukusebenza ngendlela ehambelanayo kanye nokubandakanywa komuntu wonke”.

src: Ba tla nka seabo ba tla akga balekane ba kahisanong – dikgwebo tse kgolo, tsa bosebetsi hammoho le setjhaba.
tgt: Ababambiqhaza balo mhlangano babandakanya izinhlangano zomphakathi okubanjiswene nazo – izinhlangano zamabhizinisi, ezabasebenzi kanye nezomphakathi.

src: Boemong ba hae e le Modulasetulo wa SADC, Moporesidente Ramaphosa o tla kena maetong a dipontshano ho ya Angola, Botswana le Namibia ho tloha ka la 2 ho isa ho la 3 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa, esikhundleni sakhe njengoSihlalo we-SADC, uzoba nohambo lokubonisana oluya e-Angola, Botswana nase-Namibia kusukela mhla zi-2 kuze kube ngumhla zi-3 kuNdasa 2018.

src: O tla felehetswa ke Letona la Dikamano le Tshebedisano ya Matjhaba, Lindiwe Sisulu le Letona la Lebotho la Tshireletso le Mekaubere ya Sesole, Nosiviwe Maphisa Nqakula.
tgt: Uzobe ephelezelwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezobudlelwano Bamazwe Omhlaba Nokubambisana, uLindiwe Sisulu kanye noNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela Nomakadebona Bezempi uNosiviwe Maphisa-Nqakula.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla tshwara Seboka sa Lefatshe sa bo-17 se mabapi le Kwae kapa Bophelo bo Botle (WCTOH) ho tloha ka la 7 ho isa ho la 9 Hlakubele 2018 Motse Kapa, katlasa mookotaba o reng: “Ho kopanya lefatshe bakeng sa Moloko o Lokolohileng ditlamong tsa Kwae”.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika izosingatha, ngokubambisana nelinye izwe, iNgqungquthela Yomhlaba yezi-17 Yezindaba Eziphathelene Nogwayi noma Ezempilo (i-WCTOH) kusukela mhla ziyisi-7 kuze kube ngumhla ziyisi-9 kuNdasa 2018 eKapa, ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Sibumbanisa Umhlaba ngenhloso Yokuletha Isizukulwane Esingakhahlanyezwa Wugwayi”.

src: Sena ke seboka sa pele sa ho tshwarelwa Aforika.
tgt: Kungokokuqala ngqa ukuba le ngqungquthela isingathelwe kwizwekazi lase-Afrika.

src: WCTOH e etsa kgoeletso ya hore ho be teng kgato ya boitlamo ebile e fana ka lepatlelo la mebuso, mekgatlo ya setjhaba, makgotla a Matjhaba a Kopaneng, mekgatlo ya matjhaba, basebeletsi ba bophelo bo botle le ba bang ba amehang ho okgelana tsebo le ho thakelana malebela, haholoholo mabapi le batjha le basadi ba pepesehileng tshebedisong ya kwae.
tgt: I-WTCOH inxusa ukuba amazwe azibophezele ekuthatheni izinyathelo ezifanelekile futhi ihlinzeka ngethuba lokuba ohulumeni, izinhlangano zomphakathi, abasebenzi bezempilo kanye nabanye ababambiqhaza baxoxisane futhi babelane ngolwazi nezigameko abadlule kuzona, ikakhulukazi mayelana nentsha nabesifazane abakhahlamezekayo ngenxa yokusetshenziswa kukagwayi.

src: Ho tshwara seboka ho a thusa mabapi le ho tla le ditharollo tsa sepheo sa Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha ka ho etsa tlhokomediso le thuto ka ditlamorao tse kotsi tsa tshebediso ya kwae, le tlhokeho ya ho matlafatsa dikgato tsa taolo ya kwae.
tgt: Ukusingathwa kwale ngqungquthela kuzolekelela emizamweni yokufezekisa izinjongo zoHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP), ngokuqwashisa nokufundisa abantu ngobungozi nomphumela omubi wokusetsheziswa kukagwayi, kanye nesidingo sokuqinisa izinyathelo zokulawula ugwayi.

src: Mohla la 10 le 11 Hlakubele, IEC e tla bula Ditsi tsa Boingodiso ba ho Vouta hore batho ba tle ba tlo ingodisa ba be ba hlahlobe dintlha tsa bona tsa boingodiso.
tgt: Mhla ziyi-10 namhla ziyi-11 kuNdasa, iKhomishana Yokhetho Ezimele (i-IEC) izovula iziKhungo Zokubhalisela Ukuvota ukuze abantu beze bezobhalisa futhi bahlole nemininingwane yabo yokubhaliswa.

src: Kabinete e kopa bakgethi bohle ba tshwanelehileng ho ya diteisheneng tsa bona tsa ho voutela, ho tsoseletsa lenane la bakgethi e le ho hlophisetsa dikgetho tse akaretsang tsa 2019.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyabanxusa bonke abavoti abafanelekile ukuba bavakashele iziteshi zabo zokuvota ukuze bahlole uhlu lwabavoti futhi uma kunesidingo bahlinzeke ngemininingwane yabo yakamuva ngenhloso yokulungiselela ukhetho lukazwelonke lowezi-2019.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso, haholoholo ho ba tla be ba vouta lekgetlo la pele, ho netefatsa hore ba ba le seabo tokelong ya bona ya demokrasi ya molaotheo ya ho vouta, ka ho ya ba ilo ingodisetsa ho vouta.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa ikakhulukazi labo abazobe bevota okokuqala ngqa ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi bayalisebenzisa ilungelo labo lokuvota abalinikezwe wumthethosisekelo, ngokuthi bahambe bayobhalisela ukuvota.

src: Mafelo ana a beke a boingodiso, ke katleho e kgolo mabapi le pheletso ya projeke ya dilemo tse pedi ya ho fumana diaterese tsa bodulo tsa bakgethi bohle ba ingodisitseng.
tgt: Le mpelasonto yokubhalisela ukhetho iyisigameko esisemqoka kakhulu esibheke ekuphothulweni komklamo weminyaka emibili wokuqoqwa kwamakheli asekhaya abo bonke abavoti ababhalisiwe.

src: Diteishene tsa ho voutela di tla bulwa dipakeng tsa 08:00 hoseng le 17:00 mantsiboya ho thusa bakgethi ba qalang hore ba ingodisetse ho vouta, le ho dumella bakgethi ba seng ba ingodisitse ba falletseng dibakeng tse ding hore ba ingodise botjha diterekeng tsa bona tse nepahetseng tsa ho voutela, ba be ba lokise dintlha tsa diaterese tsa bona lenaneng la bakgethi.
tgt: Iziteshi zokuvota zizobe zivuliwe phakathi kwehora le-08:00 kanye nele-17:00 ukuze kulekelelwe labo bazobe bevota okokuqala ngqa ukuba babhalisele ukhetho futhi ukuze labo bavoti abhalisiwe kepha asebethuthile emakhelini abo aphambilini bakwazi ukubhalisa kabusha ezifundeni zokuvota ezifanelekile futhi babhalise namakheli abo amasha ohlwini lwabavoti.

src: Melaetsa.
tgt: Imiyalezo.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa matitjhere ohle a ileng a tlotlwa moketjaneng wa Dikgau tsa bo18 tsa Naha tsa Botitjhere, o neng o le Johannesburg ka Moqebelo wa la 17 Hlakola 2018.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyabancoma futhi liyabahalalisela impela bonke othisha abaklonyeliswe ngezindondo eMcimbini Kazwelonke we-18 Wokuklonyeliswa Kothisha Abavelele obubanjelwe edolobheni laseGoli ngoMgqibelo mhla ziyi-17 kuNhlolanja 2018.

src: Dikgau di ne di ananela botitjhere le boetapele bo tswileng matsoho mekgahlelong e fapaneng, ho akga le Kgau ya Katleho ya Bophelo Bohle ya Nelson Mandela, le Kgau ya Moprofesara Kader Asmal.
tgt: Kulo mcimbi bekuhlonishwa labo abenze umsebenzi omuhle kakhulu kwezokufundisa nakwezobuholi emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, futhi kukhishwe nendondo i-Nelson Mandela Lifetime Achievement Award kanye ne-Professor Kader Asmal Award.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ho Motlatsi wa Letona Obed Bapela ka ho hlokahallwa ke mofumahadi wa hae Constance Bapela, ya neng a sebeletsa naha e le molekgotla nakong ya ho hlokahala ha hae.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lithi akwehlanga lungehlanga kwiPhini likaNgqongqoshe u-Obed Bapela oshonelwe wumkakhe u-Constance Bapela, obesebenzela leli lizwe njengekhansela ngenkathi eficwa wukufa.

src: Kabinete e ikamahanya le Moporesidente Ramaphosa ho fetisetseng matshediso ho ba lelapa, metswalle le bomphato ba moikonomi wa sepolotiki ebile e le mongodi, Moprofesara Johannes “Sampie” Terreblanche, ya hlokahetseng a na le dilemo tse Kabinete e thoholetsa Letona Naledi Pandor ho ananelweng ha hae ke Yunivesithi ya Leiden e Netherlands e le Moeti ya Tlotlwang wa Oort wa Moporofesara wa Astronomi le Ntshetsopele.
tgt: NjengoMongameli Ramaphosa, iKhabhinethi lidlulisa amazwi enduduzo nokuzwelana kwalo nomndeni, abangani kanye nozakwabo basomnotho wezepolitiki futhi obengumbhali, uSlz Johannes “Sampie” Terreblanche, odlule emhlabeni eseneminyaka yobudala engama-.

src: Sena se etswa e le kananelo ya katleho e tswileng matsoho eo Letona le e entseng ka ho tlamahanya saense, haholoholo astronomi, e le sesebediswa bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya lefatshe lohle ebile e le molemong wa setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lithanda ukuhalalisela uNgqongqoshe u-Naledi Pandor ngokuhlonishwa kwakhe yiNyuvesi yase-Leiden kwelase-Netherlands lapho eqokwe khona njengosolwazi oyisivakashi emkhakheni wezomkhathi, isibhakabhaka nezinkanyezi kanye nentuthuko, obizwa nge-Oort Honorary Visiting Professor of Astronomy and Development.

src: DithonyoDithonyo tsohle di emetse netefaletso ya mangolo a thuto esita le topollo e tshwanelehileng.
tgt: Lokhu kuhlonishwa kungumphumela womsebenzi omuhle kakhulu owenziwe nguNgqongqoshe u-Pandor ekuthuthukiseni ezesayensi, ikakhulukazi umkhakha wezomkhathi, isibhakabhaka kanye nezinkanyezi, njengethuluzi lokuthuthukisa umhlaba nokuhlomulisa umphakathi wonkana.

src: Lerato Mataboge e le Motlatsi wa Molaodi e Moholo (DDG): Kgwebisano le Botsetedi Aforika Borwa, Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Diindasteri (dti).
tgt: Nkz Lerato Mataboge oqashwe njengePhini likaMqondisi-Jikelele (u-DDG): Wophiko Lwezohwebo Nokutshalwa Kwezimali LwaseNingizimu Afrika, eMnyangweni Wezohwebo Nezimboni (i-dti).

src: Shandokane Evelyn Masotja e le DDG: Taolo ya tsa Boreki le Dikgwebo tse Kgolo, dti.
tgt: Nkz Shandokane Evelyn Masotja oqashwe njengo-DDG: Wophiko Lwezokuphathwa Kwamakhasimende Nokuqhutshwa Kwemisebenzi Yesikhungo, eMnyangweni Wezohwebo Nezimboni.

src: Vuyelwa Vumendlini e le DDG: Leano la Moruo la Matjhaba le Lebatowa, Lefapha la Matlotlo a Setjhaba.
tgt: Nkz Vuyelwa Vumendlini oqashwe njengo-DDG: Wophiko Lwenqubomgomo Yezomnotho Eqondene Namazwe Esifunda kanye Namazwe Omhlaba Wonke Jikelele, eMnyangweni Wezezimali Kuzwelonke.

src: Joseph Tebogo Leshope e le Mohlanka e Moholo wa tsa Tshebetso wa SENTECMof.
tgt: Mnu Joseph Tebogo Leshope oqashwe njengeNhloko Yokuqhutshwa Kwemisebenzi Yesikhungo (u-COO) we-SENTECNkz Vuyo Zitumane oqashwe njengoMphathi Omkhulu (u-CEO) wesikhungo sezamanzi, i-Amatola Water.

src: Vuyo Zitumane e le Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso (CEO) wa Amatola Water.
tgt: Adv Seeng Catherine Ntsaba-Letele oqashwe njengoMlamuli Omkhulu Wophiko Lwezinhlelo Zokusetshenziswa Komhlaba Ngokuhlanganyela.

src: Moadvokheiti Seeng Catherine Ntsaba-Letele e le Molekodi e Moholo wa Tshebeletso ya Molekodi ya Dikema tsa Setjhaba.
tgt: Mnu Edward Mamadise oqashwe njengo-CEO weHhovisi LikaMlawuli Kazwelonke owengamele umkhakha Wokuhlinzekwa Kwemininingwane-ngcaciso Ephoqelekile.

src: Edward Mamadise e le CEO ya Bolaodi ba Naha ba Ditotobatsuwa tse Tlamang.
tgt: Dkt Sagren Moodley oqokwe njengommeleli ovela ku-DST oyilunga loMkhandlu waseNingizimu Afrika Wezemisebenzi Yobungoti Kumasayensi Emvelo.

src: Ngaka Sagren Moodley e le moemedi wa DST Lekgotleng la Diporofeshene tsa Saense ya Tlhaho la Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Abaqokwe kabusha njengamalungu eBhodi Lokuhlolwa Kwamalungelo Obunikazi Abaqambi Nabasunguli:a. Nkz Shanaaz Tiry Mahomedb.

src: Pehelo ka Kopano ya Kabinete ya la 14 Hlakubele 2018Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, 14 Hlakubele 2018, Tuynhuys, Motse KapaDintlha tsa Maemo a jwale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lahlangana ngoLwesithathu, mhla ziyi-14 kuNdasa 2018, eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Kgolo ya moruo.
tgt: Izindaba Ezisematheni.

src: Kabinete e amohela kgolo ya moruo ya 1.3% ka 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela ukukhula komnotho nge-1.3% ngowezi-2017.

src: Sena ke keketseho ya ho tloha ho 0.3% ka 2016.
tgt: Lokhu kuwukukhula okusuka ku-0.3% ngowezi-2016.

src: Tshebetso ya moruo tlasa maemo a thata e lepa tse ntle bakeng sa menyetla ya kamoso ya moruo wa naha.
tgt: Ukuqhuba kahle komnotho ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima kubeka ikusasa lempumelelo yezwe kwezomnotho esimweni esihle.

src: Manane a kgolo ke letshwao la hore moruo o mathuleng a ho phahama, moo Lefapha la Matlotlo a Naha le lebeletseng hore moruo o hole ka 1.5% selemong sena o be o akofele ho 2.1% ka 2020.
tgt: Izibalo ziveza ukuthi umnotho weli uyakhula, kube uMnyango Wezezimali Kuzwelonke elindele ukuthi umnotho ukhule nge-1.5% kulo nyaka futhi ukhuphukele ku-2.1% ngowezi-2020.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho makala ohle a setjhaba ho ahella hodima mokoka o motle wa 2017, a be a sebetse le mmuso ho lokisa meralo ya ona hore e be kgato e tiileng ya ho tsitlallela kgolo ya moruo le ho thea mesebetsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa zonke izinhlaka zomphakathi ukuthi zakhele phezu kwalo mfutho omuhle wezi-2017, usebenzisane nohulumeni ukuguqula izinhlelo zawo zibe yizinyathelo eziphathekayo ezizoqhubekisa ukhula komnotho futhi kwakheke imisebenzi.

src: Tlhabollo ya Mobu Kabinete e amohela tshisinyo e ananetsweng ya ho hlomathisa Molaotheo wa Riphaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996 bakeng sa ho dumella kamoho ya mobu ntle le ditlhapiso.
tgt: Izinguquko Kwezomhlaba IKhabhinethi lamukela isiphakamiso esamukeliwe okuhloswe ukuchibiyela uMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika we-1996 ngaso ukuze kube nendlela yokubuyiselwa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo.

src: Haesale ho tloha ka 1994 mmuso o sebetsa ka matla ho sotholla masalla a ho nkelwa naha tlasa bokoloniale le mmuso wa kgethollo.
tgt: Kusukela ngowe-1994 uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika usebenze kanzima ukuguqula umlando wokudliwa komhlaba ngaphansi kokuqonelwa ngabezizwe izwe kanye nobandlululo.

src: Mmuso, o sebetsa o itshetlehile ka molao, o se o entse boholo ho netefatsa tlhahiso e tswelang pele ya ditswamobung, ha ka nqa e nngwe o akofisa motjha wa ho lokisa botjha bakeng sa ba anngweng ke ho nkelwa mobu.
tgt: Ngokusebenza ngaphansi komthetho, uhulumeni wenze okuningi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umhlaba uyaqhubeka nokukhiqizaukudla, ube usheshisa inqubo yokubuyisela umhlaba kulabo abathikanyezwa ukuphucwa umhlaba.

src: Taba ena e fetiseditswe ho Komiti ya Tjhebobotjha ya Molaotheo, e tlamehang ho tlalehela Palamente ka la 30 Phato 2018.
tgt: Lolu daba ludluliselwe eKomidini Lokubuyekeza uMthethosisekelo, okumele libuyisele umbiko ePhalamede ngomhla zingama-30 kuNcwaba 2018.

src: Dikgothaletso tse iswang ho Seboka sa Naha di tlasusumetswa ke letoto la dipitso tsa nonyo ya maikutlo a setjhaba tse tla latelwa ke dikopano tsa komiti.
tgt: Izincomo zesiGungu sikaZwelonke zizosuselwa kuchunguchunge lwemihlangano yokuthola imibono yomphakathi okuzolandelwa imihlangano yekomidi.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho bohle ba amehang hore ba tshwaele nakong ya mothati ona wa dipuisano, o tla tataisa ho utollweng ha ditharollo tse tla ntshetsa naha ya habo rona pele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa bonke ababambiqhaza ukuthi baveze izimvo zabo ngenkathi kuqhutshwa le nqubo yokubonisana, okuyizo ezizoba yizinkombandlela zezisombululo ezizoqhubekisa izwe lethu phambili.

src: Re lemmuso o tsotellang o bile o sebetsa le batho, bohle ba amehang ba tla kenyeletswa nakong ya mothati ona.
tgt: Njengohulumeni onakekelayo nogxile kubantu, kuzobonisanwa nabo bonke ababambiqhaza ngenkathi kuqhutshwa le nqubo.

src: Kabinete e boela e kopa setjhaba ho lesa ho inkela mobu ho seng molaong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liqhubeka linxusa umphakathi ukuthi ungazitapeli umhlaba ngendlela engemthetho.

src: Re naha e ikokobeletsang molao ebile e rata kgotso, ka mekgwa e amohelehileng ya ho rarolla diqaka, ho akga le qaka ya mobu.
tgt: Siyilizwe elihlonipha umthetho nelinokuthula elinezindlela ezanele zokubhekana nezinkinga, okubandakanya udaba lomhlaba.

src: Aforika Borwa e dula e butse menyetla bakeng sa kgwebo, mme botsetedi ho tsa temo le bohwai bo amohetswe.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika isaqhubeka nomsebenzi wamabhizinisi, utshalomali kwezolimo lusamukelekile.

src: Ho molemong wa Aforika Borwa hore e be le dihwai tsa kgwebo mme mothati ona o ka netefatsa hore re bile re na le manane a hodimo a dihwai tsa kgwebo tse atlehileng.
tgt: Kuyoyisiza iNingizimu Afrika ukuba nabalimi abaqhuba amabhizinisi ezolimo futhi le nqubo ingaqinisekisa ukuthi sinesibalo esiphezulu sabalimi abaqhuba amabhizinisi ezolimo.

src: Porojeke ya setjhaba sa Nofingxana ya Double Drift Wildlife Economy.
tgt: Umklamo womphakathi waseNofingxana Wezomnotho Wezilwane Zasendle eDouble Drift Nature Reserve.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha Porojeke ya setjhaba sa Nofingxana ya Double Drift Wildlife Economy, Serapeng sa Diphoofolo tse Hlaha sa Double Drift Kapa Botjhabela ke Letona la Merero ya Tikoloho, Ngaka Edna Molewa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela ukwethulwa koMklamo womphakathi waseNofingxana Wezomnotho Wezilwane Zasendle eDouble Drift Nature Reserve eMpumalanga Kapa nguNgqongqoshe Wezemvelo, uDkt.

src: Sena se ne se kenyeleditse ho fana ka lengolo la bonga thepa ho Mokgatlo wa Likhaya Lethu Communal Property (CPA) lebitsong la Letona la Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Mahae le Tlhabollo ya Mobu, Mofumahadi Maite Nkoana-Mashabane.
tgt: Lokhu kubandakanya ukunikezela ngamatayitela eLikhaya Lethu Communal Property Association (i-CPA) egameni likaNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya Nezinguquko Kwezomhlaba, uNksz.

src: Setjhaba sa Double Drift se ne se nkelwe ditokelo tsa bodudi le tsa makgulo ke Molao wa Mobu wa 1913.
tgt: Maite Nkoana-Mashabane.

src: Ka 1994, setjhaba sena se ile sa kenya tseko ya mobu e ileng ya rarollwa ka 2012, moo ho ileng ha thehwa Likhaya Lethu CPLikhaya Lethu CPA e na le ditho tsa Setjhaba sa Double Drift tse 1 500 mme e amohetse R6 milione e tswang Lefapheng la Merero ya Tikoloho, ho ntshetsapele boiteko ba kgwebo ya diphoofolo tse hlaha polasing ya Naudeshoek (1 400 ya dihektara).
tgt: Umphakathi waseDouble Drift waphucwa amalungelo awo okuhlala nokuba namadlelo uMthetho Wezomhlaba we-1913.

src: Selekane se ile sa sebetswa ka Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Mahae le Tlhabollo ya Mobu.
tgt: Ngowe-1994, umphakathi wafaka isicelo sokubuyiselwa umhlaba esaphothulwa, okwaholela ekusungulweni kweLikhaya Lethu CPILikhaya Lethu CPA inamalungu oMphakathi waseDouble Drift oyizi-1 500 futhi lathola izigidi ezithandathu zamarandi kuMnyango Wezemvelo ukuze uthuthukise ibhizinisi lezomnotho Wezilwane Zasendle epulazini iNaudeshoek (elinamahektha ayizi-1 400).

src: Banka ya VBS Mutual.
tgt: Ukukhokha kuqhutshwe uMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya Nezinguquko Kwezomhlaba.

src: Kabinete e nketse hloohong tsebiso ya Banka ya Resefe ya Aforika Borwa mabapi le Banka ya VBS Mutual.
tgt: I-VBS Mutual Bank.

src: Bohlokomedi bo thontsweng bo tla tshehetsa Banka ya VBS Mutual ho busetsa bokgoni ba yona ba maemo a ditjhelete bo be bo sebetsane le ditabatabelo tsa setjhaba esita le ba kwalletseng tjhelete VBKabinete e dula e ikitlaelleditse ho se tshwaneng le ho fetoleng lekala la tsa dtjhelete ntle le ho beha ditabatabelo tsa ba kwallang tjhelete tlokotsing.
tgt: IKhabinethi liyasazi isimemezelo seBhange Lombuso LaseNingizimu Afrika mayelana ne-VBS Mutual Bank.

src: Kabinete e amohela letsholo la ‘CEOs Know’ la Brand South Africa, ka tshebedisano le Boetapele ba Kgwebo ba Aforika Borwa, ho phahamisa Aforika Borwa jwaloka sebaka seo ho ka tsetelwang ho sona.
tgt: Ukuqokwa komphathelimali kuzokweseka i-VBS Mutual Bank ukuze kubhekanwe nezinselele zalo zokuphelelwa imali futhi kubhekelelwe izintshisekelo zomphakathi kanye nabafakimali ku-VBIKhabhinethi isaqhubeka nokuzimisela ngokwenza umkhakha wezimali ubandakanye abantu bezinhlanga ezahlukene futhi ube noguquko ngaphandle kokulimaza abafakimali.

src: Sena se ahella hodima meralo ya rona ya motheo e maemong a hodimo, ka Lebenkele le Rekisang Tsohle la InvestSA, bokgoni ba diphuputso le ntshetsopele, ntlafatso le motheo o tsitsitseng wa tlhahiso ho tshehetsa batsetedi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamuka umkhankaso othi 'CEOs Know' (okusho ukuthi Izikhulu Eziphezulu Ziyazi) oqhutshwa iBrand South Africa, ngokubambisana ne-Business Leadership South Africa (I-BLSA), ukwazisa iNingizimu Afrika njengendawo okungatshalwa imali kuyo.

src: Dibaka tse ntjha tsa kgolo le tsona di butswe moruong wa mawatle, ho eneji e hlwekileng, moruo o sa senyeng tikoloho le ho phopholetsa kgase ya shale.
tgt: Lokhu kwakhaela phezu kwengqalasizinda yethu ekwizinga lomhlaba eyi-InvestSA One-Stop Shop, ucwaningo kanye namakhono okuthuthuka, ukusungula amasu amasha kanye nokukhiqiza osekuzinzile okweseka abatshalimali.

src: Letsholo lena le kenyeletsa Bahlanka ba Baholo ba Phethahatso (di-CEO) ba tswang dikgwebong tsa dinaha tse ngata empa di tsepame kahara Aforika Borwa, tse thakelanang tsebo ya tsona mabapi le botsetedi bo tswelang pele Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Kunezindawo zokukhula ezintsha ezivuliwe emnothweni wasolwandle, amandla avuselelekayo, umnotho ongayilimazi imvelo kanye nokuthungatha i-shale-gas.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa kaofela ka moya wa “Thuma Mina” (Roma Nna) o fokang naha ka bophara hore ba be le seabo sa bona ka ho arolelana dipale tse monate mabapi le ho aha lebitso le letle la naha ya habo rona esita le ho hodisa boipiletso ba yona ba botsetedi.
tgt: Lo mkhankaso uqukethe iziKhulu eziPhezulu (ama-CEO) avela ezinkampanini eziningi zakumazwe ngamazwe, ezizinze eNingizimu Afrika, athula imibono yawo ngokuqhubeka kotshalomali eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Lenaneo la Phumantsho la Bahlahisi ba Motlakase ba Ikemetseng (di-IPP).
tgt: Uhlelo Lokuthenga Lwabakhiqizi Bezamandla Abazimele (ama-IPP).

src: Kabinete e e etse hloko taba ya nyewe ya Lekgotla le Phahameng e hlahletsweng ke mekgatlo e mmedi eo e seng ya mmuso mabapi le qeto ya mmuso ya ho tekena ditumellano tsa theko ya motlakase le di-IPP tse Taba ena e tla phethelwa ke Lekgotla le Phahameng ka la 27 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lazisa icala eliseNkantolo Ephakeme elifakwe izinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni (ama-NGO) ezimbili mayelana nesinqumo sikahulumeni sokusayina izivumelwano zokuthenga ezamandla nama-IPP angama-27.

src: Ka moya wa matla a molaotheo le taelo ya molao, ho tekena ho tjhetjhisitswe.
tgt: Ngomoya wokuhlonipha umthethosisekelo kanye nengalo yomthetho, ukusayina kuhlehlisiwe.

src: Kabinete e tiisa boikitlaetso ba ho rarolla diqaka tse amanang le mananeo ana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liqinisekisa ukuzibophelela ekuxazululeni izinkinga eziqondene nalezi zinhlelo.

src: Lenaneo la Phumantsho la Bahlahisi ba Ikemetseng ba Eneji e Hlwekileng ba Matla a Motlakase, le tla netefatsa hore basebedisi naheng ya rona ba fumantshwa eneji e theko e tlase ebile e le e hlwekileng, mme le tla tlisa matsete a hlokehang haholo kwano Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Uhlelo Lokuthola Umkhiqizi Wamandla Avuselelekayo Ozimele luzoqinisekisa ukuthi abathengi ezweni lethu bathola amandla angambi eqolo nahlanzekile, futhi kukhiqizwe utshalomali oludingeka kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Diporojeke tsena di tla fana ka mesebetsi ya moshwelella e 61 600, moo 95% ya yona e tla ba ya baahi ba Aforika Borwa, ho tsepamisitswe maikutlo haholo ho batjha.
tgt: Le miklamo izohlinzeka ngemisebenzi eyizi-61 600 lapho okuzoqashwa abantu kuyo ngokugcwele, ama-95% ayo azoba ngawezakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi abantu abasebasha.

src: Kabinete e tiisa botjha boikitlaetso ba yona ba selekane se tiileng sa lekala la mmuso le la poraefete ha re ntse re hahamallela mererong ya rona ya kamoso ya diphetoho ho tsa eneji esita le bophelo bo betere bakeng sa bohle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinda liqinisekisa ukuzinikela kwalo ekubambisaneni okukhulu phakathi kukahulumeni nezimboni ezizimele njengoba sibheke ezimpokophelweni zethu zoguquko kwezamandla zakusasa kanye nempilo engcono kubantu bonke.

src: Sena se a hlokahala ho tlisa botsitso bo batlehang haholo ba maano le bolaodi, le ho baballa boemo ba Aforika Borwa jwaloka sebaka se setle se ka kgethelwang botsetedi ho tsa eneji.
tgt: Lokhu kuyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe inqubomgomo nomthethonqubo odingeka kakhulu, futhi kwenziwe iNingizimu Afrika ibe indawo ethandwayo ngabatshalimali bomkhakha wezamandla.

src: Listeriosisi.
tgt: Isifo i-Listeriosis.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona a tswang botebong ba pelo ho metswalle le ba malapa a ba ileng ba hlokahala kamora ho tshwarwa ke Listeriosisi, mme e lakaletsa ba ntseng ba hlaphohelwa hore ba fole ka potlako.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lithi akuhlanga lungehlanga kubangani kanye nemindeni yalabo abadlule emhlabeni ngenxa yokuthola isifo i-Listeriosis, futhi lifisela labo abalashelwa sona ukwelulama okusheshayo.

src: Batho ba fetang 180 ba hlokahetse mme ho tlalehilwe diketsahalo tse 940 Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Bangaphezu kwezi-180 abantu abashonile, kwabikwa nokuthi abantu abangama-940 eNingizimu Afrika bahlaselelwe yilesi sifo.

src: Kabinete e kgothatswa ke matsapa a matla a Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle, Setheo sa Naha sa Mafu a Tshwaetsang (NICD) le Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Bophelo bo Botle (WHO) ho kgina kokwanahloko ya listeria hore e se ke ya jaleha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likhuthazekile ngezinyathelo ezinzulu ezithathwe uMnyango wezeMpilo, iSikhungo Sikazwelonke Sezifo Ezithathelanayo (i-NICD) kanye neNhlangano Yezempilo Yomhlaba (i-WHO) ukunqanda ukusabalala kwegciwane le-listeria.

src: Ho tswela pele ho matlafatsa matsapa ana, Letona la Bophelo bo Botle, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, le tla kopana le Lekgotla la Baoki la Aforika Borwa (SANC) ka Labone, mohla la 15 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: Aaron Motsoaledi, uzoba nomhlangano noMkhandlu Wezabahlengi eNingizimu Afrika (i-SANC) ngoLwesine, mhla ka-15 kuNdasa 2018.

src: Kabinete e ananela kgatelopele e ntle e entsweng mabapi le ho hlwaya le ho kotela sesosa sa ho ropoha ha Listeriosisi ena e bolayang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lazisa inqubekela phambili enhle ebonakele ngokuhlonza nokubalula umthombo wokuqubuka kwesifo esibulalayo i-Listeriosis.

src: Kgato e latetsweng ya ho tloswa ha dihlahiswa tsa dijo tse tswang ditsing tse tharo tsa tshebetso ya nama tsa Enterprise le Rainbow – moo ho kokwanahloko e fumanweng teng – e ne e le nako ya bohlokwa ya ho kgina ho ropoha hona.
tgt: Ukubuyiselwa emuva kwemikhiqizo yokudla yasezikhungweni ezintathu zase-Enterprise naseRainbow ezikhiqiza imikhiqizo yenyama - lapho kwatholakala khona igciwane - kwaba isinyathelo esikhulu esathathelwa ukunqanda ukuqubuka kwalesi sifo.

src: Lefu lena le fumanehang dijong le hlwailwe kgetlo la pele ka Phupjane 2017.
tgt: Lesi sifo esiqubuka ekudleni sahlonzwa okokuqala kuNhlaba 2017.

src: Listeriosisi ke lefu le kotsi empa le ka thibelwang la ba la alafuwa ka katleho ka tshebediso ya diantibayothiki.
tgt: Isifo i-Listeriosis siyisifo esibucayi, esingagwemeka, nesingalashwa ngempumelelo ngama-antibiotics.

src: Ba kotsing ka ho fetisisa ke basadi ba immeng, masea a manyane haholo, metsofe le batho bao masole a bona a mmele a fokolang haholo.
tgt: Abasengcupheni enkulu abantu besifazane abakhulelwe, izinsane ezincane kakhulu, abantu abakhulile kanye nabantu abanamasosha omzimba abuthaka.

src: Batho ba bontshang matshwao a feberu, mesifa e opang, ho nyekelwa ke pelo kapa letshollo ba lokela ho ya ngakeng kapa ditliliniking tse haufi hanghang.
tgt: Abantu ababonakalisa izimpawu zomkhuhlane, ubuhlungu bemisipha, ukuphalaza noma ukuhanjiswa isisu kumele babonane nodokotela babo noma baphuthume emtholampilo oseduzane.

src: Kabinete e na le tshepo ya hore Aforika Borwa e tla hlola ho ropoha ha lefu lena mme e kopa batho bohle ho lemoha melawana e mehlano ya boipaballo dijong nakong ena:Hatlela ka sesepa le metsi pele o tshwara dijo, le kamora ho sebedisa ntlwanaPhehisisa dijo mme o se ke wa ja dijo tse sa butswang kaha kokwanahloko e shwa ha dijo di butswitseO seke wa tshwara dijo tse tala le tse phehilweng mmohoBoloka dijo motjhesong o nepahetseng mmeEtsa bonnete ba hore dihlahiswa tsohle tsa lebese di hlwekile kapa bonnyane di hakonositswe o be o hlatswe dijo tse sa phehwang ka metsi a hlwekileng a phallang pele o di ja, kapa ka metsi a neng a bedisitswe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linethemba lokuthi iNingizimu Afrika izokunqoba lokhu kuqubuka kwesifo futhi linxusa bonke abantu ukuthi balandele imithetho yokudla emihlanu ngalesi sikhathi:Geza izandla ngensipho namanzi ngaphambi kokuphatha ukudla, nalapho uqeda ukusebenzisa indlu yangasesePhekisisa ukudla, ungakudli ukudla okungavuthisiswanga njengoba igciwane i-Listeria lifa uma ukudla kuphekisisiweUngakuphathi ukudla okuluhlaza nokuvuthiwe ngesikhathi esisodwaGcina ukudla emazingeni okushisa afanele futhiQinisekisa ukuthi imikhiqizo yobisi idlulisiwe emlilweni noma okungenani ibilisiwe kancane futhi ugeze ukudla okungaphekwa ngamanzi angahlezi esitsheni ngaphambi kokuthi kudliwe noma okungenani kube amanzi abiliswe kuqala.

src: Ba nang le qeaqeo efe kapa efe e amanang le Listeriosisi, ba ka ikopanya le NICD ho 011 386 Ditjhelete tsa dithuso tsa setjhaba.
tgt: Labo abangenasiqiniseko ngesifo i-Listeriosis bangaxhumana ne-NICD ku: 011 386 Izibonelelo zikahulumeni.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka boemo ba ho ba malalaalaotswe ha Lekala la Aforika Borwa la Polokeho ya Setjhaba (SASSA) ba ho fana ka mmotlolo o kopantsweng habedi wa kabo ya ditjhelete tsa dithuso tsa setjhaba ho bakgolamolemo ka la 1 Mmesa 2018.
tgt: IKhabhinethi laziswe ukuthi Inhlangano Yezimpensheni Nezibonelelo Zikahulumeni eNingizimu Afrika (i-SASSA) seyikulungele ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo oludidiyele lokwaba izibonelelo zikahulumeni kubahlomuli bazo ngomhla ka-1 kuMbasa 2018.

src: Sena se tsamaelana le kahlolo ya Lekgotla la Molaotheo (ConCourt) e laetseng katoloso ya konteraka ya hajwale le Cash Paymaster Services (CPS) ho fihlela ka la 31 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: Lokhu kuhambisana nesahlulelo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo eyakhipha umyalelo wokwelula inkontileka ekhona ye-Cash Paymaster Services (i-CPS) kuze kube umhla ka-31 kuNdasa 2018.

src: Kabinete e thasisetsa boikitlaetso ba yona lenaneong la mmuso la thuso ya tsa kahisano, le tsepameng setsiketsing sa dikgato tsa rona tsa phediso ya bofuma ebile le le bohlokwa pusetsong ya seriti sa batho ba habo rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinda liveza ukuzibophelela kwalo ohlelweni lokusiza umphakathi lukahulumeni, okungumongo wezinhlelo zethu zokuqeda ububha futhi ezingumnyombo wokubuyisela isithunzi sabantu bakithi.

src: Kabinete e kgotsofetse ka hore bakgolamolemo ba dithuso tsa ditjhelete tsa setjhaba ba tla lefuwa ka la 1 Mmesa 2018.Dikarete tsa hajwale tsa SASSA di tla dula di sebetsa ho fihlela ka Tshitwe 2018.
tgt: Lanelisekile ukuthi abahlomuli bezibonelelo zikahulumeni bazokhokhelwa mhla ka-1 kuMbasa 2018.Amakhadi e-SASSA amanje azoqhubeka nokusebenza kuze kube kuZibandlela 2018.

src: Mothati wa ho fetola dikarete tsa bakgolamolemo o tla etswa ka mokgwa o sa belaetseng ebile e le o sa tlo sitisa ho lefuwa ha ditjhelete tsa dithuso.
tgt: Inqubo yokushintsha amakhadi abahlomuli izokwenziwa ngendlela engenaphutha engezukuphazamisa ukukhokhwa kwezibonelelo.

src: Bakgolamolemo bohle ba tla fumana ditjhelete tsa bona tsa dithuso tsa mmuso ka makala a bona a ditefo a akgang dibanka, Posong ya Aforika Borwa (SAPO) le mabenkeleng a mang.
tgt: Bonke abahlomuli bazothola izibonelelo ezindaweni abakhokhelwa kuzo okubandakanya amabhange, iPosi laseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPO) kanye nezinye izitolo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho ba se nang diakhaonte tsa banka ho leba makaleng a haufi le bona a Poso hore ba ilo bula diakhaonte.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa labo abangenawo ama-akhawunti asebhange ukuthi baye kovula ama-akhawunti abo emaposini aseduze nabo.

src: Kabinete e laetse SASSA, mmoho le Tsamaiso ya Dikgokahanyo le Tlhahisoleseding ya Mmuso (GCIS), ho etsa ka hohle kamoo e ka kgonang ka teng ho tsebisa bakgolamolemo bohle ka diphetoho dife kapa dife tse ka bang teng motjheng wa diphetoho tsa ho tloha ho CPS ho ya mmotlolong o motjha o kopantsweng habedi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyalele i-SASSA, ngokuhlanganyela noPhiko Lukahulumeni Lwezokuxhumana Nokudluliswa Kolwazi (i-GCIS), luzokwenza konke okusemandleni ukwazisa bonke abahlomuli nganoma oluphi ushintsho olungase lube khona enqubweni yoguquko kusukwa ku-CPS kuya ohlelweni oludidiyele olusha.

src: Kabinete e dula e ikitlaelleditse ho netefatsa hore mmuso o ikokobeletsa kahlolo ya ConCourt.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lisazimisele ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni ulandela isahlulelo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo.
