src: Dikantoro tsa SASSA di tla bulwa mme di tla be di le malala-a-laotswe ho sebetsana le dikopo tse ntjha.
tgt: Amahhovisi e-SASSA azovulwa futhi alungele inqubo entsha yezicelo ezintsha.

src: Kabinete e kopa setjhaba sohle, haholoholo bakgolamolemo le ba malapa a bona, ho ikopanya le SASSA ho 0800 60 10 11 kapa ho etela kantoro e haufi ya SASSA, ha o batla ho tseba haholwanyane.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa wonke amalungu omphakathi, ikakhulukazi abahlomuli kanye nemindeni yabo, ukuthi baxhumane ne-SASSA ku-0800 60 10 11 noma baye emahhovisi e-SASSA aseduze nabo ukuze bathole ulwazi oluthe xaxa.

src: Boingodiso ba bakgethi.
tgt: Ukubhaliswa kwabavoti.

src: Kabinete e ikamahanya le Khomishene e Ikemetseng ya Dikgetho (IEC) le Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa ho leboheng maAforika Borwa ohle a arabetseng kgoeletso ya ho ingodisetsa dikgetho kapa ho lokisa dintlha tsa diaterese tsa bona letsholong la bekeng e fetileng la boingodiso ba bakgethi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihlanganyela neKhomishana Yokhetho Ezimele (IEC) noMongameli uCyril Ramaphosa ngokubonga abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abalalele isimemezelo sokubhalisela ukuvota nokubhalisa amakheli abo amasha ngempelasonto edlule emkhankasweni wokubhalisela ukuvota.

src: Sena ke mokolokotwane mabapi le boitokisetso ba dikgetho tsa botshelela tsa naha le tsa diporofense tse lebeletsweng ho tshwarwa ka 2019.
tgt: Lokhu kuyisinyathelo sokulungiselela ukhetho lukazwelonke nolwezifundazwe lwesithupha okulindeleke ukuthi lubanjwe ngowezi- 2019.

src: Palo yohle ya baahi ba 2 767 139 e etetse diteishene tsa ho voutela mafelong a fetileng a beke.
tgt: Sezizonke izakhamizi eziye ezikhungweni zokuvota ngempelasonto edlule ziyizi-2 767 139.

src: Ho bakgethi ba fetang 2.76 milione ba etetseng diteishene tsa bona tsa ho voutela:Ba kahodimonyana ho milione ba ingodisitse botjha diterekeng tsa bona tse ntjha tsa ho voutelaBa kahodimo ho 800 000 ba fetoletse boingodiso ba bona diterekeng tse ntjha tsa ho voutelaBa ka bang 500 000 e ne e le bakgethi ba ingodisang lekgetlo la peleBoingodisong bo botjha ba bakgethi, 82% ya bona e ne e le ka tlasa dilemo tse 30 mme ba ka etsang 54% e ne e le basadiGauteng ke yona e neng e na le boingodiso bo botjha bo bongata ka ho fetisisa ka 23.69%, ha latela KwaZulu-Natal ka 18.78% le Limpopo ka 17.03%.
tgt: Ebantwini abavotayo abangaphezu kwezigidi ezingu-2.76 abaye ezikhungweni zokuvota: Bangaphezu kwesigidi esi-1.3 ababhalise kabusha esifundeni sokuvota asebehlala kuso Abangaphezu kwezi-800 000 bashintshele ezifundeni ezintsha zokuvota Cishe bayizi-500 000 abantu ababhalisele ukuvota okokuqala Ebantwini ababhalisele ukuvota okokuqala, ama-82% baneminyaka yobudala engaphansi kwengama-30 futhi balinganiselwa kuma-54% abangabantu besifazane EGauteng kube nabantu ababhalisele ukuvota okokuqala abangama-23.69%, kwalandela iKwaZulu-Natali ngama-18.78% kanye neLimpopo ngama-17.02%.

src: Kapa Botjhabela e bile le boemo bo phahameng ba boingodiso ka 87%, ha latela Freistata hanyane ka hodima 82%, le KwaZulu-Natal, Limpopo le Kapa Leboya ka 79% ka tatelano.
tgt: EMpumalanga Kapa ibinabona bantu baningi babhalisele ukuvota abangama-87%, kwalandela iFree State ngokungaphezudlwana kwabantu abangama-82%, neKwaZulu-Natali, iLimpopo neNyakatho Kapa ngokwahlukana kwazo ngama-79%.

src: Bongodiso ka kakaretso ba Gauteng e ne e le 67.3%.
tgt: Isibalo sabantu ababhalisele ukuvota bebonke eGauteng kube ama-67.3%.

src: IEC e tlalehile hore jwale lenane la bakgethi le na le bakgethi ba 26 250 939, e leng se ka lekanang le 75% ya batho ba nang le tokelo ya ho kgetha, ho itshetlehilwe hodima dikgakanyong tsa Lefapha la Dipalopalo la Aforika Borwa (StatsSA) tsa dilemo tsa baahi.
tgt: I-IEC ibike ukuthi uhlu lwabavoti manje selunabavoti abayizi-26 250 939, okucishe kulingane nama-75% abantu abalungele ukuvota ngokusemthethweni, ngokususela ezibalweni zesikhungo Sezezibalo eNingizimu Afrika (i-Stats SA) zabantu abavumelekile ukuvota ngokweminyaka yabo yobudala.

src: Baahi ba ka bang 300 000 ba etetseng diteishene tsa ho voutela, ba hara bakgethi ba ka fihlang ho milione bao IEC e neng e se na diaterese tsa bona pele ho mafelo ao a beke ya boingodiso.
tgt: Cishe izakhamuzi eziyizi-300 000 eziye ezikhungweni zokuvota ziphakathi kwabavoti abacishe babe izigidi ezingu-2.8 i-IEC ebingenawo amakheli wabo ngempelasonto.

src: Lenane la bakgethi le lokisitsweng ebile e le le nepahetseng le tiisa tshepahalo ya lenane la bakgethi mme le matlafatsa demokerasi ya rona ka ho netefatsa dikgetho tse lokolohileng, tse hlokang leeme ebile e le tse tshepahalang.
tgt: Uhlu lwabavoti olubukeziwe noluyilonalona luqinisekisa ubuqiniso bohlu lwabavoti futhi luqinisa intando yeningi labantu yethu ngokuqinisekisa ukhetho olukhululelekile, olunobulungiswa nolukholakalayo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ohle a sa kgonang ho etela diteishene tsa ona tsa ho voutela mafelong a fetileng a beke, ho etela kantoro e haufi ya IEC ho ya netefatsa esita le ho lokisa diaterese tsa ona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abangakwazanga ukuya ezikhungweni zokuvota ngempelasonto edlule ukuthi baye emahhovisi e-IEC angakubo ukuyoqinisekisa nokubukeza amakheli abo.

src: Ka nqa e nngwe, sesebedisuwa sa IEC sa inthanete ho WEBTOKEN le app ya yona, di dula di fumaneha ka dihora tse 24 ka letsatsi bakeng sa bakgethi ba ingodisitseng ho lekola le ho lokisa dintlha tsa diaterese tsa bona.
tgt: Kungenjalo abavoti ababhalisile mabavakashele isizindalwazi se-IEC WEBTOKEN babheke futhi babukeze imininingwane yabo.

src: Ditakaletso tse ntle ho moatlelete Mhlengi Gwala.
tgt: Sifisela umsubathi uMhlengi Gwala ukuthi abe ngcono.

src: Kabinete e ikamahanya le Letona la Dipapadi le Boithapollo, Mofumahadi Thokozile Xasa, mabapi le ho tshwela ka mathe ketso ya bosoto ya tlhaselo kgahlanong le moatlelete ya motjha dilemong, Mhlengi Gwala, ya hlasetsweng ka sakga ya difate ha a ntse a palame baesekele KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nalo njengoNgqongqoshe Wezemidlalo Nezokungcebeleka, uNksz.

src: Kabinete e lakaletsa moatlelete enwa hore a fole ka potlako mme e fetisetsa diteboho tse mofuthu ho moifo wa bongaka wa Sepetlele sa St Augustine o ntseng o mo hlokometse.
tgt: Thokozile Xasa, ligxeka udlame olunyantisayo oluye lwabhekiswa kumsubathi osemncane, uMhlengi Gwala, ohlaselwe ngesaha ebe eqhuba ibhayisikili KwaZulu-Natali.

src: Ditlolo tsa molao ha di na sebaka setjhabeng sa habo rona mme Kabinete e ipiletsa ho badudi ho sebetsa mmoho le makala a qobello ya molao hore ho tshwarwe batlodi ba molao.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lifisela lo msubathi ukwelulama ngokushesha futhi lidlulisa ukubonga okukhulu ethimbeni labodokotela laseSibhelela i-St. Augustine ngokumunakekela.

src: Komello e tsebahatswa e le koduwa ya naha.
tgt: Ubugebengu abavumelekile ezweni lethu futhi iKhabhinethi linxusa umphakathi ukuthi usebenzisane nezikhungo eziphoqelela umthetho ukuze lezi zigebengu zibhekane nengalo yomthetho.

src: Tlasa boetapele ba Letona la Kopanelo ya Mmuso le Merero ya Botjhaba Zweli Mkhize, mmuso o tsebahaditse boemo ba naha ba koduwa ho sebetsana le bothata ba naha ba komello le metsi.
tgt: Isomiso esimenyezelwe njengenhlekelele ezweni.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa kananelo ya yona ho bao ba tswelang pele ho boloka metsi ka hara Aforika Borwa, esita le matsapa a sa sisinyeheng a entsweng ke Komiti ya Matona a Kopaneng e mabapi le Komello, hammoho le ba amehang makaleng ohle a mmuso le a setjhaba, mabapi le ho sebetsana le maemo a sa sutheng a komello a thefutseng dikarolo tse ngatanyana tsa naha.
tgt: Ngaphansi kobuholi bukaNgqongqoshe Wokwengamela Ngokubambisana Nezendabuko uZweli Mkhize, uhulumeni umemezele ukuthi izwe libhekene nenhlekelele ukuze kubhekanwe nesomiso ezweni kanye nenkinga yokutholakala kwamanzi.

src: Ntle le taba ya hore Aforika Borwa ke naha e haellwang ke metsi, Kabinete e kgodisehile hore re dula re ntse re le sebaka se ratwang ke bahahlaudi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lidlulisa ukubonga labo abaseNingizimu Afrika abaqhubeka nokulondoloza amanzi kanye nemizamo enzulu eseyenziwe iKomidi LoNgqongqoshe Elihlanganisile ngeSomiso, ngokuhlanganyela nababambiqhaza kuzo zonke izinhlaka zikahulumeni nasemphakathini, ekubhekaneni nezimo zesomiso esezishaye izingxenye eziningi zezwe.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Sehlomathisetso sa 1 se Hlomathisang Tumellano (Tshebedisano Botseteding) ya Porothokhole ya tsa Ditjhelete le Botsetedi (FIP) ya Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tsa Aforika e ka Borwa (SADC) e tekwe Palamenteng bakeng sa kananelo.
tgt: Ngaphandle kokuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyizwe eliswele amanzi, iKhabhinethi linesiqiniseko sokuthi sizoqhubeka nokuba indawo ethandwa izivakashi.

src: Sepheo sa FIP ke ho ntlafatsa maano a tsa ditjhelete le botsetedi a Dinaha tseo e leng Ditho, hore di tsamaisane le merero ya SADSena se tla netefatsa hore diphetoho dife kapa dife maanong a tsa ditjhelete le botsetedi Naheng e le nngwe eo e leng Setho ha di tlise diphetoho tse sa batleheng ho Dinaha tse ding tseo e leng Ditho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukuthi Isivumelwano Sokuchibiyela Isithasiselo 1 (Ukubambisana Kwezotshalomali) sesiVumelwano Sezezimali Notshalomali (i-FIP) seNhlangano yokuThuthukisa Amazwe aseNingizimu ne-Afrika (i-SADC) sethulwe ePhalamende ukuze silungiswe.

src: Dihlomathiso tsena di habile ho baballa tokelo ya mebuso ya ho laola dintho molemong wa setjhaba, esita le ho tsitsisa ditokelo le ditshwanelo tsa batsetedi le mebuso.
tgt: Inhloso ye-FIP ukwenza izinqubomgomo zezezimali notshalomali zaMazwe Ayimalungu zihambisane, ukuze zihambisane nezimpokophelo ze-SADLokhu kuzoqinisekisa noma oluphi ushintsho kuzinqubomgomo zezimali nezotshalomali kwelinye Lwamazwe Ayimalungu akubizi ukuthi kube nokuchitshiyelwa okungafanalele kwamanye Amazwe Ayimalungu.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tekwa ha Melawana e Boemong bo Tlase e Shebilweng Botjha ya ba ya Rehwa Botjha ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) bakeng sa Tshwaro e Ntle ya Batshwaruwa (“Melawana ya Nelson Mandela”), Palamenteng.
tgt: Inhloso yezichibiyelo ukuvikela ilungelo likahulumeni lokulawula intshisekelo yomphakathi, nokulinganisa amalungelo nezibopho zabatshalimali nohulumeni.

src: Ho rehwa botjha ha Melawana ya Boemo bo Tlase ya “Melawana ya Nelson Mandela” ho tlotla lefa la Moporesidente wa rona wa mehleng, ya qetileng dilemo tse 27 tjhankaneng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukwethulwa ePhalamende kweMithetho Ewumgomo Okungeqiwe Ngaphansi Kwawo Wokwelashwa Kwezigebengu Ebukeziwe Neqanjwe Kabusha Inhlangano Yezizwe (i-UN) ("Imithetho kaNelson Mandela").

src: Ho boetse ho bile le katoloso ya lefatshe ka bophara ya lepatlelo la Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Nelson Mandela, le hlomphuwang ke Dinaha tseo e leng Ditho tsa UN, ka la 18 Phupu, ho phahamisa maemo a botho a botshwaruwa, ho matlafatsa tlhokomediso mabapi le batshwaruwa hore ke karolo ya setjhaba esita le ho tlotla mosebetsi wa basebeletsi ba ditjhankana e le tshebeletso ya kahisano.
tgt: Ukuqanjwa kabushwa kweMithetho Ewumgomo Okungeqiwe Ngaphansi Kwawo "Imithetho kaNelson Mandela" kuhlonipha imisebenzi nomlando waloyo owayenguMongameli wethu ngaphambilini, owachitha iminyaka engama-27 ejele.

src: Melawana ena e tla thusa Aforika Borwa ho akofisa diphetoho tse mabapi le tsamaiso ya batho ya ntshetsopele ya tshokollo ya batshwaruwa e tsamaisanang le dipehelo le ditataiso tse fapafapaneng tsa matjhaba.
tgt: Kuye kwaba nokwengezelwa okukhulu kohlelo Losuku Lomhlaba Wonke LukaNelson Mandela, oluhlonishwa Amazwe Angamalungu e-UN ngomhla ziyi-18 kuNtulikazi, ukukhuthaza izindlela zokuphathwa ngobuntu ejele, ukuqwashisa ngokuthi iziboshwa ziyimalungu omphakathi futhi kuhlonishwe umsebenzi owenziwa abasebenzi basemajele njengomsebenzi wenhlalakahle yomphakathi.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Bili ya Thibelo le Twantsho ya Ditlolo tsa Molao tsa Lehloyo le Puo ya Lehloyo ya 2018 hore e tekwe Palamenteng.
tgt: Imithetho izosiza iNingizimu Afrika isheshise uguquko olubhekiswe ohlelweni lokuhlomelelisa izimilo oluthuthukisa abantu oluhambisana nemigomo nemihlahlandlela yomhlaba wonke enhlobonhlobo.

src: Bili e habile ho bopa ditlolo tsa molao tsa lehloyo le puo ya lehloyo, esita le ho kenya tshebetsong mekgwa ya ho thibela le ho lwantsha ditlolo tsena tsa molao.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukwethulwa koMthethosivivinyo Wokuvikela Nokunqanda Amacala Enzondo kanye Nenkulumo Enenzondo wezi-2018 ePhalamende.

src: E rerile ho sebetsana le dikgoka kgahlanong le batho ka lebaka la kgethollo.
tgt: UMthethosivivinyo uhlose ukwenza amacala enzondo kanye nenkulumo enenzondo ukuthi kube amacala, futhi kubekwe izindlela zokuvikela nokunqanda lawa macala.

src: E tla boela e fana ka tshusumetso ditshwanelong tsa Aforika Borwa ho ya ka disebedisuwa tsa matjhaba tsa ditokelo tsa botho.
tgt: Uhlose ukubhekana nodlame oluqondiswe kubantu ngenxa yokucindezelwa.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Bili ya Setheo sa Naha sa Boitsebelo ba Inthanete sa iKamva (iNeSI) ya 2018 hore e kenngwe Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze uMthethosivivinyo iKamva e-Skills Institute (i-NeSI) wezi-2018 ozokwethulwa ePhalamende.

src: Bili e fana ka ho thehwa ha iNeSI jwaloka setheo se molaong se nang le boetsamolao boo e leng ba sona ho sebetsana le diphephetso tsa bokgoni ba boitsebelo ba inthanete (boitsebelo ba dijithale) ka hara naha.
tgt: UMthethosivivinyo uhlinzekela ukusungulwa kwe-NeSI njengebhizinisi elisemthethweni elinomthetho walo wokubhekana nezinselele zamakhono namakhono ezobuchwepheshe ezweni.

src: Ntshetsopele ya bokgoni ba boitsebelo ba inthanete e nkuwa e le e nngwe ya dintlha tse ka sehloohong tsa mmuso mabapi le ho aha moruo o kenyeletsang bohle, esita le ho thea naha e nang le bokgoni ebile e le e tswelang pele.
tgt: Ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono ezobuchwepheshe njengoba kubonakala kuyingxenye kahulumeni ebaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni umnotho obandakanyayo, nokusungula izwe elinamakhono nelithuthukayo.

src: INeSI e tla sebetsa jwaloka sethusi sa tshebedisano le diphetoho, bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya boitsebelo ba dijithale le bokgoni ba ditlhophiso ka hara naha.
tgt: I-NeSI izosebenza njengombambiqhaza obalulekile kuzwelonke kanye nanjengesikhungo sikahulumeni esihola ushintsho, kwezokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono ezobuchwepheshe nokuba namakhono kwezinhlangano ezweni.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Bili ya Dibopeho tsa Metsing ya 2018 hore e lelekelwe Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukwethulwa koMthethosivivinyo we-Hydrographic wezi-2018 ePhalamende.

src: Bili e habile ho ananela le ho fana ka maemo a ketsamolao Kantorong ya Setsebi sa Dibopeho tsa Metsing, eo esale e le teng ka hara Lefapha la Lebotho la Tshireletso (Lebotho la Lewatleng la Aforika Borwa) haesale ho tloha tshimolohong ya ditshebeletso tsa dibopeho tsa metsing ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: UMthethosivivinyo uhlose ukwazisa nokugunyaza isimo sezomthetho eHhovisi le-Hydrographer, ebelilokhu likhona ngaphansi koMnyango Wezokuvikela (Umbutho Wezokuvikela Wasolwandle waseNingizimu Afrika) kusukela kwaqaliswa imisebenzi ye-hydrographic eNingizimu Afrika.

src: E tla thusa Setsebi sa Dibopeho tsa Metsing sa Lebotho la Lewatleng la Aforika Borwa ho ananelwa jwaloka Setsebi sa Naha sa Dibopeho tsa Metsing.
tgt: Uzosiza i-Hydrographer Yombutho Wezokuvikela Wasolwandle waseNingizimu Afrika yaziswe njenge-Hydrographer Kazwelonke.

src: E tla netefatsa hore phano ya ditshebeletso tsa dibopeho tsa metsing e ba ya semmuso mme e bopellwa ka hara molao.
tgt: Izoqinisekisa ukuthi ukuhlinzekwa kwemisebenzi ye-hydrographic yaziswa ngokugcwele futhi yenziwe ibe umthetho.

src: Sena se tsamaelana le Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Mawatle le Mmoka wa Matjhaba ya Polokeho ya Bophelo Mawatleng, e leng tumellano ya matjhaba ya tsa mawatleng e beang maemo a tlase a polokeho mabapi le kaho, thepa le tshebetso ya dikepe tsa kgwebo.
tgt: Lokhu kuhambisana neNhlangano Yezasemanzini Yomhlaba Wonke (i-IMO) kanye Nezivumelwano Zomhlaba Wonke Zokuphepha Kokuphilayo Olwandle, okuyisivumelwano sezasolwandle somhlaba uwonke esimisa imigomo yezokuphepha okungeqiwe ngaphansi kwayo kwezokwakha, ezempahla kanye nokusebenza kwemikhumbi yempahla.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Imicimbi Ezayo.

src: Kgwedi/Letsatsi la Ditokelo tsa BothoMekete ya sehopotso sa Kgwedi/Letsatsi la Naha la 2018 la Ditokelo tsa Botho e tla tshwarwa tlasa mokotaba o reng: “Selemo sa Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela: ho phahamisa le ho tebisa tlwaelo ya ditokelo tsa botho setjhabeng ka bophara”.Ketsahalo ena ya naha e tla tshwarwa ka la 21 Hlakubele 2018 Lebaleng la Kirikete la George Thabe, Sharpeville ho la Vereeniging.
tgt: Inyanga/Usuku Lwamalungelo EsintuNgowezi-2018 imibungazo yeNyanga/yoSuku LwamaLungelo Esintu izoqhutshwa ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: "Unyaka kaNelson Rolihlahla Mandela: ukukhuthaza nokugxilisa usiko lwamalungelo esintu emphakathini uwonkana".Umcimbi kazwelonke uzobanjwa mhla zingama-21 kuNdasa eGeorge Thabe Cricket Pitch, eSharpeville eVereeniging.

src: Kabinete e kopa makala ohle ho hlompha letsatsi lena la Naha, le ketekang setso sa ditokelo tsa botho sa Aforika Borwa esita le ho tlotla batho ba kang Madiba ya ileng a intsha sehlabelo molemong wa phihlello ya topollo le tokoloho tseo re nang le tsona kajeno.
tgt: IKhabinethi linxusa yonke imikhakha ukuthi uluhloniphe lolu suku lukazwelonke, olubungaza usiko lwamalungelo esintu eNingizimu Afrika, kuhlonishwa abantu abanjengoMadiba obahlupheka bazinikela ukuze sikhululeke futhi sithole nenkululeko esiyithokozela namuhla.

src: Beke ya Naha ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo ya ImbizoBeke ya Naha ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo ya Imbizo e tla ba ho tloha ka la 9 ho isa ho la 15 Mmesa 2018 tlasa mokotaba o reng: “Re le mmoho re Ntshetsa Aforika Borwa Pele”.
tgt: Isonto Lokugxila Embizweni KuzwelonkeIsonto Lokugxila Embizweni Kuzwelonke lizoqala ngomhla ziyi-9 kuya ziyi-15 kuMbasa ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: "Sisonke siqhubekisela iNingizimu Afrika phambili".

src: Monongwaha, Mokete wa Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Mandela o bopa karolo e kgolo ya beke ya tsepamiso ya maikutlo, tlasa mookotaba o monyane o reng: “E ba karolo ya lefa”.
tgt: Kulo nyaka, imibungazo yeMinyaka Eyikhulu kaMandela izoba ingxenye enkulu yaleli sonto, ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: "Philela ukuqopha umlando".

src: Ba Phethahatso ba tla buisana le setjhaba dikarolong tse fapaneng tsa naha.
tgt: Izikhulu zikahulumeni zizobonisana nemiphakathi ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene ezweni.

src: Mananeo a latelanang a Matona a tla tsebahatswa ha mmila o ntse o puta.
tgt: Izinhlelo ezahlukene zoNgqongqoshe zizomenyezelwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.

src: Kgiro ya Batjha Moporesidente Ramaphosa o lebeletswe ho thakgola bopulamadiboho ba kgato ya Ditshebeletso tsa Kgiro ya Batjha Setsing sa Thuthuhiso ya Dikgwebo sa Riversands ho la Diepsloot ka la 27 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: Ukuqashwa kwabantu abasebasha UMongameli Ramaphosa kulindeleke ukuthi ethule uhlelo lokuzwa amanzi ngobhokwe Lwemisebenzi Yokuqashwa Kwabantu Abasebasha eRiversands Incubation Hub eDiepsloot ngowezi-27 kuNdasa 2018.

src: Kgato ena, ka tshebedisano le lekala la poraefete, e habile ho matlafatsa batjha ba milione dilemong tse hlano tse tlang hore ba kene kgabong ya moruo, mohlomong e le ditho tsa setlamo sa basebetsi kapa ba itsamaisetsa dikgwebo tseo e leng tsa bona kapa ba iphumanele tjantjello ya seo ba ratang ho ntshetsa dithuto tsa bona pele ka sona.
tgt: Lolu hlelo, lothulwe ngokusebenzisana nomkhakha ozimele, luhlose ukuthuthukisa abantu abasebasha abayisigidi eminyakeni emihlanu ezayo ukuze babambe iqhaza kwezomnotho, njengabasebenzi noma ngokuqhuba amabhizinisi abo noma ngokubonakalisa uthando lokuqhubeka nokufunda.

src: Maeto a tshebetso ho ya Mozambique le ZimbabweMoporesidente Ramaphosa o tla nka maeto a tshebetso ho ya Riphaboliking ya Mozambique le Riphaboliking ya Zimbabwe ka tatelano, ka Moqebelo wa la 17 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: Uhambo olusemthethweni oluya eMozambique naseZimbabweUMongameli Ramaphosa uzoba nohambo olusemthethweni oluya eRiphabhulikhi yaseMozambique naseRiphabhulikhi yaseZimbabwe ngoMgqibelo, mhla ziyi-17 kuNdasa 2018.

src: Maeto ana a tla tsepamisa maikutlo matlafatsang ya dikamano tsa dinahapedi le dinaha tse qollotsweng ka hodimo mona.
tgt: Lolu hambo luzogxila ekuqiniseni ubudlelwano nala mazwe abalwe ngenhla.

src: Moporesidente o tla boela a thaka maikutlo ka dintho tse amanang kgotso le polokeho ka hara lebatowa esita le kontinenteng, a boele a tshohle ka dintlha tsa lefatshe tse molemong wa dinaha tsena.
tgt: UMongameli uzobamba izingxoxo ngezokuthula nezokuphepha esifundeni nasezwenikazi, aphinde akhulume ngezindaba zomhlaba jikelele ezithinta la mazwe.

src: Melaetsa.
tgt: Imiyalezo.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Ntsiki Biyela, Mosadi wa pele wa motho e motsho wa Aforika Borwa wa serathodi sa veine ya thakgotseng veine ya letshwao la hae la boitsebahatso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisela uNtsiki Biyela, umuntu wesifazane omnyama wokuqala owakha iwayini eNingizimu Afrika ngokwethula olwakhe uhlobo lewayini.

src: Jwalokaha a na le lengolo la kgerata ya tsebo ya thitelo ya veine la Yunivesithing ya Stellenbosch hammoho le malebela a dilemo tse 13 a sebetsa, ka 2018 Diveini tsa hae tsa Aslina di tla rekisa dibotlolo tse 12 000 Dinaheng tse Kopaneng tsa Amerika, Jeremane, Taiwan le Ghana.
tgt: Njengoba eneziqu ze-Veticulture yaseNyuvesi yaseStellenbosch kanye nesipiliyoni somsebenzi seminyaka eyi-13, i-Aslina Wines yakhe izothengisangamabhodlela ayizi-12 000 ngowezi-2018 e-United States of America, eGermany, eTaiwan naseGhana.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Caster Semenya ka ho roba rekoto ya Aforika Borwa ya 1 000m ya dilemo tse 35 mabelong a Athletix Grand Prix a neng a tshwaretswe Tuks ho la Pretoria.
tgt: IKhabinethi lihalalisela uCaster Semenye ngokwephula irekhodi laseNingizimu Afrika lamamitha ayizi-1000 ebeselime iminyaka engama-35 emhlanganweni we-Athletix Grand Prix eTuks ePitoli.

src: Thope ya rona ya pabala e hapile lebelo leo ka nako ya 2:35:44, a hlola rekoto ya kgale ya 1983 ya Ilze Wicksell ka metsotswana e ka bang e mmedi.
tgt: Intokazi yethu esiziqhenyayo ngayo idle umhlanganiso emjahweni esikhathini esingu-2:35:44, yaphula irekhodi elidala elamiswa ngowe-1983 ngu-Ilze Wicksell ngesikhathi esilinganiselwa kumizuzwana embili.

src: Kabinete e boela e thoholetsa Semenya ka ho fihlella peelo ya hae ya nako e telele ya ho fumana mangolo a thuto a yunivesithi, ha a ne a phethela lengolo la hae la Diploma ho tsa Saense ya Dipapadi Yunivesithing ya Leboya Bophirima ho la Potchefstroom.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde lancoma uSemenya ngokufinyelela emgomweni wakhe okudala azibekela wona wokuthola iziqu zasenyuvesi ngenkathi eqeda iziqu zakhe ze-Diploma in Sports Science eNyuvesi yaseNyakatho Ntshonalanga ePotchefstroom.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ho metswalle le ba lelapa ba Setho se Hlomphehang sa Palamente, Mofumahadi Loliwe Fazeka, ya hlokahaletseng kotsing ya koloi Kapa Botjhabela, bekeng e fetileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lidlulise amazwi okuzwelana nabangani kanye nomndeni weLungu Elihloniphekile lePhalamende, uNksz.

src: Kabinete e boela e fetisa matshediso a yona ho baratuwa ba Lenqosa la Aforika Borwa naheng ya Sweden, Mofumahadi Faith Radebe, ya hlokahetseng ka Labobedi, mohla la 13 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: Loliwe Fazeka, oshone engozini yemoto eMpumalanga Kapa, ngesonto eledlule.

src: Pele ho moo e ne e le Mohlahlobi-Kakaretso wa Mautlwela Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lidlulisa amazwi enduduzo emndenini weNxusa laseNingizimu Afrika ebeliseSweden, uNksz.

src: DithonyoDithonyo tsohle di emetse ho netefatswa ka mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang ya tlhathlobisiso.
tgt: AbaqashiweUkuqashwa kwabo bonke abalandelayo kuzokwamukelwa ngokusemthethweni kuphela uma sekuqinisekiswe ubufakazi beziqu zabo zemfundo futhi uma sebenikezwe izimvume ezifanelekile.

src: Ngaka Philemon Mjwara e le Motsamaisi-Kakaretso wa Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji bakeng sa konteraka e ekeditsweng ya dilemo tse tharo, ho tloha ka la 1 Mmesa Mofumahadi Memme Sejosengwe e le Mongodi-Kakaretso Kantorong ya Moahlodi e Moholo bakeng sa konteraka e ekeditsweng ya dilemo tse tharo, ho tloha ka la 1 Mmesa Mofumahadi Thuli E Radebe, e le Motsamaisi wa Phethahatso Setsing sa Ntlafatso ya Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba bakeng sa konteraka e ekeditsweng ya dikgwedi tse tsheletseng.
tgt: Philemon Mjwara njengoMqondisi Jikelele woMnyango Wezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe ngaphansi kwenkontileka yeminyaka emithathu, kusukela mhla lu-1 kuMbasa Nksz.

src: Monghadi Thilivhali Archibald Ramawa jwaloka Mohlanka e Moholo wa tsa Ditjhelete wa Setheo sa Naha sa Mehlodi ya Ditaba tsa Elektroniki sa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Memme Sejosengwe unguNobhala-Jikelele eHhovisi leJaji Eliyinhloko ngaphansi kwenkontileka yeminyaka emithathu engezelwe, kusukela mhla lu-1 kuMbasa Nksz.

src: Boto ya Sentech SOC Limited:a. Monghadi Magatho Mello (o thontswe hape e le Motsamaisi le Modulasetulo eo e seng wa Phethahatso)b. Monghadi Lumko Mthimde (o thontswe hape e le Motsamaisi eo e seng wa Phethahatso)c. Ngaka Sandile Malinga (Motsamaisi eo e seng wa Phethahatso) led.
tgt: Thuli Radebe, njengoMqondisi Omkhulu weSikhungo Sokungulwa Kwamasu Amasha eminyangweni Yemisebenzi Kahulumeni ngaphansi kwenkontileka yezinyanga eziyisithupha engezelwe.

src: Mapato a baitseki le mekaubere.
tgt: Imingcwabo yezingqalabutho zomzabalazo esezimnkantshubomvu.

src: Kabinete e leboha batho bohle lefatsheng ka bophara, haholoholo maAforika Borwa, ka karabelo ya bona e mofuthu ebile e le mosa nakong ya ho hlokahala ha ‘imbokodo’ Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, Moitseki wa ntwa ya tokoloho Ngaka Zola Skweyiya le moetapele wa mokgatlo wa basebetsi Archie Sibeko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyababonga impela bonke abantu emhlabeni jikelele, ikakhulukazi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ngezenzo zabo ezinobubele kanye nokusukumela phezulu kwabo kulandela ukudlula emhlabeni ‘kwembokodo’ uMama u-Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, nengqalabutho yomzabalazo uDkt Zola Skweyiya kanye nomholi wezinyunyana u-Archie Sibeko.

src: Baitseki ba rona ba nyehetse maphelo a bona boikitlaetsong ba Aforika Borwa e ntlafetseng, mme banna le basadi ba naha ya rona ba kgothatswa ba bile ba susumetswa ke ditshotleho tsa bona.
tgt: Lezi zingqalabutho zethu zanikela ngezimpilo zazo emshikashikeni wokufezekisa iphupho leNingizimu Afrika engcono, futhi abesilisa nabesifazane bakuleli bathola ugqozi nentshisekelo kumangwevu nemizabalazo yabo.

src: Kabinete e boetse e ikamahanya le Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa ho iseng hlompho ho mofu Mokaubere wa modiplomate, Moambasadara George Nene, ya sebeleditseng Aforika Borwa ka bokgabane le boitelo nakong ya hae ya ha a ne a le palehong, ho ngoka lebatowa le kontinente ya rona ho netefatsa tokoloho ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: NjengoMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa, iKhabhinethi nalo limthulela isigqoko usomaqhinga obesemnkantshubomvu osesishiyile emhlabeni, iNxusa u-George Nene, owayisebenzela ngokuzimisela nangobunyoninco obukhulu iNingizimu Afrika ngenkathi esekudingisweni, egqugquzela isifunda sethu kanye nezwekazi lonkana ukuba lifake isandla emzabalazweni wokukhulula iNingizimu Afrika.

src: Biopelaetso ba Leboya Bophirima.
tgt: Imibhikisho eqhubeka esifundazweni saseNyakatho Ntshonalanga.

src: Kabinete e sekasekile boemo bo hlokang botsitso bo ropohileng Leboya Bophirima, bo ammeng ditshebeletso tse ngatanyana, haholoholo ditshebeletso tsa bophelo bo botle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi libhungile ngodaba lwezinxushunxushu eziqhubeka esifundazweni saseNyakatho Ntshonalanga, eseziphazamise ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingongqangi zomphakathi eziningana, ikakhulukazi ezempilo.

src: Jwaloka mmuso o tsotellang, Kabinete e ananetse mehato e mmedi ya hanghang ya bokenadipakeng ho busetsa kgutso le botsitso sebakeng seo.
tgt: Njengohulumeni onakekelayo, iKhabhinethi ligunyaze izinhlelo zokungenelela ezimbili ezisheshayo okuhloswe ngaso ukubuyisa ukuthula nozinzo endaweni.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho sebediswa ha Karolo ya 100(1) ya Molaotheo wa Riphaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996, ho rarolla koduwa ena, haholoholo lekaleng la bophelo bo botle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukusetshenziswa kweSigaba 100(1) soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika we-1996 ngenhloso yokubhekana nesimo esibucayo esiqhubekayo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezempilo.

src: Sepheo se ka sehloohong sa bokenadipakeng bona e tla ba ho:busetsa tshepo le boitshepo dipakeng tsa basebetsi le mmusothusa porofense ho ntlafatsa mekgwatsamaiso le bokgoni ba yona tlwaelong e ntjhanetefatsa boikamahanyo le moralo wa mmuso wa ketsamolao le taolotsitsisa tikoloho ya basebetsi, ho kgutlisa phano ya ditshebeletso ya nako e telele, ho netefatsa tshireletseho ya basebetsi le ho ntlafatsa tsamaiso ya ditjhelete.
tgt: Injongo-ngqangi yalokhu kungenelela kukahulumeni wukwenza lokhu okulandelayo:ukubuyisa ukwethembana phakathi kwabasebenzi nohulumeniukulekelela isifundazwe ukuthi siphucule izinhlelo namandla aso okusebenza ukuze umsebenzi kahulumeni uqale futhi ukusebenza njengenjwayeloukuqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa kwemithetho nemithethonqubo elawulayo kahulumeniukuletha uzinzo kwezabasebenzi, kubuyiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo-ngqangi okusimeme, kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka kwabasebenzi futhi kwenziwe ngcono nokuphathwa kwezimali.

src: Kabinete e boetse e laetse sehlopha sa tshebetso sa Matona ho etela Leboya Bophirima ho fumana dintlha tsa sebele.
tgt: Futhi iKhabhinethi selijube ithimba loNgqongqoshe ukuba livakashele esifundazweni saseNyakatho Ntshonalanga ngenhloso yokuyozibonela ngawalo isimo esiqhubekayo futhi lithole namaqiniso mayelana nesimo esiqhubekayo emphakathini.

src: Matona a lebelletswe hore a fane ka tlaleho dibekeng tse pedi tse tlang.
tgt: Kulindeleke ukuba bathumele umbiko emavikini amabili ezayo.

src: Tlaleho ena e tla thusa ho fumana haeba ho na le bokenadipakeng bo bong bo ka nnang ba hlokeha.
tgt: Umbiko mayelana namaqiniso azotholwa yileli thimba emphakathini uzolekelela ekuhlonzeni ezinye izinhlelo zokungenelela okungenzeka zidingeke esifundazweni.

src: Sehlopha seo sa Tshebetso se akga Matona a Thero, Bodisa le Tlhahlobo (Mohlophisi) Bophelo bo Botle tsa Ditjhelete Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Setso hammoho le Setlamo sa Matona a Toka, Thibelo ya Ditlolo tsa Molao le Tshireletso.
tgt: Leli Thimba Elijutshiwe lakhiwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezokuhlela, Ukuqapha Nokuhlola (Ongumlawuli ozohola futhi ahlanganise ithimba) Owezempilo Owezezimali Owokwengamela Ngokubambisana kanye Nezindaba Zendabuko, ngokunjalo noNgqongqoshe Beqoqwana Lezobulungiswa, Ukuvinjelwa Kobugebengu Nokuvikeleka.

src: Leha e lemoha ditletlebo tse hlahisitsweng ke setjhaba, Kabinete e seolla ka matla diketso tsa dikgoka, boinyafelo le bosenyi ba thepa tse neng di tsamaisana le mehwanto ya boipelaetso dibakeng tse ding tsa porofense.
tgt: Nakuba liziphawulile izinkinga ezivezwe yimiphakathi, iKhabhinethi lizigxeka kakhulu izenzo zodlame, nokuphanga, nokucekelwa phansi kwempahla obekuhambisana nale mibhikisho kwezinye izindawo zesifundazwe.

src: Ditherisano tsa meputso lekaleng la setjhaba.1 Kabinete e ile ya tlalehelwa ka ditherisano tsa hajwale tsa meputso ya Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba.
tgt: Izingxoxo zamaholo emkhakheni wabasebenzi bakahulumeni.1 IKhabhinethi lethulelwe umbiko mayelana nezingxoxo zamaholo eziqhubekayo njengamanje emkhakheni wabasebenzi bakahulumeni.

src: Kabinete e kopile Lefapha la Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba le Tsamaiso hammoho le komiti e fanang ka matla hore di sebetse ka boikitlaetso ho rarolla ho se utlwisisane ho teng mabapi le ditherisano tsa meputso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi selinxuse uMnyango Wezemisebenzi Kahulumeni Nokuphathwa Kwayo ngokuhlanganyela nekomidi loNgqongqoshe elijutshiwe, ukuba basebenze ngokushesha emizamweni yabo yokuxazulula lesi simo sikangqingentshe esikhona njengamanje ezingxoxweni zamaholo.

src: Seteraeke sa dibese.
tgt: Isiteleka samabhasi.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho baamehi bohle lekaleng la dipalangwang tsa setjhaba ho fedisa seteraeke sa naha sa dibese ka potlako.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyabanxusa bonke ababambiqhaza emkhakheni wezithuthi zomphakathi ukuba benze imizamo yokuqeda ngokushesha isiteleka samabhasi sikazwelonke.

src: Re kopa baamehi bohle hore ba kgutlele ditherisanong ho etsetsa hore ho tle ho fihlellwe tumellano e molemong wa bohle ba amehang esita le naha.
tgt: Siyabanxusa bonke abathintekayo ukuba babuyele ezingxoxweni zokubonisana ukuze kufinyelelwe esivumelwaneni esizovuna bonke abayingxenye yezingxoxo kanye nezwe lonkana.

src: Merusu Lebaleng la Moses Mabhida.
tgt: Udlame olubheduke eNkundleni Yezemidlalo i-Moses Mabhida.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe diketso tsa merusu le bosenyi bo soto ba thepa tse entsweng ke balatedi ba bolo ya maoto kamora hore ba itahlele ka Lebaleng la Moses Mabhida, Durban, nakong ya papadi ya Liki e Kgolo ya Bolo ya Maoto (PSL) mafelong a beke.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lilugxeka kakhulu udlame olungenangqondo nokucekelwa phansi kwempahla okwenziwe ngabalandeli bebhola likanobhutshuzwayo kulandela ukungena kwabo ngenkani ebaleni okudlalelwa kulona eNkundleni Yezemidlalo i-Moses Mabhida emva kokuphela komdlalo wenhlangano yebhola likanobhutshuzwayo, i-Premier Soccer League, ngempelasonto edlule.

src: Ditheo tsa qobello ya molao di koptjwa ho netefatsa hore bohle ba bileng le letsoho bosenying le diketsong tsa merusu papading eo, ba nka boikarabello bakeng sa diketso tsa bona.
tgt: Izikhungo Zokuqinisekisa Ukuthotshelwa Komthetho ziyanxuswa ukuba ziqinisekise ukuthi bonke labo ababeyingxenye yezenzo zobuxhwanguxhwangu nodlame kulo mdlalo bayajeziswa ngezenzo zabo ezimbi.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ya hore ho etswe dipatlisiso tse potlakileng le hore ho kenngwe tshebetsong mehato e tiileng ya tshireletso ho netefatsa polokeho ya babohi le bahlanka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa ukuthi kwenziwe uphenyo olusheshayo, futhi kuqaliswe nezinyathelo zokuphepha nokuvikeleka eziqinile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwezibukeli nezikhulu zebhola.

src: E kopa bohle ba amehang hore ba be le tshebedisano mmoho dipatlisisong, ho thibela hore kamoso diketso tse tjena di se ke tsa etsahala hape.
tgt: Liyabanxusa futhi bonke ababambiqhaza ukuba balekelele ophenyweni olwenziwayo lokuvimbela ukuqubuka kodlame olunjengalolu esikhathini esizayo.

src: Diteishene tsa seyalemoya sa setjhaba.
tgt: Iziteshi zomsakazo zomphakathi.

src: Kabinete e amohela tumellano e fihletsweng ya ho hokela botjha diteishene tse 15 tsa seyalemoya tse neng di kwetswe ke Sentech hobane di sa lefa ditefello tsa kabo ya leqhubu la kgaso, ha ho ntse ho batlwa ditharollo tsa nako e telelele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyasamukela isivumelwano okufinyelelwe kusona sokuvumela iziteshi zomsakazo zomphakathi eziyi-15 ukuba ziqhubeke futhi zisakaze emva kokumiswa yi-Sentech ngenxa yokuhluleka kwazo ukukhokha imali yezindleko zokuhlinzekwa ngesiginali yokusakaza ngomoya, njengoba kusaqhutshekwa nemizamo yokuthola isixazululo esisimeme kule nkinga.

src: Tumellano e fihletswe kamora hore mmuso o be le kopano le Sentech, Foramo ya Naha ya Seyalemoya sa Setjhaba, Lekgotla la Ntshetsopele ya Mehlodi ya Ditaba le ho se Tshwane (MDDA) esita le Lekgotla le Ikemetseng la Dikgokahanyo la Aforika Borwa (ICASA).
tgt: Kufinyelelwe kulesi sivumelwano emva kokuba uhulumeni ebambe umhlangano ne-Sentech, iNhlangano Kazwelonke Yeziteshi Zomsakazo Zomphakathi, uPhiko Lokuthuthukisa Ezokusakaza Nokwahlukana (i-MDDA) kanye Nesikhungo Esizimele Esibhekelele Ezokuxhumana eNingizimu Afrika (i-Icasa).

src: Lekala la seyalemoya sa setjhaba ke lepatlelo la bohlokwa la kgokahanyo le fang batho ba habo rona phihlello ho tlhahisoleseding, ebile e le tsela ya ho bopa setjhaba se nang le tsebo.
tgt: Umkhakha wezemisakazo yomphakathi uyinkundla yokuxhumana esemqoka kakhulu ehlinzeka abantu bakuleli ngethuba lokuzitholela ulwazi futhi usebenza njengendlela enhle yokwakha umphakathi ohlonyiswe ngolwazi.

src: Bohle ba amehang ba dumellane ka ho kopana haufinyane ho tla le tharollo ya nako e telele e tla tlisa boitjaro diteisheneng tsena.
tgt: Bonke ababambiqhaza bavumile ukuphinda bahlangane khona maduze nje ukuze kutholakale ikhambi lesikhathi eside elizoholela ekusimameni kwalezi ziteshi zomsakazo ukuze ziqhubeke isikhathi eside nomsebenzi wazo.

src: Kopano ya Dihlooho tsa Mebuso ya Mokgatlo wa Dinaha tsa Selekane.
tgt: UMhlangano Wezinhloko Zamazwe Angamadlelandawonye eBhrithane.

src: Kabinete e amohela kananelo ya Lenaneo la Tshebetso la Mokgatlo wa Dinaha tsa Selekane bakeng sa dilemo tse pedi tse tlang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyakuthokozela ukwamukelwa koHlelo Lokusebenza lwale minyaka emibili ezayo Lwenhlangano Yamazwe Angamadlelandawonye.

src: Moporesidente Ramaphosa o etelletse pele Moifo wa Aforika Borwa Kopanong ya Dihlooho tsa Mebuso ya Mokgatlo wa Dinaha tsa Selekane (CHOGM 2018) tlasa mookotaba o reng: “Ho hahamalla Bokamosong bo Tshwanang” ho tloha ka la 19 ho isa ho la 20 Mmesa 2018.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa nguyena obehola iThimba Lezithunywa Ebezimele iNingizimu Afrika eMhlanganweni Wezinhloko Zamazwe Angamadlelandawonye (i-CHOGM 2018) ngaphansi kwesihloko esithi: “Siphokophele Kwingomuso Elifanayo” owabanjwa kusukela mhla ziyi-19 kuya kumhla zingama-20 kuMbasa 2018.

src: Ha a teka Aforika Borwa e le se seng sebaka sa botsetedi se hlahelletseng ka mahetla mebarakeng e thuthuang, Moporesidente Ramaphosa o boetse a teka puo Kopanong ya Baetapele ba Aforika ba Foramo ya Kgwebo ya Mokgatlo wa Dinaha tsa Selekane, a ba a dula majwana le batsetedi ba baholo ba matjhaba hammoho le baetapele ba kgwebo.
tgt: Njengomzamo wokubeka iNingizimu Afrika endaweni enhle njengelinye lamazwe asafufusa aphuma phambili ekuheheni abatshali-zimali bangaphandle, uMongameli Ramaphosa wethula futhi inkulumo eMhlanganweni Wabaholi Base-Afrika weNhlangano Yezebhizinisi Yamazwe Angamadlelandawonye, futhi waxoxisana nabatshali-zimali nabaholi bamabhizinisi abaphakeme bamazwe ngamazwe.

src: O boetse a fetisa memo ho batsetedi ba itlhommeng pele esita le baetapele ba kgwebo hore ba be teng Kopanong ya Botsetedi e hlophiseditsweng hore e tshwarwe hamorao selemong sena.
tgt: Wamema futhi nabatshali-zimali nabaholi bamabhizinisi abahamba phambili emhlabeni ukuthi beze eNingizimu Afrika bazokwethamela iNgqungquthela Yezotshalomali elindelwe ngamehlo abomvu, ezobanjwa makhathaleni ngokuqhubeka kwalo nyaka.

src: Tlasa boetapele ba Moporesidente Ramaphosa, moifo wa Aforika Borwa o boetse wa sebedisa monyetla ona o tlisitsweng ke CHOGM hore ba tswele pele ho thaothela bonkgetheng ba Aforika Borwa ho Lekgotla la Tshireletso la Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) bakeng sa sehla sa 2019 – 2020.
tgt: Ngaphansi kobuholi bukaMongameli Ramaphosa, iThimba laseNingizimu Afrika lasebenzisa futhi nethuba elahlinzekwa yi-CHOGM lokuqhubeka nokunxenxa amanye amazwe ukuba asekele imizamo yeNingizimu Afrika yokufakwa njengelinye lamazwe azokhethwa ukuthi abe yingxenye yoMkhandlu Wezokuvikela weNhlangano Yezizwe (i-UN) kwihlandla lomkhandlu lowezi-2019 – 2020.

src: Dikgetho tsena di hlophiseditswe ho tshwarwa ka la 8 Phuptjane 2018 ho la New York, Amerika (USA).
tgt: Lolu khetho luzobanjwa mhla ziyisi-8 kuNhlangulana 2018 e-New York, kwelase-USUtshalomali.

src: Kabinete e amohela thonyo ya Mopresidente Ramaphosa ya maqosa a kgethehileng mabapi le botsetedi hore a dule majwana le batsetedi ba lapeng esita le ba dinaheng tsa bolata ka menyetla ya moruo e Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyasamukela isinyathelo sikaMongameli Ramaphosa sokuqoka izithunywa ezikhethekile ezine ezizogqugquzela ukulethwa kotshalomali kuleli ngokuxhumana nabatshali-zimali bakuleli nabakwamanye amazwe zibachazele kabanzi ngamathuba ezomnotho akhona eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Maqosa ana a laetswe hore a hohele botsetedi ka tsela e tsepameng ebile e le e ditjeo di tlase.
tgt: Lezi zithunywa zethweswe umsebenzi wokuheha utshalomali ngendlela egxilile futhi engambi eqolo.

src: Tjantjello ena ya botsetedi e tla fihla sehlohlolong ka ho tshwarwa ha seboka se seholo sa botsetedi ho ella mafelong a selemo, ho bokella tjhelete e kahodimo ho R1 trillion botseteding bo botjha ka dilemo tse hlano.
tgt: Umkhankaso wokuheha utshalomali uzofinyelela kuvuthondaba ngokubanjwa kwengqungquthela enkulukazi ngasekupheleni kwalo nyaka, okuhloswe ngayo ukuheha utshalomali oluyinkulungwane yezigidigidi (ithriliyoni) zamarandi kule minyaka emihlanu ezayo.

src: Kgakolo ya Setsi sa Gauteng sa Ntho Tsohle tsa Botsetedi ba Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ukwethulwa kweSikhungo Esinguntozonke se-InvestSA saseGauteng.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa ka matla batsetedi ba lapeng le ba matjhaba hore ba sebedise ditsi tsa botsetedi tsa Ntho Tsohle tsa Diporofense, tse ntseng di kgakolwa ho potoloha le naha – moo sa morarorao e leng Setsi sa Ntho Tsohle sa Gauteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyabakhuthaza kakhulu abatshali-zimali bakuleli nabakwamanye amazwe ukuba basebenzise iziKhungo Zezifundazwe Zotshalomali Ezingontozoke ezethulwayo njengamanje ezweni lonkana – futhi isiKhungo Esinguntozonke sakamuva esethuliwe kuleli ngesaseGauteng.

src: Setsi sa Ntho Tsohle tsa Botsetedi sa Aforika Borwa ke lenaneo la moporesidente la ho bapatsa le ho nolofatsa botsetedi Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Uhlelo lwe-InvestSA LweziKhungo Ezingontozonke wuhlelo lukaMongameli lokugqugquzela nokwenza lula inqubo yokutshalwa kwezimali eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Hajwale, Setsi sa Ntho Tsohle tsa Botsetedi sa Aforika Borwa se se se kentswe tshebetsong ka katleho KwaZulu-Natal le Kapa Bophirima.
tgt: Kuze kube manje, sekusungulwe ngempumelelo iziKhungo ze-InvestSA Ezingontozonke esifundazweni saKwaZulu-Natali kanye naseNtshonalanga Kapa.

src: Ditsi tsa Ntho Tsohle tsa Botsetedi di ntse di fanwa diporofenseng tsohle, mme di tla sebedisetswa ho hlophisa le ho momahanya mabatowa a kgethehileng a moruo, ditheo tsa botsetedi ba diporofense, makgotla a lehae le mafapha a tshwanelehileng a mmuso a amehang ho tsa taolo, ngodiso, mangolo a tumello le ditaba tsa dilaesense.
tgt: Luyaqhubeka uhlelo lokusungulwa kweziKhungo Zotshalomali Ezingontozonke kuzo zonke izifundazwe zakuleli, futhi lezi zikhungo zizosetshenziselwa ukuhlanganisa nokuhambelanisa umsebenzi wezizinda zomnotho ezikhethekile, izimpiko zotshalomali zezifundazwe, omasipala kanye neminyango kahulumeni efanelekile ebandakanyeka ezindabeni eziphathelene nokulawulwa, ukubhaliswa kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwezimvume namalayisensi kubatshali-zimali.

src: Dikarete tse ntjha tsa Posong tsa-SASSA tsa Banka ya Posong.
tgt: Amakhadi Amasha ePosi, i-SASSA ne-Postbank.

src: Kabinete e amohela katleho ya ho bula madiboho ya phano ya dikarete tse ntjha tsa Lekgotla la Tshireletso ya Setjhaba la Aforika Borwa (SASSA) diposong tse kgethilweng Kapa Bophirima, ho dumella majalefa a ditjhelete tsa dithuso tsa setjhaba ho fapanya dikarete tsa bona tsa hajwale hore ba fumane tse ntjha tsa Posong ya Aforika Borwa (SAPO)-SASSA tsa Banka ya Posong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyayamukela inqubo elingwayo yokukhishwa kwamakhadi amasha eNhlangano Yezimpesheni Nezibonelelo Zikahulumeni yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SASSA) emaposini akhethiweyo esifundazweni saseNtshonalanga Kapa ukuze abahlomuli bezibonelelo zikahulumeni bakwazi ukushintshisa amakhadi abo amadala ngamaKhadi Amasha Eposi laseNingizimu Afrika, (i-SAPO), i-SASSA kanye ne-Postbank.

src: Baamohedi ba ditjhelete tsa dithuso tsa setjhaba le beng ba dikarete ba ntse ba kgona ho sebedisa dikarete tsa bona tsa hajwale ho fihlela ka Tshitwe 2018, empa Kabinete e kgothalletsa majalefa ho ya fapanya dikarete tsa bona tsa kgale ka ho etela SASSA kapa SAPO tsa bona tse haufi ho tloha ka la 2 Motsheanong ho fihlela mafelong a Lwetse Thuto e Phahameng.
tgt: Abahlomuli kanye nabanikazi bamakhadi ezibonelelo zikahulumeni basazokwazi ukusebenzisa lawo makhadi abawasebenzisayo njengamanje kuze kuphele inyanga kaZibandlela 2018, kodwa-ke iKhabhinethi liyabakhuthaza ukuthi bavakashele emahhovisi e-SASSA noma e-SAPO aseduze nabo bayoshintshisa amakhadi abo amadala kusukela mhla zi-2 kuNhlaba kuyofinyelela ekupheleni kukaMandulo Imfundo Ephakeme.

src: Kabinete e amohela kgatelopele e etswang ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha thuto ya mahala jwalokaha ho tobokeditswe ke Letona la Thuto e Phahameng le Thupelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyayithokozela inqubekelaphambili eyenziwayo ekuqalisweni kohlelo lokuhlinzekwa kwemfundo yamahhala, njengoba uNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqesha esechazile kabanzi ngalokhu.

src: Phatlalatso ya keketso ya bohlokwa kabong ya motheo ya tjhelete ya NSFAS ho tloha ho R9,849 bilione ka 2017/18 ho ya ho R35,321 bilione ka 2020/21, e bontsha boikitlaetso ba Mmuso ho thuseng baithuti ba tswang malapeng a kojwana di mahetleng esita le a mokgahlelo wa basebetsi.
tgt: Isimemezelo sokukhushulwa kwesabelo se-NSFAS ngemali ebhekile impela sisuka kwisamba esingamabhiliyoni ayisi-9,849 amarandi ngowezi-2017/18 siyofinyelela kumabhiliyoni angama-35,321 amarandi ngowezi-2020/21 kubonisa ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni ekulekeleleni abafundi abaphuma emakhaya ahlwempu kanye nalawo anabondli abenza imisebenzi eholela amaholo aphansi.

src: Lenaneo la Tshehetso la Dikgwebo tse nyenyane, tse mahareng le tse nyanenyane (SMME).
tgt: Uhlelo Lokwesekwa kwama-SMMIKhabhinethi liyakwamukela ukwethulwa koHlelo Lokugqugquzelwa Kwamathuba Omsebenzi ngokusebenzisa umklamo wokweSekwa Kwamabhizinisi Asafufusa (ama-SMME), okuwuhlelo oluwubambiswano phakathi koMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwamabhizinisi Amancane (i-DSBD) kanye neNhlangano Yamazwe ase-Yurophu (i-EU).

src: Kabinete e amohela kgakolo ya Phahamiso ya Khiro ka Lenaneo la Tshehetso ya diSMME, leo e leng selekane dipakeng tsa Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane (DSBD) le Kopano ya Dinaha tsa Yuropa (EU).
tgt: Lolu hlelo luzosekela ama-SMME ngokuwahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuthuthukiswa kwebhizinisi, luwalekelele ukuba akwazi ukufinyelela nokuthola izindawo angahweba kuzo kanye nabantu angahwebelana nabo noma abathengisele imikhiqizo yawo, lwenze ngcono ukufinyelela kwawo ezinsizakalweni zokuxhaswa ngezimali futhi luwalekelele ngokunciphisa umthwalo onzima osemahlombe awo ophathelene nokuphathwa nokulawulwa kwamabhizinisi asemancane.

src: Saense le Thekenoloji.
tgt: Ezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe.

src: Kabinete e rorisa bohle ba kentseng letsoho botenng ba ZACUBE-2, e leng sathalaete ya tjhubu e kgolokgolo ebile e le e hatetseng pele ka ho fetisisa Aforika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyabancoma impela bonke labo ababandakanyekayo emsebenzini wokwakhiwa nokuphothulwa kwe-ZACUBE-2, okuyisiphuphutheki (isathelayithi) esithuthuke kakhulu sokuqala sase-Afrika.

src: Sathalaete ena ya boima ba 4kg ya ZACUBE-2 – e hlahisitsweng ke Yunivesithi ya Thekenoloji ya Hlohleng ya Kapa (CPUT) le Setheo sa Thekenoloji sa Fora le Aforika Borwa, se laolwang ke Lekgotla la Sepakapaka sa Naha la Aforika Borwa – se filwe ditjhelete ke Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji.
tgt: Isiphuphutheki i-ZACUBE-2 esinesisindo esingamakhilogramu amane – esathuthukiswa yinyuvesi yezobuchwepheshe i-Cape Peninsula University of Technology (i-CPUT) kanye nesikhungo sezobuchwepheshe i-French South African Institute of Technology, futhi ebesilawulwa yisiKhungo Sikazwelonke Sezomkhathi saseNingizimu Afrika – saxhaswa ngezimali wuMnyango Wezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe.

src: Ke nano-sathalaete ya bobedi e hlahisitsweng ke CPUSathalaete ena ya tjhubu e rometswe Indiya hore e tle e romelwe sepakapakeng.
tgt: Lesi yisiphuphutheki esincane sesibili esithuthukiswe e-CPULesi siphuphutheki sesithunyelwe kwelase-India lapho sizocitshwa khona siye phezulu emkhathini.

src: E tla thusa ho bokella lesedi la ho utolla kgolo ya moruo moruong wa mawatleng.
tgt: Sizosiza ekuqoqeni imininingo ezolekelela ekuvulweni kwamathuba okukhulisa umnotho ngokusebenzisa umkhakha womnotho wasolwandle.

src: Nano-sathalaete ena e tla thusa ho rarolla ditlhoko tsa lenaneo la Moruo wa Mawatleng wa Operation Phakisa esita le ho thusa ho lemoha tshebetso ya diphedi tsa mawatleng ho thathika le mabopo a Aforika Borwa esita le ho lemoha mello ya meru pele e etsahala.
tgt: Lesi siphuphutheki esincane sizolekelela ekufezekisweni kwezidingo zohlelo loMkhankaso we-Operation Phakisa Womnotho Wasolwandle futhi silekelele ngokuqapha konke okwenzekayo olwandle olusogwini lwaseNingizimu Afrika futhi sizohlinzeka ngezexwayiso nolwazi olusheshayo uma kwenzeka kuqubuka imililo yequbula emahlathini.

src: Indaba ya Merafo ya KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: INgqungquthela Yezezimayini Ebibanjelwe KwaZulu-Natali.

src: Kabinete e amohela sephetho sa Indaba ya Merafo ya KwaZulu-Natal ya matsatsi a mabedi, moo baromuwa ba neng ba tshohla ditaba tse tla thusa ho fetola lekala le ho utolla menyetla ya lethathama la merafo porofenseng eo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyawamukela umphumela weNgqungquthela Yezezimayini edonse izinsuku ezimbili ebibanjelwe KwaZulu-Natali, lapho izithunywa zibhunge khona ngezindaba ezizolekelela ekulethweni koguquko kulo mkhakha futhi kuvulwe namathuba aphathelene nochungechunge lomsebenzi wokumbiwa kanye nokulungiswa kwemikhiqizo yezimbiwa esifundazweni.

src: Lekala la merafo ke le leng la makala a bohlokwa a ka re thutsang ho fetola moruo wa rona mme Kabinete e ipileditse ho dikhamphane tsa merafo, basebetsi le setjhaba ho matlafatsa maqhama hore tshebetso ya merafo e tle e be le botsitso ka nako e telelele.
tgt: Umkhakha wezimayini ngomunye wemikhakha esemqoka kakhulu engalekelela ekuletheni uguquko emnothweni wezwe futhi iKhabhinethi selinxuse izinkampani zezimayini, abasebenzi kanye nemiphakathi ukuba baqinise ubudlelwano phakathi kwabo ukuze usimame futhi uchume umkhakha wezimayini.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Moralo wa Bodisa le Tlhahlobo bakeng sa Leano la Naha la Batjha (NYP) 2015-2020.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lilugunyazile uHlaka Lokuqapha Nokuhlola lweNqubomgomo Kazwelonke Yentsha (i-NYP) yowezi-2015-2020.

src: Moralo ona o fana ka sebopeho sa boikarabello le tshebetso e ntle katlehong ya sepheo sa NYP sa 2020.
tgt: Lolu hlaka luhlinzekela ukuphendula kahle nokusebenza ngobunyoninco ekufezekisweni kwezinjongo ze-NYP zowezi-2020.

src: Leano le habile ho ntlafatsa tshebetso le ho matlafatsa phano ya ditshebeletso, haholoholo mananeong a batjha.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo ihlose ukwenza ngcono indlela okusetshenzwa ngayo kanye nokuphucula ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo, ikakhulukazi izinhlelo zentsha.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tshwarwa ha Lenaneo la Kgwedi ya Aforika la Selemo le Selemo bakeng sa Motsheanong 2018 tlasa mmokotaba o reng: “Selemo sa Nelson Mandela – Ho Aha Aforika e Betere le Lefatshe le Betere”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukusingathwa koHlelo lwenyanga kaNhlaba 2018 loMgubho Waminyaka Yonke Wenyanga ye-Afrika ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Unyaka ka-Nelson Mandela – Sakha i-Afrika Engcono kanye Nomhlaba Ongcono”.

src: Kgwedi ya Motsheanong e keteka dikatleho tse entsweng ntshetsopeleng ya Aforika.
tgt: Ngenyanga kaNhlaba kugujwa imisebenzi eyimpumelelo eyenziwe ekuthuthukisweni kwe-Afrika.

src: Diketsahalo di fella ka Letsatsi la Aforika mohla la 25 Motsheanong, e leng letsatsi le phatlaladitsweng ke Kopano ya Dinaha tsa Aforika (AU) mme le ketekwa Aforika.
tgt: Imicimbi ezobanjwa ngale nyanga izofinyelela kuvuthondaba ngoSuku lwe-Afrika mhla zingama-25 kuNhlaba, okuwusuku olwaqokwa futhi lwamenyezelwa ngokusemthethweni yiNhlangano Yamazwe ase-Afrika (i-AU) futhi olugujwa ezwekazini lase-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka tlaleho le bokenadipakeng bo entsweng boemong ba dinyewe tsa tlatlapo ya motabo, tlhekefetso le boitshwaro bo bobe kgahlanong le ditho tsa Lebotho la Sesole sa Naha la Aforika Borwa (SANDF) tse rometsweng ho ya tshehetsa Letsholo la Tsitsiso la Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) ho la Democratic Republic of Congo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihlinzekwe ngolwazi mayelana nombiko kanye nezinhlelo zokungenelela eziqhutshwayo eziphathelene nesimo samacala okuxhaphaza ngokocansi, ukuhlukumeza kanye nokuziphatha kabi, okungamacala abekwe amalungu oMbutho Wezokuvikela waseNingizmu Afrika (i-SANDF) akanise kwelase-Democratic Republic of Congo lapho ejutshwe khona ukuyolekelela eMkhankasweni Wenhlangano Yezizwe (i-UN) Wokuletha Ukuthula Nozinzo kuleliya lizwe.

src: Leha Kabinete e kgotsofaditswe ke bokenadipakeng bo entsweng ho rarolla ditlhekefetso tsena, e seolla ka matla mofuta ofe kapa ofe wa tlhekefetso ya motabo le diketso tsa boitshwaro bo bobe ba ditho tsa SANDF dibakeng tseo ba rometsweng ho tsona.
tgt: Nakuba iKhabhinethi ligculisekile ngezinhlelo zokungenelela ezisetshenziswayo ukunqanda lesi sihlava sokuhlukumeza, lizigxeka kakhulu izenzo zokuxhaphaza ngokocansi nokungaziphathi kahle kwamalungu ombutho we-SANDF ezindaweni lapho ethunyelwe khona ukuba ayolekelela.

src: Ho rometswe sehlopha ho ya batlisisa ka diqoso tsohle tse tlalehilweng.
tgt: Sekusungulwe ithimba elijutshwe ukuba liphenye zonke izinsolo ezibikiwe.

src: Leha dinyewe tse ding di se di phethetswe, tse ding di se di le mokgahlelong wa dinyewe tsa sesole.
tgt: Nakuba esephothuliwe amanye alawa macala, kunamanye asefinyelele esigabeni sokuqulwa phambi kwesithangama senkantolo yombutho wezokuvikela.

src: Dipatlisiso tsena tsohle di entswe ka tshebetso ya semolao ya sesole ka mokgwa o nang le ponaletso le boikarabello.
tgt: Lonke uphenyo olwenziwe luqhutshwe ngokwenqubo yomthetho wokuqulwa kwamacala ombutho wezokuvikela ngendlela esobala, engachemile futhi ehambisana nokuphendula ngendlela efanele.

src: Aforika Borwa, jwaloka tlwaelo, e tla tswelapele ho arabela ka potlako ha e sebetsana le diketsahalo tse jwalo.
tgt: Njengenjwayelo, iNingizimu Afrika izoqhubeka nokuthatha izinyathelo ezisheshayo ukubhekana nezigameko ezinjengalezi.

src: Boitshwaro bo bobe le ditlolo tsa molao dithong tsa SANDF di hloilwe mme di ke ke tsa mamellwa.
tgt: Siyazinyanya kakhulu izenzo zobugebengu nokungaziphathi kahle embuthweni we-SANDF futhi lokhu ngeke kubekezelelwe nakancane.

src: Bao ba fumanwang ba di tlotse ba tla sebetswa ka Molawana wa Boitshwaro le Molawana wa Kgalemo wa Sesole.
tgt: Labo okutholakale ukuthi baphule umthetho kuzobhekwana nabo ngokweMigomo Yokuziphatha Yamalungu Ombutho Wezokuvikela.

src: Kabinete e boetse ya tshehetsa phethelo ya Bili ya Kgalemo ya Sesole, e habileng ho sebetsana le kgalemo ka kakaretso ho SANDF, ho akga le matlafatso ya tlhaloso ya tlatlapo ya motabo le keketso ya kotlo e tlase hore e be dilemo tse Dibili.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likusekelile futhi nokuphothulwa koMthethosivivinywa Wokuziphatha Kwamalungu Ombutho Wezokuvikela, okuhloswe ngawo ukubhekana nokuziphatha kwamasosha embuthweni we-SANDF wonkana, kubandakanya nokuqiniswa kwencazelo yokuxhaphaza ngokocansi nokukhushulwa kwesigwebo esiyisisekelo sibekwe eminyakeni eyi-10.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho phatlalatswa ha Bili ya Taolo ya Dihlahiswa tsa Kwae le Mekgwatsamaiso ya Phetiso ya Elektroniki ya 2017 Koranteng ya Mmuso bakeng sa tlhahiso ya maikutlo a setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukushicilelwa koMthethosivivinywa Wokulawulwa Kwemikhiqizo Kagwayi kanye Nezinhlelo Zokubhema Ugwayi Ngamadivayisi Asebenza Ngogesi wezi-2017 kuSomqulu Kahulumeni ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngawo.

src: Bili ena e hlakola Molao wa Taolo ya Dihlahiswa tsa Kwae, 1993 (Molao wa 83 wa 1993) e le ho kgothaletsa bophelo bo botle ba setjhaba le ho nyalanya molao wa taolo ya kwae wa Aforika Borwa le Tumellano ya Moralo wa Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Bophelo bo Botle Taolong ya Kwae.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uhlose ukuqeda ukusebenza koMthetho Wokulawulwa Kwemikhiqizo Kagwayi, we-1993 (uMthetho wama-83 we-1993) ukuze kugqugquzelwe ukunakekelwa kwempilo yomphakathi futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umthetho waseNingizimu Afrika wokulawulwa kwemikhiqizo kagwayi uyahambelana noHlaka Lwesivumelwano SeNhlangano Yezempilo Emhlabeni (i-WHO) mayelana Nokulawulwa Kukagwayi.

src: O rarolla dintlha tsa bohlokwa tse kahare tse amanang le dibaka tsa setjhaba, pepeso ya dihlahiswa tsa kwae dibakeng tsa thekiso, tshebediso ya disebediswa tsa elektroniki le tsebiso ya dipakethe tse sa takwang tsa dihlahiswa tsa kwae.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uzocacisa nodaba oluphathelene nemikhakha ebalulekile, njengezindawo okubhenyelwa kuzona ugwayi ngaphakathi ezakhiweni zomphakathi, ukubekwa obala kwemikhiqizo kagwayi ezitolo, ukusetshenziswa kwamadivayisi okubhema ugwayi asebenza ngogesi kanye nokwethulwa kwamaphakethe kagwayi angabhaliwe lutho ngaphandle futhi angenayo nemifanekiso.

src: Kabinete e ananetse phatlalatso ya Bili ya Moralo o Kopantsweng wa 2018 hore e hatiswe Koranteng ya Mmuso bakeng sa tlhahiso ya maikutlo a setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukushicilelwa koMthethosivivinywa Wezinhlaka Ezididiyelwe wezi-2018 kuSomqulu Kahulumeni ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngawo.

src: Bili e habile ho fihlella thero e hlophisitsweng ebile e le e kopantsweng makaleng ohle a mmuso, a fepelanang a bile a sebetsa ka momahano ho kgothaletsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP) ka bokgabane.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uhlose ukuqinisekisa ukuhlela ngendlela ehambelanayo futhi edidiyelwe kuzo zonke izinhlaka zikahulumeni, okumele zibe yizinhlaka ezisekelanayo futhi ezisebenza ngokubambisana ekugqugquzeleni ukuqaliswa kahle koHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP).Ukuhlela okwenziwe kwaba wumgomo nenkambiso yesikhungo kuhambisana ne-NDP futhi kuhlose ukuqalisa ukusebenza kwesibophezelo soHlaka Lokusebenza Lwesikhathi Esimaphakathi lowezi-2014-2019 lokusungula izindlela kanye namandla okusebenza ngaphakathi ezinhlakeni zoMbuso ukuze ziqalise ukuhlela okuthuthukisayo kwesikhathi eside.

src: Tlwaetso ya merero e tsamaisana le NDP mme e habile ho tiisa boikitlaetso bo Moralong wa Lewa la Nako e Mahareng wa 2014-2019, ho thea ditsela le bokgoni kahara Naha ho etsa thero ya ntshetsopele ya nako e telelele.
tgt: Kuzogqugquzela uMbuso osebenza ngendlela ehambelanayo futhi osabela kangcono ezidingweni zomphakathi, ozosebenza kangcono ekugqugquzeleni izinguguquko ezinohlonze esimweni sawo, ezidingekayo ukuze kulethwe uguquko olubandakanya umuntu wonke, futhi okuyizinguquko ezizothuthukisa abasebenzi bakuleli kanye noMbuso wentando yeningi labantu onohlonze.

src: Diketsahalo tse Tlang.
tgt: Imicimbi Ezayo.

src: Letsatsi la TokolohoKabinete e rorisa maAforika Borwa ohle le makala a nang le seabo ka tsela tse fapaneng meketeng ya morao ya Kgwedi ya Tokoloho.
tgt: Usuku LwenkululekoIKhabhinethi liyabancoma impela bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nemikhakha ebambe iqhaza ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene emigubhweni eqhubekayo njengamanje yeNyanga Yenkululeko.

src: Moporesidente Ramaphosa o tla fana ka puo ya sehlooho moketeng wa Letsatsi la Naha la Tokoloho mohla la 27 Mmesa 2018 Lebaleng la Ngaka Petrus Molemela Bloemfontein, Freistata tlasa mookotaba o reng: “Selemo sa Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela: mathuleng a temoho e tletseng ya tokoloho ya rona ka phetoho e potlakileng ya moruo wa kahisano”.Ketsahalo ena e tla latelwa ke Mokete wa Dikgau tsa Naha wa 2018 ka Moqebelo wa la 28 Mmesa 2018 Pretoria, moo Moporesidente Ramaphosa a tla abela baamohedi ba tshwanehileng ka Tlotlo ya Baobab, Tlotlo ya Ikhamanga, Tlotlo ya Luthuli le Tlotlo ya Bomphato ya OR Tambo.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa uzokwethula inkulumo yosuku emcimbini wokugujwa koSuku Lukazwelonke Lwenkululeko mhla zingama-27 enkundleni yezemidlalo i-Dr Petrus Molemela Stadium e-Bloemfontein, esifundazweni saseFreyistata ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Unyaka ka-Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela: siphokophele ekufezekisweni ngokuphelele kwenkululeko yethu ngokusebenzisa uguquko lwenhlalo-mnotho olunohlonze”.Lo mcimbi woSuku Lukazwelonke Lwenkululeko uzolandelwa ngumcimbi weziNdondo Zezwe wezi-2018 ozobanjwa ngoMgqibelo mhla zingama-28 kuMbasa 2018 ePitoli, lapho uMongameli Ramaphosa ezoklomelisa khona abantu abavelele ngalezi zindondo ezilandelayo: i-Order of the Baobab, i-Order of Ikhamanga, i-Order of Luthuli kanye ne-Order of the Companions of OR Tambo.

src: Ditlotlo tsa Naha ke dikgau tse phahameng ka ho fetisisa tseo Aforika Borwa e di abang, ka Moporesidente, ho baahi le ditho tsa dibaka tsa matjhaba tse kentseng letsoho ka bokgabane ho etseng hore naha e be e lokolohileng, setjhaba sa demokrasi le katleho e kopaneng ka ho se tshwane ha yona.
tgt: IziNdondo Zezwe yizindondo eziphakeme kunazo zonke iNingizimu Afrika, ngokusebenzisa uMongameli, ehlonipha ngazo izakhamuzi zakuleli kanye namalungu omphakathi wamazwe ngamazwe adlale indima enkulu ekwenzeni leli lizwe libe yizwe elikhululekile, elibuswa ngentando yeningi labantu futhi eliphumelelayo eliyimbumba nakuba linezinhlobo zabantu abahlukahlukene.

src: Mekete ya Letsatsi la MotsheanongKabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho basebetsi bohle ho potoloha le naha hore ba ikamahanye le ho keteka Letsatsi la Basebetsi ka Labobedi mohla la 1 Motsheanong 2018 mme ba nahane ka dikatleho tsa ditokelo tsa basebetsi haesale ho tloha mathwasong a demokrasi.
tgt: Imigubho yoSuku LwabasebenziIKhabhinethi liyabanxusa bonke abasebenzi ezweni lonkana ukuthi bazibandakanye emigubhweni yoSuku Lwabasebenzi ngoLwesibili mhla lu-1 kuNhlaba 2018 futhi babheke emuva bakhumbule konke osekuzuziwe kusukela ekufikeni koMbuso wentando yeningi labantu kuze kube manje, mayelana namalungelo abasebenzi.

src: Letsatsi lena ke sehopotso sa hore dibaka tsa tshebetso di tlameha ho bolokeha le hore bahiri ba lokela ho etsa haholwanyane ho netefatsa polokeho ya basebetsi ba bona, haholoholo lekaleng la merafo.
tgt: Lolu wusuku oluyisikhumbuzo sokuthi izizinda okusetshenzelwa kuzona kumele kube ngeziphephile futhi abaqashi kumele babhukule, baqinise imizamo yabo ekuqinisekiseni ukuphepha kwabasebenzi babo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezimayini.

src: Kabinete e boetse e fetisitse matshediso a yona a tswang boteng ba pelo ho ba malapa, metswalle le basebetsimmoho ba basebetsi ba tsheletseng ba morafo ba ileng ba tjha mme ba shwa ha bese e neng e ba isa mosebetsing e tjheswa ka qhomane ya peterole ke bahlasedi ba sa tsejweng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi futhi lidlulisa amazwi okuzwelana kakhulu nemindeni, abangani kanye nozakwabo babavukuzi abayisithupha abashiswe wumlilo bangqongqa esigamekweni sokuhlaselwa kwebhasi ebelibathutha libahambisa emsebenzini, elihlaselwe ngebhomu likaphethiloli elijikijelwe ngabahlaseli abangaziwa.

src: Kabinete e entse kgoeletso ho ditho tsa setjhaba ho thusa sepolesa thahasellong ya sona ya ho rarolla nyewe ena ka potlako.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liwanxusile amalungu omphakathi ukuthi alekelele amaphoyisa emizamweni yawo yokubamba futhi avalele ngokushesha bonke labo abayingxenye yaleli cala.

src: MelaetsaKabinete e lebohisa:1.
tgt: ImiyalezoIKhabhinethi lihalalisela:1.

src: Monono wa moNdebele Esther Mahlangu, ya filweng lengolo la bongaka la tlotla Yunivesithing ya Johannesburg ho ananela nyehelo ya hae e tswileng matsoho bononong le botjhabeng ba Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Umdwebi oyingcweti yemifanekiso nemihlobiso yamaNdebele, u-Esther Mahlangu, ohlonishwe yi-University of Johannesburg ngeziqu zobudokotela, ngenxa yegalelo lakhe elikhulukazi kwezobuciko namasiko endabuko eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Sehlopha sa Aforika Borwa se phahamiseditseng folakga ya rona hodimo Dipapading tsa Mokgatlo wa Dinaha tsa Selekane ho la Gold Coast Australia, ha se ne se phethela se le boemong ba botshelela ka palo yohle ya dikgau tse 37 (kgauta tse 13, silifera tse 11 le boronse tse 13).
tgt: IQembu LaseNingizimu Afrika eliphakamisele ifulegi lakuleli phezulu eMqhudelwaneni Wemidlalo Yamazwe Angamadlelandawonye obubanjelwe e-Gold Coast kwelase-Australia, lapho liphothule khona lisendaweni yesithupha ohlwini lwamazwe anqobe izindondo, njengoba lizuze izindondo ezingama-37 uma sezizonke (okuyizindondo eziyi-13 zegolide, eziyi-11 zesiliva kaye neziyi-13 zethusi).

src: Katleho ya bona e tlisitswe ke ho sebetsa ka thata, boikitlaetso le mamello.
tgt: Le mpumelelo yabo engaka iwumphumela wokuzikhandla, ukuzimisela nokubekezela.

src: Hona ke kgothatso ho baatlelete ba batjha mme e tiisa botjha nnete ya hore dipapadi ke karolo ya mmopo wa setjhaba o re tlamahanyang re le maAforika Borwa.
tgt: Lokhu kuzofaka ugqozi kubadlali nabasubathi bakuleli abasebasha futhi kuyisiqinisekiso esicacile sokuthi ngempela ezemidlalo ziyibhande elisihlanganisa ndawonye sonke njengabantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ba kahodimodimo ba ba hapileng dikgau tsa kgauta ba akga:Caster Semenya – 800m le 1500m ya basadiLuvo Manyonga – ho qhomela hole ha bannaNdodomzi Ntutu – T12 100m ya bannaHenri Schoeman –triathlon ya bannaTatjana Schoenmaker – 100m le 200m ho breaststroke ya basadiChad le Clos – 50m, 100m le 200m tsa banna ho butterfly ya bannaCameron van der Burgh – 50m ho breaststroke ya bannaAkani Simbine – 100m ya banna leMartin Erasmus – 97kg wrestling freestyle ya banna.
tgt: Abanqobe izindondo zegolide yilaba:Caster Semenya – onqobe umjaho wabesifazane webanga elingama-800m kanye nowebanga elingama-1500mLuvo Manyonga – onqobe umqhudelwano wabesilisa wokugxuma ibanga elideNdodomzi Ntutu – onqobe umjaho wabesilisa abangaboni kahle emehlweni webanga eliyi-100m, i-T12 100mHenri Schoeman – onqobe umqhudelwano wabesilisa we-triathlon (obandakanya imidlalo emithathu, ukubhukuda, amabhayisikili kanye nokugijima ibanga elide)Tatjana Schoenmaker – onqobe umqhudelwano wabesifazane wokubhukuda wohlobo lwe-breaststroke ebangeni elingama-100m kanye nama-200mChad le Clos – onqobe umqhudelwano wabesilisa wokubhukuda wohlobo lwe-butterfly ebangeni elingama-50m, 100m kanye nama-200mCameron van der Burgh – onqobe umqhudelwano wabesilisa wokubhukuda wohlobo lwe-breaststroke ebangeni elingama-50mAkani Simbine – onqobe umjaho wabesilisa webanga elingama-100m kanye noMartin Erasmus – onqobe umqhudelwano wabesilisa wokubambana ngezikhwepha, i-wrestling freestyle, esisindweni esingama-97kg.

src: Moporofesara Sibongile Muthwa le Ngaka Geraldine Fraser-Moleketi ka tlhomamiso ya bona ya haufinyane e le motlatsi wa motjhanselara le motjhanselara ka tatelano, ba Yunivesithi ya Nelson Mandela.
tgt: USolwazi Sibongile Muthwa kanye noDkt Geraldine Fraser-Moleketi abagcotshwe esikhathini esifushane esedlule njengePhini LikaShansela noShansela ngokulandelana kwabo e-Nelson Mandela University.

src: Sehlopha sa Aforika Borwa ka ho hapa dikgau tse tharo Mmokeng wa bo10 wa Bohwebi ba Lefatshe Istanbul, Turkey ka Mmesa 2018, ho ananeleng boitlamo le boikitlaetso ba naha ho ntshetseng pele diSMMLefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Kgwebo tse Nyenyane, hammoho le molekane wa lona, 22 on Sloane, e leng khamphase e kgolo ho fetisisa Aforika ya dikgwebo tse qalang, le hapile Kgau ya Selemo ya Naha ya Bohwebi Lefatsheng.
tgt: IQembu LaseNingizimu Afrika ngokunqoba kwalo izindondo ezintathu eNgqungqutheleni Yeshumi Yomhlaba Yezokusungulwa Nokuqhutshwa Kwamabhizinisi ebibanjelwe e-Istanbul, kwelase-Turkey ngoMbasa 2018, eziwuphawu lokuhlonishwa kokuzibophezela nokuzimisela kwaleli lizwe ekuthuthukiseni ama-SMMUMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwamabhizinisi Amancane kanye nesikhungo obambisene naso, i-22 on Sloane, okuyisikhungo esikhulu kunazo zonke e-Afrika esilekelela osomabhizinisi abasafufusa ukuze bakwazi ukuphemba amabhizinisi abo, banqoba iNdondo Yelizwe Elivelele Kulo Nyaka KwezokuSungulwa Nokuqhutshwa Kwamabhizinisi Emhlabeni.

src: Sehlopha sa Aforika Borwa se boetse sa hapa Kgau ya Bomampodi ba Letshwao la Boitsebahatso le Bomampodi ba Diphuputso, e ananelang dinaha tsa Kgokelano ya Bohwebi Lefatsheng ho tswa lefatsheng ka bophara.
tgt: Iqembu LaseNingizimu Afrika lanqoba futhi nendondo i-Brand Champions Award kanye ne-Research Champions Award, okuyizindondo ezihlonipha igalelo lalawo mazwe emhlabeni jikelele ayingxenye ye-Global Entrepreneurship Network.

src: DithonyoDithonyo tsohle di itshetlehile netefatsong ya mangolo a thuto le kamohelo e loketseng.
tgt: AbaqashiweUkuqashwa kwabo bonke abalandelayo kuzokwamukelwa ngokusemthethweni kuphela uma sekuqinisekiswe ubufakazi beziqu zabo zemfundo futhi uma sebenikeziwe izimvume ezifanelekile.

src: Motlatsi wa Letona Mondli Gungubele e le Modulasetulo sa Boto ya Public Investment Corporation SOC Limited.
tgt: IPhini LikaNgqongqoshe uMondli Gungubele njengoSihlalo Webhodi yophiko lukahulumeni lokuhehwa kwabatshali-zimali, olubizwa nge-Public Investment Corporation SOC Limited.

src: Mof Thandaza Zenobia Lungile Shandu e le Motlatsi wa Molaodi e Moholo: Tshehetso le Tlhophiso ya Ditheo Lefapheng la Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Setso.
tgt: Nkz Thandaza Zenobia Lungile Shandu njengePhini LikaMqondisi-Jikelele: Ophikweni Lokwesekwa Kwesikhungo Nokuhanjelaniswa Kahle Kwemisebenzi Eyenziwayo eMnyangweni Wokwengamela Ngokubambisana Nezindaba Zendabuko.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro la, 9 Motsheanong 2018, Tuynhuys, Motse KapaDintlha tsa Hajwale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lahlangana ngoLwesithathu, mhla ziyi-9 kuNhlaba 2018, eTuynhuys, eKapaIzindaba Ezisematheni.

src: Tlhekefetso e Amanang le Batho ba Bong bo Itseng (GBV).
tgt: Udlame Oluqondiswe Kubantu Bobulili Obuthile (i-GBV).

src: Kabinete e boeletsa kgalemo ya yona ya tlhekefetso ya basadi le bana, mme e re kgothaletsa bohle mafapheng a rona a fapaneng hore re nke mehato kgahlano le tlhekefetso ya basadi, bana le ditjhaba tsa Basadi ba ratanang le basadi, Banna ba ratanang le banna, Batho ba ratanang le batho ba bong ka bobedi le Batho ba sa ikamahanyeng le bong ba bona ba tlhaho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lilugxeka liphindelela udlame oluqondiswe kubantu besifazane nezingane, lisimema sonke ezindaweni ezihlukene esikuzo ukuthi sithathe isinyathelo sokuqeda udlame olubhekiswe kubantu besifazane, ngezingane kanye nabantu besifazane abathandanayo, abantu besilisa abathandanayo, abantu abathandana nabantu besifazane kanjalo nabesilisa kanye nabantu abashintsha ubulili babo.

src: Ke mosebetsi wa moAfrika Borwa e mong le e mong ho ruta ba bang ka ditokelo tsa basadi le bana, le ka mekgwa e fapaneng e teng ho thusa mahlasipa a tlhekefetso.
tgt: Kuwumsebenzi wabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukufundisana ngamalungelo abantu besifazane nezingane, nangezinye izindlela ezinhlobonhlobo zokuxazulula le nkinga ezikhona ezingasiza izisulu zodlame.

src: Kabinete e amohela qeto ya Lekgotla le Phahameng la Gauteng Borwa ya ho ahlolela mmolai ya fumanweng molato Sandile Mantsoe ho hlola dilemo tse 32 tjhankaneng bakeng sa polao ya kgarebe ya hae ya mehleng Karabo Mokoena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela isinqumo seNkantolo Ephakeme yaseNingizimu neGauteng sokugweba uSandile Mantsoe, ongumbulali, ogwetshwe iminyaka engama-32 ebhadla ejele ngokubulala uKarabo Mokoena owayeyintombi yakhe.

src: Dikgetsi tse ding tse jwalo ka ho fumanwa ha setopo sa Katlego Joja ya dilemo di 10 ho la Mamelodi Bophirima, botjhabela ho Pretoria le polao ya Zolile Khumalo, ke mmelaelwa eo e leng moithuti wa mehleng, Yunivesithing ya Theknoloji ya Mangosuthu ho la Durban, ke sesupo sa mathata a tswellang ho re phepetsa jwalo ka naha.
tgt: Amanye amacala anjengokutholakala kwesidumbu sikaKatlego Joja owayeneminyaka eyi-10 eMamelodi West, eMpumalanga nePitoli kanjalo nokubulawa kukaZolile Khumalo, ngomunye owayengumfundi waseMangosuthu University of Technology eDurban, awubufakazi bokuqhubeka kwezinselele esibhekene nazo njengezwe.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona ho lelapa la Joja le la Khumalo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lidlulisa ukuzwelana kwalo nomndeni wakwaJoja kanye nowakaKhumalo.

src: Ha mekgatlo ya toka le tshebetso ya molao di shebane le ho netefatsa hore batlodi ba molao ba fumana kotlo tse ba loketseng, rona jwalo ka setjhaba re na le karolo eo re lokelang ho e bapla ho emisa bonokwane bona.
tgt: Njengoba izinkantolo nezinhlaka zomthetho zibhekene nomsebenzi wokuqinisekisa ukuthi abenzi bobubi baqondana nengalo yomthetho, kunendima okumele siyidlale ekuqedeni lobu bugebengu njengomphakathi.

src: MaAfrika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho ikakgela ka setotswana maneneong a tshehetso le ho atolosa tsebo ditjhabeng le makaleng a bona.
tgt: Izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika zikhuthazwa ukuthi zizibandakanye ezinhlanganweni zokuqwashisa imiphakathi emisebenzini kanye nasezindaweni ezihlala kuzo.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa mahlasipa ho tlaleha ditlolo tsena tsa molao tse soto ho ditheo tsa molao, tse tlamehang ho batlisisa ditlaleho tsena tsa GBV le ho nka mehato e tiileng e molaong ho netefatsa hore ba fihlela toka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde likhuthaze izisulu ukuthi zibike ngalobu bugebengu ezinhlakeni zomthetho, okumele zenze uphenyo ngezinsolo ze-GBV futhi zisebenzisana nomthetho ukuze lziqiniseke ukwenzeka kobulungiswa.

src: Tabeng e fapaneng empa e amanang, Lekgotla le Akaretsang la Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UNGA) le phatlaladitse la 13 Phuptjane e le Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Tsebisahatso ka Boswefe.
tgt: Kolunye udaba oluseceleni kodwa olungaqhelile kakhulu kulolu, Umhlangano Owujikelele weNhlangano Yezizwe (i-UN) wamemezela ukuthi usuku lomhla ziyi-13 kuNhlangulana wuSuku Lwamazwe Ngamazwe Lokuqwashisa Ngokuba Nebala Elimhlophe (i-Albinism).

src: Letsholo lena le ikemiseditse ho atolosa tsebo mabapi le batho ba phelang le boswefe ba sireleditsweng ka botlalo ke Molaotheo wa Riphaboliki ya Afrika Borwa wa 1996.
tgt: Lo mkhankaso uhlose ukuqwashisa ngabantu abaphila nebala elimhlophe abavikelwe uMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika we-1996 ngokugcwele.

src: Ke boikarabello ba maAfrika Borwa ohle ho ithuta le ho ruta ba bang setjhabeng ka boswefe ele ho fedisa ditumelo tse seng nnete le tse fosahetseng.
tgt: Kuwumsebenzi wabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuzifundisa bona uqobo kanye nabanye abantu ngebala elimhlophe ukuze kuqedwe izinkolo-ze kanye nokudukisa okukhona.

src: Hona ho tla fokotsa masisapelo ao batho ba nang le boswefe le malapa a bona ba fetang ho ona.
tgt: Lokhu kuzonciphisa ukuhlukumezeka abantu abaphila nebala elimhlophe kanye nemindeni yabo ababhekana nabo.

src: Qeto ya Difedereishene tsa Mekgatlo ya Matjhaba ya Diatlelete (IAAF)2.1 Kabinete e hlahisitse matshwenyeho a yona mabapi le diketsahalo tse amanang le melawana ya IAAF.2 Kabinete e amohela mosebetsi o etswang ke Lefapha la Dipapadi le Boikgathollo la Afrika Borwa, le taba ya hore phanele ya maemo a hodimo ya ditsebi makaleng a amanang a tsa bongaka le molao e se e kopantswe ke lefapha.
tgt: Isinqumo Senhlangano Yemidlalo Yama-Athlethiksi Emhlabeni Jikelele (i-IAAF)2.1 IKhabhinethi liveze ukukhathazeka kwalo ngemithethonqubo emisha yeNhlangano Yemidlalo Yama-Athlethiksi Emhlabeni Jikelele (i-IAAF).2 IKhabhinethi lamukela umsebenzi owenziwa uMnyango Wezemidlalo Nokungcebeleka eNingizimu Afrika (i-SRSA) kanye, nokuthi ithimba lochwepheshe abasezingeni eliphezulu emikhakheni yezokwelapha nowezomthetho bahlanganiswa i-SRSLeli thimba lizofundisisa le mithethonqubo, licubungule ubufakazi bezobuchwepheshe i-IAAF eyethembele kubo.

src: Phanele ena e tla hlahloba melawana ena ka hloko mme e manolle bopaki ba saense boo IAAF e itshetlehileng ho bona.
tgt: Lizohlola lonke ucwaningo oselwenziwe kanye nobufakazi bezobuchwepheshe kanjalo nezimo zezokulandelwa kwezinkambisonhle bese lisebenzise umphumela ukuze kuphikisanwe nale mithethonqubo ezinkundleni ezifanele.3 IKhabhinethi limema bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi beseke abadlali nabasubathi okungenzeka bathintwe ile mithethonqubo lapha ekhaya nakwezinye izindawo emhlabeni.

src: Boemo Leboya Bophirima.
tgt: Isimo saseNyakatho Ntshonalanga.

src: Kabinete e ile ya fuwa tlaleho ya Sehlopha sa Tshebetso sa Matona a Mafapha a Kopaneng (IMTT) mabapi le Leboya Bophirima.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lathola umbiko ovela kuThimba loNgqongqoshe (i-IMTT) mayelana nesimo saseNyakatho Ntshonalanga.

src: Tlaleho ena e fane ka mosebetsi wa ho qala o seng o entswe dibekeng tse pedi tse fetileng.
tgt: Lo mbiko ubuqukethe umsebenzi oyisisekelo owenziwe emasontweni amabili adlule.

src: Kabinete e kgotsofaditswe ke kgatelopele e entsweng ke IMTT maitekong a yona a ho tlisa botsitso Porofenseng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi laneliseka ngenqubekela phambili eyenziwe i-IMTT emizamweni yayo yokuletha uzinzo kulesi Sifundazwe.

src: IMTT, e etelletsweng pele ke Letona le Kantorong ya Mopresidente, Ngaka Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma, e tla dula e shebane le ditaba tsena tsa Leboya Bophirima.
tgt: I-IMTT, eholwa uNgqongqoshe oseHhovisi LikaMongameli, uDkt.

src: Tlaleho e felletseng mabapi le diphetho tsa mosebetsi ona wa IMTT e tla fanwa ho la Leboya Bophirima bekeng e tlang.
tgt: Ngesonto elizayo kuzobanjwa umhlangano wokwethulela abemithombo yezindaba imiphumela yomsebenzi owenziwe i-IMTT eNyakatho Ntshonalanga.

src: Foramo ya Moruo wa Lekala la Setjhaba le la Poraefete ya Japane le Afrika.
tgt: Isigcawu Sezomnotho Kahulumeni Nowezimboni Ezizimele seJapan ne-Afrika.

src: Mopresidente Cyril Ramaphosa o fane ka puo ya sehlooho Foramong ya pele ya Moruo wa Lekala la Setjhaba le la Poraefete ya Japane le Afrika e neng e tshwaretswe Sandton Convention Centre ho tloha ka la 3 ho isa la 4 Motsheanong 2018.
tgt: UMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa wethule inkulumo yosuku lapho kuvulwa umhlangano weSigcawu Sezomnotho Kahulumeni Nowezimboni Ezizimele seJapan ne-Afrika obewubanjelwe eSandton Convention Centre kusukela mhla zi-3 kuya kumhla zi-4 kuNhlaba 2018.

src: Foramo e ne e boetse e tsamaiswa ke Afrika Borwa, hammoho le mmuso wa Japane le Mokgatlo wa Japane wa Kgwebo ya Kantle.
tgt: Isigcawu besesingethwe iNingizimu Afrika ngokubambisana nohulumeni waseJapan kanye ne-Japan External Trade Organization.

src: Kabinete e amohela boitlamo bo tswellang bo entsweng Kopanong ya Matjhaba ya Tokyo ya Ntshetsopele ya Afrika ho la Nairobi, Kenya ka 2016, moo teng Japane e ileng ya itlama ho fana ka dibilione tse $30 tsa Amerika ho Afrika pakeng tsa 2016 le 2019.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela ukuzibophezela okuqhubekayo okwenzeka kuNkomfa Yamazwe Ngamazwe aseTokyo Ngokuthuthukiswa Kwe-Afrika ebibanjelwe eNairobi, eKenya ngowezi-2016, lapho izwe laseJapan lathembisa ukutshala izigidigidi ezingu-US $30 phakathi kowezi-2016 nowezi-2019 e-Afrika.

src: Ke dikhamphani tse fetang 100 tsa Japane tse leng teng Afrika.
tgt: Zingaphezu kwama-100 izinkampani zaseJapan ezikhona e-Afrika.

src: Keketso ya Tefiso ya Tshepe le Aluminiamo ke naha ya Amerika.
tgt: Ukwenyuswa Kwentela Yokuhwebelana Yensimbi Ne-aliminiyamu i-United States (US).

src: Kabinete e swabisitse ke qeto ya Amerika ya hose behelle Afrika Borwa kathoko tefisong ya ditheko tsa tshepe le aluminiamo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lidlulisa ukudumala kwalo ngesinqumo esithathwe i-US sokufaka iNingizimu Afrika emazweni akhokhiswa intela yokuhwebelana yensimbi ne-aliminiyamu.

src: Mmuso wa Afrika Borwa o tla tswelapele ho bua le ba matleng mmusong wa Amerika ho fumana sephetho se amohelehang ho mahlakore ka bobedi.
tgt: Uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika uzoqhubeka nokubonisana nezikhulu zase-US ukuze kutholakale umphumela owanelisa la mazwe womabili.

src: Kabinete e boetse e kgothaletsa dikgwebo tsa lehae tse rekisang thepa kantle ho naha ho tswelapele ho kopa bareki ba Amerika hore ba etse dikopo tsa dipehellothoko tsa dihlahiswa, kaha dikhamphani tsa Afrika Borwa di rekisa dihlahiswa tse ikgethileng le tse sebeditsweng ka karolo hore di lo sebetswa hape ha di fihla ho la Amerika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinda likhuthaza abahwebi bakuleli abadayisela amanye amazwe imikhiqizo yensimbi ne-aliminiyamu ukuthi baqhubeke nokunxenxa abathengi bale mikhiqizo base-US ukuthi bafake isicelo sokuthi lemikhiqizo ingakhokhiswa intela yokuhwebelana, njengoba kuyimikhiqizo etholakala eNingizimu Afrika kuphela futhi iyimikhiqizo eluhlaza nengalungiswanga yaqedwa nezakulungiswa iqedelelwe e-US kwakhiwe neminye imikhiqizo ngayo.

src: Tsosoloso ya Diphaka tsa Indasteri.
tgt: Ukuvuselelwa Kwezikhungo Zezimboni.

src: Kabinete e amohela phethelo ya mokgahlelo wa pele wa Phaka ya Indasteri ya Phuthaditjhaba Foreisetata jwalo ka mohato wa bohlokwa tshebetsong ya Lenaneo la Tsosoloso ya Diphaka tsa Indasteri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela ukuqedwa kwesigaba sokuqala sokuvuselelwa Kwesikhungo iPhuthaditjhaba Industrial Park eFreyistata njengesinyathelo esibaluleke kakhulu esesithathiwe ukuze kuqaliswe uHlelo Lokuvuselela Izikhungo Zezimboni.

src: Dintlafatso tsa boleng ba R50 milione di tla hohela barekisi ba lehae hore ba thehe dikgwebo tsa bona mona ka lebaka la meaho e ntlafetseng le polokeho.
