tgt: Izindawo zaseNingizimu Afrika ezivikelwe zibandakanya izizinda zamagugu omhlaba, iziqiwu, izizinda zemvelo, izizinda zemvelo ezikhethekile, imvelo evikelekile, izindawo zasolwandle ezivikelwe, izindawo ezisezintabeni ezineziziba zamanzi, futhi ikakhulukazi izindawo ezingamahlathi avikelwe, kanye nezizinda zemvelo ezingamahlathi.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Maemo a Ditherisano a Aforika Borwa bakeng sa Kopano ya bo13 ya Seboka sa ho Notla Mekga e yang Mmokeng wa Ramsar o mabapi le Diqanthana tse Diphuleng (Ramsar COP 12) e tla tshwarelwa Dubai, United Arab Emirates, ho tloha ka la 21 ho isa ho la 29 Mphalane 2018.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyigunyazile iMibono YeNingizimu Afrika Ezosetshenziswa Ezingxoxweni zoMhlangano we-13 Wengqungquthela Yamazwe Asayine Isivumelwano Samaxhaphozi Sase-Ramsar (i-Ramsar COP 13) ezobanjelwa e-Dubai, kwelase-United Arab Emirates, kusukela mhla zingama-21 kuze kube ngumhla zingama-29 kuMfumfu 2018.

src: Dipheo tse batsi tsa Mmoka wa Ramsar ke ho netefatsa boteng ba paballo le tshebediso e tjhatsi ya diqanthana tsohle tse diphuleng.
tgt: Izinjongo ezibanzi zeSivumelwano sase-Ramsar wukuqinisekisa ukulondolozwa nokusetshenziswa ngobuhlakani kwawo wonke amaxhaphozi.

src: Aforika Borwa teng, diqanthana tse diphuleng ke tsona tse tlokotsing ka ho fetisisa ditikolohong tsohle, ka 48% ya tsona tse leng kotsing e mpe.
tgt: ENingizimu Afrika, amaxhaphozi asengcupheni kakhulu kuyo yonke imiphilandawonye yemvelo (ama-ekhosisitimu), njengoba angama-48% kuwona esengozini enkulu yokushabalala.

src: Di thusa taolong ya mehlodi ya metsi e le karolo ya mokgwa wa boitlhahanelo taolong ya komello.
tgt: Lokhu kufaka isandla ekuphathweni kwemithombo yamanzi njengengxenye yendlela yokulawulwa kwesomiso ebonisa inkuthalo nokuthatha izinyathelo eziphathekayo.

src: Dibili.
tgt: IMithethosivivinywa.

src: Kabinete e ananetse phatlalatso ya Bili ya Sehlomathiso sa Ditlhapiso tsa Dikotsi le Mafu tse Bakwang ke Maemo a Mosebetsing.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukushicilelwa kweSichibiyelo Somthethosivivinywa Wezinxephezelo Zokulimala kanye Nokungenwa Yizifo Emsebenzini wezi-2018 ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngawo.

src: Bili ena, e hlomathisang Molao wa Ditlhapiso tsa Dikotsi le Mafu tse Bakwang ke Maemo a Mosebetsing, 1993 (Molao wa 130 wa 1993) e ananela basebetsi ba malapeng, ba neng ba ntse ba teetswe kathoko Molaong, e le basebetsi ka sepheo sa hore ba fole melemo, esita le ho ntlafatsa melemo e seng e le teng.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa, ochibiyela uMthetho Wezinxephezelo Zokulimala kanye Nokungenwa Yizifo Emsebenzini, we-1993 (uMthetho ongunombolo 130 we-1993) uvikela amalungelo abasebenzi basemakhaya, abebeshiywe ngaphandle kulo Mthetho, futhi ubamukele njengabasebenzi abasemthethweni ukuze bathole imihlomulo efanele, futhi kwenziwe ngcono naleyo mihlomulo abayitholayo njengamanje.2 .

src: Dihlomathiso tsena di ntlafatsa melemo e lefshwang ho basebetsi le beng ka bona, di bile di habile ho thusa basebetsi ba lemetseng le ba kulang hore ba hlabollwe ba be ba busetswe mesebetsing le setjhabeng.
tgt: Lezi zichibiyelo zizokwenza ngcono imihlomulo ekhokhelwa abasebenzi nabantu ababondlayo, futhi zihlose ukulekelela abasebenzi abalimele kanye nalabo abangenwe yizifo ukuze bathole usizo lokwelashwa okufanelekile futhi badidiyelwe kabusha endaweni abasebenzela kuyona kanye nasemphakathini.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho lelekelwa ha Bili ya 2018 ya Sehlomathiso sa Toka ya Bana Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukuthi iSichibiyelo Somthethosivivinywa Wobulungiswa Bezingane wezi-2018 sethulwe ePhalamende.

src: Bili ena e hlomathisa Molao wa Toka ya Bana, 2008 (Molao wa 75 wa 2008) e le ho hlopha botjha dilemo tsa mathomo tsa bokgoni ba botlodi ba WEBTOKEN bana, ka ho di eketsa ho tloha dilemong tse 10 ho ya ho tse Bili ena e boela e tswelapele ho sikara ditokelo tsa bana moo di hohlanang le molao teng.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho Wobulungiswa Bezingane, wezi-2008 (uMthetho ongunombolo 75 wezi-2008) ukuze kubuyekezwe iminyaka yobudala ephansi yokubekwa icala lobugebengu ngokuthi ikhushulwe isuswa eminyakeni eyi-10 iye eminyakeni eyi-12.

src: Bili ena e boela e hakolla taba ya bokgoni ba botlodi ba molao ho ya tshwepholo, ka ho tlosa tlhoko ena ya ho bontsha bokgoni ba botlodi ba molao molemong wa tshwepholo le dipatlisiso tse etswang pele.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uthatha izinyathelo ezithe xaxa ekuvikeleni amalungelo ezingane eziphule umthetho.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho kenngwa ha Bili ya 2018 ya Sehlomathiso sa Bofofisi ba Difofane Palamenteng.
tgt: Futhi lo Mthethosivivinywa uqeda ukuxhunyaniswa kodaba lwamandla okwenza isenzo sobugebengu nokunikezwa isigwebo sokufakwa kwesaphulamthetho ngaphansi kohlelo lwesijeziso esihlukile esikhundleni sokugqunywa ejele, ngokuthi kususwe umbandela wokuthi kuboniswe ubufakazi obuqanda ikhanda ngaphambi kokuthi kuthathwe isinqumo sokufakwa kwesaphulamthetho ngaphansi kohlelo lwesijeziso esihlukile kanye nokwenziwa kophenyo olwandulela ukuqulwa kwecala.

src: Bili ena, e hlomathisang Molao wa Bofofisi ba Difofane, 2009 (Molao wa 13 wa 2009), e tla matlafatsa meralo ya tshireletso le taolo ya polokeho difofaneng, ho netefatsa boitjaro ba nako e telele esita le botsitso ba indasteri ya bofofisi ba difofane.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa, ochibiyela uMthetho Wezokuhamba Ngezindiza, wezi-2009 (uMthetho ongunombolo 13 wezi-2009), uzoqinisa izinhlaka zemithetho elawula ezokuphepha emkhakheni wezokuhamba ngezindiza, nokuvikeleka kanye nokuvikelwa kwemvelo ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukusimama nozinzo embonini yezokuhamba ngezindiza.

src: Sena se tla netefatsa hore Aforika Borwa e tswelapele ho fihlella boitlamo ba yona ba matjhaba lepatlelong la bofofisi ba difofane, e leng ntho e matlafatsang tshehetso ntshetsopeleng ya moruo wa rona e le sehotetso sa keketseho ya kgwebisano, bohahlaudi le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi.
tgt: Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyaqhubeka nokuthobela izibopho zamazwe ngamazwe emkhakheni wezokuhamba ngezindiza, okuyinto ezoqinisa ukwesekwa kwentuthuko yezomnotho yaleli lizwe futhi kuholele ekukhuphukeni kwezinga nomthamo wezohwebo, ezokuvakasha kanye nokuvulwa kwamathuba omsebenzi.

src: Bili ena e boela e fana, ho tse ding, ka boikemelo ba tshebetso ba kotsi ya sefofane le patlisiso ya ketsahalo eo, esita le ho lokisa diphapano le mafokodi.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uhlinzekela futhi, phakathi kokunye, ukuqhutshwa ngokuzimela kophenyo lwezingozi nezigameko eziphathelene nezindiza, kanye nokulungiswa kwezingxenye zomthetho ezinokuphikisana nokungahambelani okuthile kanye nobuthakathaka.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Imicimbi Ezayo.

src: Beke ya Thusong Service Centre.
tgt: Iviki lama-Thusong Service Centre.

src: Kahare ho moeleo wa Kgwedi ya Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba, Beke ya Thusong Service Centre ya selemo le selemo ho tloha ka la 17 ho isa ho la 21 Loetse 2018 katlasa mokotaba o reng: “Thuma Mina: Ho isa Ditshebeletso tsa Setjhaba Bathong”, e fana ka lepatlelo le leng la hore mmuso o ise ditshebeletso tsa setjhaba bathong.
tgt: Njengoba lenzeka ngaphansi kweNyanga Yezemisebenzi Kahulumeni, iViki lama-Thusong Service Centre elibanjwa minyaka yonke kusukela mhla ziyi-17 kuya kumhla zingama-21 kuMandulo 2018 ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Thuma Mina: Sihambisa Izinsizakalo Zikahulumeni Kubantu”, lihlinzeka ngethuba lokuthi uhulumeni ahambise izinsizakalo zikahulumeni kubantu.

src: Di-Thusong Service Centre ke ditsi tseo ho tsona ho fumanehang dintho tsohle bakeng sa phihlello ya ditshebeletso tsa mmuso le lesedi, mme di-Thusong Service Centre kaofela tse 133 naha ka bophara ke ditsi tsa tshepo, phihlello, tokiso ya menyetla, tekano le matlafatso ho bao ba neng ba kotetswe kgubung ya ntshetsopele ya moruo wa setjhaba.
tgt: Ama-Thusong Service Centre yizikhungo ezingontozonke lapho kutholakala khona izinsizakalo zikahulumeni kanye nolwazi, futhi lama-Thusong Service Centre ayi-133 atholakala ezweni lonkana ayizizinda zethemba, ukufinyelela, ukulungisa izinto ezingahanjiswanga ngendlela efanele esikhathini esedlule, ikhwalithi kanye nokuhlonyiswa kwalabo bantu ababencishwe amathuba esikhathini esedlule ekuthuthukisweni kwenhlalo-mnotho yabantu kuleli.

src: Mmuso o sebeletsa ho hokela Mokgwatsamaiso wa Taolo ya Mekoloko, o tla fokotsa mosebetsi wa lephallo e le ho thusetsa phokotsong ya nako ya ho leta.
tgt: Uhulumeni wenza imizamo yokufaka uHlelo Lokulawula Imigqa Yokulinda Izinsizakalo oluzonciphisa izinqubo nemidanti eminingi okumele ilandelwe, ukuze kuncishiswe nesikhathi sokulinda.

src: Mokgwatsamaiso ona o tla hokelwa ditsing tsohle naha ka bophara, ka tsepamiso ya maikutlo e boelang e le kgokelong ya theknoloji ya lesedi la dikgokahano (ICT), e leng yona e thusang phanong ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luzofakwa kuzo zonke izizinda zikahulumeni ezweni lonkana futhi kuzogxilwa nasekuxhumaneni ngobuchwepheshe bolwazi nokuxhumana (i-ICT), okuyinto eyenza kube lula ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zikahulumeni.

src: Seboka sa Lefatshe sa Telecom sa Mokgatlo wa Basebetsi wa Dikgokahanyo tsa Mehala tsa Matjhaba (ITU) sa 2018.
tgt: INgqungquthela ye-ITU Yezokuxhumana Ngezingcingo Yamazwe Ngamazwe yowezi-2018.

src: Kabinete e amohela Seboka sa Lefatshe sa Telecom sa ITU sa 2018 Durban ho tloha ka la 9 ho isa ho la 13 Loetse 2018, katlasa mokotaba o reng “Tshibollo bakeng sa Ntshetsopele ya Theknoloji ya Dijithale”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyayamukela iNgqungquthela Yamazwe Ngamazwe Yezokuxhumana Ngezingcingo Yenhlangano Yezokuxhumana Ngezingcingo Emhlabeni (i-ITU) yowezi-2018 ezobanjelwa eThekwini kusukela mhla ziyisi-9 kuya kumhla ziyi-13 kuMandulo 2018, ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi “Ukuqhamuka Nemiqondo Emisha Ukuthuthukisa Nokusebenzisa Ubuxhakaxhaka Besimanjemanje”.

src: Ketsahalo ena, e tlang Aforika lekgetlo la pele, e fana ka monyetla wa seabo se eketsehileng sa dinaha tsa Aforika, ho habilwe ho matlafatsa ICT Aforika jwalo ka ha e le moetapele wa ntshetsopele le tshibollo.
tgt: Lo mcimbi, oza eNingizimu Afrika okokuqala ngqa, uhlinzeka ngethuba lokuthi amazwe akhuphule izinga lokubamba kwawo iqhaza ukuze kuqiniswe futhi kuthuthukiswe ukusetshenziswa kwe-ICT e-Afrika njengensiza ezoletha intuthuko nokuqanjwa kwezinhlelo nezinsizakusebenza ezintsha.

src: Seboka sa selemo le selemo se hohela baromuwa ba kahodimo ho 9 000 ho tswa lefatsheng lohle, ka baetapele ba mmuso le ba diindasteri ba phopholetsang ba bile ba hlwaya menyetla le ditlwaelo tse ntle, haholo tsa ntshetsopele ya moruo wa setjhaba ka ICDintho tsa bohlokwa tse tla tshohlwa di akga: 5G bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya theknoloji ya dijithale, tshebedisanommoho tshireletsong ya inthanete, ditshebeletso tsa ditjhelete tsa dijithale esita le disatalaete bakeng sa ntshetsopele e theknoloji ya dijithale.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ebanjwa minyaka yonke iheha izithunywa ezingaphezu kwezi-9 000 ezivela emhlabeni wonke jikelele, lapho ohulumeni kanye nabaholi bemboni becubungula futhi bahlonze amathuba nezinkambiso ezingungqaphambili zokuthuthukisa inhlalomnotho ngokusebenzisa i-ICIzihloko ezisemqoka okuzobhungwa ngazo zibandakanya: ukusetshenziswa kwe-5G ukuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa ubuxhakaxhaka besimanjemanje, ukubambisana ekuqinisekiseni ukuvikeleka kwe-inthanethi, izinsizakalo zezimali ezihlinzekwa ngobuxhakaxhaka besimanjemanje kanye namasathelayithi okuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa ubuxhakaxhaka besimanjemanje.

src: ITU ya 2018 ya Seboka sa Lefatshe sa Telecom e tshwarwa ka nako eo Aforika Borwa e kenyang tshebetsong diprojeke tsa bohlokwa tsa naha tse akgang Lewa la Naha la e-Government le tsepamisitseng maikutlo phetohong ya dijithale ya ditshebeletso tsa mmuso le ICT ya naha, Lewa la Tshebetso la Dikgwebo tse Nyane, tse Mahareng le tse Nyenyane (SMME), le tsetselelang ho utolla bokgoni ba lekala la Aforika Borwa la di-SMME tsa ICDisebediswa tsena di thea tikoloho e thusetsang kgolo ya lekala ebile e netefatsa boitjaro ba yona ba nako e telele.
tgt: INgqungquthela ye-ITU Yezokuxhumana Ngezingcingo Yamazwe Ngamazwe yowezi-2018 isingathwa ngesikhathi lapho iNingizimu Afrika iqalisa imiklamo kazwelonke esemqoka kakhulu, ebandakanya iQhingasu Likazwelonke Lokuqhuba Umsebenzi Kahulumeni Nge-inthanethi eligxile ekuletheni uguquko lokusetshenziswa kwe-inthanethi nobuxhakaxhaka besimanjemanje uma kuhlinzekwa izinsizakalo zikahulumeni kanye neQhingasu Likazwelonke Lokweseka Amabhizinisi e-ICT Asafufusa (ama-SMME), elihlose ukuvula amathuba okukhula nokudlondlobala komkhakha wama-SMME e-ICT eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Melaetsa.
tgt: Imiyalezo.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ho:lelapa le mahlonokong esita le setjhaba sohle sa Yunivesithi ya Theknoloji ya Tshwane (TUT) kamora ho hlokahala ha Katlego Monareng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lidlulisa amazwi enduduzo:emndenini osemanzini kanye nomphakathi wonkana weNyuvesi Yezobuchwepheshe yase-Tshwane kulandela ukudlula emhlabeni kuka-Katlego Monareng.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ya hore ho theolwe moya ha sepolesa se ntse se batlisisa, ho netefatsa hore mang kapa mang ya molato ka ho shwa hoo, o tobana le letsoho la WEBTOKEN lelapa le metswalle ya batho ba robedi ba shwetseng ho phatloheng ho bileng femeng ya dibetsa ya Denel Somerset West Kapa Bophirimela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyabanxusa abantu ukuba behlise imimoya ngenkathi amaphoyisa enza uphenyo lwawo ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi umbulali ubhekana nengalo yomthetho.

src: baratuwa ba bao ba ileng ba shwela mollong o kotsi o ropohileng moahong o abelanwang ke Mafapha a Mmuso wa Profense ya Gauteng a Bophelo bo Botle, Bodulo ba Batho le Puso ya Tshebedisanommoho.
tgt: emndenini nabangani babantu abayisishiyagalombili ababhubhe ekuqhumeni okwenzeke efemini yezikhali yakwa-Denel e-Somerset West eNtshonalanga Kapa.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa batho ba Zimbabwe ka ho hahamalla katlehong ya mmuso o motjha o etelletsweng pele ke Moporesidente Emmerson Mnangagwa, ya ileng a hlomamiswa ka la 26 Phato 2018.
tgt: izihlobo nabangani babantu abashone enhlekeleleni yomlilo oqubuke esakhiweni esisetshenziswa ngokuhlanganyela yiminyango kaHulumeni Wesifundazwe sase-Gauteng, okunguMnyango Wezempilo, Owezokuhlaliswa Kwabantu kanye Nowezokuphatha Ngokubambisana.

src: Moporesidente Ramaphosa o ikamahantse le baetapele ba bang ba Aforika Harare ho ya inwesa ka nkgo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisele abantu baseZimbabwe ngoguquko olwenzeke ngempumelelo lokuthatha izintambo kukahulumeni omusha oholwa nguMongameli Emmerson Mnangagwa, owagcotshwa mhla zingama-26 kuNcwaba 2018.

src: Kabinete e tshehetsa boikitlaetso ba Moporesidente Ramaphosa ba ho sebedisana le Zimbabwe ho ntlafatsa dikamano tsa nalane, sepolotiki le tsa boena, ka thasisetso e tsepameng matlafatsong ya tshebedisanommoho ya moruo.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa wahlanganyela nabanye abaholi base-Afrika eHarare ukuyozibonela ngawakhe ngenkathi kubanjwe lo mkhosi.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Lekgotla la Saense le Diphuputso tsa Diindasteri (CSIR), haholoholo bafuputsi ba batshehadi, diphuputsong tsa bophelo bo botle tse etsetswang ho ntlafatsa mokgwatsamaiso wa bophelo bo botle wa naha ena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyakweseka ukuzibophezela kukaMongameli Ramaphosa ekutheni uzosebenzisana ngokubambisana okukhulu nelizwe laseZimbabwe ukuze kuphuculwe ubudlelwano bomlando, ezepolitiki kanye nobungani obuphakathi kwalawa mazwe, futhi okuwubudlelwano obuzogxila ikakhulukazi ekuqinisekiseni ubambiswano lwezomnotho.

src: tjhipi e fofonelang lefu la tswekere e le ho disa bophahamo ba tswekere mading, ka ho sekaseka moya o tswang ka hanong (ii) ho etsuwa ha dibaktheriya tsa mmele hore di sebediswe tlhahisong ya ditsuonyana, tlhapi ya dusky-cob le ya abalone, di tla thusa tlhahisong ya dihlahiswa tsa tlholeho tsa diphoofolo, tse se nang antibayothiki, dikhemikhale le dithethefatsi tse hodisang ka potlako (iii) esita le ho tswelapele ho utolla diphuputso tsa disele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyawuncoma impela uMkhandlu Wocwaningo Lwezesayensi Nezimboni, ikakhulukazi abacwaningi besifazane, maqondana nocwaningo lwezempilo olwenziwayo njengamanje ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa nokwenza ngcono uhlelo losizo nokunakekelwa kwezempilo kuleli.

src: Kabinete e ile ya kopanela Union Buildings Pretoria, ka Laboraro, mohla la 19 Loetse 2018.Dintlha tsa Ha jwale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi labamba umhlangano walo ngoLwesithathu mhla ziyi-19 kuMandulo 2018, e-Union Buildings, ePitoli.

src: Moruo.
tgt: Izindaba Ezisematheni.

src: Kabinete e amohela thuso e nanabetswang ke ba kgwebo bakeng sa ho romelwa ha baporofeshenale ba lekala la poraefete mmusong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyasamukela isiphakamiso somkhakha wamabhizinisi sokuphakanyiswa kwamagama ongoti bomkhakha ozimele abazolekelela uhulumeni.

src: Sena se ropohile kopanong ya boitlhophisetso e neng e tshwerwe ke Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa le baetapele ba kgwebo, maqosa a kgethehileng a botsetedi le Mokgakolo wa Bahlanka ba Baholo ba Phethahatso (CEO), pele ho Seboka se tlang sa Mesebetsi le Botsetedi.
tgt: Lokhu kuvele emhlangamweni wokulungiselela obanjwe nguMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa nabaholi bamabhizinisi, amanxusa otshalomali akhethekile kanye nenhlangano yabaphathi abakhulu bakuleli, i-CEO Initiative, ngaphambi kweNgqungquthela Yezemisebenzi kanye neNkomfa Yotshalomali ezobanjwa khona maduze nje.

src: Kopano e dumellane ka hore tsosoloso ya moruo wa Aforika Borwa e batla ho kenngwa tshebetsong ho potlakileng ha mokgekgetho wa diqholotsi le ditlhabollo tse tshepisitsweng tse ntlafatsang kgolo.
tgt: Lo mhlangano wavumelana ngazwi linye ukuthi ukuvuselelwa komnotho waseNingizimu Afrika kudinga ukuthi kuqaliswe ngokushesha iphakheji yezinyathelo zokuvuselela nokugqugquzela ukusimama komnotho kanye nezinguquko ezithenjisiwe zokuthuthukisa umnotho.

src: Ditshisinyo di ile tsa boela tsa tshohlwa mabapi le ho thea mokgakolo wa ntshetsopele ya meralo ya motheo e kenyang ditjhelete tse tswang lekaleng la poraefete esita le botsebi bo hodimo ba phano ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: Kwaxoxiswana futhi nangeziphakamiso zokuheha uxhasomali oluvela emkhakheni ozimele kanjalo nobungoti nobuchwepheshe bokuqhuba umsebenzi obuvela kulo mkhakha.

src: Thahasello ya botsetedi.
tgt: Umkhankaso wotshalomali.

src: Kabinete e boela e amohela thahasello ya botsetedi kwana Japan, e etelletsweng pele ke Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Indasteri (dti).
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyawamukela futhi nomkhankaso oholwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezimboni wokuyonxenxa utshalomali kwelase-Japan.

src: Thahasello ena e habile ho hohela matsete a boleng ba US$ 100 bilione moruong wa Aforika Borwa nakong ya dilemo tse hlano tse tlang.
tgt: Lo mkhankaso uhlose ukuheha utshalomali oluyimali engamabhiliyoni e-US$ ayi-100 oluzongena emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika kule minyaka emihlanu ezayo.

src: Haesale Japan e le molekane wa ba leshome ba kahodimodimo wa batsetedi ba nako e telele Aforika Borwa, ka dikhamphane tsa yona tse kahodimo ho 140 tse sebetsang naheng ena ya rona, e bonwang e le kgubu ya lebatowa la tlhahiso ya ho kena Aforika.
tgt: I-Japan ngelinye lamazwe ayi-10 aphuma phambili asetshale izimali eNingizimu Afrika isikhathi eside, njengoba kunezinkampani zayo ezingaphezu kwe-140 eziqhuba ibhizinisi ezweni lethu, okuyizwe elibonwa njengesizinda sezokukhiqiza kulesi sifunda sase-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa dikhamphane ho tsetela le ho nama Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyazikhuthaza izinkampani ukuthi zitshale izimali eNingizimu Afrika futhi ziphinde zelule umsebenzi webhizinisi eziwenzayo kuleli.

src: Mananeo a thupello.
tgt: Izinhlelo Zokuqeqesha.

src: Kabinete e amohela kgakolo ya projeke ya thupello ya R22-milione ke Letona la tsa Mesebetsi, Mofumahadi Mildred Oliphant, e tla thea mesebetsi makaleng a bofofisi, a kgwebo ya ho qwela metsing a lewatle esita le a temothuo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyakwamukela ukwethulwa komklamo wokuqeqesha, odle imali ezizigidi ezingama-22 zamarandi, owethulwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezabasebenzi, uNkz Mildred Oliphant, ozovula amathuba omsebenzi emkhakheni wezokuhamba ngezindiza, nasemkhakheni wabatshuzi abakhokhelwayo abasebenza ngaphansi kolwandle kanye nowezolimo.

src: Projeke ena e sebetswa ka selekane le Setheo sa Ngaka John Langalibalele Dube esita le Letlole la Inshorense ya ba Feletsweng ke Mesebetsi (UIF), eo e leng setheo sa Lefapha la tsa Bosebetsi.
tgt: Lo mklamo uqhutshwa ngokubambisana ne-Dr John Langalibalele Dube Institute kanye neSikhwama Somshwalense Wabantu Abaphelelwe Ngumsebenzi (i-UIF), okuyisikhungo soMnyango Wezabasebenzi.

src: Projeke ena e tla shadimana le ba kentseng letsoho ho UIF ba feletsweng ke mesebetsi.
tgt: Lo mklamo uzogxila kulabo asebephelelwe ngumsebenzi ababengamalungu e-UIIqembu lokuqala labantu abazohlomula libandakanya amalungu e-UIF angama-50 avela esikhumulweni sezindiza saseThekwini, i-Virginia Airport abangama-50 abavela emklamweni ose-Scottsburg, KwaZulu-Natali, wabatshuzi abakhokhelwayo abasebenza ngaphansi kolwandle, kanye nabesifazane abaphuma endaweni esemakhaya yaseMadungeni, abazoqeqeshwa ukuze basungule umfelandawonye ozotshala futhi ulime izithelo, imifino kanye nokotini, kubandakanya nokulungiswa kwemikhiqizo yezivuno zabo ukuze ilungele ukuthengiswa.

src: Sehlopha sa pele sa ba tla fola molemo se akga ba 50 ba kentseng letsoho ba tswang Boemafofaneng ba Virginia bo Durban ba 50 ba tswang projekeng ya kgwebo ya ho qwela metsing a lewatle e Scottsburg, KwaZulu-Natal, athe basadi ba mahaeng ba 100 ba tswang Emadungeni ba tla rupellwa hore ba thee koporasi ya ho lema le ho jala ditholwana, meroho le khothene tse holang ka mokgwa wa tlholeho, ho akga le ho lokisetswa ha thekiso ya tsona.
tgt: Le mifelandawonye seyisayine isivumelwano nenkampani yakwa-Pick n Pay, abazoyithengisela imifino, kanye noMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi, ozothenga kubona indwangu yokwenza umfaniswano wesikole.

src: Dikoporasi tsena di tekenne tumellano le Pick ‘n Pay bakeng sa ho e fepela ka meroho, hammoho le Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba bakeng sa ho fumana disebedisuwa tsa ho roka diyunifomo tsa dikolo.
tgt: UMnyango Wezasekhaya IKhabhinethi liyakwamukela ukuvulwa ngokusemthethweni kwamahhovisi amasha oMnyango Wezasekhaya eHluhluwe, KwaZulu-Natali, okwenziwe nguMongameli Ramaphosa.

src: Kabinete e amohela pulo ya semmuso ya dikantoro tse ntjha tsa Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae tse Hluhluwe KwaZulu-Natal ke Moporesidente Ramaphosa.
tgt: Ukwelulwa kokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zikahulumeni emiphakathini eyabe incishwe amathuba phambilini kudlala indima esemqoka kakhulu impela ekuqhubekiseni nasekujuliseni intando yeningi labantu kanye nobulungiswa emphakathini.

src: Nanabetso ena e atollotsweng ya ditshebeletso tsa setjhaba dibakeng tse neng di kotetswe, e na le seabo sa bohlokwa ho dumelleng le ho tebiseng demokrasi le toka setjhabeng.
tgt: Lokhu kuyingxenye yokuzibophezela kukahulumeni ekuletheni izinsizakalo eduze kwabantu.

src: Lenaneo la ho Fallela Kgasong e Ntjha ya Dijithale.
tgt: UHlelo Lokufudukela Ekusakazeni Ngedijithali.

src: Kabinete e kgotsofetse ka kgatelopele e entsweng ya ho falla ha naha ho tloha kgasong ya kgale ya analoko ho ya ho e ntjha ya dijithale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligculisekile ngenqubekelaphambili eyenziwayo ekufudukeni kwezwe lisuka ekusakazeni nge-analogi liya kudijithali.

src: E le karolo ya ho bala nako e setseng ya ho ya ho Tshitwe ya 2018 bakeng sa ho Tingwa ha Kgaso ya Kgale ya Analoko Freistata, transmithara ya pele e Senekal Freistata e tla tingwa ka la 20 Loetse 2018.
tgt: Njengengxenye yokulungiselela ukufika kwenyanga kaZibandlela 2018, okuzocinywa ngayo i-analogi esifundazweni saseFreyistata, mhla zingama-20 kuMandulo 2018 kuzocinywa umbhobho wokusakaza wokuqala e-Senekal e-Freyistata.

src: Sena se tsamaisana le boikitlaetso boo ho dumellanweng ka bona le Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Meralo ya Dikgokahano.
tgt: Lokhu kuhambisana nesibophezelo okwavunyelwana ngaso neNhlangano Yamazwe Ngamazwe Yengqalasizinda Yezokuxhumana (i-ITU).

src: Letsholo la dikgokahanyo le se le thakgotswe ho netefatsa hore malapa ohle a ba malalaalaotswe bakeng sa ho tingwa hona.
tgt: Uyaqhubeka umkhankaso wokwazisa umphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke amakhaya asekulungele ukucinywa kwe-analogi.

src: Malapa a nang le dithelevishene (TV) tse sebetsang ka analoko a batlang ho reka tse ntjha, a eletswa ka hore a reke tse nang le konopo ya dijithale e seng e hoketswe.
tgt: Lawo makhaya anomabonakude (i-TV) abasebenza nge-analogi anesifiso sokuthenga omabonakude abasha ayelulekwa ukuthi akhethe omabonakude anomshini owamukela isiginali yedijithali owakhelwe ngaphakathi kumabonakude.

src: Malapa a nang le lekeno le kahodimo ho sekepele sa R3 200 ka kgwedi a na le kgetho ya ho reka TV e ntjha e seng e hoketswe dijithale ebile e le e nang le dikhoudara ya TV ya Dijithale e bopelletsweng kahare, e fumanehang mabenkeleng a maholo a rekisang thepa.
tgt: Lawo makhaya athola ingenisomali engaphezu komkhawulo obekiwe ongama-R3 200 ngenyanga, uma ethanda, angaqoka ukuzithengela umabonakude omusha onedikhoda eyakhelwe ngaphakathi eyamukela isiginali yedijithali, otholakala ezitolo ezinkulu ezithengisa impahla yasendlini.

src: Ho heletswa mesebetsing.
tgt: Ukudilizwa kwabasebenzi.

src: Ho ya ka kgoeletso ya Moporesidente Ramaphosa ya ho kginwa nakwana ha dipukutlo tsa mesebetsi ka lebaka la maemo a moruo naheng ena, Kabinete e thasisetsa boipiletso ba yona ho bahiri hore taba ya ho heletswa mesebetsing e mpe e be ntho ya ho qetela eo ba ka e nahanang, le hore mekgwa e meng e teng ya sejwalejwale ya ho notla ditjeo e shebisiswe ka hloko molemong wa ho boloka mesebetsi ka nako e telele.
tgt: Ngenhloso sokusabela ekhweleni elishaywe nguMongameli Ramaphosa lokumiswa kwezinhlelo zokudilizwa kwabasebenzi ngenxa yesimo somnotho esibhekene naleli lizwe, iKhabhinethi liyabanxusa abaqashi ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi ukudilizwa kwabasebenzi kuyinto abayenza kuphela uma sekuhluleke wonke amakhambi atholakalayo, futhi kumele kuzanywe ikakhulukazi eminye imizamo yezindlela zesimanjemanje ezikhona zokunciphisa izindleko ukuze kuvikelwe imisebenzi.

src: Dipalopalo tsa ditlolo tsa molao.
tgt: Izibalomanani zobugebengu.

src: Kabinete e bo tjhaella monwana bokenadipakeng ba Setlamo sa tsa Toka, Thibelo ya Ditlolo tsa Molao le Tshireletso, ba ho tshetshetha ka potlako ka lewa le phethahetseng la ho lwantshana le dintho tse fapaneng tse ropohang dipalopalong tsa ditlolo tsa molao tse sa tswa ntshuwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lilugunyazile uhlelo lweQoqo Lezobulungiswa, Ukuvinjelwa Kobugebengu kanye Nokuvikeleka lokungenelela ngokuthi kuqaliswe ngokushesha iqhingasu elibanzi lokubhekana nezinkinga ezihlukahlukene ezivezwe yizibalomanani zobugebengu ezikhishwe esikhathini esifushane esedlule.

src: Sena se akga Seboka sa Naha ho Thibelo ya Ditlolo tsa Molao le Merusu se neng se tshwerwe haufinyane katlasa mookotaba wa, “Ho aba dibaka tse bolokehileng ka mokgwa o kopantsweng ebile e le o tswelang pele wa thibelo ya ditlolo tsa molao le merusu”, e leng se ileng sa rala tjhebelopele ya kopanelo ho tsa polokeho e le boikarabello bo kopanetsweng, sa ba sa fana ka lepatlelo bakeng sa ba amehang ba ka sehloohong esita le ditsebi ho tshetshetha ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ho kgabane ha Tokomane ya Tataiso ya 2016 ho tsa Polokeho le Tshireletso makaleng ohle.
tgt: Lokhu kubandakanya neNgqungquthela Kazwelonke Yokuvimbela Ubugebengu Nodlame ebibanjwe esikhathini esifushane esedlule ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi “Sakha imiphakathi ephephile ngokusebenzisa indlela edidiyelwe futhi ethuthukisayo yokuvimbela ubugebengu nodlame”, okuyingqungquthela eyathuthukisa inhlosombono efanayo yokubheka udaba lokuphepha njengomsebenzi osemahlombe omuntu wonke, futhi eyahlinzeka ngesigcawu sokuthi ababambiqhaza kanye nongoti abasemqoka baxoxisane ngokuqaliswa kahle kuyo yonke imikhakha koMthetho Odingidwayo wezi-2016 Ophathelene Nokuphepha Nokuvikeleka.

src: Kabinete e ngongorehile haholo ka sekgahla sa merusu setjhabeng sa habo rona mme e etsa kgoeletso makaleng ohle, dibakeng tsohle esita le ditheong tsa qobello ya molao hore ho sebetswe mmoho ho netefatsa hore dikolo le dibaka tsa setjhaba di bolokehile ebile di tshireletsehile.
tgt: Izigameko zodlame IKhabhinethi likhathazeke kakhulu ngokuphakama kwezinga lodlame kuleli futhi linxusa yonke imikhakha, imiphakathi kanye nezikhungo zokuqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa komthetho ukuba basebenzisane ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikole kanye nezindawo zomphakathi ziphephile futhi zivikelekile.

src: Diketsahalo tsa merusu tse ropohileng dikgutlwaneng tse ngata tsa naha ena ha di a amoheleha ebile di kgahlanong le Molaotheo wa rona.
tgt: Azamukelekile nakancane izenzo zodlame eziqubuke ezingxenyeni eziningana zakuleli futhi lokhu kuphambene noMthethosisekelo wezwe.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS) ka ho arabela ka potlako hore ho tshwarwe bao ba belaellwang ka ho ba le seabo merusung hara setjhaba, esita le ho fumanwa ba na le thepa e belaellwang ka hore e utswitswe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyawuncoma impela uMbutho Wamaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) ngokuthatha izinyathelo ezisheshayo ekubopheni labo okusolakala ukuthi bayabandakanyeka ezigamekweni zodlame lomphakathi kanye nalabo abatholakale nezimpahla okusolakala sengathi zintshontshiwe.

src: Ho ropoha ha bohloko ba Klebsiella.
tgt: Ukubheduka kobhubhane lwesifo se-Klebsiella IKhabhinethi lidlulisa amazwi enduduzo emindenini yabantwana abayisithupha abashonile kulandela ukubheduka kwesifo se-Klebsiella pneumoniae esibhedlela i-Thelle Mogoerane Hospital e-Vosloorus.

src: Ha jwale ho ropoha ha bohloko bona ho tlasa taolo.
tgt: Njengamanje selunqandiwe lolu bhubhane.

src: Letona la Bophelo bo Botle, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, o se a entse tsebiso ya hore masea le bomma ona sepetleleng sena ba tla fetisetswa Sepetlele sa Bana sa Nelson Mandela le Sepetlele sa Dithuto sa Charlotte Maxeke Johannesburg ka tatelano.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezempilo, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, usememezele ukuthi abantwana nomama babo bazothunyelwa esibhedlela i-Nelson Mandela Children’s Hospital kanye ne-Charlotte Maxeke Johannesburg Academic Hospital.

src: Sena se fa lefapha la bophelo bo botle la profense monyetla wa ho hlwekisa tikoloho, esita le ho rarolla ditaba tsa sebopeho sa sepetlele, ntle le tshitiso ya letho.
tgt: Lokhu kuzonikeza umnyango wezempilo wesifundazwe ithuba lokukhuculula nokususa igciwane lalesi sifo esibhedlela, futhi kulungiswe izinkinga eziphathelene nokuqhutshwa komsebenzi kulesi sibhedlela ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka.

src: Diqeto.
tgt: Izinqumo ZeKabhinethi.

src: Mokgekgetho wa diqholotsiKabinete e tshohlile yaba ya ananela mokgekgetho wa diqholotsi o sisintsweng, o sisinyang mehato ya ho tsosolosa moruo wa rona ho tswa ditshebetsong tse ngatanyana tse amanang le wona.
tgt: Iphakheji yezinyathelo zokuvuselela nokugqugquzela ukusimama komnothoIKhabhinethi lifakane imilomo, laphinde lagunyaza iphakheji yezinyathelo zokuvuselela nokugqugquzela ukusimama komnotho, ephakamisa ukuthi kuthathwe izinyathelo zokuvuselela kabusha umnotho wezwe ngokugxila emikhakheni ethile ehlobene.

src: Seboka sa ditaba se etelletsweng pele ke Moporesidente Ramaphosa se tla tshwarwa ka Labohlano mohla la 21 Loetse ho teka mokgekgetho ona.
tgt: Kuzobanjwa isithangami sabezindaba esizoholwa nguMongameli Ramaphosa mhla zingama-21 kuMandulo lapho kuzokwethulwa khona le phakeji.

src: Ditlhabollo tse amanang le VISAKabinete e boetse ya amohela tlaleho ya kopanelo e tswang ho Matona a Merero ya Lehae le Bohahlaudi ka tatelano, mabapi le ditlhabollo tse ngatanyana tse amanang le visa tse tla nolofaletsa bahahlaudi, bahwebi le barutehi ho tla Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Izinguquko eziphathelene nama-VISAIKhabhinethi lithole futhi nombiko owethulwe ngokuhlanganyela nguNgqongqoshe Wezasekhaya kanye noNgqongqoshe Wezokuvakasha, mayelana nezinguquko eziphathelene nezimvume zokungena kwabantu bakwamanye amazwe kuleli, ama-visa, ezizokwenza kube lula ukuza eNingizimu Afrika kwezivakashi, osomabhizinisi kanye nezifundiswa.

src: Ditlhabollo tsena di akga dihlomathiso melawaneng e sebetsang ho melata ya bana e etelang Aforika Borwa, tse tla phatlalatswa kaseteng ya mmuso ka Mphalane.
tgt: Lezi zinguquko zibandakanya ukuchitshiyelwa kwemithethonqubo eqondene nezingane zakwamanye amazwe ezingena eNingizimu Afrika, futhi lokhu kuzoshicilelwa kusomqulu kahulumeni ngoMfumfu.

src: Ditherisano tsa ho nyahlatswa ha ditlhoko tsa di-visa le ho nyehliswa ha ditlhoko tsa di-visa bakeng sa dinaha tse itseng, le tsona di a phethelwa.
tgt: Akusensuku zatshwala kuphothulwe nezingxoxo eziphathelene nokugudlulwa kwesidingo sama-visa kubantu abavela emazweni athile.

src: Dintlha tse tomanyana di tla tsebiswa bekeng ena.
tgt: Eminye imininingwane mayelana nalokhu izomenyezelwa kuleli viki.

src: Dibili.
tgt: IMithethosivivinywa.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Dibili tse latelang bakeng sa ho phatlalatswa hore setjhaba se tshwaele ka tsona:.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukushicilelwa kwale Mithethosivivinywa elandelayo ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngayo:.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya 2017 ya Tekano Mesebetsing.
tgt: Isichibiyelo Somthethosivivinywa Wezokulingana wezi-2017.

src: Dihlomathiso tsena di habile ho matlafatsa mekgwa ya boikamahanyo mme di tla dumella ho ralwa ha dipeelo tsa lenane le badilweng tsa tekano mesebetsing ya makala a totobaditsweng.
tgt: Lezi zichibiyelo zihlose ukuqinisa izindlela zokuqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa komthetho futhi zizovumela ukusungulwa kwemigomo nemikhawulo yezibalomanani zokuqasha ngokulingana okuhloswe ukufinyelela kuyona eziqondene ngqo nomkhakha ngamunye.

src: Letona la tsa Bosebetsi, ka pontshano le ba amehang lekaleng, ba tla kgona ho rala dipeelo tsa lenane le badilweng tsa tekano mesebetsing ya makala a totobaditsweng.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezabasebenzi, ebambisene nababambiqhaza bemikhakha, uzokwazi ukubeka imigomo nemikhawulo yezibalomanani zokuqasha ngokulingana okumele kufinyelelwe kuyona eziqondene ngqo nomkhakha ngamunye.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya 2018 ya Melao ya Lekala la tsa Ditjhelete: Dihlomathiso tsena di habile ho matlafatsa ditlhoko tsa poloko ya matlotlo bakeng sa dibanka, ho akga le dibanka tsa kopanelo le tsa dikoporasi, le tse ding tse itseng tseo e seng dibanka.
tgt: Isichibiyelo Somthethosivivinywa Wemithetho Yomkhakha Wezimali wezi-2018: Lezi zichibiyelo zihlose ukuqinisa izimiselo zobufukamelimafa (i-curatorship) bamabhange, kubandakanya amabhange amakhasimende (ama-mutual bank) kanye namabhange ayimifelandawonye (ama-cooperative bank), kanjalo nezinye izikhungo zezimali ezingagunyaziwe ukusebenza njengebhange.

src: Diphetoho di tla netefatsa hore ha ho ka etsahala hore ditheo tsena tsa ditjhelete di be le mathata, di ka thuswa ka mokgwa o tshireletsang beng ba tjhelete ba tlokotsing ka hore ho se ke ha eba teng ditshita tse kgolo tsamaisong ya tsa ditjhelete le moruo ka bobatsi.
tgt: Lezi zinguquko zizoqinisekisa ukuthi izikhungo zezimali ezihlangabezana nobunzima, zithola ukulekelelwa ngendlela ezovikela abafakimali abasengcupheni futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi aziphazamiseki kakhulu izinhlelo zezimali kanye nomnotho wonkana.

src: Diketsahalo tse Tlang.
tgt: Imicimbi Ezayo.

src: Keteko ya Letsatsi la Bojalefa la 2018 katlasa mookotaba o reng: “Selemo sa Nelson Mandela: Ho ntshetsa pele phetoho lepatlelong la bojalefa ba Aforika Borwa”, e tshwarelwa Lebaleng la Dipapadi la Riverview Kokstad, KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Usuku Lwamagugu Imigubho yoSuku Lwamagugu Lukazwelonke lowezi-2018 ezoqhutshwa ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Unyaka ka-Nelson Mandela: Siqhubekisela phambili uguquko kwezamagugu eNingizimu Afrika”, izobanjelwa eNkundleni yase-Riverview e-Kokstad, KwaZulu-Natali.

src: Ena ke karolo ya lenaneo le le lelele la kgwedi kaofela la diketsahalo tse rarollang dintho tse amanang le phetoho, phahamiso le paballo ya mohlahlwe wa bojalefa le manoni a Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lokhu kuyingxenye yohlelo lwenyanga yonke lwemibungazo okuhloswe ngayo ukubhekana nezindaba eziphathelene noguquko, ukugqugquzelwa nokulondolozwa kwamagugu acebile futhi ahlukahlukene akuleli, ubuzwe, ukwakhiwa kwesizwe kanye nobumbano lomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Keteko ena ya Letsatsi la Bojalefa e etsetswa ho tlotla Adam Kok le ditjhaba tsa Makgerikwa ka sebete, boikitlaetso le matla a bona ka ho hanana le boipehi ba bokoloniale.
tgt: Umgubho woSuku Lwamagugu kuzohlonishwa ngawo u-Adam Kok kanye nesizwe samaHilikwa (ama-Griqua) ngenxa yesibindi, ukuzimisela kanye namandla amakhulukazi abawabonisa ngenkathi belwisana nokuqonelwa ngabezizwe.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho setjhaba hore se keteke kopano ya sona ka mohlahlwe wa sona, jwalo ka ha re sebetsa mmoho ho aha naha eo batho bohle ba yona ba hlomphanang ba bile ba tsotellana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyawunxusa umphakathi ukuthi ugubhe ubunye bawo nakuba wakhiwe ngabantu abanemvelaphi ehlukahlukene, ngenkathi sisebenza ngokubambisana ekwakheni izwe lapho bonke abantu balo bebonisa ukunakekelana nokuhloniphana.

src: Seboka Kakaretso sa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UNGA).
tgt: Ukhukhulelangoqo Womhlangano Wenhlangano Yezizwe (i-UNGA).

src: Ho kenyeng letsoho mabapi le dilemo tse lekgolo tsa tswalo ya Moporesidente wa mehleng Nelson Mandela, ka la 24 Loetse 2018 UNGA e tla tshwara kopano ya boemo bo hodimo mabapi le kgotso ya lefatshe lohle e tsejwang ka hore ke Seboka sa Kgotso sa Nelson Mandela, e le ho tlotla dilemo tse lekgolo tsa tswalo ya Madiba.
tgt: Njengophawu lokufaka isandla emigubhweni yeminyaka eyikhulu kwazalwa uMongameli waphambilini u-Nelson Mandela, mhla zingama-24 kuMandulo 2018 i-UNGA izobamba umhlangano ozokwethanyelwa nayizicukuthwane okuzobhungwa kuwona ngodaba lokuthula emhlabeni, owaziwa ngeNgqungquthela ka-Nelson Mandela Yokuthula, ngenhloso yokubungaza ukuhlangana kweminyaka eyikhulu kwazalwa uMadiba.

src: Kopano ena e reretswe ho ananela tsebiso ya selekane sa sepolotiki e duletsweng majwana ke Dinaha tseo e leng Ditho tsa UNGSena se etsahala kamora dipuisano tsa Baemedi ba Moshwelella mokgatlong wa UN ba Aforika Borwa le Ireland, ba sebetsang e le bahlophisetsi, hammoho le mebuso e mmedi ena ka dikateng tsa tsebiso ena ya selekane.
tgt: Kulindeleke ukuthi lo mhlangano wamukele isivumelwano sezepolitiki okufinyelelwe kusona emva kwezingxoxo phakathi kwamazwe angamalungu e-UNGLokhu kulandela ukubonisana kohulumeni bezwekazi ezingxoxweni ebeziholwa ngokubambisana nguMmeleli weNingizimu Afrika Osebenza Ngokugcwele KwiNhlangano Yezizwe kanye nozakwabo wase-Ireland, mayelana nalokho okuqukethwe esivumelwaneni.

src: Moporesidente Ramaphosa o boetse o lebelletswe ho ba le seabo Kopanong ya UN ya Boemo bo Hodimo mabapi le bohloko ba Lefuba (TB) mohla la 26 Loetse 2018.
tgt: Kulindeleke futhi ukuthi uMongameli Ramaphosa abambe iqhaza emhlanganweni weNhlangano Yezizwe ozokwethanyelwa nayizicukuthwane okuzobhungwa kuwona ngesifo sofuba (i-TB), mhla zingama-26 kuMandulo 2018.

src: TB ke bohloko bo ka sehloohong Aforika mme tse ding tsa dinaha tse thefutsweng ke TB ka ho fetisisa di khontinenteng ena.
tgt: I-TB yisifo esiyinkinga enkulu e-Afrika futhi amanye alawo mazwe omhlaba anesibalo esiphakeme kakhulu sabantu abatheleleke nge-TB atholakala kulona leli lizwekazi.

src: Melaetsa.
tgt: Imiyalezo.

src: MatshedisoKabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona ho malapa a lahlehetsweng ke baratuwa ba ona ho swahlamaneng ha bese ho etsahetseng mmileng wa N1-25 haufi le Tobias, Masepaleng wa Setereke sa Waterberg Limpopo.
tgt: Amazwi enduduzoIKhabhinethi lidlulisa amazwi enduduzo emindenini elahlekelwe yizihlobo zayo engozini yebhasi eyenzeke emgwaqeni onguthelawayeka u-N1-25 eduze kwase-Tobias kuMasipala Wesifunda i-Waterberg eLimpopo.

src: Kabinete e boela e lakaletsa bao ba lemetseng hore ba fole ka potlako.
tgt: Futhi iKhabhinethi libafisela ukwelulama okusheshayo bonke abalimele.

src: DithoholetsoKabinete e thoholetsa Letona la Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane, Mofumahadi Lindiwe Zulu, ka hore a amohelwe boemong bo hodimodimo ba Tlotlo ya Rio Branco (Ordem de Rio Branco), le Grand Cross ho tswa Mmusong wa Brazil.
tgt: Amazwi okuhalaliselaIKhabhinethi lihalalisela uNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwamabhinisi Amancane, uNkz Lindiwe Zulu, ohlonishwe nguhulumeni wase-Brazil ngendondo esesigabeni esiphezulu kakhulu i-Order of Rio Branco (i-Ordem de Rio Branco), kanye ne-Grand Cross nguhulumeni wase-Brazil.

src: Sena se entswe ka lebaka la matsapa a Letona a ntseng a tswelapele a ho ntlafatsa dikamano tsa dinaha tse pedi dipakeng tsa Brazil le Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lokhu kuwukuhlonishwa kukaNgqongqoshe ngemizamo yakhe, elokhu iqhubeke njalo, yokwenza ngcono ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-Brazil neNingizimu Afrika.

src: Tlotlo ena ya Brazil e fuwa bao ba ipabotseng ka diketso tsa tshebeletso e tswileng matsoho esita le makgetha a setjhaba.
tgt: Le ndondo yase-Brazil inikezwa labo abazibonakalisile ngemisebenzi yabo encomekayo futhi abagqame nangezenzo zabo ezinhle kakhulu zokusebenzela umphakathi.

src: Letona Zulu e ne e le Leqosa la Aforika Borwa Brazil dipakeng tsa 2004 le 2008.DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di lokela ho netefatswa ka mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe uZulu wayeyinxusa leNingizimu Afrika kwelase-Brazil phakathi kowezi-2004 nowezi-2008.AbaqashiweUkuqashwa kwabo bonke abasebenzi kuzokwamukelwa ngokusemthethweni kuphela uma sekuqinisekiswe ubufakazi beziqu zabo zemfundo futhi uma sebenikezwe izimvume ezifanelekile.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, 10 Mphalane 2018 Tuynhuys, ho la Motse Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi labamba umhlangano walo ngoLwesithathu, mhla ziyi-10 kuMfumfu 2018 e-Tuynhuys eKapa.

src: Dintlha tsa Hajwale Letsholo la moruo le tsetelo Kabinete e amohela diketso tsa tshebetso tse jwalo ka boitlamo ba ho reka dihlahiswa tse entsweng kahare ho naha, katamelo e matla ho feta ya ho eketsa dihlahiswa tse rekiswang kantle ho naha, mesebetsi kgwebong ya temo le tshehetso bakeng sa dikgwebo tse nyane le tse mahareng.
tgt: Umnotho kanye nomkhankaso wotshalomali.1 IKhabhinethi liyazamukela izinhlelo zikahulumeni zokungenelela eziphathekayo futhi ezinohlonze ezinjengokuzibophezela ekuthengeni imikhiqizo yakuleli, ukuqiniswa kakhudlwana kwemizamo yokukhulisa umthamo wempahla yakuleli ethunyelwa emazweni angaphandle, izinhlelo zokungenelela ochungechungeni lomsebenzi wokulungiswa kwemikhiqizo yezolimo kanye nokweseka amabhizinisi asafufusa.

src: Diphatlalatso tsena di hlahile Kopanong ya Mesebetsi ya matsatsi a mabedi e sa tswa tshwarwa, e tshwerweng tlasa Khansele ya Naha ya Ntshetsopele ya Moruo le Mesebetsi.2 Sephetho sa Kopano ya Mesebetsi se latela phatlalatso ya Morero wa Tsosoloso le Ntjhafatso ya Moruo, e rerileng ho tsosolosa kgolo ya moruo ya ho theha mesebetsi e hlokehang e le kannete.
tgt: Lezi zimemezelo ziwumphumela weNgqungquthela Yemisebenzi ethathe izinsuku ezimbili ebibanjwe esikhathini esifushane esedlule, ebibizwe ngaphansi koMkhandlu Kazwelonke Wezokuthuthukiswa Komnotho kanye Nezabasebenzi (i-Nedlac).2 Umphumela weNgqungquthela Yemisebenzi ulandela isimemezelo soHlelo Lokuvuselela Nokugqugquzela Ukusimama Komnotho, oluhlose ukubuyisa nokuvuselela ukukhula komnotho futhi ludale namathuba omsebenzi adingeka kakhulu.

src: Tumellano e Ntjha ya Merafo – e phethetsweng ka tshebedisanommoho le indasteri ya merafo, kgwebo le ditjhaba tse amehileng le baamehi ba bang – e hlakisa dintlha tsa bohlokwa tsa kgolo, phehello le phetoho.3 Kabinete e kopa baamehi bohle ho sebetsana le Tumellano ya Merafo e le ho phethela le ho theha botsitso kgwebong ya merafo.
tgt: Usomqulu Wezimayini omusha – ophothulwe ngokubonisana nemboni yezimayini, abasebenzi, imiphakathi ethintekile kanye nabanye ababambiqhaza – icacisa izinto ezisemqoka kakhulu okumele zenziwe ukuze kulethwe ukukhula komnotho, ukusimama kanye noguquko.3 IKhabhinethi liyabanxusa bonke ababambiqhaza ukuthi bawucubungule futhi bazame ukuwuqonda uSomqulu Wezimayini ukuze uphothulwe futhi kulethwe uzinzo emkhakheni wezimayini.

src: Ofisi ya Merero ya Lehae ya Kokstad le phano ya mangolo a beng ba matlo Kabinete hammoho le Mopresidente Cyril Ramaphosa ba lebohisa Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae bakeng sa ho bula ofisi ya Kokstad ho la KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Ihhovisi loMnyango Wezasekhaya lase-Kokstad kanye nokunikezwa kwamatayitela.1 NjengoMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa, iKhabhinethi nalo liyawuncoma impela uMnyango Wezasekhaya ngokuvula ngempumelelo ihhovisi lawo lase-Kokstad KwaZulu-Natali.

src: Mopresidente o butse ofisi ya Merero ya Lehae jwalo ka karolo ya lenaneo la mmuso la ho atolosa kgato ya dibaka tsa phano ya ditshebeletso ya Merero ya Lehae ho kgotsofatsa ditlhoko tsa baahi bakeng sa dikarete tsa boitsebiso (di-Smart ID) le ditokomane tse ding.2 Ho feta moo, Mopresidente Ramaphosa o fane ka mangolo a beng ba matlo a 443 ho bajalefa ba Projeke ya Franklin Housing.
tgt: UMongameli wavula ngokusemthethweni leli hhovisi loMnyango Wezasekhaya njengengxenye yohlelo lukahulumeni lokwelula ukufinyelela kwezizinda zoMnyango Wezasekhaya ezihlinzeka ngezidingongqangi kubantu ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nesasasa elikhulu eliboniswa yizakhamuzi zakuleli komazisi bekhadi kanye nezinye izincwadi.2 Ngaphezu kwalokho, uMongameli Ramaphosa wadlulisela amatayitela angaphezu kwama-443 ezandleni zabahlomuli boMklamo Wezindlu wase-Franklin.

src: Ena ke karolo ya lenaneo la puseletso la ho netefatsa hore bajalefa ba fumana melemo e felletseng ya ho ba le ntlo mme ba kgona ho fihlella mmaraka wa semmuso wa matlo.3 Kabinete e boetse e nka monyetla ona ho kgothaletsa baahi ka matla hore ba late di-ID tsa bona hang ha ba fumana tsebiso ya ho di lata.
tgt: Lokhu kuyingxenye yohlelo lokuvuselela ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi abahlomuli bathokozela imihlomulo ephelele yokuba ngabanikazi bezindlu futhi ukuze bakwazi nokufinyelela emakethe yomhlaba ehlelekile.3 IKhabhinethi lithanda futhi ukusebenzisa leli thuba ukukhuthaza izakhamuzi zakuleli ukuthi zihambe ziyolanda omazisi bazo ngokushesha emva kokuthola isaziso esibanxusa ukuthi beze bazobalanda.

src: Tumellano ya phethelo mabapi le sepeketeramo Kabinete e amohela tumellano ya phethelo e fihletsweng tabeng e kenyelletsang Memo ya ho etsa Kopo bakeng sa kabo ya sepeketeramo sa tlhoko e phahameng.
tgt: Ukufinyelela esivumelwaneni mayelana nokwabiwa kwamagagasi okusakaza ngomoya IKhabhinethi liyasamukela isivumelwano okufinyelelwe kusona mayelana nodaba olubandakanya isiMemo Sokufakwa Kwezicelo eziqondene nokwabiwa kwamagagasi okusakaza ngomoya afunwa kakhulu.

src: Sena se fana ka botsitso ba pholisi lekaleng ka theknoloji ya tlhahisoleseding le dikgokahano (ICT).2 Tumellano ena ya phethelo e tsamaellana le pitso ya Mopresidente Ramophosa ya ho qala tshebetso ya kabo ya dilaesense tsa seyalemoya tsa sepeketeramo sa tlhoko e phahameng.4 E le ho kenya letsoho ka tsela tse eketsehileng ho tshebetso ya Tokomane ya Tataiso ya Pholisi e Kopantsweng ya Naha ya ICT, baamehi ba nang le kgahleho ba ka fana ka ditlatsetso tse ngotsweng ho fihlela la 8 Pudungwana 2018 ho pholisi e sisintsweng le tjhebo ya yona ho ba boholong.
tgt: Lokhu kuhlinzeka ukuqiniseka mayelana nezinqubomgomo emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bolwazi nokuxhumana (i-ICT).

src: Dikoporasi tsa pele tsa Aforika Borwa tse nyane tsa ditlhapi Kabinete e amohela dikoporasi tsa pele tsa Aforika Borwa tse nyane lekaleng la tsa ditlhapi, e leng dikoporasi tsa Port Nolloth le Hondeklipbaai ho la Kapa Leboya, tse hlomamisitsweng ke Letona la Temothou, Meru le Ditlhapi, Monghadi Senzeni Zokwana.2 Tlhomamiso e tshwaya ho kengwa tshebetsong ha pholisi ya ditheo tse nyane tsa ditlhapi.
tgt: Lesi sivumelwano sihambelana nekhwelo likaMongameli Ramaphosa lokuqaliswa kwenqubo yokwabiwa kwamalayisensi amagagasi okusakaza ngomoya afunwa kakhulu.3 Ngenhloso yokufaka isandla esithe xaxa ekuqalisweni kokusebenza koHlaka Lombiko Odingidwayo Wenqubomgomo Ye-ICT Edidiyelwe Kazwelonke, bonke abanentshisekelo bazonikezwa ithuba lokuhlinzeka uphiko ngemibono yabo ebhalwe phansi kuze kube ngumhla ziyisi-8 kuLwezi 2018 mayelana nenqubomgomo ehlongozwayo kanye nesiqondiso senqubomgomo.

src: Ditokelo tsa ditlhapi di fa batjhehi ba ditlhapi ba lehae seriti, ba neng ba tjheha ditlhapi ka ntle ho molao, ka hore jwale ba se ba sireleditswe ka lekgetlo la pele.3 Ditjhaba tse pedi tsa boraditlhapi ba banyenyane tse tla una molemo pholising ena di fumane thupelo ya motheo mabapi le dikoporasi mme di thusitswe ho ngodisa dikoporasi bakeng sa ho etsa dikopo tsa ditokelo tsa dilemo tse 15 tsa ho tjheha ditlhapi.
tgt: Imifelandawonye yabadobi abancane yokuqala ngqa yaseNingizimu Afrika IKhabhinethi liyayamukela imifelandawonye yabadobi abancane yokuqala ngqa yaseNingizimu Afrika emkhakheni wezokudoba, okungumfelandawonye wase-Port Nolloth kanye nowase-Hondeklipbaai eNyakatho Kapa, eyathulwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezolimo, Ezamahlathi Nezokudoba, uMnu Senzeni Zokwana.

src: Balefi ba lekgetho bao eseng ba nakwana ba kgethang ho faela diforomo tsa bona ka eFiling ba ka etsa jwalo ho fihlela la 31 Pherekgong 20.2 Pokeletso e nepahetseng e sebetsang hantle e netefatsa matla a nahana a busang tjhelete ya yona, mme dinehelano tse etswang ka nako le ka nepo di netefatsa hore balefi ba lekgetho ba latela molao wa lekgetho.
tgt: Amalungelo okudoba anikeza abadobi bendawo isithunzi, njengoba bebedoba ngokungemthetho, kepha-ke manje sebevikelekile, futhi kungokokuqala ngqa ukuthi kwenzeke into enjalo kuleli.

src: Tjhelete ya lekgetho e thusa mmuso ho fana ka tjhelete bakeng sa diprojeke tsa naha tsa phano ya ditshebeletso le mananeo a mang a ntshetsopele ya setjhaba le moruo.
tgt: Le miphakathi yabadobi abancane emibili ezohlomula kule nqubomgomo seyithole ukuqeqeshwa okuyisisekelo mayelana nemifelandawonye futhi ilekeleliwe ukubhalisa imifelandawonye yayo ukuze ikwazi ukufaka izicelo zamalungelo okudoba isikhathi esiyiminyaka eyi-.

src: Ditefo tsa digrante tsa setjhaba Kabinete e tlalehetswe ke Komiti ya Mafapha a Kopaneng: Digrante tsa Setjhaba, eo modulasetulo wa yona e leng Letona Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma.
tgt: Isikhathi sokuthunyelwa kwamafomu entela.1 IKhabhinethi liyabancoma abakhokhi bentela ababalelwa ezigidini ezintathu asebewathumelile amafomu abo entela, futhi abayisigamu kulaba bawathumele nge-inthanethi amafomu abo besebenzisa uhlelo lwe-eFiling.

src: Ho tloha ka la 1 Mphalane 2018, bajalefa ba fetang dimilione tse 10 ba lefilwe ka tshebediso ya e nngwe ya mekgwa ena – Ofisi ya Poso ya Aforika Borwa (SAPO)/Postbank Grindrod Bank hammoho le barekisi ba bang ba jwalo ka Boxer, Shoprite, le Pick n Pay.2 Mmuso o atlehile ho tlosa tefo ya digrante tsa setjhaba ho tloha ho Cash Paymaster Services (CPS) jwalo ka ha ho laetswe ke Kahlolo ya Lekgolo la Molaotheo.
tgt: Mhla zingama-31 kuMfumfu, siyavalwa isikhathi sokuthunyelwa kwamafomu entela sowezi-2018 maqondana nabakhokhi bentela abathola ingenisomali evela emholweni kuphela kanye nabakhokhi bentela yesithutshana (okusho labo abathola ingenisomali ngale komholo, noma ingenisomali evela ebhizinisini) abaqoka ukuzihambisela amafomu abo mathupha egatsheni lesiKhungo Esiqoqa Intela saseNingizimu Afrika (i-SARS).

src: Bajalefa bohle ba kontane ba lefuwang ke CPS ba fetiseditswe mme CPS e se e tsebisitswe ka phediso ya konteraka ho tloha ka la 30 Loetse 20.3 Kabinete e leboha mosebetsi o motle wa botsamaisi o neng o etelletswe pele ke Komiti ya Mafapha a Kopaneng e tsheheditswe ke Sehlopha sa Mosebetsi wa Botekgeniki sa Balaodikakaretso.
tgt: Abakhokhi bentela yesithutshana abaqoka ukuthumela amafomu nge-eFiling bazonikezwa ithuba lokuthumela amafomu abo kuze kube ngumhla zingama-31 kuMasingana 20.2 Ukuqoqwa ngendlela efanele kwemali engenayo emgodlagodleni kahulumeni kuqinisekisa amandla aleli lizwe olulawula imali engenayo ngokuzimela futhi ukuthunyelwa kwamafomu entela aqukethe imininingwane efanelekile, ngesikhathi esibekiwe, kuyaqinisekisa ukuthi abakhokhi bentela bathathwa njengabantu abawuthobelayo umthetho wezentela.

src: E boetse e fetisetsa diteboho tsa yona ho basebeletsi ba SAPO, Setheo sa Aforika Borwa sa Tshireletseho ya Setjhaba (SASSA) le, lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba la Meralo ya Dikgokahanyo le Ditshebeletso tsa Poso la Merero, Bodisa le Tlhatlhobo ya Tshebetso la Matlotlo a Setjhaba Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa ya Aforika Borwa (SAPS) le Tsamaiso ya Dikgokahanyo le Tlhahisoleseding ya Mmuso (GCIS).4 Kabinete e leboha bajalefa bohle ba digrante tsa setjhaba bakeng sa tshebedisanommoho ya bona nakong ya phetoho ena.
tgt: Imali etholakala ngokukhokhwa kwentela ilekelela uhulumeni ukuze akwazi ukuxhasa ngezimali imiklamo yokuthunyelwa kwezidingongqangi kuleli kanye nezinye izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwenhlalomnotho.

src: Diketekelo tsa Dilemokgolo tsa Mme Albertina Sisulu Kabinete e tlalehetswe ka ditokiso tsa ketekelo ya dilemokgolo tsa Mama Albertina Sisulu tse tla etsahala nakong ya kgwedi ya hae ya tswalo ya Mphalane.
tgt: Ukukhokhwa kwezibonelelomali zikahulumeni.1 IKhabhinethi lethulelwe umbiko yiKomidi LoNgqongqoshe Beminyango Ehlukahlukene: Elijutshwe Ukubhekana Nodaba Lwezibonelelomali Zikahulumeni, usihlalo walo okunguNgqongqoshe Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma.

src: Mama Sisulu o hlahile ka la 21 Mphalane 1918 mme Modulasetulo wa IMC bakeng sa Diketekelo tsa Dilemokgolo, Letona Jeff Radebe, o teng mona ho tla hlalosa diketsahalo tse tlang tse amanang le mokete wa dilemokgolo.
tgt: Kusukela mhla lu-1 kuMfumfu 2018, bangaphezu kwezigidi eziyi-10 abahlomuli abakhokhelwe izibonelelomali zabo kusetshenziswa ezinye zalezi zikhungo ezilandelayo – iPosi laseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPO)/i-Postbank i-Grindrod Bank kanye nezitolo ezinjengo-Boxer, Shoprite, kanye no-Pick n Pay.2 Uhulumeni usekwazile ukufudukisa ngempumelelo umsebenzi wokukhokhwa kwezibonelelomali zikahulumeni usuka enkampanini yakwa-Cash Paymaster Services (i-CPS) ngokomyalelo wesiNqumo Senkantolo.

src: Kahlolo ya ntate wa Springs.1 Kabinete e amohela kahlolo ya monna ya hlekefetsang, ya tsejwang ka hore ke Kgodumodumo ya Springs.
tgt: Bonke abahlomuli abebekhokhelwa imali engukheshi ngu-CPS sebefudukisiwe futhi i-CPS seyazisiwe ngokuqedwa kwenkontileka yayo kusukela mhla zingama-30 kuMandulo 20.3 IKhabhinethi lidlulisa ukubonga kwalo ngomsebenzi wokuqapha omuhle kakhulu obuholwa yiThimba LoNgqongqoshe Beminyango Ehlukahlukene lisekelwa yiThimba Elikhethekile LabaQondisi Jikelele Abanolwazi Olunzulu Emsebenzini Walo Mkhakha.

src: O ahloletswe ho hlola dilemo tse 35 tjhankaneng bakeng sa teko ya ho bolaya mora wa hae, tlhekefetso ya bana le ho se tsotelle bana, hammoho le ho sebedisa le ho hweba ka dithethefatsi.
tgt: Liyawubonga futhi umsebenzi omuhle wezikhulu ezivela ku-SAPO, Inhlangano Yezimpesheni Nezibonelelo Zikahulumeni eNingizimu Afrika (i-Sassa) kanye noMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi OwezeNgqalasizinda Yezokuxhumana Nezinsizakalo Zeposi OwezokuHlela, Ukuqapha Nokuhlola Owezezimali Kuzwelonke uMbutho Wamaphoyisa waseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) kanye Nophiko Lukahulumeni Lwezokuxhumana Nokuhlinzeka Ngolwazi (i-GCIS).4 IKhabhinethi liyababonga bonke abahlomuli bezibonelelomali zikahulumeni ngobambiswano lwabo abalubonisile kulesi sikhathi soguquko.

src: Tlhekefetso ya bong e dula e le bothata bo boholo setjhabeng sa rona, jwalo ka ha re bone ka peto e sa tswa etsahala ya ngwana e monyane sebakeng sa ho jella sa Dros, Silverton.2 Kabinete e hatisella dikgoelletso tsa hore ditheo tsa tshebetso ya molao di etse tsohle tse matleng a tsona ho qosa baetsi ba ditlolo tsena tsa molao tse harosang dibete.
tgt: Imigubho yekhulu-nyaka lika-Albertina Sisulu IKhabhinethi lethulelwe umbiko mayelana namalungiselelo omgubho wekhulu-nyaka likaMama u-Albertina Sisulu ozobanjwa ngenyanga azalwa ngayo, uMfumfu.

src: E boetse e hoella le rona bohle hore re sebetseng mmoho ho emisa tlhekefetso ya ditokelo tsa bana le ditho tsa setjhaba tse sa bolokehang ka ho fetisisa.
tgt: UMama uSisulu wazalwa mhla zingama-21 kuMfumfu 1918, futhi usiHlalo WeKomidi LoNgqongqoshe Beminyango Ehlukahlukene Ejutshwe Umsebenzi Wokuhlela Lo mgubho, uNgqongqoshe u-Jeff Radebe, ukhona lapha ukuzochaza kabanzi mayelana nemicimbi nemisebenzi ezokwenziwa ephathelene nomgubho wekhulu-nyaka likaMama u-Albertina Sisulu.

src: Boipelaetso ba Westbury Kabinete e amohela tshebetso ya Letona la Sepolesa Bheki Cele ho la Westbury, eo e leng karolo ya moralo o pharalletseng wa ho lwantsha bothata ba dithethefatsi le dintwa tse amanang le maqulwana sebakeng seo.2 Tshebetso ena e kenyelletsa ho romelwa ha Sehlopha sa Tshebetso e Radilweng sa Thibelo ya Botlokotsebe (TRT - Maberete) le boteng bo eketsehileng ba sepolesa.
tgt: Ukugwetshwa kukababa wase-Springs.1 IKhabhinethi liyakwamukela ukugwetshwa kwendoda enesihluku, edume ngeleNunu Esabekayo yase-Springs (i-Springs Monster).

src: Sa bohlokwa ke hore, ho boetse ho tla ba le dipatlisiso mabapi le manyofonyofo a etsahalang kahare ho Seteishene sa Sepolesa sa Westbury.3 Kabinete e bitsa setjhaba sa Westbury le ditjhaba tsohle hore di sebetse le sepolesa ho netefatsa hore re fatolla diteketso tsa botlokotsebe, dithethefatsi le maqulwana dibakeng tse fapaneng tse ba dulang ho tsona.
tgt: Wagwetshwa iminyaka engama-35 ejele ngecala lokuzama ukubulala indodana yakhe, ukuhlukumeza, ukuhluleka ukunakekela izingane zakhe kanye nokusebenzisa futhi athengise izidakamizwa.

src: Botlokotsebe.1 Kabinete e lebohisa ditheo tsa molao ka ho etsa dipatlisiso tse matla tsa makala a fapaneng tse amanang le diketsahalo tsa dimolong, mabenkeleng le dimoskeng tse lebisitseng ho ho tshwarwa ha babelaellwa ba Di ne di kenyelletsa Sehlopha sa Toka, Thibelo ya Botlokotsebe le Tshireletso.
tgt: Udlame oluqondiswe kwabesifazane lusalokhu luyinselele enkulu ezweni lethu, njengoba lokhu kubonakale ngokucacile esigamekweni sokudlwengulwa kwengane esencane esenzeke esikhathini esifushane esedlule esitolo sokudla sakwa-Dros e-Silverton.

src: Ho lebelletswe hore babelaellwa bohle ba tla shebana le diqoso tse kenyelletsang polao, teko ya polao le ho tlola Molao wa Diqhomane.2 Kabinete e netefalletsa maAforika Borwa hore ho lwantshwa botlokotsebe ho bohlokwa haholo le hore mmuso o tla tswelapele ho nka mehato e hlokehang ho netefatsa hore ho ba le tikoloho e bolokehileng hape e sireletsehileng bakeng sa baahi bohle ba Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Khabhinethi liyagcizelela ekhweleni eliqondiswe kwiziphathimandla eziqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa komthetho ukuthi zenze konke okusemandleni azo ukushushisa abenzi balawa macala amabi kangaka.

src: Diphetolo tsa mabitso: Makhanda Kabinete e amohela phetolo ya lebitso la Grahamstown, ho la Kapa Botjhabela, hore e be Makhanda, ho tlotla moprofeta wa moXhosa, rafilosofi le lesole le neng le lwana kgahlanong le bokoloniale.2 Phetoho ena ke karolo e bohlokwa ya leeto la rona la demokrasi mme e tla thusa ho aha katamelano ya setjhaba e eketsehileng le ho aha kutlwisiso e tebileng ya nalane ya rona eo re e arolelanang.
tgt: Futhi liyasinxusa sonke ukuthi sisebenzisane ekunqandeni ukuphulwa kwamalungelo ezingane nalawo malungu omphakathi angakwazi ukuzivikela futhi adinga ukubhekelelwa kakhudlwana.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete Kabinete e amohetse mmotlolo o shebilweng botjha wa phano ya ditshebeletso wa Projeke ya Phetolo ya Phatlalatso ya Dijithale.
tgt: Imibhikisho yase-Westbury.1 IKhabhinethi liyazamukela izinyathelo zokungenelela e-Westbury ezithathwe nguNgqongqoshe uBheki Cele, eziyingxenye yeqhingasu elibanzi lokulwisana nesihlava sezidakamizwa kanye nodlame oluphathelene nemigulukudu kuleya ndawo.2 Izinyathelo zokungenelela zibandakanya ukutshalwa kwethimba lamaphoyisa akhethekile aqeqeshwe ngokujulile, adume “ngelamaBherethi”, kanye nokukhuliswa kwesibalo samaphoyisa aqaphile, ehla enyuka emphakathini, eqinisekisa ukuphepha komphakathi.

src: Mmotlolo ona o sebedisa mokgwa o kgannwang ke mmaraka/mabenkele ka tshebedisanommoho le dikamano le lekala la poraefete le indasteri.
tgt: Futhi okubaluleke nakakhulu, kuzokwenziwa uphenyo mayelana nezinsolo zenkohlakalo esiteshini samaphoyisa sase-Westbury.

src: Ka mokgwa ona, mmuso o ke ke wa hlola o nka karolo patlong ya mabokose a ‘set-top’, poloko ya tsona dibakeng tse kgolo tsa poloko, tsamaiso ya tsona le ho kengwa ha disebediswa tsena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyawunxusa umphakathi wase-Westbury kanye nayo yonke eminye imiphakathi ukuthi isebenzisane namaphoyisa ukunqanda izenzo zobugebengu, izidakamizwa kanye nemigulukudu ezindaweni ehlala kuzona.

src: Sena se fa Aforika Borwa motjha wa ho phethela projeke ka tsela e kenyelletsang bohle, e theko e tlase hape e sebetsang hantle mme e fokotsang kotsi bakeng sa mmuso.
tgt: Ubugebengu IKhabhinethi liyazincoma impela izimpiko eziqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa komthetho ngophenyo olunzulu olumkhakha-mningi ezilwenzile oluphathelene nezigameko zeziqhumane ezitholakale ezikhungweni ezinenxanxathela yezitolo, ezitolo ezinkulu ezidumile kanye nasezindlini zesonto lamaSulumane (ama-mosque), okuwuphenyo oseluholele ekuboshweni kwabasolwa abayi-19.

src: Sena se tla sutumelletsa phetoho ya bobohi ba dijithale hore bo be palong e ka bang 85% le ho feta, ho lebisa ho ho tingwa ha diphatlalatsi tsa analoko.
tgt: Lolu phenyo belubandakanya neQoqwana Lezobulungiswa, Ukuvinjelwa Kobugebengu kanye Nokuvikeleka.

src: Kabinete e amohetse Tokomane ya Aforika Borwa ya Botebo bo Tshwanang, e tla nehelanwa ho Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN).
tgt: Abasolwa abathathu kulaba baboshelwe amacala aphathelene neziqhumane ezatholakala ezikhungweni ezihlukahlukene eThekwini, kubandakanya nendlu yesonto lamaSulumane e-Verulam.

src: Tokomane ena e fana ka kgatelopele e nang le tlhahisoleseding ya mofuta o akaretsang, wa nnete le wa dipalopalo ho tatelo ya Aforika Borwa ya ditshwanelo tse hoketsweng ho ditumellano tse robong tse tekennweng tsa UN.
tgt: Bonke abasolwa kulindeleke ukuthi babekwe amacala, kubandakanya elokubulala, ukuzama ukubulala kanye nokwephula uMthetho Weziqhumane.2 IKhabhinethi liyabaqinisekisa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi ukulwisana nobugebengu kuyinto ebekwe eqhulwini futhi uhulumeni uzoqhubeka nokuthatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abahlali baseNingizimu Afrika baphila ngaphansi kwesimo esiphephile futhi esivikelekile.

src: Diketsahalo tse TlangPolelo ya Pholisi ya Tekanyetso ya Nako e Bohareng (MTBPS)Letona la Ditjhelete Tito Mboweni le tla fana ka Polelo ya Pholisi ya Tekanyetso ya Nako e Bohareng (MTBPS) ka Laboraro, la 24 Mphalane 2018, le tla hlahisa diphetolo ho bajete ya naha ho netefatsa tshwarello ya tsa ditjhelete.
tgt: Ukuguqulwa kwegama lendawo: Makhanda IKhabhinethi liyakwamukela ukuguqulwa kwegama ledolobha i-Grahamstown, eMpumalanga Kapa, libizwe ngeMakhanda, ngenhloso yokuhlonipha umphrofethi, isazi senzululwazi kanye nomkhuzi wempi owalwisana nenqubo yokuqonelwa ngabezizwe.2 Lolu guquko luyingxenye esemqoka ohambweni lwentando yeningi labantu futhi luzolekelela ukuqinisa ubumbano lomphakathi futhi luzokwenza ukuthi abantu bakuleli bawuqonde futhi bawazise kakhudlwana umlando waleli lizwe, okungumlando wethu sonke.

src: Kabinete e kopa setjhaba hore se sebedise dipalangwang tsa setjhaba le ho kenya tshebetsong matsholo a polokeho mebileng selemo ho pota.
tgt: Izinqumo ZeKhabhinethiIKhabhinethi lilugunyazile uhlelo olubuyekeziwe lokuqaliswa koMklamo Wokufudukela Ekusakazeni Ngedijithali.

src: Ha re sebediseng kgwedi ena ho keteka le ho busetsa tlwaelo ya mekgatlo ya ho tsamaya mmoho ho ya mosebetsing ho fokotsa sephethephethe mebileng ya rona.
tgt: Lolu hlelo lusebenzisa indlela yokusebenza eqhutshwa yizimakethe noma izitolo ngokuthi kubanjiswane nomkhakha ozimele kanye nezimboni.

src: Polokeho mebileng ya rona e ntse e le bothata bo boholo, mme bakganni le ditaaso di lokela ho sebedisa mebila ka boikarabello.
tgt: Ngale ndlela yokusebenza, uhulumeni ngeke esazibandakanya ekuthengweni kwamabhokisana okudonsa isiginali kamabonakude (ama-set-top-boxes), ukugcinwa kwawo, kanye nokuthuthwa nokuxhunywa kwawo emakhaya.

src: Melaetsa Ditebohiso Theleskoupu ya seyalemoya ya Aforika Borwa, e leng MeerKAT, e tla kenya letsoho ho Breakthrough Listen, e leng letsholo la matjhaba le batlang matshwao a bophelo bo bohlale sepakapakeng.
tgt: Lokhu kuhlinzeka iNingizimu Afrika ngethuba lokuqhubekela phambili ekuphothulweni kwalo mklamo wokufudukela ekusakazeni ngedijithali ngendlela ebandakanyayo, engambi eqolo futhi esebenza kahle, futhi kunciphisa nobungozi kuhulumeni.

src: E supa botsebi ba rona bo tsejwang lefatsheng ka bophara le meaho.
tgt: Lokhu kuzokhuphula inani lababukeli asebebukela umabonakude othola isiginali yedijithali lifinyelele emkhawulweni obekuhloswe ukufinyelela kuwona wama-85% futhi kuze kudlulele nangaphezulu kwalokho, njengoba kuphokophelwe ekucimeni wonke amasiginali okusakaza nge-analogi.

src: Theleskoupu ya seyalemoya ya Aforika Borwa ya dikotlolo tse 64 ya MeerKAT, e hlomamisitsweng ka Phupu selemong sena, ke theleskoupu e utlwellang haholo ho fetisisa lefatsheng lohle.
tgt: Lo mbhalo uhlinzeka ngenqubekelaphambili equkethe ulwazi olujwayelekile olungamaqiniso futhi olunezibalomanani mayelana nokuthobela kweNingizimu Afrika izibopho ezihambisana nezivumelwano ze-UN eziyisishiyagalolunye ezasayinwa.

src: Kabinete e lebohisa sehlopha sa bafuputsi ba Yunivesithi ya Wits se entseng phetolo e atlehileng ya nalane ho tlosa sebete ho tswa ho Mme ya nang le tshwaetso ya HIV ho ya ho ngwana wa hae ya senang HISehlopha sa dingaka se ne se kenyelletsa Moprofesara Jean Botha, Ngaka Francesca Conradie, Ngaka Harriet Etheredge, Ngaka June Fabian le Moprofesara Caroline Tiemessen.
tgt: Imicimbi EzayoIsitatimende Senqubomgomo Yesabelomali Sesikhathi Esimaphakathi (i-MTBPS)UNgqongqoshe Wezezimali u-Tito Mboweni uzokwethula Isitatimende Senqubomgomo Yesabelomali Sesikhathi Esimaphakathi (i-MTBPS) ngoLwesithathu, mhla zingama-24 kuMfumfu 2018, esizoveza izinguquko ezithile ezenziwe kwisabelomali sikazwelonke ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukusimama kwezimali.

src: Kabinete e lebohisa batho ba Equatorial Guinea ka ketekelo ya bona ya boipuso ba dilemo tse Aforika Borwa esale e na le dikamano tse phethahetseng tsa bodiplomate le Riphabliki ya Equatorial Guinea ho tloha ka la 5 Motsheanong 1993.Matshediso Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ho lelapa, metswalle le basebetsimmoho ba Letona la Merero ya Tikoloho Boma Edna Molewa ya fetileng.
tgt: Inyanga Yezokuthutha Uhlelo lwalo nyaka lweNyanga Yezokuthutha lugcizelela ukubaluleka kwengqalasizinda yezokuthutha, enjengezithuthi zasolwandle, izindiza, izitimela kanye nezithuthi ezihamba emgwaqeni njengoba lokhu kuyizinto ezisemqoka ezizolekelela ekukhuliseni umnotho.

src: Letona Molewa o ipabotse mesebetsing le matsholong a mangata, ho tloha ho tlatsetso ya hae ntweng ya tokoloho ho isa ho ntweng ya tekatekano ya basadi setjhabeng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyawunxusa umphakathi ukuthi usebenzise izithuthi zomphakathi futhi uqalise ngenkuthalo ukusebenza kwezinhlelo zokuphepha emgwaqeni, okuyinto okumele yenziwe unyaka wonke.

src: E boetse e bile mampodi wa naha le wa matjhaba bakeng sa poloko ya tikoloho bakeng sa lefatshe le tswellang le ka arolelanwang le ho natefelwa ke bohle.
tgt: Masisebenziseni iNyanga Yezokuthutha ukugubha nokubuyisa isikompilo lokuthi abantu bagibelisane emotweni eyodwa uma beya emsebenzini esikhundleni sokuthi umuntu ngamunye azihambele ngemoto yakhe ukuze kuncishiswe isiminyaminya sezimoto emigwaqeni yakuleli.

src: Mmuso o se o tshepisitse tshehetso ya ona, moo ho hlokehang, mme Kabinete e tlotla basebetsi ba maAforika Borwa ba thuso ba nkileng karolo mesebetsing ya thuso Sehlekehlekeng sa Indonesia sa Sulawesi, se otluweng ke ho reketla ha lefatshe le tsunami.
tgt: ImiyalezoAmazwi okuhalaliselaIsibonakude seNingizimu Afrika esisebenza ngamagagasi omoya, i-MeerKAT, sizoba yingxenye ye-Breakthrough Listen, okuwuhlelo lwamazwe ngamazwe lokucinga nokuthungatha izimpawu zezidalwa eziphilayo emkhathini.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, 24 Mphalane 2018 ho la Tuynhuys, Motse Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi labamba umhlangana walo ngoLwesithathu, mhla zingama-24 kuMfumfu 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.

src: Dintlha tsa Hajwale.
tgt: Izindaba Ezisematheni.

src: Polelo ya Pholisi ya Tekanyetso ya Nako e Bohareng (MTBPS)1.1 Kabinete e amohela MTBPS ya pele ka Letona la Ditjhelete Tito Mboweni, e thehilweng hodima tumelo e matla ya hore Afrika Borwa e ka ntjhafatswa.2 MTBPS ya 2018 e totobatsa dikgetho tsa thata tsa moruo le lekgetho tse tjametseng mmuso nakong ya dilemo tse tharo tse tlang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela i-MTBPS yokuqala kaNgqongqoshe Wezezimali uTito Mboweni, ebesisuselwa enkolelweni enkulu yokuthi iNingizimu Afrika ingavuselelwa.

src: Kgolo ya moruo bakeng sa 2018 e fetoletswe tlase ho tloha ho 1.5% ho ya ho 0.7%, mme tikoloho ya lefatshe e dula e ntse e le thata bakeng sa meruo ya mebaraka e thuthuwang.
tgt: I-MTBPS yowezi-2018 icaphuna ubunzima uhulumeni abhekene nabo ezinqumweni okumele azithathe kwezomnotho kanye nakwimali kahulumeni eminyakeni emithathu ezayo.

src: MTBPS ya 2018 e qala tshebetso ya morero wa Mopresidente wa tsosoloso ya kgolo ya moruo le puseletso, tse tla tshehetswa ke botsitso ba tsa lekgetho le ditjhelete.3 Mmuso o dula o itlametse botsitso ba tsa lekgetho, empa ho bile le phokotseho esale ho tloha ka puo ya Ditekanyetso ya 2018 ka Hlakola selemong sena.
tgt: Ukukhula kwezomnotho konyaka wezi-2018 kubuyekeziwe kwasuka ku-1.5% kwaya ku-0.7%, futhi isimo somhlaba jikelele siqhubeka nokuba nezingqinamba kwezomnotho emazweni asafufusa.

src: Mmuso o ikitlaelletsa ho tlisa botsitso le ho fokotsa mekoloto.
tgt: I-MTBPS yowezi-2018 iqalisa ukusimamisa kanye nohlelo lukahulumeni lokuvusesela nokugqugquzela ukusimama komnotho, oluzosekelwa uzinzo lwesikhwamamali sikahulumeni kanye nolwezimali.

src: Papisong le tikoloho e phephetsang ya moruo le tsa lekgetho, karolo e sisingwang ya lekeno e tswelapele ho beha sehlohlolong mananeo a tshebediso e hodimo ya tjhelete a tshehetsang ditshebeletso tsa thuto ya motheo, bophelo bo botle, boiketlo ba setjhaba, metsi, tlhwekiso le motlakase.
tgt: Uhulumeni uqhubeka nokuzibophezela ekusimamiseni isikhawamamali sikahulumeni, kodwa kube nokuchezuka okuncane selokhu sethulwa kuSabelomali sowezi-2018 kuNhlolanja kulo nyaka.

src: Phetolo ya lefatshe Kabinete e amohela ho kenngwa tshebetsong ho tsitsitseng ha mananeo a phetolo le pusetso ya lefatshe a lokisang tlhokeho ya toka ya nako e fetileng le ho thusa ho hodisa moruo.2 Mopresidente Cyril Ramaphosa o etelletse pele mokete wa pusetso ya lefatshe, moo dihektere tse 4 586 tsa lefatshe di fuweng setjhaba sa KwaMkhwanazi ho la Empangeni, KwaZulu-Natal.3 Setjhaba sa KwaMkhwanazi se boetse se tla fumana dikapana tsa kamora phallo le tshehetso tse tla ba thusa ho fihlella tshebediso e hodimodimo ya leruo la lefatshe leo.
tgt: Njengoba kuncipha umthwalo osindayo kwezomnotho kanye nasesimweni sesikhwamamali sikahulumeni, ukwahlukaniswa kwengeniso okuphakanyiswayo kuyaqhubeka nokubeka eqhulwini izinhlelo zokusebenzisa imali emphakathini njengemfundo eyisisekelo, ezempilo, ezenhlalakahle, amanzi, ukuthuthwa kwendle kanye nezinsiza zikagesi.

src: Tshenyo ya disebediswa tsa setjhaba Kabinete e hlahisitse ngongoreho mabapi le tshenyo ya disebediswa tsa dipalangwang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela imiphumela yeNgqungquthela Yezempilo KaMongameli ehlose ukudingida izinselele ezinhlobonhlobo eziqondene nohlelo lwezempilo lomphakathi.

src: Sena se nyotobetsa boitlamo ba mmuso ba ho isa ditshebeletso ho ditjhaba tse neng di sotlehileng nakong ya kgale.
tgt: Imiphumela izoqinisa amalungiselelo okuqalisa uMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke (i-NHI).

src: Tshenyo ena e hlokisa batho ba sotlehileng ditshebeletso tseo ba di hlokang e le kannete.2 Kabinete e kopa ditho tsa setjhaba hore di be sedi mme di sebetse mmoho le ditheo tsa molao hore ba ikarabellang diketsong tsena ba tshwarwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela ukuqaliswa kwezinhlelo zoguquko nokubuyiselwa komhlaba eziqhutshwa ngokulinganayo eziqondene nemisebenzi nokungalungi kwesikhathi esedlule futhi lisiza ukukhulisa umnotho.

src: Kabinete e boetse e lemohile hore Sehlopha sa Toka, Thibelo ya Botlokotsebe le Tshireletso se tla sebetsana le taba ena ka nepo.
tgt: UMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa uhole umcimbi wokubuyiswa komhlaba, lapho kunikezelwe ngamahektha ayizi-4 586 omhlaba emphakathini waKwaMkhwanazi eMpangeni, KwaZulu-Natali.

src: Tshebetso ya ho thonya Molaodi wa Botjhotjhisi ba Naha (NDPP)5.1 Kabinete e amohetse tsela e ntjha ya ho thonya NDPMopresidente Ramaphosa o thontse Sehlopha sa Keletso ho thonya batho ba tshwanelehang le ho tshwara dikopano tsa dipotso tsa mosebetsi le bona ho bona haeba ba tshwaneleha ho ka palama setulo sa Hlooho ya Bolaodi ba Botjhotjhisi ba Naha.
tgt: Umphakathi waKwaMkhwanazi uzothola nezabelo ezilandela ukubuyiswa komhlaba kanye nokwesekwa okuzowusiza usebenzise yonke ingcebo ongase uyithole kulowa mhlaba.

src: Sehlopha seo se kopane lekgetlo la pele bekeng ena mme ho lebelletswe hore se tla fana ka lenane le lekgutshwane la mabitso a batho ba tshwanelehang ho Mopresidente pele ho la 7 Tshitwe Kahlolo ya Lekgotla la Molaotheo Kabinete e sekasekile Kahlolo ya Lekgotla la Molaotheo e mabapi le tshebediso, temo le ho ba le matekwane ke motho e moholo ha hae bakeng sa tshebediso ya hae le kamo ya sena.
tgt: Lokhu kushintsha imiphakathi esebenzela ukuziphilisa ibambe iqhaza kwezohwebo futhi ibe ngabanikazi bamabhizinisi kuyo yonke imisebenzi evela kwezolimo kanye nengcebo engatholakala emhlabeni wabo.

src: Ditho tsa setjhaba di koptjwa ho ithuta kahlolo ena kaha tshebediso ya matekwane sebakeng sa setjhaba e thibetswe.
tgt: Uhulumeni uzinikele ekwesekeni ukusimamiswa kwamabhizinisi ezolimo aqubukayo, okubandakanya imisebenzi engama-262 ehambisana nokuguqulwa komhlaba ukuze kuhlomule intsha kanye nabantu besifazane kuzo zonke izifundazwe.

src: Batswadi le bahlokomedi ba kgothalletswa ho tshehetsa baithuti nakong ena e bohlokwahadi leetong la bona la thuto.
tgt: Lokhu kubhidlizwa kwempahla kuphuca abampofu inqwaba yezinsiza eziyizidingongqangi.

src: Ho boetse ho bohlokwa ho kgothalletsa baithuti ho phethela dithuto tsa bona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa amalungu omphakathi ukuthi aqaphele futhi asebenzisane nezinhlaka zomthetho ukuze labo abaphula umthetho babhekana nengalo yomthetho.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete Kabinete e amohetse phatlalatso ya Dibaka tsa Mawatle tse Sireleditsweng (di-MPA) tse 20 jwalo ka karolo ya Operation Phakisa: Netweke ya Baemedi ba Moruo wa Mawatle wa di-MPA.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde laveza ukuthi iQoqwana Lezobulungiswa, Ukuvikelwa Kobugebengu Nezokuvikela lizobhekana kanjani nalolu daba ngokufanele.

src: Molemo wa mokgahlelo ona o eketsehileng hara tse ding o tla dumella ntshetsopele e eketsehileng ya bohahlaudi ba tikoloho le phahamiso ya phihlello ya disebediswa tse laolwang ka tsela e tswellang bakeng sa dikgwebo tse nyane tsa ho tjheha dihlapi.
tgt: Inqubo yokuqokwa KukaMqondisi Wephiko Lwezokushushisa Kuzwelonke (i-NDPP) IKhabhinethi lamukele indlela entsha yokuqoka u-NDPUMongameli Ramaphosa uqoke Ithimba Labeluleki elizohlonza futhi libambe imposambuso nabantu abafanelekile ukuthi bangathatha isikhundla sokuba yiNhloko yoPhiko Lwezokushushisa Kuzwelonke (i-NPA).

src: Mekgahlelo e sisintsweng e ne e latela ditshekatsheko le baamehi bohle ba nkang letsoho.
tgt: Ithimba lisebenze okokuqala kuleli sonto futhi kulindeleke ukuthi lithumele amagama abantu abakhethwe njengalabo abangase bafanelwe ukuthatha lesi sikhundla kuMongameli ngomhla ziyi-7 kuZibandlela 2018.

src: Kabinete e amohetse Lenaneo la Bobedi la Tshebetso (NAP) la Aforika Borwa le Shebilweng Botjha le ho Matahanngwa ho Lwantsha Ketso ya Mahwatata, Tshenyeho ya Lefatshe le ho Lwantsha Dikamo tsa Komello (2018-2030).
tgt: Isinqumo Senkantolo YoMthethosisekelo.1 IKhabhinethi lenze izethulo ngeSinqumo Senkantolo yoMthethosisekelo esiqondene nokusetshenziswa, ukulinywa nokuphathwa kwensangu ngabantu abadala ngasese bezisebenzisele ngokwabo kanye nomthelela wako.

src: NAP e ikemiseditse ho kenya letsoho tshireletsong le tshebedisong ya nako e telele ya lefatshe la rona le dihlodilweng tse ding tsa naha.
tgt: Kucelwa ukuthi amalungu omphakathi azijwayeze lesi sinqumo njengoba ukusetshenziswa kwensangu emphakathini kungavumelekile.

src: Ho latela Seratswana sa 9 sa tumellano, baamehi ba hloka ho hlahisa, ho lokisa le ho kenya tshebetsong NAP jwalo ka karolo e bohareng ya moralo wa ho lwantsha tlhaho ya mahwatata le ho thibela dikamo tsa komello.
tgt: Phezu kwalokho, lesi sinqumo asikuqedanga ukuba yicala kokudayiswa kwensangu.2 IKhabhinethi lazisa ukuthi lesi sinqumo sisebenza phakathi kweminye imithetho engase isebenze maqondana nokusebenzisa, ukuphatha kanye nokutshala insangu.

src: Kabinete e amohetse phatlalatso ya Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Bana ho Kasete ya Mmuso bakeng sa maikutlo a setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela iNgqungquthela Yezokuphepha Ezikoleni esanda kubanjwa ngaphansi kobuholi bukaNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo u-Angie Motshekga.

src: Bili ena e labalabela ho matlafatsa kgokahano ya sistimi ya tlhokomelo ya bana le tshireletso ka tshebedisanommoho ya mafapha le makala.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ihlanganise ababambiqhaza kwezemfundo nabazimele ukuthola izisombululo ngezinkinga zezokuphepha eziqondene nezikole ezweni kanye nokusungula indlela ebheke phambili yokwakha izimo eziphephile esikoleni.

src: Ditokiso tsena di arabela Kahlolo ya Lekgotla le Phahameng la Gauteng Leboya ya Pudungwana 2017, moo teng Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba le laetsweng ho lokisa le ho tsebisa ditokiso tse hlokehang ho Molao wa Bana, 2005 (Molao 38 wa 2005) mabapi le tharollo ya semolao ya tsamaiso ya sistimi ya tlhokomelo ya bana ba sa nkwang semolao.
tgt: Lokhu kulandela izigameko zodlame ezehle ezikoleni ezithile, okubandakanya ukubulawa ngesihluku kukathisha oneminyaka engama-24, uMnu.

src: Bili e kenya tshebetsong Molawana o sisintsweng wa Pholisi e Kopaneng ya Naha ya ICT o ammohetsweng ke Kabinete ka Lwetse 2016.Diphetho tse rerilweng di tla etsa hore ho be le Ofisi ya Ditshebeletso tsa Poso ya Aforika Borwa e hlodisanang, e sebetsang hape e tshwarelletseng e fanang ka/e tsamaisang ditshebeletso tsohle le phihlello hammoho le phetoho ya lekala la diposo.
tgt: Izivivinyo zikamatikuletsheni IKhabhinethi lifisela bonke abafundi, ikakhulukazi abafundi beBanga le-12, okumhlophe kulesi sikhathi.

src: Bili e boetse e fana hape le ka matla a ho fana ka diaterese tsa bodulo ho ditjhaba tsa mahaeng le tse dulang metseng ya marena.
tgt: Okokuqala ngqa, kulo nyaka uMnyango uzoba nesivivinyo sokuhlolela uLimi Lwezimpawu lwaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SASL) ezingeni loLimi Lwasekhaya esizobhalwa abafundi abangama-58 abangezwa kahle ezikoleni eziyi-10.

src: Ena ke karolo ya diteko tse kopaneng tsa ho hohela ditsetelo le ho hodisa moruo wa rona.
tgt: Abafundi ezweni lonke bazosayina isifungo esingaphoqelekile sokuzinikela ukuhlonipha isithunzi sezivivinyo ngokungayephuli imibandela yezivivinyo.

src: Ho feta moo, barumuwa ba bane ba tsa matsete ba kgethilweng ke Mopresidente ba tla fana ka tlaleho ho kopano mabapi le kgatelopele eo ba e entseng.
tgt: Abazali nababheki bezingane bakhuthazwa ukuthi babeseke abafundi ngalesi sikhathi esibucayi ohambweni lwabo lwezemfundo.

src: Kopano ya Sehlopha sa Dinaha tse Mashome a Mabedi (G20) Mopresidente Ramaphosa o memilwe ke Tjhanselara ya Federale ya Jeremane, Ngaka Angela Merkel, ho nka karolo ho Kopano ya Matsete ya G20 – Kgwebo ya Jeremane le Tumellano le Dinaha tsa (CwA), le Kopano ya Kgwebo, tseo bobedi di tla tshwarelwa ho la Berlin, Jeremane ka la 30 Mphalane 2018.Kopano ya Matsete ya G20 e tla kopanya kgwebo ya Jeremane le Dinaha tsa CwA hore ba utulle menyetla ya tsetelo tlasa moralo wa G20 wa Selekane le Aforika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukunqunywa kweziNdawo Zasolwandle Ezivikelekile (ama-MPA) ezingama-20 njengengxenye yeNethiwekhi Emelwe yama-MPA ye-Operation Phakisa: Umnotho Wasolwandle.

src: Batsetedi ba Jeremane ba tla hlahisa diprojeke tsa bohlokwa tse di ntseng di tswelapele Dinaheng tsa CwA le ho batla menyetla e meng kontinenteng.
tgt: Umhlomulo womsebenzi ongenzelwe, phakathi kokunye, uzovumela ukuqhubeka kokuthuthukiswa kwezokuvakasha okuqondene nezemvelo kanye nokukhuthazwa kokufinyelela ezinsizeni zabadobi abadobela ukuziphilisa eziphethwe ngendlela esimamisayo.
