src: Kgwedi ya Dipalangwang Kgwedi ya Dipalangwang selemong sena e tla ketekwa tlasa mookotaba: “Siyakha – Ho ahwa meralo e ntlafetseng ya ditshebeletso ho hodisa Afrika Borwa”.
tgt: INyanga Yezokuthutha Kulo nyaka iNyanga Yezokuthutha izogujwa ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Siyakha – Sakha ingqalasizinda engcono ezokhulisa iNingizimu Afrika”.

src: Kgwedi ya Dipalangwang 2023 e tla tsepama matseteng a maholo meralong ya ditshebeletso ya dipalangwang, le boipiletso ba ho nka bohato ho sireletsa meralo ya ditshebeletso ya dipalangwang e se utsuwe le ho senngwa.
tgt: INyanga Yezokuthutha ngowezi-2023 izogxila kutshalomali olukhulu kwingqalasizinda yezokuthutha, kanye nekhwelo lokuthatha igxathu lokuvikela ingqalasizinda yezokuthutha ukuthi ingebiwa futhi ingacekelwa phansi.

src: Letsatsi la Lefatshe la Matitjhere Afrika Borwa e tla ikamahanya le dinaha tse ding ho keteka Letsatsi la Lefatshe la Matitjhere ka Labone la la 5 Mphalane 2023, tlasa mookotaba: “Matitjhere ao re a hlokang bakeng la thuto eo re e batlang: Bohlokwa ba ho lwantsha kgaello ya matitjhere lefatsheng.” Sepheo ka letsatsi leo ke ho hlokomedisa, ho etsa hore batho ba utlwisise le ho ananela seabo sa bohlokwa sa matitjhere thutong le ntshetsopeleng lefatsheng ka bophara.
tgt: Usuku Lomhlaba Lothisha INingizimu Afrika izohlanganyela nomhlaba wonke ekukhumbuleni uSuku Lomhlaba Lothisha ngoLwesine, mhla wesi-5 kuMfumfu 2023, ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Othisha esibadingela imfundo esiyifunayo: Ukubaluleka komhlaba ukuthi uvale igebe lokuntuleka kothisha”.

src: Letsatsi lena le tsebahaditswe ke Mokgatlo wa Basebetsi wa Lefatshe le Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng wa tsa Thuto, Saense le Setso, ho keteka mosebetsi wa bohlokwa o etswang ke matitjhere.
tgt: Lolu suku kuhloswe ngalo ukuqwashisa, ukuqondisisa kanye nokubonga igalelo elibaluleke kakhulu elifakwa ngothisha kwezemfundo kanye nentuthuko emhlabeni jikelele.

src: DitebohisoKabinete e thoholeditse le ho lebisa ditakaletso tse ntle ho:Mokgenerale Bheki Cele, Letona la Mapolesa, ya fumaneng Great Wall Commemorative Medal, China bakeng sa seabo sa Tshebeletso ya Mapolesa ya Afrika Borwa tshebedisanong ya dinaha tsena tse pedi ya ho kenngwa ha molao tshebetsong ka kakaretso.
tgt: Lolu suku luphinde lwamenyezelwa ngokuhlanganyela yiNhlangano Yabasebenzi Yamazwe Ngamazwe kanye neNhlangano Yezizwe Ezibumbene Yezemfundo, Isayensi Namasiko njengendlela yokubungaza umsebenzi obaluleke kakhulu owenziwa ngothisha.

src: Mme Angie Motshekga, Letona la Thuto ya Motheo, ka ho kgethwa ke Mongodi e Moholo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng, Monghadi Antonio Guterres, ho ba Moifong wa Lefatshe wa Boemo bo Hodimo o tla mo eletsa ka mekgwa eo dinaha di ka tlisang diphetoho mekgwatshebetsong ya thuto ya tsona.
tgt: UkuhalalisaIKhabhinethi lihalalisela futhi lifisela okuhle laba abalandelayo: UJenene Bheki Cele, uNgqongqoshe Wamaphoyisa, oklonyeliswe nge-Great Wall Commemorative Medal ephuma e-People’s Republic of China ngegalelo loPhiko Lwamaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika lokusebenzisana ekuqinisekiseni ukuthotshelwa komthetho phakathi kwala mazwe womabili.

src: Moifo o kenyeletsa baemedi ba Mokgatlo wa Basebetsi wa Matjhaba, Mokgatlo wa Matitjhere wa Tshebetso wa Thuto, Saense le tsa Setso, Mekgatlo ya Lefatshe ya Matitjhere le Matona a Mararo a Thuto.
tgt: Angie Motshekga, uNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo, ngokukhethwa nguNobhala-Jikelele we-UN, uMnu.

src: Ditudiyo tsa Cape Town Film, dibapadi tsa naha ena tsa ditshwantshiso le dibapadi tsa dikarolo tse kotsi, ka seabo sa bona filiming ya Netflix, One Piece, e fihlelletseng boemong ba pele lefatsheng ka bophara motjheng ona wa kgaso ya inthanete.
tgt: Antonio Guterres, ukuthi abe yingxenye ye-Global High-Level Panel okuyithimba elizomeluleka ngokuthi amazwe angaziguqula kanjani izindlela-kusebenza kwezemfundo.

src: Sebaka sa Tsino sa Van Ryn, ka ho fumana kgau ya Boranti bo tswang pele Lefatsheng bakeng sa boranti ba yona bo tsinnweng habedi ba dilemo tse lshome le metso e mmedi, Tlhodisanong ya Matsina ya Matjhaba ya 2023 London.
tgt: Ukukhethwa kukaNgqongqoshe u-Motshekga kuleli thimba eliphezulu kubonisa ukungcitha-buchopho bakhe emkhakheni wezemfundo futhi kubonisa ukuthi indlela yezemfundo eNingizimu Afrika ithenjiwe.

src: MatshedisoKabinete e lebisitse matshediso malapeng le metswalleng ya: Monghadi Aziz Goolam Hoosein Pahad (82), eo e neng e le moitseki kgahlano le mmuso wa kgethollo le eo e bileng Motlatsa-Letona la Ditaba tsa Kantle wa pele wa mmuso wa Demokrasi wa Afrika Borwa ho tloha ka 1994 ho ya ho 2008.
tgt: Ithimba liqukathe abamele iNhlangano Yabasebenzi Yamazwe Ngamazwe, iThimba Lothisha beNhlangano ye-UN Yezemfundo, Isayensi Namasiko, Izinyonyana Zothisha Zomhlaba kanye noNgqongqoshe bezemfundo abathathu.

src: Maemo a Renang 2023 Bommampodi ba Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Rugby Kabinete e ile ya lebohisa di-Springboks ka tlholo ya tsona ya Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Rugby wa 2023 e ileng ya etsa hore Afrika Borwa e be yona feela naha e hapileng Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Rugby ka makgetlo a mane le ya bobedi ho hapa mohope oo ka ho latellana.
tgt: OShampeni Bomhlaba Bebhola Lombhoxo ngowezi-2023 IKhabhinethi lihalalisele iqembu lama-Springboks ekunqobeni kwalo iNdebe Yomhlaba Yebhola Lombhoxo ngowezi-2023 nokwenze ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ibe ilona kuphela lizwe elinqobe iNdebe Yomhlaba yebhola Lombhoxo izikhawu ezine (4) kanye nelesibili ukunqoba izikhawu zilandelana.

src: Historing ya rugby Afrika Borwa, sehlopha sena sa di-Springboks ke sona se nang le merabe e fapaneng ka ho fetisisa ho latela boemedi ba palo ya batho ya Afrika Borwa.
tgt: Emlandweni webhola lombhoxo eNingizimu Afrika, leli qembu lama-Springboks liyiqembu elahlukehlukene kakhulu uma ubheka ukwahlukana kwemvelaphi yabantu eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Sebopeho sena sa sehlopha sa merabe e fapaneng hase ketso e iketsahalletseng feela, empa ke boiteko bo rerilweng ke basebetsi ba tsamaiso le ba kwetlisang ba di-Springboks ho kgetha sehlopha se kenyelletsang bohle.
tgt: Ukudidiyelwa kwaleli qembu elahlukahlukene kanje akuzenzekelanga, kodwa kube ngumsebenzi wabaphathi nabaqeqeshi bama-Springboks wokukhetha iqembu elingacwasi muntu.

src: Qeto eo e bontshang sebete sa mokwetlisi Rassie Erasmus le sehlopa sa hae e tswela pele ho bontsha Maafrika Borwa le lefatshe lohle, hore motho e mong le e mong ya nang le bokgoni, haeba a fuwa monyetla le tshehetso, a ka hlahella – le bopaki ba hore re Matla Mmoho.
tgt: Isinqumo esiphusile esathathwa ngumqeqeshi wangaleso sikhathi u-Rassie Erasmus nethimba lakhe siyaqhubeka ukubonisa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika nomhlaba wonke, ukuthi wonke umuntu onekhono, uma enikezwa ithuba nokwesekwa, angenza ezibukwayo – okuyisiqinisekiso sokuthi Sinamandla uma Sibambisene.

src: Sa bohlokwa le ho feta, mamello le boikemisetso ba di-Springboks lebaleng la dipapadi, ho phethahatsa moelelo wa nnete wa se bolelwang ke ho ba Moafrika Borwa, e leng se etsang hore naha ena e kgolo e eme kgahlanong le ditshitiso tsohle le mathata e le hore e hlahe e le mohlodi.
tgt: Okubaluleke kakhulu, ukuphikelela nokuzimisela kwama-Springboks enkundleni yezemidlalo kubonise ukufana nse nokuba ngumuntu waseNingizimu Afrika, lokho okwenza lesi sizwe esikhulukazi sibhekane nazo zonke izingqinamba kanye nobunzima ukuze sizonqoba.

src: Tse ding tsa dibapadi tse hlwahlwa tsa sehlopha sena sa di-Springboks di ile tsa lokela ho hlola mathata tseleng ya tsona e lebisang katlehong e kgolo.
tgt: Abanye babadlali abaphuma phambili eqenjini lama-Springboks bebebhekene nobunzima ezimpilweni zabo endleleni yabo eya ekunqobeni.

src: Kabinete e ile ya lebohisa Siyamthanda “Siya” Kolisi, mokapotene wa di-Springboks tse hapileng ka makgetlo a mabedi Mohope wa Lefatshe bakeng sa ho etella pele sehlopha ho se lebisa boemong ba Greatest of All Time (GOAT) mme ho keteka ho lokela ho tswela pele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisele uSiyamtanda “Siya” Kolisi, ongukaputeni wama-Springboks onqobe kabili iNdebe Yomhlaba ngokuhola iqembu lafinyelela ezingeni esilibiza nge-Greatest of All Time (GOAT) kanti imigubho kufanele iqhubeke.

src: Foramo ya AGOA Kabinete e thabetse tiisetso ya botsamaisi ba Amerika le seboka ka boikemisetso ba tsona ba ho atollosa AGOA, e leng se tlisang bonnete ho setjhaba sa matsete sa dinaha tse tshwanelehang bakeng sa AGOKabinete e boetse ya amohela ho tshwarelwa ha Foramo ya AGOA ya 2023, lekgetlo la pele Johannesburg ho tloha ka la 2 – 4 Pudungwana 2023 moo ho bileng le bankakarolo ba emetseng dinaha tsa Afrika tse 32 ba tswang mmusong, kgwebong, mekgatlong ya setjhaba le mekgatlong ya basebetsi hammoho le baemedi ba mmuso wa Amerika.
tgt: IForamu ye-AGOA IKhabhinethi lamukele isiqinisekiso esenziwe ubuholi baseMelika kanye nenhlangano ngezinhloso zokwelula i-AGOA, nokuqinisekisa abatshalizimali emazweni afanelekile e-AGOIKhabhinethi liphinde lamukela ukusingathwa kweForamu ye-AGOA yezi-2023 eGoli kusuka mhla wesi-2 kuya mhla wesi-4 kuLwezi 2023 ebe nezethameli ezisuka emazweni ase-Afrika angama-32, umkhakha wezamabhizinisi, umphakathi kanye nomkhakha wezabasebenzi okokuqala ngqa kanye nabamele uhulumeni waseMelika.

src: Kabinete kamehla e tiisa hore AGOA e fana ka monyetla wa hore Amerika e matlafatse maqhama a moruo le Afrika mme kahoo e lokela ho ekeletswa nako ya ho ba tshebetsong ka nako e bonahalang, e nang le moelelo, ho etsa hore e be le mosola le tshusumetso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi belihlezi njalo liqinisekisa ukuthi i-AGOA ihlinzeka ngethuba lokuthi iMelika iqinise ubudlelwano bayo bezomnotho ne-Afrika ngakho-ke kufanele yelulwe isikhathi esibonakalayo, iphinde yenziwe ngcono ibe negalelo futhi ihehe.

src: Seboka sa Matona a Bohahlaodi a BRICS Kabinete e thabetse sephetho se atlehileng sa Seboka sa Matona a Bohahlaodi a BRICS sa 2023 se neng se tshwaretswe Cape Town, se ileng sa etsa hore dinaha tseo e leng ditho di sebedisane ka ho felletseng ho ntshetsa pele bohahlaodi ba ka hare ho BRICS, ho ntlafatsa ditsela bakeng sa motsamao o betere wa bohahlaudi le kgokahanyo hara dinaha tseo e leng ditho.
tgt: UMhlangano woNgqongqoshe Bezokuvakasha be-BRICIKhabhinethi lamukele ukuphothulwa ngempumelelo koMhlangano woNgqongqoshe be-BRICS wangowezi-2023 obubanjwe eKapa, nalapho amazwe angamalungu ezinikele ekusebenzeni ngokubambisana kanye nokugqugquzela ezokuvakasha ngaphakathi kumazwe angamalungu e-BRICS, ukusungula imigudu ezohambeka kalula kwezokuvakasha kanye nokuxhumana phakathi kwamazwe angamalungu.

src: Sena se tla matlafatsa le ho feta lefapha la Afrika Borwa la bohahlaodi le seng le ntse le bontsha matshwao a ho ntlafala.
tgt: Lokhu kuzoqhubeka kuqinise umkhakha wezokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika nosuvele ubonisa izimpawu zokuvuka.

src: Bakeng sa dikgwedi tsa pele tse 8 tsa 2023, naha e ile ya ba le baeti ba dimilione tse e leng se ileng sa bontsha keketseho ya dipersente tse ho tloha ho nako e tshwanang ka 2022.
tgt: Ezinyangeni eziyisishiyagalombili zokuqala kowezi-2023, izwe lamukela izivakashi ezingenayo eziyizigidi eziyisi-5.5 nokuchaza ukuthi izinga lezivakashi lenyuke ngama-63.4% kusuka esikhathini esifanayo ngowezi-2022.

src: Ngodiso ya Dikgetho IEC e phatlaladitse la 18 le la 19 Pudungwana 2023 e le mafelobeke a pele a ho ingodisetsa ho kgetha bakeng sa Dikgetho tsa Kakaretso tsa 2024.
tgt: Ukubhalisela Ukuvota I-IEC imemezele ukuthi umhla we-18 nomhla we-19 kuLwezi 2023 kuzoba impelasonto yokuqala yokubhalisela ukuvota kuKhetho Lukazwelonke ngowezi-2024.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho bohle ba tshwanelehang ho kgetha ho ingodisetsa ho kgetha bakeng sa Dikgetho tsa Kakaretso tsa 2024 diteisheneng tsa hao tsa ho kgetha tse haufinyane.
tgt: IKhabhinethi licela bonke abantu abafaneleke ukuvota ukuthi babhalisele ukuvota kuKhetho Lukazwelonke ngowezi-2024 eziteshini zokuvota eziseduzane nabo.

src: Ngodiso ya ho kgetha ya inthanete e butswe ho tloha ka Hlakola 2023 mme baahi ba koptjwa ho sebedisa setsi sena ho ingodisa kapa ho ntlafatsa dintlha tsa bona.
tgt: Ukubhalisela ukuvota ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-inthanethi selokhu kwavulwa kusukela ngoNhlolanja wezi-2023 kanti izakhamuzi ziyanxuswa ukuba zisebenzise le ndlela ukubhalisa noma ukushintsha imininingwane yabo.

src: Maafrika Borwa a kentseng dikopo tsa di-ID a kgothalletswa ho etela ofisi ya Meroro ya Lehae ya sebakeng sa habo bona bakeng sa ho ya di nka.
tgt: Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abafaka izicelo zomazisi babo bayagqugquzelwa ukuthi bavakashele ihhovisi loMnyango Wezasekhaya beyobalanda.

src: Ho na le dikarete tsa di-smart ID tse fetang 500 000 tse lokelang ho latwa diofising tsa Merero ya Lehae naha ka bophara.
tgt: Kunamakhadi omazisi abangaphezu kwezi-50 000 abangalandiwe emahhovisi oMnyango Wezasekhaya kulolonke izwe.

src: Motlakase Letona ofising ya Mopresidente le ikarabellang bakeng sa Motlakase le fane ka dintlha tse hlakileng ka boemo ba motlakase naheng.
tgt: Ugesi UNgqongqoshe Kagesi eHhovisi likaMengameli usekhiphe umbiko ngesimo sikagesi kuleli lizwe.

src: Kabinete e ile ya thoholetsa boiteko ba Mmuso wa Profinse ya Gauteng o sebetsang le Eskom ho tsosollosa motlakase dibakeng tsa Gauteng tse nnileng tsa ba lefifing ka lebaka la boshodu kapa ho senyeha ha di-transformer.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lishayele ihlombe imizamo kaHulumeni Wesifundazwe sase-Gauteng osebenzisana no-Eskom ukubuyisa ugesi ezindaweni zase-Gauteng ebezilokhu zacinyelwa ugesi ngenxa yokwebiwa kanye nokucekelwa phansi kwama-transformer.

src: Bosiung bo fetileng, di-transformer tse tsheletseng tse ntjha tsa motlakase di ile tsa kenngwa Kagiso, sebakeng sa West Rand ka mora hore baahi ba sale ba se na motlakase ka dilemo tse fetang tse tharo.
tgt: Izolo ebusuku, ama-transformer amasha ayisithupha aqale ukusebenza eKagiso, e-West Rand emva kokuthi umphakathi ubuhleli ngomnyama isikhathi esingaphezu kweminyaka emithathu.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho baahi bana hore ba sirelletse disebediswa tsena tsa bohlokwa boshodung, le tshenyong tse bakwang ke dikgokelo tse seng molaong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi licela le miphakathi ukuthi ivikele ingqalasizinda ebalulekile ukuthi ingebiwa, ingacekelwa phansi futhi ingalinyazwa ngenxa yokuxhuma ugesi ngokungemthetho.

src: Tjhefo ya Dijo Kabinete e tshwenyehile ka ho ata ha bana ba kudiswang ke tjhefo ya dijo eo ba e fumaneng ha ba ja dijo tse felletsweng ke nako le tse silafetseng tseo ba di rekileng mabenkeleng a spaza le ho barekisi ba seterateng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likhathazekile ngezehlakalo zokutholakala kwezingane ezidle ukudla okunobuthi osekudlulelwe yisikhathi nokunamagciwane ezikuthenga ezitolo eziyiziphaza nakulaba abadayisa emgwaqeni.

src: Kabinete e kgothaditswe ke boiteko ba tshebetso ya molao ba ho tiisa hore ho latelwa melao ya polokeho ya dijo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyagqugquzeleka ngemizamo yabomthetho yokuqinisekisa ukuthi imithetho yokuphepha kokudla iyalandelwa.

src: Seboka sa Matjhaba se Buang ka Diketso tsa ho Falla se Kwetlisang Boramotse le Marena Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka Seboka sa Matjhaba se Buang ka Diketso tsa ho Falla se Kwetlisang Boramotse le Marena se neng se tshwerwe ke Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae ka bonkakarolo ba Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dikgwebo tse Nyenyanane, Lefapha la Puso ya Kopanelo le Ditaba tsa Borena Lefapha la Bodulo ba Batho le marena le boramotse ho tswa bomasepaleng ba ditoropo le ba ditereke, se neng se tsepamisitswe ho ditlamorao tse bakwang ke ho falla ho seng molaong, ho kenyelletsa tsamaiso ya mabenkele a spaza.
tgt: UMhlangano Wezokufudukela Kwamanye Amazwe noSodolobha kanye Nabaholi Bendabuko.

src: Sephetho se ka sehloohong se akaralletsa ho kenyelletswa ha melawana ya dintho tse fapaneng bakeng sa ho lokisa mathata a amanang le phethahatso ya melawana ya kgwebo ke bomasepala le balaodi ba setso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi litshelwe kafushane ngomhlangano omayelana nokufudukela kwamanye amazwe obusingathwe nguMnyango Wezasekhaya ngokubambisana ne-DSBD, i-COGTA, uMnyango Wezokuhlaliswa Kwabantu kanye nabaholi bendabuko nosodolobha bamadolobha nomasipala besifunda nobugxile ekunqandeni imiphumela emibi yokufudukela kuleli lizwe ngokungemthetho, kubandakanya nokusebenza kwezitolo eziyiziphaza.

src: Ho tla ba le ditlhahlobo tsa hanghang tse kopanetsweng tsa dikgwebo, ka ho kgetheha tsa mabenkele a spaza ke mafapha a mosebetsi, a bophelo bo botle, a ntshetso pele ya dikgwebo tse nyenyane le dihlopha tsa tlhahlobo ya ho falla tsa Merero ya Lehae, bakeng sa ho qobella boikamahanyo le melao e sebetsang.
tgt: Imiphumela ebalulekile ibandakanya ukwethulwa kwemithetho kamasipala ezobhekana nezinselele ezihlobene nokuthi umasipala neziphathimandla zendabuko ziqinisekisa kanjani ukuthotshelwa kwemithetho kamasipala yebhizinisi.

src: Tlhahlobo ho mabenkele a spaza metseng le makeisheneng, le mekgwa ya ho a ngodisa e tla sebediswa ke baetapele ba setso le bomasepala.
tgt: Kuzoba nokuhlolisiswa okudidiyelwe kwamabhizinisi, ikakhulukazi iziphaza okuzokwenziwa uMnyango Wezabasebenzi, Owezempilo, Owokuthuthukiswa Kwamabhizinisi Amancane kanye namathimba abahloli boMnyango Wezasekhaya, ukuqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa kwemithetho efanele.

src: Ho boetse ho na le boiteko ba ho tshehetsa balaodi ba setso ho boloka tlaleho ya batho ba tswang kantle ho naha metseng ya bona.
tgt: Ukucwaningwa kweziphaza emakhaya nasemalokishini, kanye nezindlela zokuthi zibhaliswe ngaphansi kwabaholi bendabuko kanye nomasipala zizoqaliswa.

src: Molao wa laesense ya kgwebo o fetotswe bakeng sa ho tshehetsa bohle ba lakatsang ho hweba mafapheng a sa laolweng ke mmuso.
tgt: Kuneminye imizamo yokweseka iziphathimandla zendabuko ukuthi zikwazi ukugcina amabhuku anohlu lwabantu bokufika emiphakathini yabo.

src: Ntwa ya Kopanelo Kgahlanong le Botlokotsebe Kabinete e babatsa SAPS ka kotlo e kgolo ho mekgatlo ya matjhaba ya dithethefatsi ka mora ho fumana khokheine ya boleng ba dimilione tse R80 tse ileng tsa tshwarwa ka la 20 Mphalane 2023 ntlong ya polokelo Boemakepeng ba Dube Trade ka hare ho Boemafofane ba Matjhaba ba King Shaka.
tgt: Umthetho wezimvume zamabhizinisi uyachitshiyelwa ukuze uzokweseka bonke labo abafisa ukuhweba emkhakheni ongahlelekile.

src: Matsatsi a mabedi pele ho kgapo eo, khokheine e nngwe ya boleng ba dimilione tse R70 le yona e ile ya fumanwa ka khontheinareng Boemakepeng ba Durban.
tgt: Indlela Edidiyelwe Yokulwa Nobugebengu IKhabhinethi lincome i-SAPS ngokuhlakaza amaqembu ashushumbisa izidakamizwa kwamanye amazwe kulandela ukuvunjululwa kwezidakamizwa zohlobo lwe-cocaine zenani lezigidi ezingama-R80 ezishaqwe mhla wama-20 kuMfumfu 2023 endaweni yokugcina impahla e-Dube Trade Port ngaphakathi e-King Shaka International Airport.

src: Letsholo la Tshireletseho Nakong ya Matsatsi a Phomolo le se ntse le beha ditholwana ka ho tshwara ha mapolesa babelaellwa ba fetang 140, ho kenyelletsa le eo ho thweng ke nkokonono ya morafo o seng molaong, le ho hapuwa ha dithunya tse se nang laesense.
tgt: Ezinsukwini ezimbili ngaphambi kokushaqwa kwezidakamizwa, enye i-cocaine yenani lezigidi ezingama-R70 yashaqwa kwisiqukathi esiseChwebeni laseThekwini.

src: Ketelo ya ho Hlahloba ya Mopresidente Kabinete e thabetse Ketelo ya ho Hlahloba ya Mopresidente Masepaleng wa Emfuleni, e ileng ya latelwa ke dikopano le setjhaba nakong ya ketelo ya Mohlala wa Ntshetsopele ya Ditereke ya 2022.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lishayela ihlombe i-SAPS ngomsebenzi wabo wokuphazamisa nokuhlakaza ubugebengu obuhleliwe obubeka imiphakathi nesizwe sakithi engozini.

src: Ketelo ya 2022 Emfuleni e qoollotse mathata a tlhokomelo e mpe ya ditshebeletso ke masepala.
tgt: Umkhankaso i-Operation Safer Festive Season usuvele uyaqala ukuthela izithelo emva kokuthi amaphoyisa ebophe abasolwa abayi-140, kubandakanya nosolwa ngokuba ngungqondongqondo ekumbiweni kwezimayini ngokungemthetho, kanye nokushaqwa kwezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni.

src: Ka ho kenella ha Lefapha la Metsi le Bohlweki, ho bile le tswelopele e bonahalang tabeng ya ho rarolla mathata a ditshebeletso tsa metsi le bohlweki tse felletseng ka ho putlama ha tsamaiso ya Metsi a Ditshila Vaal.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukele uHambo lukaMongameli Lokuyohlola Ukuqhubeka Komsebenzi oluya kuMasipala wase-Emfuleni, obelulandelela ezingxoxweni ezaba khona nomphakathi ngesikhathi kuqhutshwa uHlelo lokuThuthukiswa Kwezifunda ngowezi-2022.

src: Mosebetsi o entswe bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa phano ya metsi, tshebetso e nepahetseng ya tsamaiso ya metsi a ditshila mme kahoo ha fediswa bothata ba metsi a dikgwerekgwere tse ditshila a mathang diterateng le dijareteng tsa batho.
tgt: Uhambo lwangowezi-2022 lokuvakashela e-Emfuleni lwatholana nezinkinga zokuthi umasipala akazinakekeli kahle izingqalasizinda.

src: Tswelopele e hlokomelehang nakong ya ketelo ena e kenyelletsa ntlafatso diphaepheng tse ngata tsa bohlokwa le diteisheneng tsa ho pompa metsi, ho ntjhafatswa le ho tiiswa ha ditsela, hammoho le tlhahiso e kgolo ya mabone a seterateng bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa kganya le polokeho.
tgt: Ngokungenelela koMnyango Wamanzi Nokuthuthwa Kwendle sekube nenqubekelaphambili ebonakalayo ekubhekaneni nezinselele zengqalasizinda yamanzi nokuthuthwa kwendle eziholele ekuweni kwe-Vaal Waste Water.

src: Leano Bakeng sa Tsamaiso ya Thepa Afrika Borwa Lefapha la Dipalangwang le tswetsepele ho qala dipuisno ka Leano le mabapi le Tsamaiso ya Thepa Afrika Borwa, e le karolo ya mehato ya ho rarolla mathata ao lefapha la tsamaiso ya thepha le tobanang le ona le ho matlafatsa boiteko ba ho ntlafatsa moruo wa Afrika Borwa.
tgt: Umsebenzi usuwenziwe ukwenza ngcono ukuthunyelwa kwamanzi, ukusebenza kahle kwengqalasizinda yamanzi angcolile lokho okuzoqeda inkinga yezitamukoko ezichithekela emigwaqeni nasemagcekeni abantu.

src: Ntshetsopele ya Mehaho le Tlhokomelo Kabinete e thabetse tswelopele e entsweng ho ntshetsopele ya mehaho le tlhokomelo ka ho phethwa ha kaho ya marokgo a mahaeng a 36 tlasa Welisizwe Rural Bridges, le kaho e ntseng e tswelapele diprojekeng tse 20 dibakeng tsa bodulo ba batho, ditseleng le metsi.
tgt: Inqubekelaphambili ebonakele ngesikhathi sokuyohlola umsebenzi ibandakanya inqwaba yamapayipi kanye neziteshi ezimpompa amanzi, ukulungiswa nokugcwaliswa kwemigwaqo, kanye nokufakwa kwezibani zasemgwaqeni ukuze kuzokhanya kangcono futhi kuphephe.

src: Ho Thakgolwa Botjha ha Ditsela tsa Matjhaba tsa South African Airways (SAA) Kabinete e thabetse ho thakgolwa botjha ha ditsela tsa matjhaba tsa SAA ka ho kenyelletsa botjha maeto a sefofane dikhonthinenteng tse ding a yang São Paulo, Brazil, e leng se boetseng sa tshwaya ho kgutla ha tshebeletso ya nako e telele ka ntle ho Cape Town le Johannesburg.
tgt: UMnyango Wezokuthutha usuziqalile izingxoxo zeNkombandlela yoHlelo Lokuthuthwa Kwempahla eNingizimu Afrika, njengenye yemizamo yokubhekana nezinselele ezibhekene nomkhakha wezokuthuthwa kwempahla kanye nokuqinisa imizamo yokuvuselela umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ho kgutla ha SAA ditseleng tsa matjhaba ho tla tlatsetsa ka ho toba kgolong ya ketelo ya matjhabeng naheng ya rona, le ho kgolo lefapheng la bohahlaodi ka mora tshenyo e bakilweng ke sewa sa COVID-19.
tgt: Ukuthuthukiswa Nokunakekelwa Kwengqalasizinda IKhabhinethi lamukele inqubekelaphambili esiyenziwe ngokuthuthukiswa nokunakekelwa kwezingqalasizinda ngokuphothulwa kwamabhuloho asemakhaya angama-36 ngaphansi kohlelo i-Welisizwe Rural Bridges, kanye nokwakhiwa okuqhubekayo kwemiklamo engama-20 ekuhlalisweni kwabantu, imigwaqo, namanzi.

src: Afrika Borwa e Thakgotse Drone e Kgolo ka ho Fetisa Afrika Kabinete e lebohisitse ba Sesole le khampani ya difofane ya Milkor ka katleho ya yona ya ho thakgola sefofane se sa hlokeng ho palangwa hore se fofiswe (UAV) sa Milkor 380, e leng se behang Afrika Borwa hara dinaha tse tswelang pele ho etsa kgatelo pele theknolojing ya di-drone.
tgt: Ukwethulwa futhi kwemizila yamazwe ngamazwe ye-South African Airways (i-SAA).

src: Milkor 380 ke drone e kgolo ka ho fetisisa e entsweng Afrika mme e tla sebediswa ke masole ha ho na le dintwa, ha ba disa moedi, ha ba disa dimela le diphoofolo tse hlaha, ho kenyelletsang twantso ya ho tsoma ho seng molaong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukele ukwethulwa futhi kwemizila yamazwe ngamazwe ye-SAA ngokuthi kuphinde kwethulwe izindiza eziya e-São Paulo, e-Brazil, okuphinde kwabuyisa ukusebenza kwezindiza osekudonse isikhathi eside eKapa naseGoli.

src: Ditlhahlobo tsa Metriki le tsa Sekolo tsa Qetellong ya Selemo Kabinete e thabetse qalo e tsamaileng ka thello ya ditlhahlobo tsa 2023 tsa National Senior Certificate (metriki), tse qadileng ka la 30 Mphalane 2023.
tgt: Ibuya le-SAA emizileni yamazwe ngamazwe kuzofaka ngqo igalelo ekukhuleni kwezokuvakasha kwamazwe ngamazwe kuleli lizwe, kanye nokukhula komkhakha wezokungcebeleka emva kokukhahlamezeka okwadalwa wubhubhane lwe-COVID-19.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete Boemo Palestina Kabinete e swabisitswe ke ho hana ha mmuso wa Iseraele ho hlompha molao wa matjhaba le ho tswela pele ho nyenyefatsa diqeto tsa Matjhaba a Kopaneng bakeg sa ho kenya tshebetsong ho emisa ntwa ntle ho kotlo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisele inkampani yezokuVikela Nobuchwepheshe Bezindiza i-Milkor ngokwethula ngempumelelo i-Milkor 380 okuyisithuthi sasemoyeni esizindizelayo (i-UAV), lokho okubeka iNingizimu Afrika phakathi kwamazwe aqhubeka nokwenza ezibukwayo kubuchwepheshe bemishini ezindizelayo ama-drone.

src: Ditsela tsa ho baleha bakeng sa batho ba Palestina di ntse di thibetswe ka phello ya ditlamorao tse bohloko bakeng sa bana, basadi le baahi ba se nang molato.
tgt: I-Milkor 380 iyona-drone enkulukazi eyakhiwe e-Afrika futhi izosetshenziswa ngumkhakha wezokuvikela empini, ekulawulweni kwemingcele, nasemizamweni yokongiwa kwemvelo kubandakanya ukulwa nokuzingela ngokungemthetho.

src: Ditlhaselo tsa batho ba Palestina ka difofane tsa mmuso wa Iseraele, di tswelapele mme palo ya batho ba shwang e a eketseha mo e kenyelletsang basadi le bana.
tgt: Izivivinyo zikaMatikuletsheni neZokuphela Konyaka.

src: Matsatsing a mabedi a fetileng, lefatshe le ile la sheba ho se letho leo le ka se etsang le shebelletse ha tlhaselo ya difofane e ba matla ho Gaza le ho West Bank moo dikolo, dipetlele, diambulense le mahae a baahi hammoho le ditsela tseo ho thweng di sireletsehile tse yang ka Borwa ho Gaza di thuntshwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukele ukuqala kahle kwezivivinyo zangowezi-2023 zikaMatikuletsheni, eziqale mhla wama-30 kuMfumfu 2023.

src: Bakeng sa dintlha tsena, Kabinete e entse qeto ya ho bitsa bodiplomate bohle ba Afrika Borwa ho tswa Tel Aviv ho tla hlalosa hore hantlehantle ke eng se etsahalang mono.
tgt: Abazali nababheki babafundi bayagqugquzelwa ukuthi baqhubeke nokweseka abafundi ngalesi sikhathi esibalulekile.

src: Kabinete e boetse e hlokometse dipuo tse nyenyefatsang tse tswelang pele tsa lenqosa la Iseraele ho Afrika Borwa, Monghadi Eliav Belotsercovsky, kgahlahonong la Maafrika Borwa, boetapele ba Afrika Borwa ka hare le ka ntle ho mmuso ho kenyelletsa le setjhaba se buang kgahlanong le polao e sehlooho e etswang ke mmuso wa Iseraele kgahlanong le Mapalestina.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lidangele ngokunqaba kukahulumeni wakwa-Israel ukuthi uhloniphe umthetho wamazwe ngamazwe nokuthi iqhubeke nokuthathela phansi izisombululo zeNhlangano Yezizwe Ezibumbene zokumiswa kwempi ngaphandle kwezijeziso.

src: Dipuo tse nyenyefatsang tsa Lenqosa Belotsercovsky di fapane le dipolelo tsa manqosa a mehleng a mabedi a Iseraele ho Afrika Borwa (Illan Baruch le Dr. Alon Liel) a nnileng a dula a tsitsitse ha a hlalosa diketso tsa mmuso wa bona kgahlanong le Palestinians e le Kgethollo le Lehloyo la Morabe o mong.
tgt: Imigudu yokusiza ukuphuma abantu base-Palestine isalokhu ivaliwe nokunomphumela omubi ebantwaneni, abesifazane kanye nezakhamuzi ezimsulwa.

src: Dipuo tsa nyenyefatsang kgahlanong le ba buang kgahlanong le tlhekefetso le baetapele ba naha di etsa hore boemo ba lenqosa Belotsercovsky e be bo sa hlokomelweng le ho feta.
tgt: Ukuhlasela ngezindiza kukahulumeni wakwa-Israel ehlasela abantu base-Palestine, kuyaqhubeka nokwenyusa izibalo zabantu abashonayo kubandakanya abasifazane nabantwana.

src: Kahoo Kabinete e laetse Lefapha la Dikamano tsa Matjhaba le Tshebedisano hore le fetisetse molao wa mmuso ka molao wa metjha ya bodiplomate wa ho se thabele se etswang ke lenqosa lena la bodiplomate.
tgt: Ezinsukwini ezimbili ezedlule, umhlaba wonke ungenakwenza lutho ubuke ukuhlaselwa ngezindiza e-Gaza nase-West Bank okucekele phansi izikole, izikhungo zezempilo, izimoto ezithwala iziguli kanye nengqalasizinda yomphakathi kanye nemigwaqo ephephile ephumela eNingizimu ye-Gaza.

src: Polelo ya Leano la Bajete ya Tekanyetso ya Nako e Mahareng Kabinete e thabetse Bajete ya Tekanyetso ya Nako e Mahareng ya 2023 (MTBPS), e faneng ka tekanyo e tshepahalang ya boemo ba moruo ba hona jwale mme ya bontsha ho tshwarella ka tiyo ha mmuso ditjheleteng tsa naha hara dikgaello tse boima tsa tjhelete.
tgt: Ngalokhu-ke, iKhabhinethi linqume ukubuyisa wonke amanxusa aseNingizimu Afrika ase-Tel Aviv ukuze kuzoxoxiswana.

src: Diqeto tsa MTBPS di ntlafatsa moralo wa ditjhelete wa rona di ntlafatsa kgolo ya moruo ha ka nako e tshwanang di lekalekanya boitlamo ba rona setjhabeng bo tshehetsang mafutsana naheng ya rona.
tgt: Eliav Belotsercovsky, elwisana nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ubuholi baseNingizimu Afrika ngaphakathi nangaphandle kuhulumeni kubandakanya umphakathi ozwakalisa ukuphikisana nokubulawa kwabantu base-Palestine bebulawa uhulumeni wakwa-Israel.

src: Leano la Ntlafatso le Kahobotjha ya Moruo di bile le seabo ho ditholwana tse ngata tse ntle ho moralo wa ditjhelete moruong wa rona.
tgt: Lezi zinkulumo ezinendelelo zeNxusa u-Belotsercovsky ziphikiswa yizitatimende zamanxusa amabili aphambilini akwa-Israeli eNingizimu Afrika (u-Illan Baruch noDkt.

src: Ho Ahuwa ha Seporo sa Terene ya Lebelo le Phahameng Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana Ho Ahuwa ha Seporo sa Terene e Tsamayang ka Lebelo le Phahameng mme Letona la Dipalangwang le la Ditjhelete ba tla tshohla taba ya ditjhelete tse tla hlokahalang bakeng sa ho kenya monahano ona tshebetsong.
tgt: Alon Liel) abalokhu bemile ekutheni lezi zenzo zikahulumeni wabo kubantu base-Palestine zifana nezoBandlululo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana ho potlakiswa ha marangrang a diphaseje tsa Johannesburg ho ya Durban bakeng sa boithuto bo felletseng ba kgonahalo e jwalo, le ho tloha Johannesburg ho ya Polokwane ho isa Musina, le Johannesburg ho ya Mbombela di tla behwa mmarakeng.
tgt: Lezi zinkulumo ezinendelelo ezibhekiswe kulabo abazwakalisa ukungahambisani nonya kanye nabaholi bezwe zenza isikhundla senxusa u-Belotsercovsky singavikeleki.

src: Moralo wa Tokomane ya Leano la Mmuso ho Boahi, Ho Falla le Tshireletso ya Baphaphathehi Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana kgatiso ya Tokomane ya Leano la Mmuso ho Boahi, ho Falla le Tshireletso ya Baphaphathehi bakeng sa maikutlo a setjhaba.
tgt: Ngalokhu-ke iKhabhinethi seliyalele uMnyango Wezobudlelwano Bamazwe Nokubambisana ukuthi lidlulise ngokusemthethweni ukunganami kukahulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika ngenxusa ngokulandela imigudu efanele yobunxusa.

src: Moralo wa Leano lena o reretswe ho fana ka motheo bakeng sa tataiso ya ho fana ka bodulo le boahi ho batho ba tswang kantle ho naha, hammoho le tshireletso ya baphaphathehi le ya phaphathehi ba dipolotiki ka hare ho Afrika Borwa, ka ho lemoha dithahasello tsa tshireletso ya naha tsa Rephabliki le ho ikobela tumellano ya matjhaba le melao ya ho falla eo Afrika Borwa e leng karolo ya yona.
tgt: ISitatimende Senqubomgomo Yesabelomali Saphakathi Nonyaka IKhabhinethi lamukele ISitatimende Senqubomgomo Yesabelomali Lwesikhathi Esiphakathi (i-MTBPS), esinikeze ngohlolo olucacile ngesimo samanje somnotho futhi sabonisa ukuzimelela kukahulumeni ezimalini zesizwe yize kubhekenwe nezinselele zemali engenayo.

src: Tlaleho ya Selemo sa bo6 ya Kgatelopele ya Tokomane ya Leano ho Ditokelo tsa Batho ba Holofofetseng Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana ho phatlalatswa koranteng ya mmuso ha Tlaleho ya Selemo sa bo6 ya Kgatelopele ya Tokomane ya Leano ho Ditokelo tsa Batho ba Holofofetseng ho kenngwa tshebetsong.
tgt: Izinqumo eziku-MTBPS zenza ngcono uhlaka lwethu lwezezimali zivuselela ukukhula komnotho ngesikhathi zihambelanisa ukuzibophezela kwethu emiphakathini nokuzokweseka labo ababuthakathaka esizweni sakithi.

src: Dibili Moralo wa Bili ya Tsosoloso ya Afrika le Letlole la Tshebedisano ya Matjhaba (ARF) Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana tlhahiso ya Phetoho ya Bili ya ARF Palamenteng.
tgt: UHlelo Lokwakha Kabusha Nokuvuselela Umnotho lube negalelo emizamweni eminingi yokongiwa kwemvelo emnothweni wethu.

src: Bili ena e reretswe ho fetola Molao wa ARF (Molao wa bo51 wa 2000) le ho theha Mokgatlo wa Ntshetsopele ya Maqhama ya Afrika Borwa, o tla sebetsa jwalo ka thuluse bakeng sa ho tshehetsa ntshetsopele ya Afrika Borwa le tshebedisano le dinaha tse mabapi ka ho kgothalletsa demokrasi, bookamedi bo molemo, thibelo le tharollo ya dikgohlano, ntshetsopele ya moruo setjhabeng le kopanyo.
tgt: Ukusungulwa Kwesitimela Esihamba Ngesivinini IKhabhinethi ligunyaze uHlaka Lokwakhiwa Kwesitimela Esihamba Ngesivinini kanti imiphumela yezezimali ukuthi siqaliswe izodingidwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezokuthutha kanye Nowezezimali.

src: Ho Thonngwa Pele batho bohle ba thonngwa, ho hlahlobisiswa mangolo a bona a thuto le a mang a hlokahalang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukubekwa phambili komgudu osuka eGoli uya eThekwini ukuthi kwenziwe ucwaningo kuwona, bese kuthi umgudu osuka eGoli uya e-Polokwane udlulele eMusina, kanye nomgudu osuka eGoli uya eMbombela izofakwa emakethe.

src: Ho thonngwa ha Monghadi Ebrahim Rasool jwalo ka Modulasetulo wa Ntshetsopele ya Banka ya Afrika Borwa.
tgt: UMthetho Odingidwayo Osahlongozwa omayelana noBuzwe, Ukufudukela Kwamanye Amazwe kanye Nokuvikelwa Kwabakhoseli.

src: Ho thonngwa ha Mme Margaret Mosibudi Phiri jwalo ka setho sa Boto ya Taolo ya Nuclear ya Naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukushicilelwa koMthetho Osadingidwa omayelana noBuzwe, Ukufudukela Kwamanye Amazwe kanye Nokuvikelwa Kwabakhoseli ukuze umphakathi uzophawula ngawo.

src: Diketsahalo tse Tlang Puisano ya Ntwa Kgahlanong le Bobodu Puisano ya Ntwa Kgahlanong le Bobodu e tla tshwarwa ka la 8 le la 9 Pudungwana 2023 Birchwood Hotel e Ekurhuleni bakeng sa ho hlomella setjhaba twantshong ya bobodu tumellanong le Leano la Naha la Ntwa Kgahlanong le Bobodu la naha ya rona.
tgt: Le Nqubomgomo esahlongozwa kuhloswe ngayo ukuhlinzeka uhlaka lokukhomba indlela ukunikezwa kwabokufika ilungelo lokuhlala kanye nobuzwe, kanjalo nokuvikela abakhoseli eNingizimu Afrika, ngokuvumelana nezokuvikeleka kuzwelonke kanye nokuthobela izivumelwano zamazwe ngamazwe kanye nezindlela ezilandelwayo zokufudukela kwamanye amazwe iNingizimu Afrika eyingxenye yazo.

src: Lena ke leano la naha le reretsweng ho theha setjhaba se lokokohileng bobodung ha ka nako e tshwanang le kgothalletsang baahi hore ba se ke ba mamella bobodu mme ba ikobele ditaelo tsa molao.
tgt: UMbiko Wenqubekelaphambili Waminyaka Yonke wesi-6 omayelana nokuqaliswa koMthetho Osadingidwa ngaMalungelo Abantu Abaphila Nokukhubazeka.

src: Letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 la 2023 la Thibelo ya Tlhekefetso ya Basadi le Bana Selemo sena se tshwaya sehopotso sa bo25 sa ho nka karolo ha Afrika Borwa ho Letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 bakeng sa Thibelo ya Tlhekefetso ya Basadi le Bana, se tla ketekwa tlasa sehlooho se reng: “Ho tiisa mehato ya ho fedisa Tlhekefetso ya Bong le Polao ya Basadi (GBVF): Ho se siye mang kapa mang morao”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukushicilelwa kusomqulu kahulumeni koMbiko Wenqubekelaphambili Waminyaka Yonke ngokuqaliswa koMthetho Osadingidwa ngaMalungelo Abantu Abaphila Nokukhubazeka.

src: Letsholo lena la lefatsheng ka bophara le ba teng ho tloha ka la 25 Pudungwana, Letsatsi la Matjhaba bakeng sa ho Fedisa Tlhekefetso kgahlanong le Basadi ho isa ho la 10 Tshitwe, Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Ditokelo tsa Botho.
tgt: Ukushicilelwa kombiko wenqubekelaphambili kuzohambisana nesikhumbuzo samazwe ngamazwe seNyanga Yokuqwashisa Ngamalungelo Abantu Abaphila Nokukhubazeka kusuka ngomhla wesi-3 kuLwezi kuya mhla wesi-3 kuZibandlela.

src: Foramo ya bo14 ya Dipuisano tsa Maano Afrika Borwa e tla ba moamohedi mmoho ho Foramo ya bo14 ya Dipuisano tsa Maano e sebedisana mmoho le UNESCO International Teacher Task Force bakeng sa Thuto (TTF) ka Pherekgong 2024 tlasa sehlooho se reng “Ho rarollo bothata ba kgaello ya matitjhere le ho etsa hore mosebetsi ona o kgahle”.
tgt: Umbiko wenqubekelaphambili uphinde ubonise ukunyuka kwenani elibekiwe labantu abaphila nokukhubazeka abasebenzayo lisuka ku-2% liya ku-3% kusuka ngonyakamali wezi-2024/2025, liqhubeke liye ku-7% kubantu abaphila nokukhubazeka uma kufika unyaka wezi-2030.

src: Foramo ena e tla kopanya basebetsi ba mmuso, di-NGO, matitjhere le ditsebi tsa thuto bakeng sa ho tshohla ditaba tsa bohlokwa tse mabapi le maemo a tshebetso bakeng sa matitjhere, ditaba tsa boikemelo le boikarabelo ba matitjhere hammo le kamoo ho ka etswang hore botitjhere e be mosebetsi o kgahlang.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa Osahlongozwa Wokuvuselelwa kwe-Afrika kanye neSikhwama Sokusebenzisana Kwamazwe Ngamazwe (i-ARF) IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukulethwa ePhalamende koMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela we-ARLo Mthethosivivinywa kuhloswe ngawo ukuchibiyela uMthetho we-ARF (uMthetho wama-51 wezi-2000) kanye nokusungula i-Ejensi Ebhekele Ukuthuthukiswa kweNingizimu Afrika, ezosebenza njengendlela yokweseka ukuthuthukiswa kweNingizimu Afrika kanye nokusebenzisana namazwe angozakwethu ngokugqugquzela intando yeningi labantu, ukuhola ngendlela efanele, ukugwema kanye nokuxazulula ukungaboni ngasolinye, ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlanganiswa kwenhlalo-mnotho.

src: Naledi ya lebelo la Moto GP Brad Binder eo hona jwale a tshwereng rekoto ya maemo a hodimo a primiyamo bakeng sa Afrika Borwa ka mora ho ba ya itlhommeng pele hara bahlodi ba bararo ba qetileng lebelo la Thailand Grand Prix.
tgt: 1 INkulumo-mpendulwano emayelana Nokulwisana Nenkohlakalo.1 INkulumo-mpendulwano emayelana Nokulwisana Nenkohlakalo izobanjwa mhla wesi-8 kuya mhla wesi-9 kuLwezi 2023 e-Birchwood Hotel e-Ekurhuleni ukuze kuzonxenxwa umphakathi ezinhlelweni zokulwisana nenkohlakalo ezihambisana neQhingasu likaZwelonke Lokulwisana Nenkohlakalo.

src: Mampodi wa pele ya phahamisang ditshepe ya tsamayang ka wheelchair wa Afrika Borwa Macethandile Kulati bakeng sa ho sirelletsa sekola sa hae ho 2023 International Federation of Body Builders and Fitness World Championship Slovenia.
tgt: NgoLwezi wezi-2020, iKhabhinethi lagunyaza IQhingasu likaZwelonke Lokulwisana Nenkohlakalo (i-NACS 2020-2030).

src: Di-chartered Accountant tsa Afrika Borwa bakeng sa ho fumana maemo a phahameng ho tlhahlobo ya lefatshe ya ditsebi tse tsheptjoang ya Edelman.
tgt: Leli yiqhingasu lezwe okuhloswe ngalo ukwakha umphakathi ongenankohlakalo ngesikhathi kuphinde kugqugquzelwa izakhamuzi ukuthi zingayibekezeleli inkohlakalo futhi zithobele umthetho.

src: Ngaka Claude Mashego bakeng sa ho hapa ka lekgetlo la pele Miss World South Africa mme jwale o tla emela Afrika Borwa tlhodisanong ya Miss World New Delhi, India ka Tshitwe selemong sena.
tgt: 2 UMkhankaso Wezinsuku eziyi-16 Wokulwisana Nodlame Olubhekiswe Kwabesifazane Nezingane wangowezi-20.1 Lo nyaka usho ukuphela kweminyaka engama-25 yokuzibandakanya kweNingizimu Afrika Emkhankasweni Wezinsuku eziyi-16 Wokulwisana Nodlame Olubhekiswe Kwabesifazane Nezingane ozokhunjulwa ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: “Sisheshisa izinyathelo zokuqeda uDlame Olubhekiswe Kwabobulili Obuthile kanye Nokubulawa Kwabesifazane (i-GBVF): Asishiyi muntu ngemuva”.2 Lo mkhankaso womhlaba uqhubeka kusuka mhla wama-25 kuLwezi, okunguSuku Lwamazwe Ngamazwe Lokuqeda Udlame Olubhekiswe Kwabesifazane kuze kube ngumhla we-10 kuZibandlela, okunguSuku Lwamazwe Ngamazwe Lwamalungelo Abantu.

src: Mmuelli Kholeka Gcaleka ho latela ho kgethwa ha hae jwalo ka Mosireletsi wa Setjhaba e motjha bakeng sa nako ya dilemo tse supileng tse tla qala ka la 1 Pudungwana 2023.
tgt: 3 IForamu ye-14 Yenkulumo-mpendulwano yeNqubomgomo.1 INingizimu Afrika izosingatha ngokubambisana iForamu ye-14 yeNkulumo-mpendulwano yeNqubomgomo neThimba Lamazwe Ngamazwe Labasebenzi Abangothisha Kwezemfundo (i-TTF) le-UNESCO ngoMasingana wezi-2024 ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: “Sibhekana nokuntuleka kothisha futhi senza umsebenzi wothisha uheheke”.

src: Matshediso Kabinete e fetisetsa matshidiso le kutlwelo bohloko ho malapa le metswalle ya:

src: Mohapi wa medale ya kgauta dipapading tsa batho ba holofetseng Zanele Situ eo e neng e le moatlelete wa pele wa mosadi wa Moafrika Borwa wa motho e motsho ho hapa medale ya kgauta Dipapading tsa Batho ba Holofetseng Sydney ka 2000.

tgt: Ngale kwezinkinga ezibekhona emdlalweni wabo bebhekene ne-India izolo, izwe lisamile ekwesekeni iqembu futhi linethemba elikhulu ukuthi lizoqhubeka nokusenza ukuthi sizigqaje.
